  var msg91WidgetConfig = {
    widgetId: window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG.MSG91_WIDGET_ID,
    tokenAuth: window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG.MSG91_WIDGET_TOKEN_AUTH,
    exposeMethods: true,
    captchaRenderId: 'msg91-captcha',
    success: function (data) { console.log('MSG91 widget success:', data); },
    failure: function (error) { console.warn('MSG91 widget failure:', error); },
  };
</script>
<script type="text/javascript">
(function loadOtpScript(urls) {
  var i = 0;
  function attempt() {
    var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = urls[i];
    s.async = true;
    s.onload = function () {
      if (typeof window.initSendOTP === 'function') {
        window.initSendOTP(msg91WidgetConfig);
      }
    };
    s.onerror = function () {
      i++;
      if (i < urls.length) attempt();
    };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }
  attempt();
})([
  'https://verify.msg91.com/otp-provider.js',
  'https://verify.phone91.com/otp-provider.js'
]);
</script>

<script>
  // Bulk order form -> Netlify Function (no page navigation, so no 404).
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('bulk-order-form');
    if (!form) return;
    const btn = document.getElementById('bulk-submit-btn');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('bulk-status');
    const successEl = document.getElementById('bulk-success');

    function showError(msg) {
      statusEl.style.display = 'block';
      statusEl.style.color = '#ff6b6b';
      statusEl.textContent = msg;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      statusEl.style.display = 'none';

      const data = {
        org: form.org.value.trim(),
        name: form.name.value.trim(),
        phone: form.phone.value.trim(),
        email: form.email.value.trim(),
        quantity: form.quantity.value.trim(),
        needed_by: form.needed_by.value.trim(),
        details: form.details.value.trim(),
        'bot-field': form['bot-field'] ? form['bot-field'].value : '',
      };

      if (!data.org || !data.name || !data.phone || !data.email) {
        showError('Please fill in organisation, contact person, phone and email.');
        return;
      }

      btn.disabled = true;
      const originalLabel = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Sending…';

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/bulk-order-submit', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(data),
        });
        const out = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (res.ok && out.ok) {
          form.style.display = 'none';
          successEl.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          showError(out.error || 'Something went wrong. Please try again or email hello@zivogift.com.');
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = originalLabel;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showError('Network error. Please check your connection and try again.');
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = originalLabel;
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  document.getElementById('contact-wa')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG.WHATSAPP_NUMBER}`, '_blank');
  });

  // Contact form -> Netlify Function (no page navigation, so no 404).
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
    if (!form) return;
    const btn = document.getElementById('contact-submit-btn');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('contact-status');
    const successEl = document.getElementById('contact-success');

    function showError(msg) {
      statusEl.style.display = 'block';
      statusEl.style.color = '#ff6b6b';
      statusEl.textContent = msg;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      statusEl.style.display = 'none';

      const data = {
        name: form.name.value.trim(),
        email: form.email.value.trim(),
        phone: form.phone.value.trim(),
        message: form.message.value.trim(),
        'bot-field': form['bot-field'] ? form['bot-field'].value : '',
      };

      if (!data.name || !data.email || !data.message) {
        showError('Please fill in your name, email and message.');
        return;
      }

      btn.disabled = true;
      const originalLabel = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Sending…';

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/contact-submit', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(data),
        });
        const out = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (res.ok && out.ok) {
          form.style.display = 'none';
          successEl.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          showError(out.error || 'Something went wrong. Please try again or email hello@zivogift.com.');
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = originalLabel;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showError('Network error. Please check your connection and try again.');
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = originalLabel;
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  // Same fix as the homepage digi-cards and the Digital Studio type-picker:
  // these step-cards are static HTML, so hide the ones an admin has
  // switched off in Catalog & Pricing. Fails open on any error.
  (function () {
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) return;
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.step-card[data-product]');
    var ids = Array.prototype.map.call(cards, function (c) { return c.dataset.product; });
    if (!ids.length) return;
    window.ZGSupabase.from('products').select('id,active').in('id', ids).then(function (res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data) return;
      var inactive = {};
      res.data.forEach(function (p) { if (!p.active) inactive[p.id] = true; });
      cards.forEach(function (c) { if (inactive[c.dataset.product]) c.style.display = 'none'; });
    });
  })();
</script>

With a <strong>Voice Gift</strong> you upload or record a voice note, and with a <strong>Video Gift</strong> you upload or record a video — each is delivered as a personalised gift page on WhatsApp with your chosen occasion, title and message. A <strong>Group Video Tribute</strong> lets several friends each add a video into one shared page, ideal for graduations, farewells and work anniversaries.</p>
    </details>
  </div>

    /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       ZIVOGIFT REVEAL — v2
       The v1 reveal was a chain of five setTimeouts totalling 9–13 seconds,
       derived from the message's WORD COUNT, with nothing tappable in
       between. Three things were wrong with that, and this rewrite is
       organised around fixing them:
       1. NO USER GESTURE. Video and audio gifts called .play() on page load.
          iOS Safari and Chrome block that, so the video sat on frame 0 and a
          25s fallback then skipped to the end — the recipient never saw the
          gift at all. Everything now starts from a tap (Act 0 → Act 1),
          which is the gesture that unlocks media playback.
       2. NO CONTROL. No skip, no replay, no progress. If you looked away you
          missed it, and there was no way back.
       3. TIMINGS DERIVED FROM CONTENT. runAudioReveal() hard-coded a 14000ms
          wait for a sequence whose length depended on word count. Every
          timing now lives in the TIMING block in JS, and the audio player is
          chained to the actual act transition instead of guessing.
       Structure: four acts on one stage.
         0 SEALED   — envelope + name + "Tap to open"
         1 UNSEAL   — seal breaks, particles, name assembles
         2 MESSAGE  — words, or the video/voice note
         3 KEEPSAKE — the card, and everything you can do with it
       ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

    /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       ACT 3 — KEEPSAKE, v2.1 "the object"
       The v2 keepsake was functionally complete but visually flat: a
       translucent rounded box on a static gradient, with the actual card —
       the thing the recipient came for — hidden behind a button they had to
       find and press. Three changes:
         1. THE CARD IS THE HERO. It loads automatically on arrival and is
            presented as a physical object: perspective, tilt-on-pointer,
            a one-shot specular sheen, a deep shadow and an accent rim.
         2. THE BACKGROUND MOVES. Two slow aurora blobs in the vibe accent
            drift behind everything. Cheap (two blurred radials, GPU
            composited) and it stops the page feeling like a form.
         3. ACTIONS ARE ALWAYS REACHABLE. A glass action bar pinned to the
            bottom, so Save/Share never scroll off on a small phone.
       All of it is inside prefers-reduced-motion guards further down.
       ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

      #message-quote { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      #msg-intro { opacity: .85; transform: none; }
      .emoji-fly { display: none; }
    }

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  // ── TIMING ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Every delay in the reveal, in one place. v1 scattered these across five
  // setTimeout calls and then hard-coded a 14000ms wait elsewhere that had to
  // stay in sync with them by hand — it did not.
  var TIMING = {
    charStagger:   70,    // per letter, Act 1
    nameHold:      1500,  // after the last letter before Act 2
    wordStagger:   105,   // per word, Act 2
    messageHold:   1800,  // after the last word before the sender line
    fromHold:      2000,  // sender line on screen before Act 3
    actFade:       650,   // cross-fade between acts
    mediaFallback: 30000, // if a video never fires 'ended', move on anyway
    minMessage:    2600,  // floor, so a two-word message is not a blink
    maxMessage:    9000   // ceiling, so a 300-word essay is not a wait
  };
  var REDUCED = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  // ── STATE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var giftId    = null;
  var gift      = null;
  var vibe      = (window.ZG_VIBE_TOKENS && window.ZG_VIBE_TOKENS.DEFAULT) || { bg1:'#1a0530', bg2:'#0d1a4a', accent:'#FFE135', text:'#fff' };
  var currentAct = -1;
  var timers    = [];
  var animFrame = null;
  var particles = [];
  var revealMode = REDUCED ? 'reduced_motion' : 'full';
  var completedReported = false;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  // ── PER-GIFT-TYPE REVEAL THEMES ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Every gift type used to run the exact same word-by-word reveal with no
  // sense of what KIND of gift it was. Each type now carries its own:
  //   intro  — a one-line framing shown above the message ("The verdict is in.")
  //   emojis — a themed burst that rises behind the message card on reveal
  // The card colours themselves still come from the vibe/persona system; this
  // layer adds the personality on top of it.
  var REVEAL_THEMES = {
    birthday_note:      { intro: 'Happy birthday \u2014 and they meant this', emojis: ['\uD83C\uDF82','\uD83C\uDF89','\uD83C\uDF88','\u2728','\uD83E\uDD73'] },
    meme_card:          { intro: 'Certified unserious',                       emojis: ['\uD83D\uDE02','\uD83D\uDC80','\uD83D\uDD25','\uD83D\uDE2D','\uD83D\uDC4C'] },
    midnight_drop:      { intro: 'Delivered right at midnight',               emojis: ['\uD83C\uDF19','\u2B50','\u2728','\uD83C\uDF20'] },
    hype_reel:          { intro: 'Now go get it',                             emojis: ['\uD83D\uDD25','\u26A1','\uD83D\uDCAA','\u2728','\uD83D\uDE80'] },
    farewell_note:      { intro: 'Before you go',                             emojis: ['\uD83C\uDF93','\uD83C\uDF1F','\uD83D\uDC9B','\uD83D\uDD4A\uFE0F'] },
    love_note:          { intro: 'Someone\u2019s been thinking about you',    emojis: ['\uD83D\uDC8C','\uD83D\uDC96','\uD83C\uDF39','\u2728'] },
    personal_message:   { intro: 'In their own words',                        emojis: ['\uD83C\uDF99\uFE0F','\uD83D\uDCAC','\u2728'] },
    media_video:        { intro: 'Press play',                               emojis: ['\uD83C\uDFAC','\u2728','\uD83C\uDF7F'] },
    media_audio:        { intro: 'Press play \u2014 headphones on',           emojis: ['\uD83C\uDFA7','\uD83C\uDF99\uFE0F','\u2728'] },
    character_drop:     { intro: 'A mystery sender appears',                  emojis: ['\uD83C\uDFAD','\uD83D\uDD2E','\u2728'] },
    squad_drop:         { intro: 'Your squad showed up',                      emojis: ['\uD83D\uDC65','\uD83C\uDF89','\uD83D\uDD25','\u2728'] },
    squad_memory_board: { intro: 'Look what they put together',              emojis: ['\uD83D\uDCF8','\uD83D\uDC9B','\u2728','\uD83E\uDDF5'] },
    roast_certificate:  { intro: 'The verdict is in',                         emojis: ['\uD83D\uDCDC','\uD83D\uDE02','\uD83D\uDD25','\u2696\uFE0F'] },
    horoscope_drop:     { intro: 'The stars had notes on you',                emojis: ['\uD83D\uDD2E','\u2728','\uD83C\uDF1F','\u264C'] },
    exam_survival_kit:  { intro: 'You\u2019ve got this',                      emojis: ['\uD83D\uDCDA','\u2615','\u270D\uFE0F','\uD83D\uDCAA'] },
    standard:           { intro: 'Someone sent this your way',                emojis: ['\uD83C\uDF81','\u2728','\uD83C\uDF89'] }
  };
  function themeFor(type) { return REVEAL_THEMES[type] || REVEAL_THEMES.standard; }
  // Themed emoji burst — a handful of the gift type's emojis rise from behind
  // the message card and fade. Purely decorative, DOM-based (no canvas), and a
  // complete no-op under reduced motion.
  function spawnEmojiBurst(emojis) {
    if (REDUCED || !emojis || !emojis.length) return;
    var stage = $('stage');
    var count = 14;
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var el = document.createElement('span');
      el.className = 'emoji-fly';
      el.textContent = emojis[i % emojis.length];
      var startX = 12 + Math.random() * 76;               // vw
      var drift  = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 26;            // vw sideways
      el.style.left = startX + 'vw';
      el.style.bottom = (8 + Math.random() * 18) + 'vh';
      el.style.setProperty('--ef-x', drift + 'vw');
      el.style.setProperty('--ef-y', -(45 + Math.random() * 35) + 'vh');
      el.style.setProperty('--ef-r', ((Math.random() - 0.5) * 90) + 'deg');
      el.style.setProperty('--ef-dur', (2.2 + Math.random() * 1.4) + 's');
      el.style.setProperty('--ef-delay', (Math.random() * 0.5) + 's');
      el.style.fontSize = (20 + Math.random() * 18) + 'px';
      stage.appendChild(el);
      (function (node) { later(function () { if (node && node.remove) node.remove(); }, 4200); })(el);
    }
  }
  // Every timeout goes through here so Skip and Replay can cancel the whole
  // pending chain in one call. v1 had no handle on its timeouts at all, which
  // is the reason it could not offer a skip button.
  function later(fn, ms) { var t = setTimeout(fn, ms); timers.push(t); return t; }
  function clearTimers() { timers.forEach(clearTimeout); timers = []; }
  // ── VIBE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function applyVibe(vibeKey, giftType, personaKey) {
    var tokens = window.ZG_VIBE_TOKENS;
    vibe = tokens ? tokens.resolveVibe(vibeKey, giftType) : vibe;
    // Character Drop personas override the vibe entirely — the whole point is
    // that the card looks like the persona, not like the sender's taste.
    var persona = (personaKey && window.ZG_PERSONAS) ? window.ZG_PERSONAS[personaKey] : null;
    if (persona) {
      vibe = { bg1:'#0a0a0a', bg2:'#111111', accent: persona.accent_color, text:'#fff', motif:'orb' };
    }
    var root = document.documentElement.style;
    root.setProperty('--accent', vibe.accent);
    root.setProperty('--bg1', vibe.bg1);
    root.setProperty('--bg2', vibe.bg2);
    root.setProperty('--text', vibe.text);
    var bg = persona ? persona.bg_gradient
                     : 'linear-gradient(160deg,' + vibe.bg1 + ' 0%,' + vibe.bg2 + ' 100%)';
    $('stage').style.background = bg;
    $('keepsake').style.background = bg;
  }
  // ── PARTICLES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var canvas = $('particle-canvas');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  function startParticles() {
    if (REDUCED) return;
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    particles = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height + canvas.height,
        size: Math.random() * 5 + 3,
        sx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4,
        sy: -(Math.random() * 2 + 0.8),
        o: Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.2
      });
    }
    canvas.style.opacity = '1';
    drawParticles();
  }
  function drawParticles() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var hex = Math.round(0 * 255);
    particles.forEach(function (p) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = vibe.accent + Math.round(p.o * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
      ctx.fill();
      p.x += p.sx; p.y += p.sy; p.o -= 0.003;
      if (p.y < -20 || p.o <= 0) {
        p.y = canvas.height + 10;
        p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
        p.o = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
      }
    });
    animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
  }
  // v1 only cancelled the rAF loop inside showFinalCard, so on any other exit
  // path it kept running for the life of the tab, draining battery behind a
  // static card.
  function stopParticles() {
    if (animFrame) { cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame); animFrame = null; }
    canvas.style.opacity = '0';
  }
  // ── ACT MACHINE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var ACTS = ['act-sealed', 'act-name', 'act-message'];
  function showAct(idx) {
    currentAct = idx;
    ACTS.forEach(function (id, i) {
      var el = $(id);
      if (i === idx) {
        el.hidden = false;
        requestAnimationFrame(function () { el.classList.add('show'); });
      } else {
        el.classList.remove('show');
        el.hidden = true;
      }
    });
    $('act-dots').querySelectorAll('span').forEach(function (d, i) {
      d.classList.toggle('on', i === idx);
    });
    $('stage-chrome').classList.toggle('show', idx >= 1);
  }
  // ── ACT 0 — SEALED ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderSealed() {
    var first = String(gift.recipient_name || 'Friend').trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
    $('sealed-name').textContent = first;
    // Use the sealed card image from the email as the envelope face. It is
    // almost always already in the browser cache, so it paints with no flash.
    if (gift.teaser_image_url) {
      var card = $('env-card');
      card.classList.add('has-image');
      card.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + gift.teaser_image_url.replace(/"/g, '%22') + '")';
    }
    var type = gift.gift_type || 'standard';
    $('sealed-hint').textContent =
      (type === 'media_video' || type === 'media_audio' || type === 'squad_drop')
        ? 'Sound on, if you can' : 'Best opened somewhere quiet';
    showAct(0);
  }
  // THE GESTURE. Everything downstream depends on this being a real user
  // interaction: it is what lets the browser play video and audio, and it is
  // the only honest signal that the gift was actually opened.
  var opening = false;
  function openGift() {
    if (opening) return;
    opening = true;
    $('env-wrap').classList.add('opening');
    // Fire-and-forget. The reveal must never wait on a network call.
    if (giftId) {
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/mark-gift-opened', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ gift_id: giftId, stage: 'opened' })
      }).catch(function () {});
    }
    if (REDUCED) { showKeepsake(); return; }
    later(function () {
      startParticles();
      runNameAct();
    }, TIMING.actFade);
  }
  $('btn-open').addEventListener('click', openGift);
  $('env-wrap').addEventListener('click', openGift);
  $('env-wrap').addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); openGift(); }
  });
  // ── ACT 1 — NAME ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function runNameAct() {
    var name = String(gift.recipient_name || 'Friend');
    var wrap = $('recipient-chars');
    wrap.innerHTML = '';
    var chars = name.split('');
    chars.forEach(function (ch) {
      var span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'rchar' + (ch === ' ' ? ' space' : '');
      // textContent, never innerHTML — the recipient name is sender-supplied.
      span.textContent = ch === ' ' ? '' : ch;
      wrap.appendChild(span);
    });
    showAct(1);
    chars.forEach(function (_, i) {
      later(function () {
        var els = wrap.querySelectorAll('.rchar');
        if (els[i]) els[i].classList.add('pop');
      }, i * TIMING.charStagger);
    });
    later(runMessageAct, chars.length * TIMING.charStagger + TIMING.nameHold);
  }
  // ── ACT 2 — MESSAGE / MEDIA ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  function runMessageAct() {
    var type = gift.gift_type || 'standard';
    var theme = themeFor(type);
    showAct(2);
    // Themed one-liner above whatever the act shows.
    var intro = $('msg-intro');
    intro.textContent = theme.intro;
    later(function () { intro.classList.add('show'); }, 120);
    if (type === 'media_video' && gift.media_url) { runVideo(theme); return; }
    runWords(theme);
  }
  function runWords(theme) {
    theme = theme || themeFor(gift.gift_type || 'standard');
    var message = String(gift.personal_message || '');
    var quote = $('message-quote');
    var msgEl = $('message-text');
    msgEl.innerHTML = '';
    // Some types (voice note, squad wall) carry no written message — the gift
    // IS the media, played in the keepsake. Don't show an empty quote card;
    // just run the themed burst so the moment still lands.
    var hasText = message.trim().length > 0;
    if (hasText) {
      quote.style.display = '';
      later(function () { quote.classList.add('show'); }, 160);
    } else {
      quote.style.display = 'none';
    }
    // Themed emoji burst rises behind the card as it lands.
    later(function () { spawnEmojiBurst(theme.emojis); }, 260);
    var words = message.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    // Built with createElement + textContent rather than innerHTML with a
    // regex escape. A regex escape only catches literal '<' and '>' and misses
    // typed-out entities like "&lt;img onerror=...&gt;", which the browser's
    // own parser re-decodes into a real tag on innerHTML insertion.
    // textContent has no such gap.
    words.forEach(function (w, i) {
      var span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'word';
      span.textContent = w;
      msgEl.appendChild(span);
      if (i < words.length - 1) msgEl.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
      later(function () { span.classList.add('in'); }, i * TIMING.wordStagger);
    });
    // Clamped, not proportional. v1 let the sequence run as long as the
    // message was, so a long note meant a long stare at static text.
    var spread = Math.min(
      Math.max(words.length * TIMING.wordStagger, TIMING.minMessage),
      TIMING.maxMessage
    );
    later(function () {
      $('from-name').textContent = displaySenderName();
      $('from-reveal').classList.add('show');
    }, spread + TIMING.messageHold);
    later(showKeepsake, spread + TIMING.messageHold + TIMING.fromHold);
  }
  function runVideo(theme) {
    // The video is the message here — hide the text quote card entirely.
    var quote = $('message-quote');
    if (quote) { quote.style.display = 'none'; quote.classList.remove('show'); }
    if (theme) later(function () { spawnEmojiBurst(theme.emojis); }, 300);
    var slot = $('media-slot');
    slot.innerHTML = '';
    $('message-text').textContent = '';
    var holder = document.createElement('div');
    holder.style.position = 'relative';
    var video = document.createElement('video');
    video.src = gift.media_url;
    video.playsInline = true;
    video.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    video.controls = false;
    // Act 0's tap already satisfied the autoplay policy, so we can start with
    // sound. muted=true is kept only as the fallback if play() is still
    // rejected — better a silent video than a frozen first frame, which is
    // what v1 delivered on every iPhone.
    video.muted = false;
    var unmute = document.createElement('button');
    unmute.className = 'media-btn';
    unmute.textContent = '🔊 Tap for sound';
    unmute.hidden = true;
    unmute.onclick = function () { video.muted = false; video.play(); unmute.hidden = true; };
    holder.appendChild(video);
    holder.appendChild(unmute);
    slot.appendChild(holder);
    video.play().catch(function () {
      video.muted = true;
      unmute.hidden = false;
      video.play().catch(function () {});
    });
    video.addEventListener('ended', showKeepsake);
    later(showKeepsake, TIMING.mediaFallback);
  }
  function displaySenderName() {
    var type = gift.gift_type || 'standard';
    var personaKey = gift.persona_key;
    if (type === 'character_drop' && personaKey && window.ZG_PERSONAS && window.ZG_PERSONAS[personaKey]) {
      var p = window.ZG_PERSONAS[personaKey];
      return p.display_name + ' ' + p.emoji;
    }
    return gift.sender_name || 'Someone special';
  }
  // ── SKIP / REPLAY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  $('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', function () {
    revealMode = 'skipped';
    showKeepsake();
  });
  $('btn-replay').addEventListener('click', function () {
    clearTimers();
    completedReported = true;   // already counted; a replay is not a second reveal
    $('keepsake').classList.remove('show');
    $('kp-bar').classList.remove('show');
    document.body.classList.remove('act-keepsake');
    $('stage').hidden = false;
    $('stage').classList.remove('gone');
    $('from-reveal').classList.remove('show');
    $('media-slot').innerHTML = '';
    // Reset the message-quote card + themed intro so a replay animates them in
    // again rather than showing them pre-revealed.
    var q = $('message-quote'); if (q) { q.classList.remove('show'); q.style.display = ''; }
    var mi = $('msg-intro'); if (mi) mi.classList.remove('show');
    // BUG FIX: the .opening class was never cleared, so on every replay the
    // envelope was still in its blown-open end state — scaled out, faded to
    // zero, seal gone. Replay showed an empty screen with a "Tap to open"
    // button under it. Same for the rise classes: without resetting them the
    // second visit to Act 3 skipped its entrance entirely.
    $('env-wrap').classList.remove('opening');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      $('keepsake').querySelectorAll('.kp-rise'),
      function (el) { el.classList.remove('in'); }
    );
    opening = false;
    renderSealed();
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  });
  // ── ACT 3 — KEEPSAKE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function showKeepsake() {
    clearTimers();
    stopParticles();
    var stage = $('stage');
    stage.classList.add('gone');
    later(function () { stage.hidden = true; }, TIMING.actFade);
    var type = gift.gift_type || 'standard';
    $('kp-eyebrow').textContent = eyebrowFor(type);
    // Part 2: sender-chosen gift title, shown above the name when present.
    var kpTitle = $('kp-title');
    if (kpTitle) {
      if (gift.gift_title) { kpTitle.textContent = gift.gift_title; kpTitle.style.display = 'block'; }
      else { kpTitle.style.display = 'none'; }
    }
    $('kp-name').textContent = gift.recipient_name || 'Friend';
    // Media gifts often carry no written note — the media IS the gift. Only
    // show the generic fallback line when there's neither a message nor a title.
    var kpMsg = gift.personal_message || (gift.gift_title ? '' : 'Someone sent you a Zivogift.');
    $('kp-message').textContent = kpMsg;
    $('kp-sender').textContent = displaySenderName();
    if (type === 'character_drop' && gift.persona_key && window.ZG_PERSONAS && window.ZG_PERSONAS[gift.persona_key]) {
      $('kp-message').style.fontFamily = window.ZG_PERSONAS[gift.persona_key].font_style;
    }
    $('keepsake').classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('act-keepsake');
    if (type === 'media_audio' && gift.media_url) mountAudio();
    if (type === 'squad_drop') loadSquadWall();
    // The card is fetched the moment the keepsake opens. Generation is
    // server-side and takes a second or two, so starting it now means the
    // image is usually already there by the time the panels finish rising.
    loadFullCard();
    // Panels rise in sequence rather than all appearing at once — the whole
    // point of Act 3 is that it should feel like an arrival, not a page load.
    var risers = $('keepsake').querySelectorAll('.kp-rise');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(risers, function (el) {
      var i = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-rise') || '0', 10);
      later(function () { el.classList.add('in'); }, 120 + i * 130);
    });
    later(function () { $('kp-bar').classList.add('show'); }, 700);
    if (!completedReported && giftId) {
      completedReported = true;
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/mark-gift-opened', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ gift_id: giftId, stage: 'completed', mode: revealMode })
      }).catch(function () {});
    }
  }
  function eyebrowFor(type) {
    var map = {
      birthday_note: 'A birthday note',
      meme_card: 'You have been memed',
      midnight_drop: 'A midnight drop',
      hype_reel: 'Your hype reel',
      farewell_note: 'A farewell note',
      love_note: 'A secret admirer note',
      media_video: 'A video message',
      media_audio: 'A voice message',
      personal_message: 'A personal message',
      character_drop: 'A mystery sender',
      squad_drop: 'Your squad showed up',
      squad_memory_board: 'A memory board',
      roast_certificate: 'Officially certified',
      horoscope_drop: 'Your reading',
      exam_survival_kit: 'Exam survival kit'
    };
    return map[type] || 'Your gift';
  }
  // ── AUDIO (media_audio) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // v1 injected this on a hard-coded 14000ms timer that had to stay in sync
  // with a word-count-derived sequence by hand. It is now mounted by
  // showKeepsake(), so it can never drift.
  function mountAudio() {
    var panel = $('audio-panel');
    panel.hidden = false;
    $('audio-title').textContent = 'A voice message from ' + displaySenderName();
    var audio = $('audio-el');
    audio.src = gift.media_url;
    var wave = $('audio-wave');
    var wctx = wave.getContext('2d');
    function draw() {
      wctx.fillStyle = '#111';
      wctx.fillRect(0, 0, wave.width, wave.height);
      var bars = 40, bw = wave.width / bars;
      wctx.fillStyle = vibe.accent;
      wctx.globalAlpha = audio.paused ? 0.3 : 0.85;
      for (var i = 0; i < bars; i++) {
        var h = (Math.sin(i * 0.5) * 0.3 + 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.1) * wave.height * 0.8;
        wctx.fillRect(i * bw, (wave.height - h) / 2, bw - 2, h);
      }
      wctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    draw();
    var timer = null;
    audio.addEventListener('play',  function () { clearInterval(timer); timer = setInterval(draw, 90); });
    audio.addEventListener('pause', function () { clearInterval(timer); draw(); });
    audio.addEventListener('ended', function () { clearInterval(timer); draw(); });
    // The Act 0 tap unlocked playback, so this actually starts.
    audio.play().catch(function () {});
  }
  // ── SQUAD WALL (squad_drop) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadSquadWall() {
    var panel = $('squad-panel');
    panel.hidden = false;
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-reactions?gift_id=' + encodeURIComponent(giftId))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { renderSquadWall((d && d.reactions) || []); })
      .catch(function () { renderSquadWall([]); });
  }
  function renderSquadWall(reactions) {
    var title = $('squad-title');
    var dots  = $('squad-dots');
    var video = $('squad-video');
    var nameEl = $('squad-name');
    if (!reactions.length) {
      title.textContent = 'Your squad';
      nameEl.textContent = 'Reactions are still coming in — check back soon.';
      video.hidden = true;
      $('btn-squad-unmute').hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    title.textContent = 'Your squad · ' + reactions.length + (reactions.length === 1 ? ' reaction' : ' reactions');
    dots.innerHTML = '';
    reactions.forEach(function () { dots.appendChild(document.createElement('span')); });
    var idx = 0;
    function play(i) {
      idx = i >= reactions.length ? 0 : i;
      var r = reactions[idx];
      video.src = r.video_url;
      video.load();
      video.play().catch(function () {});
      nameEl.textContent = r.contributor_name || 'Friend';
      dots.querySelectorAll('span').forEach(function (d, j) {
        d.style.background = j === idx ? vibe.accent : 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)';
      });
    }
    video.muted = true;
    video.addEventListener('ended', function () { setTimeout(function () { play(idx + 1); }, 500); });
    $('btn-squad-unmute').onclick = function () {
      video.muted = false;
      $('btn-squad-unmute').hidden = true;
    };
    play(0);
  }
  // ── REACTIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  $('btn-react').addEventListener('click', function () {
    $('emoji-picker').classList.toggle('open');
  });
  $('emoji-picker').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var target = e.target.closest('.ep-emoji');
    if (!target) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ep-emoji').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('selected'); });
    target.classList.add('selected');
    if (giftId) {
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/store-reaction', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ gift_id: giftId, emoji: target.dataset.emoji })
      }).catch(function () {});   // non-fatal
    }
    $('react-status').textContent = 'Sent — they will see it. 🎉';
    $('emoji-picker').classList.remove('open');
  });
  // ── REPLY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  $('btn-reply').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!gift) return;
    var type = gift.gift_type || 'standard';
    // Character Drop replies go through the token relay — the real sender's
    // phone and name never exist in this browser to leak.
    if (type === 'character_drop' && gift.reply_token) {
      window.location.href = 'digital-studio.html?reply_token=' + encodeURIComponent(gift.reply_token)
        + '&persona=' + encodeURIComponent(gift.persona_key || '')
        + '&ref=gift_reply';
      return;
    }
    var phone = gift.sender_phone || '';
    window.location.href = 'digital-studio.html?recipient_name=' + encodeURIComponent(gift.sender_name || '')
      + (phone ? '&recipient_phone=' + encodeURIComponent(phone) : '')
      + '&ref=gift_reply';
  });
  // ── DOWNLOAD & SHARE PLUMBING ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  //
  // WHY THIS IS NOT JUST <a download>.
  // The card PNG and the share clip live on the Cloudflare R2 public domain,
  // which is a DIFFERENT ORIGIN from zivogift.com. The HTML `download`
  // attribute is specified to be IGNORED on cross-origin URLs — every modern
  // browser silently drops it and navigates to the file instead. That is why
  // "Save image" and "Save video" appeared to do nothing: they were opening
  // the image in a tab, or on iOS doing nothing visible at all.
  //
  // The fix is to fetch the bytes ourselves and hand the browser a same-origin
  // blob: URL, which `download` does honour. This requires the R2 bucket CORS
  // policy to allow GET from zivogift.com — see R2-CORS-and-apply.md. If the
  // fetch is blocked we fall back to opening the file in a new tab, which at
  // least gives the user a long-press → Save path rather than a dead button.
  function toast(msg, ms) {
    var t = $('kp-toast');
    if (!t) return;
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toast._t);
    toast._t = setTimeout(function () { t.classList.remove('show'); }, ms || 2600);
  }
  function buzz(ms) {
    try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(ms || 12); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function safeFileName(ext) {
    var who = String(gift && gift.recipient_name || 'zivogift')
      .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '').toLowerCase().slice(0, 32);
    return 'zivogift-' + (who || 'card') + '.' + ext;
  }
  function fetchBlob(url) {
    return fetch(url, { mode: 'cors', credentials: 'omit' }).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
      return r.blob();
    });
  }
  function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
    var objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = objUrl;
    a.download = filename;
    a.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    // Revoke on a delay — revoking synchronously races the download in
    // Safari and produces a zero-byte file.
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl); a.remove(); }, 4000);
  }
  function saveRemoteFile(url, filename, btn) {
    if (!url) { toast('Nothing to save yet.'); return; }
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    toast('Saving…', 8000);
    fetchBlob(url)
      .then(function (blob) {
        downloadBlob(blob, filename);
        buzz();
        toast('Saved to your downloads.');
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('save failed:', err);
        // R2 CORS blocked us, or the network dropped. Opening the file is the
        // honest fallback: the user can long-press → Save from there.
        window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener');
        toast('Opened in a new tab — press and hold to save.');
      })
      .then(function () { if (btn) btn.disabled = false; });
  }
  // Web Share Level 2 (files) where it exists — that is the native sheet with
  // WhatsApp/Instagram in it, which is where these actually get shared. Falls
  // back to sharing the gift link, then to copying it.
  function shareRemoteFile(url, filename, mime, btn) {
    var text = (gift && gift.sender_name)
      ? 'Look what ' + gift.sender_name + ' sent me 🎁'
      : 'Look what I got 🎁';
    function shareLink() {
      var pageUrl = window.location.href;
      if (navigator.share) {
        return navigator.share({ title: 'My Zivogift', text: text, url: pageUrl });
      }
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        return navigator.clipboard.writeText(pageUrl).then(function () { toast('Link copied.'); });
      }
      window.open(url || pageUrl, '_blank', 'noopener');
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    var p;
    if (url && navigator.canShare && window.File) {
      p = fetchBlob(url)
        .then(function (blob) {
          var file = new File([blob], filename, { type: mime });
          if (!navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) throw new Error('files unsupported');
          return navigator.share({ files: [file], text: text });
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          // AbortError = the user closed the sheet. That is not a failure and
          // must not trigger the fallback, or they get a second dialog.
          if (err && err.name === 'AbortError') return;
          return shareLink();
        });
    } else {
      p = shareLink();
    }
    p.catch(function (err) {
      if (err && err.name === 'AbortError') return;
      console.error('share failed:', err);
      toast("Couldn't open the share sheet.");
    }).then(function () { if (btn) btn.disabled = false; });
  }
  // ── THE FULL CARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Generated ON DEMAND and only after the gift is marked opened — that is
  // what stops the message existing as an image at delivery time and leaking
  // into an inbox preview thumbnail. What changed in v2.1: it is requested
  // automatically when the keepsake opens, rather than waiting for a button
  // press, so the recipient actually sees their card.
  var fullCardUrl = null;
  var cardRequested = false;
  function loadFullCard() {
    if (cardRequested || !giftId) return;
    cardRequested = true;
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-full-card', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ gift_id: giftId })
    })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!d.url) throw new Error(d.error || 'no url');
        var img = $('save-card-img');
        img.onload = function () {
          $('card-skeleton').classList.add('gone');
          img.style.display = 'block';
          $('card-3d').classList.add('lit');
        };
        img.onerror = function () { cardFailed(); };
        img.src = d.url;
        fullCardUrl = d.url;
        $('lb-img').src = d.url;
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('get-full-card failed:', err);
        cardFailed();
      });
  }
  function cardFailed() {
    // Retryable, and honest about it. Silently leaving a shimmer forever was
    // the old behaviour and it looked like the page had hung.
    $('card-skeleton').classList.add('gone');
    var status = $('share-status');
    status.textContent = "Your card didn't load. ";
    var retry = document.createElement('button');
    retry.className = 'kp-btn';
    retry.textContent = '↻ Retry loading your card';
    retry.onclick = function () {
      status.textContent = '';
      $('card-skeleton').classList.remove('gone');
      cardRequested = false;
      loadFullCard();
    };
    status.appendChild(retry);
  }
  // Pointer tilt — the card reads as a physical object rather than an <img>.
  (function () {
    var card = $('card-3d');
    if (!card || REDUCED) return;
    var raf = null;
    function tilt(e) {
      var r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
      var py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        card.style.transform = 'rotateY(' + (px * 9).toFixed(2) + 'deg) rotateX(' + (-py * 9).toFixed(2) + 'deg) translateZ(0)';
      });
    }
    function reset() {
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      card.style.transform = '';
    }
    card.addEventListener('pointermove', tilt);
    card.addEventListener('pointerleave', reset);
    card.addEventListener('pointercancel', reset);
  })();
  // Lightbox
  (function () {
    var box = $('card-lightbox');
    var card = $('card-3d');
    function open() {
      if (!fullCardUrl) return;
      box.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function close() {
      box.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    card.addEventListener('click', open);
    card.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); open(); }
    });
    $('lb-close').addEventListener('click', close);
    box.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === box) close(); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && box.classList.contains('open')) close();
    });
  })();
  // ── ACTION BAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  $('btn-save-card').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!fullCardUrl) { toast('Your card is still being made — one moment.'); loadFullCard(); return; }
    saveRemoteFile(fullCardUrl, safeFileName('png'), this);
  });
  $('btn-share-card').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!fullCardUrl) { toast('Your card is still being made — one moment.'); loadFullCard(); return; }
    shareRemoteFile(fullCardUrl, safeFileName('png'), 'image/png', this);
  });
  // ── SHARE CLIP ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Generation is queued (clip-scheduler.js), not synchronous — a photo-bearing
  // clip can exceed Netlify's function limit.
  //
  // v2 polled forever with no ceiling. If clip-scheduler was killed mid-render
  // the job sat at status='processing' permanently, so the button showed
  // "Preparing your video…" for the rest of the session and every retry
  // re-attached to the same dead job. There is now a hard timeout on the
  // client and a stale-job reclaim on the server (see clip-scheduler.js).
  (function () {
    var btn = $('btn-share-clip');
    var saveBtn = $('btn-save-clip');
    var statusEl = $('share-status');
    var video = $('share-clip-video');
    var poller = null;
    var giveUpAt = 0;
    var clipUrl = null;
    var POLL_MS = 3000;
    var TIMEOUT_MS = 180000;   // 3 minutes: ~90 scheduler ticks of headroom
    function stop() { clearInterval(poller); poller = null; }
    function show(url) {
      stop();
      clipUrl = url;
      video.src = url;
      video.classList.add('show');
      statusEl.textContent = '';
      btn.hidden = true;
      saveBtn.hidden = false;
      buzz();
    }
    function fail(msg) {
      stop();
      statusEl.textContent = msg;
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = '↻ Try again';
    }
    function poll(jobId) {
      if (Date.now() > giveUpAt) {
        fail('That is taking longer than expected. Your card is still saveable above.');
        return;
      }
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-share-clip-status?job_id=' + encodeURIComponent(jobId))
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (d) {
          if (d.status === 'done' && d.output_url) show(d.output_url);
          else if (d.status === 'failed') fail("Couldn't make the video — please try again.");
        })
        .catch(function () { /* transient; the next tick retries */ });
    }
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (!giftId) return;
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.textContent = 'Making your video… this takes a minute or two.';
      giveUpAt = Date.now() + TIMEOUT_MS;
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/create-share-clip-job', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ gift_id: giftId })
      })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (d) {
          if (!d.job_id) throw new Error(d.error || 'Could not start video generation');
          if (d.status === 'done' && d.output_url) { show(d.output_url); return; }
          if (d.status === 'failed') { fail("Couldn't make the video — please try again."); return; }
          poller = setInterval(function () { poll(d.job_id); }, POLL_MS);
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          console.error('share clip failed:', err);
          fail("Couldn't make the video — please try again.");
        });
    });
    saveBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      saveRemoteFile(clipUrl, safeFileName('mp4'), this);
    });
  })();
  // ── BOOT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function showScreen(id) {
    ['loading-screen', 'error-screen', 'locked-screen'].forEach(function (s) {
      $(s).hidden = (s !== id);
    });
  }
  function showError() { showScreen('error-screen'); }
  function start(data) {
    gift = data;
    showScreen(null);
    $('stage').hidden = false;
    applyVibe(gift.vibe_key, gift.gift_type, gift.persona_key);
    renderSealed();
  }
  function init() {
    giftId = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('id');
    if (!giftId) { showError(); return; }
    var cfg = window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG || {};
    if (cfg.DEMO_MODE && !window.ZGSupabase) {
      start({
        id: 'demo',
        recipient_name: 'Priya',
        sender_name: 'Rahul',
        sender_phone: null,
        personal_message: 'Happy birthday! You deserve all the happiness in the world. This is just a small token to remind you how much you mean to us. Have an amazing day! 🎂',
        occasion: 'Birthday',
        vibe_key: 'confetti_pop',
        gift_type: 'standard',
        media_url: null, media_type: null, persona_key: null,
        reply_token: null, teaser_image_url: null
      });
      return;
    }
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-gift?id=' + encodeURIComponent(giftId))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (res.error || !res.data) { showError(); return; }
        // Time Capsule (#5). The server now withholds the message entirely
        // for a capsule that has not matured, so this branch is a UI concern
        // rather than the only thing guarding the content.
        if (res.data.locked) {
          var openAt = new Date(res.data.scheduled_at);
          $('locked-date').textContent = openAt.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
            day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata'
          });
          showScreen('locked-screen');
          return;   // stop — do NOT mark opened; they just have the link early
        }
        start(res.data);
      })
      .catch(showError);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    if (!animFrame) return;
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  });
  init();
})();

<script>
  (function(){
    function whenText(iso,upcoming){
      var d=new Date(iso); if(isNaN(d))return '';
      var s=d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
      return (upcoming?'Coming up · ':'')+s;
    }
    function load(id){
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-gift-timeline?id='+encodeURIComponent(id))
        .then(function(r){return r.json();})
        .then(function(j){
          if(!j||!j.ok||!j.events||!j.events.length)return;
          var list=document.getElementById('gt-list'); if(!list)return;
          list.innerHTML='';
          j.events.forEach(function(ev){
            var li=document.createElement('li');
            li.className='gt-item'+(ev.upcoming?' upcoming':'');
            li.innerHTML='<span class="gt-dot"></span><div class="gt-h"></div><div class="gt-d"></div><div class="gt-when"></div>';
            li.querySelector('.gt-h').textContent=ev.title||'';
            li.querySelector('.gt-d').textContent=ev.detail||'';
            li.querySelector('.gt-when').textContent=whenText(ev.at,ev.upcoming);
            list.appendChild(li);
          });
          document.getElementById('gift-timeline').hidden=false;
        })
        .catch(function(){});
    }
    function boot(){
      var id=(new URLSearchParams(location.search)).get('id');
      if(id)load(id);
    }
    if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
    else boot();
  })();
</script>

<section id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-heading" style="max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 24px;">
  <span class="section-label reveal">— good to know</span>
  <h2 id="faq-heading" class="section-heading reveal">BIRTHDAY NOTES & SERIAL NOTES: FAQs</h2>
  <p class="section-sub reveal">Straight answers about birthday serial notes, pricing, legality and delivery across India.</p>

  <div class="faq-list reveal" style="margin-top:32px;display:grid;gap:14px;">
    <details class="faq-item" style="border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;list-style:none;">What is a birthday serial note?</summary>
      <p style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--grey);line-height:1.6;">A <strong>birthday serial note</strong> is a genuine, uncirculated RBI-issued Indian currency note whose 6-digit serial number matches someone's date of birth — for example <strong>14/03/2004 becomes a note carrying 140304</strong>. Nothing is printed or altered; we hand-source the real note, then box it with a personalised card as a keepsake.</p>
    </details>

    <details class="faq-item" style="border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;list-style:none;">How much does a birthday note cost in India?</summary>
      <p style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--grey);line-height:1.6;">Zivogift <strong>birthday serial notes start at ₹299</strong> and go up to ₹1,299 depending on the denomination. <strong>Digital birthday gifts start at ₹49.</strong> Prices are "onwards" because each note is hand-matched; rare or exact 8-digit matches can cost a little more.</p>
    </details>

    <details class="faq-item" style="border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;list-style:none;">Is it legal to gift a currency note like this?</summary>
      <p style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--grey);line-height:1.6;">Yes. The note is <strong>genuine legal tender that is never defaced, printed on, or altered</strong>. You're paying Zivogift for the service of sourcing, date-matching, verification, personalisation and premium keepsake packaging — the currency itself keeps its full value.</p>
    </details>

    <details class="faq-item" style="border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;list-style:none;">Do you deliver across India and how long does it take?</summary>
      <p style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--grey);line-height:1.6;">Yes, we deliver <strong>across India</strong>. Because each note is hand-sourced to order, plan for <strong>7–10 days</strong> for sourcing plus delivery. <strong>Free campus delivery</strong> in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu. Need it instantly? A <a href="digital-studio.html?type=birthday_note">Birthday Digital Gift</a> lands on WhatsApp within minutes.</p>
    </details>

FILE: netlify.toml

[build]
  publish = "."
  functions = "netlify/functions"
  command = "npm install"

[functions]
  node_bundler = "esbuild"
  # Sharp and ffmpeg-static are native/binary — tell esbuild not to bundle
  # them; Netlify provides/allows them.
  external_node_modules = ["sharp", "ffmpeg-static", "@aws-sdk/client-s3", "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner"]

  # ── FONTS (this line is why card text renders at all) ────────────────────
  # Sharp rasterizes SVG through librsvg, which resolves every font-family
  # through fontconfig. The Netlify Functions Lambda image ships NO fonts, so
  # every <text>/<tspan> rendered to nothing while the gradients and rects
  # drew fine — the "card PNG renders without text" bug. netlify/fonts/ holds
  # our own TTFs plus a self-contained fonts.conf; _lib/cardFonts.js points
  # FONTCONFIG_PATH at them before Sharp's native binding initialises.
  #
  # If you remove this line, cards go blank again. _lib/cardFonts.js will at
  # least refuse to render and return a 500 rather than mailing empty cards,
  # but the deploy is broken either way.
  #
  # Populate with: node scripts/fetch-fonts.js   (see package.json postinstall)
  included_files = ["netlify/fonts/**"]

# gift-scheduler runs every 2 minutes to check for and fire pending
# WhatsApp/email digital gift sends. UTC cron — midnight IST = 18:30 UTC.
[functions."gift-scheduler"]
  schedule = "*/2 * * * *"

# clip-scheduler runs every 2 minutes to render pending share-clip video jobs
# (Download & Share button on gift.html). Kept async/queued rather than
# synchronous because photo compositing pushes render time close to the
# 10s Netlify free-plan function limit — see _lib/clipFrames.js for the
# benchmark notes behind this decision.
[functions."clip-scheduler"]
  schedule = "*/2 * * * *"

# Care Package feature — three separate cron jobs, deliberately not one
# combined function. Generation (1 big Claude call) and guardrail-checking
# (up to 8 parallel Claude calls) are split into different ticks specifically
# to stay inside Netlify's 10s synchronous limit — see care-package-generator.js
# and care-package-guardrail.js headers for the full reasoning.
#
# ── DISABLED (not launched yet) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# These three ran every 2 minutes = ~2,160 invocations/day combined, burning
# Netlify credits for a feature that isn't live. Commented out to stop the
# crons entirely. The function files stay on disk and cost nothing while idle
# (no schedule = never invoked). TO RE-ENABLE AT LAUNCH: uncomment the three
# blocks below and redeploy — nothing else changes.
# [functions."care-package-generator"]
#   schedule = "*/2 * * * *"
# [functions."care-package-guardrail"]
#   schedule = "*/2 * * * *"
# [functions."care-package-scheduler"]
#   schedule = "*/2 * * * *"

# reminder-scheduler runs once daily at 07:30 IST (02:00 UTC).
# Sends birthday reminders (#10) and friendship anniversary nudges (#19).
[functions."reminder-scheduler"]
  schedule = "0 2 * * *"

# occasion-scheduler runs once daily at 08:00 IST (02:30 UTC).
# Sends college-calendar-driven nudges — exams, placements, freshers week,
# graduation (#13), fed by campus reps and approved by an admin (#20).
[functions."occasion-scheduler"]
  schedule = "30 2 * * *"

# ── CAMPAIGN CENTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# campaign-sender drains public.campaign_recipients for campaigns marked
# 'sending'. Every 5 minutes, NOT every 2 like gift-scheduler: a promotional
# email is not time-critical to the minute, and 5 min = 288 invocations/day
# instead of 720. The first query is a single indexed lookup against the
# partial index idx_campaign_recipients_queued and early-exits when nothing is
# queued -- which is the normal state -- so having this installed costs
# almost nothing in credits while you are not running a campaign.
#
# Throughput: 20 per run x 12 runs/hour = 240/hour. A 1000-person campaign
# takes about 4 hours. The slow ramp is intentional -- a sudden bulk spike on
# a domain that has only ever sent transactional mail is the classic trigger
# for being throttled by Gmail.
#
# TO STOP CAMPAIGNS: do NOT comment this out (that needs a deploy). Use the
# Emergency tab kill switch, which is read from the database on every tick.
[functions."campaign-sender"]
  schedule = "*/5 * * * *"

# festival-scheduler runs once daily at 03:00 UTC (08:30 IST). Deliberately
# after reminder-scheduler (02:00 UTC) and occasion-scheduler (02:30 UTC) so
# the three can never collide. It only CREATES campaigns; campaign-sender
# above does the actual sending, which means there is exactly one send path
# and one set of delivery counters for manual and automated campaigns alike.
[functions."festival-scheduler"]
  schedule = "0 3 * * *"

# ── ABANDONED CHECKOUT RECOVERY ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Hourly. Emails customers whose order is stranded at 'pending_payment' for
# between 1 hour and 7 days, exactly once each. Those are the highest-intent
# visitors the site gets -- they chose a gift, entered a delivery address and
# reached the payment page -- and until now nothing followed up with them.
#
# Hourly rather than every few minutes because a recovery email is never
# urgent, and the query is a single indexed read against the partial index
# idx_orders_abandoned that early-exits when there is nothing to recover.
# 24 invocations/day.
#
# TO STOP IT: Emergency tab -> "Pause EVERYTHING". No deploy needed.
[functions."abandoned-cart-scheduler"]
  schedule = "0 * * * *"

# whatsapp-webhook handles inbound WhatsApp messages from Meta Cloud API.
# Used for Condition-Based Delivery (#23) keyword matching.
# Register this URL in Meta Developer Console → WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook.
# No schedule — triggered by HTTP (Meta delivers inbound messages here).

# Order tracking page reads the order_number from a query string — no
# special redirect rules needed since this is a plain multi-page static site.

[[headers]]
  for = "/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url"
  [headers.values]
    Access-Control-Allow-Origin = "*"
    Access-Control-Allow-Methods = "POST, OPTIONS"
    Access-Control-Allow-Headers = "Content-Type"

# gift.html is the reveal page. It must not be cached by an intermediary:
# the sealed/opened state and the personal message come from the API, and a
# shared cache holding a response would be both wrong and a privacy problem.
[[headers]]
  for = "/gift.html"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "no-store, must-revalidate"
    X-Robots-Tag = "noindex, nofollow"

[[headers]]
  for = "/*"
  [headers.values]
    X-Frame-Options = "DENY"
    X-Content-Type-Options = "nosniff"
    Referrer-Policy = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

# Friendly extensionless route for the static Bulk Orders page.
[[redirects]]
  from = "/bulk-orders"
  to = "/bulk-orders.html"
  status = 200

[[redirects]]
  from = "/bulk-orders/"
  to = "/bulk-orders.html"
  status = 200

  <p>Zivogift ("we", "us") operates zivogift.com. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices available to you.</p>

  <h2>What we collect</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>Buyer details: name, email address, phone number and account credentials.</li>
    <li>Recipient details: name, contact details, delivery address, and the occasion date or date of birth needed to source a matching currency note.</li>
    <li>Order and transaction records: items, add-ons, personalised messages, order history, payment status and payment references.</li>
    <li>Content you upload for gift creation, such as photos, audio, video or text.</li>
    <li>Technical data: IP address, device and browser information, logs, cookies and security events.</li>
  </ul>
  <p>Payment credentials are collected and processed directly by our payment partner. We do not see or store your card, UPI or net-banking credentials.</p>

  <h2>How we use it</h2>
  <ul>
    <li>To process, source, personalise, fulfil and deliver your order.</li>
    <li>To send order, delivery and service updates by email, SMS or WhatsApp.</li>
    <li>To operate accounts, saved addresses and order history.</li>
    <li>To respond to support, contact-form and campus-rep enquiries.</li>
    <li>To prevent fraud and abuse, secure the platform, and meet legal, tax and accounting obligations.</li>
    <li>To send marketing communications only where consent or another lawful basis applies. You can opt out at any time.</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>Who we share it with</h2>
  <p>We share only the minimum data needed with the service providers that run Zivogift: Netlify (hosting and deployment), Supabase (database and account login), Cashfree (payments), Cloudflare R2 (media storage), MSG91 (SMS and OTP), Resend (transactional email), WhatsApp Cloud API (delivery and gift messaging), and Gemini (AI-assisted content generation for gift text you request). We also share delivery details with courier and logistics partners where a physical order requires it. We do not sell your personal data.</p>

  <h2>Recipient data and your responsibility</h2>
  <p>When you provide someone else's name, contact details or occasion date, you confirm you have a lawful basis to share it with us for the purpose of sending that gift. Please do not submit unlawful, misleading, infringing or unnecessarily sensitive content. We use recipient information only to fulfil the gift and send related delivery communications.</p>

  <h2>Retention and security</h2>
  <p>We keep personal data only as long as reasonably needed for fulfilment, support, fraud prevention, accounting, dispute resolution and legal compliance, after which it is deleted or anonymised. We apply reasonable technical and organisational safeguards, but no internet service can be guaranteed to be completely secure.</p>

  <h2>Your choices and rights</h2>
  <p>Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or erasure of your personal data, withdraw consent where processing relies on it, unsubscribe from marketing, or raise a grievance. Update saved details from your account page, or write to <a href="mailto:hello@zivogift.com" style="color:var(--gold-light);">hello@zivogift.com</a>. We may verify your identity before acting, and may retain records we are required to keep for accounting, tax, security or legal reasons.</p>

  <h2>Cookies and local storage</h2>
  <p>We use minimal browser local storage to remember your cart between pages, plus necessary and limited analytics. We do not run third-party advertising trackers. Third-party sites we link to have their own privacy practices.</p>

  <h2>Children</h2>
  <p>Zivogift is not intended for independent use by children. Where a gift involves a child, the order should be placed by a parent or lawful guardian, who provides any consent required.</p>

  <h2>Changes to this policy</h2>
  <p>We may update this policy as our services or legal obligations change. Material changes will be posted on this page with a revised date.</p>

  <h2>Contact and grievances</h2>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var token = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('token');
  var context = null;   // { gift_id, recipient_name, sender_name, contributor_name }
  var recordedBlob = null;
  var mediaRecorder = null;
  var stream = null;
  var chunks = [];
  var recording = false;
  var timerInterval = null;
  var RECORD_DURATION_SEC = 3;

  function show(id) {
    ['screen-loading','screen-already','screen-error','screen-main','screen-success'].forEach(function (s) {
      var el = document.getElementById(s);
      if (el) el.style.display = s === id ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
  }

  if (!token) { show('screen-error'); return; }

  // ── FETCH CONTEXT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-reaction-context?token=' + encodeURIComponent(token))
    .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {
      if (data.error) { show('screen-error'); return; }
      if (data.already_submitted) { show('screen-already'); return; }
      context = data;
      document.getElementById('main-title').textContent =
        'Hey ' + (data.contributor_name || 'Friend') + '! Record your 3-sec reaction 🎬';
      document.getElementById('main-sub').textContent =
        (data.sender_name || 'Someone') + ' is gifting ' + (data.recipient_name || 'a friend') + ' — be part of the surprise wall!';
      document.getElementById('success-recipient').textContent = data.recipient_name || 'the recipient';
      show('screen-main');
      initCamera();
    })
    .catch(function () { show('screen-error'); });

  // ── CAMERA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function initCamera() {
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'user', width:{ideal:480}, height:{ideal:480} }, audio: true })
      .then(function (s) {
        stream = s;
        var lv = document.getElementById('live-video');
        if (lv) { lv.srcObject = s; lv.play(); }
        document.getElementById('record-btn').onclick = startRecording;
      })
      .catch(function () {
        document.getElementById('rec-hint').textContent = '⚠️ Camera access denied — please allow and reload';
        document.getElementById('record-btn').disabled = true;
      });
  }

  // ── RECORDING ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function startRecording() {
    if (recording) return;
    recording = true; chunks = [];

    var mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus')
      ? 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus'
      : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/mp4') ? 'video/mp4' : '';
    var options = mimeType ? { mimeType: mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: 500000 } : { videoBitsPerSecond: 500000 };

    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, options);
    mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function (e) { if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data); };
    mediaRecorder.onstop = onRecordingStop;
    mediaRecorder.start(100);

    // UI
    var btn = document.getElementById('record-btn');
    btn.textContent = '⏹';
    btn.classList.add('recording');
    btn.onclick = stopRecording;
    document.getElementById('rec-hint').textContent = 'Recording…';

    // Ring timer
    var ring = document.getElementById('ring-timer');
    var fill = document.getElementById('ring-fill');
    ring.style.display = 'block';
    var circumference = 125.6;
    var elapsed = 0;
    timerInterval = setInterval(function () {
      elapsed += 0.1;
      var offset = circumference * (1 - elapsed / RECORD_DURATION_SEC);
      fill.style.strokeDashoffset = Math.max(0, offset);
      if (elapsed >= RECORD_DURATION_SEC) stopRecording();
    }, 100);
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (!recording) return;
    recording = false;
    if (timerInterval) { clearInterval(timerInterval); timerInterval = null; }
    if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') mediaRecorder.stop();
    // Stop camera tracks for playback
    if (stream) { stream.getTracks().forEach(function (t) { t.stop(); }); stream = null; }
    var btn = document.getElementById('record-btn');
    btn.textContent = '⏺';
    btn.classList.remove('recording');
    btn.style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('rec-hint').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('ring-timer').style.display = 'none';
  }

  function onRecordingStop() {
    if (!chunks.length) return;
    var mimeType = mediaRecorder ? (mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'video/webm') : 'video/webm';
    recordedBlob = new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);
    var pbv = document.getElementById('playback-video');
    pbv.src = url; pbv.load();
    document.getElementById('camera-wrap').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('playback-wrap').style.display = 'block';

    document.getElementById('redo-btn').onclick = function () {
      recordedBlob = null;
      document.getElementById('playback-wrap').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('camera-wrap').style.display = 'block';
      var btn2 = document.getElementById('record-btn');
      btn2.style.display = ''; btn2.textContent = '⏺'; btn2.classList.remove('recording');
      document.getElementById('rec-hint').style.display = '';
      document.getElementById('rec-hint').textContent = 'Tap to start · 3 seconds · your face only';
      initCamera();
    };

    document.getElementById('send-btn').onclick = uploadAndSubmit;
  }

  // ── UPLOAD & SUBMIT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function uploadAndSubmit() {
    if (!recordedBlob || !context) return;
    var sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');
    var statusEl = document.getElementById('upload-status');
    sendBtn.disabled = true;
    statusEl.style.display = 'block';

    var mimeType = recordedBlob.type || '';
    var ext = 'webm';
    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) ext = 'mp4';

    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: ext, order_id: context.gift_id }),
    })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (!data.upload_url) throw new Error('No upload URL');
        return fetch(data.upload_url, {
          method: 'PUT',
          // Must be the exact content type the URL was signed with — the raw
          // blob.type carries a ;codecs=... suffix and breaks the signature.
          headers: { 'Content-Type': data.content_type || 'video/webm' },
          body: recordedBlob,
        }).then(function (putRes) {
          if (!putRes.ok) {
            return putRes.text().then(function (t) { throw new Error('R2 PUT ' + putRes.status + ': ' + (t || '').slice(0, 300)); });
          }
          return data.public_url;
        });
      })
      .then(function (publicUrl) {
        return fetch('/.netlify/functions/submit-reaction', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ token: token, video_url: publicUrl, duration_ms: RECORD_DURATION_SEC * 1000 }),
        });
      })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (res.ok || res.already) {
          show('screen-success');
        } else {
          throw new Error('submit-reaction returned error');
        }
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('React submit failed:', err);
        statusEl.textContent = '❌ Upload failed. Please try again.';
        sendBtn.disabled = false;
      });
  }

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

# ZivoGift — SEO / GEO / AEO / EEAT Playbook & Action List

This documents (a) what was implemented in code this session, and (b) the off-page
actions only you can do (accounts, backlinks, verification). Deploy the ZIP for the
code parts (checkmark); do the (todo) actions from your side.

---

## 1) On-page SEO (implemented) [DONE]
- Keyword-optimised <title> + meta description on every main page, keeping the
  high-intent terms people search: birthday notes, birthday serial notes,
  currency note gift, plus broadened anniversary / Valentine's / occasion terms.
- <meta name="keywords"> added (minor signal, harmless).
- Open Graph + Twitter cards aligned to new titles/descriptions (better social previews, more clicks/shares).
- Canonical tags confirmed on all pages (prevents duplicate-content dilution).
- Homepage flagship H2 keeps the keyword: "BIRTHDAY & OCCASION-DATE SERIAL NOTES".

## 2) Entity & Knowledge-Graph building (implemented) [DONE]
- Homepage @graph ties everything to one entity id https://zivogift.com/#org:
  Organization + OnlineStore + LocalBusiness, with alternateName
  (Birthday Notes / Birthday Serial Notes), knowsAbout, foundingLocation,
  contactPoint, address, and sameAs.
- WebSite node with SearchAction (sitelinks search box eligibility).
- BreadcrumbList, two Product nodes (serial note + digital gift) with INR pricing,
  and alternateName carrying the old keywords so engines connect old<->new naming.

### Action to complete the entity graph [TODO]
1. Create the social profiles referenced in sameAs (or edit the URLs in index.html
   to your real ones): Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn. sameAs only helps if those
   URLs resolve and link back to zivogift.com.
2. Google Business Profile (Bengaluru): create/verify with the same Name-Address-
   Phone (NAP) and website. Powers Map Pack + brand knowledge panel.
3. Keep NAP identical everywhere (footer, GBP, socials):
   "Zivogift, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, hello@zivogift.com".

## 3) GEO / Local & National SEO (implemented + actions)
Implemented [DONE]: LocalBusiness + areaServed (India + KA/AP/TS/TN), address, and
free-campus-delivery states named in copy and schema.

### Actions [TODO]
- Google Business Profile (above) + Bing Places.
- Get listed in India gifting/startup directories (Justdial, Sulekha, IndiaMART for
  corporate gifting, StartupIndia). Consistent NAP + do-follow where possible.
- Publish a short "Delivery across India" block/page; add city landing sections over
  time (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Vijayawada...).

## 4) AEO - Answer Engine Optimisation (implemented) [DONE]
Optimises for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini:
- FAQPage schema + visible <details> FAQ on Home, Digital Gifts, Bulk Orders
  (schema matches visible text - required).
- Content chunking: each answer is a short, self-contained, quotable paragraph with
  the question as a heading - exactly what LLMs extract as answers.
- robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot,
  Google-Extended - so AI engines may cite you.

### Actions [TODO]
- Add 3-5 more FAQs over time from real customer questions (price by denomination,
  fancy-number matches, corporate GST invoice, gifting etiquette).
- Keep answers factual and specific (numbers, prices, timelines) - LLMs prefer concrete text.

## 5) EEAT - Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trust [TODO]
- About page with the founder story (you, Bengaluru), how notes are sourced/verified,
  and a real photo. Add Person (founder) + Organization schema. Biggest EEAT lever for a small brand.
- Trust signals: refund guarantee, "genuine legal tender, never defaced" assurance,
  secure-payment (Cashfree) badge, visible contact method.
- Reviews: collect customer reviews (Google + on-site). Once you have genuine ratings,
  add AggregateRating to Product schema (never fake it - Google penalises).
- Author/expertise: byline any gifting guides with a real person.

## 6) Digital PR & Link Building [TODO]
- Story angle: "A Bengaluru startup turns your birth date into a real currency-note keepsake."
  Pitch to Indian startup/college media (YourStory, The Better India, Inc42, Edexlive,
  local Bangalore press, campus newsletters).
- Campus PR: the Campus Rep program is a natural link source - reps' college pages, fest
  sponsor pages, student blogs. Ask reps to link to zivogift.com.
- Product seeding: send keepsakes to micro-influencers (student creators, gifting pages)
  for unboxing reels -> brand searches + backlinks.
- HARO-style: answer journalist queries on gifting/startup topics for authority links.
- Aim for a few relevant, real do-follow links per quarter over hundreds of spammy ones.

## 7) Technical SEO (implemented + actions)
Implemented [DONE]: sitemap.xml (all indexable pages), robots.txt (blocks account/admin/
checkout/gift/reset, allows AI bots, points to sitemap).

### Actions [TODO]
1. Google Search Console + Bing Webmaster Tools: verify domain, submit
   https://zivogift.com/sitemap.xml, then URL Inspection -> Request Indexing for the
   homepage and each updated page after deploy.
2. Rich Results Test (search.google.com/test/rich-results) on Home / Digital Gifts /
   Bulk Orders to confirm FAQ + Product + Breadcrumb are detected.
3. Confirm HTTPS, mobile-friendly (it is), and fast (Core Web Vitals in GSC).
4. og-image.png: ensure it's 1200x630 and strong - it drives social CTR.

## 8) Keyword map (primary targets)

|---|---|---|
