// js/account-group5.js
// Group 5 account additions — loaded AFTER account.js and account-group3.js.
// Adds two tabs to account.html:
//   "💎 Pass & Perks"  — Zivo Pass status/purchase (#15) + college email
//                        verification for exclusive vibes (#16)
//   "🎓 Campus Rep"    — apply, or if approved: ref link, live stats, and a
//                        form to submit college calendar events (#13 feed, #20)
//
// Same injection pattern as account-group3.js: tab buttons before logout-btn,
// panels appended to the panel column, all via window.ZGAuth/ZGSupabase.

/* global window, document, fetch */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  var token = null;
  var userId = null;

  // ── Inject tabs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function injectTabs() {
    var logoutBtn = $('logout-btn');
    if (!logoutBtn) return;

    addTabButton('pass', '💎 Pass & Perks', logoutBtn);
    addTabButton('rep', '🎓 Campus Rep', logoutBtn);

    var anyPanel = document.querySelector('.account-panel');
    var panelWrap = anyPanel ? anyPanel.parentNode : null;
    if (!panelWrap) return;

    var passPanel = document.createElement('div');
    passPanel.className = 'account-panel';
    passPanel.id = 'panel-pass';
    passPanel.style.display = 'none';
    panelWrap.appendChild(passPanel);

    var repPanel = document.createElement('div');
    repPanel.className = 'account-panel';
    repPanel.id = 'panel-rep';
    repPanel.style.display = 'none';
    panelWrap.appendChild(repPanel);

    renderPassPanel(passPanel);
    renderRepPanel(repPanel);
  }

  function addTabButton(tab, label, logoutBtn) {
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.dataset.tab = tab;
    btn.textContent = label;
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () { switchTab(tab); });
    logoutBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, logoutBtn);
  }

  function switchTab(tab) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-panel').forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = 'none'; });
    var panel = $('panel-' + tab);
    if (panel) panel.style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tab);
    });
  }

  // ── PASS & PERKS panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function renderPassPanel(panel) {
    panel.innerHTML =
      '<h2 style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px;">ZIVO PASS & PERKS</h2>' +
      '<div id="pass-status-card" class="card-panel" style="margin-bottom:20px;"><p style="color:#888;">Loading…</p></div>' +
      '<div class="card-panel">' +
        '<h3 style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:8px;">🎓 College-Exclusive Vibes</h3>' +
        '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#888;margin-bottom:14px;">Verify your college email to unlock vibes made just for your campus.</p>' +
        '<div id="college-verified-badge" style="display:none;margin-bottom:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.1);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.3);border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;color:#4ADE80;"></div>' +
        '<div id="college-verify-form">' +
          '<div class="form-grid">' +
            '<div class="field-group full"><label>College Email</label><input type="email" id="cv-email" placeholder="you@vit.ac.in"></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="form-msg" id="cv-send-msg"></div>' +
          '<button class="btn-coral" id="cv-send-btn" style="margin-top:8px;">Send Verification Code</button>' +
          '<div id="cv-otp-row" style="display:none;margin-top:14px;">' +
            '<div class="form-grid"><div class="field-group"><label>6-digit code</label><input type="text" id="cv-code" maxlength="6" placeholder="123456"></div></div>' +
            '<div class="form-msg" id="cv-confirm-msg"></div>' +
            '<button class="btn-coral" id="cv-confirm-btn" style="margin-top:8px;">Verify</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    $('cv-send-btn').addEventListener('click', sendCollegeOtp);
    $('cv-confirm-btn').addEventListener('click', confirmCollegeOtp);

    loadPassStatus();
    loadCollegeStatus();
  }

  function loadPassStatus() {
    var card = $('pass-status-card');
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) { card.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Connect Supabase to enable Zivo Pass.</p>'; return; }

    window.ZGSupabase.rpc('has_active_pass').then(function (res) {
      var active = !!(res && res.data);
      if (!active) {
        card.innerHTML =
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
            '<div style="font-size:36px;">💎</div>' +
            '<div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;">' +
              '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:2px;">You don\'t have Zivo Pass yet</div>' +
              '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">₹99/semester — unlimited AI Polish, monthly exclusive vibe, free scheduling upgrades, 10% off all notes.</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button class="btn-coral" id="pass-buy-btn">Get Zivo Pass — ₹99</button>' +
          '</div>';
        $('pass-buy-btn').addEventListener('click', buyPass);
        return;
      }
      // Active — fetch expiry for display
      window.ZGSupabase.from('subscriptions').select('expires_at').eq('status', 'active').order('expires_at', { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle()
        .then(function (subRes) {
          var expires = subRes && subRes.data ? new Date(subRes.data.expires_at) : null;
          var expiresStr = expires ? expires.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : '';
          card.innerHTML =
            '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;">' +
              '<div style="font-size:36px;">💎</div>' +
              '<div>' +
                '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:#F4C542;margin-bottom:2px;">Zivo Pass — Active</div>' +
                '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">' + (expiresStr ? 'Valid until ' + expiresStr : '') + ' · Unlimited AI Polish, exclusive vibes unlocked, 10% off notes.</div>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        });
    }).catch(function () { card.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Could not load Pass status.</p>'; });
  }

  function buyPass() {
    if (!window.ZGCart) return;
    window.ZGCart.addToCart({
      productId: 'pass_semester',
      name: 'Zivo Pass — 1 Semester',
      emoji: '💎',
      unitPrice: 99,
      qty: 1,
      addonTotal: 0,
      addonIds: [],
      selectedOptions: {},
    });
    window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
  }

  function loadCollegeStatus() {
    if (!window.ZGSupabase || !userId) return;
    window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('college_email, college_domain, college_verified').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle()
      .then(function (res) {
        var prof = res && res.data;
        if (prof && prof.college_verified) {
          $('college-verified-badge').style.display = 'block';
          $('college-verified-badge').textContent = '✓ Verified · ' + prof.college_email;
          $('college-verify-form').style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
  }

  function sendCollegeOtp() {
    var email = ($('cv-email').value || '').trim();
    var msg = $('cv-send-msg');
    if (!email) { msg.textContent = 'Enter your college email.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return; }
    msg.textContent = 'Sending…'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#888';

    fetch('/.netlify/functions/college-email-verify?action=send', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ collegeEmail: email }),
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) { msg.textContent = res.d.error || 'Could not send code.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return; }
        msg.textContent = 'Code sent — check your inbox.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#A855F7';
        $('cv-otp-row').style.display = 'block';
      }).catch(function () { msg.textContent = 'Network error.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; });
  }

  function confirmCollegeOtp() {
    var email = ($('cv-email').value || '').trim();
    var code = ($('cv-code').value || '').trim();
    var msg = $('cv-confirm-msg');
    if (!code) { msg.textContent = 'Enter the code.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return; }
    msg.textContent = 'Verifying…'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#888';

    fetch('/.netlify/functions/college-email-verify?action=confirm', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ collegeEmail: email, code: code }),
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) { msg.textContent = res.d.error || 'Verification failed.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return; }
        $('college-verified-badge').style.display = 'block';
        $('college-verified-badge').textContent = '✓ Verified · ' + email;
        $('college-verify-form').style.display = 'none';
      }).catch(function () { msg.textContent = 'Network error.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; });
  }

  // ── CAMPUS REP panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function renderRepPanel(panel) {
    panel.innerHTML = '<h2 style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px;">CAMPUS REP</h2><div id="rep-body"><p style="color:#888;">Loading…</p></div>';
    loadRepStatus();
  }

  function loadRepStatus() {
    var body = $('rep-body');
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) { body.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Connect Supabase to enable the Campus Rep program.</p>'; return; }

    window.ZGSupabase.rpc('get_rep_stats').then(function (res) {
      var stats = res && res.data;
      if (!stats || !stats.is_rep) {
        renderApplyForm(body);
        return;
      }
      if (stats.status === 'pending') {
        body.innerHTML =
          '<div class="card-panel"><p style="font-size:14px;">Your application is in review — you\'ll be able to share your link once approved. Usually within a day or two.</p></div>';
        return;
      }
      renderRepDashboard(body, stats);
    }).catch(function () { renderApplyForm(body); });
  }

  function renderApplyForm(body) {
    body.innerHTML =
      '<p style="font-size:13px;color:#888;margin-bottom:20px;">Get your own referral link — earn real UPI cash on every order that comes through it. Structured word-of-mouth, no points, no catch.</p>' +
      '<div class="card-panel">' +
        '<div class="form-grid">' +
          field('rep-name', 'text', 'Full Name') +
          field('rep-college', 'text', 'College') +
          field('rep-phone', 'tel', 'Phone') +
          field('rep-year', 'text', 'Year of Study') +
          field('rep-social', 'text', 'Instagram / social handle (optional)') +
          field('rep-upi', 'text', 'UPI ID (for payouts)') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="form-msg" id="rep-apply-msg" style="margin-top:8px;"></div>' +
        '<button class="btn-coral" id="rep-apply-btn" style="margin-top:8px;">Apply to Become a Rep</button>' +
      '</div>';
    $('rep-apply-btn').addEventListener('click', submitRepApplication);
  }

  function field(id, type, label) {
    return '<div class="field-group"><label>' + label + '</label><input type="' + type + '" id="' + id + '"></div>';
  }

  function submitRepApplication() {
    var msg = $('rep-apply-msg');
    var payload = {
      fullName: $('rep-name').value.trim(),
      college: $('rep-college').value.trim(),
      phone: $('rep-phone').value.trim(),
      yearOfStudy: $('rep-year').value.trim(),
      socialHandle: $('rep-social').value.trim(),
      upiId: $('rep-upi').value.trim(),
    };
    if (!payload.fullName || !payload.college || !payload.phone) {
      msg.textContent = 'Name, college and phone are required.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return;
    }
    msg.textContent = 'Submitting…'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#888';

    fetch('/.netlify/functions/rep-apply', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) { msg.textContent = res.d.error || 'Could not submit application.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return; }
        loadRepStatus();
      }).catch(function () { msg.textContent = 'Network error.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; });
  }

  function renderRepDashboard(body, stats) {
    var link = window.location.origin + '/?rep=' + encodeURIComponent(stats.ref_code);
    var badge = stats.badge ? '<span style="background:rgba(244,197,66,.15);color:#F4C542;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-left:8px;">' + stats.badge + '</span>' : '';

    body.innerHTML =
      '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-bottom:16px;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-bottom:6px;">YOUR REFERRAL LINK' + badge + '</div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">' +
          '<code style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;flex:1;min-width:200px;word-break:break-all;">' + link + '</code>' +
          '<button class="btn-coral" id="rep-copy-btn" style="padding:8px 16px;">Copy</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
        statCard('Orders', stats.total_orders) +
        statCard('Total Sales', '₹' + money(stats.total_sales)) +
        statCard('Earned (pending)', '₹' + money(stats.commission_pending)) +
        statCard('Paid Out', '₹' + money(stats.commission_paid)) +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="card-panel">' +
        '<h3 style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:10px;">📅 Add a College Event</h3>' +
        '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-bottom:14px;">Exam windows, placement season, freshers week — help Zivogift nudge your batch at the right moment. Submitted events go live after admin review.</p>' +
        '<div class="form-grid">' +
          field('ev-college', 'text', 'College Name') +
          selectField('ev-type', 'Event Type', ['exams', 'placements', 'freshers_week', 'graduation', 'fest', 'other']) +
          field('ev-label', 'text', 'Label (e.g. "End-sem exams")') +
          field('ev-start', 'date', 'Start Date') +
          selectField('ev-gift', 'Suggested Gift Type', ['hype_reel', 'farewell_note', 'birthday_note', 'meme_card', 'midnight_drop', 'exam_survival_kit']) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="form-msg" id="ev-msg" style="margin-top:8px;"></div>' +
        '<button class="btn-coral" id="ev-submit-btn" style="margin-top:8px;">Submit Event</button>' +
      '</div>';

    $('rep-copy-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(function () {
        $('rep-copy-btn').textContent = 'Copied!';
        setTimeout(function () { $('rep-copy-btn').textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1500);
      });
    });
    $('ev-submit-btn').addEventListener('click', submitCollegeEvent);
  }

  function selectField(id, label, options) {
    return '<div class="field-group"><label>' + label + '</label><select id="' + id + '">' +
      options.map(function (o) { return '<option value="' + o + '">' + o.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</option>'; }).join('') +
      '</select></div>';
  }

  function statCard(label, value) {
    return '<div class="card-panel" style="text-align:center;padding:16px 10px;">' +
      '<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#F4C542;">' + value + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">' + label + '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  function money(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }

  function submitCollegeEvent() {
    var msg = $('ev-msg');
    var payload = {
      collegeName: $('ev-college').value.trim(),
      eventType: $('ev-type').value,
      eventLabel: $('ev-label').value.trim(),
      startDate: $('ev-start').value,
      giftTypeHint: $('ev-gift').value,
    };
    if (!payload.collegeName || !payload.eventLabel || !payload.startDate) {
      msg.textContent = 'College, label, and start date are required.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return;
    }
    msg.textContent = 'Submitting…'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#888';

    fetch('/.netlify/functions/submit-college-event', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) { msg.textContent = res.d.error || 'Could not submit.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; return; }
        msg.textContent = 'Submitted — thanks! It\'ll go live after review.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#A855F7';
        $('ev-college').value = ''; $('ev-label').value = ''; $('ev-start').value = '';
      }).catch(function () { msg.textContent = 'Network error.'; msg.style.display = 'block'; msg.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; });
  }

  // ── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var attempts = 0;
    var poll = setInterval(function () {
      attempts++;
      if (attempts > 30) { clearInterval(poll); return; }
      if (window.ZGAuth) {
        clearInterval(poll);
        window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
          if (!session) return;
          token = session.access_token;
          userId = session.user.id;
          injectTabs();
          if (window.location.hash === '#rep') switchTab('rep');
          if (window.location.hash === '#pass') switchTab('pass');
        }).catch(function () {});
      }
    }, 200);
  });
})();

// Classic script — "Verify Mobile Number" block on account.html's Profile tab.
//
// This replaces the old per-order OTP box that used to live in checkout.js.
// Verification now happens ONCE here and is stored permanently on the
// account (profiles.phone_verified) — create-cashfree-order.js checks that
// flag for any digital-gift order instead of asking for a fresh code every
// time. See verify-sender-otp.js for the server-side half of this.
(function () {
  var resendCooldownTimer = null;
  var currentProfile = null;

  function digitsOnly(s) { return String(s || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); }

  function setStatus(text, isError) {
    var el = document.getElementById('pv-status');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = text || '';
    el.style.color = isError ? '#F87171' : 'inherit';
  }

  function startResendCooldown(seconds) {
    var resendBtn = document.getElementById('pv-resend-btn');
    if (!resendBtn) return;
    var remaining = seconds;
    resendBtn.disabled = true;
    resendBtn.textContent = 'Resend (' + remaining + 's)';
    clearInterval(resendCooldownTimer);
    resendCooldownTimer = setInterval(function () {
      remaining -= 1;
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(resendCooldownTimer);
        resendBtn.disabled = false;
        resendBtn.textContent = 'Resend';
      } else {
        resendBtn.textContent = 'Resend (' + remaining + 's)';
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  // Renders the block for whatever the currently-loaded profile is:
  // no phone saved yet / phone saved but not verified / already verified.
  function render(profile) {
    currentProfile = profile;
    var notSaved = document.getElementById('phone-verify-not-saved');
    var alreadyDone = document.getElementById('phone-verify-already-done');
    var wrap = document.getElementById('phone-verify-wrap');
    if (!notSaved || !alreadyDone || !wrap) return;

    var phone = digitsOnly(profile && profile.phone);
    if (phone.length !== 10) {
      notSaved.style.display = 'block';
      alreadyDone.style.display = 'none';
      wrap.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    notSaved.style.display = 'none';

    if (profile.phone_verified) {
      alreadyDone.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('phone-verify-done-number').textContent = '+91 ' + phone;
      wrap.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      alreadyDone.style.display = 'none';
      wrap.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('pv-step-send').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('pv-step-enter').style.display = 'none';
      var sendBtn = document.getElementById('pv-send-btn');
      if (sendBtn) { sendBtn.disabled = false; sendBtn.textContent = 'Send code via SMS'; }
      setStatus('');
    }
  }

  function sendCode() {
    var phone = digitsOnly(currentProfile && currentProfile.phone);
    if (phone.length !== 10) {
      setStatus('Save a valid 10-digit phone number above first', true);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof window.sendOtp !== 'function') {
      setStatus('Verification is still loading — wait a moment and try again', true);
      return;
    }
    var sendBtn = document.getElementById('pv-send-btn');
    sendBtn.disabled = true;
    sendBtn.textContent = 'Sending…';
    setStatus('');

    window.sendOtp(
      '91' + phone,
      function () {
        document.getElementById('pv-step-send').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('pv-step-enter').style.display = 'block';
        setStatus('Code sent via SMS.');
        startResendCooldown(60);
      },
      function (error) {
        setStatus((error && error.message) || 'Could not send code — check the number and try again', true);
        sendBtn.disabled = false;
        sendBtn.textContent = 'Send code via SMS';
      }
    );
  }

  function verifyCode() {
    var phone = digitsOnly(currentProfile && currentProfile.phone);
    var code = digitsOnly(document.getElementById('pv-code-input').value);
    if (code.length !== 4) {
      setStatus('Enter the 4-digit code', true);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof window.verifyOtp !== 'function') {
      setStatus('Verification is still loading — wait a moment and try again', true);
      return;
    }
    var verifyBtn = document.getElementById('pv-verify-btn');
    verifyBtn.disabled = true;
    verifyBtn.textContent = 'Verifying…';
    setStatus('');

    window.verifyOtp(
      Number(code),
      function (widgetData) {
        var accessToken = (widgetData && (widgetData.message || widgetData.token || widgetData['access-token'])) || null;
        if (!accessToken) {
          setStatus('Verification failed — please try again', true);
          verifyBtn.disabled = false;
          verifyBtn.textContent = 'Verify';
          return;
        }

        window.ZGAuth.requireAuthToken().then(function (token) {
          if (!token) throw new Error('Please log in again and retry.');
          return fetch('/.netlify/functions/verify-sender-otp', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token },
            body: JSON.stringify({ phone: phone, accessToken: accessToken }),
          });
        }).then(function (res) {
          return res.json().then(function (data) { if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Verification failed'); return data; });
        }).then(function () {
          currentProfile = Object.assign({}, currentProfile, { phone_verified: true });
          render(currentProfile);
          var msg = document.getElementById('profile-msg');
          if (msg) { msg.className = 'form-msg show success'; msg.textContent = 'Mobile number verified.'; }
        }).catch(function (err) {
          setStatus(err.message, true);
          verifyBtn.disabled = false;
          verifyBtn.textContent = 'Verify';
        });
      },
      function (error) {
        setStatus((error && error.message) || 'Incorrect or expired code', true);
        verifyBtn.disabled = false;
        verifyBtn.textContent = 'Verify';
      }
    );
  }

  window.ZGAccountPhoneVerify = { render: render };

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    var sendBtn = document.getElementById('pv-send-btn');
    var verifyBtn = document.getElementById('pv-verify-btn');
    var resendBtn = document.getElementById('pv-resend-btn');
    if (sendBtn) sendBtn.addEventListener('click', sendCode);
    if (verifyBtn) verifyBtn.addEventListener('click', verifyCode);
    if (resendBtn) resendBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      document.getElementById('pv-status').textContent = '';
      sendCode();
    });
  });
})();

FILE: js\account-squad.js

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · account-squad.js  (Squad Wall 2.0 progress on the account page)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Standalone, ZERO-touch add-on. It does NOT modify account.js. It watches the
   #orders-list that account.js renders, and for each order card it asks
   get-order-squad-status whether that order contains any squad_drop gifts. If
   so, it injects a "4 of 10 friends have recorded" progress block into that
   order's expandable detail panel.

   How it finds order ids: account.js renders each order's detail container as
   <... data-detail="ORDER_ID">. We read that attribute — no change to account.js.

   Safe by design: if the order has no squad gift (the normal case) nothing is
   injected; if the request fails it stays silent. Nothing here can break the
   orders list.
   Load it AFTER account.js:  <script src="js/account-squad.js"></script>
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var processed = {};   // order_id -> true, so we only fetch once each

  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;' }[c]; }); }

  async function getToken() {
    try {
      var c = window.ZGSupabase || window.sb || window.supabase;
      if (c && c.auth && c.auth.getSession) {
        var r = await c.auth.getSession();
        return r && r.data && r.data.session ? r.data.session.access_token : null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  }

  function progressHtml(g) {
    var pending = (g.pending_contributors || []).map(function (p) { return '<span class="aqs-chip aqs-pending">' + esc(p.contributor_name) + '</span>'; }).join('');
    var done = (g.submitted_contributors || []).map(function (p) { return '<span class="aqs-chip aqs-done">' + esc(p.contributor_name) + ' ✓</span>'; }).join('');
    return '' +
      '<div class="aqs-wrap">' +
        '<div class="aqs-head">👥 Squad wall' + (g.recipient_name ? ' for ' + esc(g.recipient_name) : '') +
          '<strong>' + esc(g.summary_line) + '</strong>' + (g.complete ? '<span class="aqs-badge">Complete 🎉</span>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="aqs-bar"><i style="width:' + (g.percent || 0) + '%"></i></div>' +
        (done ? '<div class="aqs-row">' + done + '</div>' : '') +
        (pending ? '<div class="aqs-row aqs-muted">Still waiting on: ' + pending + '</div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
  }

  function injectStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('aqs-styles')) return;
    var css =
      '.aqs-wrap{margin:14px 0 4px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(124,58,237,.08);border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.25)}' +
      '.aqs-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px}' +
      '.aqs-head strong{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px}' +
      '.aqs-badge{font-size:11px;background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 9px;font-weight:700}' +
      '.aqs-bar{height:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:10px}' +
      '.aqs-bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c3aed,#db2777);border-radius:6px;transition:width .4s}' +
      '.aqs-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px}' +
      '.aqs-muted{opacity:.8}' +
      '.aqs-chip{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}' +
      '.aqs-done{background:rgba(124,58,237,.28)}' +
      '.aqs-pending{opacity:.85}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'aqs-styles'; st.textContent = css;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  async function processOrder(detailEl, orderId, token) {
    if (processed[orderId]) return;
    processed[orderId] = true;
    try {
      var res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-order-squad-status?order_id=' + encodeURIComponent(orderId), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } });
      if (!res.ok) return;
      var data = await res.json();
      var gifts = (data && data.squad_gifts) || [];
      if (!gifts.length) return;                     // not a squad order — stay silent
      injectStyles();
      var block = document.createElement('div');
      block.className = 'aqs-inject';
      block.innerHTML = gifts.map(progressHtml).join('');
      detailEl.appendChild(block);                   // appended inside the order's detail panel
    } catch (e) { /* silent — never break the orders list */ }
  }

  async function scan() {
    var host = document.getElementById('orders-list');
    if (!host) return;
    var details = host.querySelectorAll('[data-detail]');
    if (!details.length) return;
    var token = await getToken();
    if (!token) return;
    details.forEach(function (el) {
      var id = el.getAttribute('data-detail');
      if (id) processOrder(el, id, token);
    });
  }

  function start() {
    var host = document.getElementById('orders-list');
    if (!host) { setTimeout(start, 400); return; }
    // Orders render async (and re-render on tab switches); observe and re-scan.
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function () { scan(); });
    obs.observe(host, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    scan();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  else start();
})();

// Classic script — account page (orders, addresses, profile).
// v2 upgrade: "My Orders" now shows each order as an EXPANDABLE card with a
// full delivery-status tracker, the exact items ordered (qty + recipient),
// delivery address, and totals — so a customer sees status + details inline
// instead of going to the separate track-order page. Everything else
// (addresses, profile, phone-verify hook, self-heal) is unchanged.
(function () {
  function money(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }
  var user = null;

  // Delivery progress order + human labels (mirrors order-status.html).
  var STATUS_FLOW = ['paid', 'processing', 'packed', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered'];
  var STATUS_COPY = {
    pending_payment: 'Waiting for payment',
    payment_failed: 'Payment failed',
    paid: 'Order confirmed',
    processing: "We're preparing your gift",
    packed: 'Packed and ready',
    out_for_delivery: 'Out for delivery',
    delivered: 'Delivered',
    cancelled: 'Order cancelled',
    refunded: 'Order refunded',
  };
  var DIGITAL_PREFIXES = ['digital_', 'squad_', 'carepkg_', 'pass_'];

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }
  function fmtDate(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
  }
  function isDigitalItem(i) {
    var pid = i.product_id || '';
    return DIGITAL_PREFIXES.some(function (p) { return pid.startsWith(p); });
  }
  function orderIsAllDigital(o) {
    return !o.address_line && (o.order_items || []).every(isDigitalItem);
  }

  function notConnectedGuard() {
    if (window.ZGSupabase) return false;
    document.querySelector('.account-grid').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state" style="grid-column:1/-1;"><div class="e-icon">🔌</div>' +
      '<p>Accounts aren\'t connected yet — this page needs Supabase configured in js/config.js.</p></div>';
    return true;
  }

  function guard() {
    return window.ZGAuth.getCurrentUser().then(function (u) {
      if (!u) { window.location.href = 'login.html?redirect=account.html'; return false; }
      user = u;
      return true;
    });
  }

  function showTab(tab) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-nav button[data-tab]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tab);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-panel').forEach(function (p) {
      p.style.display = p.id === 'panel-' + tab ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
    if (tab === 'orders') loadOrders();
    if (tab === 'addresses') loadAddresses();
    if (tab === 'profile') loadProfile();
  }

  var loadedProfile = null;
  function loadProfile() {
    window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', user.id).maybeSingle().then(function (res) {
      var profile = res.data;
      var meta = (user.user_metadata || user.raw_user_meta_data || {});
      var fullName = (profile && profile.full_name) || meta.full_name || '';
      var phone = (profile && profile.phone) || meta.phone || '';
      var emailEl = document.getElementById('profile-email');
      if (emailEl) emailEl.value = user.email || '';
      document.getElementById('profile-name').value = fullName;
      document.getElementById('profile-phone').value = phone;
      if (!profile) {
        window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').upsert({ id: user.id, full_name: fullName, phone: phone }).then(function () {});
        profile = { id: user.id, full_name: fullName, phone: phone };
      }
      loadedProfile = profile;
      renderProfileHeader(fullName, user.email);
      if (window.ZGAccountPhoneVerify) window.ZGAccountPhoneVerify.render(profile);
    });
  }

  function renderProfileHeader(fullName, email) {
    var first = (fullName || email || 'there').trim().split(/[\s@]+/)[0];
    var initials = (fullName || email || '?').trim().split(/\s+/).map(function (w) { return w.charAt(0); })
      .join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || '?';
    var av = document.getElementById('acct-avatar');
    var hi = document.getElementById('acct-hello');
    var em = document.getElementById('acct-email');
    if (av) av.textContent = initials;
    if (hi) hi.textContent = 'Hi, ' + first;
    if (em) em.textContent = email || '';
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     MY ORDERS — expandable cards with status tracker + full details
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  var ordersById = {};

  function loadOrders() {
    var host = document.getElementById('orders-list');
    host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Loading…</p>';
    window.ZGSupabase.from('orders').select('*, order_items(*)').eq('user_id', user.id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }).then(function (res) {
        var orders = res.data;
        if (res.error || !orders || !orders.length) {
          host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="e-icon">📦</div><p>No orders yet.</p>' +
            '<a href="index.html" class="btn-coral" style="margin-top:14px;display:inline-block;">Browse Gifts</a></div>';
          return;
        }
        ordersById = {};
        orders.forEach(function (o) { ordersById[o.id] = o; });

        host.innerHTML = orders.map(function (o) {
          var itemsSummary = (o.order_items || []).map(function (i) { return esc(i.name_snapshot) + ' × ' + i.qty; }).join(', ');
          return '<div class="order-card" data-order-card="' + o.id + '">' +
            // Clickable header
            '<div class="order-card-top" style="cursor:pointer;" data-toggle="' + o.id + '">' +
              '<div>' +
                '<span class="order-num">' + esc(o.order_number) + '</span>' +
                '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px;">' + fmtDate(o.created_at) + '</div>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">' +
                '<span class="status-pill ' + o.status + '">' + o.status.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</span>' +
                '<span class="ord-caret" data-caret="' + o.id + '" style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;">▾ Details</span>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            // Always-visible one-line summary
            '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px;">' + itemsSummary + '</div>' +
            '<div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--gold-light);margin-top:6px;">₹' + money(o.total) + '</div>' +
            // Expandable detail (hidden by default)
            '<div class="order-detail" data-detail="' + o.id + '" style="display:none;">' + orderDetailHtml(o) + '</div>' +
          '</div>';
        }).join('');

        wireOrderCards(host);
      });
  }

  // The delivery-status tracker + item list + delivery info for one order.
  function orderDetailHtml(o) {
    var isBad = ['cancelled', 'payment_failed', 'refunded'].indexOf(o.status) !== -1;
    var allDigital = orderIsAllDigital(o);
    var currentIdx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(o.status);

    // Status tracker
    var tracker;
    if (isBad) {
      tracker = '<div class="timeline"><div class="timeline-step" style="color:var(--coral);">' +
        '<span class="timeline-dot" style="background:var(--coral);"></span>' + esc(STATUS_COPY[o.status] || o.status) + '</div></div>';
    } else {
      tracker = '<div class="timeline">' + STATUS_FLOW.map(function (s, i) {
        var done = currentIdx >= i;
        var isCurrent = currentIdx === i;
        return '<div class="timeline-step" style="color:' + (done ? 'var(--white)' : 'var(--grey)') + ';font-weight:' + (isCurrent ? '700' : '400') + ';">' +
          '<span class="timeline-dot" style="background:' + (done ? 'var(--gold-light)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.2)') + ';"></span>' +
          (allDigital && s === 'out_for_delivery' ? 'Sending' : STATUS_COPY[s]) +
          (isCurrent ? ' — current' : '') + '</div>';
      }).join('') + '</div>';
    }

    // Items ordered
    var items = (o.order_items || []).map(function (i) {
      var line = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;">' +
        '<div><b>' + esc(i.name_snapshot) + '</b> × ' + i.qty +
        (i.recipient_name ? '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;">For ' + esc(i.recipient_name) + '</div>' : '') +
        (i.message ? '<div style="color:#cfcbc2;font-size:12px;font-style:italic;">“' + esc(i.message) + '”</div>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
        (i.line_total != null ? '<div style="white-space:nowrap;color:var(--gold-light);">₹' + money(i.line_total) + '</div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
      return line;
    }).join('');

    // Delivery block
    var delivery;
    if (allDigital) {
      delivery = '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;">📱 Digital delivery — sent to the recipient directly, no shipping address needed.</div>';
    } else if (o.address_line) {
      var typeLabel = { standard: 'Standard delivery', campus: 'Campus pickup/drop', express: 'Express delivery' }[o.delivery_type] || o.delivery_type || 'Delivery';
      delivery = '<div style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;">' +
        '<div>' + esc(o.address_line) + '</div>' +
        '<div style="color:var(--grey);">' + esc(o.city || '') + (o.pincode ? ' — ' + esc(o.pincode) : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div style="color:var(--gold-light);font-size:12px;">' + esc(typeLabel) + '</div>' +
        (o.delivery_notes ? '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;">📝 ' + esc(o.delivery_notes) + '</div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
    } else {
      delivery = '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;">No delivery address on file.</div>';
    }

    return '<div style="margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);">' +
      section('Delivery status') + tracker +
      section('Items') + '<div style="margin-top:6px;">' + items + '</div>' +
      section('Delivery details') + '<div style="margin-top:6px;">' + delivery + '</div>' +
      // Totals
      section('Summary') +
      '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:13px;">' +
        row('Total', '<b style="color:var(--gold-light);">₹' + money(o.total) + '</b>') +
        (o.contact_phone ? row('Contact', esc(o.contact_name || '') + ' · ' + esc(o.contact_phone)) : '') +
      '</div>' +
      // Deep link to the live tracker (guests + email links use it too)
      '<div style="margin-top:14px;">' +
        '<a class="btn-ghost" style="padding:8px 16px;font-size:12px;" href="order-status.html?order_number=' +
        encodeURIComponent(o.order_number) + '&phone=' + encodeURIComponent(o.contact_phone || '') + '">Open full tracker →</a>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }
  function section(t) {
    return '<div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);margin-top:14px;">' + t + '</div>';
  }
  function row(k, v) {
    return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);"><span style="color:var(--grey);">' + k + '</span><span>' + v + '</span></div>';
  }

  function wireOrderCards(host) {
    host.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle]').forEach(function (hdr) {
      hdr.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var id = hdr.dataset.toggle;
        var det = host.querySelector('[data-detail="' + id + '"]');
        var caret = host.querySelector('[data-caret="' + id + '"]');
        if (!det) return;
        var open = det.style.display !== 'none';
        det.style.display = open ? 'none' : 'block';
        if (caret) caret.textContent = open ? '▾ Details' : '▴ Hide';
      });
    });
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ADDRESSES (unchanged)
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function loadAddresses() {
    var host = document.getElementById('addresses-list');
    window.ZGSupabase.from('addresses').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).order('is_default', { ascending: false }).then(function (res) {
      var addresses = res.data;
      if (!addresses || !addresses.length) {
        host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">No saved addresses yet.</p>';
        return;
      }
      host.innerHTML = addresses.map(function (a) {
        return '<div class="order-card">' +
          '<div class="order-card-top">' +
            '<div class="order-num">' + esc(a.label) + (a.is_default ? ' (default)' : '') + '</div>' +
            '<span data-del="' + a.id + '" style="cursor:pointer;color:var(--grey);">🗑</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--grey);line-height:1.6;">' + esc(a.recipient_name) + ' · ' + esc(a.phone) + '<br>' +
          esc(a.line1) + (a.line2 ? ', ' + esc(a.line2) : '') + ', ' + esc(a.city) + ', ' + esc(a.state || '') + ' ' + esc(a.pincode) + '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
      host.querySelectorAll('[data-del]').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function () {
          window.ZGSupabase.from('addresses').delete().eq('id', el.dataset.del).then(loadAddresses);
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function ready(fn) { if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn); else fn(); }

  ready(function () {
    if (notConnectedGuard()) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-nav button[data-tab]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { showTab(b.dataset.tab); });
    });
    var logoutBtn = document.getElementById('logout-btn');
    if (logoutBtn) logoutBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { window.ZGAuth.signOut(); });

    var profileSave = document.getElementById('profile-save');
    if (profileSave) {
      profileSave.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var full_name = document.getElementById('profile-name').value.trim();
        var phone = document.getElementById('profile-phone').value.trim();
        var msg = document.getElementById('profile-msg');
        var phoneChanged = loadedProfile && (loadedProfile.phone || '') !== phone;
        window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').update({ full_name: full_name, phone: phone }).eq('id', user.id).select().single().then(function (res) {
          msg.className = 'form-msg show ' + (res.error ? 'error' : 'success');
          msg.textContent = res.error ? res.error.message : (phoneChanged ? 'Saved. Since your number changed, verify it again below.' : 'Saved.');
          if (!res.error) {
            loadedProfile = res.data;
            if (window.ZGAccountPhoneVerify) window.ZGAccountPhoneVerify.render(res.data);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    var addressForm = document.getElementById('address-form');
    if (addressForm) {
      addressForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var msg = document.getElementById('address-msg');
        var payload = {
          user_id: user.id,
          label: document.getElementById('addr-label').value.trim() || 'Home',
          recipient_name: document.getElementById('addr-name').value.trim(),
          phone: document.getElementById('addr-phone').value.trim(),
          line1: document.getElementById('addr-line1').value.trim(),
          line2: document.getElementById('addr-line2').value.trim(),
          city: document.getElementById('addr-city').value.trim() || 'Bengaluru',
          pincode: document.getElementById('addr-pincode').value.trim(),
          is_default: document.getElementById('addr-default').checked,
        };
        if (!payload.recipient_name || !payload.phone || !payload.line1 || !payload.pincode) {
          msg.className = 'form-msg show error';
          msg.textContent = 'Please fill in all required fields.';
          return;
        }
        var pre = payload.is_default
          ? window.ZGSupabase.from('addresses').update({ is_default: false }).eq('user_id', user.id)
          : Promise.resolve();
        pre.then(function () {
          return window.ZGSupabase.from('addresses').insert(payload);
        }).then(function (res) {
          msg.className = 'form-msg show ' + (res.error ? 'error' : 'success');
          msg.textContent = res.error ? res.error.message : 'Address saved.';
          if (!res.error) { addressForm.reset(); loadAddresses(); }
        });
      });
    }

    guard().then(function (ok) {
      if (!ok) return;
      var meta = (user.user_metadata || user.raw_user_meta_data || {});
      renderProfileHeader(meta.full_name || '', user.email);
      window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('full_name').eq('id', user.id).maybeSingle().then(function (res) {
        renderProfileHeader((res.data && res.data.full_name) || meta.full_name || '', user.email);
      });
      showTab('orders');
    });
  });
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · admin-bi.js  (Run 6 — Admin Business Intelligence tab)
   Adds a self-contained "📈 Analytics" tab to admin.html. Defensive about the
   existing tab system: injects its own nav button + panel if not present, and
   hooks the click to show ours. Data: GET /admin-analytics with the admin's
   bearer token (from the Supabase client admin.html already loads).
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  function el(tag, attrs, html) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (attrs) Object.keys(attrs).forEach(function (k) {
      if (k === 'style') n.style.cssText = attrs[k];
      else if (k === 'class') n.className = attrs[k];
      else n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    });
    if (html != null) n.innerHTML = html;
    return n;
  }
  function inr(n) { if (n == null) return '—'; return '\u20B9' + Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;' }[c]; }); }
  function fmtDelay(s) { if (s == null) return '—'; if (s < 60) return s + 's'; var m = Math.floor(s / 60); return m < 60 ? (m + 'm ' + (s % 60) + 's') : (Math.floor(m / 60) + 'h ' + (m % 60) + 'm'); }

  async function getToken() {
    try {
      var client = window.sb || window.supabaseClient || window.supabase;
      if (client && client.auth && client.auth.getSession) {
        var res = await client.auth.getSession();
        return res && res.data && res.data.session ? res.data.session.access_token : null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  }

  function statCard(label, value, sub) {
    return '<div class="bi-card"><div class="bi-val">' + value + '</div><div class="bi-lbl">' + label + '</div>' + (sub ? '<div class="bi-sub">' + sub + '</div>' : '') + '</div>';
  }

  function renderDashboard(container, d) {
    var g = d.gifts || {}, rev = d.revenue || {};
    var cards = [
      statCard('Revenue (captured)', rev.available ? inr(rev.total) : '—', rev.available ? (rev.paid_orders + ' paid orders') : ('n/a · ' + (rev.reason || 'orders schema'))),
      statCard('Gifts delivered', g.sent != null ? g.sent : '—', (g.total || 0) + ' total'),
      statCard('Open rate', (g.open_rate_pct != null ? g.open_rate_pct + '%' : '—'), 'opened / delivered'),
      statCard('Avg time to open', g.avg_open_delay_seconds != null ? fmtDelay(g.avg_open_delay_seconds) : '—', ''),
      statCard('Reaction rate', (g.reaction_rate_pct != null ? g.reaction_rate_pct + '%' : '—'), 'emoji reactions'),
      statCard('Pending', g.pending != null ? g.pending : '—', (g.time_capsules || 0) + ' time capsules'),
      statCard('Failed deliveries', g.failed != null ? g.failed : '—', 'see table below'),
      statCard('Squad videos', d.squad_videos_submitted != null ? d.squad_videos_submitted : '—', 'submitted')
    ].join('');
    var perf = (g.gift_performance || []).map(function (p) {
      var max = (g.gift_performance[0] && g.gift_performance[0].count) || 1;
      var w = Math.max(4, Math.round((p.count / max) * 100));
      return '<div class="bi-bar-row"><span class="bi-bar-lbl">' + esc(p.gift_type) + '</span><span class="bi-bar"><i style="width:' + w + '%"></i></span><span class="bi-bar-num">' + p.count + '</span></div>';
    }).join('') || '<div class="bi-empty">No gift data yet.</div>';
    var failed = (d.failed_deliveries || []).map(function (f) {
      return '<tr><td>' + esc(f.recipient_name || '—') + '</td><td>' + esc(f.channel || '—') + '</td><td>' + esc(f.gift_type || '—') + '</td><td>' + (f.attempts || 0) + '</td><td class="bi-err">' + esc(f.error_message || '') + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="5" class="bi-empty">No failed deliveries 🎉</td></tr>';
    container.innerHTML =
      '<div class="bi-grid">' + cards + '</div>' +
      '<h3 class="bi-h3">Gift performance</h3><div class="bi-bars">' + perf + '</div>' +
      '<h3 class="bi-h3">Failed deliveries</h3>' +
      '<div class="table-scroll"><table class="admin-table bi-table"><thead><tr><th>Recipient</th><th>Channel</th><th>Type</th><th>Attempts</th><th>Error</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + failed + '</tbody></table></div>' +
      '<div class="bi-foot">Generated ' + new Date(d.generated_at || Date.now()).toLocaleString('en-IN') + '</div>';
  }

  async function load(panel) {
    panel.innerHTML = '<div class="bi-empty">Loading analytics…</div>';
    var token = await getToken();
    if (!token) { panel.innerHTML = '<div class="bi-empty">Please log in as admin.</div>'; return; }
    try {
      var res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/admin-analytics', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } });
      if (res.status === 403) { panel.innerHTML = '<div class="bi-empty">Not authorised. Ask to be added to ADMIN_EMAILS.</div>'; return; }
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('http ' + res.status);
      renderDashboard(panel, await res.json());
    } catch (e) { panel.innerHTML = '<div class="bi-empty">Could not load analytics. Please retry.</div>'; }
  }

  function injectStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('bi-styles')) return;
    var css =
      '.bi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:24px}' +
      '.bi-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;padding:16px}' +
      '.bi-val{font-family:"Bebas Neue",sans-serif;font-size:30px;line-height:1;color:var(--coral,#FF4D2E)}' +
      '.bi-lbl{font-size:12px;opacity:.8;margin-top:6px;letter-spacing:.5px}' +
      '.bi-sub{font-size:11px;opacity:.5;margin-top:2px}' +
      '.bi-h3{font-family:"Bebas Neue",sans-serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin:22px 0 12px}' +
      '.bi-bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}' +
      '.bi-bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px}' +
      '.bi-bar-lbl{flex:0 0 150px;opacity:.85;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}' +
      '.bi-bar{flex:1;height:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}' +
      '.bi-bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--coral,#FF4D2E);border-radius:6px}' +
      '.bi-bar-num{flex:0 0 40px;text-align:right;opacity:.7}' +
      '.bi-table td,.bi-table th{padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}' +
      '.bi-err{color:#ff9a9a;max-width:280px}' +
      '.bi-empty{opacity:.6;font-size:13px;padding:20px;text-align:center}' +
      '.bi-foot{opacity:.4;font-size:11px;margin-top:16px;text-align:right}';
    document.head.appendChild(el('style', { id: 'bi-styles' }, css));
  }

  function ensureTab() {
    var nav = document.querySelector('.account-nav');
    if (!nav) return null;
    var panel = document.getElementById('admin-analytics');
    if (!panel) {
      panel = el('div', { class: 'admin-panel', id: 'admin-analytics', style: 'display:none;' });
      panel.appendChild(el('h2', { style: 'font-family:"Bebas Neue",sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:18px;' }, 'ANALYTICS'));
      panel.appendChild(el('div', { id: 'admin-analytics-body' }));
      var content = nav.parentElement.querySelector('div:last-child') || nav.parentElement;
      content.appendChild(panel);
    }
    var btn = nav.querySelector('[data-tab="analytics"]');
    if (!btn) {
      btn = el('button', { 'data-tab': 'analytics' }, '📈 Analytics');
      var logout = document.getElementById('logout-btn');
      if (logout) nav.insertBefore(btn, logout); else nav.appendChild(btn);
    }
    return { btn: btn, panel: panel, body: document.getElementById('admin-analytics-body') };
  }

  function activate(refs) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.admin-panel').forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = 'none'; });
    refs.panel.style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-nav [data-tab]').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    refs.btn.classList.add('active');
    load(refs.body);
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    injectStyles();
    var refs = ensureTab();
    if (!refs) return;
    refs.btn.addEventListener('click', function () { activate(refs); });
  });
})();

FILE: js\admin-campaigns.js

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · js/admin-campaigns.js — the 📢 Campaigns admin tab.

   Loaded after js/admin.js, same as js/admin-group5.js and js/admin-bi.js.
   admin.js's showTab() calls window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab(tab) for every tab
   switch; this file wraps that hook rather than replacing it, so both files
   keep working. See wireTabHook() at the bottom.

   Auth: bearer token from the Supabase client admin.html already loads,
   exactly like js/admin-bi.js does it.

   DESIGN NOTE — the launch flow is deliberately three steps:
     Preview  -> you see the real reachable count
     Test     -> the real message arrives on your own phone/inbox
     Launch   -> requires typing the word SEND, and passes the previewed
                 count back to the server, which refuses if it has changed.
   Every one of those exists because the failure mode here is not "a bug",
   it is "a wrong message delivered to every customer you have, permanently".
   ========================================================================= */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var FN = '/.netlify/functions/admin-campaigns';
  var state = { segments: [], templates: [], lastPreview: null, editing: null };

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }
  function num(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }
  function fmtDate(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '—';
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }

  // Same token strategy as js/admin-bi.js.
  async function getToken() {
    try {
      var client = window.ZGSupabase || window.sb || window.supabaseClient || window.supabase;
      if (client && client.auth && client.auth.getSession) {
        var res = await client.auth.getSession();
        return res && res.data && res.data.session ? res.data.session.access_token : null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  }

  async function api(payload, qs) {
    var token = await getToken();
    if (!token) throw new Error('Not signed in. Reload the page and log in again.');
    var url = FN + (qs || '');
    var opts = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } };
    if (payload) {
      opts.method = 'POST';
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(payload);
    }
    var res = await fetch(url, opts);
    var data = await res.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || data.error || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    return data;
  }

  function host() { return document.getElementById('admin-campaigns-body'); }

  // ── MAIN RENDER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function load() {
    var h = host();
    if (!h) return;
    h.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Loading campaigns…</p>';

    try {
      var results = await Promise.all([
        api(null, '?action=segments'),
        api(null, '?action=list'),
        api(null, '?action=templates')
      ]);
      state.segments = results[0].segments || [];
      state.settings = results[0].settings || {};
      state.templates = results[2].marketing || [];
      state.templateNote = results[2].note;
      render(results[1].campaigns || []);
    } catch (e) {
      h.innerHTML = '<div class="card-panel" style="border-color:var(--coral);">' +
        '<p style="color:var(--coral);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;">Could not load Campaigns</p>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;margin-top:10px;">If this mentions a missing table, run ' +
        '<code>supabase/consolidated/60_campaigns_and_admin_ops.sql</code> in the Supabase SQL editor.</p></div>';
    }
  }

  function render(campaigns) {
    var h = host();
    var paused = state.settings && state.settings.pause_campaigns;

    h.innerHTML =
      (paused ? banner('⏸ Campaigns are PAUSED', 'No campaign will send until you turn this off in the Emergency tab.') : '') +
      (state.templateNote ? banner('WhatsApp campaigns unavailable', state.templateNote) : '') +
      composerHtml() +
      '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-top:20px;">' +
        '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:14px;">PAST &amp; RUNNING CAMPAIGNS</div>' +
        campaignsTable(campaigns) +
      '</div>';

    wireComposer();
    wireTable();
  }

  function banner(title, text) {
    return '<div style="margin-bottom:16px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;' +
      'background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral) 12%, rgba(255,255,255,.03));' +
      'border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral) 35%, transparent);">' +
      '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:4px;">' + esc(title) + '</div>' +
      '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;line-height:18px;">' + esc(text) + '</div></div>';
  }

  // ── COMPOSER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function composerHtml() {
    var segOpts = state.segments.map(function (s) {
      var count = s.reachable != null ? ' (' + num(s.reachable) + ' reachable)' : '';
      return '<option value="' + esc(s.key) + '">' + esc(s.label) + esc(count) + '</option>';
    }).join('');

    var tplOpts = state.templates.length
      ? state.templates.map(function (t) {
          return '<option value="' + esc(t.name) + '">' + esc(t.name) + ' · ' + esc(t.language) +
                 ' · ' + esc(t.bodyParamCount) + ' vars</option>';
        }).join('')
      : '<option value="">— no approved MARKETING template —</option>';

    return '<div class="card-panel">' +
      '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:14px;">NEW CAMPAIGN</div>' +

      fieldRow('Campaign name', '<input type="text" id="c-name" placeholder="e.g. Diwali 2026 — 20% off" style="width:100%;">') +

      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px;">' +
        fieldRow('Channel',
          '<select id="c-channel" style="width:100%;">' +
            '<option value="email">Email only</option>' +
            '<option value="whatsapp">WhatsApp only</option>' +
            '<option value="both">Email + WhatsApp</option>' +
          '</select>') +
        fieldRow('Audience', '<select id="c-segment" style="width:100%;">' + segOpts + '</select>') +
      '</div>' +

      '<div id="c-seg-desc" style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;margin:-6px 0 14px;"></div>' +

      '<div id="c-email-fields">' +
        fieldRow('Email subject', '<input type="text" id="c-subject" placeholder="The subject line they see in the inbox" style="width:100%;">') +
      '</div>' +

      '<div id="c-wa-fields" style="display:none;">' +
        fieldRow('WhatsApp template <span style="color:var(--grey);font-weight:400;">(must be an APPROVED MARKETING template)</span>',
          '<select id="c-template" style="width:100%;">' + tplOpts + '</select>') +
      '</div>' +

      fieldRow('Message', '<textarea id="c-body" rows="6" placeholder="Write the promotional message here.&#10;&#10;Blank lines become paragraphs in the email." style="width:100%;resize:vertical;"></textarea>') +

      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px;">' +
        fieldRow('Button link', '<input type="text" id="c-cta-url" placeholder="https://zivogift.com" style="width:100%;">') +
        fieldRow('Button label', '<input type="text" id="c-cta-label" placeholder="Send a gift" style="width:100%;">') +
      '</div>' +

      '<div style="border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:16px 0;padding-top:16px;">' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">' +
          '<button class="btn-ghost" id="c-preview" style="padding:9px 18px;font-size:13px;">1 · Preview audience</button>' +
          '<button class="btn-ghost" id="c-test" style="padding:9px 18px;font-size:13px;">2 · Send test to me</button>' +
          '<button class="btn-coral" id="c-launch" style="padding:9px 18px;font-size:13px;" disabled>3 · Launch</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:12px;">' +
          '<input type="email" id="c-test-email" placeholder="Test email (defaults to yours)" style="width:100%;font-size:12px;">' +
          '<input type="tel" id="c-test-phone" placeholder="Test phone, 10 digits" style="width:100%;font-size:12px;">' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +

      '<div id="c-result"></div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  function fieldRow(label, control) {
    return '<div style="margin-bottom:14px;">' +
      '<label style="display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:6px;">' + label + '</label>' +
      control + '</div>';
  }

  function readForm() {
    return {
      name: val('c-name'),
      channel: val('c-channel'),
      segment: val('c-segment'),
      subject: val('c-subject'),
      body: val('c-body'),
      cta_url: val('c-cta-url'),
      cta_label: val('c-cta-label'),
      wa_template: val('c-template'),
      test_email: val('c-test-email'),
      test_phone: val('c-test-phone')
    };
  }
  function val(id) { var e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? e.value.trim() : ''; }

  function wireComposer() {
    var chan = document.getElementById('c-channel');
    var seg = document.getElementById('c-segment');

    function syncChannel() {
      var v = chan.value;
      document.getElementById('c-email-fields').style.display = (v === 'email' || v === 'both') ? 'block' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('c-wa-fields').style.display = (v === 'whatsapp' || v === 'both') ? 'block' : 'none';
      invalidate();
    }
    function syncSegment() {
      var s = state.segments.filter(function (x) { return x.key === seg.value; })[0];
      document.getElementById('c-seg-desc').textContent = s ? s.describe : '';
      invalidate();
    }
    chan.addEventListener('change', syncChannel);
    seg.addEventListener('change', syncSegment);
    ['c-name', 'c-subject', 'c-body'].forEach(function (id) {
      var e = document.getElementById(id);
      if (e) e.addEventListener('input', invalidate);
    });
    syncChannel(); syncSegment();

    document.getElementById('c-preview').addEventListener('click', doPreview);
    document.getElementById('c-test').addEventListener('click', doTest);
    document.getElementById('c-launch').addEventListener('click', doLaunch);
  }

  // Any edit after a preview invalidates the launch. The server enforces this
  // too (expected_count), but disabling the button makes the rule visible
  // rather than something you discover via a 409.
  function invalidate() {
    state.lastPreview = null;
    var b = document.getElementById('c-launch');
    if (b) { b.disabled = true; b.textContent = '3 · Launch'; }
  }

  function result(html) { document.getElementById('c-result').innerHTML = html; }

  function busy(id, label) {
    var b = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!b) return function () {};
    var old = b.textContent;
    b.disabled = true; b.textContent = label;
    return function () { b.disabled = false; b.textContent = old; };
  }

  // ── STEP 1: PREVIEW ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function doPreview() {
    var done = busy('c-preview', 'Counting…');
    try {
      var form = readForm();
      var data = await api({ action: 'preview', channel: form.channel, segment: form.segment,
        name: form.name, body: form.body, subject: form.subject, wa_template: form.wa_template });
      var s = data.stats;

      var issues = (data.validation || []);
      var sampleHtml = (data.sample || []).map(function (x) {
        return '<li style="margin-bottom:3px;">' + esc(x.name) + ' — ' + esc(x.email || x.phone || '') + '</li>';
      }).join('');

      result(
        '<div style="margin-top:16px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--line);">' +
          '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;">' + num(s.reachable) + ' people will receive this</div>' +
          '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;line-height:20px;">' +
            'Matched the segment: <strong>' + num(s.matched) + '</strong><br>' +
            'Removed — unsubscribed: <strong>' + num(s.opted_out) + '</strong><br>' +
            'Email messages: <strong>' + num(s.email_recipients) + '</strong> · ' +
            'WhatsApp messages: <strong>' + num(s.whatsapp_recipients) + '</strong><br>' +
            'No usable email: ' + num(s.no_email) + ' · No usable phone: ' + num(s.no_phone) +
          '</div>' +
          (sampleHtml ? '<div style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;">Sample:<ul style="margin:6px 0 0 18px;">' + sampleHtml + '</ul></div>' : '') +
          (issues.length
            ? '<div style="margin-top:12px;color:var(--coral);font-size:12px;">⚠ ' + esc(issues.join(' ')) + '</div>'
            : '<div style="margin-top:12px;color:#4ADE80;font-size:12px;">✓ Ready. Send a test to yourself, then launch.</div>') +
        '</div>');

      if (!issues.length && s.reachable > 0) {
        state.lastPreview = { count: s.reachable, form: form };
        var b = document.getElementById('c-launch');
        b.disabled = false;
        b.textContent = '3 · Launch to ' + num(s.reachable);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      result('<p style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;margin-top:12px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>');
    }
    done();
  }

  // ── STEP 2: TEST ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function doTest() {
    var done = busy('c-test', 'Sending…');
    try {
      var form = readForm();
      var data = await api(Object.assign({ action: 'test' }, form));
      result('<div style="margin-top:16px;">' + (data.results || []).map(function (r) {
        return '<div style="padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;' +
          'background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid ' + (r.ok ? 'rgba(74,222,128,.4)' : 'var(--coral)') + ';">' +
          (r.ok ? '✓' : '✗') + ' <strong>' + esc(r.channel) + '</strong> — ' +
          esc(r.ok ? ('sent (id ' + (r.id || 'n/a') + ')') : (r.error || 'failed')) + '</div>';
      }).join('') + '</div>');
    } catch (e) {
      result('<p style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;margin-top:12px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>');
    }
    done();
  }

  // ── STEP 3: LAUNCH ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function doLaunch() {
    if (!state.lastPreview) { alert('Preview the audience first.'); return; }
    var count = state.lastPreview.count;

    // Typing SEND, not clicking OK. A confirm() dialog is dismissed by reflex;
    // typing a word is not. This is the last gate before it is irreversible.
    var typed = prompt(
      'This will send to ' + num(count) + ' people and CANNOT be undone.\n\n' +
      'Type SEND to confirm:');
    if (String(typed || '').trim().toUpperCase() !== 'SEND') {
      result('<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;margin-top:12px;">Launch cancelled.</p>');
      return;
    }

    var done = busy('c-launch', 'Queueing…');
    try {
      // Save first so the server has a persisted row to launch.
      var saved = await api(Object.assign({ action: 'save' }, state.lastPreview.form));
      var data = await api({ action: 'launch', id: saved.campaign.id, confirm: true, expected_count: count });

      result('<div style="margin-top:16px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;' +
        'background:rgba(74,222,128,.08);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.4);">' +
        '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;">✓ Queued ' + num(data.queued) + ' messages</div>' +
        '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;line-height:19px;">' + esc(data.note) + '<br>' +
        'Roughly ' + Math.ceil(data.queued / 240) + ' hour(s) to fully drain. ' +
        'Watch progress in the table below, or stop it from the Emergency tab.</div></div>');

      invalidate();
      setTimeout(load, 1500);
    } catch (e) {
      result('<p style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;margin-top:12px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>');
    }
    done();
  }

  // ── CAMPAIGN TABLE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function campaignsTable(campaigns) {
    if (!campaigns.length) {
      return '<div class="empty-state"><div class="e-icon">📢</div><p>No campaigns yet.</p></div>';
    }
    return '<div class="table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Campaign</th><th>Channel</th><th>Audience</th><th>Status</th><th>Progress</th><th>Started</th><th>Actions</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
      campaigns.map(function (c) {
        var doneN = (c.sent_count || 0) + (c.failed_count || 0);
        var pct = c.total_recipients ? Math.round((doneN / c.total_recipients) * 100) : 0;
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td>' + esc(c.name) + (c.is_automated ? ' <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--gold-light);">AUTO</span>' : '') +
            (c.subject ? '<br><span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">' + esc(c.subject) + '</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + esc(c.channel) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + esc(c.segment) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + statusPill(c.status) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="min-width:150px;">' +
            '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;">' + num(c.sent_count) + ' sent · ' +
              '<span style="color:' + (c.failed_count ? 'var(--coral)' : 'var(--grey)') + ';">' + num(c.failed_count) + ' failed</span>' +
              ' / ' + num(c.total_recipients) + '</div>' +
            '<div style="height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow:hidden;">' +
              '<div style="height:100%;width:' + pct + '%;background:var(--gold-light);"></div></div>' +
          '</td>' +
          '<td style="font-size:12px;">' + fmtDate(c.started_at) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="white-space:nowrap;">' + rowActions(c) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }

  function statusPill(s) {
    var colors = { draft: 'var(--grey)', scheduled: 'var(--gold-light)', sending: '#4ADE80',
                   paused: 'var(--gold-light)', completed: '#4ADE80', cancelled: 'var(--grey)' };
    return '<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:' + (colors[s] || 'var(--grey)') + ';">' + esc(s) + '</span>';
  }

  function rowActions(c) {
    var b = [];
    if (c.status === 'sending') b.push(act('pause', c.id, 'Pause'));
    if (c.status === 'paused') b.push(act('resume', c.id, 'Resume'));
    if (['draft', 'scheduled', 'sending', 'paused'].indexOf(c.status) !== -1) b.push(act('cancel', c.id, 'Cancel'));
    if (c.failed_count > 0) b.push(act('retry_failed', c.id, 'Retry failed'));
    b.push('<a href="#" data-export="' + c.id + '" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gold-light);margin-left:6px;">CSV</a>');
    return b.join(' ');
  }
  function act(a, id, label) {
    return '<button class="btn-ghost" data-act="' + a + '" data-id="' + id + '" style="padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;margin-right:4px;">' + label + '</button>';
  }

  function wireTable() {
    var h = host();
    h.querySelectorAll('[data-act]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
        var a = btn.dataset.act;
        if (a === 'cancel' && !confirm('Cancel this campaign? Anything not yet sent will be skipped.')) return;
        btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '…';
        try { await api({ action: a, id: btn.dataset.id }); load(); }
        catch (e) { alert(e.message); btn.disabled = false; }
      });
    });
    h.querySelectorAll('[data-export]').forEach(function (a) {
      a.addEventListener('click', async function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        if (window.ZGAdminOps && window.ZGAdminOps.download) {
          window.ZGAdminOps.download('campaign', a.dataset.export);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  // ── TAB HOOK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // admin.js calls window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab(tab). admin-group5.js already
  // owns that property, so we CHAIN rather than overwrite — otherwise the
  // Campus Reps / Calendar / Vibes / Passes tabs would all silently stop
  // loading the moment this file is added.
  var hooked = false;
  function wireTabHook() {
    // Guard against wiring twice. Without it, the DOMContentLoaded call would
    // capture the wrapper installed by the immediate call as its own `prev`,
    // and every tab switch would run load() twice — two full API round trips
    // per click.
    if (hooked) return;
    hooked = true;

    var prev = window.ZGAdminGroup5 && window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab;
    window.ZGAdminGroup5 = window.ZGAdminGroup5 || {};
    window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab = function (tab) {
      if (typeof prev === 'function') { try { prev(tab); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
      if (tab === 'campaigns') load();
    };
  }

  // Wire immediately (admin-group5.js is loaded before this file, so its
  // onTab already exists) and again on DOMContentLoaded as a safety net for
  // script-order changes. The `hooked` flag makes the second call a no-op.
  wireTabHook();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wireTabHook);

  window.ZGAdminCampaigns = { load: load };
})();
