// js/admin-group5.js — Group 5 admin tabs: Campus Reps (#20), College Calendar (#13),
// Exclusive Vibes (#16), Zivo Pass subscribers (#15). Loaded after admin.js;
// admin.js's showTab() calls window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab(tab) for every tab switch.
(function () {
  'use strict';
  function money(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'); }

  function onTab(tab) {
    if (tab === 'reps') loadReps();
    if (tab === 'calendar') loadCalendar();
    if (tab === 'vibes') loadVibes();
    if (tab === 'passes') loadPasses();
  }

  // ── CAMPUS REPS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function loadReps() {
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-reps-table');
    host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Loading…</p>';
    window.ZGSupabase.from('campus_reps').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).then(function (res) {
      var reps = res.data || [];
      if (!reps.length) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="e-icon">🎓</div><p>No applications yet.</p></div>'; return; }
      host.innerHTML = '<table class="admin-table"><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>Rep</th><th>College</th><th>Ref Code</th><th>Rate %</th><th>Status</th><th>Payout</th>' +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
        reps.map(function (r) {
          return '<tr>' +
            '<td>' + esc(r.full_name) + '<br><span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">' + esc(r.phone) + (r.upi_id ? ' · ' + esc(r.upi_id) : '') + '</span></td>' +
            '<td>' + esc(r.college) + '</td>' +
            '<td><code>' + esc(r.ref_code) + '</code></td>' +
            '<td><input type="number" value="' + r.commission_rate + '" data-rate="' + r.id + '" style="width:60px;padding:4px 6px;font-size:12px;"></td>' +
            '<td><select data-status="' + r.id + '">' +
              ['pending', 'approved', 'suspended'].map(function (s) { return '<option value="' + s + '" ' + (s === r.status ? 'selected' : '') + '>' + s + '</option>'; }).join('') +
            '</select></td>' +
            '<td><button class="btn-ghost" data-payout="' + r.id + '" style="padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;">Mark Paid</button></td>' +
          '</tr>';
        }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';

      host.querySelectorAll('[data-status]').forEach(function (sel) {
        sel.addEventListener('change', function () {
          var patch = { status: sel.value };
          if (sel.value === 'approved') patch.approved_at = new Date().toISOString();
          window.ZGSupabase.from('campus_reps').update(patch).eq('id', sel.dataset.status).then(loadReps);
        });
      });
      host.querySelectorAll('[data-rate]').forEach(function (inp) {
        inp.addEventListener('change', function () {
          window.ZGSupabase.from('campus_reps').update({ commission_rate: parseFloat(inp.value) }).eq('id', inp.dataset.rate).then(function () {});
        });
      });
      host.querySelectorAll('[data-payout]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () { markPayout(btn.dataset.payout, btn); });
      });
    });
  }

  function markPayout(repId, btn) {
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '…';
    window.ZGSupabase.from('campus_reps').select('ref_code').eq('id', repId).single().then(function (repRes) {
      var refCode = repRes.data.ref_code;
      return window.ZGSupabase.from('orders').select('id, rep_commission_amount')
        .eq('rep_ref_code', refCode).eq('rep_commission_status', 'pending');
    }).then(function (ordersRes) {
      var orders = ordersRes.data || [];
      var total = orders.reduce(function (s, o) { return s + (o.rep_commission_amount || 0); }, 0);
      if (!orders.length) { btn.textContent = 'Nothing due'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Mark Paid'; btn.disabled = false; }, 1500); return; }
      var ids = orders.map(function (o) { return o.id; });
      return window.ZGSupabase.from('orders').update({ rep_commission_status: 'paid' }).in('id', ids)
        .then(function () {
          return window.ZGSupabase.from('rep_payouts').insert({ rep_id: repId, amount: total, order_count: orders.length });
        }).then(function () {
          btn.textContent = 'Paid ₹' + money(total);
          setTimeout(loadReps, 1200);
        });
    });
  }

  // ── COLLEGE CALENDAR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        '</tr></thead><tbody>' +

            '<td style="font-size:12px;">' + esc(e.start_date) + (e.end_date ? ' → ' + esc(e.end_date) : '') + '</td>' +

          '</tr>';
        }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';

      host.querySelectorAll('[data-active]').forEach(function (cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
          window.ZGSupabase.from('college_calendar').update({ active: cb.checked }).eq('id', cb.dataset.active).then(function () {});
        });
      });
    });
  }

  // ── EXCLUSIVE VIBES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      list.querySelectorAll('[data-vactive]').forEach(function (cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', function () {

        });
      });
    });
  }

  function showAddVibeForm() {
    var list = document.getElementById('vibe-list');
    var formHost = document.createElement('div');
    formHost.className = 'card-panel';
    formHost.style.marginBottom = '16px';
    formHost.innerHTML =
      '<div class="form-grid">' +
        '<div class="field-group"><label>Design</label><select id="nv-key"><option value="campus_legend">campus_legend (gold/black)</option><option value="zivo_pass_gold">zivo_pass_gold (gold/purple)</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="field-group"><label>Display Name</label><input type="text" id="nv-name" placeholder="e.g. VIT Tech Bro Mode"></div>' +
        '<div class="field-group"><label>Unlock Type</label><select id="nv-unlock"><option value="college">College email</option><option value="pass">Zivo Pass</option></select></div>' +
        '<div class="field-group"><label>College Name (if college unlock)</label><input type="text" id="nv-college-name"></div>' +
        '<div class="field-group"><label>College Domain (if college unlock)</label><input type="text" id="nv-domain" placeholder="vit.ac.in"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button class="btn-coral" id="nv-save" style="padding:8px 18px;font-size:13px;">Save</button>';
    list.parentNode.insertBefore(formHost, list);
    document.getElementById('nv-save').addEventListener('click', function () {
      window.ZGSupabase.from('exclusive_vibes').insert({
        vibe_key: document.getElementById('nv-key').value,
        display_name: document.getElementById('nv-name').value || 'Exclusive Vibe',
        unlock_type: document.getElementById('nv-unlock').value,
        college_name: document.getElementById('nv-college-name').value || null,
        college_domain: document.getElementById('nv-domain').value || null,
        active: true,
      }).then(function () { formHost.remove(); renderVibeList(); });
    });
  }

  // ── ZIVO PASS SUBSCRIBERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function loadPasses() {
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-passes-table');
    host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Loading…</p>';
    window.ZGSupabase.from('subscriptions').select('*').order('started_at', { ascending: false }).limit(200).then(function (res) {
      var subs = res.data || [];
      var active = subs.filter(function (s) { return s.status === 'active' && new Date(s.expires_at) > new Date(); });
      host.innerHTML =
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:14px;">' + active.length + ' active subscriber' + (active.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' of ' + subs.length + ' total.</p>' +
        '<table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>User</th><th>Started</th><th>Expires</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        subs.map(function (s) {
          var live = s.status === 'active' && new Date(s.expires_at) > new Date();
          return '<tr>' +
            '<td style="font-size:12px;">' + esc(s.user_id).slice(0, 8) + '…</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:12px;">' + new Date(s.started_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN') + '</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:12px;">' + new Date(s.expires_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN') + '</td>' +
            '<td><span class="status-pill ' + (live ? 'paid' : 'cancelled') + '">' + (live ? 'active' : s.status) + '</span></td>' +
          '</tr>';
        }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
    });
  }

  window.ZGAdminGroup5 = { onTab: onTab };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · js/admin-inbox.js — the 💬 Messages tab (Customer Messages).

   A two-pane WhatsApp inbox: conversation list on the left, thread on the
   right. Built to be usable on a phone, because that is where you will
   actually answer a customer.

   THE 24-HOUR WINDOW IS THE CENTRAL UI CONCEPT
   --------------------------------------------
   Meta permits free-text replies only within 24h of the customer's last
   message. Outside it, a free-text send is REJECTED. So the composer changes
   shape based on contact.window_open:

     • window OPEN   -> free text box + a live countdown
     • window CLOSED -> the text box is disabled and an approved-template
                        picker takes its place

   Without this the dashboard would look like it sent a message and the
   customer would receive nothing — the exact silent failure this whole
   feature exists to eliminate.

   Loaded after js/admin.js. Chains window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab, the same way
   js/admin-ops.js and js/admin-campaigns.js do — see wireTabHook().
   ========================================================================= */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var FN = '/.netlify/functions/admin-inbox';

  // Polling. Only ever runs while the Messages tab is actually visible —
  // a background timer hitting a function every few seconds would quietly
  // burn Netlify invocations all day.
  var THREAD_POLL_MS = 10000;
  var LIST_POLL_MS = 15000;
  var BADGE_POLL_MS = 60000;

  var state = {
    contacts: [],
    activeId: null,
    filter: 'all',
    search: '',
    listTimer: null,
    threadTimer: null,
    badgeTimer: null,
    visible: false,
    lastThreadCount: 0,
    templates: null,
  };

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }

  async function getToken() {
    try {
      var client = window.ZGSupabase || window.sb || window.supabaseClient || window.supabase;
      if (client && client.auth && client.auth.getSession) {
        var res = await client.auth.getSession();
        return res && res.data && res.data.session ? res.data.session.access_token : null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  }

  async function api(qs, payload) {
    var token = await getToken();
    if (!token) throw new Error('Not signed in. Reload and log in again.');
    var opts = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } };
    if (payload) {
      opts.method = 'POST';
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(payload);
    }
    var res = await fetch(FN + (qs || ''), opts);
    var data = await res.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
    if (!res.ok) {
      var err = new Error(data.detail || data.error || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
      err.code = data.error;
      err.data = data;
      throw err;
    }
    return data;
  }

  function host() { return document.getElementById('admin-inbox-body'); }

  // ── FORMATTING HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function timeAgo(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    var mins = Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (mins < 1) return 'just now';
    if (mins < 60) return mins + 'm ago';
    var hrs = Math.round(mins / 60);
    if (hrs < 24) return hrs + 'h ago';
    var days = Math.round(hrs / 24);
    if (days < 7) return days + 'd ago';
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  }

  function clockTime(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }

  function windowLabel(c) {
    if (!c) return '';
    if (c.window_open) {
      var m = c.window_minutes_left || 0;
      var h = Math.floor(m / 60);
      return h >= 1 ? ('🟢 Free reply open · ' + h + 'h ' + (m % 60) + 'm left')
                    : ('🟠 Free reply open · ' + m + 'm left');
    }
    return '🔴 24h window closed — template only';
  }

  function displayName(c) {
    return c.profile_name || ('+91 ' + c.phone10);
  }

  // Delivery ticks, honest about failure.
  function statusTick(m) {
    if (m.direction !== 'out') return '';
    if (m.status === 'failed') return '<span style="color:var(--coral);" title="' + esc(m.error_message || 'failed') + '">⚠ failed</span>';
    if (m.status === 'read') return '<span style="color:#4ADE80;">✓✓</span>';
    if (m.status === 'delivered') return '<span style="opacity:.75;">✓✓</span>';
    if (m.status === 'sent') return '<span style="opacity:.55;">✓</span>';
    return '';
  }

  // ── SHELL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function renderShell() {
    var h = host();
    if (!h) return;
    h.innerHTML =
      '<div id="inbox-wrap" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:320px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:start;">' +
        '<div class="card-panel" style="padding:12px;">' +
          '<input type="search" id="inbox-search" placeholder="Search name, phone, order…" style="width:100%;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px;">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
            ['all', 'unread', 'open', 'closed'].map(function (f) {
              return '<button class="btn-ghost inbox-filter" data-filter="' + f + '" style="padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;text-transform:capitalize;">' + f + '</button>';
            }).join('') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div id="inbox-list" style="max-height:62vh;overflow-y:auto;"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="card-panel" id="inbox-thread" style="padding:0;min-height:60vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<style>' +
        '.inbox-item{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid transparent;}' +
        '.inbox-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);}' +
        '.inbox-item.active{background:rgba(245,200,66,.10);border-color:rgba(245,200,66,.35);}' +
        '.inbox-item.unread .inbox-name{font-weight:800;}' +
        '.bubble{max-width:74%;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:14px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;}' +
        '.bubble.in{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-bottom-left-radius:4px;}' +
        '.bubble.out{background:rgba(245,200,66,.16);border-bottom-right-radius:4px;}' +
        '.bubble.failed{border:1px solid var(--coral);}' +
        '.msg-row{display:flex;margin-bottom:10px;}' +
        '.msg-meta{font-size:10px;opacity:.6;margin-top:4px;display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end;}' +
        '@media(max-width:820px){#inbox-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;}' +
        '#inbox-wrap.viewing-thread > div:first-child{display:none;}}' +
      '</style>';

    h.querySelector('#inbox-search').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      state.search = e.target.value;
      clearTimeout(state._searchT);
      state._searchT = setTimeout(loadList, 320);
    });
    h.querySelectorAll('.inbox-filter').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        state.filter = b.dataset.filter;
        highlightFilter();
        loadList();
      });
    });
    highlightFilter();
  }

  function highlightFilter() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.inbox-filter').forEach(function (b) {
      var on = b.dataset.filter === state.filter;
      b.style.background = on ? 'rgba(245,200,66,.18)' : '';
      b.style.borderColor = on ? 'rgba(245,200,66,.5)' : '';
    });
  }

  // ── CONVERSATION LIST ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function loadList() {
    var list = document.getElementById('inbox-list');
    if (!list) return;
    try {
      var qs = '?action=list&filter=' + encodeURIComponent(state.filter) +
               (state.search ? '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(state.search) : '');
      var data = await api(qs);
      state.contacts = data.contacts || [];
      renderList();
      updateBadge(data.unread_total || 0);
    } catch (e) {
      list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;padding:10px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>';
    }
  }

  function renderList() {
    var list = document.getElementById('inbox-list');
    if (!list) return;
    if (!state.contacts.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:26px 10px;"><div class="e-icon">💬</div>' +
        '<p style="font-size:13px;">No conversations' + (state.search ? ' match that search' : ' yet') + '.</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = state.contacts.map(function (c) {
      var unread = (c.unread_count || 0) > 0;
      return '<div class="inbox-item' + (unread ? ' unread' : '') + (c.id === state.activeId ? ' active' : '') + '" data-id="' + esc(c.id) + '">' +
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;">' +
          '<span class="inbox-name" style="font-size:14px;">' + esc(displayName(c)) + '</span>' +
          '<span style="font-size:10px;opacity:.6;white-space:nowrap;">' + esc(timeAgo(c.last_message_at)) + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:12px;opacity:.72;margin-top:3px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">' +
          esc(c.last_message_preview || '') + '</div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:5px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">' +
          (unread ? '<span style="background:var(--coral);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;">' + c.unread_count + '</span>' : '') +
          (c.status === 'closed' ? '<span style="font-size:10px;opacity:.55;">closed</span>' : '') +
          (c.window_open ? '' : '<span style="font-size:10px;opacity:.55;">⏳ window closed</span>') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    list.querySelectorAll('.inbox-item').forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function () { openThread(el.dataset.id); });
    });
  }

  // ── THREAD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function openThread(contactId, isPoll) {
    state.activeId = contactId;
    var pane = document.getElementById('inbox-thread');
    if (!pane) return;
    var wrap = document.getElementById('inbox-wrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('viewing-thread');
    if (!isPoll) pane.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);padding:18px;">Loading…</p>';

    try {
      var data = await api('?action=thread&contact_id=' + encodeURIComponent(contactId));
      // A poll that lands after the user moved on must not hijack the pane.
      if (state.activeId !== contactId) return;
      renderThread(data.contact, data.messages || [], isPoll);
      if (!isPoll) { renderList(); loadList(); }
    } catch (e) {
      pane.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--coral);padding:18px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p>';
    }
  }

  function renderThread(contact, messages, isPoll) {
    var pane = document.getElementById('inbox-thread');
    if (!pane) return;

    // Preserve scroll position on a poll, unless the admin was already at the
    // bottom (in which case follow the new message down).
    var body = document.getElementById('thread-body');
    var wasAtBottom = !body || (body.scrollHeight - body.scrollTop - body.clientHeight < 60);
    var prevScroll = body ? body.scrollTop : 0;
    var grew = messages.length !== state.lastThreadCount;
    state.lastThreadCount = messages.length;
    if (isPoll && !grew) return; // nothing changed — do not repaint and steal focus

    var open = contact.window_open;

    var header =
      '<div style="padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
        '<div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;">' + esc(displayName(contact)) + '</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.65;margin-top:2px;">+91 ' + esc(contact.phone10) +
            (contact.last_order_number ? ' · order ' + esc(contact.last_order_number) : '') + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
          '<span style="font-size:11px;">' + esc(windowLabel(contact)) + '</span>' +
          '<button class="btn-ghost" id="thread-close" style="padding:5px 12px;font-size:11px;">' +
            (contact.status === 'closed' ? 'Reopen' : 'Mark done') + '</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    var bodyHtml = messages.map(function (m) {
      var isIn = m.direction === 'in';
      var content = '';

      if (m.media_id || m.media_url) {
        var isImage = (m.media_mime || '').indexOf('image/') === 0 || m.msg_type === 'image' || m.msg_type === 'sticker';
        if (m.media_url && isImage) {
          content = '<a href="' + esc(m.media_url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' +
            '<img src="' + esc(m.media_url) + '" style="max-width:220px;border-radius:10px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;"></a>';
        } else if (m.media_url) {
          content = '<a href="' + esc(m.media_url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--gold,#f5c842);">📎 Open ' + esc(m.msg_type) + '</a><br>';
        } else if (m.media_error) {
          content = '<span style="opacity:.7;font-size:12px;">📎 ' + esc(m.msg_type) + ' — ' + esc(m.media_error) + '</span><br>';
        } else {
          content = '<button class="btn-ghost load-media" data-mid="' + esc(m.id) + '" style="padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:6px;">📎 Load ' + esc(m.msg_type) + '</button><br>';
        }
      }

      content += esc(m.body || m.caption || '');
      if (!content.trim()) content = '<span style="opacity:.6;">(' + esc(m.msg_type) + ')</span>';

      return '<div class="msg-row" style="justify-content:' + (isIn ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end') + ';">' +
        '<div class="bubble ' + (isIn ? 'in' : 'out') + (m.status === 'failed' ? ' failed' : '') + '">' +
          content +
          '<div class="msg-meta">' +
            (m.source === 'automation' ? '<span title="Sent automatically by ZivoGift">🤖</span>' : '') +
            (m.sent_by_admin ? '<span title="' + esc(m.sent_by_admin) + '">you</span>' : '') +
            '<span>' + esc(clockTime(m.created_at)) + '</span>' + statusTick(m) +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');

    var composer = open
      ? '<div style="padding:12px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end;">' +
            '<textarea id="reply-text" rows="2" placeholder="Type a reply…" style="flex:1;padding:9px 12px;font-size:14px;resize:vertical;"></textarea>' +
            '<button class="btn-ghost" id="reply-send" style="padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;">Send</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div id="reply-result" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;"></div>' +
        '</div>'
      : '<div style="padding:12px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);">' +
          '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--grey);margin:0 0 8px;">' +
            'More than 24 hours have passed since this customer last messaged, so Meta will not deliver a free-text reply. ' +
            'Send an approved template to reopen the conversation.</p>' +
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">' +
            '<select id="reply-template" style="flex:1;min-width:180px;"><option value="">Loading templates…</option></select>' +
            '<button class="btn-ghost" id="reply-tpl-send" style="padding:9px 16px;font-size:12px;">Send template</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div id="reply-result" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;"></div>' +
        '</div>';

    pane.innerHTML = header +
      '<div id="thread-body" style="flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px;max-height:52vh;">' + bodyHtml + '</div>' +
      composer;

    var nb = document.getElementById('thread-body');
    if (nb) nb.scrollTop = (isPoll && !wasAtBottom) ? prevScroll : nb.scrollHeight;

    wireThread(contact);
  }

  function wireThread(contact) {
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('thread-close');
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
      closeBtn.disabled = true;
      try {
        await api('', { action: 'set_status', contact_id: contact.id, status: contact.status === 'closed' ? 'open' : 'closed' });
        await openThread(contact.id);
        loadList();
      } catch (e) { alert(e.message); }
      closeBtn.disabled = false;
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.load-media').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', async function () {
        b.disabled = true; b.textContent = 'Loading…';
        try {
          await api('?action=media&message_id=' + encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.mid));
          state.lastThreadCount = -1; // force a repaint
          await openThread(contact.id);
        } catch (e) {
          b.textContent = '⚠ ' + e.message.slice(0, 60);
        }
      });
    });

    var sendBtn = document.getElementById('reply-send');
    if (sendBtn) {
      var doSend = async function () {
        var ta = document.getElementById('reply-text');
        var out = document.getElementById('reply-result');
        var text = (ta.value || '').trim();
        if (!text) return;
        sendBtn.disabled = true; out.textContent = 'Sending…'; out.style.color = '';
        try {
          await api('', { action: 'reply', contact_id: contact.id, text: text });
          ta.value = '';
          out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#4ADE80;">✓ Sent</span>';
          state.lastThreadCount = -1;
          await openThread(contact.id);
          loadList();
        } catch (e) {
          out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--coral);">' + esc(e.message) + '</span>';
          // The window can lapse between page load and send. Re-render so the
          // template composer appears instead of leaving a dead text box.
          if (e.code === 'window_closed') { state.lastThreadCount = -1; await openThread(contact.id); }
        }
        sendBtn.disabled = false;
      };
      sendBtn.addEventListener('click', doSend);
      var ta = document.getElementById('reply-text');
      if (ta) ta.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
        if ((ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) && ev.key === 'Enter') { ev.preventDefault(); doSend(); }
      });
    }

    var tplSel = document.getElementById('reply-template');
    if (tplSel) loadTemplates(tplSel);

    var tplBtn = document.getElementById('reply-tpl-send');
    if (tplBtn) tplBtn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
      var sel = document.getElementById('reply-template');
      var out = document.getElementById('reply-result');
      if (!sel || !sel.value) { out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--coral);">Pick a template first.</span>'; return; }
      tplBtn.disabled = true; out.textContent = 'Sending…';
      try {
        var vars = [];
        var n = Number(sel.selectedOptions[0].dataset.vars || 0);
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          var v = prompt('Template variable {{' + (i + 1) + '}}:');
          if (v === null) { tplBtn.disabled = false; out.textContent = ''; return; }
          vars.push(v);
        }
        await api('', { action: 'reply_template', contact_id: contact.id, template_name: sel.value, variables: vars });
        out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#4ADE80;">✓ Template sent</span>';
        state.lastThreadCount = -1;
        await openThread(contact.id);
      } catch (e) {
        out.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--coral);">' + esc(e.message) + '</span>';
      }
      tplBtn.disabled = false;
    });
  }

  async function loadTemplates(sel) {
    try {
      if (!state.templates) {
        var d = await api('?action=templates');
        state.templates = d.templates || [];
        if (!d.available) {
          sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">' + esc(d.reason || 'Templates unavailable') + '</option>';
          return;
        }
      }
      if (!state.templates.length) {
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No approved templates found</option>';
        return;
      }
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Choose a template…</option>' + state.templates.map(function (t) {
        return '<option value="' + esc(t.name) + '" data-vars="' + (t.bodyParamCount || 0) + '">' +
          esc(t.name) + ' (' + esc(t.language) + ')</option>';
      }).join('');
    } catch (e) {
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">' + esc(e.message) + '</option>';
    }
  }

  // ── UNREAD BADGE ON THE NAV BUTTON ───────────────────────────────────────

  function updateBadge(n) {
    var btn = document.querySelector('.account-nav button[data-tab="inbox"]');
    if (!btn) return;
    var base = '💬 Messages';
    btn.textContent = n > 0 ? base + ' (' + n + ')' : base;
    btn.style.color = n > 0 ? 'var(--coral)' : '';
  }

  async function pollBadge() {
    try {
      var d = await api('?action=unread_count');
      updateBadge(d.unread || 0);
    } catch (e) { /* badge is cosmetic — never surface an error for it */ }
  }

  // ── LIFECYCLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function startPolling() {
    stopPolling();
    state.listTimer = setInterval(function () { if (state.visible) loadList(); }, LIST_POLL_MS);
    state.threadTimer = setInterval(function () {
      if (state.visible && state.activeId) openThread(state.activeId, true);
    }, THREAD_POLL_MS);
  }

  function stopPolling() {
    if (state.listTimer) clearInterval(state.listTimer);
    if (state.threadTimer) clearInterval(state.threadTimer);
    state.listTimer = state.threadTimer = null;
  }

  function load() {
    state.visible = true;
    renderShell();
    loadList();
    startPolling();
  }

  // ── TAB HOOK (chained — see js/admin-ops.js for the reasoning) ───────────
  var hooked = false;
  function wireTabHook() {
    if (hooked) return;
    hooked = true;
    var prev = window.ZGAdminGroup5 && window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab;
    window.ZGAdminGroup5 = window.ZGAdminGroup5 || {};
    window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab = function (tab) {
      if (typeof prev === 'function') { try { prev(tab); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
      if (tab === 'inbox') { load(); }
      else { state.visible = false; stopPolling(); }
    };
  }

  wireTabHook();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    wireTabHook();
    // The badge is the "do not miss a message" safety net, so it polls even
    // while you are on another tab — once a minute, which is negligible.
    pollBadge();
    if (!state.badgeTimer) state.badgeTimer = setInterval(pollBadge, BADGE_POLL_MS);
  });

  window.ZGAdminInbox = { load: load, openThread: openThread, pollBadge: pollBadge };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · js/admin-ops.js — the 🚨 Emergency tab + Export Center.

   This is the screen designed to be used on a PHONE, with no laptop, when
   something is wrong. Everything here is:
     • one tap away, no nesting
     • readable at phone width (single-column grids, large tap targets)
     • honest about failure — it never says "OK" unless it verified something

   It also owns the Export Center, because a CSV download is the other thing
   you want from a phone when you have lost access to everything else.

   Loaded after js/admin.js. Chains window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab like
   js/admin-campaigns.js does — see wireTabHook().
   ========================================================================= */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var FN_OPS = '/.netlify/functions/admin-ops';
  var FN_EXPORT = '/.netlify/functions/admin-export';

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }
  function num(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }

  async function getToken() {
    try {
      var client = window.ZGSupabase || window.sb || window.supabaseClient || window.supabase;
      if (client && client.auth && client.auth.getSession) {
        var res = await client.auth.getSession();
        return res && res.data && res.data.session ? res.data.session.access_token : null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  }

  async function api(payload, qs) {
    var token = await getToken();
    if (!token) throw new Error('Not signed in. Reload and log in again.');
    var opts = { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } };
    if (payload) {
      opts.method = 'POST';
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(payload);
    }
    var res = await fetch(FN_OPS + (qs || ''), opts);
    var data = await res.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || data.error || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    return data;
  }

  function host() { return document.getElementById('admin-emergency-body'); }

  // ── LOAD HEALTH ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function load() {
    var h = host();
    if (!h) return;
    h.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Checking system health…</p>';
    try {
      render(await api(null, '?action=health'));
    } catch (e) {
      h.innerHTML = '<div class="card-panel" style="border-color:var(--coral);">' +
        '<p style="color:var(--coral);font-weight:700;">Health check failed</p>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</p></div>';
    }
  }

  function render(d) {
    host().innerHTML =
      statusBanner(d) +
      switchesPanel(d) +
      giftsPanel(d) +
      pipelinePanel(d) +
      testsPanel(d) +
      exportPanel() +
      envPanel(d) +
      tablesPanel(d) +
      optoutPanel();
    wire(d);
  }

    return '<div style="padding:16px 18px;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:18px;' +

  // Downloading needs the bearer token, so a plain <a href> cannot be used —
  // it would hit the function unauthenticated and get a 403. Fetch as a blob
  // and trigger a synthetic download instead.
  async function download(type, id) {
    var box = document.getElementById('op-export-result');
    if (box) box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:12px;">Preparing ' + esc(type) + '…</span>';
    try {
      var token = await getToken();
      var url = FN_EXPORT + '?type=' + encodeURIComponent(type) + (id ? '&id=' + encodeURIComponent(id) : '');
      var res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } });
      if (!res.ok) {
        var err = await res.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
        throw new Error(err.detail || err.error || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
      }
      var rows = res.headers.get('X-Row-Count');
      var blob = await res.blob();
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = 'zivogift-' + type + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 5000);
      if (box) box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#4ADE80;font-size:12px;">✓ Downloaded ' + esc(type) +
        (rows ? ' (' + num(rows) + ' rows)' : '') + '</span>';
    } catch (e) {
      if (box) box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--coral);font-size:12px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</span>';
    }
  }

  // ── ENV VARS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    return panel('🔑 ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES',

  // ── WIRING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function wire(d) {
    var h = host();

    h.querySelectorAll('[data-switch]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
        var key = btn.dataset.switch;
        var turningOn = btn.dataset.on !== 'true';
        if (turningOn && key === 'pause_all_schedulers' &&
            !confirm('This stops ALL campaign and festival automation. Gift deliveries keep running. Continue?')) return;
        btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '…';
        try { await api({ action: 'set_switch', key: key, value: turningOn }); load(); }
        catch (e) { alert(e.message); btn.disabled = false; }
      });
    });

    var retry = document.getElementById('op-retry-sends');
    if (retry) retry.addEventListener('click', async function () {
      if (!confirm('Requeue failed gift sends? They will be re-attempted within 2 minutes.')) return;
      retry.disabled = true; retry.textContent = 'Requeueing…';
      try {
        var r = await api({ action: 'retry_failed_sends' });
        document.getElementById('op-retry-result').innerHTML =
          '<span style="color:#4ADE80;font-size:13px;">' + esc(r.detail) + '</span>';
        setTimeout(load, 2000);
      } catch (e) {
        document.getElementById('op-retry-result').innerHTML =
          '<span style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</span>';
        retry.disabled = false;
      }
    });

    bindTest('op-do-email', 'test_email', function () { return { to: valOf('op-test-email') }; });
    bindTest('op-do-wa', 'test_whatsapp', function () { return { phone: valOf('op-test-phone') }; });

    h.querySelectorAll('[data-export]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () { download(btn.dataset.export); });
    });

    bindOptout('op-oo-add', 'optout_add');
    bindOptout('op-oo-del', 'optout_remove');
  }

  function valOf(id) { var e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? e.value.trim() : ''; }

  function bindTest(btnId, action, argsFn) {
    var btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
      var old = btn.textContent;
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Sending…';
      var box = document.getElementById('op-test-result');
      try {
        var r = await api(Object.assign({ action: action }, argsFn()));
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;' +
          'background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid ' + (r.ok ? 'rgba(74,222,128,.4)' : 'var(--coral)') + ';">' +
          (r.ok ? '✓ ' : '✗ ') + esc(r.detail) + '</div>';
      } catch (e) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</div>';
      }
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = old;
    });
  }

  function bindOptout(btnId, action) {
    var btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
      btn.disabled = true;
      var box = document.getElementById('op-oo-result');
      try {
        var r = await api({ action: action, email: valOf('op-oo-email'), phone: valOf('op-oo-phone') });
        box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#4ADE80;font-size:13px;">✓ ' + esc(r.action) + '</span>';
      } catch (e) {
        box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--coral);font-size:13px;">' + esc(e.message) + '</span>';
      }
      btn.disabled = false;
    });
  }

  // ── TAB HOOK (chained — see js/admin-campaigns.js for the reasoning) ─────
  var hooked = false;
  function wireTabHook() {
    if (hooked) return;
    hooked = true;
    var prev = window.ZGAdminGroup5 && window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab;
    window.ZGAdminGroup5 = window.ZGAdminGroup5 || {};
    window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab = function (tab) {
      if (typeof prev === 'function') { try { prev(tab); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
      if (tab === 'emergency') load();
    };
  }

  wireTabHook();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wireTabHook);

  window.ZGAdminOps = { load: load, download: download };
})();
