// Classic script — admin dashboard (Overview + Orders + Catalog pricing).
// v2.2 upgrade:
//   • Overview: KPIs, 14-day revenue chart, status breakdown, attention list
//   • Failed digital sends panel with one-click RESEND
//   • Orders: search, CSV export, expandable detail
//   • NEW: per-row CHECKBOXES + select-all + bulk DELETE of orders
//   • NEW: horizontal-scroll wrapper so the wide orders table is never clipped
// Backward compatible: all v1 IDs, status-update flow, catalog editor and the
// window.ZGAdminGroup5 hook are preserved unchanged.
(function () {
  var STATUSES = ['pending_payment', 'paid', 'processing', 'packed', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'refunded', 'payment_failed'];
  var PAID_STATES = ['paid', 'processing', 'packed', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered'];
  var OPEN_FULFILMENT = ['paid', 'processing', 'packed', 'out_for_delivery'];

  function money(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }

  function notConnectedGuard() {
    if (window.ZGSupabase) return false;
    document.querySelector('.account-grid').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty-state" style="grid-column:1/-1;"><div class="e-icon">🔌</div>' +
      '<p>The admin panel isn\'t connected yet — this needs Supabase configured in js/config.js.</p></div>';
    return true;
  }

  function guard() {
    return window.ZGAuth.getCurrentUser().then(function (user) {
      if (!user) { window.location.href = 'login.html?redirect=admin.html'; return false; }
      return window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('is_admin').eq('id', user.id).single().then(function (res) {
        if (!res.data || !res.data.is_admin) {
          document.body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding-top:140px;"><div class="e-icon">🔒</div><p>This page is for the Zivogift team only.</p><br><a href="index.html" class="btn-coral">Back to Site</a></div>';
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      });
    });
  }

  function showTab(tab) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-nav button[data-tab]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tab);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.admin-panel').forEach(function (p) {
      p.style.display = p.id === 'admin-' + tab ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
    if (tab === 'overview') loadOverview();
    if (tab === 'orders') loadOrders();
    if (tab === 'catalog') loadCatalog();
    if (tab === 'addons') loadAddons();
    if (window.ZGAdminGroup5 && window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab) window.ZGAdminGroup5.onTab(tab);
  }

  function fmtDob(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(iso);
    if (!m) return iso;
    var d = new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]));
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
  }
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }
  function fmtDateTime(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }
  function isToday(iso) {
    if (!iso) return false;
    var d = new Date(iso), n = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() === n.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === n.getMonth() && d.getDate() === n.getDate();
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     OVERVIEW / DASHBOARD
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function loadOverview() {
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-overview-body');
    if (!host) return;
    host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Crunching the numbers…</p>';

    var ordersQ = window.ZGSupabase.from('orders')
      .select('id, order_number, created_at, status, total, contact_name')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(500);
    var sendsQ = window.ZGSupabase.from('digital_sends').select('status').limit(2000);
    var carePkgQ = window.ZGSupabase.from('care_package_orders').select('status').limit(1000);

    Promise.all([ordersQ, sendsQ, carePkgQ]).then(function (r) {
      if (r[0].error) { host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--coral);">' + esc(r[0].error.message) + '</p>'; return; }
      var orders = r[0].data || [];
      var sends = (r[1] && r[1].data) || [];
      var pkgs = (r[2] && r[2].data) || [];

      var revenueTotal = 0, revenueToday = 0, ordersToday = 0;
      var counts = {};
      STATUSES.forEach(function (s) { counts[s] = 0; });
      orders.forEach(function (o) {
        counts[o.status] = (counts[o.status] || 0) + 1;
        if (PAID_STATES.indexOf(o.status) !== -1) {
          revenueTotal += Number(o.total || 0);
          if (isToday(o.created_at)) revenueToday += Number(o.total || 0);
        }
        if (isToday(o.created_at)) ordersToday += 1;
      });
      var pendingFulfilment = OPEN_FULFILMENT.reduce(function (s, k) { return s + (counts[k] || 0); }, 0);
      var awaitingPayment = counts.pending_payment || 0;

      var sendFailed = 0, sendPending = 0;
      sends.forEach(function (s) {
        if (s.status === 'failed') sendFailed++;
        else if (s.status === 'pending') sendPending++;
      });
      var pkgActive = 0, pkgPaused = 0, pkgFailed = 0;
      pkgs.forEach(function (p) {
        if (p.status === 'active') pkgActive++;
        else if (p.status === 'paused') pkgPaused++;
        else if (p.status === 'failed') pkgFailed++;
      });

      host.innerHTML =
        kpiRow([
          kpi('Revenue (captured)', '₹' + money(revenueTotal), 'across ' + orders.length + ' recent orders', '#4ADE80'),
          kpi('Revenue today', '₹' + money(revenueToday), ordersToday + ' order' + (ordersToday === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' today', 'var(--gold-light)'),
          kpi('Awaiting fulfilment', String(pendingFulfilment), 'paid & not yet delivered', pendingFulfilment ? 'var(--coral)' : 'var(--grey)'),
          kpi('Awaiting payment', String(awaitingPayment), 'started but unpaid', 'var(--grey)')
        ]) +
        kpiRow([
          kpi('Failed digital sends', String(sendFailed), 'resend below', sendFailed ? 'var(--coral)' : '#4ADE80'),
          kpi('Pending digital sends', String(sendPending), 'queued to go out', 'var(--gold-light)'),
          kpi('Active care packages', String(pkgActive), pkgPaused + ' paused · ' + pkgFailed + ' failed', pkgFailed ? 'var(--coral)' : '#4ADE80'),
          kpi('Total orders', String(orders.length), 'in the last 500', 'var(--white)')
        ]) +
        '<div id="ov-failed-sends"></div>' +
        '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-top:18px;">' +
          '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:14px;">REVENUE — LAST 14 DAYS</div>' +
          sparkline(orders) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-top:18px;">' +
          '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:14px;">ORDERS BY STATUS</div>' +
          statusBreakdown(counts, orders.length) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-top:18px;">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
            '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;">NEEDS ATTENTION</div>' +
            '<button class="btn-ghost" id="ov-go-orders" style="padding:6px 14px;font-size:11px;">Open Orders →</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          attentionList(orders) +
        '</div>';

      var goBtn = document.getElementById('ov-go-orders');
      if (goBtn) goBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { showTab('orders'); });

      loadFailedSends();
    });
  }

  function kpiRow(cards) {
    return '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px;">' + cards.join('') + '</div>';
  }
  function kpi(label, value, sub, color) {
    return '<div class="card-panel" style="padding:18px 20px;">' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);">' + esc(label) + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:34px;line-height:1.1;margin:6px 0 2px;color:' + color + ';">' + value + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--grey);">' + esc(sub) + '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  function sparkline(orders) {
    var days = 14, buckets = [];
    var today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (var i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var d = new Date(today.getTime() - i * 86400000);
      buckets.push({ key: d, label: d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }), val: 0 });
    }
    orders.forEach(function (o) {
      if (PAID_STATES.indexOf(o.status) === -1) return;
      var d = new Date(o.created_at); d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      buckets.forEach(function (b) { if (b.key.getTime() === d.getTime()) b.val += Number(o.total || 0); });
    });
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, buckets.map(function (b) { return b.val; }).concat([1]));
    var bars = buckets.map(function (b) {
      var h = Math.round((b.val / max) * 90) + 2;
      return '<div style="flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0;">' +
        '<div title="₹' + money(b.val) + '" style="width:70%;height:' + h + 'px;border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold));"></div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--grey);white-space:nowrap;transform:rotate(-35deg);transform-origin:center;">' + b.label + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;height:130px;padding-top:8px;">' + bars + '</div>';
  }

  function statusBreakdown(counts, total) {
    var colorMap = {
      pending_payment: '#9C9890', paid: '#F5C842', processing: '#F5C842', packed: '#FF4D2E',
      out_for_delivery: '#FF4D2E', delivered: '#4ADE80', cancelled: '#7a7a7a', refunded: '#7a7a7a', payment_failed: '#ff5a3c'
    };
    return STATUSES.map(function (s) {
      var c = counts[s] || 0;
      var pct = total ? Math.round((c / total) * 100) : 0;
      return '<div style="margin-bottom:10px;">' +
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;">' +
          '<span style="text-transform:capitalize;">' + s.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</span>' +
          '<span style="color:var(--grey);">' + c + ' · ' + pct + '%</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="height:8px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden;">' +
          '<div style="height:100%;width:' + pct + '%;background:' + (colorMap[s] || '#888') + ';border-radius:6px;"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function attentionList(orders) {
    var needy = orders.filter(function (o) {
      return o.status === 'pending_payment' || o.status === 'payment_failed' || OPEN_FULFILMENT.indexOf(o.status) !== -1;
    }).slice(0, 6);
    if (!needy.length) return '<div style="color:#4ADE80;font-size:13px;">🎉 All caught up — nothing waiting on you.</div>';
    return needy.map(function (o) {
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;">' +
        '<span><span class="order-num">' + esc(o.order_number) + '</span> · ' + esc(o.contact_name || '') + '</span>' +
        '<span class="status-pill ' + o.status + '">' + o.status.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</span>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     FAILED DIGITAL SENDS + RESEND
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function loadFailedSends() {
    var host = document.getElementById('ov-failed-sends');
    if (!host) return;
    var q = window.ZGSupabase.from('digital_sends')
      .select('order_item_id, order_id, status, scheduled_at, error_message, order_items(name_snapshot, recipient_name, recipient_email)')
      .eq('status', 'failed').order('scheduled_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50);

    q.then(function (res) {
      if (res.error) {
        return window.ZGSupabase.from('digital_sends')
          .select('order_item_id, order_id, status, scheduled_at, error_message')
          .eq('status', 'failed').order('scheduled_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50);
      }
      return res;
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res || res.error) { host.innerHTML = ''; return; }
      var rows = res.data || [];
      if (!rows.length) {
        host.innerHTML = '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-top:18px;">' +
          '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:8px;">FAILED DIGITAL SENDS</div>' +
          '<div style="color:#4ADE80;font-size:13px;">✓ No failed sends — everything went out cleanly.</div></div>';
        return;
      }
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="card-panel" style="margin-top:18px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--coral) 40%, transparent);">' +
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
          '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--coral);">FAILED DIGITAL SENDS — RESEND</div>' +
          '<button class="btn-ghost" id="resend-all" style="padding:6px 14px;font-size:11px;">↻ Resend all</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="table-scroll"><table class="admin-table" style="min-width:760px;"><thead><tr><th>Gift</th><th>Recipient</th><th>Failed at</th><th>Error</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        rows.map(function (s) {
          var oi = s.order_items || {};
          return '<tr data-fail="' + esc(s.order_item_id) + '">' +
            '<td>' + esc(oi.name_snapshot || '—') + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + esc(oi.recipient_name || '') + (oi.recipient_email ? '<br><span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">' + esc(oi.recipient_email) + '</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
            '<td style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;">' + fmtDateTime(s.scheduled_at) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="color:var(--coral);font-size:11.5px;max-width:240px;">' + esc(s.error_message || 'Unknown error') + '</td>' +
            '<td><button class="btn-coral resend-btn" data-item="' + esc(s.order_item_id) + '" style="padding:6px 14px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;">↻ Resend</button></td>' +
          '</tr>';
        }).join('') +
        '</tbody></table></div></div>';

      host.querySelectorAll('.resend-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () { resendOne(btn.dataset.item, btn); });
      });
      var allBtn = document.getElementById('resend-all');
      if (allBtn) allBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!confirm('Re-queue all failed digital sends?')) return;
        allBtn.disabled = true; allBtn.textContent = 'Resending…';
        var ids = rows.map(function (r) { return r.order_item_id; });
        resendMany(ids).then(function () { loadOverview(); });
      });
    });
  }

  function resendPayload() {
    // attempts:0 — gift-scheduler.js gives up after 4 attempts (see
    // schema-scheduler-hardening.sql). A failed row is already at the max, so
    // without resetting this the scheduler would immediately fail it again.
    // A manual resend is a deliberate fresh start.
    return { status: 'pending', scheduled_at: new Date().toISOString(), error_message: null, attempts: 0 };
  }
  function resendOne(orderItemId, btn) {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '…'; }
    window.ZGSupabase.from('digital_sends').update(resendPayload()).eq('order_item_id', orderItemId).then(function (res) {
      if (res.error) { if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Failed'; btn.disabled = false; } alert('Could not re-queue: ' + res.error.message); return; }
      if (btn) btn.textContent = 'Queued ✓';
      window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
        fetch('/.netlify/functions/gift-scheduler', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: session ? 'Bearer ' + session.access_token : '' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ trigger: 'manual-resend', order_item_id: orderItemId })
        }).catch(function () {});
      });
      setTimeout(loadOverview, 900);
    });
  }
  function resendMany(ids) {
    return window.ZGSupabase.from('digital_sends').update(resendPayload()).in('order_item_id', ids).then(function () {
      return window.ZGAuth.getSession();
    }).then(function (session) {
      return fetch('/.netlify/functions/gift-scheduler', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: session ? 'Bearer ' + session.access_token : '' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ trigger: 'manual-resend-bulk' })
      }).catch(function () {});
    });
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ORDERS
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function deliveryCell(o) {
    if (!o.address_line) return '<span style="color:var(--grey);">📱 Digital only — no shipping needed</span>';
    var typeLabel = { standard: 'Standard', campus: 'Campus pickup/drop', express: 'Express' }[o.delivery_type] || o.delivery_type;
    var fullAddr = [o.address_line, o.city, o.pincode].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    var html = '<div style="max-width:230px;">' +
      '<div>' + esc(o.address_line) + '</div>' +
      '<div style="color:var(--grey);">' + esc(o.city) + (o.pincode ? ' — ' + esc(o.pincode) : '') + '</div>' +
      '<div style="color:var(--gold-light);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;">' + esc(typeLabel) + '</div>';
    if (o.delivery_notes) html += '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;">📝 ' + esc(o.delivery_notes) + '</div>';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn-ghost copy-addr-btn" data-addr="' + esc(fullAddr) + '" style="margin-top:6px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:10px;">Copy address</button></div>';
    return html;
  }

  var DIGITAL_SEND_PREFIXES = ['digital_', 'squad_'];
  var CAREPKG_PREFIX = 'carepkg_';

  function digitalSendBadge(send) {
    if (!send) return '<span style="color:var(--grey);">Not scheduled yet</span>';
    if (send.status === 'sent') return '<span style="color:#4ADE80;">✓ Delivered' + (send.sent_at ? ' — ' + fmtDateTime(send.sent_at) : '') + '</span>';
    if (send.status === 'failed') return '<span style="color:var(--coral);">✗ Failed' + (send.error_message ? ' — ' + esc(send.error_message) : '') + '</span>';
    if (send.status === 'cancelled') return '<span style="color:var(--grey);">Cancelled</span>';
    return '<span style="color:var(--gold-light);">⏳ Pending — due ' + fmtDateTime(send.scheduled_at) + '</span>';
  }
  function carePackageBadge(cp) {
    if (!cp) return '<span style="color:var(--grey);">Not scheduled yet</span>';
    var labels = {
      pending_generation: '<span style="color:var(--gold-light);">⏳ Generating content</span>',
      active: '<span style="color:#4ADE80;">▶ Sending (in progress)</span>',
      paused: '<span style="color:var(--grey);">⏸ Paused by recipient</span>',
      completed: '<span style="color:#4ADE80;">✓ All messages delivered</span>',
      failed: '<span style="color:var(--coral);">✗ Generation failed</span>',
    };
    return labels[cp.status] || esc(cp.status);
  }
  function itemStatusHtml(item, order, digitalSendsByItemId, carePackagesByOrderId) {
    var pid = item.product_id || '';
    if (DIGITAL_SEND_PREFIXES.some(function (p) { return pid.startsWith(p); })) return digitalSendBadge(digitalSendsByItemId[item.id]);
    if (pid.startsWith(CAREPKG_PREFIX)) return carePackageBadge(carePackagesByOrderId[order.id]);
    return '<span style="color:var(--grey);">NA</span>';
  }

  var loadedOrders = [], loadedSends = {}, loadedPkgs = {};
  var selectedOrderIds = {};   // id -> true, for bulk delete
  // How many orders the Orders tab pulls. Raised from a hardcoded 100 and
  // made adjustable via the "Load more" control -- see loadOrders().
  var ordersLimit = 500;
  var ordersTotal = null;      // exact server-side count, for "N of M"

  function loadOrders() {
    var filterEl = document.getElementById('order-filter');
    var filter = filterEl ? filterEl.value : 'all';
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-orders-table');
    host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);">Loading…</p>';
    selectedOrderIds = {};
    updateBulkBar();

    // ── ROW CAP (audit finding #9) ────────────────────────────────────────
    // This was a hard .limit(100). Past 100 orders, older ones silently
    // vanished from the Orders tab AND from its CSV export -- with no
    // indication anything had been hidden, which is the dangerous part.
    // Now: a larger default, a visible "showing N of M" line, and a control
    // to load more. The full-fidelity export lives in
    // netlify/functions/admin-export.js (Emergency tab).
    var query = window.ZGSupabase.from('orders')
      .select('*, order_items(*)', { count: 'exact' })
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(ordersLimit);
    if (filter !== 'all') query = query.eq('status', filter);

    query.then(function (res) {
      if (res.error) { host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--coral);">' + res.error.message + '</p>'; return; }
      var orders = res.data;
      if (typeof res.count === 'number') ordersTotal = res.count;
      if (!orders.length) { loadedOrders = []; host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="e-icon">📭</div><p>No orders here yet.</p></div>'; return; }

      var orderIds = orders.map(function (o) { return o.id; });
      var digitalSendsQ = window.ZGSupabase.from('digital_sends').select('order_item_id, status, sent_at, scheduled_at, error_message').in('order_id', orderIds);
      var carePkgQ = window.ZGSupabase.from('care_package_orders').select('order_id, status').in('order_id', orderIds);

      Promise.all([digitalSendsQ, carePkgQ]).then(function (results) {
        loadedSends = {};
        (results[0].data || []).forEach(function (s) { loadedSends[s.order_item_id] = s; });
        loadedPkgs = {};
        (results[1].data || []).forEach(function (c) { loadedPkgs[c.order_id] = c; });
        loadedOrders = orders;
        renderOrdersTable();
      });
    });
  }

  function currentSearch() { var el = document.getElementById('order-search'); return el ? el.value.trim().toLowerCase() : ''; }
  function filteredOrders() {
    var q = currentSearch();
    if (!q) return loadedOrders;
    return loadedOrders.filter(function (o) {
      var hay = [o.order_number, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.contact_email, o.city, o.pincode]
        .concat((o.order_items || []).map(function (i) { return i.name_snapshot + ' ' + (i.recipient_name || ''); }))
        .join(' ').toLowerCase();
      return hay.indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });
  }

  function renderOrdersTable() {
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-orders-table');
    var orders = filteredOrders();
    var countEl = document.getElementById('order-count');
    if (countEl) {
      // Be explicit that the list is capped. The old copy said "100 orders"
      // whether you had 100 or 4,000, which quietly hid the truncation.
      var txt = orders.length + ' order' + (orders.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + (currentSearch() ? ' matching' : '');
      if (ordersTotal !== null && loadedOrders.length < ordersTotal) {
        txt += ' \u00b7 showing the newest ' + loadedOrders.length + ' of ' + ordersTotal + ' total';
      }
      countEl.innerHTML = esc(txt) +
        (ordersTotal !== null && loadedOrders.length < ordersTotal
          ? ' <button id="orders-load-more" class="btn-ghost" style="padding:4px 12px;font-size:11px;margin-left:8px;">Load more</button>'
          : '');
      var moreBtn = document.getElementById('orders-load-more');
      if (moreBtn) moreBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        ordersLimit += 500;
        moreBtn.textContent = 'Loading\u2026';
        loadOrders();
      });
    }
    if (!orders.length) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="e-icon">🔍</div><p>No orders match “' + esc(currentSearch()) + '”.</p></div>'; return; }

    // NOTE: the whole table is wrapped in .table-scroll so it scrolls
    // horizontally instead of being clipped by the content column.
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="table-scroll"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th class="sel-col"><input type="checkbox" class="sel-check" id="sel-all" title="Select all"></th>' +
      '<th></th><th>Order</th><th>Date</th><th>Customer</th><th>Delivery Address</th><th>Items</th><th>Digital Status</th><th>Total</th><th>Status</th><th>Update</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
      orders.map(function (o) {
        var checked = selectedOrderIds[o.id] ? 'checked' : '';
        return '<tr data-orow="' + o.id + '">' +
          '<td class="sel-col"><input type="checkbox" class="sel-check row-sel" data-sel="' + o.id + '" ' + checked + '></td>' +
          '<td><button class="btn-ghost row-expand" data-exp="' + o.id + '" style="padding:2px 9px;font-size:13px;line-height:1;">▸</button></td>' +
          '<td><span class="order-num">' + o.order_number + '</span></td>' +
          '<td style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;">' + fmtDateTime(o.created_at) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + esc(o.contact_name) + '<br><span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">' + esc(o.contact_phone) + '</span><br><span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">' + esc(o.contact_email) + '</span></td>' +
          '<td>' + deliveryCell(o) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="max-width:260px;">' + (o.order_items || []).map(function (i) {
            var line = esc(i.name_snapshot) + ' ×' + i.qty;
            if (i.recipient_name) line += ' <span style="color:var(--grey);">— for ' + esc(i.recipient_name) + '</span>';
            if (i.recipient_dob) line += ' <span style="color:var(--gold-light);font-size:11px;">(DOB: ' + fmtDob(i.recipient_dob) + ')</span>';
            return line;
          }).join('<br>') + '</td>' +
          '<td style="max-width:220px;font-size:11.5px;">' + (o.order_items || []).map(function (i) { return itemStatusHtml(i, o, loadedSends, loadedPkgs); }).join('<br>') + '</td>' +
          '<td>₹' + money(o.total) + '</td>' +
          '<td><span class="status-pill ' + o.status + '">' + o.status.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</span></td>' +
          '<td><select data-order="' + o.id + '">' +
            STATUSES.map(function (s) { return '<option value="' + s + '" ' + (s === o.status ? 'selected' : '') + '>' + s.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</option>'; }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '</tr>' +
        '<tr class="order-detail" data-detail="' + o.id + '" style="display:none;"><td colspan="11">' + orderDetailHtml(o) + '</td></tr>';
      }).join('') +
      '</tbody></table></div>';
    wireOrdersTable(host);
    updateBulkBar();
  }

  function orderDetailHtml(o) {
    var items = (o.order_items || []).map(function (i) {
      var bits = [];
      if (i.personalization_message) bits.push('<div style="font-size:12px;color:#cfcbc2;font-style:italic;margin-top:3px;"><strong style="color:var(--gold-light);">Customer note:</strong> &quot;' + esc(i.personalization_message) + '&quot;</div>');
      if (i.recipient_phone) bits.push('<span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">📱 ' + esc(i.recipient_phone) + '</span>');
      if (i.recipient_email) bits.push('<span style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;"> ✉ ' + esc(i.recipient_email) + '</span>');
      if (i.selected_options && typeof i.selected_options === 'object' && Object.keys(i.selected_options).length) {
        bits.push('<div style="font-size:12px;color:#cfcbc2;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.6;">' + Object.keys(i.selected_options).map(function (k) { return '<span style="color:var(--grey);">' + esc(k) + ':</span> ' + esc(String(i.selected_options[k])); }).join('<br>') + '</div>');
      }
      if (Array.isArray(i.addons) && i.addons.length) {
        bits.push('<div style="font-size:12px;color:#cfcbc2;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.6;"><strong style="color:var(--gold-light);">Add-ons to prepare:</strong><br>' + i.addons.map(function (a) { return esc(a.name || a.id || 'Add-on') + (a.price != null ? ' (+&#8377;' + money(a.price) + ')' : ''); }).join('<br>') + '</div>');
      }
      if (i.media_url) {
        bits.push('<div style="margin-top:6px;"><a href="' + esc(i.media_url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--gold-light);font-size:12px;">📷 Open uploaded photo</a></div>');
      }
      return '<div style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">' +
        '<div><b>' + esc(i.name_snapshot) + '</b> × ' + i.qty +
        (i.line_total != null ? ' <span style="color:var(--gold-light);float:right;">₹' + money(i.line_total) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
        (i.recipient_name ? '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--grey);">For ' + esc(i.recipient_name) + (i.recipient_dob ? ' · DOB ' + fmtDob(i.recipient_dob) : '') + '</div>' : '') +
        bits.join(' ') +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    return '<div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;">' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;">' +
        '<div><div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:8px;">Items</div>' + items + '</div>' +
        '<div><div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:8px;">Order</div>' +
          detailRow('Order #', o.order_number) + detailRow('Placed', fmtDateTime(o.created_at)) +
          detailRow('Contact', esc(o.contact_name) + ' · ' + esc(o.contact_phone)) + detailRow('Email', esc(o.contact_email)) +
          (o.promo_code ? detailRow('Promo', esc(o.promo_code)) : '') + (o.discount ? detailRow('Discount', '−₹' + money(o.discount)) : '') +
          (o.delivery_fee != null ? detailRow('Delivery fee', '₹' + money(o.delivery_fee)) : '') +
          detailRow('Total', '<b style="color:var(--gold-light);">₹' + money(o.total) + '</b>') +
          trackingEditorHtml(o) +
        '</div>' +
      '</div></div>';
  }

  /* ── COURIER TRACKING (audit finding #6) ────────────────────────────────
     There was no tracking field anywhere in the schema, so the status email
     told a customer their gift was "Out for delivery" and then gave them no
     way to follow it -- every one of those emails generated a "where is my
     order?" reply answered by hand.

     Shown only for orders that contain a PHYSICAL item; a digital-only order
     has nothing to courier. Saving here writes to orders.tracking_number /
     courier_name / tracking_url, which _lib/resend.js's statusUpdateEmail()
     renders into the next status email automatically.

     Requires supabase/consolidated/70_pipeline_fixes.sql. */
  function hasPhysicalItem(o) {
    return (o.order_items || []).some(function (i) {
      return i.product_id && !String(i.product_id).startsWith('digital_');
    });
  }

  function trackingEditorHtml(o) {
    if (!hasPhysicalItem(o)) return '';
    return '<div style="margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);">' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:8px;">Courier tracking</div>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;gap:6px;">' +
        '<input type="text" data-courier="' + o.id + '" value="' + esc(o.courier_name || '') + '" placeholder="Courier (e.g. Delhivery)" style="width:100%;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px;">' +
        '<input type="text" data-tracknum="' + o.id + '" value="' + esc(o.tracking_number || '') + '" placeholder="Tracking / AWB number" style="width:100%;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px;">' +
        '<input type="url" data-trackurl="' + o.id + '" value="' + esc(o.tracking_url || '') + '" placeholder="Tracking URL (optional)" style="width:100%;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px;">' +
        '<button class="btn-ghost" data-savetrack="' + o.id + '" style="padding:7px 14px;font-size:11px;justify-self:start;">Save tracking</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:6px;">Included automatically in the next status-update email you send for this order.</p>' +
    '</div>';
  }
  function detailRow(k, v) {
    return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);"><span style="color:var(--grey);">' + k + '</span><span>' + v + '</span></div>';
  }

  function wireOrdersTable(host) {
    host.querySelectorAll('select[data-order]').forEach(function (sel) {
      sel.addEventListener('change', function () { updateOrderStatus(sel.dataset.order, sel.value, sel); });
    });
    host.querySelectorAll('.copy-addr-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var text = btn.dataset.addr;
        var done = function () { var orig = btn.textContent; btn.textContent = 'Copied ✓'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = orig; }, 1200); };
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(function () { window.prompt('Copy address:', text); });
        else window.prompt('Copy address:', text);
      });
    });
    host.querySelectorAll('[data-savetrack]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var id = btn.dataset.savetrack;
        var patch = {
          courier_name:    (host.querySelector('[data-courier="' + id + '"]').value || '').trim() || null,
          tracking_number: (host.querySelector('[data-tracknum="' + id + '"]').value || '').trim() || null,
          tracking_url:    (host.querySelector('[data-trackurl="' + id + '"]').value || '').trim() || null,
        };
        btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '\u2026';
        window.ZGSupabase.from('orders').update(patch).eq('id', id).then(function (res) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          if (res.error) {
            btn.textContent = 'Failed';
            // Almost always "column does not exist" -- i.e. the migration.
            alert('Could not save tracking: ' + res.error.message +
                  '\n\nIf this mentions a missing column, run supabase/consolidated/70_pipeline_fixes.sql.');
          } else {
            btn.textContent = 'Saved \u2713';
            var row = loadedOrders.filter(function (x) { return x.id === id; })[0];
            if (row) { row.courier_name = patch.courier_name; row.tracking_number = patch.tracking_number; row.tracking_url = patch.tracking_url; }
          }
          setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save tracking'; }, 1600);
        });
      });
    });
    host.querySelectorAll('.row-expand').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var det = host.querySelector('tr[data-detail="' + btn.dataset.exp + '"]');
        if (!det) return;
        var open = det.style.display !== 'none';
        det.style.display = open ? 'none' : 'table-row';
        btn.textContent = open ? '▸' : '▾';
      });
    });
    // Per-row selection checkboxes.
    host.querySelectorAll('.row-sel').forEach(function (cb) {
      cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (cb.checked) selectedOrderIds[cb.dataset.sel] = true;
        else delete selectedOrderIds[cb.dataset.sel];
        updateBulkBar();
      });
    });
    // Select-all toggles every currently visible row.
    var selAll = host.querySelector('#sel-all');
    if (selAll) selAll.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var on = selAll.checked;
      host.querySelectorAll('.row-sel').forEach(function (cb) {
        cb.checked = on;
        if (on) selectedOrderIds[cb.dataset.sel] = true;
        else delete selectedOrderIds[cb.dataset.sel];
      });
      updateBulkBar();
    });
  }

  // Bulk bar reflects the current selection count and enables/disables delete.
  function updateBulkBar() {
    var bar = document.getElementById('orders-bulkbar');
    var countEl = document.getElementById('bulk-count');
    var delBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-delete');
    var n = Object.keys(selectedOrderIds).length;
    if (!bar) return;
    bar.classList.toggle('show', n > 0);
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = n + ' selected';
    if (delBtn) delBtn.disabled = n === 0;
  }

  // Delete selected orders.
  //
  // The DB does the heavy lifting: every child of `orders` is declared
  //   order_items          ON DELETE CASCADE
  //   order_status_history ON DELETE CASCADE
  //   digital_sends        ON DELETE CASCADE  (→ reply_tokens, gift_reactions,
  //                                             share_clip_jobs also CASCADE)
  //   care_package_orders  ON DELETE SET NULL
  //   subscriptions        ON DELETE SET NULL  (keeps a paid Zivo Pass alive)
  // so a single DELETE on `orders` cleans up everything and can't be blocked
  // by a foreign key. FK cascade actions are NOT subject to child-table RLS,
  // so no per-child delete policy is needed either.
  //
  // The ONE thing required is a DELETE policy on `orders` itself — see
  // supabase/schema-admin-order-delete.sql. Without it, RLS silently deletes
  // 0 rows (no error), which we detect below and call out explicitly instead
  // of pretending it worked.
  function deleteSelectedOrders() {
    var ids = Object.keys(selectedOrderIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    if (!confirm('Delete ' + ids.length + ' order' + (ids.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' permanently? This cannot be undone.')) return;

    var delBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-delete');
    if (delBtn) { delBtn.disabled = true; delBtn.textContent = 'Deleting…'; }

    // .select() so we get the deleted rows back and can tell a real delete
    // apart from an RLS silent no-op (0 rows, no error).
    window.ZGSupabase.from('orders').delete().in('id', ids).select('id').then(function (res) {
      if (res && res.error) {
        alert('Could not delete: ' + res.error.message);
        if (delBtn) { delBtn.disabled = false; delBtn.textContent = '🗑 Delete selected'; }
        return;
      }
      var deleted = (res && res.data) ? res.data.length : 0;
      if (deleted === 0) {
        alert('Nothing was deleted.\n\nThis almost always means the admin DELETE policy on the "orders" table is missing. ' +
          'Run supabase/schema-admin-order-delete.sql in the Supabase SQL editor once, then try again.');
        if (delBtn) { delBtn.disabled = false; delBtn.textContent = '🗑 Delete selected'; }
        return;
      }
      selectedOrderIds = {};
      if (delBtn) delBtn.textContent = '🗑 Delete selected';
      loadOrders();
    });
  }

  function updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus, selectEl) {
    selectEl.disabled = true;
    window.ZGSupabase.from('orders').update({ status: newStatus }).eq('id', orderId).then(function (res) {
      if (res.error) { alert('Could not update: ' + res.error.message); selectEl.disabled = false; return; }
      return window.ZGSupabase.from('order_status_history').insert({ order_id: orderId, status: newStatus, note: 'Updated by admin' }).then(function () {
        return window.ZGAuth.getSession();
      }).then(function (session) {
        return fetch('/.netlify/functions/notify-status-update', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + session.access_token },
          body: JSON.stringify({ orderId: orderId, newStatus: newStatus }),
        }).catch(function () {});
      }).finally(function () { loadOrders(); });
    });
  }

  function exportOrdersCsv() {
    var orders = filteredOrders();
    if (!orders.length) { alert('Nothing to export.'); return; }
    var cols = ['Order #', 'Placed', 'Status', 'Customer', 'Phone', 'Email', 'City', 'Pincode', 'Delivery', 'Items', 'Total'];
    var rows = orders.map(function (o) {
      var items = (o.order_items || []).map(function (i) { return i.name_snapshot + ' x' + i.qty + (i.recipient_name ? ' (for ' + i.recipient_name + ')' : ''); }).join(' | ');
      return [o.order_number, fmtDateTime(o.created_at), o.status, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.contact_email, o.city || '', o.pincode || '', o.delivery_type || '', items, o.total];
    });
    var csv = [cols].concat(rows).map(function (r) { return r.map(function (c) { return '"' + String(c == null ? '' : c).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }).join(','); }).join('\n');
    var blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'zivogift-orders-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CATALOG (unchanged)
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function loadCatalog() {
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-catalog-table');
    window.ZGSupabase.from('products').select('*').order('sort_order').then(function (res) {
      var products = res.data || [];
      // Keep the full product rows keyed by id so a Save can MERGE into the
      // existing option_pricing instead of overwriting it (that overwrite used
      // to wipe the "Frame Size" upcharges every time Handmade +₹ was saved).
      var productsById = {};
      products.forEach(function (p) { productsById[p.id] = p; });
      // Parse a product's option_pricing (jsonb may arrive as object or string).
      function parseOptionPricing(p) {
        var op = p && p.option_pricing;
        if (typeof op === 'string') { try { op = JSON.parse(op); } catch (e) { op = null; } }
        return (op && typeof op === 'object') ? op : null;
      }
      // Read the current "Creation Type → Handmade" upcharge (rupees added on
      // top of the base price) from a product's option_pricing map. Returns
      // null when the product has no such option (e.g. notes, bundles) so the
      // cell can render a dash and we never write option_pricing to those rows.
      // Blank input = NULL = unlimited. Digital products are labelled as such
      // so nobody sets a stock limit on something that has no scarcity.
      function stockCell(p) {
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(p, 'stock_qty')) {
          return '<td style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">—</td>';
        }
        if (p.type === 'digital') {
          return '<td style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;">n/a</td>';
        }
        var v = (p.stock_qty === null || p.stock_qty === undefined) ? '' : p.stock_qty;
        var soldOut = p.stock_qty === 0;
        return '<td><input type="number" min="0" value="' + v + '" data-stock="' + p.id + '" placeholder="∞" ' +
          'title="Blank = unlimited" style="width:72px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;' +
          (soldOut ? 'border-color:var(--coral);color:var(--coral);' : '') + '"></td>';
      }
      function handmadeDelta(p) {
        var op = parseOptionPricing(p);
        if (op && op['Creation Type'] && typeof op['Creation Type'].Handmade === 'number') {
          return op['Creation Type'].Handmade;
        }
        return null;
      }
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="table-scroll"><table class="admin-table" style="min-width:820px;"><thead><tr><th>Product</th><th>Type</th><th>Price (₹)</th><th>Stock</th><th>Option pricing (&#8377;)</th><th>Active</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        products.map(function (p) {
          var op = parseOptionPricing(p) || {};
          var optionFields = [];
          Object.keys(op).sort().forEach(function (group) {
            var choices = op[group];
            if (!choices || typeof choices !== 'object') return;
            Object.keys(choices).forEach(function (choice) {
              optionFields.push('<label style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin:2px 8px 2px 0;font-size:11px;">' + esc(group) + ' / ' + esc(choice) + '<input type="number" min="0" value="' + Number(choices[choice] || 0) + '" data-option-product="' + p.id + '" data-option-group="' + esc(group) + '" data-option-choice="' + esc(choice) + '" style="width:72px;padding:5px 6px;font-size:11px;"></label>');
            });
          });
          var handmadeCell = '<td style="min-width:320px;">' + (optionFields.length ? optionFields.join('') : '<span style="color:var(--grey);">No priced options</span>') + '</td>';
          return '<tr>' +
            '<td>' + (p.emoji || '') + ' ' + p.name + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-transform:capitalize;color:var(--grey);">' + p.type + '</td>' +
            '<td><input type="number" value="' + p.price + '" data-price="' + p.id + '" style="width:90px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;"></td>' +
            stockCell(p) +
            handmadeCell +
            '<td><input type="checkbox" ' + (p.active ? 'checked' : '') + ' data-active="' + p.id + '" style="width:auto;"></td>' +
            '<td><button data-save="' + p.id + '" class="btn-ghost" style="padding:6px 14px;font-size:11px;">Save</button></td>' +
          '</tr>';
        }).join('') +
        '</tbody></table></div>' +
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:8px;"><strong>Stock:</strong> leave blank for unlimited (correct for every digital product). Enter a number only for items you physically hold — checkout blocks the sale at 0 instead of taking money for something you cannot ship. Requires 70_pipeline_fixes.sql.</p>' +
        '<p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:8px;">“Price (₹)” is the base (e.g. the Digital option). “Handmade +₹” is added on top only when the buyer chooses Handmade — so Handmade total = Price + Handmade +₹. Leave “—” rows as they are.</p>';
      host.querySelectorAll('[data-save]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var id = btn.dataset.save;
          var price = parseFloat(host.querySelector('[data-price="' + id + '"]').value);
          var active = host.querySelector('[data-active="' + id + '"]').checked;
          if (isNaN(price) || price < 0) { btn.textContent = 'Bad price'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save'; }, 1500); return; }
          var update = { price: price, active: active };

          // ── STOCK (audit finding #10) ────────────────────────────────────
          // Blank means UNLIMITED (stored as NULL), which is every product's
          // default and the correct value for all digital products. Only a
          // real number imposes a limit, so an admin can never accidentally
          // take the catalogue offline by leaving a field empty.
          var stockEl = host.querySelector('[data-stock="' + id + '"]');
          if (stockEl) {
            var raw = String(stockEl.value).trim();
            if (raw === '') {
              update.stock_qty = null;
            } else {
              var n = parseInt(raw, 10);
              if (isNaN(n) || n < 0) { btn.textContent = 'Bad stock'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save'; }, 1500); return; }
              update.stock_qty = n;
            }
          }
          var merged = parseOptionPricing(productsById[id]) || {};
          var optionsValid = true;
          host.querySelectorAll('[data-option-product="' + id + '"]').forEach(function (input) {
            var delta = parseFloat(input.value);
            if (isNaN(delta) || delta < 0) { optionsValid = false; return; }
            var group = input.dataset.optionGroup;
            var choice = input.dataset.optionChoice;
            if (!merged[group] || typeof merged[group] !== 'object') merged[group] = {};
            merged[group][choice] = delta;
          });
          if (!optionsValid) { btn.textContent = 'Bad option'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save'; }, 1500); return; }
          update.option_pricing = merged;
          btn.textContent = '…';
          window.ZGSupabase.from('products').update(update).eq('id', id).then(function (res) {
            btn.textContent = res.error ? 'Failed' : 'Saved ✓';
            setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save'; }, 1500);
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ADD-ONS — enable/disable + price the birthday-note add-ons (Premium
     Keepsake Box, Personalised Note Card, Midnight Delivery Slot, Numerology
     Reading, Photo Print Insert, Scented Card). Same live-edit pattern as the
     catalog: the studio & gift builder read the `addons` table on load, so a
     save here is reflected on the storefront with no deploy. Admin sees
     inactive rows too (addons_public_read policy: active=true OR is_admin()).
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function loadAddons() {
    var host = document.getElementById('admin-addons-table');
    if (!host) return;
    window.ZGSupabase.from('addons').select('*').order('sort_order').then(function (res) {
      if (res.error) { host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;">Couldn\'t load add-ons: ' + esc(res.error.message) + '</p>'; return; }
      var addons = res.data || [];
      if (!addons.length) { host.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;">No add-ons found. Run the add-ons seed SQL in Supabase, then refresh.</p>'; return; }
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="table-scroll"><table class="admin-table" style="min-width:640px;"><thead><tr><th>Add-on</th><th>Price (₹)</th><th>Active</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        addons.map(function (a) {
          return '<tr>' +
            '<td>' + (a.emoji || '') + ' ' + esc(a.name) + '<div style="color:var(--grey);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;">' + esc(a.description || '') + '</div></td>' +
            '<td><input type="number" min="0" value="' + a.price + '" data-aprice="' + a.id + '" style="width:90px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;"></td>' +
            '<td><input type="checkbox" ' + (a.active ? 'checked' : '') + ' data-aactive="' + a.id + '" style="width:auto;"></td>' +
            '<td><button data-asave="' + a.id + '" class="btn-ghost" style="padding:6px 14px;font-size:11px;">Save</button></td>' +
          '</tr>';
        }).join('') +
        '</tbody></table></div>';
      host.querySelectorAll('[data-asave]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var id = btn.dataset.asave;
          var price = parseFloat(host.querySelector('[data-aprice="' + id + '"]').value);
          var active = host.querySelector('[data-aactive="' + id + '"]').checked;
          if (isNaN(price) || price < 0) { btn.textContent = 'Bad price'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save'; }, 1500); return; }
          btn.textContent = '…';
          window.ZGSupabase.from('addons').update({ price: price, active: active }).eq('id', id).then(function (r) {
            btn.textContent = r.error ? 'Failed' : 'Saved ✓';
            setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Save'; }, 1500);
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function ready(fn) { if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn); else fn(); }

  ready(function () {
    if (notConnectedGuard()) return;
    var logoutBtn = document.getElementById('logout-btn');
    if (logoutBtn) logoutBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { window.ZGAuth.signOut(); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.account-nav button[data-tab]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { showTab(b.dataset.tab); });
    });
    var filterEl = document.getElementById('order-filter');
    if (filterEl) filterEl.addEventListener('change', loadOrders);
    var searchEl = document.getElementById('order-search');
    if (searchEl) searchEl.addEventListener('input', renderOrdersTable);
    var csvBtn = document.getElementById('order-export');
    if (csvBtn) csvBtn.addEventListener('click', exportOrdersCsv);
    var refreshBtn = document.getElementById('overview-refresh');
    if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', loadOverview);
    // Bulk delete wiring.
    var delBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-delete');
    if (delBtn) delBtn.addEventListener('click', deleteSelectedOrders);
    var clearBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-clear');
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { selectedOrderIds = {}; renderOrdersTable(); });

    guard().then(function (ok) {
      if (ok) showTab(document.getElementById('admin-overview') ? 'overview' : 'orders');
    });
  });
})();

// Classic script — login/signup page.
(function () {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var mode = params.get('mode') === 'signup' ? 'signup' : 'login';

  function render() {
    document.getElementById('form-title').textContent =
      mode === 'login' ? 'WELCOME BACK' : mode === 'forgot' ? 'RESET YOUR PASSWORD' : 'CREATE YOUR ACCOUNT';
    document.getElementById('form-sub').textContent =
      mode === 'login' ? 'Log in to track orders and save addresses.'
      : mode === 'forgot' ? 'Enter your email and we\'ll send you a link to reset it.'
      : 'Save your addresses and track every order in one place.';
    document.getElementById('name-field').style.display = mode === 'signup' ? 'block' : 'none';
    var pwField = document.getElementById('password-field');
    var pwInput = document.getElementById('auth-password');
    pwField.style.display = mode === 'forgot' ? 'none' : 'block';
    pwInput.required = mode !== 'forgot';
    document.getElementById('forgot-link').parentElement.style.display = mode === 'login' ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').textContent =
      mode === 'login' ? 'Log In' : mode === 'forgot' ? 'Send Reset Link' : 'Create Account';
    var switchText = document.getElementById('switch-text');
    switchText.innerHTML =
      mode === 'forgot' ? 'Remembered it? <a href="#" id="switch-link">Log in</a>'
      : mode === 'login' ? 'New here? <a href="#" id="switch-link">Create an account</a>'
      : 'Already have an account? <a href="#" id="switch-link">Log in</a>';
    document.getElementById('switch-link').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      mode = mode === 'login' ? 'signup' : 'login';
      render();
    });
  }

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    render();

    document.getElementById('forgot-link').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      mode = 'forgot';
      render();
    });

    document.getElementById('auth-form').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var msg = document.getElementById('auth-msg');
      msg.className = 'form-msg';
      var email = document.getElementById('auth-email').value.trim();
      var password = document.getElementById('auth-password').value;
      var fullName = document.getElementById('auth-name').value.trim();
      var btn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');

      if (!window.ZGSupabase) {
        msg.textContent = 'Accounts aren\'t connected yet — this needs Supabase configured in js/config.js.';
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
        return;
      }

      btn.disabled = true;

      if (mode === 'forgot') {
        window.ZGSupabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
          redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/reset-password.html',
        }).then(function (res) {
          if (res.error) throw res.error;
          // Deliberately the same message whether or not an account exists
          // for this email — Supabase itself doesn't reveal that either, so
          // this page shouldn't leak it as a side effect.
          msg.textContent = 'If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.';
          msg.classList.add('show', 'success');
        }).catch(function (err) {
          msg.textContent = err.message;
          msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
        }).finally(function () {
          btn.disabled = false;
        });
        return;
      }

      var action = mode === 'signup'
        ? window.ZGSupabase.auth.signUp({ email: email, password: password, options: { data: { full_name: fullName } } })
        : window.ZGSupabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: email, password: password });

      action.then(function (res) {
        if (res.error) throw res.error;
        if (mode === 'signup') {
          msg.textContent = 'Account created! Check your email to confirm, then log in.';
          msg.classList.add('show', 'success');
          mode = 'login';
          render();
        } else {
          // Land on the home page after a normal login. An explicit ?redirect=
          // (e.g. sent here from checkout or the account guard) still wins, so
          // deep links continue to work — only the default changed from the
          // account page to the home page.
          var redirect = params.get('redirect') || 'index.html';
          window.location.href = redirect;
        }
      }).catch(function (err) {
        msg.textContent = err.message;
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
      }).finally(function () {
        btn.disabled = false;
      });
    });
  });
})();

(function () {
  'use strict';

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
    else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
  }

  function digitsOnly(s) { return String(s || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); }

  function computeStartDate(triggerDateStr) {
    // Trigger date (birth/due date) IS the start date for v1 — the "confirm
    // baby has arrived" flow for due-date orders is a real gap, noted in the
    // UI copy but not built yet (see care-package.js follow-up note below).
    return triggerDateStr;
  }

  ready(function () {
    var noteInput = $('cp-personal-note');
    var noteCount = $('cp-note-count');
    if (noteInput && noteCount) {
      noteInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        noteCount.textContent = String(noteInput.value.length);
      });
    }

    var addBtn = $('cp-add-to-cart-btn');
    if (!addBtn) return;

    addBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var msg = $('cp-form-msg');
      msg.textContent = '';
      msg.style.color = '';

      var recipientPhone = digitsOnly($('cp-recipient-phone').value);
      var triggerDate = $('cp-trigger-date').value;
      var relationship = $('cp-relationship').value;
      var personalNote = $('cp-personal-note').value.trim();
      var senderName = $('cp-sender-name').value.trim();

      // Client-side checks — the real validation happens server-side in
      // carePackageHelper.js (rows missing recipient_phone/trigger_date are
      // silently skipped, not just trusted), this is just fast feedback.
      var errors = [];
      if (recipientPhone.length !== 10) errors.push('Enter a valid 10-digit recipient number');
      if (!triggerDate) errors.push("Enter the baby's birth or due date");
      if (!senderName) errors.push('Enter your name');
      if (personalNote.length > 400) errors.push('Personal note is too long');

      if (errors.length) {
        msg.textContent = errors[0];
        msg.style.color = '#F87171';
        return;
      }

      var startDate = computeStartDate(triggerDate);

      var cartItem = {
        id: 'carepkg-' + Date.now(),
        productId: 'carepkg_postpartum',
        name: 'New Parent Care Package',
        price: 199, // must match products.price in schema-care-package.sql — update both together
        qty: 1,
        recipientName: null, // no single "recipient name" field for this product — personalization happens via relationship/note, not a name-on-card
        recipientPhone: recipientPhone,
        // Mapped onto `message` (not just selectedOptions) deliberately —
        // create-cashfree-order.js's content moderation gate reads
        // cart item `.message`, and personal_note is the one piece of free
        // text a sender writes that feeds into 14 AI-generated messages.
        // This makes it ride the same moderation check for free rather than
        // needing a separate one built just for this product.
        message: personalNote,
        selectedOptions: {
          vibe: null,
          package_type: 'postpartum',
          relationship_tone: relationship,
          personal_note: personalNote || null,
          trigger_date: triggerDate,
          start_date: startDate,
          cadence_days: 3,
          total_messages: 14,
        },
      };

      window.ZGCart.addToCart(cartItem);
      msg.textContent = '✓ Added to cart!';
      msg.style.color = '#4ADE80';
      setTimeout(function () { window.location.href = 'checkout.html'; }, 700);
    });
  });
})();

// FOLLOW-UP NOT BUILT YET: for due-date orders, the spec implies messages
// should start once the baby has actually arrived, not automatically on the
// estimated due date (due dates commonly shift by days/weeks either
// direction). v1 starts the sequence on trigger_date regardless. A real fix
// needs its own confirmation step (e.g. a WhatsApp keyword from the sender,
// similar to the existing condition_keyword pattern in digital_sends) before
// care-package-generator.js picks the order up — flagging this rather than
// quietly shipping a half-solution.

// Classic script — cart logic + cart drawer UI + the drawer's open/close wiring.
// localStorage-backed so it survives across pages/refreshes. This is DISPLAY
// only: the authoritative price check always happens server-side in
// netlify/functions/create-cashfree-order.js, which re-reads prices from
// Supabase and ignores whatever the browser sends.
(function () {
  var CART_KEY = 'zivogift_cart_v1';
  var DELIVERY_KEY = 'zivogift_delivery_v1';

  function getCart() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CART_KEY)) || [];
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // Broadcast that the cart changed so any open view (the checkout order
  // summary in particular) can re-render its line items + totals immediately,
  // instead of waiting for a manual page refresh. Fired on add / remove / clear.
  function emitCartChanged() {
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zg:cart-changed'));
    } catch (e) { /* CustomEvent unsupported — safe to ignore */ }
  }

  function saveCart(cart) {
    localStorage.setItem(CART_KEY, JSON.stringify(cart));
    updateCartBadge();
    emitCartChanged();
  }

  function addToCart(item) {
    var cart = getCart();
    var lineId = item.lineId || (item.productId + '_' + Date.now());
    cart.push(Object.assign({}, item, { lineId: lineId }));
    saveCart(cart);
    return cart;
  }

  function removeFromCart(lineId) {
    var cart = getCart().filter(function (i) { return i.lineId !== lineId; });
    saveCart(cart);
    renderCartDrawer();
  }

  function clearCart() {
    localStorage.removeItem(CART_KEY);
    updateCartBadge();
    emitCartChanged();
  }

  function cartCount() {
    return getCart().reduce(function (s, i) { return s + (i.qty || 1); }, 0);
  }

  function cartSubtotal() {
    return getCart().reduce(function (s, i) { return s + i.unitPrice * i.qty + (i.addonTotal || 0); }, 0);
  }

  function getDeliveryType() {
    return localStorage.getItem(DELIVERY_KEY) || 'standard';
  }
  function setDeliveryType(t) {
    localStorage.setItem(DELIVERY_KEY, t);
  }

  function updateCartBadge() {
    var badge = document.getElementById('cart-count');
    if (!badge) return;
    var n = cartCount();
    badge.textContent = n;
    badge.classList.toggle('visible', n > 0);
  }

  function openCartDrawer() {
    renderCartDrawer();
    var sidebar = document.getElementById('cart-sidebar');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
    if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.add('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');
  }
  function closeCartDrawer() {
    var sidebar = document.getElementById('cart-sidebar');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
    if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.remove('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show');
  }

  function renderCartDrawer() {
    var list = document.getElementById('cart-items-list');
    if (!list) return;
    var cart = getCart();
    if (!cart.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty"><div class="empty-emoji">🎁</div><p>Nothing in here yet.<br>Add a gift to get started.</p></div>';
    } else {
      list.innerHTML = cart.map(function (i) {
        return '<div class="cart-item">' +
          '<div class="cart-item-emoji">' + (i.emoji || '🎁') + '</div>' +
          '<div class="cart-item-info">' +
            '<div class="cart-item-name">' + i.name + ' × ' + i.qty + '</div>' +
            (i.recipientName ? '<div class="cart-item-opts">For: ' + i.recipientName + ((i.recipientDobDisplay || i.recipientDob) ? ' · DOB ' + (i.recipientDobDisplay || i.recipientDob) : '') + '</div>' : '') +
            (i.message ? '<div class="cart-item-msg">"' + i.message + '"</div>' : '') +
            (i.selectedOptions && Object.keys(i.selectedOptions).length ? '<div class="cart-item-opts">' + Object.keys(i.selectedOptions).map(function (k) { var v = String(i.selectedOptions[k]); if (v.length > 40) v = v.slice(0, 40) + '…'; return k + ': ' + v; }).join(' · ') + '</div>' : '') +
            (i.mediaUrl && i.mediaType === 'image' ? '<div class="cart-item-opts">📷 Photo attached</div>' : '') +
            (i.addonNames && i.addonNames.length ? '<div class="cart-item-opts">Extras: ' + i.addonNames.join(', ') + '</div>' : '') +
            '<div class="cart-item-price">₹' + (i.unitPrice * i.qty + (i.addonTotal || 0)) + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<span class="cart-item-remove" data-remove="' + i.lineId + '">🗑</span>' +
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
      list.querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function () { removeFromCart(el.dataset.remove); });
      });
    }
    renderTotals('cart-totals');
  }

  // Resolve the delivery fee for the drawer. There is NO flat ₹65 any more:
  // the fee comes from js/delivery-zones.js keyed on the destination pincode.
  // The cart drawer usually has no pincode yet, so in that case we show
  // "Calculated at checkout" rather than inventing a number — the real fee is
  // resolved on the checkout page (and re-verified on the server). Returns
  // { fee: <number|null>, label: <string> }.
  function resolveDrawerDelivery(opts) {
    var deliveryType = opts.deliveryType || getDeliveryType();
    var pincode = opts.pincode || null;
    // Premium Keepsake Box => flat Rs.150, irrespective of pincode/campus.
    var hasBox = getCart().some(function (item) {
      return Array.isArray(item.addonIds) && item.addonIds.indexOf('addon_box') !== -1;
    });
    if (hasBox) return { fee: 150, label: '₹150 (gift box)' };
    if (window.ZGDeliveryZones && pincode) {
      var r = window.ZGDeliveryZones.feeFor(deliveryType, pincode);
      if (r.ok) return { fee: r.fee, label: r.fee === 0 ? 'Free' : '₹' + r.fee };
    }
    // Campus with no pincode is still free; anything else is deferred.
    if (deliveryType === 'campus') return { fee: 0, label: 'Free' };
    return { fee: null, label: 'Calculated at checkout' };
  }

  function renderTotals(targetId, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var el = document.getElementById(targetId);
    if (!el) return 0;
    var sub = cartSubtotal();
    var del = resolveDrawerDelivery(opts);
    var deliveryFee = del.fee || 0;
    var discount = opts.discount || 0;
    var total = Math.max(0, sub - discount) + deliveryFee;
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="cart-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>₹' + sub + '</span></div>' +
      (discount > 0 ? '<div class="cart-row" style="color:var(--gold-light)"><span>Promo discount</span><span>−₹' + discount + '</span></div>' : '') +
      '<div class="cart-row"><span>Delivery</span><span>' + del.label + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="cart-row total"><span>Total</span><span>₹' + total +
        (del.fee === null ? '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);"> + delivery</span>' : '') +
      '</span></div>';
    return total;
  }

  // Validates a promo code live against Supabase (read-only, public per RLS).
  // If Supabase isn't configured/reachable yet, just say so — no crash.
  function checkPromoCode(code) {
    if (!code) return Promise.resolve(null);
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) return Promise.resolve(null);
    return window.ZGSupabase
      .from('promo_codes')
      .select('*')
      .eq('code', code.trim().toUpperCase())
      .eq('active', true)
      .maybeSingle()
      .then(function (res) {
        var data = res.data;
        if (res.error || !data) return null;
        if (data.expires_at && new Date(data.expires_at) < new Date()) return null;
        var sub = cartSubtotal();
        var discount;
        if (data.type === 'fixed_total') {
          // Preview mirrors the server: final payable becomes a flat value
          // (e.g. ₹1). Delivery fee is added later in renderTotals, so for the
          // digital carts this code is meant for it lands on the value exactly.
          var flat = Math.max(1, Math.round(data.value));
          discount = Math.max(0, sub - flat);
        } else {
          discount = data.type === 'percent' ? Math.round((sub * data.value) / 100) : data.value;
          if (data.max_discount) discount = Math.min(discount, data.max_discount);
        }
        return { code: data.code, discount: discount };
      })
      .catch(function () { return null; });
  }

  window.ZGCart = {
    getCart: getCart,
    addToCart: addToCart,
    removeFromCart: removeFromCart,
    clearCart: clearCart,
    cartCount: cartCount,
    cartSubtotal: cartSubtotal,
    getDeliveryType: getDeliveryType,
    setDeliveryType: setDeliveryType,
    updateCartBadge: updateCartBadge,
    openCartDrawer: openCartDrawer,
    closeCartDrawer: closeCartDrawer,
    renderCartDrawer: renderCartDrawer,
    renderTotals: renderTotals,
    checkPromoCode: checkPromoCode,
  };

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    updateCartBadge();
    var cartBtn = document.getElementById('cart-btn');
    var cartClose = document.getElementById('cart-close');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
    if (cartBtn) cartBtn.addEventListener('click', openCartDrawer);
    if (cartClose) cartClose.addEventListener('click', closeCartDrawer);
    if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', function () {
      closeCartDrawer();
      var panel = document.getElementById('person-panel');
      if (panel) panel.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });
})();

// Classic script — catalog rendering + the "personalize before adding to
// cart" panel. Reads live from Supabase (admin-editable prices/copy) and
// falls back to the seed data below whenever Supabase isn't configured yet
// or isn't reachable — so this page always renders something real, never a
// blank grid, regardless of network conditions.
(function () {

  var PRODUCTS = [];
  var ADDONS = [];
  // true once the live products query has returned successfully (even if it
  // returned zero rows). Used to distinguish "DB says inactive" from "DB down".
  var CATALOG_LIVE = false;
  var pending = null;
  function money(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }
  function byType(t) { return PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.type === t; }); }
  function loadCatalog() {
    var fetchPromise;
    if (window.ZGSupabase) {
      fetchPromise = Promise.all([
        window.ZGSupabase.from('products').select('*').eq('active', true).order('sort_order'),
        window.ZGSupabase.from('addons').select('*').eq('active', true).order('sort_order'),
      ]).catch(function () { return null; });
    } else {
      fetchPromise = Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return fetchPromise.then(function (results) {
      var products = results && results[0] && !results[0].error ? results[0].data : null;
      var addons = results && results[1] && !results[1].error ? results[1].data : null;
      // Did the products query actually SUCCEED? An empty array is a valid,
      // authoritative answer ("nothing is active") and must NOT be treated the
      // same as a failed/unreachable query. renderFrames() relies on this to
      // decide whether falling back to the built-in seed is legitimate.
      CATALOG_LIVE = !!(results && results[0] && !results[0].error && results[0].data);
      PRODUCTS = products && products.length ? products : FALLBACK_PRODUCTS;
      ADDONS = addons && addons.length ? addons : FALLBACK_ADDONS;
      renderNotes();
      renderBundles();
      renderKitsAndDigital();
      renderFrames();
      renderDigitalSpotlight();
      renderSquad();
      renderAddonsFeature();
      syncSelectableAddons();
      // Newly injected .reveal cards need to be (re)observed by js/ui.js.
      if (window.ZGReobserveReveal) window.ZGReobserveReveal();
    });
  }
  function renderNotes() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('denom-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    var notes = byType('note');
    if (!notes.length) {
      notes = PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){ return p.product_type === 'note'; });
    }
    grid.innerHTML = notes.map(function (p) {
      var face = (p.name.match(/₹\d+/) || [p.emoji])[0];
      var compareAt = p.compare_at_price || Math.round(p.price * 2.3);
      return '<div class="denom-card reveal" data-product="' + p.id + '">' +
        '<div class="denom-face">' + face + '</div>' +
        '<div class="denom-label">' + p.name.replace(/₹\d+\s*/, '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="denom-our-price"><span class="price-strike">₹' + money(compareAt) + '</span> <span class="price-now">₹' + money(p.price) + '</span> <span class="price-onwards">onwards</span></div>' +
        '<button class="denom-add-btn" data-open="' + p.id + '" type="button" style="pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;position:relative;z-index:10;">Choose this note</button>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    // Attach direct listeners to each button (most reliable)
    grid.querySelectorAll('.denom-add-btn[data-open]').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        openPanelForNote(btn.dataset.open);
      });
    });
    // Also attach event delegation ONCE via a flag on the grid element
    if (!grid._delegated) {
      grid._delegated = true;
      grid.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('.denom-add-btn[data-open]');
        if (btn) { e.preventDefault(); openPanelForNote(btn.dataset.open); }
      });
    }
  }
