  // The homepage "Digital Gifts, Built Different" cards (#digital-spotlight)
  // are static hand-styled HTML, not generated from PRODUCTS like the note/
  // bundle/kit grids — so they used to stay visible even after an admin
  // switched a digital product off in Catalog & Pricing. Each card now
  // carries data-product="<product id>"; here we hide the ones whose id
  // isn't in the (already active-only) PRODUCTS list. Fails open — if a
  // card has no data-product, or PRODUCTS is empty, it's left visible —
  // this is a visibility/UX concern, not the checkout security boundary,
  // which create-cashfree-order.js already enforces server-side.
  // Personalised framed keepsakes (type 'frame'): Word Portrait + Name Across
  // Earth. Physical products, fulfilled by hand from /admin. Rendered into
  // #frames-grid (index.html). Each card opens the personalise panel in frame
  // mode via openPanelForFrame().
  function frameHandmadeDelta(p) {
    try {
      var op = p.option_pricing;
      if (typeof op === 'string') op = JSON.parse(op);
      if (op && op['Creation Type']) {
        var m = op['Creation Type'], max = 0;
        Object.keys(m).forEach(function (k) { if (typeof m[k] === 'number' && m[k] > max) max = m[k]; });
        return max;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return 0;
  }
  function findOptValues(opts, label) {
    for (var i = 0; i < (opts || []).length; i++) { if (opts[i].label === label) return opts[i].values; }
    return null;
  }
  function renderFrames() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('frames-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    var section = document.getElementById('portrait-frames');
    var frames = byType('frame');
    if (!frames.length) { frames = PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.product_type === 'frame'; }); }
    // BUGFIX: previously, zero active frames fell through to FALLBACK_PRODUCTS,
    // so unticking "Active" in admin had no effect -- the built-in seed simply
    // re-rendered the cards. Worse, the buyer could then reach checkout, where
    // create-cashfree-order.js rejects inactive products ("Unknown or inactive
    // product"), i.e. a visible but unbuyable gift.
    //
    // The seed fallback is now used ONLY when the live query genuinely failed
    // (offline / Supabase unreachable). When the DB answers and says nothing is
    // active, we honour that: clear the static cards and hide the section.
    if (!frames.length && !CATALOG_LIVE) {
      frames = FALLBACK_PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.type === 'frame'; });
    }
    if (!frames.length) {
      // Remove the hardcoded cards baked into index.html, otherwise they stay
      // on screen and remain clickable.
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      if (section) section.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    if (section) section.style.display = '';
    grid.innerHTML = frames.map(function (p) {
      var compareAt = p.compare_at_price || Math.round(p.price * 2.2);
      var badge = p.id === 'frame_wordart' ? '100% Handmade option' : 'Real satellite art';
      return '<div class="frame-card reveal" data-product="' + p.id + '">' +
        '<div class="frame-emoji">' + (p.emoji || '\U0001f5bc\ufe0f') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="frame-badge">' + badge + '</div>' +
        '<div class="frame-name">' + p.name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="frame-desc">' + (p.description || '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="frame-price"><span class="price-strike">\u20b9' + money(compareAt) + '</span> <span class="price-now">\u20b9' + money(p.price) + '</span> <span class="price-onwards">from</span></div>' +
        '<button class="frame-add-btn" data-open="' + p.id + '" type="button">Personalise &amp; add</button>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () { openPanelForFrame(btn.dataset.open); });
    });
  }
  function renderDigitalSpotlight() {
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.digi-card[data-product]');
    if (!cards.length) return;
    var activeDigitalIds = {};
    byType('digital').forEach(function (p) { activeDigitalIds[p.id] = true; });
    cards.forEach(function (card) {
      var pid = card.dataset.product;
      card.style.display = activeDigitalIds[pid] ? '' : 'none';
    });
  }
  function renderSquad() {

' <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey)">per person</span>' : '') + '</div>' +

  // The SELECTABLE add-ons in #person-panel (the "MAKE IT YOURS" popup) are
  // static HTML in index.html — unlike the #addons-grid showcase, they were
  // never reconciled against the DB. That meant an add-on turned off in admin
  // (active=false) stayed visible AND selectable in the panel. This hides any
  // that aren't in the active set (same approach studio.js uses for products)
  // and syncs the live price/label so admin price edits also show up.
  //
  // Fail-safe: only runs when we actually got real rows from Supabase. If the
  // DB fetch failed we fell back to FALLBACK_ADDONS (all active by design), so
  // we must NOT hide anything — better to show all than to blank the panel.
  function syncSelectableAddons() {
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) return;            // no backend -> leave static HTML as-is
    var activeById = {};
    ADDONS.forEach(function (a) { activeById[a.id] = a; });
    document.querySelectorAll('.addon-item[data-id]').forEach(function (el) {
      var id = el.dataset.id;
      var a = activeById[id];
      if (!a) {
        // Inactive (or unknown): hide it and make sure it can't stay selected.
        el.classList.remove('selected');
        el.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }
      el.style.display = '';
      // Keep price in sync with admin edits.
      el.dataset.price = a.price;
      var priceEl = el.querySelector('.addon-price');
      if (priceEl) priceEl.textContent = '+₹' + money(a.price);
    });
    // Keepsake Box lives as a separate toggle row (id="wrap-toggle", no data-id).
    // BUGFIX: previously this only showed/hid the row and never updated its
    // price, so an admin price change (e.g. ₹149 -> ₹349) left the popup still
    // reading the hardcoded "+₹149" in the <small> line while finalizeAddToCart
    // charged the DB price — a shown-vs-charged mismatch. Now we also rewrite
    // the price text (and a data-price hook) from the DB-synced ADDONS row.
    var wrap = document.getElementById('wrap-toggle');
    if (wrap) {
      var row = wrap.closest('.toggle-row');
      var box = activeById['addon_box'];
      if (row) row.style.display = box ? '' : 'none';
      if (box && row) {
        // Expose the live price for any code that wants it.
        row.dataset.price = box.price;
        // Rewrite the "+₹149" that lives inside the label's <small> so the
        // buyer sees exactly what will be charged. Matches "₹149" or "+₹1,299".
        var small = row.querySelector('.toggle-label small');
        if (small) small.textContent = small.textContent.replace(/\+?₹\s*[\d,]+/, '+₹' + money(box.price));
      }
    }
  }
  function renderAddonsFeature() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('addons-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = ADDONS.map(function (a) {
      return '<div class="addon-feature-card reveal">' +
        '<div class="addon-feature-icon">' + a.emoji + '</div>' +
        '<div class="addon-feature-name">' + a.name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="addon-feature-desc">' + (a.description || '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="addon-feature-price">+₹' + money(a.price) + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function basePending(product) {
    return {
      productId: product.id, name: product.name, emoji: product.emoji, unitPrice: product.price,
      qty: 1, recipientName: '', recipientDob: '', recipientDobDisplay: '', message: '', selectedOptions: {},
      addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
    };
  }
  function openPanelForNote(productId) {
    var product = PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.id === productId; })[0];
    pending = basePending(product);
    openPanel({ showNoteFields: true, showDigitalFields: false });
  }
  function openPanelForSimple(productId) {
    var product = PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.id === productId; })[0];
    pending = basePending(product);
    var isDigital = product.id.startsWith('digital_') || product.id.startsWith('squad_');
    openPanel({ showNoteFields: false, showDigitalFields: isDigital });
  }
  function openPanelForProduct(productId) {
    var product = PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.id === productId; })[0];
    pending = basePending(product);
    if (product.options && product.options.length) {
      product.options.forEach(function (o, i) {
        var sel = document.getElementById('opt-' + product.id + '-' + i);
        if (sel) pending.selectedOptions[o.label] = sel.value;
      });
    }
    var isDigital = product.id.startsWith('digital_') || product.id.startsWith('squad_');
    openPanel({ showNoteFields: false, showDigitalFields: isDigital });
  }
  function openPanelForFrame(productId) {
    var product = PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.id === productId; })[0];
    if (!product) { product = FALLBACK_PRODUCTS.filter(function (p) { return p.id === productId; })[0]; }
    if (!product) return;
    pending = basePending(product);
    pending.isFrame = true;
    pending.frameKind = product.id;
    openPanel({ showNoteFields: false, showDigitalFields: false, showFrameFields: true, frameProduct: product });
  }
  // Frame products don't use the note add-ons / keepsake-box row. Toggle those
  // extras so the panel shows only the fields that apply to a framed keepsake.
  function setPanelExtras(visible) {
    document.querySelectorAll('#person-panel .addon-item').forEach(function (el) { el.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none'; });
    var toggleRow = document.querySelector('#person-panel .toggle-row');
    if (toggleRow) toggleRow.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
  }
  function renderFrameFields(host, product) {
    var opts = product.options || [];
    function sizeSel(id) {
      var vals = findOptValues(opts, 'Frame Size') || ['A4 (8x12 in)', 'A3 (12x16 in)'];
      return '<label class="frame-fl">Frame Size</label><select id="' + id + '" class="frame-input">' +

  function finalizeAddToCart() {
    if (!pending) return;
    if (pending.isFrame) return finalizeFrameAddToCart();
    var noteRecipient = document.getElementById('note-recipient');
    if (noteRecipient) {
      if (!noteRecipient.value.trim()) {
        noteRecipient.classList.add('error');
        setTimeout(function () { noteRecipient.classList.remove('error'); }, 1500);
        return;
      }
      pending.recipientName = noteRecipient.value.trim();
      var dobEl = document.getElementById('note-dob');
      var rawDob = dobEl ? dobEl.value.trim() : '';
      if (!rawDob) {
        if (dobEl) { dobEl.style.borderColor='#FF4D2E'; setTimeout(function(){ dobEl.style.borderColor=''; },1500); }
        return;
      }
      // recipient_dob is stored in a Postgres `date` column. Postgres's
      // default DateStyle is MDY, so an ambiguous "DD/MM/YYYY" string here
      // can silently get misparsed for any day <= 12 (e.g. "05/08/2003"
      // meant as 5-Aug could be stored as May 8th). The <input type="date">
      // value (rawDob) is already unambiguous ISO YYYY-MM-DD — send that to
      // the backend untouched, and keep a separate DD/MM/YYYY string only
      // for the human-readable cart summary.
      pending.recipientDob = rawDob;
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(rawDob)) {
        var parts = rawDob.split('-');
        pending.recipientDobDisplay = parts[2] + '/' + parts[1] + '/' + parts[0];
      } else {
        pending.recipientDobDisplay = rawDob;
      }
    }
    // Digital products — capture delivery mode, WhatsApp, email + send time
    var digitalNameEl = document.getElementById('digital-recipient-name');
    if (digitalNameEl) {
      var modeEl = document.querySelector('input[name="digi-mode"]:checked');
      var mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'both';
      pending.deliveryMode = mode;
      // WhatsApp validation
      var digitalPhoneEl = document.getElementById('digital-recipient-phone');
      if (mode !== 'email') {
        if (digitalPhoneEl && !digitalPhoneEl.value.trim()) {
          digitalPhoneEl.classList.add('error');
          setTimeout(function () { digitalPhoneEl.classList.remove('error'); }, 1500);
          return;
        }
      }
      // Email validation
      var digitalEmailEl = document.getElementById('digital-recipient-email');
      if (mode !== 'whatsapp') {
        if (digitalEmailEl && !digitalEmailEl.value.trim()) {
          digitalEmailEl.classList.add('error');
          setTimeout(function () { digitalEmailEl.classList.remove('error'); }, 1500);
          return;
        }
      }
      pending.recipientName = digitalNameEl.value.trim() || pending.recipientName;
      var rawPhone = (digitalPhoneEl && mode !== 'email' ? digitalPhoneEl.value.trim() : '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      pending.recipientPhone = rawPhone.length === 10 ? '91' + rawPhone : rawPhone;
      pending.recipientEmail = (digitalEmailEl && mode !== 'whatsapp') ? digitalEmailEl.value.trim() : '';
      var sendTimeEl = document.getElementById('digital-send-time');
      var sendChoice = sendTimeEl ? sendTimeEl.value : 'midnight';
      pending.scheduledSendAt = computeSendTime(sendChoice);
    }
    var addonNames = [], addonIds = [], addonTotal = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('.addon-item.selected').forEach(function (el) {
      var price = parseInt(el.dataset.price, 10) || 0;
      addonTotal += price;
      addonIds.push(el.dataset.id);
      addonNames.push(el.querySelector('.addon-name').childNodes[0].textContent.trim());
    });
    // Premium Keepsake Box (the .toggle switch, not an .addon-item). If it's on,
    // include it just like a selected add-on. Price comes from the DB-synced
    // ADDONS list so admin price edits apply; the server re-prices by id anyway.
    var wrapToggle = document.getElementById('wrap-toggle');
    if (wrapToggle && wrapToggle.classList.contains('on')) {
      var box = null;
      for (var bi = 0; bi < ADDONS.length; bi++) { if (ADDONS[bi].id === 'addon_box') { box = ADDONS[bi]; break; } }
      addonTotal += box ? Number(box.price) : 149;
      addonIds.push('addon_box');
      addonNames.push(box ? box.name : 'Premium Keepsake Box');
    }
    // Hard guard: Scented Card cannot survive without the Premium Keepsake Box
    // even if the UI state was tampered with. The server re-checks this too.
    var scentIdx = addonIds.indexOf('addon_scent');
    if (scentIdx !== -1 && addonIds.indexOf('addon_box') === -1) {
      var scentPrice = 19;
      for (var si = 0; si < ADDONS.length; si++) {
        if (ADDONS[si].id === 'addon_scent') { scentPrice = Number(ADDONS[si].price) || 19; break; }
      }
      addonIds.splice(scentIdx, 1);
      addonNames.splice(scentIdx, 1);
      addonTotal = Math.max(0, addonTotal - scentPrice);
    }
    pending.addonIds = addonIds;
    pending.addonNames = addonNames;
    pending.addonTotal = addonTotal;
    var instructions = document.getElementById('panel-instructions');
    pending.message = instructions ? instructions.value.trim() : '';
    window.ZGCart.addToCart(pending);
    pending = null;
    closePanel();
    setTimeout(window.ZGCart.openCartDrawer, 250);
  }
  function flashErr(el) { if (!el) return; el.classList.add('error'); setTimeout(function () { el.classList.remove('error'); }, 1500); }
  function uploadFramePhoto(file) {
    var nm = file.name || 'photo.jpg';
    var ext = (nm.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase();
    if (['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'].indexOf(ext) < 0) ext = 'jpg';
    var tempId = 'tmp-' + Date.now();
    return fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: ext, order_id: tempId }),
    }).then(function (res) { return res.json(); }).then(function (data) {
      if (!data.upload_url) throw new Error('no upload url');
      return fetch(data.upload_url, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': data.content_type }, body: file })
        .then(function (putRes) { if (!putRes.ok) throw new Error('put failed'); return data.public_url; });
    });
  }
  function finalizeFrameAddToCart() {
    var product = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < PRODUCTS.length; i++) { if (PRODUCTS[i].id === pending.frameKind) { product = PRODUCTS[i]; break; } }

    if (!product) product = { id: pending.frameKind, price: pending.unitPrice, option_pricing: null };
    var rec = document.getElementById('frame-recipient');
    if (!rec || !rec.value.trim()) { flashErr(rec); return; }
    pending.recipientName = rec.value.trim();

    if (pending.frameKind === 'frame_wordart') {

      if (langEl) selectedOptions['Language'] = langEl.value;
      var wordsEl = document.getElementById('frame-words');
      if (!wordsEl || !wordsEl.value.trim()) { flashErr(wordsEl); return; }
      selectedOptions['Custom Words'] = wordsEl.value.trim();
      pending.unitPrice = product.price + (creation === 'Handmade' ? frameHandmadeDelta(product) : 0);
      var photoEl = document.getElementById('frame-photo');
      var file = photoEl && photoEl.files && photoEl.files[0];
      if (!file) { flashErr(photoEl); return; }
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        var st = document.getElementById('frame-photo-status');
        if (st) { st.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; st.textContent = 'Photo must be under 10 MB.'; }
        return;
      }
      pending.selectedOptions = selectedOptions;
      var proceedBtn = document.getElementById('panel-proceed');
      if (proceedBtn) { proceedBtn.disabled = true; proceedBtn.textContent = 'Uploading photo\u2026'; }
      uploadFramePhoto(file).then(function (url) {
        pending.mediaUrl = url;
        pending.mediaType = 'image';
        window.ZGCart.addToCart(pending);
        pending = null;
        if (proceedBtn) { proceedBtn.disabled = false; proceedBtn.textContent = 'Add to Cart \U0001f6d2'; }
        closePanel();
        setTimeout(window.ZGCart.openCartDrawer, 250);
      }).catch(function () {
        var st2 = document.getElementById('frame-photo-status');
        if (st2) { st2.style.color = '#FF4D2E'; st2.textContent = 'Upload failed - please try again.'; }
        if (proceedBtn) { proceedBtn.disabled = false; proceedBtn.textContent = 'Add to Cart \U0001f6d2'; }
      });
      return;
    }

    // frame_landsat
    var nameEl = document.getElementById('frame-name');
    var nmv = nameEl ? nameEl.value.trim() : '';
    if (!nmv || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(nmv)) { flashErr(nameEl); return; }
    selectedOptions['Name'] = nmv;
    pending.selectedOptions = selectedOptions;
    pending.unitPrice = product.price;
    window.ZGCart.addToCart(pending);
    pending = null;
    closePanel();
    setTimeout(window.ZGCart.openCartDrawer, 250);
  }
  // Converts the buyer's chosen send-time into a UTC ISO string
  function computeSendTime(choice) {
    var now = new Date();
    var istOffsetMs = 330 * 60 * 1000; // UTC+5:30
    if (choice === 'now') return now.toISOString();
    if (choice === 'morning') {
      // 8:00 AM IST tomorrow. We work on an IST-shifted clock (now + offset),
      // so the wall-clock hour to pin is 08:00 — NOT 02:30. Subtracting the
      // offset once afterwards yields the correct UTC instant.
      // BUGFIX: previously pinned 02:30 on the shifted clock and then subtracted
      // the offset again (double conversion) — sends landed at ~2:30 AM IST.
      var tomorrow = new Date(now.getTime() + istOffsetMs);
      tomorrow.setUTCDate(tomorrow.getUTCDate() + 1);
      tomorrow.setUTCHours(8, 0, 0, 0); // 08:00 IST on the shifted clock
      return new Date(tomorrow.getTime() - istOffsetMs).toISOString();
    }
    // Default: midnight IST (00:00 IST = 18:30 UTC previous day)
    var midnightIST = new Date(now.getTime() + istOffsetMs);
    midnightIST.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    if (midnightIST.getTime() <= now.getTime() + istOffsetMs) {
      midnightIST.setUTCDate(midnightIST.getUTCDate() + 1);
    }
    return new Date(midnightIST.getTime() - istOffsetMs).toISOString();
  }
  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }
  ready(function () {
    loadCatalog();
    // Scented Card is only orderable together with the Premium Keepsake Box.
    // It is visually + functionally disabled whenever the box toggle is off,
    // and any stale selection is cleared so it can never reach the cart alone.
    function syncScentedCardAvailability() {
      var scent = document.querySelector('.addon-item[data-id="addon_scent"]');
      if (!scent) return;
      var wt = document.getElementById('wrap-toggle');
      var boxOn = !!(wt && wt.classList.contains('on'));
      scent.setAttribute('aria-disabled', boxOn ? 'false' : 'true');
      scent.style.opacity = boxOn ? '' : '0.45';
      scent.style.cursor = boxOn ? '' : 'not-allowed';
      if (!boxOn) scent.classList.remove('selected');
      var small = scent.querySelector('.addon-name small');
      if (small) small.textContent = boxOn
        ? 'A faint vanilla or rose note'
        : 'Add the Premium Keepsake Box to unlock this';
    }
    window.ZGSyncScentedCard = syncScentedCardAvailability;

    document.querySelectorAll('.addon-item').forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (el.dataset.id === 'addon_scent' && el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;
        el.classList.toggle('selected');
      });
    });
    // Premium Keepsake Box is a separate .toggle switch (id="wrap-toggle"), not
    // an .addon-item — it was never given a click handler in the original code,
    // so it could not be turned on at all. Wire it to flip the .on class the
    // CSS already styles (.toggle.on). finalizeAddToCart reads this state below.
    var wrapToggle = document.getElementById('wrap-toggle');
    if (wrapToggle) {
      wrapToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
        wrapToggle.classList.toggle('on');
        syncScentedCardAvailability();
      });
    }
    syncScentedCardAvailability();
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById('panel-close');
    var proceedBtn = document.getElementById('panel-proceed');
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closePanel);
    if (proceedBtn) proceedBtn.addEventListener('click', finalizeAddToCart);
  });
  window.ZGCatalog = { loadCatalog: loadCatalog, closePanel: closePanel, finalizeAddToCart: finalizeAddToCart };
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · CHECKOUT SAVED-ADDRESS PICKER — checkout-address.js   (v1)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Additive, self-contained. Loaded AFTER js/checkout.js on checkout.html.

   Best-practice flow chosen:
     • If the logged-in user has saved addresses, we show a picker ABOVE the
       address form and PRE-SELECT their default one, auto-filling the address
       fields (co-address / co-city / co-pincode). Nothing is assumed silently —
       the chosen address is shown as a selected card the user can change.
     • They can pick any other saved address, or choose "＋ Deliver to a new
       address", which clears the fields and reveals the manual form with a
       "Save this address for next time" checkbox.
     • For guests / no saved addresses, it does nothing (the normal form shows).
     • For all-digital carts (no shipping) checkout.js hides the address
       section — we detect that and don't inject the picker.

   It only reads/writes the existing fields and the `addresses` table, so it
   never interferes with checkout.js's own submit logic. create-cashfree-order.js
   remains the server-side source of truth.
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }

  var addresses = [];
  var currentUserId = null;
  var injected = false;

  // The .checkout-section that contains the shipping address field.
  function addressSection() {
    var addr = $('co-address');
    if (!addr) return null;
    return addr.closest ? addr.closest('.checkout-section') : null;
  }
  function sectionHidden(sec) {
    if (!sec) return true;
    return sec.style.display === 'none' || sec.offsetParent === null;
  }

  function fillFields(a) {
    var line = [a.line1, a.line2].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    if ($('co-address')) $('co-address').value = line;
    if ($('co-city')) $('co-city').value = a.city || '';
    if ($('co-pincode')) $('co-pincode').value = a.pincode || '';
    // Clear any prior validation error styling.
    ['co-address', 'co-city', 'co-pincode'].forEach(function (id) {
      var el = $(id); if (el) el.classList.remove('field-invalid');
    });
  }
  function clearFields() {
    if ($('co-address')) $('co-address').value = '';
    if ($('co-city')) $('co-city').value = '';
    if ($('co-pincode')) $('co-pincode').value = '';
  }

  function cardHtml(a) {
    var line = [a.line1, a.line2].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    return '<label class="zg-addr-card" data-addr-id="' + esc(a.id) + '" ' +
      'style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:10px;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;">' +
      '<input type="radio" name="zg-saved-addr" value="' + esc(a.id) + '" style="width:auto;margin-top:3px;accent-color:var(--gold-light);">' +
      '<div style="flex:1;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">' +
        '<div style="font-weight:700;">' + esc(a.label || 'Address') + (a.is_default ? ' <span style="color:var(--gold-light);font-weight:400;">· default</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div style="color:var(--grey);">' + esc(a.recipient_name || '') + (a.phone ? ' · ' + esc(a.phone) : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div>' + esc(line) + '</div>' +
        '<div style="color:var(--grey);">' + esc(a.city || '') + (a.pincode ? ' — ' + esc(a.pincode) : '') + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</label>';
  }

  function injectPicker() {
    if (injected) return;
    var sec = addressSection();
    if (!sec || sectionHidden(sec)) return;   // digital-only or no address on page
    injected = true;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.id = 'zg-addr-picker';
    wrap.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:18px;';
    wrap.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--gold-light);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;">DELIVER TO</div>' +
      addresses.map(cardHtml).join('') +
      // "new address" option
      '<label class="zg-addr-card" data-addr-id="__new__" ' +
        'style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:6px;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;">' +
        '<input type="radio" name="zg-saved-addr" value="__new__" style="width:auto;accent-color:var(--gold-light);">' +
        '<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;">＋ Deliver to a new address</div>' +
      '</label>';

    // Put the picker at the very top of the address section (after its <h3> if present).
    var heading = sec.querySelector('h3');
    if (heading && heading.nextSibling) sec.insertBefore(wrap, heading.nextSibling);
    else sec.insertBefore(wrap, sec.firstChild);

    // A "save this new address" checkbox shown only in new-address mode.
    var saveRow = document.createElement('div');
    saveRow.id = 'zg-save-addr-row';
    saveRow.style.cssText = 'display:none;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--grey);';
    saveRow.innerHTML = '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">' +
      '<input type="checkbox" id="zg-save-addr" style="width:auto;accent-color:var(--gold-light);"> Save this address for next time</label>';
    sec.appendChild(saveRow);

    // Wire selection.
    wrap.querySelectorAll('input[name="zg-saved-addr"]').forEach(function (radio) {
      radio.addEventListener('change', function () { onSelect(radio.value); });
    });

    // Highlight helper.
    function paint() {
      wrap.querySelectorAll('.zg-addr-card').forEach(function (c) {
        var on = c.querySelector('input').checked;
        c.style.borderColor = on ? 'var(--gold-light)' : '';
        c.style.background = on ? 'rgba(212,160,23,.06)' : '';
      });
    }
    wrap._paint = paint;

    // Pre-select the default (or first) saved address and auto-fill.
    var def = addresses.filter(function (a) { return a.is_default; })[0] || addresses[0];
    var defRadio = wrap.querySelector('input[value="' + (def ? def.id : '') + '"]');
    if (defRadio) { defRadio.checked = true; onSelect(def.id); }
  }

  function setNewMode(isNew) {
    var sec = addressSection();
    if (!sec) return;
    // Show/hide the manual address inputs' container rows. We don't remove
    // them (checkout.js reads them) — for a saved pick we just fill + dim.
    var saveRow = $('zg-save-addr-row');
    if (saveRow) saveRow.style.display = isNew ? 'block' : 'none';

    ['co-address', 'co-city', 'co-pincode'].forEach(function (id) {
      var el = $(id);
      if (!el) return;
      // In "saved" mode we keep fields filled but visually calm; still editable
      // so the user can tweak. In "new" mode they're empty and focused for entry.
      el.readOnly = false;
      el.style.opacity = '1';
    });
    if (isNew) {
      clearFields();
      var first = $('co-address'); if (first) first.focus();
    }
  }

  function onSelect(value) {
    var wrap = $('zg-addr-picker');
    if (wrap && wrap._paint) wrap._paint();
    if (value === '__new__') {
      setNewMode(true);
    } else {
      var a = addresses.filter(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(value); })[0];
      if (a) { fillFields(a); setNewMode(false); }
    }
  }

  // Best-effort save of a newly-typed address when the order is placed.
  function wireSaveOnPlace() {
    var placeBtn = $('place-order-btn');
    if (!placeBtn) return;
    placeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var saveChk = $('zg-save-addr');
      if (!saveChk || !saveChk.checked) return;
      var newRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="zg-saved-addr"][value="__new__"]');
      if (!newRadio || !newRadio.checked) return;   // only when actually entering new
      var line = ($('co-address') && $('co-address').value.trim()) || '';
      var city = ($('co-city') && $('co-city').value.trim()) || '';
      var pincode = ($('co-pincode') && $('co-pincode').value.trim()) || '';
      var name = ($('co-name') && $('co-name').value.trim()) || '';
      var phone = ($('co-phone') && $('co-phone').value.trim()) || '';
      if (!line || !pincode) return;
      // Fire-and-forget; if it fails the order still proceeds.
      window.ZGSupabase.from('addresses').insert({
        user_id: currentUserId,
        label: 'Saved at checkout',
        recipient_name: name,
        phone: phone,
        line1: line,
        line2: '',
        city: city || 'Bengaluru',
        pincode: pincode,
        is_default: addresses.length === 0,
      }).then(function () {}, function () {});
      saveChk.checked = false;   // avoid a duplicate save if they click twice
    });
  }

  function init() {
    if (!$('co-address')) return;                 // not the checkout page
    if (!window.ZGAuth || !window.ZGSupabase) return;
    window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
      if (!session) return;                       // guests use the plain form
      currentUserId = session.user.id;
      return window.ZGSupabase.from('addresses').select('*').eq('user_id', currentUserId)
        .order('is_default', { ascending: false });
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res || res.error || !res.data || !res.data.length) return;
      addresses = res.data;
      // Let checkout.js finish its own layout (it hides the address section for
      // digital-only carts inside updateTotals on ready), then inject.
      setTimeout(function () { injectPicker(); wireSaveOnPlace(); }, 350);
    }).catch(function () {});
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · CHECKOUT FORM VALIDATION — checkout-validation.js
   Replaces loose validation in checkout.js with strict field-by-field rules
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function isValidEmail(email) {
    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email.trim());
  }
  function isValidPhone(phone) {
    // Exactly 10 digits, starts with 6–9
    return /^[6-9][0-9]{9}$/.test(phone.replace(/\s/g,''));
  }
  function isValidPincode(pin) {
    // 6 digits exactly, Indian pincodes start with 1–9
    return /^[1-9][0-9]{5}$/.test(pin.trim());
  }
  function isValidName(name) {
    return name.trim().length >= 2 && !/^\d+$/.test(name.trim());
  }

  function setValid(inputEl, msgEl) {
    if (!inputEl) return;
    inputEl.classList.remove('field-invalid');
    inputEl.classList.add('field-valid');
    if (msgEl) { msgEl.textContent = ''; msgEl.style.display = 'none'; }
  }
  function setInvalid(inputEl, msgEl, msg) {
    if (!inputEl) return;
    inputEl.classList.remove('field-valid');
    inputEl.classList.add('field-invalid');
    if (msgEl) { msgEl.textContent = msg; msgEl.style.display = 'block'; }
    inputEl.focus();
  }

  // Ensure error spans exist next to each checkout field
  function ensureErrSpan(inputEl) {
    if (!inputEl) return null;
    var existing = inputEl.parentElement.querySelector('.co-err');
    if (existing) return existing;
    var span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'co-err';
    span.style.cssText = 'display:none;font-size:11px;color:#FF4D2E;margin-top:4px;display:block;';
    inputEl.parentNode.insertBefore(span, inputEl.nextSibling);
    return span;
  }

  function injectValidationCSS() {
    if (document.getElementById('co-validation-css')) return;
    var style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'co-validation-css';
    style.textContent = [
      'input.field-valid  { border-color: #39FF14 !important; }',
      'input.field-invalid { border-color: #FF4D2E !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,77,46,.15) !important; }',
      'textarea.field-invalid { border-color: #FF4D2E !important; }',
      '.co-err { font-size:11px; color:#FF4D2E; margin-top:5px; display:none; }',
      '.co-err.show { display:block !important; }',
    ].join('\n');
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  // Enforce input type restrictions live
  function enforceInputRestrictions() {
    var phoneEl   = document.getElementById('co-phone');
    var pincodeEl = document.getElementById('co-pincode');
    var nameEl    = document.getElementById('co-name');

    if (phoneEl) {
      phoneEl.setAttribute('type','tel');
      phoneEl.setAttribute('maxlength','10');
      phoneEl.setAttribute('inputmode','numeric');
      phoneEl.setAttribute('pattern','[0-9]{10}');

      phoneEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
        // Strip non-digits
        phoneEl.value = phoneEl.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,10);
      });
      phoneEl.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        var err = ensureErrSpan(phoneEl);
        var v = phoneEl.value.trim();
        if (!v) return; // leave for submit
        if (!isValidPhone(v)) {
          var msg = v.length !== 10 ? 'Must be exactly 10 digits' : 'Must start with 6, 7, 8, or 9';
          setInvalid(phoneEl, err, msg); err && err.classList.add('show');
        } else {
          setValid(phoneEl, err); err && err.classList.remove('show');
        }
      });
    }

    if (pincodeEl) {
      pincodeEl.setAttribute('type','tel');
      pincodeEl.setAttribute('maxlength','6');
      pincodeEl.setAttribute('inputmode','numeric');
      pincodeEl.setAttribute('pattern','[0-9]{6}');

      pincodeEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
        pincodeEl.value = pincodeEl.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,6);
      });
      pincodeEl.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        var err = ensureErrSpan(pincodeEl);
        var v = pincodeEl.value.trim();
        if (!v) return;
        if (!isValidPincode(v)) {
          setInvalid(pincodeEl, err, v.length !== 6 ? 'Must be 6 digits' : 'Enter a valid Indian pincode');
          err && err.classList.add('show');
        } else {
          setValid(pincodeEl, err); err && err.classList.remove('show');
        }
      });
    }

    var emailEl = document.getElementById('co-email');
    if (emailEl) {
      emailEl.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        var err = ensureErrSpan(emailEl);
        var v = emailEl.value.trim();
        if (!v) return;
        if (!isValidEmail(v)) {
          setInvalid(emailEl, err, 'Enter a valid email like you@example.com');
          err && err.classList.add('show');
        } else {
          setValid(emailEl, err); err && err.classList.remove('show');
        }
      });
    }

    var cityEl = document.getElementById('co-city');
    if (cityEl) {
      cityEl.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        var err = ensureErrSpan(cityEl);
        var v = cityEl.value.trim();
        if (!v) return;
        if (v.length < 2) {
          setInvalid(cityEl, err, 'City is too short');
          err && err.classList.add('show');
        } else {
          setValid(cityEl, err); err && err.classList.remove('show');
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // Full validation before submit — returns true if all pass
  window.ZGValidateCheckout = function() {
    var ok = true;

    // For digital-only carts the address section is hidden — skip address/pincode validation
    var addressEl = document.getElementById('co-address');
    var isDigitalOnly = addressEl && addressEl.closest && (
      (addressEl.closest('.checkout-section') && addressEl.closest('.checkout-section').style.display === 'none') ||
      (addressEl.offsetParent === null)
    );

    var fields = [
      { id:'co-name',    label:'Full Name',    test: isValidName,   msgs: { empty:'Please enter your name', invalid:'Name must be at least 2 characters' } },
      { id:'co-phone',   label:'Phone',        test: isValidPhone,  msgs: { empty:'Phone number is required', invalid:'Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number' } },
      { id:'co-email',   label:'Email',        test: isValidEmail,  msgs: { empty:'Email is required', invalid:'Enter a valid email like you@gmail.com' } },
      { id:'co-address', label:'Address',      test: function(v){ return v.trim().length >= 5; }, msgs: { empty:'Delivery address is required', invalid:'Address is too short' }, optional: isDigitalOnly },
      { id:'co-city',    label:'City',         test: function(v){ return v.trim().length >= 2; }, msgs: { empty:'City is required', invalid:'City is too short' }, optional: isDigitalOnly },
      { id:'co-pincode', label:'Pincode',      test: isValidPincode, msgs: { empty:'Pincode is required', invalid:'Enter a valid 6-digit pincode' }, optional: isDigitalOnly },
    ];

    // Scroll to first error helper
    var firstErrorEl = null;

    fields.forEach(function(f) {
      var inputEl = document.getElementById(f.id);
      if (!inputEl) return;
      if (f.optional && !inputEl.value.trim()) return; // skip optional if blank

      var err = ensureErrSpan(inputEl);
      var v = inputEl.value;

      if (!v || !v.trim()) {
        setInvalid(inputEl, err, f.msgs.empty);
        if (err) err.classList.add('show');
        if (!firstErrorEl) firstErrorEl = inputEl;
        ok = false;
      } else if (!f.test(v)) {
        setInvalid(inputEl, err, f.msgs.invalid);
        if (err) err.classList.add('show');
        if (!firstErrorEl) firstErrorEl = inputEl;
        ok = false;
      } else {
        setValid(inputEl, err);
        if (err) err.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

    if (firstErrorEl) {
      firstErrorEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    }

    return ok;
  };

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function() {
    if (!document.getElementById('co-phone')) return; // not checkout page
    injectValidationCSS();
    enforceInputRestrictions();

    // Pre-fill email if coming from studio
    try {
      var prefill = sessionStorage.getItem('zg_prefill_email');
      var emailEl = document.getElementById('co-email');
      if (prefill && emailEl && !emailEl.value) emailEl.value = prefill;
    } catch(e){}
  });

})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · CHECKOUT PINCODE ZONE CHIP — js/checkout-zone.js
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Additive, self-contained. Loaded AFTER js/checkout.js on checkout.html.

   Draws a live chip UNDER the pincode field showing the buyer's resolved
   delivery zone + fee + ETA the moment they type a valid 6-digit pincode.
   It reads the ONE resolver in js/delivery-zones.js, and asks checkout.js to
   recalc the order summary (window.ZGCheckout.recalc) whenever the pincode or
   the selected delivery option changes — so the number in the chip and the
   number in the totals are always the same one that the server will charge.

   It never computes a fee itself; it only presents what ZGDeliveryZones says.
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function selectedDeliveryType() {
    var el = document.querySelector('input[name="delivery"]:checked');
    return el ? el.value : 'standard';
  }

  function ensureChip() {
    var pin = $('co-pincode');
    if (!pin) return null;
    var chip = $('co-zone-chip');
    if (chip) return chip;
    chip = document.createElement('div');
    chip.id = 'co-zone-chip';
    chip.className = 'co-zone-chip';
    chip.style.display = 'none';
    // Place it right under the pincode field's group so it reads as belonging
    // to that input on every screen size.
    var group = pin.closest ? pin.closest('.field-group') : pin.parentNode;
    (group || pin.parentNode).appendChild(chip);
    return chip;
  }

  function render() {
    var pinEl = $('co-pincode');
    var chip = ensureChip();
    if (!pinEl || !chip || !window.ZGDeliveryZones) return;

    var raw = (pinEl.value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) { chip.style.display = 'none'; return; }

    var type = selectedDeliveryType();
    var res = window.ZGDeliveryZones.feeFor(type, raw);
    var z = res.zone;

    chip.className = 'co-zone-chip';

    // Not yet a valid pincode — stay quiet until they've typed 6 digits,
    // then show a clear "unknown" prompt (we never guess a fee).
    if (!z.valid) {
      var d = raw.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (d.length < 6) { chip.style.display = 'none'; return; }
      chip.classList.add('warn');
      chip.innerHTML = '📍 <strong>Unknown pincode.</strong> Please check it — we can\'t price delivery for this one.';
      chip.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }

    // Campus chosen but this pincode isn't in our campus states.
    if (!res.ok && res.reason === 'campus_not_available') {
      chip.classList.add('warn');
      chip.innerHTML = z.emoji + ' <strong>' + z.label + '</strong> — free campus delivery is only for Karnataka, Andhra, Telangana &amp; Tamil Nadu. Switch to Standard delivery for this pincode.';
      chip.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }

    // Normal case: show zone + fee (or Free for eligible campus) + ETA.
    var feeTxt = res.fee === 0
      ? 'Free <span class="cz-sub">(campus)</span>'
      : '₹' + res.fee;
    chip.classList.add('ok');
    chip.innerHTML =
      z.emoji + ' <strong>' + z.label + '</strong>' +
      '<span class="cz-dot">•</span> Delivery ' + feeTxt +
      '<span class="cz-dot">•</span> <span class="cz-sub">ETA ' + z.eta + '</span>';
    chip.style.display = 'block';
  }

  function recalc() {
    render();
    if (window.ZGCheckout && typeof window.ZGCheckout.recalc === 'function') {
      window.ZGCheckout.recalc();
    }
  }

  function wire() {
    var pinEl = $('co-pincode');
    if (!pinEl) return; // not the checkout page
    if (pinEl.dataset.zoneBound) return;
    pinEl.dataset.zoneBound = '1';

    pinEl.addEventListener('input', recalc);
    pinEl.addEventListener('blur', recalc);

    // Delivery option cards / radios can flip campus<->standard.
    document.querySelectorAll('.delivery-opt, input[name="delivery"]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function () { setTimeout(recalc, 0); });
      el.addEventListener('change', recalc);
    });

    // Draw once in case the pincode was pre-filled (saved address).
    render();
  }

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    // Give checkout.js + checkout-address.js a tick to lay out / prefill.
    setTimeout(wire, 400);
  });
})();

FILE: js\checkout.js

(function () {
  var FUNCTION_URL = '/.netlify/functions/create-cashfree-order';

  function money(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }
  function getPromo() {
    try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('zivogift_promo')) || null; } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function genOrderNumber() {
    var d = new Date();
    var pad = function(n){ return String(n).padStart(2,'0'); };
    return 'ZG' + String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2) + pad(d.getMonth()+1) + pad(d.getDate()) + Math.floor(10000 + Math.random()*90000);
  }

  function renderSummary() {
    var cart = window.ZGCart.getCart();
    var emptyEl = document.getElementById('checkout-empty');
    var formEl  = document.getElementById('checkout-form-area');
    if (!cart.length) {
      if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
      if (formEl)  formEl.style.display  = 'none';
      return;
    }
    var host = document.getElementById('summary-items');
    if (host) {
      host.innerHTML = cart.map(function(i){
        var optLine = (i.selectedOptions && Object.keys(i.selectedOptions).length)
          ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:2px;">' + Object.keys(i.selectedOptions).map(function(k){ var v=String(i.selectedOptions[k]); if(v.length>36)v=v.slice(0,36)+'\u2026'; return k+': '+v; }).join(' \u00b7 ') + (i.mediaUrl ? ' \u00b7 \uD83D\uDCF7 photo' : '') + '</div>'
          : '';
        return '<div class="summary-item"><span>' + i.name + ' × ' + i.qty +
          (i.recipientName ? ' (' + i.recipientName + ')' : '') + optLine + '</span>' +
          '<span>₹' + money(i.unitPrice * i.qty + (i.addonTotal||0)) + '</span></div>';
      }).join('');
    }
    updateTotals();
  }

  // Any cart line carrying the Premium Keepsake Box forces a flat Rs.150
  // delivery fee regardless of pincode zone, campus eligibility or quantity.
  var GIFT_BOX_DELIVERY_FEE = 150;
  function hasGiftBoxAddon() {
    return window.ZGCart.getCart().some(function (item) {
      return Array.isArray(item.addonIds) && item.addonIds.indexOf('addon_box') !== -1;
    });
  }

  function physicalKeepsakeCount() {
    return window.ZGCart.getCart().reduce(function(total, item) {
      return total + (String(item.productId || '').indexOf('note_') === 0 ? Number(item.qty || 1) : 0);
    }, 0);
  }

  function isAllDigitalCart() {
    var cart = window.ZGCart.getCart();
    if (!cart.length) return false;
    return cart.every(function(i){
      return i.productId && (i.productId.startsWith('digital_') || i.productId.startsWith('squad_') || i.productId.startsWith('pass_') || i.productId.startsWith('carepkg_'));
    });
  }

  function hasAnyDigitalCart() {
    var cart = window.ZGCart.getCart();
    return cart.some(function(i){
      return i.productId && (i.productId.startsWith('digital_') || i.productId.startsWith('squad_') || i.productId.startsWith('pass_') || i.productId.startsWith('carepkg_'));
    });
  }

  // Tracks whether the physical-cart delivery fee could actually be resolved
  // from the pincode. When false, Place Order is blocked (we never charge a
  // guessed fee). Read by the place-order handler below.
  var deliveryResolvable = true;

  // Resolve the physical delivery fee from the ONE zone resolver, keyed on the
  // selected option + destination pincode. Returns { known, fee, label }.
  function resolvePhysicalDelivery() {
    var el = document.querySelector('input[name="delivery"]:checked');
    var deliveryType = el ? el.value : 'standard';
    var pinEl = document.getElementById('co-pincode');
    var pincode = (pinEl && pinEl.value || '').trim();

    if (!window.ZGDeliveryZones) {
      // Module missing — fail safe to a resolvable standard fee rather than 0.
      return { known: true, fee: deliveryType === 'campus' ? 0 : 120, label: deliveryType === 'campus' ? 'Free' : '₹120' };
    }
    var r = window.ZGDeliveryZones.feeFor(deliveryType, pincode);
    if (r.ok) {
      return { known: true, fee: r.fee, label: r.fee === 0 ? 'Free' : '₹' + r.fee };
    }
    if (r.reason === 'campus_not_available') {
      return { known: false, fee: 0, label: 'Campus not available here' };
    }
    return { known: false, fee: 0, label: 'Enter pincode' };
  }

  function updateTotals() {
    var sub = window.ZGCart.cartSubtotal();
    var allDigital = isAllDigitalCart();
    var fee = 0;
    var deliveryRow;

    if (allDigital) {
      deliveryResolvable = true;
      deliveryRow = '<div class="cart-row" style="color:#4caf50"><span>Delivery</span><span>Free ✨ (digital)</span></div>';
    } else {
      var d = resolvePhysicalDelivery();
      deliveryResolvable = d.known;
      fee = d.known ? d.fee : 0;
      deliveryRow = '<div class="cart-row"><span>Delivery</span><span>' +
        (d.known ? (d.fee === 0 ? 'Free' : '₹' + d.fee) : '<span style="color:var(--coral)">' + d.label + '</span>') +
        '</span></div>';
    }

    var promo    = getPromo();
    var discount = promo ? promo.discount : 0;
    var FREE_DELIVERY_MIN_KEEPSAKES = 4;
    var keepsakeCount = physicalKeepsakeCount();
    var freeDeliveryEarned = !allDigital && keepsakeCount >= FREE_DELIVERY_MIN_KEEPSAKES;
    if (freeDeliveryEarned) {
      fee = 0;
      deliveryResolvable = true;
      deliveryRow = '<div class="cart-row" style="color:#4caf50"><span>Delivery</span><span>Free ✨ (4+ keepsakes)</span></div>';
    }
    // Gift-box delivery overrides zone pricing AND the 4+ keepsake waiver.
    var boxDelivery = !allDigital && hasGiftBoxAddon();
    if (boxDelivery) {
      fee = GIFT_BOX_DELIVERY_FEE;
      deliveryResolvable = true;
      freeDeliveryEarned = false;
      deliveryRow = '<div class="cart-row"><span>Delivery</span><span>₹' + money(fee) + '</span></div>' +
        '<div style="margin:6px 0 2px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.35);border-radius:10px;color:var(--cream);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;">' +
        '📦 A flat ₹150 delivery fee applies because your order includes the Premium Keepsake Box add-on. This replaces standard pincode-based and free-delivery pricing.' +
        '</div>';
    }
    var total    = Math.max(0, sub - discount) + fee;
    var totalsEl = document.getElementById('summary-totals');
    if (totalsEl) {
      totalsEl.innerHTML =
        '<div class="cart-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>₹' + money(sub) + '</span></div>' +
        (discount ? '<div class="cart-row" style="color:var(--gold-light)"><span>Promo (' + promo.code + ')</span><span>−₹' + money(discount) + '</span></div>' : '') +
        deliveryRow +
        (!allDigital ? '<div id="free-delivery-progress" style="margin:10px 0;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.35);border-radius:10px;color:var(--cream);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;">' +
          (freeDeliveryEarned ? '🎉 Free standard delivery unlocked with ' + keepsakeCount + ' occasion-date keepsakes.' : 'Add ' + (FREE_DELIVERY_MIN_KEEPSAKES - keepsakeCount) + ' more physical occasion-date keepsake' + ((FREE_DELIVERY_MIN_KEEPSAKES - keepsakeCount) === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' to unlock free standard delivery. Digital gifts and add-ons do not count toward the minimum of 4.') + '</div>' : '') +
        '<div class="cart-row total"><span>Total</span><span>₹' + money(total) +
          (!allDigital && !deliveryResolvable ? '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);"> + delivery</span>' : '') +
        '</span></div>';
    }
    // Hide physical delivery sections for digital-only carts
    var deliverySection = document.querySelector('.checkout-section:has(#co-address)') ||
      Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.checkout-section')).find(function(s){ return s.querySelector('#co-address'); });
    var deliveryOpts = document.querySelector('.checkout-section:has(.delivery-options)') ||
      Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.checkout-section')).find(function(s){ return s.querySelector('.delivery-options'); });
    if (deliverySection) deliverySection.style.display = allDigital ? 'none' : '';
    if (deliveryOpts)    deliveryOpts.style.display    = allDigital ? 'none' : '';

    // Sourcing / availability note — relevant only when a physical serial note
    // is in the cart. Digital-only carts are instant + free, so it's hidden.
    var sourcingNote = document.getElementById('checkout-sourcing-note');
    if (sourcingNote) sourcingNote.style.display = (!allDigital && sub > 0) ? 'block' : 'none';

    // Savings section
    var savingsEl = document.getElementById('savings-section');
    if (savingsEl && sub > 0) {
      var competitorMultiplier = 2.5;
      var competitorTotal = Math.round(sub * competitorMultiplier);
      var saved = competitorTotal - total;
      document.getElementById('savings-competitor-price').textContent = '₹' + money(competitorTotal);
      document.getElementById('savings-our-price').textContent = '₹' + money(total);
      document.getElementById('savings-amount').textContent = '₹' + money(saved) + ' 🎉';
      savingsEl.style.display = saved > 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
    }
    return total;
  }

  function selectDeliveryOpt(value) {
    window.ZGCart.setDeliveryType(value);
    document.querySelectorAll('.delivery-opt').forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.value === value);
    });
    updateTotals();
  }

  // ── DEMO SUCCESS SCREEN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function showDemoSuccess(orderNumber, cart, total, contactName) {
    var screen = document.getElementById('success-screen');
    if (!screen) return;

    // Check if any digital gifts need WhatsApp
    var digitalItems = cart.filter(function(i){
      return i.productId && (i.productId.startsWith('digital_') || i.productId.startsWith('squad_') || i.productId.startsWith('carepkg_'));
    });

    var digitalNote = '';
    if (digitalItems.length) {
      digitalNote = '<div style="background:rgba(212,160,23,.12);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 18px;margin:14px 0;text-align:left;">' +
        '<div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--gold-light);margin-bottom:8px;">📱 Digital gift scheduled</div>' +
        digitalItems.map(function(i){
          var when = i.scheduledSendAt ? new Date(i.scheduledSendAt).toLocaleString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',day:'numeric',month:'short'}) : 'Midnight';
          return '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#cfcbc2;">• ' + i.name + ' → ' + (i.recipientName||'Recipient') + ' at ' + when + (i.recipientPhone ? ' (WA: +'+i.recipientPhone+')' : '') + '</div>';
        }).join('') +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:8px;">⚡ In live mode, AiSensy sends this automatically at the scheduled time.</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }

    screen.innerHTML =
      '<div style="text-align:center;max-width:480px;padding:20px;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:64px;margin-bottom:16px;">🎉</div>' +
        '<div style="font-family:Bebas Neue,sans-serif;font-size:42px;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:8px;">ORDER PLACED!</div>' +
        '<div style="font-family:Space Mono,monospace;color:var(--gold-light);font-size:17px;margin-bottom:6px;">' + orderNumber + '</div>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:4px;">Hi ' + contactName + ', this is a <strong style="color:var(--yellow);">DEMO</strong> — no payment or email was processed.</p>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:16px;">Total would have been <strong style="color:var(--white);">₹' + money(total) + '</strong></p>' +
        digitalNote +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px;">' +
          '<a href="index.html" style="background:var(--coral);color:#fff;padding:12px 26px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;">← Back to Shop</a>' +
          '<a href="order-status.html?order_number=' + orderNumber + '&phone=9999999999" style="border:1.5px solid rgba(245,245,240,.3);color:var(--white);padding:12px 26px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;">Track Order</a>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    screen.style.display = 'flex';
    spawnConfetti();
  }

  function spawnConfetti() {
    var colors = ['#FF4D2E','#F5C842','#FFE135','#fff','#D4A017'];
    for (var i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      (function(i){
        setTimeout(function(){
          var el = document.createElement('div');
          el.className = 'confetti-piece';
          el.style.cssText = 'left:' + Math.random()*100 + 'vw;width:' + (6+Math.random()*8) + 'px;height:' + (6+Math.random()*8) + 'px;' +
            'background:' + colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)] + ';border-radius:' + (Math.random()>0.5?'50%':'2px') + ';' +
            'animation-duration:' + (2+Math.random()*2) + 's;animation-delay:' + Math.random()*0.5 + 's;opacity:1;';
          document.body.appendChild(el);
          setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 4000);
        }, i * 30);
      })(i);
    }
  }
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // ── DIGITAL GIFT VERIFICATION GATE ───────────────────────────────────────
  // Replaces the old per-order MSG91 OTP box. Verification now happens once
  // in My Account (js/account-phone-verify.js); this just checks the logged-
  // in user's profile status and either unlocks Place Order or points to
  // My Account. create-cashfree-order.js re-checks the same profile flag
  // server-side regardless of what this shows.
  var ZGDigitalVerifyGate = (function () {
    var isVerified = false;
    var accountProfile = null;
    var accountEmail = null;

    function digitsOnly(s) { return String(s || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); }

    function applyLockedFields() {
      var phoneEl = document.getElementById('co-phone');
      var emailEl = document.getElementById('co-email');
      var nameEl  = document.getElementById('co-name');
      var lockedNote = document.getElementById('co-locked-note');
      // Prefill the name from the account profile so a logged-in buyer isn't
      // asked to retype a name they already saved. Left EDITABLE — the buyer's
      // own name and the gift's "from" can legitimately differ — unlike phone
      // and email which are locked to the verified account values.
      if (nameEl && accountProfile && accountProfile.full_name && !nameEl.value) {
        nameEl.value = accountProfile.full_name;
      }
      if (phoneEl && accountProfile) {
        phoneEl.value = accountProfile.phone || '';
        phoneEl.readOnly = true;
        phoneEl.style.opacity = '0.7';
        phoneEl.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
      }
      if (emailEl && accountEmail) {
        emailEl.value = accountEmail;
        emailEl.readOnly = true;
        emailEl.style.opacity = '0.7';
        emailEl.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
      }
      if (lockedNote) lockedNote.style.display = 'block';
    }

    function renderGate() {
      var gate = document.getElementById('digital-verify-gate');
      var ok = document.getElementById('digital-verify-ok');
      // Mobile-only hint that sits right next to the phone field (CSS shows it
      // only on small screens). Toggled in lock-step with the main gate.
      var mHint = document.getElementById('co-phone-verify-hint');
      if (mHint) mHint.classList.toggle('show', !isVerified);
      if (!gate || !ok) return;
      gate.style.display = isVerified ? 'none' : 'block';
      ok.style.display = isVerified ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    // Called once on page load for a digital cart. Requires login (redirects
    // to login.html otherwise), then pulls phone/email/verification status
    // from the account and locks those fields against editing.
    function init() {
      if (!hasAnyDigitalCart()) return Promise.resolve();
      return window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
        if (!session) {
          window.location.href = 'login.html?redirect=checkout.html';
          return null;
        }
        accountEmail = session.user.email;
        // full_name added so the name field can be prefilled for digital carts.
        return window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('full_name, phone, phone_verified').eq('id', session.user.id).single();
      }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res) return; // redirected to login above
        accountProfile = res.data || {};
        isVerified = !!(accountProfile.phone_verified && digitsOnly(accountProfile.phone).length === 10);
        applyLockedFields();
        renderGate();
        updateTotals();
      });
    }

    return {
      init: init,
      isVerified: function () { return isVerified; },
    };
  })();
  window.ZGDigitalVerifyGate = ZGDigitalVerifyGate;
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  var placeBtn = document.getElementById('place-order-btn');
  if (placeBtn) {
    placeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var msg  = document.getElementById('checkout-msg');
      var btn  = placeBtn;
      msg.className = 'form-msg';

      var name    = document.getElementById('co-name').value.trim();
      var phone   = document.getElementById('co-phone').value.trim();
      var email   = document.getElementById('co-email').value.trim();
      var address = document.getElementById('co-address').value.trim();
      var city    = (document.getElementById('co-city').value||'').trim() || 'Bengaluru';
      var pincode = (document.getElementById('co-pincode').value||'').trim();
      var notes   = (document.getElementById('co-notes').value||'').trim();
      var delEl   = document.querySelector('input[name="delivery"]:checked');
      var deliveryType = delEl ? delEl.value : 'standard';

      // ── STRICT VALIDATION via ZGValidateCheckout ──────────────────
      if (window.ZGValidateCheckout && !window.ZGValidateCheckout()) {
        msg.textContent = 'Please fix the highlighted fields above.';
        msg.classList.add('show','error');
        return;
      }
      // Additional guard if validation script not loaded
      // Address is not required for digital-only carts (field is hidden)
      if (!name || !phone || !email || (!isAllDigitalCart() && !address)) {
        msg.textContent = 'Please fill in all required fields.';
        msg.classList.add('show','error');
        return;
      }

      // ── Delivery-zone guard for physical carts ───────────────────────────
      // Never let an order through with a guessed/blank delivery fee. Mirrors
      // exactly what create-cashfree-order.js will re-check on the server.
      if (!isAllDigitalCart() && window.ZGDeliveryZones) {
        var zres = window.ZGDeliveryZones.feeFor(deliveryType, pincode);
        if (!zres.ok) {
          if (zres.reason === 'campus_not_available') {
            msg.textContent = 'Free campus delivery is only for Karnataka, Andhra, Telangana & Tamil Nadu. Please choose Standard delivery for this pincode.';
          } else {
            msg.textContent = 'We couldn\'t determine a delivery fee for this pincode. Please check the pincode.';
          }
          msg.classList.add('show','error');
          var pinEl2 = document.getElementById('co-pincode');
          if (pinEl2) pinEl2.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          return;
        }
      }
      // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      // ── Account verification gate (client-side convenience check;
      // create-cashfree-order.js re-checks this server-side regardless) ────
      if (hasAnyDigitalCart()) {
        if (!window.ZGDigitalVerifyGate || !window.ZGDigitalVerifyGate.isVerified()) {
          msg.textContent = 'Please verify your mobile number in My Account before placing this order.';
          msg.classList.add('show','error');
          var gateEl = document.getElementById('digital-verify-gate');
          if (gateEl) gateEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          return;
        }
      }
      // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      var cart  = window.ZGCart.getCart();
      var promo = getPromo();

      // ── DEMO MODE: skip backend entirely ────────────────────────────────
      if (window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG && window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG.DEMO_MODE) {
        btn.disabled    = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Placing demo order…';
        var sub      = window.ZGCart.cartSubtotal();
        var fee      = 0;
        if (!isAllDigitalCart()) {
          if (window.ZGDeliveryZones) {
            var dz = window.ZGDeliveryZones.feeFor(deliveryType, pincode);
            fee = dz.ok ? dz.fee : 0;
          } else {
            fee = deliveryType === 'campus' ? 0 : 120;
          }
        }
        var discount = promo ? promo.discount : 0;
        var total    = Math.max(0, sub - discount) + fee;
        var orderNum = genOrderNumber();
        setTimeout(function(){
          window.ZGCart.clearCart();
          sessionStorage.removeItem('zivogift_promo');
          showDemoSuccess(orderNum, cart, total, name);
          btn.disabled    = false;
          btn.textContent = 'Pay & Place Order →';
        }, 1200);
        return;
      }
      // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      // Live mode — call Netlify function → Cashfree
      btn.disabled    = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Placing your order…';

      window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function(session){
        var headers = {'Content-Type':'application/json'};
        if (session) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + session.access_token;
        return fetch(FUNCTION_URL, {
          method: 'POST', headers: headers,
          body: JSON.stringify({
            cart: cart.map(function(i){
              return { productId:i.productId, qty:i.qty, recipientName:i.recipientName,
                recipientDob:i.recipientDob, recipientPhone:i.recipientPhone||null,
                recipientEmail:i.recipientEmail||null, deliveryMode:i.deliveryMode||null,
                scheduledSendAt:i.scheduledSendAt||null, message:i.message,
                selectedOptions:i.selectedOptions, addonIds:i.addonIds,
                // Group 2 fields
                giftType:i.giftType||null, mediaUrl:i.mediaUrl||null, mediaType:i.mediaType||null,
                personaKey:i.personaKey||null,
                contributorPhones:i.contributorPhones||[], contributorNames:i.contributorNames||[],
                // Group 3 fields
                isTimeCapsule:i.isTimeCapsule||false,
                conditionType:i.conditionType||'none',
                conditionLabel:i.conditionLabel||null,
                friendId:i.friendId||null };
            }),
            contact:  {name:name, phone:phone, email:email},
            delivery: {type:deliveryType, addressLine:address, city:city, pincode:pincode, notes:notes},
            promoCode: promo ? promo.code : null,
            ref: (function(){ try { return sessionStorage.getItem('zg_order_ref') || null; } catch(e){ return null; } })(),
            replyToken: (function(){ try { return sessionStorage.getItem('zg_reply_token') || null; } catch(e){ return null; } })(),
            repCode: (window.ZGReferral && window.ZGReferral.getRepCode()) || null,
          }),
        });
      }).then(function(res){
        return res.json().then(function(data){ if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error||'Order failed.'); return data; });
      }).then(function(data){
        window.ZGCart.clearCart();
        sessionStorage.removeItem('zivogift_promo');
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem('zg_reply_token'); } catch(e) {}
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem('zg_order_ref'); } catch(e) {}
        if (data.free){ window.location.href='order-status.html?order_number='+data.orderNumber+'&phone='+encodeURIComponent(phone); return; }
        if (!window.Cashfree) throw new Error('Cashfree SDK failed to load — check your connection.');
        window.Cashfree({mode:data.cashfreeEnv}).checkout({paymentSessionId:data.paymentSessionId, redirectTarget:'_self'});
      }).catch(function(e){
        msg.textContent = e.message;
        msg.classList.add('show','error');
        btn.disabled    = false;
        btn.textContent = 'Pay & Place Order →';
      });
    });
  }

  // Expose a recalc hook so js/checkout-zone.js can ask the summary to
  // refresh whenever the pincode or delivery option changes.
  window.ZGCheckout = { recalc: updateTotals };

  // ── PROMO CODE ENTRY (checkout order summary) ────────────────────────────
  // Mirrors the note-builder/cart-drawer promo: validates via the shared
  // ZGCart.checkPromoCode, stores the result under the same sessionStorage key
  // that create-cashfree-order.js already reads, then recalcs the totals.
  function wireCheckoutPromo() {
    var input = document.getElementById('co-promo-input');
    var btn   = document.getElementById('co-promo-apply');
    var msg   = document.getElementById('co-promo-msg');
    if (!input || !btn) return;

    function setMsg(text, kind) {
      if (!msg) return;
      msg.textContent = text || '';
      msg.style.display = text ? 'block' : 'none';
      msg.style.color = kind === 'ok' ? '#4ADE80' : (kind === 'err' ? '#FF6B57' : 'var(--grey)');
    }

    // Reflect an already-applied promo (e.g. entered in the cart drawer).
    var existing = getPromo();
    if (existing && existing.code) {
      input.value = existing.code;
      setMsg('✓ ' + existing.code + ' applied — ₹' + money(existing.discount) + ' off', 'ok');
    }

    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var code = (input.value || '').trim();
      if (!code) { setMsg('Enter a promo code first.', 'err'); return; }
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Checking…';
      Promise.resolve(window.ZGCart.checkPromoCode(code)).then(function (result) {
        if (result && result.code) {
          sessionStorage.setItem('zivogift_promo', JSON.stringify(result));
          setMsg('✓ ' + result.code + ' applied — ₹' + money(result.discount) + ' off', 'ok');
        } else {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('zivogift_promo');
          setMsg("That code didn't work — check it and try again.", 'err');
        }
        updateTotals();
      }).catch(function () {
        setMsg('Could not validate the code right now. Try again.', 'err');
      }).then(function () {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Apply';
      });
    });

    input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); btn.click(); }
    });
  }

  // When the cart changes anywhere (e.g. the buyer deletes a line from the
  // cart drawer while on this page), re-render the order summary + totals live.
  // Previously this only happened on a manual refresh, so the checkout total
  // stayed stale after a delete. ZGCart fires 'zg:cart-changed' on every
  // add / remove / clear.
  window.addEventListener('zg:cart-changed', function () { renderSummary(); });
  // Belt-and-braces: also catch cross-tab cart edits via the storage event.
  window.addEventListener('storage', function (e) {
    if (e && e.key === 'zivogift_cart_v1') renderSummary();
  });

  function ready(fn){ if (document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fn); else fn(); }
  ready(function(){
    renderSummary();
    wireCheckoutPromo();
    // For digital carts this redirects to login if needed, then locks
    // phone/email to the account's verified values. For physical-only
    // carts it resolves immediately and does nothing.
    ZGDigitalVerifyGate.init();
    selectDeliveryOpt(window.ZGCart.getDeliveryType());
    document.querySelectorAll('.delivery-opt').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var r = document.querySelector('input[name="delivery"][value="'+el.dataset.value+'"]');
        if (r) r.checked = true;
        selectDeliveryOpt(el.dataset.value);
      });
    });
    // Convenience prefill for logged-in users on physical-only carts (name
    // always; phone/email only if the gate above hasn't already locked
    // them, which it does for any cart containing a digital gift).
    if (!hasAnyDigitalCart()) {
      window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function(session){
        if (!session||!window.ZGSupabase) return;
        window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('full_name,phone').eq('id',session.user.id).single().then(function(res){
          if (res.data && res.data.full_name) document.getElementById('co-name').value = res.data.full_name;
          if (res.data && res.data.phone) document.getElementById('co-phone').value = res.data.phone;
        });
        if (session.user.email) document.getElementById('co-email').value = session.user.email;
      });
    }
  });
})();

// Classic script — the one piece of nav behavior that genuinely needs
// Supabase: swapping "Login" for "My Account" once we know someone's signed
// in. Cart drawer wiring lives in cart.js; everything else lives in ui.js.
(function () {
  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    var link = document.getElementById('nav-auth-link');
    if (!link || !window.ZGAuth) return;
    window.ZGAuth.getCurrentUser()
      .then(function (user) {
        if (user) {
          link.textContent = 'My Account';
          link.href = 'account.html';
          injectNavLogout(link);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        /* Supabase not configured/reachable yet — leave the default Login link, no harm done */
      });
  });

  // Put a clearly visible "Log Out" straight into the navbar whenever someone is
  // signed in. Previously logout lived only inside the account sidebar, which is
  // hard to find on mobile. Because #nav-links is the same list the hamburger
  // toggles, this makes logout reachable in BOTH desktop and mobile menus, on
  // every page — not just My Account.
  function injectNavLogout(authLink) {
    if (document.getElementById('nav-logout-link')) return;      // never duplicate
    var navList = document.getElementById('nav-links');
    if (!navList) return;

    var li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'nav-logout-li';

    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.id = 'nav-logout-link';
    a.href = '#';
    a.textContent = '\u21AA Log Out';
    a.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    a.style.color = 'var(--coral)';
    a.style.fontWeight = '600';

    a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      // Close the mobile menu if open, then sign out.
      navList.classList.remove('mobile-open');
      if (window.ZGAuth && window.ZGAuth.signOut) window.ZGAuth.signOut();
    });

    li.appendChild(a);

    // Place it right after the "My Account" link when possible, else append.
    var authLi = (authLink.closest ? authLink.closest('li') : authLink.parentNode);
    if (authLi && authLi.parentNode === navList) {
      navList.insertBefore(li, authLi.nextSibling);
    } else {
      navList.appendChild(li);
    }
  }
})();

// ── FEATURE #20: Campus Rep referral capture ────────────────────────────────
// Any page can be someone's entry point (zivogift.com/?rep=anna-vit), so this
// runs site-wide. Attribution is "last touch, 30 days" — sticks in localStorage
// so it survives across sessions until checkout, then checkout.js reads it.
(function captureRepReferral() {
  try {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var rep = params.get('rep');
    if (rep) {
      var record = { code: rep, expires: Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 };
      localStorage.setItem('zg_rep_ref', JSON.stringify(record));
    }
  } catch (e) { /* localStorage unavailable — attribution just won't persist, no harm */ }

  window.ZGReferral = {
    getRepCode: function () {
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem('zg_rep_ref');
        if (!raw) return null;
        var record = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (!record || !record.code || Date.now() > record.expires) return null;
        return record.code;
      } catch (e) { return null; }
    },
  };
})();
