/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · DELIVERY ZONES — js/delivery-zones.js   (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Origin = Bengaluru. The delivery fee is decided by the DESTINATION PINCODE
   (not by distance/km). This one module is used in THREE places so the fee a
   buyer SEES on checkout is always the fee that gets CHARGED:

     • js/checkout-zone.js  — live pincode -> zone -> fee chip under the field
     • js/checkout.js       — order-summary totals (browser + demo path)
     • netlify/functions/create-cashfree-order.js — server-side authority
       (it `require()`s THIS file, so there is genuinely one resolver).

   ZONE TABLE
   ┌────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────┬──────┐
   │ Local          │ Bengaluru (560 / 561 / 562)                  │ ₹55  │
   │ South regional │ Karnataka · Andhra · Telangana · Tamil Nadu  │ ₹85  │
   │ Rest of India  │ all other serviceable pincodes               │ ₹120 │
   │ Special/remote │ NE (78x/79x), J&K+Ladakh (180–194), A&N(744) │ ₹150 │
   └────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────┴──────┘

   Campus delivery = FREE, but restricted to the 4 south states (local/south).
   Standard delivery = open pan-India, priced by the zone above.
   Unknown / invalid pincode is NEVER guessed — it returns valid:false so the
   caller can block/prompt instead of charging a wrong fee.

   UMD wrapper: attaches to window.ZGDeliveryZones in the browser and exports
   the same object under Node (CommonJS) for the Netlify function.
   ============================================================================ */
(function (root, factory) {
  var api = factory();
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) { module.exports = api; }
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.ZGDeliveryZones = api; }
})(typeof self !== 'undefined' ? self : this, function () {
  'use strict';

  // Fee + presentation for each zone key. ETA is display-only.
  var ZONES = {
    local:   { key: 'local',   fee: 55,  label: 'Bengaluru · Local',        eta: '1–2 days',  emoji: '🏙️' },
    south:   { key: 'south',   fee: 85,  label: 'South India · Regional',   eta: '2–4 days',  emoji: '🌴' },
    rest:    { key: 'rest',    fee: 120, label: 'Rest of India',            eta: '4–7 days',  emoji: '🇮🇳' },
    special: { key: 'special', fee: 150, label: 'Remote / Special zone',    eta: '6–10 days', emoji: '🏔️' }
  };

  // Campus (free) is only offered where we run the campus network today.
  var CAMPUS_ZONES = { local: true, south: true };

  function digits(pin) {
    return String(pin == null ? '' : pin).replace(/\D/g, '');
  }

  // Returns { valid, zone, fee, label, eta, emoji, pincode }.
  // valid:false means "don't guess a fee — prompt the buyer".
  function resolveZone(pincodeRaw) {
    var pin = digits(pincodeRaw);

    // Must be a real 6-digit Indian PIN. Indian PINs never start with 0, and
    // the first digit maps to postal regions 1–8 (9 is not a civilian zone).
    if (pin.length !== 6 || /^[09]/.test(pin)) {
      return { valid: false, zone: 'unknown', fee: null, label: 'Enter a valid 6-digit pincode', eta: null, emoji: '📍', pincode: pin };
    }

    var p2 = parseInt(pin.slice(0, 2), 10); // first two digits
    var p3 = parseInt(pin.slice(0, 3), 10); // first three digits

    // ── Special / remote (checked FIRST so it wins over the broad rest-of-India
    //    bucket that would otherwise swallow these ranges). ──────────────────
    if (p2 === 78 || p2 === 79) return build('special', pin);   // North-East states
    if (p3 >= 180 && p3 <= 194) return build('special', pin);   // J&K + Ladakh
    if (p3 === 744)             return build('special', pin);   // Andaman & Nicobar

    // ── Local: Bengaluru city (and immediate 561/562 belt). ─────────────────
    if (p3 === 560 || p3 === 561 || p3 === 562) return build('local', pin);

    // ── South regional: KA (ex-Bengaluru) · AP · TG · TN. ───────────────────
    if (p3 >= 563 && p3 <= 591) return build('south', pin);     // Karnataka
    if (p3 >= 500 && p3 <= 509) return build('south', pin);     // Telangana
    if (p3 >= 515 && p3 <= 535) return build('south', pin);     // Andhra Pradesh
    if (p3 >= 600 && p3 <= 643) return build('south', pin);     // Tamil Nadu (incl. Puducherry belt)

    // ── Everything else that is a valid Indian PIN. ─────────────────────────
    return build('rest', pin);
  }

  function build(zoneKey, pin) {
    var z = ZONES[zoneKey];
    return {
      valid: true,
      zone: z.key,
      fee: z.fee,
      label: z.label,
      eta: z.eta,
      emoji: z.emoji,
      pincode: pin
    };
  }

  // True if a resolved zone key is eligible for FREE campus delivery.
  function isCampusEligible(zoneKey) {
    return !!CAMPUS_ZONES[zoneKey];
  }

  // Convenience: the fee to charge for a given delivery type + pincode.
  // Returns { ok, fee, reason, zone }. `ok:false` => block the order.
  //   deliveryType: 'campus' | 'standard'
  function feeFor(deliveryType, pincodeRaw) {
    var z = resolveZone(pincodeRaw);
    if (!z.valid) {
      return { ok: false, fee: null, reason: 'invalid_pincode', zone: z };
    }
    if (deliveryType === 'campus') {
      if (!isCampusEligible(z.zone)) {
        return { ok: false, fee: null, reason: 'campus_not_available', zone: z };
      }
      return { ok: true, fee: 0, reason: null, zone: z };
    }
    // standard (or anything non-campus) -> zone fee
    return { ok: true, fee: z.fee, reason: null, zone: z };
  }

  return {
    ZONES: ZONES,
    resolveZone: resolveZone,
    isCampusEligible: isCampusEligible,
    feeFor: feeFor
  };
});

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · FRAMES NAV SHIM — frames-nav.js
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Additive, self-contained. Add ONE line on index.html, just before </body>:
       <script src="js/frames-nav.js"></script>
   (place it AFTER js/catalog.js so it wins).

   What it does: makes any "Personalise / add" button on a FRAME product card
   (the #portrait-frames section) open the dedicated detail page
   frames.html?id=<product_id> instead of the old in-page personalise panel.

   It works by intercepting the click in the CAPTURE phase (before catalog.js's
   own bubble-phase handler runs), so it reliably overrides the panel without
   editing catalog.js. Any product id that starts with "frame_" is routed to the
   detail page; everything else (notes, kits, digital, squad) is left untouched.
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function frameIdFrom(el) {
    var node = el.closest ? el.closest('[data-open],[data-product],[data-save]') : null;
    if (!node) return null;
    var id = node.getAttribute('data-open') || node.getAttribute('data-product');
    if (id && id.indexOf('frame_') === 0) return id;
    return null;
  }

  // Capture-phase: runs before the button's own click handler, so we can cancel
  // the panel and navigate instead.
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var target = e.target;
    if (!target || !target.closest) return;
    // Only act inside the frames section (or on an explicit frame button).
    var inFrames = target.closest('#portrait-frames, #frames-grid');
    var id = frameIdFrom(target);
    if (!id) return;
    if (!inFrames) {
      // A frame button could exist elsewhere; still route it, but only if it's
      // clearly a frame add/personalise control (has data-open).
      var btn = target.closest('[data-open]');
      if (!btn || (btn.getAttribute('data-open') || '').indexOf('frame_') !== 0) return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.location.href = 'frames.html?id=' + encodeURIComponent(id);
  }, true);
})();

  function qp(k) { try { return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }

    return typeof d === 'number' ? d : 0;
  }
  function currentUnitPrice() {

    if (cfg.creationDelta && cfg.fields.indexOf('creation') >= 0 && state.creation === 'Handmade') p += cfg.creationDelta;
    p += currentSizeDelta();

  }

    return p + minSize;

  // ── Live price sync (optional) — reflects /admin edits without a redeploy ──
  function syncLivePricing() {

        if (r.active === false) cfg.__inactive = true;

      '<div class="fd-grid">' +
        '<div class="fd-media">' +
          '<div class="fd-hero"><img id="fd-hero-img" src="' + esc(cfg.samples[0]) + '" alt="' + esc(cfg.name) + '"></div>' +

        '</div>' +
        '<div class="fd-info">' +
          '<a href="index.html#portrait-frames" class="fd-back">\u2190 All frames</a>' +
          '<h1 class="fd-title">' + esc(cfg.name) + '</h1>' +
          '<p class="fd-tagline">' + esc(cfg.tagline) + '</p>' +
          '<div class="fd-trust-row">' + trust + '</div>' +
          '<div class="fd-price">' +
            '<span class="fd-strike">\u20b9' + money(cfg.compareAt) + '</span> ' +
            '<span class="fd-now" id="fd-price-now">\u20b9' + money(currentUnitPrice()) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="fd-config" id="fd-config-line"></span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="fd-how"><h3>How it works</h3><ol>' + how + '</ol></div>' +
          '<div class="fd-form"><h3>Make it yours</h3>' + fields +
            '<div id="fd-err" class="fd-err"></div>' +
            '<button id="fd-add" class="fd-add" type="button">Add to Cart \uD83D\uDED2 \u00b7 \u20b9<span id="fd-add-price">' + money(currentUnitPrice()) + '</span></button>' +
            '<p class="fhint">Physical keepsake \u00b7 delivery calculated at checkout by pincode \u00b7 full refund if we can\u2019t craft it.</p>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    // gallery
    main.querySelectorAll('.thumb').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        main.querySelectorAll('.thumb').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('active'); });
        b.classList.add('active');
        $('fd-hero-img').src = b.dataset.src;
      });
    });
    // creation-type price updates
    main.querySelectorAll('input[name="f-creation"]').forEach(function (r) {
      r.addEventListener('change', function () { state.creation = r.value; refreshPrice(); });
    });
    // size price updates
    var sizeEl = $('f-size');
    if (sizeEl) sizeEl.addEventListener('change', refreshPrice);
    // photo status
    var photo = $('f-photo');
    if (photo) photo.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var st = $('f-photo-status');
      var f = photo.files && photo.files[0];
      if (!f) return;
      if (f.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { st.className = 'fhint err'; st.textContent = 'That photo is over 10 MB \u2014 please pick a smaller one.'; }
      else { st.className = 'fhint ok'; st.textContent = '\u2713 ' + f.name + ' ready.'; }
    });
    $('fd-add').addEventListener('click', onAdd);
    refreshPrice();
  }

  function refreshPrice() {
    var p = currentUnitPrice();
    if ($('fd-price-now')) $('fd-price-now').textContent = '\u20b9' + money(p);
    if ($('fd-add-price')) $('fd-add-price').textContent = money(p);
    var bits = [];
    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('creation') >= 0) bits.push(state.creation);
    var sizeEl = $('f-size'); if (sizeEl) bits.push(sizeEl.value.replace(/\s*\(.*\)$/, ''));
    if ($('fd-config-line')) $('fd-config-line').textContent = bits.length ? '(' + bits.join(' \u00b7 ') + ')' : '';
  }

  function showErr(msg) { var e = $('fd-err'); if (e) { e.textContent = msg; e.style.display = 'block'; e.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }); } }
  function clearErr() { var e = $('fd-err'); if (e) { e.textContent = ''; e.style.display = 'none'; } }

  function uploadPhoto(file) {
    var ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase();
    if (['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'].indexOf(ext) < 0) ext = 'jpg';
    return fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: ext, order_id: 'tmp-' + Date.now() })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d.upload_url) throw new Error('no url');
      return fetch(d.upload_url, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': d.content_type }, body: file })
        .then(function (put) { if (!put.ok) throw new Error('put'); return d.public_url; });
    });
  }

  // ── Collect + validate, then add to cart ───────────────────────────────────
  function onAdd() {
    clearErr();
    var opts = {};
    var rec = $('f-recipient');
    if (!rec || !rec.value.trim()) return showErr('Please tell us who this gift is for.');
    var recipientName = rec.value.trim();

    // Frame Size — value string is byte-identical to the option_pricing key.
    if ($('f-size')) opts['Frame Size'] = $('f-size').value;
    if ($('f-language')) opts['Language'] = $('f-language').value;

    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('creation') >= 0) {
      var cr = document.querySelector('input[name="f-creation"]:checked');
      opts['Creation Type'] = cr ? cr.value : 'Handmade';
    }
    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('words') >= 0) {
      var w = $('f-words'); if (!w || !w.value.trim()) return showErr('Add the words we should fill the portrait with.');
      opts['Custom Words'] = w.value.trim();
    }
    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('name') >= 0) {
      var nm = $('f-name'); if (!nm || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(nm.value)) return showErr('Enter the name to spell (letters only).');
      opts['Name'] = nm.value.trim();
    }
    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('borndate') >= 0) {
      var bd = $('f-borndate'); if (!bd || !bd.value) return showErr('Please pick their birth date.');
      opts['Birth Date'] = bd.value;
    }
    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('eventdate') >= 0) {
      var ed = $('f-eventdate'); if (!ed || !ed.value) return showErr('Please pick the date of the moment.');
      opts['Event Date'] = ed.value;
      if ($('f-eventtime') && $('f-eventtime').value) opts['Time'] = $('f-eventtime').value;
    }
    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('location') >= 0) {
      var lo = $('f-location'); if (!lo || !lo.value.trim()) return showErr('Please enter the place / city.');
      opts['Location'] = lo.value.trim();
    }
    if ($('f-occasion') && $('f-occasion').value.trim()) opts['Occasion'] = $('f-occasion').value.trim();

    var message = $('f-message') ? $('f-message').value.trim() : '';
    var unitPrice = currentUnitPrice();

    function commit(mediaUrl) {
      window.ZGCart.addToCart({
        productId: productId, name: cfg.name, emoji: cfg.emoji, unitPrice: unitPrice, qty: 1,
        recipientName: recipientName, recipientDob: '', message: message,
        selectedOptions: opts, addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
        mediaUrl: mediaUrl || null, mediaType: mediaUrl ? 'image' : null
      });
      success();
    }

    if (cfg.fields.indexOf('photo') >= 0) {
      var pf = $('f-photo'), file = pf && pf.files && pf.files[0];
      if (!file) return showErr('Please upload one photo.');
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) return showErr('That photo is over 10 MB \u2014 please pick a smaller one.');
      var btn = $('fd-add'); btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Uploading photo\u2026';
      uploadPhoto(file).then(commit).catch(function () {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = 'Add to Cart \uD83D\uDED2 \u00b7 \u20b9<span id="fd-add-price">' + money(unitPrice) + '</span>';
        showErr('Photo upload failed \u2014 please try again.');
      });
    } else {
      commit(null);
    }
  }

  function success() {
    var ov = $('fd-success');
    if (ov) ov.classList.add('show');
    if (window.ZGCart && window.ZGCart.updateCartBadge) window.ZGCart.updateCartBadge();
  }

  // ── Boot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function boot() {
    if (!productId || !cfg) {
      $('frame-detail').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:80px 20px;"><h1>Frame not found</h1><p style="color:var(--grey,#9C9890);">This gift may have moved. <a href="index.html#portrait-frames" style="color:var(--gold-light,#F5C842);">See all frames \u2192</a></p></div>';
      return;
    }
    syncLivePricing().then(function () {
      if (cfg.__inactive) {
        $('frame-detail').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:80px 20px;">' +
          '<h1>Currently unavailable</h1>' +
          '<p style="color:var(--grey,#9C9890);">This keepsake isn\'t available right now. ' +
          '<a href="index.html#portrait-frames" style="color:var(--gold-light,#F5C842);">See all frames \u2192</a></p>' +
          '</div>';
        document.title = 'Currently unavailable \u00b7 Zivogift';
        return;
      }
      render();
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot); else boot();
})();

// ============================================================================
// ZIVOGIFT — memories.js  (Run 1: Memory Vault)
// Renders the logged-in user's sent + received gifts as a timeline.
// ============================================================================
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);

  async function getAccessToken() {
    try {
      const client = window.sb || window.supabaseClient || window.supabase;
      if (client && client.auth && client.auth.getSession) {
        const { data } = await client.auth.getSession();
        return data && data.session ? data.session.access_token : null;
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return null;
  }

  function fmtDate(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '';
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d)) return '';
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
  }
  function fmtDelay(seconds) {
    if (seconds == null) return '';
    if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
    const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    if (m < 60) return `${m}m ${seconds % 60}s`;
    const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
    return `${h}h ${m % 60}m`;
  }

  const GIFT_EMOJI = {
    birthday_note: '🎂', meme_card: '😂', midnight_drop: '🌙', hype_reel: '🔥',
    farewell_note: '🎓', love_note: '💌', character_drop: '🎭', squad_drop: '👥',
    roast_certificate: '📜', horoscope_drop: '🔮', exam_survival_kit: '📚',
    digital_scrapbook: '📖', standard: '🎁',
  };
  function giftEmoji(t) { return GIFT_EMOJI[t] || '🎁'; }

  function statusPill(g) {
    if (g.is_time_capsule && g.status !== 'sent') return '<span class="mv-pill mv-pill--capsule">⏳ Sealed</span>';
    if (g.opened_at) return '<span class="mv-pill mv-pill--opened">❤️ Opened</span>';
    if (g.status === 'sent') return '<span class="mv-pill mv-pill--sent">✅ Delivered</span>';
    if (g.status === 'pending') return '<span class="mv-pill mv-pill--pending">🕒 Scheduled</span>';
    if (g.status === 'failed') return '<span class="mv-pill mv-pill--failed">⚠️ Failed</span>';
    return `<span class="mv-pill">${g.status || ''}</span>`;
  }

  function sentCard(g) {
    const img = g.teaser_image_url || g.card_image_url;
    const analytics = [];
    if (g.open_delay_seconds != null) analytics.push(`opened after ${fmtDelay(g.open_delay_seconds)}`);
    if (g.reaction) analytics.push(`reacted ${g.reaction}`);
    if (g.reaction_count) analytics.push(`${g.reaction_count} squad reaction${g.reaction_count > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
    const link = g.gift_url ? `<a class="mv-open" href="${g.gift_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Re-open ↗</a>` : '';
    return `
      <article class="mv-card">
        <div class="mv-thumb">${img ? `<img src="${img}" alt="" loading="lazy">` : `<span class="mv-emoji">${giftEmoji(g.gift_type)}</span>`}</div>
        <div class="mv-body">
          <div class="mv-line1"><strong>To ${g.recipient_name || 'a friend'}</strong> ${statusPill(g)}</div>
          <div class="mv-line2">${giftEmoji(g.gift_type)} ${g.occasion || 'Gift'} · ${fmtDate(g.created_at)}</div>
          ${analytics.length ? `<div class="mv-analytics">${analytics.join(' · ')}</div>` : ''}
          ${link}
        </div>
      </article>`;
  }

  function receivedCard(g) {
    const img = g.card_image_url;
    const from = g.sender_name ? `From ${g.sender_name}` : 'From a secret admirer';
    const link = g.gift_url ? `<a class="mv-open" href="${g.gift_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open again ↗</a>` : '';
    return `
      <article class="mv-card">
        <div class="mv-thumb">${img ? `<img src="${img}" alt="" loading="lazy">` : `<span class="mv-emoji">${giftEmoji(g.gift_type)}</span>`}</div>
        <div class="mv-body">
          <div class="mv-line1"><strong>${from}</strong> ${statusPill(g)}</div>
          <div class="mv-line2">${giftEmoji(g.gift_type)} ${g.occasion || 'Gift'} · ${fmtDate(g.sent_at)}</div>
          ${link}
        </div>
      </article>`;
  }

  function renderEmpty(container, message) { container.innerHTML = `<div class="mv-empty">${message}</div>`; }

  async function load() {
    const sentWrap = $('#mv-sent');
    const recvWrap = $('#mv-received');
    const countEl  = $('#mv-counts');
    if (!sentWrap || !recvWrap) return;

    const token = await getAccessToken();
    if (!token) {
      renderEmpty(sentWrap, 'Please <a href="login.html?redirect=memories.html">log in</a> to see your memories.');
      recvWrap.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-my-memories', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('load_failed');
      const data = await res.json();
      const sent = data.sent || [];
      const recv = data.received || [];
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${sent.length} sent · ${recv.length} received`;
      sentWrap.innerHTML = sent.length ? sent.map(sentCard).join('')
        : '<div class="mv-empty">No gifts sent yet. <a href="digital-studio.html">Create your first ✨</a></div>';
      recvWrap.innerHTML = recv.length ? recv.map(receivedCard).join('')
        : '<div class="mv-empty">Nothing received yet — share your Zivogift number with friends. 🎁</div>';
    } catch (e) {
      renderEmpty(sentWrap, 'Could not load your memories right now. Please refresh.');
      recvWrap.innerHTML = '';
    }
  }

  function wireTabs() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.mv-tab').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.mv-tab').forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('is-active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.mv-panel').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('is-active'));
        btn.classList.add('is-active');
        const panel = document.querySelector(btn.dataset.target);
        if (panel) panel.classList.add('is-active');
      });
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { wireTabs(); load(); });
})();

// Classic script — guest order tracking page.
(function () {
  var STATUS_FLOW = ['paid', 'processing', 'packed', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered'];
  var STATUS_COPY = {
    pending_payment: 'Waiting for payment',
    payment_failed: 'Payment failed — please try again or contact us',
    paid: 'Order confirmed',
    processing: "We're crafting your gift",
    packed: 'Packed and ready',
    out_for_delivery: 'Out for delivery',
    delivered: 'Delivered',
    cancelled: 'Order cancelled',
    refunded: 'Order refunded',
  };

  function money(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN'); }

  function renderOrder(order, items) {
    document.getElementById('lookup-form').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('order-result').style.display = 'block';

    var itemsHtml = items.map(function (i) {
      return '<div class="summary-item"><span>' + i.name_snapshot + ' × ' + i.qty + (i.recipient_name ? ' — for ' + i.recipient_name : '') + '</span><span>₹' + money(i.line_total) + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');

    var isTerminalBad = ['cancelled', 'payment_failed', 'refunded'].indexOf(order.status) !== -1;
    var currentIdx = STATUS_FLOW.indexOf(order.status);

    var timelineHtml = isTerminalBad
      ? '<div class="timeline-step"><span class="timeline-dot" style="background:var(--coral);"></span>' + STATUS_COPY[order.status] + '</div>'
      : STATUS_FLOW.map(function (s, i) {
          return '<div class="timeline-step" style="opacity:' + (i <= currentIdx ? 1 : 0.4) + ';">' +
            '<span class="timeline-dot" style="background:' + (i <= currentIdx ? 'var(--gold-light)' : '#444') + ';"></span>' +
            STATUS_COPY[s] +
          '</div>';
        }).join('');

    document.getElementById('order-result').innerHTML =
      '<div class="card-panel">' +
        '<div class="order-card-top">' +
          '<div><div class="order-num">' + order.order_number + '</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:4px;">Placed ' + new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) + '</div></div>' +
          '<span class="status-pill ' + order.status + '">' + order.status.replace(/_/g, ' ') + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="margin:18px 0;">' + itemsHtml + '</div>' +
        '<div class="cart-row total"><span>Total</span><span>₹' + money(order.total) + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="timeline">' + timelineHtml + '</div>' +
        '<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:16px;">Delivering to: ' + order.address_line + ', ' + order.city + ' ' + (order.pincode || '') + '</p>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  // Shown immediately on return from the payment gateway, while we wait for
  // the Cashfree webhook to confirm. Deliberately does NOT say "waiting for
  // payment" -- from the customer's point of view they have already paid.
  function showConfirmingState() {
    var form = document.getElementById('lookup-form');
    var result = document.getElementById('order-result');
    if (form) form.style.display = 'none';
    if (!result) return;
    result.style.display = 'block';
    result.innerHTML =
      '<div class="card-panel" style="text-align:center;padding:42px 24px;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:42px;margin-bottom:14px;">\uD83D\uDD04</div>' +
        '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:10px;">CONFIRMING YOUR PAYMENT</div>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:14px;line-height:22px;max-width:360px;margin:0 auto;">' +
          'This usually takes just a few seconds. Please do not close this page or press back.' +
        '</p>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  // The webhook still has not landed after the full wait. The order is almost
  // certainly fine -- so say so honestly, and give them something to do other
  // than worry.
  function showSlowConfirmState(orderNumber) {
    var result = document.getElementById('order-result');
    if (!result) return;
    result.innerHTML =
      '<div class="card-panel" style="text-align:center;padding:38px 24px;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:14px;">\u23F3</div>' +
        '<div style="font-family:\'Bebas Neue\',sans-serif;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:10px;">PAYMENT IS TAKING A MOMENT TO CONFIRM</div>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:14px;line-height:22px;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto 8px;">' +
          'If the amount has left your account, your order <strong style="color:var(--white);">is safe</strong> &mdash; ' +
          'confirmation can occasionally lag by a few minutes. You will get an email as soon as it clears.' +
        '</p>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--grey);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:20px;">Order ' +
          '<span style="font-family:monospace;color:var(--gold-light);">' + orderNumber + '</span></p>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
          '<button class="btn-coral" id="os-recheck" style="padding:11px 24px;font-size:13px;">Check again</button>' +
          '<a href="contact.html" style="border:1.5px solid rgba(245,245,240,.3);color:var(--white);padding:11px 24px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;">Contact us</a>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    var btn = document.getElementById('os-recheck');
    if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function () { window.location.reload(); });
  }

  function lookupOrder(orderNumber, phone) {
    var msg = document.getElementById('lookup-msg');
    msg.className = 'form-msg';
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) {
      msg.textContent = 'Order tracking isn\'t connected yet — this needs Supabase configured in js/config.js.';
      msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
      return;
    }
    window.ZGSupabase.rpc('track_order', { p_order_number: orderNumber, p_phone: phone }).then(function (res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data) {
        msg.textContent = "We couldn't find an order with that number and phone combination.";
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
        return;
      }
      renderOrder(res.data.order, res.data.items);
    });
  }

  var lookupBtn = document.getElementById('lookup-btn');
  if (lookupBtn) {
    lookupBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var orderNumber = document.getElementById('lookup-order-number').value.trim().toUpperCase();
      var phone = document.getElementById('lookup-phone').value.trim();
      if (!orderNumber || !phone) {
        var msg = document.getElementById('lookup-msg');
        msg.textContent = 'Enter both your order number and phone number.';
        msg.className = 'form-msg show error';
        return;
      }
      lookupOrder(orderNumber, phone);
    });
  }

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var qOrderNumber = params.get('order_number');
    var qPhone = params.get('phone');
    if (qOrderNumber && qPhone && window.ZGSupabase) {
      document.getElementById('lookup-order-number').value = qOrderNumber;
      document.getElementById('lookup-phone').value = qPhone;

      // ── POST-PAYMENT CONFIRMATION WAIT ─────────────────────────────────
      // This is the screen a customer lands on the instant they finish paying
      // at Cashfree. The order only flips out of 'pending_payment' when the
      // Cashfree webhook reaches cashfree-webhook.js, which is a separate
      // server-to-server call that can lag the browser redirect by a few
      // seconds -- occasionally longer under load.
      //
      // The old behaviour polled 8 times at 2s = 16 seconds, then rendered
      // whatever it had. So a customer whose money had left their account
      // could be shown a page that said "Waiting for payment" with no
      // explanation -- the single most alarming thing an e-commerce site can
      // tell someone who has just paid.
      //
      // Two changes:
      //   1. A real interim state, so the wait is explained instead of looking
      //      like a failure.
      //   2. A longer window (40 x 2s = 80s), and if it STILL has not
      //      confirmed, reassuring copy plus a manual refresh -- never a bare
      //      "Waiting for payment".
      showConfirmingState();

      var attempts = 0;
      var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 40;   // 40 x 2s = 80 seconds
      var poll = setInterval(function () {
        attempts++;
        window.ZGSupabase.rpc('track_order', { p_order_number: qOrderNumber, p_phone: qPhone }).then(function (res) {
          if (res.data && res.data.order.status !== 'pending_payment') {
            clearInterval(poll);
            renderOrder(res.data.order, res.data.items);
          } else if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
            clearInterval(poll);
            if (res.data && res.data.order.status === 'pending_payment') {
              showSlowConfirmState(qOrderNumber);
            } else if (res.data) {
              renderOrder(res.data.order, res.data.items);
            }
          }
        }).catch(function () {
          // A transient network error must not end the wait early.
          if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) clearInterval(poll);
        });
      }, 2000);
    } else if (qOrderNumber) {
      document.getElementById('lookup-order-number').value = qOrderNumber;
    }
  });
})();

// Classic script — reset-password.html.
// The person arrives here from the link in Supabase's password-reset
// email. supabase-js v2 automatically reads the recovery token out of the
// URL hash on page load (detectSessionInUrl, on by default) and turns it
// into a real session — no code needed here for that part. This script
// just checks that a session actually showed up, and if so, submits the
// new password via auth.updateUser().
(function () {
  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  ready(function () {
    var msg = document.getElementById('reset-msg');
    var form = document.getElementById('reset-form');
    var btn = document.getElementById('reset-submit-btn');

    if (!window.ZGSupabase) {
      msg.textContent = 'Accounts aren\'t connected yet — this needs Supabase configured in js/config.js.';
      msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
      form.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    // Give supabase-js a moment to parse the URL hash and establish the
    // recovery session before checking for it.
    window.ZGSupabase.auth.getSession().then(function (res) {
      var session = res.data && res.data.session;
      if (!session) {
        msg.textContent = 'This reset link is invalid or has expired. Go back and request a new one.';
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
        form.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      msg.className = 'form-msg';
      var pw1 = document.getElementById('reset-password').value;
      var pw2 = document.getElementById('reset-password-confirm').value;

      if (pw1.length < 6) {
        msg.textContent = 'Password must be at least 6 characters.';
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
        return;
      }
      if (pw1 !== pw2) {
        msg.textContent = 'Passwords don\'t match.';
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
        return;
      }

      btn.disabled = true;
      window.ZGSupabase.auth.updateUser({ password: pw1 }).then(function (res) {
        if (res.error) throw res.error;
        msg.textContent = 'Password updated! Taking you to log in…';
        msg.classList.add('show', 'success');
        form.style.display = 'none';
        setTimeout(function () { window.location.href = 'login.html'; }, 1800);
      }).catch(function (err) {
        msg.textContent = err.message;
        msg.classList.add('show', 'error');
      }).finally(function () {
        btn.disabled = false;
      });
    });
  });
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · REVEAL PLUS — reveal-plus.js   (v3 — wired)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Additive polish for gift.html. It observes the SAME DOM the reveal drives and
   layers on: a confetti/foil burst when the keepsake arrives, a sticky-note meme
   layer around the message for the fun gift types, and 3D pointer tilt on the
   sealed envelope.

   FIX vs v2: v2 DEFINED burst() and spawnFunLayer() but NEVER CALLED EITHER —
   ready() only wired the envelope tilt, so the flair was dead code. v3 fires
   them off the real reveal milestones via a MutationObserver on classes
   gift.html already toggles (#act-message.show, #keepsake.show). No edit to
   gift.html is required. All effects are a no-op under prefers-reduced-motion.
   ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var REDUCED = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }
  function accent() {
    var v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent').trim();
    return v || '#FFE135';
  }
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

  var FUN_INTROS = {
    'Certified unserious':   ['😂', '💀', '🔥', '😭', '👌', '🤡', '📸'],
    'The verdict is in':     ['📜', '😂', '🔥', '⚖️', '💀'],
    'Now go get it':         ['🔥', '⚡', '💪', '🚀', '✨'],
    'Your squad showed up':  ['👥', '🎉', '🔥', '✨', '❤️']
  };
  var STICKY_CAPTIONS = {
    'Certified unserious':   ['lol', 'iconic', 'no cap', 'fr fr', '💯', 'unserious', 'sending this', 'crying 😭'],
    'The verdict is in':     ['guilty', 'certified', 'exhibit A', 'lol', 'framed', 'the audacity'],
    'Now go get it':         ['GO', 'you got this', 'beast', 'lfg', 'main character', 'unstoppable'],
    'Your squad showed up':  ['squad', 'we love u', 'group hug', 'legends', 'the crew']
  };
  var DEFAULT_STICKIES = ['🎁', '✨', 'for you', 'made ur day?', '💛'];

  function introText() {
    var el = document.getElementById('msg-intro');
    return el ? (el.textContent || '').trim() : '';
  }

  var fired = false;
  function burst(ox, oy) {
    if (REDUCED || fired) return; fired = true;
    var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'rp-confetti';
    canvas.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;pointer-events:none;';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    function size() {
      canvas.width = innerWidth * dpr; canvas.height = innerHeight * dpr;
      canvas.style.width = innerWidth + 'px'; canvas.style.height = innerHeight + 'px';
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }
    size();
    ox = ox != null ? ox : innerWidth / 2;
    oy = oy != null ? oy : innerHeight * 0.42;
    var pal = [accent(), '#ffffff', '#FFD24A', '#FF6B4A', '#8E7BFF'];
    var pieces = [], N = 120;
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var ang = (Math.PI * 2) * (i / N) + rand(-0.3, 0.3), sp = rand(6, 15), foil = Math.random() < 0.55;
      pieces.push({
        x: ox, y: oy, vx: Math.cos(ang) * sp * rand(0.7, 1.3), vy: Math.sin(ang) * sp - rand(4, 9),
        w: foil ? rand(6, 13) : rand(4, 8), h: foil ? rand(9, 21) : rand(4, 8),
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI, vr: rand(-0.17, 0.17),
        color: pal[(Math.random() * pal.length) | 0], circle: !foil && Math.random() < 0.5
      });
    }
    var start = performance.now(), DUR = 2600;
    addEventListener('resize', size);
    (function frame(now) {
      var t = now - start;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight);
      var fade = t > DUR - 700 ? Math.max(0, (DUR - t) / 700) : 1;
      pieces.forEach(function (p) {
        p.vy += 0.28; p.vx *= 0.99; p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.rot += p.vr;
        ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = fade; ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(p.rot); ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        if (p.circle) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, p.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
        else {
          ctx.fillRect(-p.w / 2, -p.h / 2, p.w, p.h);
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade * 0.5; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)';
          ctx.fillRect(-p.w / 2, -p.h / 2, p.w, p.h / 3);
        }
        ctx.restore();
      });
      if (t < DUR) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else { removeEventListener('resize', size); if (canvas.parentNode) canvas.parentNode.removeChild(canvas); }
    })(start);
  }

  var funDone = false;
  function spawnFunLayer() {
    if (REDUCED || funDone) return; funDone = true;
    var intro = introText();
    var emojis   = FUN_INTROS[intro] || null;
    var captions = STICKY_CAPTIONS[intro] || DEFAULT_STICKIES;
    var isMeme = !!emojis;
    if (!emojis) emojis = ['✨', '🎁', '💛'];
    var host = document.getElementById('act-message') || document.getElementById('stage');
    if (!host) return;
    var layer = document.createElement('div');
    layer.id = 'rp-sticky-layer';
    layer.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;';
    host.appendChild(layer);
    var noteCount = isMeme ? 6 : 3;
    var picks = captions.slice();
    for (var i = 0; i < noteCount; i++) {
      var isSticker = isMeme && Math.random() < 0.45;
      var node = document.createElement('div');
      var rot = rand(-13, 13);
      var left = (Math.random() < 0.5) ? rand(2, 20) : rand(66, 86);
      var top  = rand(8, 78);
      node.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:' + left + '%;top:' + top + '%;' +
        'transform:rotate(' + rot + 'deg) scale(.4);opacity:0;' +
        'transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1),opacity .5s ease;' +
        'will-change:transform,opacity;font-family:\'Caveat\',cursive;';
      if (isSticker) {
        node.textContent = emojis[(Math.random() * emojis.length) | 0];
        node.style.fontSize = rand(30, 46) + 'px';
      } else {
        var cap = picks.length ? picks.splice((Math.random() * picks.length) | 0, 1)[0]
                               : emojis[(Math.random() * emojis.length) | 0];
        node.textContent = cap;
        node.style.fontSize = rand(16, 22) + 'px';
        node.style.fontWeight = '700';
        node.style.padding = '7px 12px';
        node.style.borderRadius = '10px';
        node.style.color = '#12100c';
        node.style.background = accent();
        node.style.boxShadow = '0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35)';
      }
      layer.appendChild(node);
      (function (el, r, delay) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          el.style.opacity = isSticker ? '0.95' : '1';
          el.style.transform = 'rotate(' + r + 'deg) scale(1)';
        }, delay);
        setTimeout(function () { el.style.opacity = '0'; }, delay + 5200);
      })(node, rot, 350 + i * 180);
    }
    setTimeout(function () { if (layer.parentNode) layer.parentNode.removeChild(layer); funDone = false; }, 7200);
  }

  function wireTilt(wrap, card) {
    if (REDUCED || !wrap || !card) return;
    var active = true, MAX = 12;
    function move(x, y) {
      if (!active) return;
      var r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px = (x - r.left) / r.width - 0.5, py = (y - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
      card.style.transform = 'perspective(800px) rotateY(' + (px * MAX) + 'deg) rotateX(' + (-py * MAX) + 'deg)';
    }
    wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { move(e.clientX, e.clientY); });
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { if (active) card.style.transform = ''; });
    wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
      if (e.touches && e.touches[0]) move(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
    });
    var stop = function () { active = false; card.style.transform = ''; };
    wrap.addEventListener('click', stop);
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (wrap.classList.contains('opening')) { stop(); obs.disconnect(); }
    });
    obs.observe(wrap, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  }

  function wireRevealHooks() {
    if (REDUCED) return;
    var msgAct = document.getElementById('act-message');
    if (msgAct) {
      var mObs = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (msgAct.classList.contains('show')) { spawnFunLayer(); }
      });
      mObs.observe(msgAct, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }
    var keepsake = document.getElementById('keepsake');
    if (keepsake) {
      var kObs = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (keepsake.classList.contains('show')) {
          setTimeout(function () { burst(); }, 260);
          kObs.disconnect();
        }
      });
      kObs.observe(keepsake, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }
    var envWrap = document.getElementById('env-wrap');
    if (envWrap) {
      var rObs = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (!envWrap.classList.contains('opening')) { fired = false; }
      });
      rObs.observe(envWrap, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }
  }

  ready(function () {
    var wrap = document.getElementById('env-wrap');
    var card = document.getElementById('env-card');
    wireTilt(wrap, card);
    wireRevealHooks();
  });
})();

/* ZIVOGIFT · scrapbook.js (Run 5 viewer) — swipeable memory book.
   Data: GET /.netlify/functions/get-scrapbook?id=<gift_id>. Loads real photos
   client-side. Touch swipe + arrow keys + on-screen nav. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var state = { pages: [], idx: 0, book: null, total: 0 };

  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'); }

  function buildSlides(book) {
    var slides = [];
    slides.push('<div class="sb-slide sb-cover">' +
      '<div class="sb-eyebrow">A SCRAPBOOK</div>' +
      '<h1 class="sb-title">' + esc(book.title) + '</h1>' +
      '<div class="sb-forwho">for ' + esc(book.recipient_name || 'you') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="sb-meta">' + book.page_count + ' chapters · made by ' + esc(book.sender_name || 'someone') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="sb-hint">swipe →</div></div>');
    (book.pages || []).forEach(function (p, i) {
      var photos = (p.photo_urls || []).map(function (u) {
        return '<div class="sb-photo"><img src="' + encodeURI(u) + '" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>';
      }).join('');
      slides.push('<div class="sb-slide">' +
        '<div class="sb-chapno">CHAPTER ' + (i + 1) + '</div>' +
        '<h2 class="sb-chapter">' + esc(p.chapter) + '</h2>' +
        (photos ? '<div class="sb-photos sb-n' + (p.photo_urls || []).length + '">' + photos + '</div>' : '') +
        (p.note ? '<p class="sb-note">' + esc(p.note) + '</p>' : '') +
        '<div class="sb-pagenum">' + (i + 1) + ' / ' + book.page_count + '</div></div>');
    });
    return slides;
  }

  function render() {
    $('sb-track').style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-state.idx * 100) + '%)';
    $('sb-prev').disabled = state.idx === 0;
    $('sb-next').disabled = state.idx >= state.total - 1;
    var dots = $('sb-dots').children;
    for (var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) dots[i].className = i === state.idx ? 'on' : '';
  }
  function go(i) { state.idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(state.total - 1, i)); render(); }

  function wireGestures() {
    var area = $('sb-viewport'), x0 = null;
    area.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { x0 = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    area.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
      if (x0 == null) return;
      var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - x0;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 45) go(state.idx + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
      x0 = null;
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(state.idx + 1);
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(state.idx - 1);
    });
    $('sb-prev').addEventListener('click', function () { go(state.idx - 1); });
    $('sb-next').addEventListener('click', function () { go(state.idx + 1); });
  }

  function boot(book) {
    state.book = book;
    var slides = buildSlides(book);
    state.total = slides.length;
    $('sb-track').innerHTML = slides.join('');
    $('sb-dots').innerHTML = slides.map(function (_, i) { return '<span class="' + (i === 0 ? 'on' : '') + '"></span>'; }).join('');
    $('sb-loading').style.display = 'none';
    $('sb-viewport').style.display = 'block';
    wireGestures(); render();
  }
  function fail(msg) { $('sb-loading').innerHTML = '<div class="sb-err">' + esc(msg) + '</div>'; }

  function init() {
    var id = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('id');
    if (!id) { fail('This scrapbook link is missing its id.'); return; }
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-scrapbook?id=' + encodeURIComponent(id))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { if (!d || d.error || !d.book) { fail('This scrapbook could not be found.'); return; } boot(d.book); })
      .catch(function () { fail('Could not load this scrapbook. Please refresh.'); });
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
})();
