// js/studio-group2.js
// Group 2 studio additions: Personal Message (F1), Character Drop (F3), Squad Drop (F4).
// Loaded AFTER studio.js and personas.js. Exposes window.ZGGroup2 for the type-card hook.

/* global window, document, fetch, MediaRecorder, AudioContext, navigator */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ── HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function showStep(stepId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.studio-step').forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.display = 'none';
    });
    var el = $(stepId);
    if (el) { el.style.display = 'block'; el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }
  }

  function setFieldError(inputEl, errId, msg) {
    if (inputEl) inputEl.style.borderColor = msg ? '#FF4D2E' : '';
    var errEl = $(errId);
    if (errEl) errEl.textContent = msg || '';
  }

  function fmtTime(sec) {
    var m = String(Math.floor(sec / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    var s = String(Math.floor(sec % 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    return m + ':' + s;
  }

  // ── PERSONAL MESSAGE (Feature 1) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  var pmState = {
    mediaType: null,   // 'video' | 'audio'
    blob: null,
    publicUrl: null,
    durationMs: null,
    stream: null,
    mediaRecorder: null,
    chunks: [],
    timerInterval: null,
    waveInterval: null,
    analyserNode: null,
    audioCtx: null,
    recording: false,
  };

  var MAX_DURATION_SEC = 20;
  var MIN_DURATION_SEC = 5;

  function initPersonalMessage(mediaType) {
    pmState.mediaType = mediaType;
    pmState.blob = null; pmState.publicUrl = null; pmState.durationMs = null;
    pmState.recording = false; pmState.chunks = [];

    var liveVideo   = $('pm-live-preview');
    var waveCanvas  = $('pm-waveform-canvas');
    var recordBtn   = $('pm-record-btn');
    var recordIcon  = $('pm-record-icon');
    var recordLabel = $('pm-record-label');
    var timerEl     = $('pm-timer-display');
    var fillEl      = $('pm-countdown-fill');
    var playbackSec = $('pm-playback-section');
    var uploadStatus= $('pm-upload-status');
    var readyBadge  = $('pm-ready-badge');
    var nextBtn     = $('pm-next-btn');

    // Reset UI
    if (liveVideo)    { liveVideo.style.display    = mediaType === 'video' ? 'block' : 'none'; liveVideo.srcObject = null; }
    if (waveCanvas)   { waveCanvas.style.display   = mediaType === 'audio' ? 'block' : 'none'; }
    if (playbackSec)  playbackSec.style.display   = 'none';
    if (uploadStatus) uploadStatus.style.display  = 'none';
    if (readyBadge)   readyBadge.style.display    = 'none';
    if (timerEl)      timerEl.textContent          = '00:00';
    if (fillEl)       fillEl.style.width           = '0%';
    if (nextBtn)      { nextBtn.style.opacity = '0.4'; nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }

    if (recordBtn) {
      recordBtn.onclick = function () {
        if (!pmState.recording) {
          startRecording(mediaType);
        } else {
          stopRecording();
        }
      };
    }
  }

  function startRecording(mediaType) {
    var constraints = mediaType === 'video'
      ? { video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 480 }, height: { ideal: 480 } }, audio: true }
      : { audio: true };

    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints)
      .then(function (stream) {
        pmState.stream = stream;
        pmState.chunks = [];

        // Live preview
        if (mediaType === 'video') {
          var lv = $('pm-live-preview');
          if (lv) { lv.srcObject = stream; lv.play(); }
        } else {
          startWaveform(stream);
        }

        // Choose best MIME type
        var mimeType;
        if (mediaType === 'video') {
          mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus')
            ? 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus'
            : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/mp4') ? 'video/mp4' : '';
        } else {
          mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/webm;codecs=opus')
            ? 'audio/webm;codecs=opus'
            : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/mp4') ? 'audio/mp4' : '';
        }

        var options = mimeType ? { mimeType: mimeType } : {};
        pmState.mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, options);
        pmState.mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function (e) {
          if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) pmState.chunks.push(e.data);
        };
        pmState.mediaRecorder.onstop = onRecordingStop;
        pmState.mediaRecorder.start(200); // 200ms timeslices
        pmState.recording = true;

        // UI
        var icon = $('pm-record-icon'); var label = $('pm-record-label');
        if (icon) icon.textContent = '⏹';
        if (label) label.textContent = 'Stop';
        $('pm-record-btn').style.background = '#c00';

        // Timer
        var elapsed = 0;
        var timerEl = $('pm-timer-display');
        var fillEl  = $('pm-countdown-fill');
        pmState.timerInterval = setInterval(function () {
          elapsed += 0.5;
          if (timerEl) timerEl.textContent = fmtTime(elapsed);
          if (fillEl)  fillEl.style.width  = Math.min((elapsed / MAX_DURATION_SEC) * 100, 100) + '%';
          if (elapsed >= MAX_DURATION_SEC) stopRecording();
        }, 500);
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.warn('getUserMedia failed:', err);
        alert('Could not access camera/microphone. Please allow access and try again.');
      });
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (pmState.timerInterval) { clearInterval(pmState.timerInterval); pmState.timerInterval = null; }
    if (pmState.waveInterval)  { clearInterval(pmState.waveInterval);  pmState.waveInterval  = null; }
    if (pmState.mediaRecorder && pmState.mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
      pmState.mediaRecorder.stop();
    }
    if (pmState.stream) {
      pmState.stream.getTracks().forEach(function (t) { t.stop(); });
      pmState.stream = null;
    }
    pmState.recording = false;
    var icon = $('pm-record-icon'); var label = $('pm-record-label');
    if (icon) icon.textContent = '⏺';
    if (label) label.textContent = 'Start Recording';
    var btn = $('pm-record-btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.background = '';
  }

  function onRecordingStop() {
    if (!pmState.chunks.length) return;
    var mimeType = pmState.mediaRecorder && pmState.mediaRecorder.mimeType
      ? pmState.mediaRecorder.mimeType
      : (pmState.mediaType === 'video' ? 'video/webm' : 'audio/webm');
    pmState.blob = new Blob(pmState.chunks, { type: mimeType });
    pmState.durationMs = null; // Will be measured on playback

    var url = URL.createObjectURL(pmState.blob);

    if (pmState.mediaType === 'video') {
      var pbv = $('pm-playback-video');
      if (pbv) { pbv.src = url; pbv.style.display = 'block'; pbv.load(); }
      var lv = $('pm-live-preview');
      if (lv) { lv.srcObject = null; lv.style.display = 'none'; }
    } else {
      var pba = $('pm-playback-audio');
      if (pba) { pba.src = url; pba.style.display = 'block'; }
      var wc = $('pm-waveform-canvas');
      if (wc) wc.style.display = 'none';
    }

    var playbackSec = $('pm-playback-section');
    if (playbackSec) playbackSec.style.display = 'block';

    // Re-record
    var rerecordBtn = $('pm-rerecord-btn');
    if (rerecordBtn) {
      rerecordBtn.onclick = function () {
        pmState.blob = null; pmState.publicUrl = null;
        var ps = $('pm-playback-section'); if (ps) ps.style.display = 'none';
        var ru = $('pm-ready-badge'); if (ru) ru.style.display = 'none';
        var nextBtn = $('pm-next-btn');
        if (nextBtn) { nextBtn.style.opacity = '0.4'; nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }
      };
    }

    // Use this
    var useBtn = $('pm-use-btn');
    if (useBtn) {
      useBtn.onclick = function () {
        uploadMedia();
      };
    }
  }

  function startWaveform(stream) {
    try {
      var ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      pmState.audioCtx = ctx;
      var source = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
      var analyser = ctx.createAnalyser();
      analyser.fftSize = 128;
      source.connect(analyser);
      pmState.analyserNode = analyser;
      var canvas = $('pm-waveform-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      var cCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      var bufLen = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
      var dataArr = new Uint8Array(bufLen);
      function drawWave() {
        analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArr);
        cCtx.fillStyle = '#111';
        cCtx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        var barW = canvas.width / bufLen;
        for (var i = 0; i < bufLen; i++) {
          var h = (dataArr[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
          cCtx.fillStyle = '#FFE135';
          cCtx.fillRect(i * barW, canvas.height - h, barW - 1, h);
        }
      }
      pmState.waveInterval = setInterval(drawWave, 50);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Waveform failed:', e);
    }
  }

  function uploadMedia() {
    if (!pmState.blob) return;
    var useBtn = $('pm-use-btn');
    var uploadStatus = $('pm-upload-status');
    var uploadMsg    = $('pm-upload-msg');
    var readyBadge   = $('pm-ready-badge');
    var nextBtn      = $('pm-next-btn');
    if (useBtn) useBtn.disabled = true;
    if (uploadStatus) uploadStatus.style.display = 'block';
    if (uploadMsg) uploadMsg.textContent = 'Uploading…';

    // Determine extension
    var mimeType = pmState.blob.type || '';
    var ext = 'webm';
    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) ext = 'mp4';
    else if (mimeType.includes('mp3') || mimeType.includes('mpeg')) ext = 'mp3';
    else if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) ext = 'ogg';

    // Use a temporary order_id placeholder — the real order_id is linked at checkout
    var tempId = 'tmp-' + Date.now();

    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: ext, order_id: tempId }),
    })
      .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (!data.upload_url) throw new Error('No upload_url returned');
        return fetch(data.upload_url, {
          method: 'PUT',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': data.content_type },
          body: pmState.blob,
        }).then(function (putRes) {
          if (!putRes.ok) {
            return putRes.text().then(function (t) { throw new Error('R2 PUT ' + putRes.status + ': ' + (t || '').slice(0, 300)); });
          }
          return data.public_url;
        });
      })
      .then(function (publicUrl) {
        pmState.publicUrl = publicUrl;
        if (uploadStatus) uploadStatus.style.display = 'none';
        if (readyBadge) {
          readyBadge.style.display = 'block';
          var dur = $('pm-ready-duration');
          if (dur && pmState.durationMs) dur.textContent = Math.round(pmState.durationMs / 1000) + ' seconds recorded';
        }
        if (nextBtn) { nextBtn.style.opacity = '1'; nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; }
        if (useBtn) useBtn.disabled = false;
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('Media upload failed:', err);
        if (uploadMsg) uploadMsg.textContent = 'Upload failed — please try again';
        if (useBtn) useBtn.disabled = false;
      });
  }

  function initPersonalMessageStep() {
    // Back buttons for sub-type selector
    var chooseVideo = $('pm-choose-video');
    var chooseAudio = $('pm-choose-audio');
    var subtypeSel  = $('pm-subtype-selector');
    var recorder    = $('pm-recorder');

    if (chooseVideo) {
      chooseVideo.onclick = function () {
        if (subtypeSel) subtypeSel.style.display = 'none';
        if (recorder) recorder.style.display = 'block';
        initPersonalMessage('video');
      };
    }
    if (chooseAudio) {
      chooseAudio.onclick = function () {
        if (subtypeSel) subtypeSel.style.display = 'none';
        if (recorder) recorder.style.display = 'block';
        initPersonalMessage('audio');
      };
    }

    // Measure duration from playback element
    var pbv = $('pm-playback-video');
    var pba = $('pm-playback-audio');
    function captureDuration(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () {
        if (el.duration && isFinite(el.duration)) {
          pmState.durationMs = el.duration * 1000;
        }
      });
    }
    captureDuration(pbv); captureDuration(pba);

    // Next button
    var nextBtn = $('pm-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.onclick = function () {
        if (!pmState.publicUrl) { alert('Please record and upload your message first.'); return; }
        var recipName = ($('pm-recipient-name') || {}).value && $('pm-recipient-name').value.trim();
        var senderName = ($('pm-sender-name') || {}).value && $('pm-sender-name').value.trim();
        var phone = ($('pm-phone') || {}).value && $('pm-phone').value.trim();
        var email = ($('pm-email') || {}).value && $('pm-email').value.trim();

        var ok = true;
        if (!recipName)  { setFieldError($('pm-recipient-name'), 'err-pm-recipient', 'Enter recipient name'); ok = false; }
        else               setFieldError($('pm-recipient-name'), 'err-pm-recipient', '');
        if (!phone || phone.length < 10) { setFieldError($('pm-phone'), 'err-pm-phone', 'Enter valid 10-digit number'); ok = false; }
        else                               setFieldError($('pm-phone'), 'err-pm-phone', '');
        if (!email || !email.includes('@')) { setFieldError($('pm-email'), 'err-pm-email', 'Enter valid email'); ok = false; }
        else                                  setFieldError($('pm-email'), 'err-pm-email', '');
        if (!ok) return;

        if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
        var mediaSubType = pmState.mediaType === 'video' ? 'media_video' : 'media_audio';
        window.ZGCart.addToCart({
          productId: 'digital_personal',
          name: 'Personal Message',
          emoji: '🎙️',
          unitPrice: 59,
          qty: 1,
          recipientName: recipName,
          message: '🎙️ Personal ' + (pmState.mediaType === 'video' ? 'video' : 'voice') + ' message',
          selectedOptions: {
            vibe_key: 'personal_message',
            gift_type: mediaSubType,
            media_url: pmState.publicUrl,
            media_type: pmState.mediaType,
          },
          addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
          recipientPhone: phone ? '91' + phone : null,
          recipientEmail: null,
          deliveryMode: 'whatsapp',
          senderEmail: email,
          giftType: mediaSubType,
          mediaUrl: pmState.publicUrl,
          mediaType: pmState.mediaType,
          scheduledSendAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
        });
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', email); } catch(e) {}
        window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
      };
    }
  }

  // ── CHARACTER DROP (Feature 3) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  var cdState = { personaKey: null };

  function initCharacterDrop() {
    var grid = $('persona-grid');
    if (!grid || !window.ZG_PERSONAS) return;
    grid.innerHTML = '';

    Object.values(window.ZG_PERSONAS).forEach(function (persona) {
      var card = document.createElement('button');
      card.className = 'persona-card';
      card.dataset.personaKey = persona.key;
      card.innerHTML =
        '<div class="persona-emoji">' + persona.emoji + '</div>' +
        '<div class="persona-name">' + persona.display_name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="persona-tagline">' + persona.tagline + '</div>' +
        '<div class="persona-swatch" style="background:' + persona.bg_gradient + ';border:2px solid ' + persona.accent_color + ';"></div>';
      card.onclick = function () {
        cdState.personaKey = persona.key;
        document.querySelectorAll('.persona-card').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
        card.classList.add('selected');

        // Apply persona colours to studio preview
        var previewCard = document.getElementById('preview-card');
        var previewBg   = document.getElementById('preview-bg-layer');
        if (previewBg) previewBg.style.background = persona.bg_gradient;
        if (previewCard) {
          previewCard.style.setProperty('--accent', persona.accent_color);
          previewCard.style.borderColor = persona.accent_color + '44';
        }
        var fromName = document.getElementById('preview-from-name');
        if (fromName) fromName.textContent = persona.display_name + ' ' + persona.emoji;

        // Show message section
        var msgSec = $('persona-message-section');
        if (msgSec) msgSec.style.display = 'block';
        var personaLabel = $('cd-persona-label');
        if (personaLabel) personaLabel.textContent = persona.display_name + ' ' + persona.emoji;
      };
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });

    // Generate with Character AI
    var genBtn = $('cd-generate-btn');
    if (genBtn) {
      genBtn.onclick = function () {
        if (!cdState.personaKey) { alert('Please select a persona first.'); return; }
        var persona = window.ZG_PERSONAS[cdState.personaKey];
        var recipName = ($('cd-recipient-name') || {}).value ? $('cd-recipient-name').value.trim() : '';
        var hints     = ($('cd-hints')          || {}).value ? $('cd-hints').value.trim()          : '';
        var occasion  = ($('cd-occasion')        || {}).value ? $('cd-occasion').value.trim()       : 'Birthday';

        genBtn.disabled = true; genBtn.textContent = '✨ Channeling…';
        var loadEl = $('cd-ai-loading'); if (loadEl) loadEl.style.display = 'block';

        var userPrompt = 'Recipient name: ' + (recipName || 'Unknown') + '.'
          + (hints ? ' Hints from sender: ' + hints + '.' : '')
          + ' Occasion: ' + occasion + '.';

        // BUGFIX (Group 5 audit): this used to fetch api.anthropic.com
        // directly from the browser with no API key (always failed, silently
        // fell back to a canned line). Now routed through the server-side
        // ai-generate.js, which holds the key.
        var authPromise = (window.ZGAuth ? window.ZGAuth.getSession() : Promise.resolve(null)).catch(function(){ return null; });

        authPromise.then(function(session) {
          var headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
          if (session) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + session.access_token;
          return fetch('/.netlify/functions/ai-generate', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: headers,
            body: JSON.stringify({ system: persona.claude_prompt, prompt: userPrompt, maxTokens: 300 }),
          });
        })
          .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
          .then(function (data) {
            var text = (data && data.text) || '';
            var msgEl = $('cd-msg-preview');
            if (msgEl) { msgEl.value = text.trim(); msgEl.style.fontStyle = 'normal'; }
            var previewMsg = document.getElementById('preview-message-text');
            if (previewMsg) previewMsg.textContent = text.trim();
          })
          .catch(function () {
            var msgEl = $('cd-msg-preview');
            if (msgEl) msgEl.value = "Something in the air shifted when they saw your name. They'll understand. 🌫️";
          })
          .finally(function () {
            genBtn.disabled = false; genBtn.textContent = '✨ Generate with Character AI';
            if (loadEl) loadEl.style.display = 'none';
          });
      };
    }

    // Recipient name → update preview
    var cdRecip = $('cd-recipient-name');
    if (cdRecip) {
      cdRecip.addEventListener('input', function () {
        var ptn = document.getElementById('preview-to-name');
        if (ptn) ptn.textContent = cdRecip.value.trim() || 'Your friend';
      });
    }

    // Next button
    var nextBtn = $('cd-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.onclick = function () {
        if (!cdState.personaKey) { alert('Please select a persona.'); return; }
        var recipName = $('cd-recipient-name') ? $('cd-recipient-name').value.trim() : '';
        var phone     = $('cd-phone')          ? $('cd-phone').value.trim()          : '';
        var email     = $('cd-email')          ? $('cd-email').value.trim()          : '';
        var msg       = $('cd-msg-preview')    ? $('cd-msg-preview').value.trim()    : '';
        var ok = true;
        if (!recipName) { setFieldError($('cd-recipient-name'), 'err-cd-recipient', 'Enter recipient name'); ok = false; }
        else              setFieldError($('cd-recipient-name'), 'err-cd-recipient', '');
        if (!phone || phone.length < 10) { setFieldError($('cd-phone'), 'err-cd-phone', 'Enter valid 10-digit number'); ok = false; }
        else                               setFieldError($('cd-phone'), 'err-cd-phone', '');
        if (!msg) { alert('Please generate or write a message first.'); ok = false; }
        if (!ok) return;

        var persona = window.ZG_PERSONAS[cdState.personaKey];
        if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
        window.ZGCart.addToCart({
          productId: 'digital_character',
          name: 'Character Drop',
          emoji: '🎭',
          unitPrice: 49,
          qty: 1,
          recipientName: recipName,
          message: msg,
          selectedOptions: {
            gift_type: 'character_drop',
            persona_key: cdState.personaKey,
            vibe_key: cdState.personaKey,
            Occasion: $('cd-occasion') ? ($('cd-occasion').value.trim() || 'Birthday') : 'Birthday',
          },
          addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
          recipientPhone: phone ? '91' + phone : null,
          recipientEmail: null,
          deliveryMode: 'whatsapp',
          senderEmail: email,
          giftType: 'character_drop',
          personaKey: cdState.personaKey,
          // Sender name is hidden — persona takes its place on the gift page
          scheduledSendAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
        });
        try { if (email) sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', email); } catch(e) {}
        window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
      };
    }
  }

  // ── SQUAD DROP (Feature 4) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var MAX_SQUAD = 8;
  var sdSlots = [];

  function initSquadDrop() {
    sdSlots = [];
    var listEl = $('squad-contributors');
    var addBtn = $('sd-add-slot-btn');
    if (!listEl) return;
    listEl.innerHTML = '';

    // Start with 3 slots
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) addSquadSlot();
    if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = 'block';

    if (addBtn) {
      addBtn.onclick = function () {
        if (sdSlots.length < MAX_SQUAD) addSquadSlot();
        if (sdSlots.length >= MAX_SQUAD) addBtn.style.display = 'none';
      };
    }

    var nextBtn = $('sd-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.onclick = function () {
        var recipName     = $('sd-recipient-name')   ? $('sd-recipient-name').value.trim()   : '';
        var recipPhone    = $('sd-recipient-phone')  ? $('sd-recipient-phone').value.trim()  : '';
        var senderName    = $('sd-sender-name')      ? $('sd-sender-name').value.trim()      : '';
        var senderPhone   = $('sd-sender-phone')     ? $('sd-sender-phone').value.trim()     : '';
        var senderEmail   = $('sd-email')            ? $('sd-email').value.trim()            : '';

        var ok = true;
        if (!recipName)  { setFieldError($('sd-recipient-name'), 'err-sd-recipient', 'Enter recipient name'); ok = false; }
        else               setFieldError($('sd-recipient-name'), 'err-sd-recipient', '');
        if (!recipPhone || recipPhone.length < 10) { setFieldError($('sd-recipient-phone'), 'err-sd-recipient-phone', 'Enter valid number'); ok = false; }
        else                                          setFieldError($('sd-recipient-phone'), 'err-sd-recipient-phone', '');
        if (!senderEmail || !senderEmail.includes('@')) { setFieldError($('sd-email'), 'err-sd-email', 'Enter valid email'); ok = false; }
        else                                              setFieldError($('sd-email'), 'err-sd-email', '');
        if (!ok) return;

        // Collect valid contributor slots
        var contribPhones = [];
        var contribNames  = [];
        sdSlots.forEach(function (slot) {
          var ph = slot.phoneInput ? slot.phoneInput.value.trim() : '';
          var nm = slot.nameInput  ? slot.nameInput.value.trim()  : '';
          if (ph && ph.length === 10) {
            contribPhones.push('91' + ph);
            contribNames.push(nm || 'Friend');
          }
        });

        if (contribPhones.length === 0) { alert('Add at least one squad member phone number.'); return; }

        if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
        window.ZGCart.addToCart({
          productId: 'digital_squad',
          name: 'Squad Drop',
          emoji: '👥',
          unitPrice: 79,
          qty: 1,
          recipientName: recipName,
          message: 'Squad reaction wall from ' + (senderName || 'the squad'),
          selectedOptions: {
            gift_type: 'squad_drop',
            vibe_key: 'squad_drop',
            contributor_phones: contribPhones,
            contributor_names: contribNames,
          },
          addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
          recipientPhone: recipPhone ? '91' + recipPhone : null,
          recipientEmail: null,
          deliveryMode: 'whatsapp',
          senderEmail: senderEmail,
          giftType: 'squad_drop',
          contributorPhones: contribPhones,
          contributorNames: contribNames,
          scheduledSendAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
        });
        try { if (senderEmail) sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', senderEmail); } catch(e) {}
        window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
      };
    }
  }

  function addSquadSlot() {
    var listEl = $('squad-contributors');
    if (!listEl) return;
    var idx = sdSlots.length + 1;
    var slotEl = document.createElement('div');
    slotEl.className = 'squad-slot';
    slotEl.innerHTML =
      '<span class="squad-slot-label">Friend ' + idx + ' 📱</span>' +
      '<div class="phone-wrap" style="flex:1;">' +
        '<span class="phone-flag">🇮🇳 +91</span>' +
        '<input type="tel" class="sq-phone" placeholder="10-digit number" maxlength="10" inputmode="numeric">' +
      '</div>' +
      '<input type="text" class="sq-name" placeholder="Their name (optional)" style="margin-top:6px;">';
    listEl.appendChild(slotEl);
    sdSlots.push({
      el: slotEl,
      phoneInput: slotEl.querySelector('.sq-phone'),
      nameInput: slotEl.querySelector('.sq-name'),
    });
  }

  // ── ENTRY POINT: called by studio.js type-card click hook ─────────────────
  function handleTypeSelect(type) {
    if (type === 'personal_message') {
      showStep('step-personal-message');
      var subtypeSel = $('pm-subtype-selector');
      var recorder   = $('pm-recorder');
      if (subtypeSel) subtypeSel.style.display = 'flex';
      if (recorder)   recorder.style.display   = 'none';
      initPersonalMessageStep();
    } else if (type === 'character_drop') {
      showStep('step-character-drop');
      // Reset persona section
      var msgSec = $('persona-message-section'); if (msgSec) msgSec.style.display = 'none';
      cdState.personaKey = null;
      document.querySelectorAll('.persona-card').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
      initCharacterDrop();
    } else if (type === 'squad_drop') {
      showStep('step-squad-drop');
      initSquadDrop();
    } else if (type === 'voice_gift' || type === 'video_gift') {
      showStep('step-media-gift');
      initMediaGift(type === 'video_gift' ? 'video' : 'audio');
    } else if (type === 'group_tribute') {
      showStep('step-group-tribute');
      initGroupTribute();
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PART 2 — VOICE GIFT / VIDEO GIFT (media_audio | media_video)
  // Occasion + title + personal message + media (UPLOAD or RECORD).
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  var MG_MAX_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024; // 25 MB — direct-to-R2, no function timeout
  var mgState = {
    mode: 'audio',        // 'audio' | 'video'
    source: 'upload',     // 'upload' | 'record'
    blob: null,           // File (upload) or Blob (record)
    ext: null,
    publicUrl: null,
    occasionKey: 'birthday',
    occasionGreeting: 'Birthday',
    // recorder internals
    stream: null, mediaRecorder: null, chunks: [], recording: false, timerInterval: null,
  };

  function initMediaGift(mode) {
    mgState.mode = mode;
    mgState.source = 'upload';
    mgState.blob = null; mgState.ext = null; mgState.publicUrl = null;
    mgState.occasionKey = 'birthday'; mgState.occasionGreeting = 'Birthday';

    var isVideo = mode === 'video';
    var word = isVideo ? 'video' : 'voice';

    // Labels
    setText('mg-eyebrow', isVideo ? 'VIDEO GIFT' : 'VOICE GIFT');
    setText('mg-heading', isVideo ? 'Create your video gift' : 'Create your voice gift');
    setText('mg-media-word', word);
    setText('mg-drop-title', isVideo ? 'Choose a video file' : 'Choose a voice file');
    setText('mg-drop-hint', isVideo ? 'MP4, MOV or WEBM · up to 25 MB' : 'MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or WEBM · up to 25 MB');
    var dropIcon = $('mg-drop-icon'); if (dropIcon) dropIcon.textContent = isVideo ? '🎬' : '🎙️';

    // File input accept
    var fileInput = $('mg-file-input');
    if (fileInput) {
      fileInput.accept = isVideo ? 'video/mp4,video/quicktime,video/webm,.mp4,.mov,.webm'
                                 : 'audio/mpeg,audio/mp4,audio/ogg,audio/wav,audio/webm,.mp3,.m4a,.wav,.ogg,.webm';
      fileInput.value = '';
    }

    // Reset panes / status
    hide('mg-playback-section'); hide('mg-upload-status'); hide('mg-ready-badge');
    hide('mg-record-pane'); show('mg-upload-pane');
    setSelected('mg-src-upload', true); setSelected('mg-src-record', false);
    var next = $('mg-next-btn'); if (next) { next.style.opacity = '0.4'; next.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }
    setText('mg-timer', '00:00');
    var lv = $('mg-live-preview'); if (lv) { lv.style.display = 'none'; lv.srcObject = null; }

    // Occasion chips
    renderOccasionChips('mg-occasion-grid', 'mg-occasion-custom-row', 'mg-occasion-custom', function (key, greeting) {
      mgState.occasionKey = key; mgState.occasionGreeting = greeting;
      // Prefill a friendly title if the field is still empty
      var t = $('mg-title');
      if (t && !t.value.trim()) {
        var o = window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.get ? window.ZGOccasions.get(key) : null;
        if (o && !o.custom) t.value = 'Happy ' + o.label + '!';
      }
    });

    // Source toggle
    var upBtn = $('mg-src-upload'), recBtn = $('mg-src-record');
    if (upBtn) upBtn.onclick = function () {
      mgState.source = 'upload';
      setSelected('mg-src-upload', true); setSelected('mg-src-record', false);
      show('mg-upload-pane'); hide('mg-record-pane');
      stopMgRecording();
    };
    if (recBtn) recBtn.onclick = function () {
      mgState.source = 'record';
      setSelected('mg-src-record', true); setSelected('mg-src-upload', false);
      hide('mg-upload-pane'); show('mg-record-pane');
    };

    // Dropzone → file input
    var dz = $('mg-dropzone');
    if (dz && fileInput) dz.onclick = function () { fileInput.click(); };
    if (fileInput) fileInput.onchange = function () {
      var f = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
      if (f) handleMgFile(f);
    };

    // Record button
    var rb = $('mg-record-btn');
    if (rb) rb.onclick = function () {
      if (!mgState.recording) startMgRecording(); else stopMgRecording(true);
    };

    // Next
    var nextBtn = $('mg-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.onclick = submitMediaGift;
  }

  function handleMgFile(file) {
    if (file.size > MG_MAX_BYTES) {
      alert('That file is ' + (file.size / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB. Please keep it under 25 MB.');
      return;
    }
    var ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
    var okAudio = ['mp3', 'm4a', 'wav', 'ogg', 'webm'];
    var okVideo = ['mp4', 'mov', 'webm'];
    var allowed = mgState.mode === 'video' ? okVideo : okAudio;
    if (allowed.indexOf(ext) === -1) {
      alert('Unsupported file type ".' + ext + '". Allowed: ' + allowed.join(', '));
      return;
    }
    mgState.blob = file;
    mgState.ext = ext;

    // Local preview
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    showMgPreview(url);
    // Auto-upload
    uploadMgMedia(file, ext, file.name);
  }

  function showMgPreview(url) {
    show('mg-playback-section');
    var pv = $('mg-playback-video'), pa = $('mg-playback-audio');
    if (mgState.mode === 'video') {
      if (pv) { pv.src = url; pv.style.display = 'block'; }
      if (pa) { pa.style.display = 'none'; }
    } else {
      if (pa) { pa.src = url; pa.style.display = 'block'; }
      if (pv) { pv.style.display = 'none'; }
    }
  }

  function startMgRecording() {
    var isVideo = mgState.mode === 'video';
    var constraints = isVideo
      ? { video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 480 }, height: { ideal: 480 } }, audio: true }
      : { audio: true };
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints).then(function (stream) {
      mgState.stream = stream; mgState.chunks = [];
      var lv = $('mg-live-preview');
      if (isVideo && lv) { lv.style.display = 'block'; lv.srcObject = stream; lv.play(); }

      var mime = isVideo
        ? (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus') ? 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus'
           : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/mp4') ? 'video/mp4' : '')
        : (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/webm;codecs=opus') ? 'audio/webm;codecs=opus'
           : MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/mp4') ? 'audio/mp4' : '');
      mgState.mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mime ? { mimeType: mime } : {});
      mgState.mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function (e) { if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) mgState.chunks.push(e.data); };
      mgState.mediaRecorder.onstop = onMgRecordingStop;
      mgState.mediaRecorder.start(200);
      mgState.recording = true;

      setText('mg-record-icon', '⏹'); setText('mg-record-label', 'Stop');
      var btn = $('mg-record-btn'); if (btn) btn.style.background = '#c00';

      var elapsed = 0, MAX = 60; // uploads/records up to 60s for these products
      mgState.timerInterval = setInterval(function () {
        elapsed += 0.5;
        setText('mg-timer', fmtTime(elapsed));
        if (elapsed >= MAX) stopMgRecording(true);
      }, 500);
    }).catch(function (err) {
      console.warn('getUserMedia failed:', err);
      alert('Could not access camera/microphone. Allow access, or use Upload instead.');
    });
  }

  function stopMgRecording(finalize) {
    if (mgState.timerInterval) { clearInterval(mgState.timerInterval); mgState.timerInterval = null; }
    if (finalize && mgState.mediaRecorder && mgState.mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
      mgState.mediaRecorder.stop();
    }
    if (mgState.stream) { mgState.stream.getTracks().forEach(function (t) { t.stop(); }); mgState.stream = null; }
    mgState.recording = false;
    setText('mg-record-icon', '⏺'); setText('mg-record-label', 'Start Recording');
    var btn = $('mg-record-btn'); if (btn) btn.style.background = '';
    var lv = $('mg-live-preview'); if (lv) { lv.srcObject = null; }
  }

  function onMgRecordingStop() {
    if (!mgState.chunks.length) return;
    var mime = (mgState.mediaRecorder && mgState.mediaRecorder.mimeType) || (mgState.mode === 'video' ? 'video/webm' : 'audio/webm');
    var blob = new Blob(mgState.chunks, { type: mime });
    var ext = mime.indexOf('mp4') !== -1 ? 'mp4' : mime.indexOf('ogg') !== -1 ? 'ogg' : 'webm';
    mgState.blob = blob; mgState.ext = ext;
    var lv = $('mg-live-preview'); if (lv) lv.style.display = 'none';
    showMgPreview(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
    uploadMgMedia(blob, ext, 'recording.' + ext);
  }

  function uploadMgMedia(blob, ext, displayName) {
    show('mg-upload-status'); hide('mg-ready-badge');
    setText('mg-upload-msg', 'Uploading…');
    var next = $('mg-next-btn'); if (next) { next.style.opacity = '0.4'; next.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }
    var tempId = 'tmp-' + Date.now();
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: ext, order_id: tempId }),
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (!data.upload_url) throw new Error('No upload_url');
        return fetch(data.upload_url, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': data.content_type }, body: blob })
          .then(function (put) {
            if (!put.ok) return put.text().then(function (t) { throw new Error('R2 PUT ' + put.status + ': ' + (t || '').slice(0, 200)); });
            return data.public_url;
          });
      })
      .then(function (publicUrl) {
        mgState.publicUrl = publicUrl;
        hide('mg-upload-status'); show('mg-ready-badge');
        setText('mg-ready-name', displayName || '');
        maybeEnableMgNext();
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('MG upload failed:', err);
        setText('mg-upload-msg', 'Upload failed — please try again');
      });
  }

  function maybeEnableMgNext() {
    var next = $('mg-next-btn');
    if (next && mgState.publicUrl) { next.style.opacity = '1'; next.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; }
  }

  function submitMediaGift() {
    var isVideo = mgState.mode === 'video';
    var title = val('mg-title');
    var recip = val('mg-recipient-name');
    var phone = val('mg-phone');
    var email = val('mg-email');
    var msg = val('mg-message');

    var ok = true;
    if (!mgState.publicUrl) { alert('Please upload or record your ' + (isVideo ? 'video' : 'voice note') + ' first.'); return; }
    if (!title) { setFieldError($('mg-title'), 'err-mg-title', 'Add a gift title'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('mg-title'), 'err-mg-title', '');
    if (!recip) { setFieldError($('mg-recipient-name'), 'err-mg-recipient', 'Enter recipient name'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('mg-recipient-name'), 'err-mg-recipient', '');
    if (!phone || phone.length < 10) { setFieldError($('mg-phone'), 'err-mg-phone', 'Enter valid 10-digit number'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('mg-phone'), 'err-mg-phone', '');
    if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) { setFieldError($('mg-email'), 'err-mg-email', 'Enter valid email'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('mg-email'), 'err-mg-email', '');
    // Custom occasion required if "other" chosen
    var occ = resolveOccasion('mg-occasion-custom');
    if (occ === null) { ok = false; }
    if (!ok) return;

    var giftType = isVideo ? 'media_video' : 'media_audio';
    if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
    window.ZGCart.addToCart({
      productId: isVideo ? 'digital_video' : 'digital_voice',
      name: isVideo ? 'Video Gift' : 'Voice Gift',
      emoji: isVideo ? '🎬' : '🎙️',
      unitPrice: isVideo ? 99 : 79,      // display only; server re-prices from products table
      qty: 1,
      recipientName: recip,
      message: msg || '',
      selectedOptions: {
        gift_type: giftType,
        vibe_key: giftType,
        media_url: mgState.publicUrl,
        media_type: mgState.mode,
        Occasion: occ,
        gift_title: title,
      },
      addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
      recipientPhone: '91' + phone,
      recipientEmail: null,
      deliveryMode: 'whatsapp',
      senderEmail: email,
      giftType: giftType,
      mediaUrl: mgState.publicUrl,
      mediaType: mgState.mode,
      scheduledSendAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
    });
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', email); } catch (e) {}
    window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PART 2 — GROUP VIDEO TRIBUTE (delivers as squad_drop)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  var GT_MAX = 8;
  var gtSlots = [];
  var gtState = { occasionKey: 'birthday', occasionGreeting: 'Birthday' };

  function initGroupTribute() {
    gtSlots = [];
    gtState.occasionKey = 'birthday'; gtState.occasionGreeting = 'Birthday';
    var listEl = $('gt-contributors');
    if (listEl) listEl.innerHTML = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) addGtSlot();

    renderOccasionChips('gt-occasion-grid', 'gt-occasion-custom-row', 'gt-occasion-custom', function (key, greeting) {
      gtState.occasionKey = key; gtState.occasionGreeting = greeting;
      var t = $('gt-title');
      if (t && !t.value.trim()) {
        var o = window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.get ? window.ZGOccasions.get(key) : null;
        if (o && !o.custom) t.value = 'Congratulations!';
      }
    });

    var addBtn = $('gt-add-slot-btn');
    if (addBtn) {
      addBtn.style.display = 'block';
      addBtn.onclick = function () {
        if (gtSlots.length < GT_MAX) addGtSlot();
        if (gtSlots.length >= GT_MAX) addBtn.style.display = 'none';
      };
    }

    var nextBtn = $('gt-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.onclick = submitGroupTribute;
  }

  function addGtSlot() {
    var listEl = $('gt-contributors');
    if (!listEl) return;
    var idx = gtSlots.length + 1;
    var slotEl = document.createElement('div');
    slotEl.className = 'squad-slot';
    slotEl.innerHTML =
      '<span class="squad-slot-label">Friend ' + idx + ' 📱</span>' +
      '<div class="phone-wrap" style="flex:1;">' +
        '<span class="phone-flag">🇮🇳 +91</span>' +
        '<input type="tel" class="gt-phone" placeholder="10-digit number" maxlength="10" inputmode="numeric">' +
      '</div>' +
      '<input type="text" class="gt-name" placeholder="Their name (optional)" style="margin-top:6px;">';
    listEl.appendChild(slotEl);
    gtSlots.push({ el: slotEl, phoneInput: slotEl.querySelector('.gt-phone'), nameInput: slotEl.querySelector('.gt-name') });
  }

  function submitGroupTribute() {
    var title = val('gt-title');
    var recip = val('gt-recipient-name');
    var recipPhone = val('gt-recipient-phone');
    var email = val('gt-email');
    var msg = val('gt-message');

    var ok = true;
    if (!title) { setFieldError($('gt-title'), 'err-gt-title', 'Add a tribute title'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('gt-title'), 'err-gt-title', '');
    if (!recip) { setFieldError($('gt-recipient-name'), 'err-gt-recipient', 'Enter recipient name'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('gt-recipient-name'), 'err-gt-recipient', '');
    if (!recipPhone || recipPhone.length < 10) { setFieldError($('gt-recipient-phone'), 'err-gt-recipient-phone', 'Enter valid number'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('gt-recipient-phone'), 'err-gt-recipient-phone', '');
    if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) { setFieldError($('gt-email'), 'err-gt-email', 'Enter valid email'); ok = false; } else setFieldError($('gt-email'), 'err-gt-email', '');
    var occ = resolveOccasion('gt-occasion-custom');
    if (occ === null) ok = false;
    if (!ok) return;

    var contribPhones = [], contribNames = [];
    gtSlots.forEach(function (slot) {
      var ph = slot.phoneInput ? slot.phoneInput.value.trim() : '';
      var nm = slot.nameInput ? slot.nameInput.value.trim() : '';
      if (ph && ph.length === 10) { contribPhones.push('91' + ph); contribNames.push(nm || 'Friend'); }
    });
    if (contribPhones.length === 0) { alert('Add at least one friend to contribute a video.'); return; }

    if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
    window.ZGCart.addToCart({
      productId: 'digital_tribute',
      name: 'Group Video Tribute',
      emoji: '👥',
      unitPrice: 149,     // display only; server re-prices
      qty: 1,
      recipientName: recip,
      message: msg || '',
      selectedOptions: {
        gift_type: 'squad_drop',
        vibe_key: 'squad_drop',
        contributor_phones: contribPhones,
        contributor_names: contribNames,
        Occasion: occ,
        gift_title: title,
      },
      addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
      recipientPhone: '91' + recipPhone,
      recipientEmail: null,
      deliveryMode: 'whatsapp',
      senderEmail: email,
      giftType: 'squad_drop',
      contributorPhones: contribPhones,
      contributorNames: contribNames,
      scheduledSendAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
    });
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', email); } catch (e) {}
    window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
  }

  // ── Shared small helpers for Part 2 ────────────────────────────────────────
  function val(id) { var e = $(id); return e && e.value ? e.value.trim() : ''; }
  function setText(id, t) { var e = $(id); if (e) e.textContent = t; }
  function show(id) { var e = $(id); if (e) e.style.display = 'block'; }
  function hide(id) { var e = $(id); if (e) e.style.display = 'none'; }
  function setSelected(id, on) { var e = $(id); if (e) e.classList.toggle('selected', !!on); }

  // Renders occasion chips from the shared ZGOccasions.LIST. Calls back with
  // (occasionKey, greeting) on select. Shows the custom input for "other".
  function renderOccasionChips(gridId, customRowId, customInputId, onSelect) {
    var grid = $(gridId);
    if (!grid) return;
    var list = (window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.LIST) ? window.ZGOccasions.LIST : [
      { key: 'birthday', label: 'Birthday', emoji: '🎂', greeting: 'Birthday' }
    ];
    grid.innerHTML = list.map(function (o) {
      return '<button type="button" class="occasion-chip' + (o.key === 'birthday' ? ' selected' : '') +
        '" data-key="' + o.key + '">' + (o.emoji || '✨') + ' ' + o.label + '</button>';
    }).join('');
    var customRow = $(customRowId);
    function pick(key) {
      grid.querySelectorAll('.occasion-chip').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.toggle('selected', c.dataset.key === key); });
      var greeting = (window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.greetingFor)
        ? window.ZGOccasions.greetingFor(key, $(customInputId) ? $(customInputId).value : '')
        : 'Birthday';
      var o = (window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.get) ? window.ZGOccasions.get(key) : null;
      if (customRow) customRow.style.display = (o && o.custom) ? 'block' : 'none';
      if (onSelect) onSelect(key, greeting);
    }
    grid.querySelectorAll('.occasion-chip').forEach(function (chip) {
      chip.onclick = function () { pick(chip.dataset.key); };
    });
    pick('birthday');
  }

  // Returns the final Occasion greeting string, or null if a custom occasion
  // was chosen but left blank (caller treats null as a validation failure).
  function resolveOccasion(customInputId) {
    var selected = document.querySelector('#' + (customInputId === 'mg-occasion-custom' ? 'mg' : 'gt') + '-occasion-grid .occasion-chip.selected');
    var key = selected ? selected.dataset.key : 'birthday';
    var o = (window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.get) ? window.ZGOccasions.get(key) : null;
    if (o && o.custom) {
      var custom = val(customInputId);
      if (!custom) {
        var row = $(customInputId); if (row) row.style.borderColor = '#FF4D2E';
        alert('Please name the occasion.');
        return null;
      }
      return custom;
    }
    return (window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.greetingFor) ? window.ZGOccasions.greetingFor(key, '') : 'Birthday';
  }

        flex:1; padding:12px; border-radius:12px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700;
        background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
        color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75); cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; transition:.15s;
      }
      .mg-source-btn:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color:#fff; }
      .mg-source-btn.selected { border-color:var(--accent,#FFE135); color:#fff; background:rgba(255,225,53,.12); }
      .mg-dropzone {
        width:100%; padding:26px 16px; border-radius:16px; cursor:pointer; text-align:center;
        background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border:1.5px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
        color:#fff; font-family:inherit; transition:.15s;
      }
      .mg-dropzone:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-color:var(--accent,#FFE135); }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  injectStyles();

  window.ZGGroup2 = { handleTypeSelect: handleTypeSelect };

})();

// js/studio-group3.js
// Group 3 studio additions — loaded AFTER studio.js.
// Adds three UI layers to the existing studio steps:
//
//   1. RELATIONSHIP CONTEXT ENGINE (#9)
//      - On Message step: a "Know this person?" smart banner. If the user is
//        logged in, shows a typeahead over their saved friends list. Selecting
//        a friend prefills recipient name + phone + last vibe + adds context
//        to the AI Polish prompt. Also offers to save the friend after checkout.
//
//   2. TIME CAPSULE (#5)
//      - On Schedule step: a "Time Capsule" toggle. When enabled, replaces the
//        normal scheduling options with a date-picker capped at 4 years from now
//        and sets a ₹0 scheduling surcharge (capsules are a premium fixed price
//        product, not the standard surcharge model).
//
//   3. CONDITION-BASED DELIVERY (#23)
//      - On Schedule step: a "Send only when I say so" toggle. When enabled, the
//        gift sits locked until the sender texts a generated keyword to Zivogift's
//        WhatsApp number. Adds a label text box ("e.g. after placement results").
//
//   4. DEEP-LINK PREFILL (#10 re-order)
//      - On DOMContentLoaded: reads ?recipientName, ?recipientPhone, ?vibeKey
//        from the URL (written by reminder-scheduler.js nudge links) and
//        pre-populates the studio state and DOM fields.
//
// Integration points into studio.js:
//   - Reads/writes window.ZGStudioState (set by studio.js as
//     window.ZGStudioState = state after the IIFE runs — see patch note below).
//   - Calls window.ZGCart.addToCart() — same as studio.js.
//   - Wraps the existing addToCartAndRedirect by patching the confirm button's
//     onclick after renderConfirmStep fires (via MutationObserver on #step-4).

/* global window, document, fetch */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ── PATCH NOTE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // studio.js must expose its internal `state` object so we can read/write it.
  // Add this single line at the END of studio.js, just before the closing `})()`
  //   window.ZGStudioState = state;
  // Without this, Group 3 reads from state safely via data attributes and DOM
  // but cannot write back. See the patched studio.js section below.
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  // Group 3 local state — never conflicts with studio.js state
  var g3 = {
    selectedFriend:    null,   // friends row currently selected
    isTimeCapsule:     false,
    conditionEnabled:  false,
    conditionLabel:    '',
    friends:           [],     // cached from friends-api
    friendsLoaded:     false,
    userLoggedIn:      false,
  };

  // ── 1. RELATIONSHIP CONTEXT ENGINE ────────────────────────────────────────

  function initFriendsBanner() {
    // Only runs if the message step exists
    var msgStep = $('step-2') || document.querySelector('[id*="message"]');
    if (!msgStep) return;

    // Build the banner HTML and inject it above the recipient name field
    var recipGroup = $('f-recipient-name') && $('f-recipient-name').closest('.field-group');
    if (!recipGroup) return;

    var banner = document.createElement('div');
    banner.id  = 'g3-friends-banner';
    banner.style.cssText = [
      'margin-bottom:14px',
      'background:rgba(168,85,247,.08)',
      'border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.25)',
      'border-radius:12px',
      'padding:12px 14px',
      'position:relative',
    ].join(';');

    banner.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#A855F7;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.8px;margin-bottom:8px;">✨ KNOW THIS PERSON?</div>' +
      '<div style="position:relative;">' +
        '<input id="g3-friend-search" type="text" placeholder="Search saved friends…" autocomplete="off" ' +
          'style="width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);' +
          'color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;box-sizing:border-box;">' +
        '<div id="g3-friend-dropdown" style="display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;' +
          'z-index:100;background:#1a1028;border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.3);border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;' +
          'max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="g3-friend-selected" style="display:none;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:#A855F7;"></div>' +
      '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;color:#777;">Prefills their details + makes AI Polish smarter 🧠</div>';

    // Insert before the recipient field group
    recipGroup.parentNode.insertBefore(banner, recipGroup);

    // Wire search input
    var searchInput = $('g3-friend-search');
    var dropdown    = $('g3-friend-dropdown');

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
      var q = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q || !g3.friends.length) { dropdown.style.display = 'none'; return; }
      var matches = g3.friends.filter(function (f) {
        return f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }).slice(0, 6);
      if (!matches.length) { dropdown.style.display = 'none'; return; }
      dropdown.innerHTML = matches.map(function (f) {
        var sub = [f.relationship_type, f.phone ? '📱 ' + f.phone : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
        return '<div class="g3-dd-item" data-id="' + f.id + '" style="padding:10px 12px;cursor:pointer;' +
          'border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);font-size:13px;">' +
          '<span style="color:#fff;font-weight:600;">' + f.name + '</span>' +
          (sub ? '<span style="color:#888;margin-left:8px;">' + sub + '</span>' : '') +
          '</div>';
      }).join('');
      dropdown.style.display = 'block';

      dropdown.querySelectorAll('.g3-dd-item').forEach(function (item) {
        item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { item.style.background = 'rgba(168,85,247,.15)'; });
        item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { item.style.background = ''; });
        item.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var friend = g3.friends.find(function (f) { return f.id === item.dataset.id; });
          if (friend) applyFriend(friend);
          dropdown.style.display = 'none';
        });
      });
    });

    // Close dropdown on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (!banner.contains(e.target)) dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // Load friends if logged in
    if (window.ZGAuth) {
      window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
        if (!session) return;
        g3.userLoggedIn = true;
        fetchFriends(session.access_token);
      }).catch(function () {});
    }
  }

  function fetchFriends(token) {
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/friends-api?action=list', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token },
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (data.friends) {
          g3.friends = data.friends;
          g3.friendsLoaded = true;
          var input = $('g3-friend-search');
          if (input) {
            input.placeholder = g3.friends.length
              ? 'Search ' + g3.friends.length + ' saved friend' + (g3.friends.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + '…'
              : 'No saved friends yet — fill in below to add one';
          }
        }
      }).catch(function () {});
  }

  function applyFriend(friend) {
    g3.selectedFriend = friend;

    // Prefill recipient name
    var nameInput = $('f-recipient-name');
    if (nameInput) {
      nameInput.value = friend.name;
      nameInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }

    // Prefill recipient phone (strip to 10 digits)
    var phoneInput = $('f-phone');
    if (phoneInput && friend.phone) {
      phoneInput.value = String(friend.phone).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10);
      phoneInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }

    // Pre-select vibe if we remember it — write to studio state
    if (friend.last_vibe_key && window.ZGStudioState) {
      window.ZGStudioState.vibeKey = friend.last_vibe_key;
    }

    // Show selected indicator
    var sel = $('g3-friend-selected');
    if (sel) {
      sel.style.display = 'block';
      sel.innerHTML = '';
      var checkPrefix = document.createTextNode('✓ ');
      var strong = document.createElement('strong');
      strong.textContent = friend.name;
      sel.appendChild(checkPrefix);
      sel.appendChild(strong);
      if (friend.context_notes) {
        sel.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' — context loaded for AI Polish 🧠'));
      }
      var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
      clearBtn.id = 'g3-clear-friend';
      clearBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#FF4D2E;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;margin-left:8px;';
      clearBtn.textContent = '✕ clear';
      sel.appendChild(clearBtn);
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        g3.selectedFriend = null;
        sel.style.display = 'none';
        var si = $('g3-friend-search');
        if (si) si.value = '';
      });
    }
  }

  // Inject friend context into AI Polish prompt when available
  function getFriendContextSuffix() {
    if (!g3.selectedFriend) return '';
    var f = g3.selectedFriend;
    var parts = [];
    if (f.relationship_type) parts.push('Relationship: ' + f.relationship_type);
    if (f.context_notes)     parts.push('Context: ' + f.context_notes);
    if (!parts.length) return '';
    return '\n\n[Friend context for personalisation: ' + parts.join('. ') + ']';
  }

  // Monkey-patch window.ZGStudioAIPolish to inject context — called by studio.js
  // We patch the prompt-builder via the AI_PROMPTS mechanism by wrapping the
  // msg before it's passed. studio.js calls callAIPolish(msg) — we intercept
  // via overriding the input event to append context.
  function patchAIPolishForContext() {
    var polishBtn = $('ai-polish-btn');
    if (!polishBtn || polishBtn.dataset.g3Patched) return;
    polishBtn.dataset.g3Patched = '1';

    polishBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      // This fires before studio.js's listener because we add ours first.
      // Append friend context to the message input so callAIPolish picks it up.
      if (!g3.selectedFriend) return;
      var msgInput = $('msg-input');
      if (!msgInput) return;
      var suffix = getFriendContextSuffix();
      if (suffix && !msgInput.value.includes('[Friend context')) {
        // Temporarily append context so the API call includes it.
        // We store original and restore after a tick so the user never sees it.
        var orig = msgInput.value;
        msgInput.value = orig + suffix;
        setTimeout(function () { msgInput.value = orig; }, 50);
      }
    }, true); // capture phase — fires before studio.js's bubble listener
  }

  // ── 2. TIME CAPSULE UI (#5) ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  function initTimeCapsuleToggle() {
    var schedContainer = $('schedule-options');
    if (!schedContainer) return;

    // Inject toggle after the scheduling options
    var wrapper = schedContainer.closest('.card-panel') || schedContainer.parentNode;
    if (!wrapper || $('g3-capsule-wrap')) return;

    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.id  = 'g3-capsule-wrap';
    div.style.cssText = 'margin-top:18px;padding:14px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.05);' +
      'border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2);border-radius:12px;';
    div.innerHTML =
      '<label style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;">' +
        '<input type="checkbox" id="g3-capsule-toggle" style="margin-top:3px;width:auto;accent-color:#D4AF37;">' +
        '<div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#D4AF37;">⏳ 4-Year Time Capsule</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-top:3px;">Schedule this gift to arrive on their graduation day — or any date up to 4 years away. They won\'t be able to open it early.</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</label>' +
      '<div id="g3-capsule-fields" style="display:none;margin-top:14px;">' +
        '<label style="font-size:12px;color:#D4AF37;font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;">📅 DELIVER ON</label>' +
        '<input type="date" id="g3-capsule-date" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);' +
          'color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;">' +
        '<div id="g3-capsule-err" style="font-size:11px;color:#FF4D2E;margin-top:4px;"></div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:6px;">🔒 Your recipient won\'t be able to open this gift before the date you choose.</div>' +
      '</div>';

    wrapper.appendChild(div);

    var toggle   = $('g3-capsule-toggle');
    var fields   = $('g3-capsule-fields');
    var dateInput = $('g3-capsule-date');

    // Set date bounds: tomorrow → 4 years from now
    var minDate = new Date(Date.now() + 24*60*60*1000);
    var maxDate = new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    dateInput.min = minDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    dateInput.max = maxDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    toggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
      g3.isTimeCapsule = toggle.checked;
      fields.style.display = toggle.checked ? 'block' : 'none';
      // Hide normal scheduling row when capsule is on — capsule date takes over
      var normalSched = $('schedule-options');
      var customRow   = $('custom-schedule-row');
      if (normalSched) normalSched.style.opacity = toggle.checked ? '.35' : '1';
      if (normalSched) normalSched.style.pointerEvents = toggle.checked ? 'none' : '';
      if (customRow)   customRow.style.display = 'none';
    });

    dateInput.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var err = $('g3-capsule-err');
      if (!dateInput.value) { if (err) err.textContent = ''; return; }
      var chosen = new Date(dateInput.value);
      if (chosen < minDate) {
        if (err) err.textContent = 'Must be at least tomorrow';
      } else if (chosen > maxDate) {
        if (err) err.textContent = 'Maximum 4 years from now';
      } else {
        if (err) err.textContent = '';
      }
    });
  }

  function getCapsuleScheduledAt() {
    if (!g3.isTimeCapsule) return null;
    var dateInput = $('g3-capsule-date');
    if (!dateInput || !dateInput.value) return null;
    // Send at noon IST on the chosen date (less dramatic than midnight for a capsule)
    var d = new Date(dateInput.value + 'T06:30:00Z'); // 06:30 UTC = 12:00 IST
    return d.toISOString();
  }

  function validateCapsule() {
    if (!g3.isTimeCapsule) return true;
    var dateInput = $('g3-capsule-date');
    var err       = $('g3-capsule-err');
    if (!dateInput || !dateInput.value) {
      if (err) err.textContent = 'Pick a date for your Time Capsule';
      return false;
    }
    var chosen = new Date(dateInput.value);
    var minDate = new Date(Date.now() + 24*60*60*1000);
    var maxDate = new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    if (chosen < minDate || chosen > maxDate) {
      if (err) err.textContent = 'Date must be between tomorrow and 4 years away';
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // ── 3. CONDITION-BASED DELIVERY UI (#23) ──────────────────────────────────

  function initConditionToggle() {
    var wrapper = $('g3-capsule-wrap') && $('g3-capsule-wrap').parentNode;
    if (!wrapper || $('g3-condition-wrap')) return;

    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.id  = 'g3-condition-wrap';
    div.style.cssText = 'margin-top:12px;padding:14px;background:rgba(255,77,46,.04);' +
      'border:1px solid rgba(255,77,46,.18);border-radius:12px;';
    div.innerHTML =
      '<label style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;">' +
        '<input type="checkbox" id="g3-condition-toggle" style="margin-top:3px;width:auto;accent-color:#FF4D2E;">' +
        '<div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#FF8C6B;">🔐 Send Only When I Say So</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-top:3px;">Gift stays locked until you text us a keyword on WhatsApp. Perfect for placement results, match reveals, or any surprise moment.</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</label>' +
      '<div id="g3-condition-fields" style="display:none;margin-top:14px;">' +
        '<label style="font-size:12px;color:#FF8C6B;font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;">📝 WHAT\'S THE OCCASION?</label>' +
        '<input type="text" id="g3-condition-label" maxlength="80" ' +
          'placeholder="e.g. after their placement result, after the match, after exams" ' +
          'style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,77,46,.25);' +
          'color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;">' +
        '<div style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(255,77,46,.08);border-radius:8px;">' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#FF8C6B;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;">📲 HOW IT WORKS</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#aaa;line-height:1.6;">' +
            'After payment, we\'ll WhatsApp you a keyword (e.g. <strong style="color:#fff;">SEND PRIYA</strong>).<br>' +
            'When the moment arrives, just text that keyword to our WhatsApp number — and the gift fires instantly.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    wrapper.appendChild(div);

    var toggle     = $('g3-condition-toggle');
    var fields     = $('g3-condition-fields');
    var labelInput = $('g3-condition-label');

    toggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
      g3.conditionEnabled = toggle.checked;
      fields.style.display = toggle.checked ? 'block' : 'none';
    });

    if (labelInput) {
      labelInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        g3.conditionLabel = labelInput.value.trim();
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 4. DEEP-LINK PREFILL (#10 re-order from reminder nudge) ───────────────

  function applyDeepLinkPrefill() {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var name   = params.get('recipientName');
    var phone  = params.get('recipientPhone');
    var vibe   = params.get('vibeKey');

    if (!name && !phone && !vibe) return;

    // Wait for studio.js to finish rendering the message step
    // We use a short poll since DOMContentLoaded doesn't guarantee initMessageStep has run
    var attempts = 0;
    var poll = setInterval(function () {
      attempts++;
      if (attempts > 30) { clearInterval(poll); return; }

      var nameInput  = $('f-recipient-name');
      var phoneInput = $('f-phone');

      if (!nameInput) return; // not rendered yet
      clearInterval(poll);

      if (name) {
        nameInput.value = name;
        nameInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
      }
      if (phone) {
        phoneInput && (phoneInput.value = String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10));
        phoneInput && phoneInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
      }
      if (vibe && window.ZGStudioState) {
        window.ZGStudioState.vibeKey = vibe;
      }
    }, 200);
  }

  // ── HOOK: intercept ZGCart.addToCart to inject Group 3 fields ───────────
  //
  // studio.js calls addToCartAndRedirect() which calls window.ZGCart.addToCart().
  // Rather than racing to patch btn.onclick (studio.js reassigns it on every
  // renderConfirmStep call and would overwrite our patch), we permanently wrap
  // ZGCart.addToCart once at init time. The wrapper runs for every addToCart
  // call — Group 2 and standard — so it must be a no-op when Group 3 features
  // are off (which it is: isTimeCapsule=false, conditionType='none' etc.).

  function patchAddToCartForGroup3() {
    // ZGCart is defined by cart.js which loads before us — it should be ready,
    // but poll briefly in case of a load-order edge case.
    var attempts = 0;
    var poll = setInterval(function () {
      attempts++;
      if (attempts > 20) { clearInterval(poll); return; }
      if (!window.ZGCart || !window.ZGCart.addToCart) return;
      clearInterval(poll);

      var originalAdd = window.ZGCart.addToCart;

      window.ZGCart.addToCart = function (item) {
        // ── Validate capsule before allowing cart add ──────────────────────
        if (g3.isTimeCapsule && !validateCapsule()) {
          // Scroll to the capsule error so the user sees it
          var capsuleWrap = $('g3-capsule-wrap');
          if (capsuleWrap) capsuleWrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          return; // block the cart add
        }

        // ── Inject Group 3 fields ──────────────────────────────────────────
        item.isTimeCapsule  = g3.isTimeCapsule;
        item.conditionType  = g3.conditionEnabled ? 'sender_confirm' : 'none';
        item.conditionLabel = g3.conditionEnabled ? g3.conditionLabel : null;
        item.friendId       = g3.selectedFriend ? g3.selectedFriend.id : null;

        // Override scheduledSendAt for time capsule (replaces midnight/custom)
        if (g3.isTimeCapsule) {
          var capsuleAt = getCapsuleScheduledAt();
          if (capsuleAt) item.scheduledSendAt = capsuleAt;
        }

        var result = originalAdd.call(window.ZGCart, item);

        // ── Update friend's last vibe + gift type (fire-and-forget) ───────
        if (g3.selectedFriend && window.ZGAuth) {
          window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
            if (!session) return;
            fetch('/.netlify/functions/friends-api?action=save', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                Authorization: 'Bearer ' + session.access_token,
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                id:             g3.selectedFriend.id,
                name:           g3.selectedFriend.name,
                last_vibe_key:  (window.ZGStudioState && window.ZGStudioState.vibeKey) || g3.selectedFriend.last_vibe_key,
                last_gift_type: (window.ZGStudioState && window.ZGStudioState.type)    || g3.selectedFriend.last_gift_type,
              }),
            }).catch(function () {});
          }).catch(function () {});
        }

        return result;
      };
    }, 100);
  }

  // ── HOOK: watch schedule step (step-3) to inject capsule + condition UI ───
  // We observe step-3's style attribute. When it becomes visible, inject our
  // two Group 3 toggles beneath the existing scheduling options.
  // `seen` resets on hide so re-entry on Back→Forward works correctly.

  function watchScheduleStep() {
    var step3 = $('step-3');
    if (!step3) return;
    var seen = false;
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
      var visible = step3.style.display !== 'none' && step3.offsetParent !== null;
      if (visible && !seen) {
        seen = true;
        setTimeout(function () {
          initTimeCapsuleToggle();
          initConditionToggle();
        }, 80);
      } else if (!visible) {
        seen = false;
      }
    });
    obs.observe(step3, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
  }

  // ── HOOK: message step ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function watchMessageStep() {
    var step2 = $('step-2');
    if (!step2) return;
    var seen = false;
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
      var visible = step2.style.display !== 'none' && step2.offsetParent !== null;
      if (visible && !seen) {
        seen = true;
        setTimeout(function () {
          initFriendsBanner();
          patchAIPolishForContext();
        }, 80);
      }
    });
    obs.observe(step2, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
  }

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    applyDeepLinkPrefill();
    watchMessageStep();
    watchScheduleStep();
    patchAddToCartForGroup3();
  });

  // Expose for debugging / e2e tests
  window.ZGGroup3 = { state: g3, applyFriend: applyFriend };

})();

// js/studio-group4.js
// Group 4 studio additions — Revenue Expansion:
//   #11 AI Roast Certificate
//   #17 Personalised Horoscope Drop
//   #18 Exam Survival Kit (timed delivery)
// Loaded AFTER studio.js, studio-group2.js, studio-group3.js.
// Exposes window.ZGGroup4 for the type-card hook in studio.js.

/* global window, document, fetch */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ── HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function showStep(stepId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.studio-step').forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.display = 'none';
    });
    var el = $(stepId);
    if (el) { el.style.display = 'block'; el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }
  }

  function setFieldError(inputEl, errId, msg) {
    if (inputEl) inputEl.style.borderColor = msg ? '#FF4D2E' : '';
    var errEl = $(errId);
    if (errEl) errEl.textContent = msg || '';
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  }

  // Shared Claude call — used by all three Group 4 features.
  // onText receives the raw text response; caller parses it as needed.
  // onDone (optional) always fires last, success or failure — use it to reset button/loading UI.
  //
  // BUGFIX (Group 5 audit): this used to fetch api.anthropic.com directly
  // from the browser with no API key — always failed, silently fell back to
  // static templates for every user. Now routed through the server-side
  // ai-generate.js, which holds ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
  function callClaude(systemPrompt, userPrompt, maxTokens, onText, onError, onDone) {
    var authPromise = (window.ZGAuth ? window.ZGAuth.getSession() : Promise.resolve(null)).catch(function () { return null; });

    authPromise.then(function (session) {
      var headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
      if (session) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + session.access_token;
      return fetch('/.netlify/functions/ai-generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ system: systemPrompt, prompt: userPrompt, maxTokens: maxTokens || 400 }),
      });
    })
      .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        var text = (data && data.text) || '';
        if (!text) throw new Error('empty response');
        onText(text.trim());
      })
      .catch(function (err) { onError(err); })
      .finally(function () { if (onDone) onDone(); });
  }

  function extractJson(text) {
    var match = text.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim().match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
    try { return JSON.parse(match ? match[0] : text); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  function fmtTraits(raw) {
    return (raw || '').split(',').map(function (t) { return t.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function next5min() {
    return new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
  }

  function checkoutRedirect(email) {
    try { if (email) sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', email); } catch (e) {}
    window.location.href = 'checkout.html';
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  var RC_SYSTEM_PROMPT =
    'You write the body text for a mock "official" certificate that affectionately roasts a college friend. ' +

    'that has lost its mind. Given a recipient name, optional college, and a few "crimes"/traits from their friend, ' +

    'Missed Deadlines") that plays on the traits given, then write a short formal certifying paragraph awarding it. ' +
    'Respond with ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no preamble: {"title":"<the formal title, 3-7 words>","body":' +
    '"<1-2 sentence certifying paragraph, under 45 words, third person, formal register, funny content>"}';

  function rcFallback(name, college, traits) {
    var t = traits.length ? traits : ['being consistently late', 'legendary group-chat silence', 'surviving on maggi'];
    var titles = [
      "Hostel's Premier Attendance Ghost",
      'Chief Executive of Missed Deadlines',
      'Undisputed Champion of Last-Minute Everything',
      'Senior Vice President, Group Chat Silence Division',
    ];
    var title = titles[Math.floor(Math.random() * titles.length)];
    var body = 'This is to formally certify that ' + name + (college ? ' of ' + college : '') +
      ' has, through sustained and remarkable effort, demonstrated excellence in ' + t.slice(0, 3).join(', ') +
      ', and is hereby awarded this title in recognition of services rendered to chaos.';
    return { title: title, body: body };
  }

  function renderRcPreview() {

    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = rcState.title;

    if (wrap) wrap.style.display = 'block';
    var nextBtn = $('rc-next-btn');

  function initRoastCertificate() {
    rcState = { title: '', body: '', ready: false };
    var wrap = $('rc-cert-preview'); if (wrap) wrap.style.display = 'none';
    var nextBtn = $('rc-next-btn'); if (nextBtn) { nextBtn.style.opacity = '0.4'; nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }

    var genBtn = $('rc-generate-btn');
    if (genBtn) {
      genBtn.onclick = function () {
        var name = ($('rc-recipient-name') || {}).value ? $('rc-recipient-name').value.trim() : '';
        var college = ($('rc-college') || {}).value ? $('rc-college').value.trim() : '';
        var traitsRaw = ($('rc-traits') || {}).value ? $('rc-traits').value.trim() : '';

        var ok = true;

        else setFieldError($('rc-recipient-name'), 'err-rc-recipient', '');
        if (!traitsRaw) { setFieldError($('rc-traits'), 'err-rc-traits', 'Give us at least one "crime"'); ok = false; }
        else setFieldError($('rc-traits'), 'err-rc-traits', '');
        if (!ok) return;

        var traits = fmtTraits(traitsRaw);

        var loadEl = $('rc-ai-loading'); if (loadEl) loadEl.style.display = 'block';
