        callClaude(RC_SYSTEM_PROMPT, userPrompt, 300, function (text) {
          var parsed = extractJson(text);
          if (parsed && parsed.title && parsed.body) {
            rcState.title = parsed.title.trim();
            rcState.body = parsed.body.trim();
          } else {
            var fb = rcFallback(name, college, traits);
            rcState.title = fb.title; rcState.body = fb.body;
          }
          renderRcPreview();
        }, function () {
          var fb = rcFallback(name, college, traits);
          rcState.title = fb.title; rcState.body = fb.body;
          renderRcPreview();
        }, function () {
          genBtn.disabled = false; genBtn.textContent = '🔄 Regenerate Certificate';
          if (loadEl) loadEl.style.display = 'none';
        });
      };
    }

    var nextBtnEl = $('rc-next-btn');
    if (nextBtnEl) {
      nextBtnEl.onclick = function () {
        if (!rcState.ready) return;
        var name = $('rc-recipient-name').value.trim();
        var college = ($('rc-college') || {}).value ? $('rc-college').value.trim() : '';
        // We now collect the RECIPIENT's contact so the certificate can be

        var email = ($('rc-email') || {}).value ? $('rc-email').value.trim() : '';

        else setFieldError($('rc-phone'), 'err-rc-phone', '');
        if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) { setFieldError($('rc-email'), 'err-rc-email', "Enter their valid email"); ok = false; }
        else setFieldError($('rc-email'), 'err-rc-email', '');
        if (!ok) return;

        if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
        window.ZGCart.addToCart({
          productId: 'digital_roast',
          name: 'AI Roast Certificate',
          emoji: '📜',
          unitPrice: 59,
          qty: 1,

          giftType: 'roast_certificate',

  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // #21 — SQUAD MEMORY BOARD WITH PHOTO UPLOAD
  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  var MAX_PHOTOS = 6;
  var MIN_PHOTOS = 2;
  var MAX_FILE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024; // 8MB
  var smbTempOrderId = null;
  // photos: [{ localId, file, objectUrl, publicUrl, status: 'uploading'|'ready'|'error' }]
  var smbState = { photos: [] };

  function smbExtFor(file) {
    var type = (file.type || '').toLowerCase();
    if (type.indexOf('png') > -1) return 'png';
    if (type.indexOf('webp') > -1) return 'webp';
    return 'jpg';
  }

  function smbRenderThumbs() {
    var wrap = $('smb-photo-thumbs');
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.innerHTML = smbState.photos.map(function (p) {
      var overlay = p.status === 'uploading'
        ? '<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;color:#fff;">Uploading…</div>'
        : p.status === 'error'
          ? '<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(255,0,0,0.35);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;color:#fff;">Failed</div>'
          : '';
      return '<div style="position:relative;width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,154,86,0.4);">' +
        '<img src="' + p.objectUrl + '" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">' +
        overlay +
        '<button type="button" data-remove-id="' + p.localId + '" style="position:absolute;top:2px;right:2px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);color:#fff;border:none;font-size:12px;line-height:20px;cursor:pointer;">✕</button>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');

    wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-remove-id]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () {
        var id = btn.getAttribute('data-remove-id');
        smbState.photos = smbState.photos.filter(function (p) {
          if (p.localId === id) { URL.revokeObjectURL(p.objectUrl); return false; }
          return true;
        });
        smbRenderThumbs();
        smbUpdateStatus();
        smbValidateNextEnable();
      };
    });
  }

  function smbUpdateStatus() {
    var statusEl = $('smb-upload-status');
    if (!statusEl) return;
    var ready = smbState.photos.filter(function (p) { return p.status === 'ready'; }).length;
    var total = smbState.photos.length;
    if (total === 0) { statusEl.textContent = ''; return; }
    statusEl.textContent = ready + ' of ' + total + ' uploaded' + (total < MIN_PHOTOS ? ' — add at least ' + MIN_PHOTOS : '');
  }

  function smbValidateNextEnable() {
    var nextBtn = $('smb-next-btn');
    if (!nextBtn) return;
    var readyCount = smbState.photos.filter(function (p) { return p.status === 'ready'; }).length;
    var ok = readyCount >= MIN_PHOTOS;
    nextBtn.style.opacity = ok ? '1' : '0.4';
    nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = ok ? 'auto' : 'none';
    setFieldError(null, 'err-smb-photos', ok ? '' : ('Add at least ' + MIN_PHOTOS + ' photos'));
  }

  function smbUploadOne(photo) {
    var ext = smbExtFor(photo.file);
    fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: ext, order_id: smbTempOrderId }),
    })
      .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (!data.upload_url) throw new Error('no upload_url');
        return fetch(data.upload_url, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': data.content_type }, body: photo.file })
          .then(function (putRes) {
            if (!putRes.ok) {
              return putRes.text().then(function (t) { throw new Error('R2 PUT ' + putRes.status + ': ' + (t || '').slice(0, 300)); });
            }
            photo.status = 'ready';
            photo.publicUrl = data.public_url;
            smbRenderThumbs();
            smbUpdateStatus();
            smbValidateNextEnable();
          });
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('Photo upload failed:', err);
        photo.status = 'error';
        smbRenderThumbs();
        smbUpdateStatus();
      });
  }

  function initSquadMemoryBoard() {
    smbState.photos.forEach(function (p) { URL.revokeObjectURL(p.objectUrl); });
    smbState = { photos: [] };
    smbTempOrderId = 'tmp-' + Date.now();
    var thumbs = $('smb-photo-thumbs'); if (thumbs) thumbs.innerHTML = '';
    var statusEl = $('smb-upload-status'); if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = '';
    var nextBtn = $('smb-next-btn'); if (nextBtn) { nextBtn.style.opacity = '0.4'; nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }

    var addBtn = $('smb-photo-add-btn');
    var fileInput = $('smb-photo-input');
    if (addBtn && fileInput) {
      addBtn.onclick = function () { fileInput.click(); };
      fileInput.onchange = function () {
        var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(fileInput.files || []);
        fileInput.value = ''; // allow re-selecting the same file later
        var remainingSlots = MAX_PHOTOS - smbState.photos.length;
        if (remainingSlots <= 0) { alert('Max ' + MAX_PHOTOS + ' photos.'); return; }

        files.slice(0, remainingSlots).forEach(function (file) {
          if (!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(file.type)) {
            alert(file.name + ' — only JPG, PNG, or WEBP images are supported.');
            return;
          }
          if (file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
            alert(file.name + ' is over 8MB — please pick a smaller photo.');
            return;
          }
          var photo = {
            localId: 'p' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7),
            file: file,
            objectUrl: URL.createObjectURL(file),
            publicUrl: null,
            status: 'uploading',
          };
          smbState.photos.push(photo);
          smbUploadOne(photo);
        });
        smbRenderThumbs();
        smbUpdateStatus();
        smbValidateNextEnable();
      };
    }

    var nextBtnEl = $('smb-next-btn');
    if (nextBtnEl) {
      nextBtnEl.onclick = function () {
        var readyPhotos = smbState.photos.filter(function (p) { return p.status === 'ready'; });
        if (readyPhotos.length < MIN_PHOTOS) return;

        var name = ($('smb-recipient-name') || {}).value ? $('smb-recipient-name').value.trim() : '';
        var message = ($('smb-message') || {}).value ? $('smb-message').value.trim() : '';
        var caption = ($('smb-caption') || {}).value ? $('smb-caption').value.trim() : '';
        // Collect the RECIPIENT's contact — the board is delivered to them on
        // both WhatsApp and email. Sender details are captured at checkout.
        var phone = ($('smb-phone') || {}).value ? $('smb-phone').value.trim() : '';
        var email = ($('smb-email') || {}).value ? $('smb-email').value.trim() : '';

        var ok = true;
        if (!name) { setFieldError($('smb-recipient-name'), 'err-smb-recipient', 'Enter their name'); ok = false; }
        else setFieldError($('smb-recipient-name'), 'err-smb-recipient', '');
        if (!message) { setFieldError($('smb-message'), 'err-smb-message', 'Add a group message'); ok = false; }
        else setFieldError($('smb-message'), 'err-smb-message', '');
        if (!phone || phone.length < 10) { setFieldError($('smb-phone'), 'err-smb-phone', "Enter their valid number"); ok = false; }
        else setFieldError($('smb-phone'), 'err-smb-phone', '');
        if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) { setFieldError($('smb-email'), 'err-smb-email', "Enter their valid email"); ok = false; }
        else setFieldError($('smb-email'), 'err-smb-email', '');
        if (!ok) return;

        if (!window.ZGCart) { console.error('ZGCart not loaded'); return; }
        window.ZGCart.addToCart({
          productId: 'digital_squadmemory',
          name: 'Squad Memory Board',
          emoji: '📸',
          unitPrice: 89,
          qty: 1,
          recipientName: name,
          message: message,
          selectedOptions: {
            gift_type: 'squad_memory_board',
            vibe_key: 'squad_memory_board',
            Occasion: caption || 'Squad Memories',
            photo_urls: readyPhotos.map(function (p) { return p.publicUrl; }),
          },
          addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
          recipientPhone: '91' + phone,
          recipientEmail: email,
          deliveryMode: 'both',
          giftType: 'squad_memory_board',
          scheduledSendAt: next5min(),
        });
        // Sender's own email is locked to their account at checkout, so don't
        // prefill it with the recipient's address.
        checkoutRedirect(null);
      };
    }
  }

  // ── ENTRY POINT: called by studio.js type-card click hook ─────────────────
  function handleTypeSelect(type) {
    if (type === 'roast_certificate') {
      showStep('step-roast-certificate');
      initRoastCertificate();
    } else if (type === 'horoscope_drop') {
      showStep('step-horoscope-drop');
      initHoroscopeDrop();
    } else if (type === 'exam_survival_kit') {
      showStep('step-exam-kit');
      initExamKit();
    } else if (type === 'squad_memory_board') {
      showStep('step-squad-memory');
      initSquadMemoryBoard();
    }
  }

  window.ZGGroup4 = { handleTypeSelect: handleTypeSelect };

})();

// js/studio-group5.js
// Group 5 studio additions — loaded AFTER studio.js, BEFORE its DOMContentLoaded
// handler fires (script order in digital-studio.html), same pattern as
// studio-group2.js / studio-group3.js / studio-group4.js.
//
// Provides:
//   window.ZGGroup5.appendExclusiveVibes(grid, type, onSelect)  — Feature #16 + #15
//   window.ZGGroup5.checkPolishAllowed() / recordPolishUse() / showPolishUpsell() — Feature #15
//
// Both features degrade gracefully with Supabase unconfigured or the user
// logged out — exclusive vibes just don't render, and AI Polish stays
// ungated (matches today's behavior) rather than blocking anyone.

/* global window, document */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var FREE_POLISH_LIMIT = 3; // per calendar month, logged-in non-Pass users

  // ── Fixed visual designs for the two exclusive vibe keys ──────────────────
  // The `exclusive_vibes` Supabase table controls WHO unlocks WHICH key and
  // WHEN (monthly rotation) — the actual look is one of these two hand-built
  // designs, kept in sync with generate-card-image.js's VIBE_STYLES so the
  // studio preview matches what the recipient actually receives.
  var EXCLUSIVE_DESIGNS = {
    campus_legend: {
      icon: '👑',
      preview: {
        bg: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #120a00 0%, #241400 100%)',
        particles: ['👑', '🏆', '⚡', '✨', '🔥', '💛'],
        textColor: '#FFF6DC', accentColor: '#E8B923',
        font: 'Bebas Neue, sans-serif',
        border: '2px solid rgba(232,185,35,.4)',
        layout: 'party',
        tagBg: 'rgba(232,185,35,.15)', tagColor: '#E8B923',
      },
    },
    zivo_pass_gold: {
      icon: '💎',
      preview: {
        bg: 'linear-gradient(160deg, #160018 0%, #2a0a1a 100%)',
        particles: ['💎', '✨', '🌟', '👑', '🥂', '💫'],
        textColor: '#FFEFD0', accentColor: '#F4C542',
        font: 'Georgia, serif',
        border: '2px solid rgba(244,197,66,.4)',
        layout: 'warm',
        tagBg: 'rgba(244,197,66,.15)', tagColor: '#F4C542',
      },
    },
  };

  var cache = { fetched: false, exclusiveRows: [], hasPass: false, collegeDomain: null, collegeVerified: false, polishCount: 0, monthKey: null };

  function monthKey() {
    var d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function loadStatus() {
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) return Promise.resolve(cache);
    return window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
      var tasks = [
        window.ZGSupabase.from('exclusive_vibes').select('*').eq('active', true),
      ];
      if (session) {
        tasks.push(window.ZGSupabase.rpc('has_active_pass'));
        tasks.push(window.ZGSupabase.from('profiles').select('college_domain, college_verified').eq('id', session.user.id).maybeSingle());
        tasks.push(window.ZGSupabase.from('ai_polish_usage').select('count').eq('user_id', session.user.id).eq('month_key', monthKey()).maybeSingle());
      }
      return Promise.all(tasks).then(function (results) {
        cache.exclusiveRows = (results[0] && results[0].data) || [];
        if (session) {
          cache.hasPass = !!(results[1] && results[1].data);
          var prof = results[2] && results[2].data;
          cache.collegeDomain = prof ? prof.college_domain : null;
          cache.collegeVerified = prof ? !!prof.college_verified : false;
          var usage = results[3] && results[3].data;
          cache.polishCount = usage ? usage.count : 0;
        }
        cache.monthKey = monthKey();
        cache.fetched = true;
        return cache;
      });
    }).catch(function () { cache.fetched = true; return cache; });
  }

  function isUnlocked(row) {
    if (row.unlock_type === 'pass') return cache.hasPass;
    if (row.unlock_type === 'college') {
      return cache.collegeVerified && cache.collegeDomain &&
        row.college_domain && cache.collegeDomain.toLowerCase() === row.college_domain.toLowerCase();
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ── Feature #16 / #15 — exclusive vibe cards ───────────────────────────────
  function appendExclusiveVibes(grid, type, onSelect) {
    var render = function () {
      var rows = cache.exclusiveRows.filter(function (r) {
        return Array.isArray(r.applicable_types) ? r.applicable_types.indexOf(type) !== -1 : true;
      });
      rows.forEach(function (row) {
        var design = EXCLUSIVE_DESIGNS[row.vibe_key];
        if (!design) return;
        var unlocked = isUnlocked(row);
        var card = document.createElement('button');
        card.className = 'vibe-card' + (unlocked ? '' : ' vibe-card-locked');
        card.style.cssText = 'background:' + design.preview.bg + ';border:' + design.preview.border + ';position:relative;' +
          (unlocked ? '' : 'opacity:.65;');
        var lockBadge = unlocked ? '' :
          '<div style="position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;font-size:14px;">🔒</div>';
        var unlockHint = row.unlock_type === 'pass'
          ? 'Zivo Pass exclusive — this month only'
          : (row.college_name ? 'Exclusive to ' + row.college_name : 'College exclusive');

        card.innerHTML =
          lockBadge +
          '<div class="vibe-icon" style="font-size:32px;margin:8px 0 6px;">' + design.icon + '</div>' +
          '<div class="vibe-name" style="color:' + design.preview.accentColor + ';font-weight:700;font-size:13px;">' + row.display_name + '</div>' +
          '<div class="vibe-sub" style="font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin:3px 0 8px;">' + unlockHint + '</div>';

        card.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (!unlocked) {
            showUnlockPrompt(row);
            return;
          }
          grid.querySelectorAll('.vibe-card').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
          card.classList.add('selected');
          onSelect({ key: row.vibe_key, name: row.display_name, preview: design.preview });
        });

        grid.appendChild(card);
      });
    };

    if (cache.fetched) { render(); } else { loadStatus().then(render); }
  }

  function showUnlockPrompt(row) {
    var msg = row.unlock_type === 'pass'
      ? 'This vibe is a Zivo Pass exclusive. Grab the Pass (₹99/semester) in My Account to unlock it — plus unlimited AI Polish and 10% off notes.'
      : 'This vibe is exclusive to ' + (row.college_name || 'a specific college') + '. Verify your college email in My Account to unlock it.';
    if (window.confirm(msg + '\n\nGo to My Account now?')) {
      window.location.href = 'account.html';
    }
  }

  // ── Feature #15 — AI Polish gating ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function checkPolishAllowed() {
    if (!cache.fetched) return true; // haven't resolved status yet — don't block the first click
    if (cache.hasPass) return true;
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) return true; // demo mode / not configured — never block
    return cache.polishCount < FREE_POLISH_LIMIT;
  }

  function recordPolishUse() {
    // Client-side count is now just a fast local UX gate (avoids a wasted
    // network round-trip when we already know the free tier is used up).
    // netlify/functions/ai-generate.js is the sole authority that writes
    // ai_polish_usage — writing here too would race against it and could
    // clobber a correct server-side count with a stale client one.
    if (cache.hasPass) return;
    cache.polishCount++;
  }

  function showPolishUpsell(container) {
    if (!container) return;
    container.style.display = 'block';
    container.innerHTML =
      '<div style="background:rgba(244,197,66,.08);border:1px solid rgba(244,197,66,.3);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;">' +
      '<div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px;">💎</div>' +
      '<div style="font-weight:700;color:#F4C542;margin-bottom:4px;">Free AI Polish used up for this month</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-bottom:12px;">Zivo Pass gives you unlimited AI Polish, a monthly exclusive vibe, and 10% off all notes — ₹99/semester.</div>' +
      '<a href="account.html" style="display:inline-block;background:#F4C542;color:#160018;font-weight:700;padding:9px 20px;border-radius:50px;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;">Get Zivo Pass →</a>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  window.ZGGroup5 = {
    appendExclusiveVibes: appendExclusiveVibes,
    checkPolishAllowed: checkPolishAllowed,
    recordPolishUse: recordPolishUse,
    showPolishUpsell: showPolishUpsell,
  };

  // Kick off status fetch early so it's usually ready by the time step-vibe renders.
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { loadStatus(); });
})();

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · DIGITAL GIFT STUDIO — studio-occasions.js
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Phase 1 + Phase 3 of the "Digital Gifts — every occasion" upgrade.

   WHAT THIS IS
   ------------
   A pure DATA + HELPER module. It adds NO backend, NO database, NO new Netlify
   function. It only supplies the occasion list + per-occasion copy/AI guidance
   that js/studio.js reads when the chosen gift type is occasion-aware
   (currently the generic "Birthday Digital Gift" / birthday_note card).

   HOW studio.js USES IT
   ---------------------
   • TYPES        — which gift types show the occasion picker.
   • LIST         — the occasions shown as chips (mirrors the account.js
                    special-dates picker so the two stay consistent).
   • get(key)     — one occasion record.
   • greetingFor  — the value sent as selectedOptions.Occasion. The server
                    builds "Happy ${occasion}, ${name}!" (see
                    _lib/whatsapp.js / resend email copy / card image), so these
                    strings are chosen to read naturally after the word "Happy".
   • promptGuide  — Phase 3: appended to the AI-Polish prompt so suggestions are
                    occasion-appropriate, not always birthday-shaped.
   • fallbacks    — Phase 3: occasion-aware offline suggestions used when the AI
                    endpoint is unavailable / rate-limited.

   Nothing here is secret, so it stays client-side (same design note as the
   existing AI_PROMPTS block in studio.js).
   ============================================================================ */

      eyebrow: 'YOUR MESSAGE', heading: 'Write it from the heart',
      tag: 'Sent with Zivogift \u2728',
      placeholder: "Type your message\u2026 whatever the occasion, make it theirs",
      preview: 'Your message will appear here \u2014 type below to preview\u2026',
      aiTone: 'A special personal occasion. Warm, sincere and celebratory \u2014 match the sender\u2019s own words.',
      fallback: [
        '{R}, thinking of you today and wishing you all the happiness in the world \u2728',
        'Some days just deserve a little extra love \u2014 this one is for you, {R} \uD83D\uDC9B',
        '{R}, whatever today means to you, i hope it is wonderful. Sending love \uD83C\uDF1F'
      ]
    }
  ];

  var BY_KEY = {};
  LIST.forEach(function (o) { BY_KEY[o.key] = o; });

  function get(key) { return BY_KEY[key] || BY_KEY.birthday; }

  // Default message pre-filled into the studio textarea for an occasion — this
  // is the same line shown in the live preview (o.preview). "Other" starts
  // blank so the sender writes their own. Kept <= 200 chars to match the
  // studio's character cap and stay visually clean on the end card.
  function defaultMsgFor(key, customLabel) {
    var o = get(key);
    if (o.custom) return '';
    return o.preview;
  }

  // Value sent as selectedOptions.Occasion. For "Other", the sender's typed
  // custom label wins so the delivered "Happy ${occasion}" reads as they meant.
  function greetingFor(key, customLabel) {
    var o = get(key);
    if (o.custom && customLabel && customLabel.trim()) return customLabel.trim();
    return o.greeting;
  }

  // Phase 3 — occasion guidance appended to the studio's AI-Polish prompt.
  function promptGuide(key, customLabel) {
    var o = get(key);
    var name = (o.custom && customLabel && customLabel.trim()) ? customLabel.trim() : o.label.replace(/\u2026$/, '');
    return 'OCCASION: ' + name + '. ' + o.aiTone +
      ' Keep the chosen vibe, but the words must clearly fit THIS occasion, not a generic birthday.';
  }

  // Phase 3 — offline suggestions when the AI endpoint is unavailable.
  function fallbacks(key, recipientName) {
    var o = get(key);
    var r = (recipientName && String(recipientName).trim()) || 'they';
    return o.fallback.map(function (line) { return line.replace(/\{R\}/g, r); });
  }

  function isEligibleType(type) { return TYPES.indexOf(type) !== -1; }

  window.ZGOccasions = {
    TYPES: TYPES,
    LIST: LIST,
    get: get,
    defaultMsgFor: defaultMsgFor,
    greetingFor: greetingFor,
    promptGuide: promptGuide,
    fallbacks: fallbacks,
    isEligibleType: isEligibleType
  };
})();

  // ── DOM ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var $ = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
  var steps = ['step-type','step-vibe','step-message','step-schedule','step-confirm'];
  var currentStep = 0;

  function gotoStep(idx) {
    steps.forEach(function(s,i){ var el=$(s); if(el) el.classList.toggle('active', i===idx); });
    currentStep = idx;
    updateProgress();
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    // Occasion picker + occasion copy — refreshed each time we enter the
    // message step, since state.type is only known after type/vibe selection.
    if (idx === 2) renderOccasionPicker();
    // Re-apply vibe placeholder whenever entering the message step
    if (idx === 2 && state.vibeKey) {
      var inp = $('msg-input');
      if (inp && !inp.value) {
        var PLACEHOLDERS = {
          'savage_roast':'e.g. bro you have zero chill and that\'s why we love you',
          'vibe_check':'e.g. you genuinely understood the assignment of life no cap',
          'hostel_life':'e.g. 3AM maggi runs, borrowed notes, you made hostel worth it',
          'wholesome_gold':'e.g. started writing a roast but honestly you just mean a lot',
          'party_blast':'e.g. IT\'S YOUR DAY and we are absolutely NOT being calm about it',
          'heartfelt':'e.g. some people make the world feel softer just by being in it',
          'cosmic_birthday':'e.g. the universe was clearly having a good day when it made you',
          'neon_hype':'e.g. ANOTHER YEAR OF BEING AN ABSOLUTE LEGEND let\'s go',
          'midnight_sky':'e.g. it\'s midnight and i\'m thinking about how lucky i am to know you',
          'deep_feels':'e.g. midnight things — you\'re one of the genuinely good people',
          'party_midnight':'e.g. IT IS YOUR BIRTHDAY AND WE ARE NOT SLEEPING TONIGHT',
          'mystery_drop':'e.g. someone\'s thinking of you at midnight. guess who.',
          'exam_warrior':'e.g. you\'ve put in the work. now go show them what that looks like',
          'chill_confidence':'e.g. you know this. you\'ve always known this. just go.',
          'comeback_king':'e.g. everything you\'ve been through built the person walking in today',
          'tearjerker':'e.g. 3 years of canteen, mess, hostels — i can\'t believe you\'re leaving',
          'funny_farewell':'e.g. who gave you permission to leave honestly',
          'short_sweet':'e.g. some people you just carry with you forever',
          'secret_admirer':'e.g. you\'ll probably never know who sent this but i\'m glad you exist',
          'bold_confession':'e.g. i like you. not in a maybe-sort-of way. in a very obvious way',
          'poetic_love':'e.g. there\'s a version of every day that\'s better because you\'re in it',
          'funny_love':'e.g. i am being extremely normal about you. this is fine.',
        };
        if (PLACEHOLDERS[state.vibeKey]) inp.placeholder = PLACEHOLDERS[state.vibeKey];
      }
    }
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-dot').forEach(function(d,i){
      d.classList.toggle('active', i===currentStep);
      d.classList.toggle('done', i<currentStep);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.sp-line').forEach(function(l,i){
      l.classList.toggle('done', i<currentStep);
    });
  }

  // ── STEP 0: TYPE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Hides type-cards for products the admin has switched off (Catalog tab,
  // products.active) — the cards themselves are still static HTML (kept
  // that way; a full data-driven rewrite of 14 hand-styled cards wasn't
  // worth the risk for this fix), but visibility now follows the database
  // instead of being permanently on regardless of the admin toggle.
  //
  // IMPORTANT: this must be an ALLOWLIST, not a blocklist. The products
  // table's RLS policy is `using (active = true or is_admin())` — an
  // anonymous visitor's query can only ever see active rows; an inactive
  // row isn't returned as active:false, it's just absent, as if it never
  // existed. So "fetch everything, hide anything marked inactive" can
  // never work for a public visitor — it will never see the inactive
  // row to hide it. Instead: fetch the active set, and hide any card
  // whose product id is NOT in that set. Every id in PRODUCTS below is
  // seeded into public.products (see supabase/schema*.sql), so "not in
  // the active set" reliably means "inactive", not "doesn't exist".
  // Fails OPEN (leaves cards visible) only if the query itself errors —
  // this is a visibility/UX concern, not the security boundary;
  // create-cashfree-order.js already rejects inactive products
  // server-side regardless of what the UI shows.
  function applyActiveProductFilter() {
    if (!window.ZGSupabase) return;
    var productIds = Object.keys(PRODUCTS).map(function (k) { return PRODUCTS[k].id; });
    window.ZGSupabase.from('products').select('id,price').in('id', productIds).eq('active', true).then(function (res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data) return; // query failed - fail open; server still validates
      var activeProducts = {};
      res.data.forEach(function (p) { activeProducts[p.id] = p; });
      document.querySelectorAll('.type-card').forEach(function (card) {
        var prod = PRODUCTS[card.dataset.type];
        if (!prod) return;
        var live = activeProducts[prod.id];
        if (!live) { card.style.display = 'none'; return; }
        var livePrice = Number(live.price);
        if (isFinite(livePrice) && livePrice >= 0) {
          prod.price = livePrice;
          card.dataset.price = String(livePrice);
          var priceEl = card.querySelector('.type-price');
          if (priceEl) priceEl.textContent = '\u20b9' + livePrice;
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function initTypeStep() {
    applyActiveProductFilter();
    document.querySelectorAll('.type-card').forEach(function(card) {
      card.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var type = card.dataset.type;
        document.querySelectorAll('.type-card').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('selected'); });
        card.classList.add('selected');
        var prod = PRODUCTS[type];
        state.type = type; state.typeName = prod.name;
        state.typePrice = parseInt(card.dataset.price,10); state.typeIcon = prod.icon;
        state.vibe = null; state.vibeKey = ''; state.vibeName = '';
        updatePreviewForType(type);

        // Group 2 types have their own dedicated steps — delegate to studio-group2.js
        if (prod.isGroup2 && window.ZGGroup2 && window.ZGGroup2.handleTypeSelect) {
          window.ZGGroup2.handleTypeSelect(type);
          return;
        }

        // Care Package has its own dedicated page — multi-week paced
        // sequence doesn't fit the single-message wizard shape, same reason
        // Group2/Group4 types delegate elsewhere rather than reuse step-message.
        if (prod.isCarePackage) {
          window.location.href = 'care-package.html';
          return;
        }

        // Group 4 types have their own dedicated steps — delegate to studio-group4.js
        if (prod.isGroup4 && window.ZGGroup4 && window.ZGGroup4.handleTypeSelect) {
          window.ZGGroup4.handleTypeSelect(type);
          return;
        }

        renderVibeStep(type);
        setTimeout(function(){ gotoStep(1); }, 150);
      });
    });
  }

  // ── STEP 1: VIBE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderVibeStep(type) {
    var eyebrow = $('vibe-eyebrow');
    if (eyebrow) eyebrow.textContent = PRODUCTS[type].name.toUpperCase();
    var vibes = VIBES_BY_TYPE[type] || VIBES_BY_TYPE.birthday_note;
    var grid = $('vibe-grid');
    if (!grid) return;

    var VIBE_SAMPLES = {
      'savage_roast':    '"bro really thought he could exist without me 💀"',
      'vibe_check':      '"understood the assignment. no cap. slay ✅"',
      'hostel_life':     '"3AM maggi > everything. you get it 🍜"',
      'wholesome_gold':  '"starts as a roast. ends with actual tears 💛"',
      'party_blast':     '"IT IS YOUR BIRTHDAY AND WE ARE NOT CALM 🎊"',
      'heartfelt':       '"some people just make the world feel softer 🌸"',
      'cosmic_birthday': '"the universe aligned the day you were born ✨"',
      'neon_hype':       '"BIRTHDAY. UNLOCKED. LEGEND STATUS. GO. ⚡"',
      'midnight_sky':    '"12AM. stars. quietly thinking of you 🌌"',
      'deep_feels':      '"midnight things we never say out loud 🌙"',
      'party_midnight':  '"IT IS YOUR DAY. WAKE UP. WE\'RE CELEBRATING 🎉"',
      'mystery_drop':    '"someone\'s thinking of you. figure out who. 🔮"',
      'exam_warrior':    '"YOU STUDIED. YOU\'RE READY. GO OWN IT 💪"',
      'chill_confidence':'"you know this. you\'ve always known this. 😌"',
      'comeback_king':   '"every L built the person walking in today 👑"',
      'tearjerker':      '"3 years. canteen. mess. hostel. i\'ll miss you 🌊"',
      'funny_farewell':  '"traitor. who gave you permission to leave 😭"',
      'short_sweet':     '"some people you just carry with you forever 🎓"',
      'secret_admirer':  '"you\'ll never know who sent this. but i\'m glad you exist 🌌"',
      'bold_confession': '"i like you. not in a subtle way. very obviously 💗"',
      'poetic_love':     '"every day is better because you\'re in it ✨"',
      'funny_love':      '"i am extremely normal about you. totally fine. 🥺"',
      'motivation':      '"you earned every bit of this. now go get the next one 🚀"',
    };

    grid.innerHTML = vibes.map(function(v) {
      var particlePreview = (v.preview.particles || []).slice(0,4).map(function(p){
        return '<span style="font-size:14px;opacity:.8;">' + p + '</span>';
      }).join('');
      var sampleLine = VIBE_SAMPLES[v.key] || '"your message, transformed ✨"';

      return '<button class="vibe-card" data-key="' + v.key + '" style="background:' + v.preview.bg + ';border:' + v.preview.border + ';">' +
        '<div class="vibe-particles-row">' + particlePreview + '</div>' +
        '<div class="vibe-icon" style="font-size:32px;margin:8px 0 6px;">' + v.icon + '</div>' +
        '<div class="vibe-name" style="color:' + v.preview.accentColor + ';font-weight:700;font-size:13px;">' + v.name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="vibe-sub" style="font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin:3px 0 8px;">' + v.sub + '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-family:' + v.preview.font + ';color:' + v.preview.textColor + ';font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;border-left:2px solid ' + v.preview.accentColor + ';text-align:left;">' + sampleLine + '</div>' +
      '</button>';
    }).join('');

    grid.querySelectorAll('.vibe-card').forEach(function(card) {
      card.addEventListener('click', function() {
        grid.querySelectorAll('.vibe-card').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('selected'); });
        card.classList.add('selected');
        var key = card.dataset.key;
        var vibeObj = vibes.find(function(v){ return v.key===key; });
        state.vibe = key; state.vibeKey = key;
        state.vibeName = vibeObj ? vibeObj.name : key;
        if (vibeObj) applyVibeToPreview(vibeObj.preview, key);
        setTimeout(function(){ gotoStep(2); }, 150);
      });
    });

    // Group 5 — append exclusive vibe cards (locked or unlocked) after the
    // standard grid, if any are available for this product type.
    if (window.ZGGroup5 && window.ZGGroup5.appendExclusiveVibes) {
      window.ZGGroup5.appendExclusiveVibes(grid, type, function(vibeObj) {
        state.vibe = vibeObj.key; state.vibeKey = vibeObj.key;
        state.vibeName = vibeObj.name;
        applyVibeToPreview(vibeObj.preview, vibeObj.key);
        setTimeout(function(){ gotoStep(2); }, 150);
      });
    }
  }

  // ── LIVE PREVIEW ENGINE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function updatePreviewForType(type) {
    var prod = PRODUCTS[type];
    $('preview-icon').textContent = prod.icon;
    $('preview-message-text').textContent = 'Your message will appear here…';
    $('preview-to-name').textContent = 'Your friend';
    $('preview-from-name').textContent = 'You';
    clearPreviewParticles();
  }

  // ── OCCASION PICKER (Phase 1) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Only rendered for occasion-aware types. Reads the shared data module
  // (js/studio-occasions.js). No-op if that module is absent, so studio.js stays
  // safe to ship even if the occasion script fails to load.
  function occasionType() {
    return !!(window.ZGOccasions && window.ZGOccasions.isEligibleType(state.type));
  }

  function currentOccasion() {
    return (window.ZGOccasions ? window.ZGOccasions.get(state.occasionKey) : null);
  }

  function renderOccasionPicker() {
    var wrap = $('occasion-picker-wrap');
    if (!wrap) return;
    if (!occasionType()) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; wrap.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    wrap.style.display = 'block';

    var chips = window.ZGOccasions.LIST.map(function (o) {
      var sel = (o.key === state.occasionKey) ? ' selected' : '';
      return '<button type="button" class="occasion-chip' + sel + '" data-okey="' + o.key + '">' +
        '<span class="oc-emoji">' + o.emoji + '</span>' +
        '<span class="oc-label">' + o.label + '</span></button>';
    }).join('');

    wrap.innerHTML =
      '<div class="occasion-eyebrow">WHAT ARE WE CELEBRATING?</div>' +
      '<div class="occasion-chip-row" id="occasion-chip-row">' + chips + '</div>' +
      '<div class="occasion-custom-wrap" id="occasion-custom-wrap" style="display:none;">' +
        '<input type="text" id="occasion-custom-input" maxlength="30" placeholder="Name the occasion… e.g. Retirement, Housewarming">' +
      '</div>';

    wrap.querySelectorAll('.occasion-chip').forEach(function (chip) {
      chip.addEventListener('click', function () {
        wrap.querySelectorAll('.occasion-chip').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
        chip.classList.add('selected');
        state.occasionKey = chip.dataset.okey;
        var o = window.ZGOccasions.get(state.occasionKey);
        var customWrap = $('occasion-custom-wrap');
        if (customWrap) customWrap.style.display = o.custom ? 'block' : 'none';
        applyOccasionCopy();
      });
    });

    var customInput = $('occasion-custom-input');
    if (customInput) {
      customInput.value = state.occasionCustom || '';
      customInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        state.occasionCustom = customInput.value.trim();
        applyOccasionCopy();
      });
    }

    applyOccasionCopy();
  }

  // Swaps the message-step heading/eyebrow, textarea placeholder, live-preview
  // icon/tag/sample line to match the chosen occasion. Never overwrites what the
  // sender has already typed.
  function applyOccasionCopy() {
    if (!occasionType()) return;
    var o = currentOccasion();
    if (!o) return;

    var stepMsg = $('step-message');
    if (stepMsg) {
      var eyebrow = stepMsg.querySelector('.step-eyebrow');
      var heading = stepMsg.querySelector('.step-heading');
      if (eyebrow) eyebrow.textContent = o.eyebrow;
      if (heading) heading.textContent = o.heading;
    }

    var input = $('msg-input');
    if (input) input.placeholder = o.placeholder;

    var iconEl = $('preview-icon');
    if (iconEl && !state.vibeKey) iconEl.textContent = o.emoji;

    var tagEl = $('preview-tag');
    if (tagEl) tagEl.textContent = o.tag;

    // Pre-fill the textarea with this occasion's default line — the same text
    // shown in the live preview — so the sender starts from a ready greeting
    // and can edit it. Only fills when the field is still an untouched default
    // (empty, or holding the previously-selected occasion's default), so a
    // sender who has typed their own words is never overwritten when they
    // switch occasions.
    var def = (window.ZGOccasions ? window.ZGOccasions.defaultMsgFor(state.occasionKey, state.occasionCustom) : '');
    if (input) {
      var untouched = (!state.message) || (state.message === state._occasionDefault);
      if (untouched) {
        input.value = def;
        state.message = def;
        state._occasionDefault = def;
        var counter = $('msg-char-count');
        if (counter) counter.textContent = def.length + ' / 200';
      }
    }

    var msgEl = $('preview-message-text');
    if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = state.message || o.preview;
  }

  function applyPreviewLayout(layout, p) {

    switch(layout) {

        icon.style.animation = 'previewBounce 1s ease-in-out infinite';
        content.style.background = 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)';
        content.style.borderRadius = '16px';
        content.style.margin = '20px 12px';
        break;
      case 'warm':
        icon.style.fontSize = '48px';
        icon.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,140,0,.6))';
        content.style.padding = '30px 18px';
        break;
      case 'cosmic':
        icon.style.fontSize = '50px';
        icon.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(168,85,247,.7))';
        break;
      case 'neon':
        icon.style.fontSize = '48px';
        icon.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(57,255,20,.8))';
        var msgEl = $('preview-message-text');
        if (msgEl) { msgEl.style.textTransform = 'uppercase'; msgEl.style.letterSpacing = '1px'; }
        break;
      case 'gold':
        icon.style.fontSize = '52px';
        icon.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(212,160,23,.6))';
        var msgEl2 = $('preview-message-text');
        if (msgEl2) { msgEl2.style.letterSpacing = '1px'; }
        break;
      case 'midnight':
        icon.style.fontSize = '52px';
        icon.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(96,128,255,.5))';
        break;
      case 'roast':
        icon.style.fontSize = '56px';
        icon.style.transform = 'rotate(-8deg)';
        icon.style.display = 'inline-block';
        break;
      case 'mystery':
        icon.style.fontSize = '44px';
        icon.style.opacity = '0.4';
        icon.style.filter = 'blur(1px)';
        break;
      case 'letter':
        content.style.textAlign = 'left';
        content.style.padding = '32px 24px';
        break;
      case 'minimal':

  function spawnPreviewParticles(symbols) {
    var container = $('preview-particles');
    if (!container) return;
    clearPreviewParticles();
    if (!symbols || !symbols.length) return;

    for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      (function(i) {
        setTimeout(function() {
          var p = document.createElement('div');
          p.className = 'pp-item';
          var sym = symbols[i % symbols.length];
          var isEmoji = sym && sym.length <= 2 && /\p{Emoji}/u.test(sym);
          p.textContent = sym;
          p.style.cssText =
            'position:absolute;' +
            'font-size:' + (isEmoji ? (10+Math.random()*12) : (8+Math.random()*8)) + 'px;' +
            'left:' + (5 + Math.random()*85) + '%;' +
            'top:' + (5 + Math.random()*85) + '%;' +
            'opacity:' + (0.08 + Math.random()*0.14) + ';' +
            'pointer-events:none;' +
            'animation:ppFloat ' + (4+Math.random()*4) + 's ease-in-out infinite;' +
            'animation-delay:' + (Math.random()*3) + 's;';
          container.appendChild(p);
        }, i * 60);
      })(i);
    }
  }

  function clearPreviewParticles() {
    var c = $('preview-particles');
    if (c) c.innerHTML = '';
  }

  // ── RECIPIENT PHOTO UPLOAD (optional) ───────────────────────────────────
  // Same presigned-upload-to-R2 pattern as Squad Memory Board (studio-group4.js
  // smbUploadOne) — reused rather than reinvented. Shown as-is in the share
  // clip on gift.html, no styling/filter applied.
  // Determines the real file extension by sniffing magic bytes directly,
  // rather than trusting the browser-reported file.type. Several mobile
  // browser/file-picker combinations (iOS Safari picking from certain photo
  // sources, some Android WebViews, cloud-synced files) leave file.type
  // blank or generic. Trusting a blank file.type meant we could tell the
  // server "this is a .jpg" for a file that was actually a real .png — the
  // server's magic-byte validator then (correctly) rejected the mismatch,
  // producing "File content does not match its extension" for a perfectly
  // ordinary PNG the person genuinely selected. Reading the real header
  // bytes first means the extension we claim always matches what the
  // server checks against. Returns a Promise<string>.
  function photoExtFor(file) {
    return file.slice(0, 12).arrayBuffer().then(function (buf) {
      var b = new Uint8Array(buf);
      function startsWith(bytes, offset) {
        offset = offset || 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
          if (b[offset + i] !== bytes[i]) return false;
        }
        return true;
      }
      if (startsWith([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a])) return 'png';
      if (startsWith([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff])) return 'jpg';
      if (startsWith([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46]) && startsWith([0x57, 0x45, 0x42, 0x50], 8)) return 'webp';
      // Couldn't identify it from real bytes — fall back to the browser's
      // MIME type as a last guess. Can still be wrong, but the server-side
      // check remains the real gate either way.
      var type = (file.type || '').toLowerCase();
      if (type.indexOf('png') > -1) return 'png';
      if (type.indexOf('webp') > -1) return 'webp';
      return 'jpg';
    });
  }

  function initRecipientPhotoUpload() {
    var addBtn = $('photo-add-btn');
    var fileInput = $('photo-file-input');
    var thumbWrap = $('photo-thumb-wrap');
    var thumbImg = $('photo-thumb-img');
    var thumbOverlay = $('photo-thumb-overlay');
    var removeBtn = $('photo-remove-btn');
    if (!addBtn || !fileInput) return;

    if (!photoTempOrderId) photoTempOrderId = 'tmp-' + Date.now();

    addBtn.onclick = function () { fileInput.click(); };

    removeBtn.onclick = function () {
      state.recipientPhotoUrl = null;
      fileInput.value = '';
      thumbWrap.style.display = 'none';
      addBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
      var errEl = $('err-photo');
      if (errEl) errEl.textContent = '';
    };

    fileInput.onchange = function () {
      var file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
      if (!file) return;

      var errEl = $('err-photo');
      if (file.size > PHOTO_MAX_BYTES) {
        if (errEl) errEl.textContent = 'Photo is too large — please use one under 8MB.';
        fileInput.value = '';
        return;
      }
      if (errEl) errEl.textContent = '';

      var objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      thumbImg.src = objectUrl;
      thumbWrap.style.display = 'block';
      thumbOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
      addBtn.style.display = 'none';

      var ext = photoExtFor(file);
      ext.then(function (resolvedExt) {
        return fetch('/.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ file_extension: resolvedExt, order_id: photoTempOrderId }),
        });
      })
        .then(function (res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          if (!data.upload_url) throw new Error(data.error || 'no upload_url');
          // Only Content-Type is signed — sending any extra header breaks the signature.
          return fetch(data.upload_url, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': data.content_type }, body: file }).then(function (putRes) {
            if (!putRes.ok) {
              return putRes.text().then(function (t) { throw new Error('R2 PUT ' + putRes.status + ': ' + (t || '').slice(0, 300)); });
            }
            state.recipientPhotoUrl = data.public_url;
            thumbOverlay.style.display = 'none';
          });
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          console.error('Recipient photo upload failed:', err);
          if (errEl) errEl.textContent = "Couldn't upload — please try again.";
          thumbWrap.style.display = 'none';
          addBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
          state.recipientPhotoUrl = null;
        });
    };
  }

  // ── STEP 2: MESSAGE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function initMessageStep() {
    var input      = $('msg-input');
    var counter    = $('msg-char-count');
    var polishBtn  = $('ai-polish-btn');
    var recipInput = $('f-recipient-name');
    var senderInput= $('f-sender-name');

    // Vibe-specific message placeholders
    var VIBE_PLACEHOLDERS = {
      'savage_roast':    'e.g. bro you have zero chill and that\'s why we love you',

      'hostel_life':     'e.g. 3AM maggi runs, borrowed notes, you made hostel worth it',
      'wholesome_gold':  'e.g. started writing a roast but honestly you just mean a lot',
      'party_blast':     'e.g. IT\'S YOUR DAY and we are absolutely NOT being calm about it',

      'neon_hype':       'e.g. ANOTHER YEAR OF BEING AN ABSOLUTE LEGEND let\'s go',
      'midnight_sky':    'e.g. it\'s midnight and i\'m thinking about how lucky i am to know you',
      'deep_feels':      'e.g. midnight things — you\'re one of the genuinely good people',
      'party_midnight':  'e.g. IT IS YOUR BIRTHDAY AND WE ARE NOT SLEEPING TONIGHT',
      'mystery_drop':    'e.g. someone\'s thinking of you at midnight. guess who.',
      'exam_warrior':    'e.g. you\'ve put in the work. now go show them what that looks like',
      'chill_confidence':'e.g. you know this. you\'ve always known this. just go.',
      'comeback_king':   'e.g. everything you\'ve been through built the person walking in today',
      'tearjerker':      'e.g. 3 years of canteen, mess, hostels — i can\'t believe you\'re leaving',
      'funny_farewell':  'e.g. who gave you permission to leave honestly',
      'short_sweet':     'e.g. some people you just carry with you forever',
      'secret_admirer':  'e.g. you\'ll probably never know who sent this but i\'m glad you exist',
      'bold_confession': 'e.g. i like you. not in a maybe-sort-of way. in a very obvious way',
      'poetic_love':     'e.g. there\'s a version of every day that\'s better because you\'re in it',
      'funny_love':      'e.g. i am being extremely normal about you. this is fine.',
    };

    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        state.message = input.value;
        // Once the sender edits the text it is no longer an untouched occasion
        // default, so switching occasions must not overwrite it (see
        // applyOccasionCopy). Clearing this marker guarantees that.
        state._occasionDefault = null;
        counter.textContent = input.value.length + ' / 200';
        $('preview-message-text').textContent = input.value || 'Your message will appear here…';
      });
      // Vibe-specific placeholder only when the field is empty. For
      // occasion-aware types the textarea is pre-filled with the occasion
      // default (applyOccasionCopy), so we don't fight that here.
      var vPlaceholder = VIBE_PLACEHOLDERS[state.vibeKey];
      if (vPlaceholder && !input.value) input.placeholder = vPlaceholder;
    }
    if (recipInput) {
      recipInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
        state.recipientName = recipInput.value.trim();
        $('preview-to-name').textContent = state.recipientName || 'Your friend';
      });
    }
    if (senderInput) {
      senderInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
        state.senderName = senderInput.value.trim();
        $('preview-from-name').textContent = state.senderName || 'You';
      });
    }

    initRecipientPhotoUpload();

    if (polishBtn) {
      polishBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var msg = input ? input.value.trim() : '';
        callAIPolish(msg);
      });
    }

    var nextBtn = $('msg-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (!validateMessageStep()) return;
        renderScheduleStep();
        gotoStep(3);
      });
    }
  }

  function validateMessageStep() {
    var ok = true;
    var msgInput    = $('msg-input');
    var recipInput  = $('f-recipient-name');
    var senderInput = $('f-sender-name');

    if (!msgInput || !msgInput.value.trim()) {
      var wrap = msgInput && msgInput.closest('.message-area-wrap');
      if (wrap) {
        wrap.style.borderColor = '#FF4D2E';
        wrap.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 2px rgba(255,77,46,.15)';
        setTimeout(function(){ wrap.style.borderColor=''; wrap.style.boxShadow=''; }, 2000);
      }
      ok = false;
    }
    if (!recipInput || !recipInput.value.trim()) {
      setFieldState(recipInput, 'invalid', 'err-recipient-name', 'Enter the recipient\'s name');
      ok = false;
    } else { setFieldState(recipInput, 'valid', 'err-recipient-name', ''); }

    if (!senderInput || !senderInput.value.trim()) {
      setFieldState(senderInput, 'invalid', 'err-sender-name', 'Enter your name');
      ok = false;
    } else { setFieldState(senderInput, 'valid', 'err-sender-name', ''); }

    return ok;
  }

  // ── AI POLISH — uses per-type, per-vibe, context-aware prompt ────────────
  function callAIPolish(originalMsg) {
    var polishBtn    = $('ai-polish-btn');
    var loadingEl    = $('ai-loading');
    var suggestionsEl= $('ai-suggestions');

    if (!originalMsg) {
      // Shake the textarea to signal it's needed
      var wrap = $('msg-input') && $('msg-input').closest('.message-area-wrap');
      if (wrap) { wrap.style.borderColor='#FF4D2E'; setTimeout(function(){ wrap.style.borderColor=''; },1500); }
      return;
    }

    // Group 5 — Zivo Pass free-tier gate. Non-Pass users get a limited number
    // of polishes/month; Pass holders are unlimited. checkPolishAllowed()
    // returns synchronously from a cached status (see studio-group5.js) so this
    // never blocks the click — it just shows an upsell instead of calling out.
    if (window.ZGGroup5 && window.ZGGroup5.checkPolishAllowed && !window.ZGGroup5.checkPolishAllowed()) {
      window.ZGGroup5.showPolishUpsell(suggestionsEl);
      return;
    }
    if (window.ZGGroup5 && window.ZGGroup5.recordPolishUse) window.ZGGroup5.recordPolishUse();

    polishBtn.disabled = true;
    polishBtn.textContent = '✨ Crafting…';
    loadingEl.style.display = 'flex';
    suggestionsEl.style.display = 'none';
    suggestionsEl.innerHTML = '';

    var type   = state.type || 'birthday_note';
    // BUGFIX: this used to fall back to the literal string 'them' when the
    // recipient name field (which sits BELOW the message field in the UI)
    // hadn't been filled in yet. The prompt templates interpolate this value
    // directly as "Recipient: <value>", so the model treated the word
    // "them" as if it were the person's actual name and used it that way in
    // the output ("hey them —"). Passing an explicit instruction instead of
    // a word-that-looks-like-a-name fixes it regardless of fill order.
    var recip  = state.recipientName || 'the recipient (name not given yet — do NOT invent or use a placeholder word as their name; address them warmly as "you" instead)';
    var sender = state.senderName || 'sender';
    var vibe   = state.vibeKey || state.vibeName || 'default';

    // Use type-specific prompt
    var promptFn = AI_PROMPTS[type] || AI_PROMPTS.birthday_note;
    var prompt = promptFn(originalMsg, recip, sender, vibe);

    // Phase 3 — occasion-aware polish. For occasion-eligible types the base
    // prompt is birthday-shaped; this line retargets it to the chosen occasion
    // (Anniversary, Graduation, New Baby, …) without changing the vibe. Nothing
    // secret here, so it stays client-side, same as AI_PROMPTS above.
    if (occasionType() && window.ZGOccasions) {
      prompt = window.ZGOccasions.promptGuide(state.occasionKey, state.occasionCustom) + '\n' + prompt;
    }

    // BUGFIX (Group 5 audit): this used to fetch api.anthropic.com directly
    // from the browser with no API key, which always failed and silently
    // fell back to static suggestions — so "AI Polish" never actually ran
    // AI. Now routed through netlify/functions/ai-generate.js, which holds
    // the key server-side and also enforces the real Zivo Pass free-tier limit.
    var authPromise = (window.ZGAuth ? window.ZGAuth.getSession() : Promise.resolve(null)).catch(function(){ return null; });

    authPromise.then(function(session) {
      var headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
      if (session) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + session.access_token;

      return fetch('/.netlify/functions/ai-generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: prompt })
      });
    })
    .then(function(res){ return res.json().then(function(data){ return { ok: res.ok, data: data }; }); })
    .then(function(result) {
      polishBtn.disabled = false;
      polishBtn.textContent = '✨ Polish with AI';
      loadingEl.style.display = 'none';

      if (!result.ok) {
        if (result.data && result.data.error === 'limit_reached' && window.ZGGroup5 && window.ZGGroup5.showPolishUpsell) {
          window.ZGGroup5.showPolishUpsell(suggestionsEl);
          suggestionsEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }
        renderSuggestions(getFallbackSuggestions(type, originalMsg, state.recipientName), suggestionsEl);
        return;
      }

      var text = (result.data && result.data.text) || '';
      var clean = text.replace(/```json|```/g,'').trim();
      // Sometimes model wraps in quotes or adds text — extract the JSON array
      var match = clean.match(/\[[\s\S]*?\]/);
      var suggestions;
      try { suggestions = JSON.parse(match ? match[0] : clean); } catch(e) { suggestions = []; }

      if (!Array.isArray(suggestions) || !suggestions.length) {
        suggestions = getFallbackSuggestions(type, originalMsg, recip);
      }

      renderSuggestions(suggestions, suggestionsEl);
    })
    .catch(function() {
      polishBtn.disabled = false;
      polishBtn.textContent = '✨ Polish with AI';
      loadingEl.style.display = 'none';
      renderSuggestions(getFallbackSuggestions(type, originalMsg, state.recipientName), suggestionsEl);
    });
  }
