  function renderSuggestions(suggestions, container) {
    container.style.display = 'flex';
    container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#A855F7;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:1px;">PICK ONE OR WRITE YOUR OWN</div>' +
      suggestions.map(function(s) {
        return '<button class="ai-suggestion-pill" data-suggestion="' + encodeURIComponent(s) + '">' +
          s + '<span class="pill-use">Tap to use →</span></button>';
      }).join('');

    container.querySelectorAll('.ai-suggestion-pill').forEach(function(pill) {
      pill.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var msgInput = $('msg-input');
        var decoded = decodeURIComponent(pill.dataset.suggestion);
        if (msgInput) { msgInput.value = decoded; msgInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); }
        container.style.display = 'none';
      });
    });
  }

  // ── STEP 3: SCHEDULE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderScheduleStep() {
    var opts = SCHEDULE_OPTS[state.type] || SCHEDULE_OPTS.birthday_note;
    var container = $('schedule-options');
    if (!container) return;

    // Default schedule key to first option
    if (!state.scheduleKey || !opts.find(function(o){ return o.key===state.scheduleKey; })) {
      state.scheduleKey = opts[0].key;
    }

    container.innerHTML = opts.map(function(o) {
      var sel = state.scheduleKey === o.key;
      return '<label class="schedule-opt' + (sel?' selected':'') + '" data-key="' + o.key + '">' +
        '<input type="radio" name="schedule" value="' + o.key + '"' + (sel?' checked':'') + '>' +
        '<div class="sched-icon">' + o.icon + '</div>' +
        '<div><div class="sched-label">' + o.label + '</div><div class="sched-sub">' + o.sub + '</div></div>' +
      '</label>';
    }).join('');

    // Delivery format note
    var prod = PRODUCTS[state.type];
    var noteEl = $('delivery-format-note');
    if (noteEl && prod) { noteEl.textContent = prod.deliveryNote; noteEl.style.display = 'block'; }

    container.querySelectorAll('.schedule-opt').forEach(function(opt) {
      opt.addEventListener('click', function() {
        container.querySelectorAll('.schedule-opt').forEach(function(o){ o.classList.remove('selected'); });
        opt.classList.add('selected');
        state.scheduleKey = opt.dataset.key;
        var customRow = $('custom-schedule-row');
        if (customRow) customRow.style.display = (state.scheduleKey === 'custom') ? 'block' : 'none';
        updateScheduleSurcharge();
      });
    });

    var dtInput = $('f-custom-dt');
    if (dtInput) {
      var now = new Date(Date.now() + 30*60000);
      var maxDate3mo = new Date(Date.now() + 90*24*60*60000);
      dtInput.min = now.toISOString().slice(0,16);
      dtInput.max = maxDate3mo.toISOString().slice(0,16);
      dtInput.addEventListener('change', updateScheduleSurcharge);
    }

    // For midnight_drop 'custom' — also show a midnight-specific note
    if (state.type === 'midnight_drop') {
      var customRow = $('custom-schedule-row');
      if (customRow) {
        var midnoteId = 'midnight-date-note';
        if (!$( midnoteId)) {
          var n = document.createElement('div');
          n.id = midnoteId;
          n.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:var(--gold-light);margin-top:6px;';
          n.textContent = '🌙 We will deliver this at exactly 12:00 AM on the date you choose.';
          customRow.appendChild(n);
        }
      }
    }

    // Show surcharge row in DOM if it doesn't exist yet
    var surchargeRow = $('schedule-surcharge-row');
    if (!surchargeRow) {
      var customRow2 = $('custom-schedule-row');
      if (customRow2) {
        var sr = document.createElement('div');
        sr.id = 'schedule-surcharge-row';
        sr.style.cssText = 'display:none;margin-top:10px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.08);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;';
        sr.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--gold-light);font-weight:700;">+₹20 scheduling charge</span> <span style="color:var(--grey);">— your chosen date is more than 7 days away. This covers extended queue management.</span>';
        customRow2.appendChild(sr);
      }
    }
    updateScheduleSurcharge();

    var anonRow = $('anon-row');
    if (anonRow) anonRow.style.display = prod && prod.showAnon ? 'block' : 'none';

    // Wire delivery mode toggle
    var modeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="studio-digi-mode"]');
    function applyDeliveryMode() {
      var modeEl = document.querySelector('input[name="studio-digi-mode"]:checked');
      var mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'both';
      var wpField = $('studio-whatsapp-field');
      var emField = $('studio-email-field');
      if (wpField) wpField.style.display = (mode === 'email') ? 'none' : '';

      // ── BACKUP EMAIL FOR WHATSAPP-ONLY GIFTS ───────────────────────────
      // This field used to be hidden outright in WhatsApp mode, which meant a
      // WhatsApp-only gift had NO email address stored anywhere. That quietly
      // disabled the email rescue path in whatsapp-webhook.js: when Meta
      // reports the number is not on WhatsApp, the gift has nowhere to go and
      // is simply lost.
      //
      // So instead of hiding it, keep it visible and make it OPTIONAL, with
      // copy that explains exactly why it is worth filling in. It stays
      // required in 'email' and 'both' modes, unchanged.
      var emLabel = $('email-label');
      var emInput = $('f-recipient-email');
      if (emField) {
        emField.style.display = '';
        if (mode === 'whatsapp') {
          if (emLabel) emLabel.innerHTML = "Recipient's email <span class=\"opt-note\">(optional &mdash; backup if WhatsApp fails)</span>";
          if (emInput) emInput.placeholder = 'their@email.com (recommended)';
        } else {
          if (emLabel) emLabel.innerHTML = "Recipient's email <span class=\"req\">*</span>";
          if (emInput) emInput.placeholder = 'their@email.com';
        }
      }
      state.deliveryMode = mode;
    }
    modeRadios.forEach(function(r) {
      r.addEventListener('change', applyDeliveryMode);
    });
    applyDeliveryMode();

    // Live phone validation
    var phoneInput = $('f-phone');
    var emailInput = $('f-email');
    if (phoneInput && !phoneInput.dataset.bound) {
      phoneInput.dataset.bound = '1';
      phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
        phoneInput.value = phoneInput.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,10);
        if (phoneInput.value.length===10) setFieldState(phoneInput,'valid','err-phone','');
        else if (phoneInput.value.length>0) setFieldState(phoneInput,'invalid','err-phone','');
      });
    }
    if (emailInput && !emailInput.dataset.bound) {
      emailInput.dataset.bound = '1';
      emailInput.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        if (emailInput.value && isValidEmail(emailInput.value)) setFieldState(emailInput,'valid','err-email','');
        else if (emailInput.value) setFieldState(emailInput,'invalid','err-email','Enter a valid email');
      });
    }

    var nextBtn = $('schedule-next-btn');
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.onclick = function() {
      if (!validateScheduleStep()) return;
      renderConfirmStep(); gotoStep(4);
    };
  }

  function validateScheduleStep() {
    var ok = true;
    var modeEl = document.querySelector('input[name="studio-digi-mode"]:checked');
    var mode = modeEl ? modeEl.value : 'both';
    state.deliveryMode = mode;

    var phoneInput = $('f-phone');
    var emailInput = $('f-email');
    var recipientEmailInput = $('f-recipient-email');
    var phone = phoneInput ? phoneInput.value.replace(/\D/g,'') : '';

    // Validate WhatsApp if needed
    if (mode !== 'email') {
      if (!phone) {
        setFieldState(phoneInput,'invalid','err-phone','WhatsApp number is required'); ok=false;
      } else if (!/^[6-9][0-9]{9}$/.test(phone)) {
        setFieldState(phoneInput,'invalid','err-phone', phone.length!==10 ? 'Must be exactly 10 digits' : 'Must start with 6, 7, 8, or 9');
        ok=false;
      } else {
        setFieldState(phoneInput,'valid','err-phone',''); state.phone=phone;
      }
    } else {
      state.phone = '';
    }

    // Validate recipient email if needed
    if (mode !== 'whatsapp') {
      var recipEmail = recipientEmailInput ? recipientEmailInput.value.trim() : '';
      if (!recipEmail) {
        setFieldState(recipientEmailInput,'invalid','err-recipient-email','Recipient email is required'); ok=false;
      } else if (!isValidEmail(recipEmail)) {
        setFieldState(recipientEmailInput,'invalid','err-recipient-email','Enter a valid email'); ok=false;
      } else {
        setFieldState(recipientEmailInput,'valid','err-recipient-email',''); state.recipientEmail = recipEmail;
      }
    } else {
      // WhatsApp-only: the email is an OPTIONAL backup address. Blank is
      // perfectly valid and must never block checkout -- but if they did type
      // something, it has to be a real address, because a malformed one is
      // worse than none (it looks like a working fallback and is not).
      var backupEmail = recipientEmailInput ? recipientEmailInput.value.trim() : '';
      if (!backupEmail) {
        setFieldState(recipientEmailInput,'','err-recipient-email','');
        state.recipientEmail = '';
      } else if (!isValidEmail(backupEmail)) {
        setFieldState(recipientEmailInput,'invalid','err-recipient-email','Enter a valid email, or leave it blank'); ok=false;
      } else {
        setFieldState(recipientEmailInput,'valid','err-recipient-email','');
        state.recipientEmail = backupEmail;
      }
    }

    // Sender's receipt email is now collected on the checkout page, so the
    // studio no longer has an #f-email field. Only validate it if it's still
    // present (older layouts); otherwise skip — checkout captures it.
    if (emailInput) {
      var email = emailInput.value.trim();
      if (!email) {
        setFieldState(emailInput,'invalid','err-email','Email required for your receipt'); ok=false;
      } else if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
        setFieldState(emailInput,'invalid','err-email','Enter a valid email like you@gmail.com'); ok=false;
      } else {
        setFieldState(emailInput,'valid','err-email',''); state.email=email;
      }
    } else {
      state.email = '';
    }

    if (state.scheduleKey==='custom') {
      var dtInput = $('f-custom-dt');
      var dtVal = dtInput ? dtInput.value : '';
      if (!dtVal) { setFieldState(dtInput,'invalid','err-custom-dt','Pick a date & time'); ok=false; }
      else if (new Date(dtVal).getTime() < Date.now()+15*60000) {
        setFieldState(dtInput,'invalid','err-custom-dt','Must be at least 15 minutes from now'); ok=false;
      } else { setFieldState(dtInput,'valid','err-custom-dt',''); state.customDt=dtVal; }
    }

    var anonCheck = $('f-anon');
    state.anonymous = anonCheck ? anonCheck.checked : false;
    return ok;
  }

  // ── STEP 4: CONFIRM ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderConfirmStep() {
    var dlabel = { midnight:'Tonight at Midnight 🌙', morning:'Tomorrow 8 AM ☀️', now:'Right Now ⚡',
      custom: state.customDt
        ? (state.type === 'midnight_drop'
            ? '🌙 Midnight on ' + new Date(state.customDt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})
            : new Date(state.customDt).toLocaleString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}))
        : 'Scheduled' };

    var surcharge = state.schedulingSurcharge || 0;
    var finalPrice = state.typePrice + surcharge;

    var summary = $('confirm-summary');
    var priceEl = $('confirm-price');
    if (priceEl) priceEl.textContent = finalPrice;
    if (summary) {
      summary.innerHTML = [
        ['Gift Type', state.typeName + ' ' + state.typeIcon],
        ['Vibe',      state.vibeName],
        ['To',        state.recipientName],
        ['From',      state.anonymous ? 'Anonymous 🤫' : state.senderName],
        ['Message',   (state.message||'(no message)').slice(0,80)+(state.message.length>80?'…':'')],
        ['Sends to',  state.deliveryMode !== 'email' && state.phone ? '+91 ' + state.phone : (state.recipientEmail || '—')],
        ['Delivery',  (dlabel[state.scheduleKey]||state.scheduleKey)],
        surcharge ? ['Scheduling fee', '+₹20 (date is >7 days away)'] : null,
        ['Price',     '₹' + finalPrice + (surcharge ? ' <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--grey);">(incl. scheduling charge)</span>' : '')],
      ].filter(Boolean).map(function(r){ return '<div class="cs-row"><span class="cs-label">'+r[0]+'</span><span class="cs-value">'+r[1]+'</span></div>'; }).join('');
    }
    var addBtn = $('confirm-add-btn');
    if (addBtn) addBtn.onclick = addToCartAndRedirect;
  }

  function addToCartAndRedirect() {
    var prod = PRODUCTS[state.type];
    if (!prod || !window.ZGCart) return;
    var surcharge = state.schedulingSurcharge || 0;
    var giftType  = state.type || 'standard';
    // Phase 1 — occasion-eligible types use the sender's chosen occasion so the
    // server-built greeting ("Happy ${occasion}, ${name}!") matches. All other
    // types keep their fixed OCCASION_BY_TYPE value, exactly as before.
    var occasion  = (occasionType() && window.ZGOccasions)
      ? window.ZGOccasions.greetingFor(state.occasionKey, state.occasionCustom)
      : (OCCASION_BY_TYPE[giftType] || 'Birthday');
    window.ZGCart.addToCart({
      productId: prod.id, name: state.typeName, emoji: state.typeIcon,
      unitPrice: state.typePrice + surcharge, qty: 1,
      recipientName: state.recipientName, recipientDob: '',
      message: state.message,
      // giftType has to travel with the line item: create-cashfree-order.js
      // reads `item.giftType` and defaults to 'standard' when it's absent,
      // which is exactly why every gift arrived labelled "Birthday Gift".
      // It's also mirrored into selectedOptions.gift_type because
      // digitalSendsHelper.js accepts either path.
      giftType: giftType,
      selectedOptions: {
        vibe: state.vibeName,
        schedule: state.scheduleKey,
        vibe_key: state.vibeKey,
        gift_type: giftType,
        Occasion: occasion,
        recipient_photo_url: state.recipientPhotoUrl || null
      },
      addonIds: [], addonNames: [], addonTotal: 0,
      recipientPhone: state.phone ? '91' + state.phone : null,
      recipientEmail: state.recipientEmail || null,
      deliveryMode: state.deliveryMode || 'both',
      senderEmail: state.email, anonymous: state.anonymous,
      scheduledSendAt: computeSendTime(state.scheduleKey, state.customDt),
    });
    // Prefill the checkout email if we have one (sender receipt email was
    // removed from the studio, so this is usually empty now — that's fine,
    // checkout collects/locks the purchaser email itself).
    try { if (state.email) sessionStorage.setItem('zg_prefill_email', state.email); } catch(e){}
    setTimeout(function(){ window.location.href = 'checkout.html'; }, 300);
  }

  function updateScheduleSurcharge() {
    var dtInput = $('f-custom-dt');
    var surchargeRow = $('schedule-surcharge-row');
    if (!dtInput || !surchargeRow || state.scheduleKey !== 'custom') { state.schedulingSurcharge = 0; return; }
    if (!dtInput.value) { surchargeRow.style.display = 'none'; state.schedulingSurcharge = 0; return; }
    var chosen = new Date(dtInput.value);
    var sevenDaysFromNow = new Date(Date.now() + 7*24*60*60*1000);
    var needsSurcharge = chosen > sevenDaysFromNow;
    surchargeRow.style.display = needsSurcharge ? 'block' : 'none';
    state.schedulingSurcharge = needsSurcharge ? 20 : 0;
  }

  function computeSendTime(choice, customDt) {
    var now = new Date(); var ist = 330*60000;
    if (choice==='now') return new Date(now.getTime()+5*60000).toISOString();
    if (choice==='custom') {
      if (!customDt) return now.toISOString();
      // For midnight_drop custom: force time to midnight IST on chosen date
      if (state.type === 'midnight_drop') {
        var d = new Date(customDt);
        var istDate = new Date(d.getTime() + ist);
        istDate.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        return new Date(istDate.getTime() - ist).toISOString();
      }
      return new Date(customDt).toISOString();
    }
    if (choice==='morning'){
      // 8:00 AM IST tomorrow. We work on an IST-shifted clock (now + ist),
      // roll to the next day, then pin the wall-clock time to 08:00 IST and
      // convert back to UTC by subtracting the offset once.
      // BUGFIX: this previously set 02:30 on the shifted clock (the UTC
      // equivalent of 8 AM) AND then subtracted the offset again — a double
      // conversion that made sends land at ~2:30 AM IST instead of 8 AM.
      var t=new Date(now.getTime()+ist); t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate()+1); t.setUTCHours(8,0,0,0);
      return new Date(t.getTime()-ist).toISOString();
    }
    var m=new Date(now.getTime()+ist); m.setUTCHours(0,0,0,0);
    if(m.getTime()<=(now.getTime()+ist)) m.setUTCDate(m.getUTCDate()+1);
    return new Date(m.getTime()-ist).toISOString();
  }

  // ── HELPERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function setFieldState(el, st, errId, msg) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('valid','invalid');
    if (st) el.classList.add(st);
    var e = errId ? $(errId) : null;
    if (e) e.textContent = msg||'';
  }
  function isValidEmail(email) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email); }

  function initBackButtons() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.back-btn[data-goto]').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var idx = steps.indexOf(btn.dataset.goto);
        if (idx>=0) gotoStep(idx);
      });
    });
  }

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    gotoStep(0);
    initTypeStep();
    initMessageStep();
    initBackButtons();

    // Inject ppFloat keyframe
    if (!document.getElementById('ppFloat-style')) {
      var s=document.createElement('style'); s.id='ppFloat-style';
      s.textContent='@keyframes ppFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(8deg)}}';
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    }

    // URL param pre-select
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var preType = params.get('type');
    if (preType && PRODUCTS[preType]) {
      var card = document.querySelector('.type-card[data-type="'+preType+'"]');
      if (card) setTimeout(function(){ card.click(); }, 250);
    }

    // ── CHARACTER DROP REPLY: ?reply_token=<uuid>&persona=<key>&ref=gift_reply
    // Recipient clicked "Reply to The Mystery" on gift page. We resolve the token
    // server-side to get persona info only (never real sender phone). Then we
    // store the token in sessionStorage so checkout.js can pass it to the order.
    var replyToken = params.get('reply_token');
    var replyPersona = params.get('persona');
    var refParam = params.get('ref');

    if (replyToken && refParam === 'gift_reply') {
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('zg_order_ref', 'gift_reply'); } catch(e) {}
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('zg_reply_token', replyToken); } catch(e) {}

      // Resolve token → get persona display name (no phone ever returned)
      fetch('/.netlify/functions/resolve-reply-token?token=' + encodeURIComponent(replyToken))
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          if (data.error) return;
          // Show a banner so user knows who they're replying to
          var personaDisplay = (data.persona_emoji || '🎭') + ' ' + (data.persona_display_name || 'Someone special');
          var banner = document.createElement('div');
          banner.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(255,225,53,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,225,53,0.25);'
            + 'border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:14px;text-align:center;';
          banner.innerHTML = '💌 Sending a reply to <strong>' + personaDisplay + '</strong><br>'
            + '<span style="font-size:12px;opacity:0.6;">Their identity stays hidden — they\'ll get a surprise gift notification</span>';
          var studio = document.getElementById('studio-wrap') || document.querySelector('.studio-steps');
          if (studio) studio.insertBefore(banner, studio.firstChild);
        })
        .catch(function () {}); // non-fatal
    } else {
      // Standard gift reply — pre-fill recipient from URL params
      var preRecipName  = params.get('recipient_name')  || '';
      var preRecipPhone = params.get('recipient_phone') || '';
      if (refParam === 'gift_reply') {
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('zg_order_ref', 'gift_reply'); } catch(e) {}
        if (preRecipName)  state.recipientName = preRecipName;
        if (preRecipPhone) state.phone = preRecipPhone.replace(/^\+?91/, '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10);
        var _prefillDone = false;
        var _prefillObs  = new MutationObserver(function() {
          var ri = document.getElementById('f-recipient-name');
          var pi = document.getElementById('f-phone');
          if (ri && !_prefillDone) {
            _prefillDone = true;
            if (preRecipName)  { ri.value = preRecipName;  state.recipientName = preRecipName; }
            if (preRecipPhone) {
              var cleaned = preRecipPhone.replace(/^\+?91/, '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10);
              if (pi) { pi.value = cleaned; state.phone = cleaned; }
            }
            _prefillObs.disconnect();
          }
        });
        _prefillObs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    }
  });

  // Group 3: expose internal state so studio-group3.js can read/write vibe, type, etc.
  window.ZGStudioState = state;

})();

// Classic script (no import/export) so it loads correctly under file://,
// behind strict corporate proxies, and anywhere ES module CORS rules would
// otherwise silently break the page. Depends on the Supabase UMD bundle
// being loaded first via a plain <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...">
// tag in the HTML, which sets window.supabase = { createClient }.
(function () {
  var cfg = window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG || {};
  var isConfigured =
    cfg.SUPABASE_URL &&
    cfg.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY &&
    cfg.SUPABASE_URL.indexOf('YOUR-PROJECT') === -1;

  var client = null;
  if (isConfigured && window.supabase && typeof window.supabase.createClient === 'function') {
    try {
      client = window.supabase.createClient(cfg.SUPABASE_URL, cfg.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Could not create Supabase client:', e);
    }
  }

  // window.ZGSupabase is null until js/config.js has real values in it — every
  // other script checks for that before trying to use it, and falls back to
  // local/demo behavior instead of throwing.
  window.ZGSupabase = client;

  window.ZGAuth = {
    getSession: function () {
      if (!client) return Promise.resolve(null);
      return client.auth.getSession().then(function (res) {
        return (res.data && res.data.session) || null;
      });
    },
    getCurrentUser: function () {
      return window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
        return session ? session.user : null;
      });
    },
    requireAuthToken: function () {
      return window.ZGAuth.getSession().then(function (session) {
        return session ? session.access_token : null;
      });
    },
    signOut: function () {
      var done = client ? client.auth.signOut() : Promise.resolve();
      return done.then(function () {
        window.location.href = 'index.html';
      });
    },
  };
})();

// Presentation-only behavior: navbar scroll state, hamburger menu, scroll-reveal
// animation, ticker content, hero entrance, WhatsApp button link.
//
// Deliberately a plain classic script with ZERO imports — this must keep working
// even if the Supabase/Cashfree CDN scripts are slow, blocked, or fail outright
// (corporate networks, ad blockers, sandboxed previews, etc). Nothing the visitor
// needs to *see* the page should depend on a third-party script loading.
(function () {
  function ready(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  ready(function () {
    // ---- Hero entrance: visible by default in CSS; this just adds a staggered fade-in ----
    var enterEls = document.querySelectorAll('[data-enter]');
    enterEls.forEach(function (el, i) {
      el.classList.add('enter-pending');
      setTimeout(function () {
        el.classList.add('enter-visible');
      }, 120 + i * 110);
    });

    // ---- Scroll reveal for section content ----
    var observer = null;
    function observeReveal(scope) {
      var revealEls = (scope || document).querySelectorAll('.reveal:not(.pre-reveal):not(.visible)');
      if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || !revealEls.length) return;
      if (!observer) {
        observer = new IntersectionObserver(
          function (entries) {
            entries.forEach(function (entry) {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.remove('pre-reveal');
                entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                observer.unobserve(entry.target);
              }
            });
          },
          { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' }
        );
      }
      revealEls.forEach(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('pre-reveal');
        observer.observe(el);
      });
    }
    observeReveal(document);
    // catalog.js calls this after it injects product cards, so they get the
    // same reveal treatment. Elements default to visible (opacity:1) in CSS,
    // so if this never runs for any reason, nothing is left stuck invisible.
    window.ZGReobserveReveal = function () { observeReveal(document); };
    // If IntersectionObserver isn't supported, .reveal elements simply stay at
    // their CSS default (opacity:1) — visible, just without the animation.

    // ---- Navbar background on scroll ----
    var navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
      if (navbar) navbar.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 30);
    });

    // ---- Mobile menu ----
    var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    var navLinks = document.getElementById('nav-links');
    if (hamburger && navLinks) {
      hamburger.addEventListener('click', function () {
        navLinks.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
      });
      navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (a) {
        a.addEventListener('click', function () {
          navLinks.classList.remove('mobile-open');
        });
      });
    }

    // ---- Ticker content (the bar itself is in the HTML already as a fallback) ----
    var tickerHost = document.getElementById('ticker-inner');
    if (tickerHost) {
      var items = ['🎂 Birthdays', '💸 Birthday serial notes', '💍 Anniversaries', '🎓 Farewell gifts', '🌙 Midnight drops', '👫 Squad gifting', '📦 Premium packaging', '✍️ Personalised notes'];
      var strip = items.map(function (i) { return '<span class="ticker-item">' + i + ' •</span>'; }).join('');
      tickerHost.innerHTML = strip + strip;
    }

    // ---- WhatsApp floating button ----
    var waBtn = document.getElementById('wa-btn');
    if (waBtn && window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG && window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG.WHATSAPP_NUMBER) {
      waBtn.href = 'https://wa.me/' + window.ZIVOGIFT_CONFIG.WHATSAPP_NUMBER;
    }
  });
})();

/* js/vibe-tokens.js
 *
 * THE canonical vibe palette for ZivoGift. Single source of truth.
 *
 * Before this file existed the same palette was hand-maintained in FIVE places:
 *   js/studio.js (preview objects), netlify/functions/generate-card-image.js,
 *   netlify/functions/_lib/resend.js, netlify/functions/_lib/clipFrames.js
 *   and gift.html. They had already drifted — `squad_memory_board` and
 *   `personal_message` existed only in the email copy, `campus_legend` and
 *   `zivo_pass_gold` only in the card copy — which is why an emailed gift did
 *   not look like the card, and neither looked like the studio preview.
 *
 * UMD on purpose: this loads as a plain <script> in the browser (sets
 * window.ZG_VIBE_TOKENS) AND is require()-able from the Netlify Functions.
 * esbuild (node_bundler = "esbuild" in netlify.toml) inlines the relative
 * require at bundle time, so there is no runtime file read and nothing needs
 * to go into included_files.
 *
 * Adding a vibe: add it HERE and nowhere else.
 *   bg1/bg2 — gradient stops   accent — highlight   text — body copy
 *   motif   — vector motif key drawn server-side (see generate-card-image.js).
 *             Deliberately NOT an emoji: the Lambda image has no emoji font,
 *             so an emoji glyph rasterizes as a tofu box on the PNG.
 *   emoji   — client-side only (email HTML + gift.html), where real emoji
 *             fonts exist.
 *   font    — CSS family hint for the card layout.
 */
(function (root, factory) {
  var tokens = factory();
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = tokens;                 // Netlify Functions
  }
  if (root) {
    root.ZG_VIBE_TOKENS = tokens;            // browser
  }
})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this, function () {
  'use strict';

  var VIBES = {

    cosmic_dream:   { bg1:'#1a0a3a', bg2:'#050212', accent:'#A855F7', text:'#E8D5FF', motif:'stars',   emoji:'\uD83C\uDF0C', font:'sans-serif' },
    neon_rave:      { bg1:'#001208', bg2:'#002510', accent:'#39FF14', text:'#ffffff', motif:'bolt',    emoji:'\u26A1',       font:'monospace'  },
    golden_legacy:  { bg1:'#120e00', bg2:'#0d0900', accent:'#D4A017', text:'#FFF8DC', motif:'crown',   emoji:'\uD83D\uDC51', font:'sans-serif' },
    soft_pastel:    { bg1:'#1a0020', bg2:'#0d0018', accent:'#EC4899', text:'#FFD6F0', motif:'bloom',   emoji:'\uD83C\uDF38', font:'cursive'    },
    // Universal "proud / driven" vibe — reads right for graduation, promotion,

    motivation:     { bg1:'#001528', bg2:'#04223a', accent:'#FFB020', text:'#DCEEFF', motif:'trophy',  emoji:'\uD83D\uDE80', font:'sans-serif' },

    anon_mystery:   { bg1:'#060608', bg2:'#101014', accent:'#A080C0', text:'#E0D8F0', motif:'orb',     emoji:'\uD83D\uDD2E', font:'monospace'  },
    // ── Group 4 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    roast_certificate:  { bg1:'#1a1502', bg2:'#0d0a00', accent:'#D4A017', text:'#FFF4D6', motif:'seal',  emoji:'\uD83D\uDCDC', font:'serif'      },
    horoscope_drop:     { bg1:'#170028', bg2:'#05000d', accent:'#B490FF', text:'#E8D8FF', motif:'orb',   emoji:'\uD83D\uDD2E', font:'sans-serif' },
    exam_survival_kit:  { bg1:'#00121f', bg2:'#001830', accent:'#FFB020', text:'#DCEEFF', motif:'book',  emoji:'\uD83D\uDCDA', font:'sans-serif' },
    squad_memory_board: { bg1:'#2a1400', bg2:'#120800', accent:'#FF9A56', text:'#FFF3E0', motif:'frame', emoji:'\uD83D\uDCF8', font:'sans-serif' },
    personal_message:   { bg1:'#101018', bg2:'#05050a', accent:'#FF9A56', text:'#F2ECE4', motif:'wave',  emoji:'\uD83C\uDF99', font:'sans-serif' },
    // ── Group 5 — exclusive vibes (unlock rules live in `exclusive_vibes`) ─
    campus_legend:  { bg1:'#120a00', bg2:'#241400', accent:'#E8B923', text:'#FFF6DC', motif:'crown',  emoji:'\uD83D\uDC51', font:'sans-serif' },
    zivo_pass_gold: { bg1:'#160018', bg2:'#2a0a1a', accent:'#F4C542', text:'#FFEFD0', motif:'gem',    emoji:'\uD83D\uDC8E', font:'serif'      },
  };

  var DEFAULT_KEY = 'confetti_pop';

  /**
   * Resolves a vibe key to its tokens.
   *
   * Resolution order is vibe_key → gift_type → default. The old per-file
   * copies silently fell through to a hard-coded confetti-pop object, so an
   * unrecognised vibe rendered as a DIFFERENT, real-looking vibe and nobody
   * noticed. This logs instead, and tells the caller it fell back.
   *
   * @returns {{bg1,bg2,accent,text,motif,emoji,font,key,resolved:boolean}}
   */
  function resolveVibe(vibeKey, giftType) {
    var hit = (vibeKey && VIBES[vibeKey]) ? vibeKey
            : (giftType && VIBES[giftType]) ? giftType
            : null;

    if (!hit) {
      if (vibeKey || giftType) {
        try {
          console.warn('[vibe-tokens] unknown vibe_key="' + vibeKey + '" gift_type="' +
                       giftType + '" — falling back to ' + DEFAULT_KEY);
        } catch (e) { /* no console in some rasterizer contexts */ }
      }
      hit = DEFAULT_KEY;
      return assign({}, VIBES[hit], { key: hit, resolved: false });
    }
    return assign({}, VIBES[hit], { key: hit, resolved: true });
  }

  // Object.assign shim — gift.html targets older mobile Safari.
  function assign(target) {
    for (var i = 1; i < arguments.length; i++) {
      var src = arguments[i];
      if (!src) continue;
      for (var k in src) {
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(src, k)) target[k] = src[k];
      }
    }
    return target;
  }

  return {
    VIBES: VIBES,
    DEFAULT_KEY: DEFAULT_KEY,
    DEFAULT: VIBES[DEFAULT_KEY],
    resolveVibe: resolveVibe,
    keys: function () { return Object.keys(VIBES); },
  };
});

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT — STUDENT VIBES JS
   Floating particles, animated counters, campus scroll, vibe reveal

(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ── 1. FLOATING CURRENCY PARTICLES ──────────────────────────────────────
  function initParticles() {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'particles-canvas';
    document.body.insertBefore(canvas, document.body.firstChild);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    function resize() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    const symbols = ['₹', '💸', '✨', '🎂', '💝', '🎁'];
    const particles = [];
    const N = window.innerWidth < 700 ? 12 : 22;

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * window.innerWidth,
        y: Math.random() * window.innerHeight,
        size: 10 + Math.random() * 14,
        speed: .15 + Math.random() * .3,
        drift: (Math.random() - .5) * .3,
        opacity: .03 + Math.random() * .06,
        symbol: symbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * symbols.length)],
        rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        rotSpeed: (Math.random() - .5) * .008,
      });
    }

    function draw() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(p => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.opacity;
        ctx.font = `${p.size}px serif`;
        ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.rotate(p.rotation);
        ctx.fillText(p.symbol, 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();

        p.y -= p.speed;
        p.x += p.drift;
        p.rotation += p.rotSpeed;

        if (p.y < -40) {
          p.y = canvas.height + 40;
          p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
        }
        if (p.x < -40) p.x = canvas.width + 40;
        if (p.x > canvas.width + 40) p.x = -40;
      });
      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    draw();
  }

  // ── 2. ANIMATED COUNTERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function animateCounter(el, target, suffix) {
    let start = 0;
    const duration = 1600;
    const startTime = performance.now();
    function step(now) {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const val = Math.floor(eased * target);
      el.textContent = val.toLocaleString('en-IN') + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  // ── 3. VIBE STRIP COUNTERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  function initVibeStrip() {
    const section = document.getElementById('vibe-strip');
    if (!section) return;
    let triggered = false;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (entries[0].isIntersecting && !triggered) {
        triggered = true;
        section.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => {
          const target = parseInt(el.dataset.count, 10);
          const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || '';
          animateCounter(el, target, suffix);
        });
      }
    }, { threshold: .3 });
    obs.observe(section);
  }

  // ── 4. VIBE SCROLL REVEAL ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function initVibeReveal() {
    const els = document.querySelectorAll('.vibe-in');
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
          e.target.classList.add('vibe-visible');
          obs.unobserve(e.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: .12 });
    els.forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
  }

  // ── 5. CAMPUS SCROLL DUPLICATION ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function initCampusScroll() {
    const scroll = document.querySelector('.campus-scroll');
    if (!scroll) return;
    const items = scroll.innerHTML;
    scroll.innerHTML = items + items; // seamless loop
  }

  // ── 6. HERO SERIAL NUMBER TYPEWRITER ────────────────────────────────────
  function initSerialTypewriter() {
    const code = document.querySelector('.serial-demo-code');
    const demos = [
      { date: '12 · 05 · 2001', code: '3AK 120501' },
      { date: '07 · 08 · 1999', code: '5BM 070899' },
      { date: '25 · 12 · 2003', code: '2CK 251203' },
      { date: '14 · 02 · 2000', code: '4DR 140200' },
    ];
    let idx = 0;
    const dateEl = document.querySelector('.serial-demo-date');
    if (!code || !dateEl) return;

    setInterval(() => {
      idx = (idx + 1) % demos.length;
      const d = demos[idx];
      // fade out
      code.style.opacity = '0';
      dateEl.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => {
        code.textContent = d.code;
        dateEl.textContent = d.date;
        code.style.opacity = '1';
        dateEl.style.opacity = '1';
      }, 400);
    }, 3000);

    code.style.transition = 'opacity .4s';
    dateEl.style.transition = 'opacity .4s';
  }

  // ── 7. VIBE BADGE DISMISS ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  function initVibeBadge() {
    const badge = document.querySelector('.vibe-badge');
    if (!badge) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
      badge.style.transition = 'opacity .5s, transform .5s';
      badge.style.opacity = '0';
      badge.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%) translateY(-10px)';
      setTimeout(() => badge.remove(), 500);
    }, 4000);
  }

  // ── 8. PRODUCT CARD EMOJI BOUNCE ON HOVER ───────────────────────────────
  function initCardHover() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-card, .squad-card, .denom-card').forEach(card => {
      const emoji = card.querySelector('.product-img, .squad-icon, .denom-face');
      if (!emoji) return;
      card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        emoji.style.transition = 'transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)';
        emoji.style.transform = 'scale(1.15) rotate(-5deg)';
      });
      card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        emoji.style.transform = '';
      });
    });
  }

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    if (!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      initParticles();
    }
    initVibeStrip();
    initVibeReveal();
    initCampusScroll();
    initSerialTypewriter();
    initVibeBadge();
    initCardHover();
  });
})();

// ── STICKY NOTE INTERACTIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
(function initStickyNotes() {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const notes = document.querySelectorAll('.sticky-note');
    
    // Click to pop/wiggle
    notes.forEach(note => {
      note.addEventListener('click', () => {
        note.style.transition = 'transform .15s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)';
        const r = parseFloat(note.style.animationName) || 0;
        note.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
        note.style.transform = `scale(1.18) rotate(${(Math.random()-0.5)*12}deg)`;
        setTimeout(() => {
          note.style.transform = '';
          note.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
        }, 350);
      });
    });

    // Stagger animation start times so they don't all move in sync
    notes.forEach((note, i) => {
      note.style.animationDelay = `${-(i * 1.3)}s`;
    });

    // Random new sticky note drops in from top occasionally
    const messages = [
      { emoji: '🥳', text: 'Squad ka fav!',    color: 'sn-yellow' },
      { emoji: '💌', text: 'From your bestie', color: 'sn-pink'   },
      { emoji: '🎉', text: 'Surprise loading…',color: 'sn-mint'   },
      { emoji: '🤍', text: 'Made with love',   color: 'sn-white'  },
      { emoji: '🔢', text: '14·02·2002 ✓',    color: 'sn-lavender'},
      { emoji: '🎁', text: 'Senti gift unlocked', color: 'sn-peach'},
    ];
    let dropIdx = 0;
    const hero = document.getElementById('hero');
    if (!hero) return;

    function dropNote() {
      const m = messages[dropIdx % messages.length];
      dropIdx++;
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = `sticky-note ${m.color}`;
      el.style.cssText = `
        position:absolute;
        left:${8 + Math.random() * 84}%;
        top:-60px;
        transform:rotate(${(Math.random()-0.5)*12}deg);
        opacity:0;
        transition:opacity .5s, top 1.2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
        z-index:4;
        pointer-events:none;
      `;
      el.innerHTML = `<span class="sn-emoji">${m.emoji}</span><span class="sn-text">${m.text}</span>`;
      hero.appendChild(el);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        el.style.opacity = '1';
        el.style.top = `${15 + Math.random() * 65}%`;
      });
      // fade out after 4s
      setTimeout(() => {
        el.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 600);
      }, 4200);
    }

    // Drop one note every ~12 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      dropNote();
      setInterval(dropNote, 12000);
    }, 6000);
  });
})();

FILE: netlify\fonts\README.md
=====================================================

# netlify/fonts

This directory is why card text renders at all.

Sharp rasterizes SVG through **librsvg**, which resolves every `font-family`
through **fontconfig**. The Netlify Functions Lambda image ships **no fonts**.
Geometry (rects, circles, gradients) is font-independent so it draws normally,
but every `<text>` / `<tspan>` resolves to no font and rasterizes to nothing —
which is why gift cards and share clips came out looking correct and completely
wordless.

## What lives here

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `fonts.conf` | Self-contained fontconfig **template**. `__ZG_FONT_DIR__` is substituted at cold start by `netlify/functions/_lib/cardFonts.js`, which writes the resolved copy to `/tmp` and points `FONTCONFIG_FILE` at it. It deliberately includes no system font directories, so a card renders identically on your laptop and on a bare Lambda. |
| `*.ttf` | The fonts themselves. **Not committed by default** — run the fetch script below. |
| `OFL.txt` | Licence notice, written by the fetch script. |

## Populate it

```bash
node scripts/fetch-fonts.js
git add netlify/fonts/*.ttf
git commit -m "Bundle card rendering fonts"
```

`npm install` also runs this via `postinstall`, so a clean Netlify build
populates the directory before functions are bundled. **Committing the TTFs is
still safer** — it means the deploy never depends on Google Fonts being
reachable during the build window.

## If you skip this

`_lib/cardFonts.js` refuses to rasterize when the directory contains no font
files, so `generate-card-image` returns 500, `gift-scheduler` retries four
times and then alerts `ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL`. That is deliberate: a loud failure
beats silently mailing blank cards, which is what happened before.

Note the refusal is a **pure-JS pre-flight check on the file list**, not a
render attempt. librsvg does not degrade gracefully with an empty font path —
it segfaults the process (verified: exit 139), and a segfault cannot be caught
in JavaScript.

## Do not

- Remove `included_files = ["netlify/fonts/**"]` from `netlify.toml`.
- `require('sharp')` anywhere except `_lib/cardFonts.js`. The native binding
  reads `FONTCONFIG_PATH` once, at initialisation — whoever requires it first
  wins, and if that happens before cardFonts sets the env vars, the fonts are
  invisible.

FILE: netlify\functions\abandoned-cart-scheduler.js

// netlify/functions/abandoned-cart-scheduler.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs hourly (see netlify.toml).
//
// AUDIT FINDING #8: orders were created with status 'pending_payment' before
// the customer was handed to Cashfree, and NOTHING ever followed up on the
// ones that never came back. Those people chose a gift, filled in a delivery
// address and reached the payment page — the highest-intent traffic the site
// ever sees — and then hit some friction: a declined card, a UPI timeout, a
// phone call, second thoughts about the delivery fee.
//
// One email, sent once, recovering even a small share of them is typically
// the highest-ROI automation an e-commerce site of this size can run.
//
// ── THE RULES, AND WHY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Timing lives in public.v_abandoned_checkouts (70_pipeline_fixes.sql), not
// here, so there is one definition rather than two that can drift:
//
//   • older than 1 hour  — never interrupt someone who is still paying right
//                          now, or stuck on a slow bank OTP screen
//   • newer than 7 days  — past a week the email reads as strange, and this
//                          ceiling also stops the FIRST deploy from mailing
//                          years of historical rows in one burst, which every
//                          mailbox provider would read as a spam run
//   • recovery_email_sent_at IS NULL — exactly one email per order, ever
//
// ── WHY ONLY ONE EMAIL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A 3-email "recovery sequence" converts marginally better and annoys people
// considerably more. With no laptop to monitor complaint rates, one polite
// email is the right risk trade.
//
// ── SUPPRESSION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// This sits on the line between transactional and marketing: it refers to a
// specific order THEY started, but its purpose is commercial. It is therefore
// treated as marketing — it honours marketing_optouts and carries an
// unsubscribe link, exactly like a campaign.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendEmail, abandonedCheckoutEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');
const { guardSchedulers } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');
const { loadSuppressionSet, isSuppressed } = require('./_lib/suppression');
const { unsubUrl } = require('./_lib/unsubToken');

// Small batch on purpose. Recovery email is never urgent, and a slow drip
// protects sender reputation far better than a burst. Hourly x 25 = up to 600
// a day, which is vastly more headroom than this volume needs.
const BATCH_SIZE = 25;

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const halted = await guardSchedulers(supabase, 'abandoned-cart-scheduler');
  if (halted) return halted;

  const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';

  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from('v_abandoned_checkouts')
    .select('*')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (error) {
    console.error('abandoned-cart-scheduler: query failed:', error.message,
      '-- has supabase/consolidated/70_pipeline_fixes.sql been run?');
    return { statusCode: 500, body: error.message };
  }
  if (!rows || !rows.length) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'No abandoned checkouts to recover.' };
  }

  const suppression = await loadSuppressionSet(supabase);

  let sent = 0, skipped = 0, failed = 0;

  for (const order of rows) {
    try {
      if (isSuppressed(suppression, { phone: order.phone10, email: order.contact_email })) {
        // Stamp it anyway. Otherwise this row is re-examined every single hour
        // forever, and the suppressed customer sits permanently at the front
        // of the queue blocking the batch.
        await stamp(supabase, order.id);
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      const { data: items } = await supabase
        .from('order_items')
        .select('name_snapshot, recipient_name, qty')
        .eq('order_id', order.id);

      // ── RE-CHECK THE STATUS IMMEDIATELY BEFORE SENDING ─────────────────
      // The view was read at the top of this run. If the Cashfree webhook
      // landed in the meantime, that customer has now PAID — and telling a
      // paying customer "you did not finish your order" is worse than sending
      // nothing at all. Cheap query, and it closes a real race.
      const { data: fresh } = await supabase
        .from('orders').select('status').eq('id', order.id).maybeSingle();
      if (!fresh || fresh.status !== 'pending_payment') {
        await stamp(supabase, order.id);
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      const unsubscribeUrl = unsubUrl({
        email: order.contact_email,
        phone10: order.phone10,
        campaignId: null,
      });

      const res = await sendEmail({
        to: order.contact_email,
        subject: `Your Zivogift order is still waiting — ${order.order_number}`,
        html: abandonedCheckoutEmail(order, items || [], siteUrl, unsubscribeUrl),
        headers: {
          'List-Unsubscribe': `<${unsubscribeUrl}>`,
          'List-Unsubscribe-Post': 'List-Unsubscribe=One-Click',
        },
      });

      if (res.skipped) {
        // RESEND_API_KEY missing. Do NOT stamp — nothing was sent, and
        // stamping would permanently consume the one email this order gets.
        console.warn('abandoned-cart-scheduler: RESEND_API_KEY not set — nothing sent, order left for retry.');
        failed++;
        continue;
      }

      await stamp(supabase, order.id);
      sent++;
      console.log(`abandoned-cart-scheduler: recovery email sent for ${order.order_number}`);

    } catch (e) {
      // A hard send failure (bad address, provider reject) still gets stamped:
      // the address will not improve on retry, and an un-stamped row would
      // block the batch every hour forever.
      console.error(`abandoned-cart-scheduler: failed for ${order.order_number}:`, (e && e.message) || e);
      await stamp(supabase, order.id).catch(() => {});
      failed++;
    }
  }

  const summary = { examined: rows.length, sent, skipped, failed };
  console.log('abandoned-cart-scheduler complete:', JSON.stringify(summary));
  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify(summary) };
};

async function stamp(supabase, orderId) {
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .update({ recovery_email_sent_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('id', orderId);
  if (error) {
    console.warn(`abandoned-cart-scheduler: could not stamp order ${orderId}: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

// GET /.netlify/functions/admin-analytics  (Run 6 — Admin BI)
// Returns revenue + gift-performance + delivery-health + failed-deliveries.
// AUTH: verifies the caller's Supabase token and checks ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist
// (comma-separated env). Fails CLOSED if ADMIN_EMAILS is unset. Align with your
// other admin functions if they gate differently.
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { aggregateGiftStats, buildFailedList, aggregateRevenue, ordersByDay } = require('./_lib/analytics-core');

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const ANON_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

function adminEmails() {
  return String(process.env.ADMIN_EMAILS || '').split(',').map(function (s) { return s.trim().toLowerCase(); }).filter(Boolean);
}
async function verifyAdmin(authHeader) {
  const token = String(authHeader || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return null;
  const c = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, ANON_KEY);
  const { data, error } = await c.auth.getUser(token);
  if (error || !data || !data.user) return null;
  const email = String(data.user.email || '').toLowerCase();
  const allow = adminEmails();
  if (!allow.length) return null;                 // fail closed
  return allow.indexOf(email) !== -1 ? email : null;
}

async function _process(supabase) {
  const { data: sends, error: sErr } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('id, status, gift_type, channel, sent_at, opened_at, reveal_completed_at, reaction, first_open_delay_seconds, attempts, error_message, recipient_name, created_at, is_time_capsule');
  if (sErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: { error: 'sends_query_failed', detail: sErr.message } };

  let orders = [];
  try { const { data: o } = await supabase.from('orders').select('*').limit(5000); orders = o || []; } catch (e) { orders = []; }

  let squadSubmitted = 0;
  try {
    const { count } = await supabase.from('gift_reactions').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).not('video_url', 'is', null);
    squadSubmitted = count || 0;
  } catch (e) { squadSubmitted = 0; }

  return { statusCode: 200, body: {
    generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    gifts: aggregateGiftStats(sends || []),
    revenue: aggregateRevenue(orders),
    squad_videos_submitted: squadSubmitted,
    failed_deliveries: buildFailedList(sends || [], 100),
    orders_trend: ordersByDay(orders)
  } };
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  try {
    const who = await verifyAdmin(event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization);
    if (!who) return { statusCode: 403, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'forbidden' }) };
    const res = await _process(getSupabaseAdmin());
    return { statusCode: res.statusCode, headers, body: JSON.stringify(res.body) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('admin-analytics fatal:', e && e.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'server_error' }) };
  }
};

module.exports._process = _process;

FILE: netlify\functions\admin-campaigns.js

// netlify/functions/admin-campaigns.js
//
// The Campaign Center API. One endpoint, action-dispatched, because Netlify
// bills per function and eleven tiny functions would be eleven cold starts.
//
//   GET  ?action=segments            -> segment list + live reachable counts
//   GET  ?action=list                -> recent campaigns with progress
//   GET  ?action=detail&id=...       -> one campaign + recipient breakdown
//   GET  ?action=templates           -> approved MARKETING WhatsApp templates
//   POST {action:'preview'}          -> audience stats WITHOUT creating anything
//   POST {action:'save'}             -> create/update a draft
//   POST {action:'test'}             -> send ONLY to the admin, nothing stored
//   POST {action:'launch'}           -> materialise recipients, set status
//   POST {action:'pause'|'resume'|'cancel'}
//   POST {action:'retry_failed'}     -> requeue this campaign's failures
//
// SAFETY MODEL -- the three things that stop a mistake becoming 5000 messages:
//   1. preview  : you see the exact reachable count before anything is written
//   2. test     : you send the real rendered email/WhatsApp to yourself only
//   3. launch   : requires confirm:true AND the expected_count you were shown.
//                 If the audience has changed since the preview, launch is
//                 REJECTED rather than silently sending to a different list.
//
// Launch does NOT send. It only writes campaign_recipients rows with
// status='queued'. campaign-sender.js (cron) does the sending in batches of
// 20, which is the same batch size gift-scheduler.js already uses against the
// same provider APIs.

const { withAdmin, json, parseBody } = require('./_lib/adminAuth');
const { segmentList, resolveAudience, firstName } = require('./_lib/audience');
const { renderCampaignEmail, unsubHeaders } = require('./_lib/campaignEmail');
const { sendEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate, describeTemplates } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
const { getSettings } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');

const VALID_CHANNELS = ['email', 'whatsapp', 'both'];
const EDITABLE_STATES = ['draft', 'scheduled'];

exports.handler = withAdmin(async (event, { admin, supabase }) => {
  const qs = event.queryStringParameters || {};
  const body = parseBody(event);
  const action = String(body.action || qs.action || 'list').toLowerCase();

  switch (action) {
    case 'segments': return await handleSegments(supabase);
    case 'list':     return await handleList(supabase);
    case 'detail':   return await handleDetail(supabase, qs.id || body.id);
    case 'templates':return await handleTemplates();
    case 'preview':  return await handlePreview(supabase, body);
    case 'save':     return await handleSave(supabase, body, admin);
    case 'test':     return await handleTest(supabase, body, admin);
    case 'launch':   return await handleLaunch(supabase, body);
    case 'pause':    return await handleState(supabase, body.id, 'paused', ['sending', 'scheduled']);
    case 'resume':   return await handleState(supabase, body.id, 'sending', ['paused']);
    case 'cancel':   return await handleState(supabase, body.id, 'cancelled', ['draft', 'scheduled', 'sending', 'paused']);
    case 'retry_failed': return await handleRetryFailed(supabase, body.id);
    default:
      return json(400, { error: 'unknown_action', detail: `"${action}" is not a valid action.` });
  }
});

// ── SEGMENTS (with live counts) ────────────────────────────────────────────
// Counts are computed for real, not estimated, because the whole safety model
// depends on the number you see being the number that gets messaged.
async function handleSegments(supabase) {
  const segments = segmentList();
  const out = [];
  for (const s of segments) {
    try {
      const { stats } = await resolveAudience(supabase, s.key, 'both');
      out.push({ ...s, matched: stats.matched, reachable: stats.reachable, email: stats.email_recipients, whatsapp: stats.whatsapp_recipients, opted_out: stats.opted_out });
    } catch (e) {
      out.push({ ...s, error: String((e && e.message) || e) });
    }
  }
  const settings = await getSettings(supabase);
  return json(200, { segments: out, settings });
}

// ── LIST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleList(supabase) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('campaigns')
    .select('id, name, channel, segment, subject, status, scheduled_at, started_at, completed_at, total_recipients, sent_count, failed_count, is_automated, created_at')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(100);
  if (error) return json(500, { error: 'list_failed', detail: error.message });
  return json(200, { campaigns: data || [] });
}

// ── DETAIL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleDetail(supabase, id) {
  if (!id) return json(400, { error: 'missing_id' });

  const { data: campaign, error } = await supabase.from('campaigns').select('*').eq('id', id).single();
  if (error || !campaign) return json(404, { error: 'not_found', detail: error && error.message });

  const { data: recips } = await supabase
    .from('campaign_recipients')
    .select('status, channel, wa_status, error_message')
    .eq('campaign_id', id)
    .limit(5000);

  const breakdown = {};
  const errors = {};
  for (const r of recips || []) {
    const k = `${r.channel}_${r.status}`;
    breakdown[k] = (breakdown[k] || 0) + 1;
    if (r.status === 'failed' && r.error_message) {
      const key = String(r.error_message).slice(0, 120);
      errors[key] = (errors[key] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  // Grouped error reasons, not a raw list -- 400 rows of the same Meta error
  // tell you one thing, and you need to read it once, on a phone.
  const topErrors = Object.keys(errors)
    .map((k) => ({ reason: k, count: errors[k] }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count).slice(0, 10);

  return json(200, { campaign, breakdown, top_errors: topErrors, sampled: (recips || []).length });
}

// ── WHATSAPP TEMPLATES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Read LIVE from Meta via the existing describeTemplates() helper, rather
// than from a hardcoded list. That means a newly-approved marketing template
// shows up in the dropdown with no redeploy -- which matters because template
// approval happens on Meta's schedule, not yours.
async function handleTemplates() {
  // Shape returned by _lib/whatsapp.js describeTemplates():
  //   { available:boolean, reason?:string, templates:[{ name, language, status,
  //     category, bodyParamCount, headerFormat, headerParamCount,
  //     dynamicUrlButtonIndex }] }
  // It never throws -- it reports `available:false` with a reason instead.
  const res = await describeTemplates();
  const list = (res && res.templates) || [];

  const normalised = list.map((t) => ({
    name: t.name,
    status: t.status,
    language: t.language,
    category: t.category,
    bodyParamCount: t.bodyParamCount,
    headerFormat: t.headerFormat,
  }));

  const marketing = normalised.filter(
    (t) => String(t.status).toUpperCase() === 'APPROVED' &&
           String(t.category || '').toUpperCase() === 'MARKETING'
  );

  let note = null;
  if (!res || res.available === false) {
    note = `WhatsApp template list unavailable: ${(res && res.reason) || 'unknown'}. ` +
           `Set WHATSAPP_WABA_ID in Netlify to read your approved templates. Email campaigns are unaffected.`;
  } else if (!marketing.length) {
    note = 'No APPROVED template in the MARKETING category exists on this WhatsApp Business Account. ' +
           'Meta does not permit bulk promotional messages on UTILITY templates, so WhatsApp campaigns ' +
           'cannot run until a MARKETING template is approved. Email campaigns are unaffected.';
  }

  return json(200, { available: !!(res && res.available), marketing, all: normalised, note });
}

// ── VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function validate(c) {
  const errs = [];
  if (!String(c.name || '').trim()) errs.push('Campaign name is required.');
  if (!String(c.body || '').trim()) errs.push('Message body is required.');
  if (VALID_CHANNELS.indexOf(c.channel) === -1) errs.push(`Channel must be one of: ${VALID_CHANNELS.join(', ')}.`);
  if ((c.channel === 'email' || c.channel === 'both') && !String(c.subject || '').trim()) {
    errs.push('An email subject is required for email campaigns.');
  }
  if ((c.channel === 'whatsapp' || c.channel === 'both') && !String(c.wa_template || '').trim()) {
    errs.push('A WhatsApp template name is required for WhatsApp campaigns. Free-text bulk WhatsApp is not permitted by Meta.');
  }
  if (String(c.body || '').length > 4000) errs.push('Message body is too long (max 4000 characters).');
  return errs;
}

// ── PREVIEW ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handlePreview(supabase, body) {
  const channel = VALID_CHANNELS.indexOf(body.channel) !== -1 ? body.channel : 'email';
  try {
    const { recipients, stats } = await resolveAudience(supabase, body.segment || 'all', channel);
    // A handful of real names so you can sanity-check the list is who you think.
    const sample = recipients.slice(0, 5).map((r) => ({
      name: r.full_name,
      email: r.email ? maskEmail(r.email) : null,
      phone: r.phone10 ? `${r.phone10.slice(0, 2)}xxxxx${r.phone10.slice(-3)}` : null,
    }));
    return json(200, { stats, sample, validation: validate(body) });
  } catch (e) {
    return json(400, { error: 'preview_failed', detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
  }
}

function maskEmail(e) {
  const [u, d] = String(e).split('@');
  if (!d) return e;
  return `${u.slice(0, 2)}${'*'.repeat(Math.max(1, u.length - 2))}@${d}`;
}

// ── SAVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleSave(supabase, body, admin) {
  const errs = validate(body);
  if (errs.length) return json(400, { error: 'validation_failed', detail: errs.join(' ') });

  const patch = {
    name: String(body.name).trim(),
    channel: body.channel,
    segment: body.segment || 'all',
    subject: body.subject ? String(body.subject).trim() : null,
    body: String(body.body).trim(),
    cta_url: body.cta_url || null,
    cta_label: body.cta_label || null,
    wa_template: body.wa_template || null,
    scheduled_at: body.scheduled_at || null,
    status: body.scheduled_at ? 'scheduled' : 'draft',
  };

  if (body.id) {
    const { data: existing } = await supabase.from('campaigns').select('status').eq('id', body.id).single();
    if (existing && EDITABLE_STATES.indexOf(existing.status) === -1) {
      return json(409, { error: 'not_editable', detail: `A campaign that is "${existing.status}" can no longer be edited. Duplicate it instead.` });
    }
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('campaigns').update(patch).eq('id', body.id).select().single();
    if (error) return json(500, { error: 'save_failed', detail: error.message });
    return json(200, { campaign: data, created: false });
  }

  patch.created_by = admin.userId;
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('campaigns').insert(patch).select().single();
  if (error) return json(500, { error: 'save_failed', detail: error.message });
  return json(200, { campaign: data, created: true });
}

// ── TEST SEND ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Sends the REAL rendered message to the admin only. Writes nothing to
// campaign_recipients, so a test never pollutes the campaign's counters and
// can be repeated as often as you like.
async function handleTest(supabase, body, admin) {
  const errs = validate(body);
  if (errs.length) return json(400, { error: 'validation_failed', detail: errs.join(' ') });

  const campaign = { id: body.id || 'test', ...body };
  const results = [];

  if (body.channel === 'email' || body.channel === 'both') {
    const to = String(body.test_email || admin.email || '').trim();
    if (!to) {
      results.push({ channel: 'email', ok: false, error: 'No test email address available for your admin account.' });
    } else {
      const recipient = { full_name: firstName(body.test_name || 'Suresh'), email: to, phone10: null, customer_key: 'test' };
      try {
        const { subject, html, text } = renderCampaignEmail(campaign, recipient);
        const res = await sendEmail({
          to, subject: `[TEST] ${subject}`, html, text,
          headers: unsubHeaders(campaign, recipient),
        });
        results.push({ channel: 'email', ok: !res.skipped, skipped: !!res.skipped, id: res.id || null,
          error: res.skipped ? 'RESEND_API_KEY is not set on this deploy -- no email was sent.' : null });
      } catch (e) {
        results.push({ channel: 'email', ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e) });
      }
    }
  }

  if (body.channel === 'whatsapp' || body.channel === 'both') {
    const phone = String(body.test_phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!phone) {
      results.push({ channel: 'whatsapp', ok: false, error: 'Enter a test phone number to test the WhatsApp channel.' });
    } else {
      try {
        const res = await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
          recipientPhone: phone,
          templateName: body.wa_template,
          bodyVariables: buildWaVars(body, { full_name: firstName(body.test_name || 'Suresh') }),
        });
        results.push({ channel: 'whatsapp', ok: true, id: res.messageId, template: res.templateName, language: res.language });
      } catch (e) {
        results.push({ channel: 'whatsapp', ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e), terminal: !!(e && e.terminal) });
      }
    }
  }

  return json(200, { results });
}

/**
 * WhatsApp body variables for a campaign template.
 *
 * The convention this codebase uses for the suggested `zg_promo_broadcast`
 * template is {{1}} = first name, {{2}} = the campaign message. Any approved
 * template with exactly those two body variables will work unchanged.
 * _lib/whatsapp.js reconciles the count against the real Meta definition, so
 * a mismatch surfaces as a clear error rather than a malformed send.
 */
function buildWaVars(campaign, recipient) {
  return [
    recipient.full_name || 'there',
    String(campaign.body || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 900),
  ];
}

// ── LAUNCH ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleLaunch(supabase, body) {
  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) return json(400, { error: 'missing_id' });
  if (body.confirm !== true) return json(400, { error: 'not_confirmed', detail: 'Launch requires confirm:true.' });

  const { data: campaign, error } = await supabase.from('campaigns').select('*').eq('id', id).single();
  if (error || !campaign) return json(404, { error: 'not_found' });
  if (['sending', 'completed'].indexOf(campaign.status) !== -1) {
    return json(409, { error: 'already_launched', detail: `This campaign is already "${campaign.status}".` });
  }

  const errs = validate(campaign);
  if (errs.length) return json(400, { error: 'validation_failed', detail: errs.join(' ') });

  const { recipients, stats } = await resolveAudience(supabase, campaign.segment, campaign.channel);

  if (!recipients.length) {
    return json(400, { error: 'empty_audience', detail: 'No reachable recipients matched this segment.', stats });
  }

  // The drift guard. The admin confirmed a number they were shown; if the
  // real audience no longer matches it, refuse rather than send to a list
  // they did not approve.
  if (body.expected_count != null && Number(body.expected_count) !== stats.reachable) {
    return json(409, {
      error: 'audience_changed',
      detail: `The audience changed since you previewed it (was ${body.expected_count}, now ${stats.reachable}). Preview again and re-confirm.`,
      stats,
    });
  }

  // Build one row per recipient per channel.
  const rows = [];
  for (const r of recipients) {
    for (const ch of r.channels) {
      rows.push({
        campaign_id: id,
        customer_key: r.customer_key,
        full_name: r.full_name,
        email: ch === 'email' ? r.email : null,
        phone10: ch === 'whatsapp' ? r.phone10 : null,
        channel: ch,
        status: 'queued',
      });
    }
  }

  // Chunked insert. A single 5000-row insert exceeds the payload limit and
  // would fail as one atomic lump; ignoreDuplicates makes a partial retry
  // safe against the uq_campaign_recipient unique index.
  const CHUNK = 500;
  let inserted = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const slice = rows.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    const { error: insErr } = await supabase
      .from('campaign_recipients')
      .upsert(slice, { onConflict: 'campaign_id,customer_key,channel', ignoreDuplicates: true });
    if (insErr) {
      await supabase.from('campaigns').update({ status: 'paused' }).eq('id', id);
      return json(500, {
        error: 'queue_failed',
        detail: `Queued ${inserted} of ${rows.length} before failing: ${insErr.message}. The campaign was set to "paused" so the sender will not run on a partial list.`,
      });
    }
    inserted += slice.length;
  }

  const { data: updated, error: updErr } = await supabase.from('campaigns').update({
    status: 'sending',
    started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    total_recipients: rows.length,
  }).eq('id', id).select().single();
  if (updErr) return json(500, { error: 'launch_failed', detail: updErr.message });

  return json(200, {
    campaign: updated,
    queued: rows.length,
    stats,
    note: 'Queued. campaign-sender runs every 5 minutes and sends in batches of 20. Nothing has been sent yet.',
  });
}

// ── STATE TRANSITIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleState(supabase, id, next, allowedFrom) {
  if (!id) return json(400, { error: 'missing_id' });
  const { data: c } = await supabase.from('campaigns').select('status').eq('id', id).single();
  if (!c) return json(404, { error: 'not_found' });
  if (allowedFrom.indexOf(c.status) === -1) {
    return json(409, { error: 'bad_transition', detail: `Cannot go from "${c.status}" to "${next}".` });
  }
  const patch = { status: next };
  if (next === 'cancelled') patch.completed_at = new Date().toISOString();
  const { error } = await supabase.from('campaigns').update(patch).eq('id', id);
  if (error) return json(500, { error: 'update_failed', detail: error.message });

  // Cancelling must also drop anything not yet sent, otherwise the sender
  // would happily keep picking up queued rows for a "cancelled" campaign.
  if (next === 'cancelled') {
    await supabase.from('campaign_recipients')
      .update({ status: 'skipped', error_message: 'Campaign cancelled' })
      .eq('campaign_id', id).eq('status', 'queued');
  }
  return json(200, { id, status: next });
}

// ── RETRY FAILED ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleRetryFailed(supabase, id) {
  if (!id) return json(400, { error: 'missing_id' });
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('campaign_recipients')
    .update({ status: 'queued', attempts: 0, error_message: null })
    .eq('campaign_id', id).eq('status', 'failed')
    .select('id');
  if (error) return json(500, { error: 'retry_failed', detail: error.message });

  await supabase.from('campaigns')
    .update({ status: 'sending', failed_count: 0, completed_at: null })
    .eq('id', id);

  return json(200, { requeued: (data || []).length });
}

FILE: netlify\functions\admin-export.js
