// netlify/functions/admin-export.js
//
// CUSTOMER EXPORT CENTER — server-side CSV.
//
// WHY THIS EXISTS WHEN js/admin.js ALREADY HAS AN "Export CSV" BUTTON
// -------------------------------------------------------------------
// The existing exportOrdersCsv() in js/admin.js builds its CSV from the rows
// already loaded into the browser — and loadOrders() fetches with .limit(500)
// under the caller's RLS. So that button silently exports at most 500 orders
// and, critically, only the columns the table happens to render. It is a
// screen export, not a data export.
//
// This function reads with the service-role key, pages through the full set,
// and returns real CSV with a Content-Disposition attachment header. If you
// lose the laptop, this is the file that means you have not lost the
// business.
//
//   GET ?type=customers   -> deduped customer list + lifetime value
//   GET ?type=orders      -> every order, all columns
//   GET ?type=order_items -> line items joined to order numbers
//   GET ?type=campaign&id=<uuid> -> per-recipient delivery report
//   GET ?type=optouts     -> the suppression list
//   GET ?type=digital_sends -> gift delivery log
//
// Add &format=json to get JSON instead — useful for eyeballing on a phone,
// where a downloaded CSV is awkward to open.

const { verifyAdmin, json } = require('./_lib/adminAuth');
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

const PAGE = 1000;
// Netlify Functions have a 6 MB response cap. 40k rows of typical width sits
// comfortably under it; beyond that we truncate LOUDLY (a truncation flag in
// the filename and a final CSV row) rather than silently returning a partial
// file that looks complete.
const MAX_ROWS = 40000;

const EXPORTS = {
  customers: {
    from: 'v_customers',
    select: 'customer_key, full_name, email, phone10, orders_count, paid_orders_count, lifetime_value, first_order_at, last_order_at, has_digital, has_physical, opted_out',
    order: { col: 'last_order_at', asc: false },
  },
  orders: {
    from: 'orders',
    select: '*',
    order: { col: 'created_at', asc: false },
  },
  order_items: {
    from: 'order_items',
    select: 'id, order_id, product_id, name_snapshot, unit_price, qty, recipient_name, recipient_dob, addon_total, line_total',
    order: { col: 'id', asc: true },
  },
  // Added with the order-pipeline audit fixes: the recovery queue, so you can
  // see who is stranded at payment and follow up by hand if you want to.
  abandoned: {
    from: 'v_abandoned_checkouts',
    select: 'order_number, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, total, created_at',
    order: { col: 'created_at', asc: false },
  },
  optouts: {
    from: 'marketing_optouts',
    select: 'email, phone10, source, created_at',
    order: { col: 'created_at', asc: false },
  },
  digital_sends: {
    from: 'digital_sends',
    select: 'id, order_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, channel, status, wa_status, scheduled_at, sent_at, attempts, error_message',
    order: { col: 'scheduled_at', asc: false },
  },
  campaign: {
    from: 'campaign_recipients',
    select: 'campaign_id, customer_key, full_name, email, phone10, channel, status, attempts, wa_status, provider_message_id, error_message, sent_at',
    order: { col: 'created_at', asc: true },
    requiresId: true,
    idColumn: 'campaign_id',
  },
};

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  // Not using withAdmin(): that wrapper always returns JSON, and this endpoint
  // needs to return text/csv with an attachment header on success.
  const admin = await verifyAdmin(event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization);
  if (!admin.ok) return json(403, { error: admin.reason, detail: admin.detail });

  const qs = event.queryStringParameters || {};
  const type = String(qs.type || 'customers').toLowerCase();
  const spec = EXPORTS[type];
  if (!spec) return json(400, { error: 'unknown_type', detail: `Valid types: ${Object.keys(EXPORTS).join(', ')}` });
  if (spec.requiresId && !qs.id) return json(400, { error: 'missing_id', detail: `type=${type} requires &id=<uuid>` });

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const rows = [];
  let truncated = false;

  try {
    for (let from = 0; from < MAX_ROWS; from += PAGE) {
      let q = supabase.from(spec.from).select(spec.select)
        .order(spec.order.col, { ascending: spec.order.asc })
        .range(from, from + PAGE - 1);
      if (spec.requiresId) q = q.eq(spec.idColumn, qs.id);

      const { data, error } = await q;
      if (error) return json(500, { error: 'query_failed', detail: error.message, hint: 'If this mentions a missing relation, run supabase/consolidated/60_campaigns_and_admin_ops.sql' });
      if (!data || !data.length) break;
      rows.push(...data);
      if (data.length < PAGE) break;
      if (rows.length >= MAX_ROWS) { truncated = true; break; }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return json(500, { error: 'export_failed', detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
  }

  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const filename = `zivogift-${type}${truncated ? '-TRUNCATED' : ''}-${stamp}.csv`;

  if (String(qs.format || '').toLowerCase() === 'json') {
    return json(200, { type, count: rows.length, truncated, rows });
  }

  let csv = toCsv(rows);
  if (truncated) {
    csv += `\n"TRUNCATED at ${MAX_ROWS} rows — export in narrower slices or query Supabase directly."\n`;
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8',
      'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
      'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
      'X-Row-Count': String(rows.length),
    },
    // BOM so Excel on Windows reads UTF-8 correctly. Without it, any customer
    // name with an accent or a rupee sign renders as mojibake — and this file
    // exists precisely to be opened in Excel.
    body: '\uFEFF' + csv,
  };
};

function toCsv(rows) {
  if (!rows.length) return 'no_data\n';

  // Union of keys across all rows, not just the first: Supabase omits null
  // JSON columns on some rows, and keying off row[0] alone would silently
  // drop a whole column from the export.
  const cols = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const r of rows) {
    for (const k of Object.keys(r)) {
      if (!seen.has(k)) { seen.add(k); cols.push(k); }
    }
  }

  const lines = [cols.map(cell).join(',')];
  for (const r of rows) lines.push(cols.map((c) => cell(r[c])).join(','));
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function cell(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  let s = typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v);

  // CSV injection guard. A customer could set their name to "=HYPERLINK(...)"
  // and Excel would execute it on open. Prefixing with an apostrophe is the
  // standard neutralisation and keeps the value readable.
  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(s)) s = `'${s}`;

  if (/[",\n\r]/.test(s)) s = `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  return s;
}

module.exports.toCsv = toCsv;

FILE: netlify\functions\admin-inbox.js

// netlify/functions/admin-inbox.js
//
// CUSTOMER MESSAGES API — the backend for the 💬 Messages tab.
//
//   GET  ?action=list&filter=all|unread|open|closed&q=<search>
//        -> conversation list, unread first
//   GET  ?action=thread&contact_id=<uuid>&limit=200
//        -> full message history for one customer (marks it read)
//   GET  ?action=unread_count
//        -> badge count; polled, so deliberately cheap
//   GET  ?action=media&message_id=<uuid>
//        -> lazily pulls an inbound media file from Meta into R2 and
//           returns a public URL
//   POST {action:'reply', contact_id, text}
//   POST {action:'reply_template', contact_id, template_name, variables:[]}
//   POST {action:'set_status', contact_id, status:'open'|'closed'}
//   POST {action:'set_note', contact_id, note}
//   POST {action:'mark_read', contact_id}
//
// Auth is the shared withAdmin() wrapper, so this endpoint accepts the same
// two proofs as every other admin function (profiles.is_admin OR
// ADMIN_EMAILS) and returns the same structured 403 detail.
//
// Requires: supabase/consolidated/80_whatsapp_inbox.sql

const { withAdmin, json, parseBody } = require('./_lib/adminAuth');
const { sendWhatsAppText, fetchInboundMedia, markMessageRead } = require('./_lib/whatsappSession');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplateRaw, describeTemplates } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
const { recordOutbound, windowIsOpen, previewFor } = require('./_lib/waInbox');
const { uploadBufferToR2 } = require('./_lib/r2Client');

const LIST_LIMIT = 100;
const THREAD_LIMIT = 300;

/** Adds the derived window state the UI needs, without a second round trip. */
function decorateContact(c) {
  const open = windowIsOpen(c);
  let minutesLeft = null;
  if (c.window_expires_at) {
    minutesLeft = Math.max(0, Math.round((new Date(c.window_expires_at).getTime() - Date.now()) / 60000));
  }
  return {
    ...c,
    window_open: open,
    window_minutes_left: open ? minutesLeft : 0,
  };
}

exports.handler = withAdmin(async (event, { admin, supabase }) => {
  const qs = event.queryStringParameters || {};
  const body = parseBody(event);
  const action = String(body.action || qs.action || 'list').toLowerCase();

  // ── LIST ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'list') {
    const filter = String(qs.filter || 'all').toLowerCase();
    const search = String(qs.q || '').trim();

    let query = supabase
      .from('wa_contacts')
      .select('id, phone10, wa_phone, profile_name, last_inbound_at, last_outbound_at, last_message_at, last_message_preview, window_expires_at, unread_count, status, admin_note, last_order_number')
      .order('last_message_at', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
      .limit(LIST_LIMIT);

    if (filter === 'unread') query = query.gt('unread_count', 0);
    else if (filter === 'open') query = query.eq('status', 'open');
    else if (filter === 'closed') query = query.eq('status', 'closed');

    if (search) {
      const safe = search.replace(/[%,()]/g, '');
      query = query.or(`phone10.ilike.%${safe}%,profile_name.ilike.%${safe}%,last_order_number.ilike.%${safe}%`);
    }

    const { data, error } = await query;
    if (error) {
      return json(500, {
        error: 'list_failed',
        detail: `${error.message} — if this says the relation does not exist, run supabase/consolidated/80_whatsapp_inbox.sql`,
      });
    }

    const contacts = (data || []).map(decorateContact);
    return json(200, {
      contacts,
      total: contacts.length,
      unread_total: contacts.reduce((n, c) => n + (c.unread_count || 0), 0),
    });
  }

  // ── UNREAD COUNT (polled — keep it cheap) ────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'unread_count') {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('wa_contacts').select('unread_count').gt('unread_count', 0);
    if (error) return json(200, { unread: 0, degraded: true, detail: error.message });
    return json(200, {
      unread: (data || []).reduce((n, r) => n + (r.unread_count || 0), 0),
      conversations: (data || []).length,
    });
  }

  // ── THREAD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'thread') {
    const contactId = String(qs.contact_id || body.contact_id || '');
    if (!contactId) return json(400, { error: 'missing_contact_id' });

    const { data: contactRows, error: cErr } = await supabase
      .from('wa_contacts').select('*').eq('id', contactId).limit(1);
    if (cErr) return json(500, { error: 'contact_failed', detail: cErr.message });
    if (!contactRows || !contactRows.length) return json(404, { error: 'not_found' });
    const contact = contactRows[0];

    const { data: messages, error: mErr } = await supabase
      .from('wa_messages')
      .select('id, direction, wa_message_id, msg_type, body, caption, media_id, media_mime, media_url, media_error, status, error_message, sent_by_admin, template_name, source, context_wa_id, created_at')
      .eq('contact_id', contactId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
      .limit(THREAD_LIMIT);
    if (mErr) return json(500, { error: 'thread_failed', detail: mErr.message });

    // Opening a conversation is reading it.
    if (contact.unread_count > 0) {
      await supabase.from('wa_contacts').update({ unread_count: 0 }).eq('id', contactId);
      contact.unread_count = 0;

      // Blue ticks on the customer's phone for the newest inbound message.
      // Cosmetic and non-blocking — never let it fail the request.
      const lastIn = [...(messages || [])].reverse().find((m) => m.direction === 'in' && m.wa_message_id);
      if (lastIn) { try { await markMessageRead(lastIn.wa_message_id); } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ } }
    }

    return json(200, { contact: decorateContact(contact), messages: messages || [] });
  }

  // ── MEDIA (lazy fetch Meta -> R2) ────────────────────────────────────────
  // Meta's media URLs expire in minutes and need the bearer token, so the
  // webhook stores only media_id. The bytes are pulled the first time an
  // admin actually opens the conversation, then cached in R2 forever.
  if (action === 'media') {
    const messageId = String(qs.message_id || body.message_id || '');
    if (!messageId) return json(400, { error: 'missing_message_id' });

    const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
      .from('wa_messages').select('id, media_id, media_mime, media_url, msg_type').eq('id', messageId).limit(1);
    if (error) return json(500, { error: 'media_lookup_failed', detail: error.message });
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return json(404, { error: 'not_found' });

    const row = rows[0];
    if (row.media_url) return json(200, { url: row.media_url, cached: true });
    if (!row.media_id) return json(400, { error: 'no_media', detail: 'This message has no media attached.' });

    const fetched = await fetchInboundMedia(row.media_id);
    if (!fetched.ok) {
      // Record why, so the UI can explain rather than spin. Media older than
      // ~30 days is expired at Meta and is genuinely unrecoverable — the
      // message text and metadata remain.
      await supabase.from('wa_messages')
        .update({ media_error: fetched.error, media_fetched_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', row.id);
      return json(502, { error: 'media_fetch_failed', detail: fetched.error });
    }

    const ext = (fetched.mime.split('/')[1] || 'bin').split(';')[0];
    let url;
    try {
      url = await uploadBufferToR2(fetched.buffer, `wa-inbox/${row.id}.${ext}`, fetched.mime);
    } catch (e) {
      return json(502, { error: 'r2_upload_failed', detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
    }

    await supabase.from('wa_messages').update({
      media_url: url,
      media_mime: fetched.mime,
      media_size: fetched.size,
      media_fetched_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      media_error: null,
    }).eq('id', row.id);

    return json(200, { url, cached: false, size: fetched.size, mime: fetched.mime });
  }

  // ── TEMPLATES (for replying outside the 24h window) ──────────────────────
  if (action === 'templates') {
    const cat = await describeTemplates();
    const approved = (cat.templates || []).filter((t) => t.status === 'APPROVED');
    return json(200, { available: cat.available, reason: cat.reason || null, templates: approved });
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────── WRITES ──────────────────────────────────
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return json(400, { error: 'unknown_action', detail: `"${action}" is not a GET action.` });
  }

  const contactId = String(body.contact_id || '');
  if (!contactId) return json(400, { error: 'missing_contact_id' });

  const { data: cRows, error: cErr } = await supabase
    .from('wa_contacts').select('*').eq('id', contactId).limit(1);
  if (cErr) return json(500, { error: 'contact_failed', detail: cErr.message });
  if (!cRows || !cRows.length) return json(404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const contact = cRows[0];

  // ── REPLY (free text, inside the 24h window) ─────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'reply') {
    const text = String(body.text || '').trim();
    if (!text) return json(400, { error: 'empty_message' });

    // Checked locally first so the common case fails instantly with a useful
    // message instead of a round trip to Meta and error code 131047.
    if (!windowIsOpen(contact)) {
      return json(409, {
        error: 'window_closed',
        detail: 'The 24-hour reply window for this customer has closed. Meta only allows an approved template now.',
        window_expires_at: contact.window_expires_at,
      });
    }

    const to = contact.wa_phone || contact.phone10;
    const res = await sendWhatsAppText({ to, text });

    // Recorded either way. A failed reply must be VISIBLE in the thread —
    // silently dropping it is how you end up believing you answered someone.
    await recordOutbound(supabase, {
      phone: to,
      waMessageId: res.ok ? res.messageId : null,
      msgType: 'text',
      body: text,
      status: res.ok ? 'sent' : 'failed',
      source: 'reply',
      sentByAdmin: admin.email,
      errorCode: res.ok ? null : String((res.error && res.error.code) || ''),
      errorMessage: res.ok ? null : (res.error && res.error.message) || null,
      markRead: true,
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      return json(502, {
        error: res.windowExpired ? 'window_closed' : 'send_failed',
        detail: (res.error && res.error.message) || 'WhatsApp send failed',
      });
    }
    return json(200, { ok: true, message_id: res.messageId, preview: previewFor({ msgType: 'text', body: text }) });
  }

  // ── REPLY WITH TEMPLATE (outside the window) ─────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'reply_template') {
    const templateName = String(body.template_name || '').trim();
    if (!templateName) return json(400, { error: 'missing_template' });
    const variables = Array.isArray(body.variables) ? body.variables.map(String) : [];
    const to = contact.wa_phone || contact.phone10;

    try {
      // Uses the RAW sender: this function records the outbound row itself
      // with the admin's email attached, and the mirrored wrapper would add a
      // second, duplicate 'automation' row for the same message.
      const res = await sendWhatsAppTemplateRaw({
        recipientPhone: to, templateName, bodyVariables: variables,
      });
      await recordOutbound(supabase, {
        phone: to,
        waMessageId: res.messageId,
        msgType: 'template',
        body: [templateName, ...variables].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
        templateName: res.templateName || templateName,
        status: 'sent',
        source: 'reply',
        sentByAdmin: admin.email,
        markRead: true,
      });
      return json(200, { ok: true, message_id: res.messageId, template: res.templateName || templateName });
    } catch (e) {
      await recordOutbound(supabase, {
        phone: to,
        msgType: 'template',
        body: templateName,
        templateName,
        status: 'failed',
        source: 'reply',
        sentByAdmin: admin.email,
        errorMessage: String((e && e.message) || e),
        markRead: false,
      });
      return json(502, { error: 'template_send_failed', detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
    }
  }

  // ── STATUS / NOTE / MARK READ ────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'set_status') {
    const status = String(body.status || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!['open', 'closed'].includes(status)) return json(400, { error: 'bad_status' });
    const patch = { status, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
    if (status === 'closed') patch.unread_count = 0;
    const { error } = await supabase.from('wa_contacts').update(patch).eq('id', contactId);
    if (error) return json(500, { error: 'update_failed', detail: error.message });
    return json(200, { ok: true, status });
  }

  if (action === 'set_note') {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('wa_contacts')
      .update({ admin_note: String(body.note || '').slice(0, 2000), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', contactId);
    if (error) return json(500, { error: 'update_failed', detail: error.message });
    return json(200, { ok: true });
  }

  if (action === 'mark_read') {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('wa_contacts').update({ unread_count: 0 }).eq('id', contactId);
    if (error) return json(500, { error: 'update_failed', detail: error.message });
    return json(200, { ok: true });
  }

  return json(400, { error: 'unknown_action', detail: `"${action}" is not supported.` });
});

FILE: netlify\functions\admin-ops.js

// netlify/functions/admin-ops.js
//
// THE EMERGENCY ADMIN CONSOLE API.
//
// This is the function that matters most when you do not have a laptop. It
// answers "is everything actually working?" in one call, and gives you the
// small number of levers that can fix things without a deploy.
//
//   GET  ?action=health   -> full system health: env vars, DB, templates,
//                            failed sends, stuck campaigns, kill switches
//   POST {action:'set_switch', key, value}
//   POST {action:'test_email', to}
//   POST {action:'test_whatsapp', phone}
//   POST {action:'retry_failed_sends'}   -> requeue failed digital_sends (gifts)
//   POST {action:'optout_add'|'optout_remove', email?, phone?}
//
// WHY health CHECKS ENV VARS BY NAME
// ----------------------------------
// Nearly every "the site is broken" incident in this codebase traces back to
// an unset or rotated Netlify env var, and from a phone there is no way to
// see which one. This reports presence (never the value) for each one, so the
// answer is one screen instead of an afternoon.
//
// Nothing here ever returns a secret's value — only whether it is set, and
// its length, which is enough to spot a truncated paste.

const { withAdmin, json, parseBody, adminEmails } = require('./_lib/adminAuth');
const { getSettings, setSetting, DEFAULTS } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');
const { sendEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate, describeTemplates } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
const { normalizePhone } = require('./_lib/phoneUtil');

// Grouped so the UI can render them as sections and you can see at a glance
// which SUBSYSTEM is broken, not just which string is missing.
// Names verified by grepping `process.env.*` across netlify/, scripts/ and
// tools/ in this exact codebase — not assumed. Getting one of these wrong
// would make the console report a healthy var as missing, which is worse
// than not checking at all.
const ENV_GROUPS = {
  'Core / Supabase': ['SUPABASE_URL', 'SUPABASE_ANON_KEY', 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY', 'SITE_URL'],
  'Admin access': ['ADMIN_EMAILS', 'ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL'],
  'Email (Resend)': ['RESEND_API_KEY', 'RESEND_FROM_EMAIL', 'RESEND_FROM_NAME'],
  'WhatsApp (Meta)': ['WHATSAPP_TOKEN', 'WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID', 'WHATSAPP_WABA_ID',
                      'WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN', 'WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET', 'WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME'],
  // Customer Messages (WhatsApp Inbox). ADMIN_WHATSAPP_NUMBER and
  // WHATSAPP_RELAY_TEMPLATE are only needed if you switch the paid
  // personal-number relay on; the inbox itself works without them.
  'Customer Messages': ['ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL', 'ADMIN_WHATSAPP_NUMBER', 'WHATSAPP_RELAY_TEMPLATE'],
  'Payments (Cashfree)': ['CASHFREE_APP_ID', 'CASHFREE_SECRET_KEY', 'CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_SECRET', 'CASHFREE_ENV'],
  'Media (Cloudflare R2)': ['R2_ACCOUNT_ID', 'R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY', 'R2_BUCKET_NAME', 'R2_PUBLIC_URL'],
  'OTP (MSG91)': ['MSG91_AUTH_KEY', 'MSG91_SENDER_ID', 'MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID'],
  'AI (Gemini)': ['GEMINI_API_KEY'],
  'Campaigns': ['UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET'],
};

// Absence of these breaks something customer-facing right now.
const CRITICAL = ['SUPABASE_URL', 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY', 'RESEND_API_KEY', 'WHATSAPP_TOKEN', 'WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID'];

exports.handler = withAdmin(async (event, { admin, supabase }) => {
  const qs = event.queryStringParameters || {};
  const body = parseBody(event);
  const action = String(body.action || qs.action || 'health').toLowerCase();

  switch (action) {
    case 'health':             return await handleHealth(supabase, admin);
    case 'set_switch':         return await handleSetSwitch(supabase, body, admin);
    case 'test_email':         return await handleTestEmail(body, admin);
    case 'test_whatsapp':      return await handleTestWhatsApp(body);
    case 'retry_failed_sends': return await handleRetryFailedSends(supabase);
    case 'optout_add':         return await handleOptout(supabase, body, true);
    case 'optout_remove':      return await handleOptout(supabase, body, false);
    default:
      return json(400, { error: 'unknown_action', detail: `"${action}" is not a valid action.` });
  }
});

// ── HEALTH ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleHealth(supabase, admin) {
  const env = {};
  const missingCritical = [];

  for (const group of Object.keys(ENV_GROUPS)) {
    env[group] = ENV_GROUPS[group].map((name) => {
      const v = process.env[name];
      const set = !!(v && String(v).trim());
      if (!set && CRITICAL.indexOf(name) !== -1) missingCritical.push(name);
      return { name, set, length: set ? String(v).length : 0, critical: CRITICAL.indexOf(name) !== -1 };
    });
  }

  // Migration presence check. Querying each new table is the only honest way
  // to know whether 60_campaigns_and_admin_ops.sql was actually applied --
  // and "the admin panel shows zeros" versus "the migration was never run"
  // look identical from a phone otherwise.
  const tables = {};
  for (const t of ['v_customers', 'campaigns', 'campaign_recipients', 'marketing_optouts', 'admin_settings', 'festival_schedules', 'v_abandoned_checkouts',
                   // Customer Messages -- an error here means
                   // 80_whatsapp_inbox.sql has not been applied, and inbound
                   // customer messages are NOT being captured.
                   'wa_contacts', 'wa_messages', 'wa_webhook_failures']) {
    try {
      const { count, error } = await supabase.from(t).select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true });
      tables[t] = error ? { ok: false, error: error.message } : { ok: true, rows: count || 0 };
    } catch (e) {
      tables[t] = { ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e) };
    }
  }

  // Gift delivery health — the transactional path, which matters more than
  // any campaign. Reuses digital_sends, which already exists.
  const gifts = {};
  try {
    for (const s of ['pending', 'failed', 'sent']) {
      const { count } = await supabase.from('digital_sends')
        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('status', s);
      gifts[s] = count || 0;
    }
    const { count: waFailed } = await supabase.from('digital_sends')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('wa_status', 'failed');
    gifts.whatsapp_failed = waFailed || 0;

    // Overdue = scheduled in the past but still pending. A non-zero number
    // here means gift-scheduler is not running, which is a real emergency.
    const { count: overdue } = await supabase.from('digital_sends')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('status', 'pending').lt('scheduled_at', new Date(Date.now() - 20 * 60 * 1000).toISOString());
    gifts.overdue_20min = overdue || 0;
  } catch (e) {
    gifts.error = String((e && e.message) || e);
  }

  // ── CUSTOMER MESSAGES HEALTH ───────────────────────────────────────────
  // The two numbers that tell you whether the inbox is trustworthy:
  // how many customers are waiting on a reply, and whether the webhook has
  // spooled anything it could not process.
  const inbox = {};
  try {
    const { data: unreadRows } = await supabase
      .from('wa_contacts').select('unread_count').gt('unread_count', 0);
    inbox.conversations_unread = (unreadRows || []).length;
    inbox.messages_unread = (unreadRows || []).reduce((n, r) => n + (r.unread_count || 0), 0);

    // A non-zero count is not data loss -- the raw payload is preserved in
    // wa_webhook_failures -- but it does mean something needs looking at.
    const { count: spooled } = await supabase
      .from('wa_webhook_failures').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('resolved', false);
    inbox.unprocessed_failures = spooled || 0;

    const { count: inbound24 } = await supabase
      .from('wa_messages').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('direction', 'in').gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toISOString());
    inbox.inbound_last_24h = inbound24 || 0;

    // WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET fails CLOSED in the webhook: unset means every
    // inbound POST is rejected with a 401 and no message is ever stored.
    // This is the single most likely cause of an empty inbox, so it is
    // called out explicitly rather than left in the env list.
    inbox.webhook_can_receive = !!(process.env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET && process.env.WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN);
    if (!inbox.webhook_can_receive) {
      inbox.warning = 'WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET and/or WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN are not set — Meta webhooks are being REJECTED and no customer message is being captured.';
    }
  } catch (e) {
    inbox.error = `${String((e && e.message) || e)} — run supabase/consolidated/80_whatsapp_inbox.sql`;
  }

  // ── PIPELINE HEALTH (added with the order-pipeline audit fixes) ─────────
  // Two things that silently cost money and are invisible from a phone:
  // abandoned checkouts sitting unrecovered, and products that have sold out
  // without anyone noticing.
  const pipeline = {};
  try {
    const { count: abandoned } = await supabase
      .from('v_abandoned_checkouts').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true });
    pipeline.abandoned_awaiting_recovery = abandoned || 0;
  } catch (e) { pipeline.abandoned_error = String((e && e.message) || e); }

  try {
    const { data: prods } = await supabase
      .from('products').select('id, name, stock_qty, active').not('stock_qty', 'is', null);
    const tracked = prods || [];
    pipeline.stock_tracked = tracked.length;
    pipeline.sold_out = tracked.filter((p) => p.stock_qty === 0 && p.active)
      .map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name }));
    pipeline.low_stock = tracked.filter((p) => p.stock_qty > 0 && p.stock_qty <= 3)
      .map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, stock_qty: p.stock_qty }));
  } catch (e) { pipeline.stock_error = String((e && e.message) || e); }

  try {
    const { count: unnotified } = await supabase
      .from('digital_sends').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('status', 'failed').is('buyer_notified_at', null);
    pipeline.failed_gifts_buyer_not_told = unnotified || 0;
  } catch (e) { /* column missing = migration not applied; tables check covers it */ }

  // WhatsApp template reachability.
  let whatsapp;
  try {
    const res = await describeTemplates();
    const list = (res && res.templates) || [];
    whatsapp = {
      available: !!(res && res.available),
      reason: (res && res.reason) || null,
      total: list.length,
      approved: list.filter((t) => String(t.status).toUpperCase() === 'APPROVED').length,
      marketing_approved: list.filter((t) =>
        String(t.status).toUpperCase() === 'APPROVED' &&
        String(t.category || '').toUpperCase() === 'MARKETING').length,
      not_approved: list.filter((t) => String(t.status).toUpperCase() !== 'APPROVED')
        .map((t) => ({ name: t.name, status: t.status })),
    };
  } catch (e) {
    whatsapp = { available: false, reason: String((e && e.message) || e) };
  }

  const settings = await getSettings(supabase);

  // Campaigns that claim to be sending but have made no progress recently.
  let stuck = [];
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('campaigns')
      .select('id, name, status, started_at, total_recipients, sent_count, failed_count')
      .eq('status', 'sending');
    stuck = (data || []).filter((c) =>
      c.started_at && (Date.now() - new Date(c.started_at).getTime()) > 60 * 60 * 1000 &&
      (c.sent_count + c.failed_count) < c.total_recipients);
  } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }

  const problems = [];
  if (missingCritical.length) problems.push(`Missing critical env vars: ${missingCritical.join(', ')}`);
  if (!adminEmails().length) problems.push('ADMIN_EMAILS is not set — admin functions rely solely on profiles.is_admin.');
  for (const t of Object.keys(tables)) {
    if (!tables[t].ok) problems.push(`Table/view "${t}" is unreadable — run supabase/consolidated/60_campaigns_and_admin_ops.sql`);
  }
  if (gifts.overdue_20min > 0) problems.push(`${gifts.overdue_20min} gift sends are overdue by 20+ minutes — gift-scheduler may not be running.`);
  if (pipeline.sold_out && pipeline.sold_out.length) problems.push(`Sold out but still active: ${pipeline.sold_out.map((p) => p.name).join(', ')}`);
  if (pipeline.low_stock && pipeline.low_stock.length) problems.push(`Low stock: ${pipeline.low_stock.map((p) => `${p.name} (${p.stock_qty})`).join(', ')}`);
  if (pipeline.failed_gifts_buyer_not_told > 0) problems.push(`${pipeline.failed_gifts_buyer_not_told} permanently failed gift(s) whose buyer has not been told.`);
  if (gifts.failed > 0) problems.push(`${gifts.failed} gift sends have failed permanently.`);
  if (whatsapp && !whatsapp.available) problems.push(`WhatsApp template introspection unavailable: ${whatsapp.reason}`);
  if (whatsapp && whatsapp.available && !whatsapp.marketing_approved) problems.push('No APPROVED MARKETING WhatsApp template — WhatsApp campaigns cannot run.');
  if (settings.pause_all_schedulers) problems.push('pause_all_schedulers is ON — all schedulers are halted.');
  if (settings.pause_campaigns) problems.push('pause_campaigns is ON — campaigns are halted.');
  for (const c of stuck) problems.push(`Campaign "${c.name}" has been sending for over an hour with ${c.sent_count + c.failed_count}/${c.total_recipients} processed.`);
  // Customer Messages. The first of these is the one that loses you orders.
  if (inbox.warning) problems.push(inbox.warning);
  if (inbox.error) problems.push(`Customer Messages unavailable: ${inbox.error}`);
  if (inbox.unprocessed_failures > 0) problems.push(`${inbox.unprocessed_failures} inbound WhatsApp payload(s) could not be processed — raw copies are in wa_webhook_failures.`);
  if (inbox.conversations_unread > 0) problems.push(`${inbox.conversations_unread} customer conversation(s) are waiting for a reply.`);

  return json(200, {
    generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    admin: { email: admin.email, via: admin.via },
    healthy: problems.length === 0,
    problems,
    env,
    tables,
    gifts,
    inbox,
    pipeline,
    whatsapp,
    settings,
    stuck_campaigns: stuck,
    switch_keys: Object.keys(DEFAULTS),
  });
}

async function handleSetSwitch(supabase, body, admin) {
  try {
    const res = await setSetting(body.key, body.value === true || body.value === 'true', supabase, admin.userId);

  } catch (e) {
    return json(400, { error: 'set_failed', detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
  }
}

// ── TESTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function handleTestEmail(body, admin) {
  const to = String(body.to || admin.email || '').trim();
  if (!to) return json(400, { error: 'no_recipient', detail: 'No email address to send the test to.' });
  try {
    const res = await sendEmail({
      to,
      subject: 'Zivogift — admin test email',
      html: '<p style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;">If you are reading this, Resend is configured correctly and outbound email works.</p>',
      text: 'If you are reading this, Resend is configured correctly and outbound email works.',
    });
    if (res.skipped) return json(200, { ok: false, detail: 'RESEND_API_KEY is not set on this deploy — nothing was sent.' });
    return json(200, { ok: true, id: res.id, detail: `Sent to ${to}. Check the inbox, and the spam folder.` });
  } catch (e) {
    return json(200, { ok: false, detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
  }
}

async function handleTestWhatsApp(body) {
  const phone = normalizePhone(body.phone);
  if (!phone) return json(400, { error: 'bad_phone', detail: 'Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.' });

  // Uses the MAIN gift template, not a marketing one, on purpose: this test
  // is asking "does WhatsApp delivery work at all", and the gift template is
  // the one that must never be broken.
  const templateName = process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME || 'zivogift_birthday_surprise';
  try {
    const res = await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
      recipientPhone: phone,
      templateName,
      bodyVariables: ['Admin test', 'Zivogift'],
    });
    return json(200, { ok: true, id: res.messageId, template: res.templateName, language: res.language,
      detail: `Accepted by Meta. Delivery is confirmed separately by the webhook — check the handset.` });
  } catch (e) {
    return json(200, { ok: false, terminal: !!(e && e.terminal), detail: String((e && e.message) || e), template: templateName });
  }
}

// ── RETRY FAILED GIFT SENDS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// This touches digital_sends, i.e. real customer gifts, not campaigns.
// Capped at 100 per click so one tap cannot stampede the provider APIs.
async function handleRetryFailedSends(supabase) {
  const { data: failed, error } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends').select('id').eq('status', 'failed').limit(100);
  if (error) return json(500, { error: 'query_failed', detail: error.message });
  if (!failed || !failed.length) return json(200, { requeued: 0, detail: 'No failed gift sends to retry.' });

  const { error: updErr } = await supabase.from('digital_sends')
    .update({ status: 'pending', attempts: 0, error_message: null })
    .in('id', failed.map((f) => f.id));
  if (updErr) return json(500, { error: 'update_failed', detail: updErr.message });

  return json(200, { requeued: failed.length, detail: `${failed.length} gift sends requeued. gift-scheduler picks them up within 2 minutes.` });
}

// ── MANUAL OPT-OUT MANAGEMENT ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// For when someone replies "stop sending me this" to an email or a DM rather
// than using the link.
async function handleOptout(supabase, body, add) {
  const email = body.email ? String(body.email).trim().toLowerCase() : null;
  const digits = body.phone ? String(body.phone).replace(/\D/g, '') : '';
  const phone10 = digits ? digits.slice(-10) : null;
  if (!email && !phone10) return json(400, { error: 'no_identifier', detail: 'Provide an email or a phone number.' });

  try {
    if (add) {
      if (email) await supabase.from('marketing_optouts').upsert({ email, source: 'manual' }, { onConflict: 'email' });
      if (phone10) await supabase.from('marketing_optouts').upsert({ phone10, source: 'manual' }, { onConflict: 'phone10' });
    } else {
      if (email) await supabase.from('marketing_optouts').delete().eq('email', email);
      if (phone10) await supabase.from('marketing_optouts').delete().eq('phone10', phone10);
    }
    return json(200, { ok: true, email, phone10, action: add ? 'opted_out' : 'removed' });
  } catch (e) {
    return json(500, { error: 'optout_failed', detail: String((e && e.message) || e) });
  }
}

FILE: netlify\functions\admin-whatsapp-diagnostics.js

// GET /.netlify/functions/admin-whatsapp-diagnostics
//
// Answers, in one call, the question that has been costing the most time:
// "is WhatsApp actually configured correctly, and does every template my code
// calls exist, approved, with the parameter count my code sends?"
//
// It does NOT send a message unless you explicitly ask it to with
//   ?test=<10-or-12-digit-number>
// in which case it sends the real gift template to that number so you can
// confirm end-to-end delivery on your own handset.
//
// AUTH: same pattern as admin-analytics.js -- Supabase token + ADMIN_EMAILS
// allowlist, failing closed if ADMIN_EMAILS is unset.

const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const { describeTemplates, sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
const { normalizePhone } = require('./_lib/phoneUtil');

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const ANON_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

// Every template name this codebase can send, and the number of body
// variables it passes. Keep this in sync when you add a template -- it is the
// contract the diagnostics check against.
const EXPECTED_TEMPLATES = [
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME || 'zivogift_birthday_surprise', bodyVars: 2, usedBy: 'gift-scheduler.js (main gift delivery)' },
  { name: 'gift_delivered_sender_notify',                                     bodyVars: 2, usedBy: 'gift-scheduler.js (sender notify)' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REPLY_RECEIVED || 'gift_reply_received',        bodyVars: 1, usedBy: 'notify-original-sender.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REACTION_INVITE || 'squad_reaction_invite',     bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'send-reaction-invites.js' },
  { name: 'zg_condition_gift_instructions',                                   bodyVars: 4, usedBy: '_lib/digitalSendsHelper.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_OCCASION_NUDGE || 'zg_occasion_nudge', bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'occasion-scheduler.js' },
  { name: 'zg_birthday_reminder',                                             bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'reminder-scheduler.js' },
  { name: 'zg_anniversary_nudge',                                             bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'reminder-scheduler.js' },
  { name: 'zg_special_day_reminder',                                          bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'reminder-scheduler.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CARE_DAILY || 'zg_care_package_daily',       bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'care-package-scheduler.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CARE_COMPLETE || 'zg_care_package_complete', bodyVars: 2, usedBy: 'care-package-scheduler.js' },
];

function adminEmails() {
  return String(process.env.ADMIN_EMAILS || '')
    .split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
}

async function verifyAdmin(authHeader) {
  const token = String(authHeader || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return null;
  const c = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, ANON_KEY);
  const { data, error } = await c.auth.getUser(token);
  if (error || !data || !data.user) return null;
  const email = String(data.user.email || '').toLowerCase();
  const allow = adminEmails();
  if (!allow.length) return null;                 // fail closed
  return allow.indexOf(email) !== -1 ? email : null;
}

// Confirms the token and phone number id actually work, and reports the
// number's display name and quality rating -- a throttled or flagged number
// is a common silent cause of undelivered messages.
async function checkPhoneNumber() {
  const token = process.env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN;
  const id    = process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID;
  if (!token || !id) return { ok: false, reason: 'WHATSAPP_TOKEN or WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID not set' };

  const version = process.env.WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION || 'v20.0';
  const url = `https://graph.facebook.com/${version}/${id}` +
              `?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,throughput`;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || data.error) {
      return { ok: false, reason: data.error ? `${data.error.message} (code ${data.error.code})` : `HTTP ${res.status}` };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      display_phone_number: data.display_phone_number,
      verified_name: data.verified_name,
      quality_rating: data.quality_rating,
      code_verification_status: data.code_verification_status,
      throughput: data.throughput,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, reason: `Network error: ${err.message}` };
  }
}

function auditTemplates(catalogue) {
  return EXPECTED_TEMPLATES.map((exp) => {
    const found = catalogue.find((t) => t.name === exp.name);
    if (!found) {
      return { ...exp, present: false, verdict: 'MISSING -- this template does not exist on your WABA. Every send using it will fail.' };
    }
    const issues = [];
    if (found.status !== 'APPROVED') {
      issues.push(`status is ${found.status}, not APPROVED`);
    }
    if (found.bodyParamCount !== exp.bodyVars) {
      issues.push(`template declares ${found.bodyParamCount} body variable(s) but the code sends ${exp.bodyVars}`);
    }
    return {
      ...exp,
      present: true,
      approvedLanguage: found.language,
      status: found.status,
      templateBodyVars: found.bodyParamCount,
      headerFormat: found.headerFormat,
      hasDynamicUrlButton: found.dynamicUrlButtonIndex >= 0,
      verdict: issues.length ? `NEEDS ATTENTION -- ${issues.join('; ')}` : 'OK',
    };
  });
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  }

  try {
    const who = await verifyAdmin(event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization);
    if (!who) return { statusCode: 403, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'forbidden' }) };

    const env = {
      WHATSAPP_TOKEN:            !!process.env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN,
      WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID:  !!process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID,
      WHATSAPP_WABA_ID:          !!process.env.WHATSAPP_WABA_ID,
      WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET:       !!process.env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET,
      WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN: !!process.env.WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN,
      WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION:    process.env.WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION || 'v20.0 (default)',
    };

    const [phone, described] = await Promise.all([checkPhoneNumber(), describeTemplates()]);

    const templates = described.available
      ? auditTemplates(described.templates)
      : [];

    const blocking = [];
    if (!env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN)           blocking.push('WHATSAPP_TOKEN is not set -- no WhatsApp message can be sent.');
    if (!env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID) blocking.push('WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID is not set -- no WhatsApp message can be sent.');
    if (!env.WHATSAPP_WABA_ID)         blocking.push('WHATSAPP_WABA_ID is not set -- template shapes are guessed instead of read. Set it.');
    if (!env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET)      blocking.push('WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is not set -- the inbound webhook rejects everything, so delivery receipts and condition keywords are lost.');
    if (!phone.ok)                     blocking.push(`Phone number check failed: ${phone.reason}`);
    templates.filter((t) => t.verdict !== 'OK').forEach((t) => blocking.push(`${t.name}: ${t.verdict}`));

    // ── Optional live send ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    let testSend = null;
    const testRaw = (event.queryStringParameters || {}).test;
    if (testRaw) {
      const to = normalizePhone(testRaw);
      if (!to) {
        testSend = { ok: false, error: `"${testRaw}" is not a recognizable Indian mobile number` };
      } else {
        try {
          const r = await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
            recipientPhone: to,
            templateName: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME || 'zivogift_birthday_surprise',
            bodyVariables: ['ZivoGift', 'This is a delivery test from your admin diagnostics. If you can read this, WhatsApp is working.'],
          });
          testSend = { ok: true, ...r, note: 'Accepted by Meta. Confirm it actually arrived on the handset -- acceptance is not delivery.' };
        } catch (err) {
          testSend = { ok: false, terminal: !!err.terminal, metaCode: err.metaCode || null, error: err.message };
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        healthy: blocking.length === 0,
        blocking_issues: blocking,
        env,
        phone_number: phone,
        template_introspection: described.available
          ? { available: true, count: described.templates.length }
          : { available: false, reason: described.reason },
        templates,
        all_templates_on_waba: described.available ? described.templates.map((t) => t.name).sort() : [],
        test_send: testSend,
      }, null, 2),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'diagnostics_failed', detail: err.message }) };
  }
};

FILE: netlify\functions\ai-generate.js

// POST /.netlify/functions/ai-generate
//
// AUDIT BUGFIX (Group 5): three separate places in the studio called
// api.anthropic.com directly from the browser with NO API key —
//   • js/studio.js          — "AI Polish" message suggestions
//   • js/studio-group2.js   — Character Drop persona message generation
//   • js/studio-group4.js   — AI Roast Certificate + Horoscope Drop
// All three always failed (the browser can't hold a secret key) and
// silently fell back to static templates. Every user saw canned text and
// never real AI output, with no visible error. This is the one server-side
// function all three now call — it holds ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (same pattern as
// noteStoryHelper.js / numerologyHelper.js) and is the only thing that ever
// touches the real API.
//
// Body: { system?, prompt, maxTokens? }
//   - prompt-building (which template, which vibe, which persona) stays
//     client-side since none of it is secret — this function's only job is
//     to hold the key and enforce the usage limit below.
//
// Auth (optional): with a Supabase bearer token, enforces the real Zivo Pass
// free tier — 3 AI generations/month for non-Pass accounts, unlimited for
// Pass holders. Guests (no token) are never gated, same as the rest of the
// site. This closes the gap where the old client-side-only counter in
// studio-group5.js could be bypassed by calling the endpoint directly.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { generateText } = require('./_lib/anthropicHelper');

const FREE_GENERATIONS_LIMIT = 3;

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); } catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }); }

  const prompt = String(body.prompt || '').trim();
  const system = body.system ? String(body.system).trim() : undefined;
  const maxTokens = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(body.maxTokens, 10) || 500, 1), 1200);

  if (!prompt) return json(400, { error: 'Missing prompt' });
  if (prompt.length > 4000) return json(400, { error: 'Prompt too long' });
  if (system && system.length > 4000) return json(400, { error: 'System prompt too long' });

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const authHeader = event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization;

  if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    const token = authHeader.slice(7);
    const { data: userData } = await supabase.auth.getUser(token);
    const userId = userData && userData.user ? userData.user.id : null;

    if (userId) {
      const { data: sub } = await supabase
        .from('subscriptions').select('id')
        .eq('user_id', userId).eq('status', 'active')
        .gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
        .maybeSingle();
      const hasPass = !!sub;

      if (!hasPass) {
        const monthKey = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
        const { data: usage } = await supabase
          .from('ai_polish_usage').select('count').eq('user_id', userId).eq('month_key', monthKey).maybeSingle();
        const count = usage ? usage.count : 0;

        if (count >= FREE_GENERATIONS_LIMIT) {
          return json(403, { error: 'limit_reached', message: 'Free AI generations used up for this month — Zivo Pass gives unlimited.' });
        }
        await supabase.from('ai_polish_usage')
          .upsert({ user_id: userId, month_key: monthKey, count: count + 1 }, { onConflict: 'user_id,month_key' });
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    const text = await generateText({ system, prompt, maxTokens });
    return json(200, { text });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('ai-generate: generateText failed:', e.message);
    return json(502, { error: 'ai_unavailable', message: e.message });
  }
};

function json(status, body) {
  return { statusCode: status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) };
}

// POST /.netlify/functions/bulk-order-submit
//
// Handles the Bulk & Corporate Orders form (bulk-orders.html).
//
// WHY THIS EXISTS: the form used to be a Netlify Forms submission
// (data-netlify="true"), which POSTs to the page URL and relies on Netlify's
// build-time form detection. When that detection isn't active the POST hits a
// static HTML file and Netlify returns its 404 "Page Not Found" — exactly the
// "not successful after entering details" symptom on "Request a Quote". This
// function replaces that flow: the page fetch()es here, we email the enquiry
// to the owner via Resend, and the page shows an inline success state. No page
// navigation, so no 404. Mirrors contact-submit.js on purpose.

const { sendEmail, escapeHtml } = require('./_lib/resend');

function json(status, body) {
  return {
    statusCode: status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  };
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); }
  catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid request' }); }

  // Honeypot — bots fill hidden fields. Pretend success, send nothing.
  if (body['bot-field']) return json(200, { ok: true });

  const org      = String(body.org || '').trim();
  const name     = String(body.name || '').trim();
  const phone    = String(body.phone || '').trim();
  const email    = String(body.email || '').trim();
  const quantity = String(body.quantity || '').trim();
  const neededBy = String(body.needed_by || '').trim();
  const details  = String(body.details || '').trim();

  if (!org || !name || !phone || !email) {
    return json(400, { error: 'Please fill in organisation, contact person, phone and email.' });
  }
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
    return json(400, { error: 'Please enter a valid email address.' });
  }
  if (details.length > 5000) {
    return json(400, { error: 'That is a little long — please shorten your requirement.' });
  }

  const adminEmail = process.env.BULK_ORDER_NOTIFY_EMAIL
    || process.env.CAMPUS_REP_NOTIFY_EMAIL
    || process.env.ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL
    || 'hello@zivogift.com';

  const row = (label, value) =>
    `<p style="margin:4px 0;"><strong>${escapeHtml(label)}:</strong> ${escapeHtml(value || 'Not provided')}</p>`;

  const html =
    `<h2>New bulk / corporate order enquiry</h2>` +
    row('Organisation / College', org) +
    row('Contact person', name) +
    row('Phone', phone) +
    row('Email', email) +
    row('Approx. quantity', quantity) +
    row('Needed by', neededBy) +
    `<p style="margin:10px 0 4px;"><strong>What they need:</strong></p>` +
    `<p style="margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;">${escapeHtml(details || 'Not provided')}</p>`;

  const text =
    `New bulk / corporate order enquiry\n` +
    `Organisation / College: ${org}\n` +
    `Contact person: ${name}\n` +
    `Phone: ${phone}\n` +
    `Email: ${email}\n` +
    `Approx. quantity: ${quantity || 'Not provided'}\n` +
    `Needed by: ${neededBy || 'Not provided'}\n` +
    `What they need:\n${details || 'Not provided'}`;

  try {
    await sendEmail({
      to: adminEmail,
      replyTo: email,
      subject: `New bulk order enquiry from ${org} (${name})`,
      html,
      text,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('bulk-order-submit: email send failed:', e.message);
    return json(500, { error: 'Sorry, something went wrong sending your request. Please email hello@zivogift.com.' });
  }

  return json(200, { ok: true });
};

FILE: netlify\functions\campaign-sender.js

// netlify/functions/campaign-sender.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs every 5 minutes (see netlify.toml).
// Drains public.campaign_recipients for campaigns in status 'sending'.
//
// Shape deliberately copied from gift-scheduler.js: same BATCH_SIZE of 20,
// same Promise.allSettled, same attempts/MAX_ATTEMPTS retry discipline. There
// is no reason for the marketing path to behave differently from the gift
// path against the same provider APIs, and copying the proven shape means one
// mental model for both.
//
// ── WHY EVERY 5 MINUTES, NOT EVERY 2 ────────────────────────────────────────
// gift-scheduler runs every 2 minutes because a birthday gift is time-critical
// to the minute. A promotional email is not. 5 minutes is 288 invocations/day.
// The first query is a single indexed count against a partial index
// (idx_campaign_recipients_queued) and early-exits when there is nothing
// queued, which is the normal state. That keeps the credit cost of having
// this feature installed close to zero when you are not running a campaign.
//
// ── THROUGHPUT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 20 per run x 12 runs/hour = 240/hour. A 1000-person email campaign takes
// about 4 hours to drain. That is intentional: a slow ramp on a domain that
// has only ever sent transactional mail is exactly what you want, because a
// sudden 1000-message spike is the classic trigger for being throttled.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
const { renderCampaignEmail, unsubHeaders } = require('./_lib/campaignEmail');
const { guardCampaigns } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');

const BATCH_SIZE = 20;
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Kill switch, checked before any query that costs anything.
  const halted = await guardCampaigns(supabase, 'campaign-sender');
  if (halted) return halted;

  // 1. Pick ONE campaign that is actively sending. Doing one campaign per run
  //    rather than interleaving keeps the per-campaign counters honest and
  //    means a big campaign cannot starve behind a stuck one.
  const { data: campaigns, error: cErr } = await supabase
    .from('campaigns')
    .select('*')
    .eq('status', 'sending')
    .order('started_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(1);

  if (cErr) {
    console.error('campaign-sender: campaign fetch failed:', cErr.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: cErr.message };
  }
  if (!campaigns || !campaigns.length) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'No campaign is sending.' };
  }

  const campaign = campaigns[0];

  // 2. Grab a batch of queued recipients.
  const { data: batch, error: rErr } = await supabase
    .from('campaign_recipients')
    .select('*')
    .eq('campaign_id', campaign.id)
    .eq('status', 'queued')
    .lt('attempts', MAX_ATTEMPTS)
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (rErr) {
    console.error('campaign-sender: recipient fetch failed:', rErr.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: rErr.message };
  }

  // 3. Nothing left -> the campaign is done. Recount from the table rather
  //    than trusting the running counters, so the final numbers are the truth
  //    even if a previous run died mid-batch.
  if (!batch || !batch.length) {
    return await finalise(supabase, campaign);
  }

  console.log(`campaign-sender: campaign "${campaign.name}" -- processing ${batch.length}`);

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    batch.map((r) => processRecipient(supabase, campaign, r))
  );

  const sent = results.filter((x) => x.status === 'fulfilled' && x.value === 'sent').length;
  const failed = results.length - sent;

  // Increment rather than overwrite: two runs must not clobber each other's
  // progress. Read-modify-write is acceptable here because only one cron
  // instance processes a given campaign at a time.
  const { data: fresh } = await supabase
    .from('campaigns').select('sent_count, failed_count').eq('id', campaign.id).single();
  await supabase.from('campaigns').update({
    sent_count: ((fresh && fresh.sent_count) || 0) + sent,
    failed_count: ((fresh && fresh.failed_count) || 0) + failed,
  }).eq('id', campaign.id);

  console.log(`campaign-sender: sent=${sent} failed=${failed}`);
  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ campaign: campaign.name, processed: batch.length, sent, failed }) };
};

async function processRecipient(supabase, campaign, r) {
  const attempts = (r.attempts || 0) + 1;

  try {
    let messageId = null;

    if (r.channel === 'email') {
      if (!r.email) throw terminal('No email address on this recipient row.');
      const { subject, html, text } = renderCampaignEmail(campaign, r);
      const res = await sendEmail({
        to: r.email,
        subject,
        html,
        text,
        headers: unsubHeaders(campaign, r),
      });
      // sendEmail returns {skipped:true} rather than throwing when the API key
      // is missing. Treating that as success would report a campaign as fully
      // delivered when not one message left the building.
      if (res.skipped) throw terminal('RESEND_API_KEY is not set on this deploy -- nothing was sent.');
      messageId = res.id || null;

    } else if (r.channel === 'whatsapp') {
      if (!r.phone10) throw terminal('No phone number on this recipient row.');
      if (!campaign.wa_template) throw terminal('This campaign has no WhatsApp template name.');
      const res = await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
        recipientPhone: `91${r.phone10}`,
        templateName: campaign.wa_template,
        bodyVariables: [
          r.full_name || 'there',
          String(campaign.body || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 900),
        ],
      });
      messageId = res.messageId || null;

    } else {
      throw terminal(`Unknown channel "${r.channel}".`);
    }

    await supabase.from('campaign_recipients').update({
      status: 'sent',
      attempts,
      provider_message_id: messageId,
      sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      error_message: null,
    }).eq('id', r.id);

    return 'sent';

  } catch (e) {
    const msg = String((e && e.message) || e);

    // _lib/whatsapp.js marks errors `terminal` when a retry cannot possibly
    // help (template rejected, number not on WhatsApp, missing env var).
    // Retrying those just burns quota and hurts the number's quality rating.
    const isTerminal = !!(e && e.terminal) || attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS;

    await supabase.from('campaign_recipients').update({
      status: isTerminal ? 'failed' : 'queued',
      attempts,
      error_message: msg.slice(0, 500),
    }).eq('id', r.id);

    if (isTerminal) console.error(`campaign-sender: recipient ${r.id} failed permanently: ${msg}`);
    else console.warn(`campaign-sender: recipient ${r.id} attempt ${attempts} failed, will retry: ${msg}`);

    return 'failed';
  }
}

function terminal(message) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  e.terminal = true;
  return e;
}

// Recount from campaign_recipients -- the single source of truth -- and close
// the campaign out.
async function finalise(supabase, campaign) {
  const counts = {};
  for (const s of ['sent', 'failed', 'queued', 'skipped']) {
    const { count } = await supabase
      .from('campaign_recipients')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('campaign_id', campaign.id).eq('status', s);
    counts[s] = count || 0;
  }

  // Rows that exhausted MAX_ATTEMPTS while still marked 'queued' would
  // otherwise stall the campaign forever, because the batch query filters
  // them out but finalise() would keep seeing queued > 0.
  if (counts.queued > 0) {
    const { data: stuck } = await supabase
      .from('campaign_recipients')
      .select('id')
      .eq('campaign_id', campaign.id).eq('status', 'queued')
      .gte('attempts', MAX_ATTEMPTS).limit(1000);
    if (stuck && stuck.length) {
      await supabase.from('campaign_recipients')
        .update({ status: 'failed', error_message: 'Gave up after maximum retry attempts.' })
        .in('id', stuck.map((x) => x.id));
      console.warn(`campaign-sender: marked ${stuck.length} exhausted recipients as failed`);
      return { statusCode: 200, body: `Cleaned up ${stuck.length} exhausted rows.` };
    }
  }

  await supabase.from('campaigns').update({
    status: 'completed',
    completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    sent_count: counts.sent,
    failed_count: counts.failed,
  }).eq('id', campaign.id);

  console.log(`campaign-sender: campaign "${campaign.name}" completed -- sent=${counts.sent} failed=${counts.failed}`);
  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ completed: campaign.name, ...counts }) };
}

module.exports.processRecipient = processRecipient;

// netlify/functions/care-package-generator.js
//
// SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs every 2 minutes, same cadence as
// gift-scheduler.js / clip-scheduler.js.
//
// Picks up care_package_orders with status='pending_generation', generates
// the full message sequence in ONE Claude call per order (structured JSON,
// ~14 entries), and stores it. Deliberately does NOT run the safety
// guardrail checks in this same tick — see care-package-guardrail.js and
// the schema comment on guardrail_checked for why (10s limit risk).
//
// Calls _lib/anthropicHelper.js's generateText() DIRECTLY, not the
// ai-generate.js HTTP endpoint — ai-generate.js hard-caps maxTokens at 1200,
// which a 14-entry structured JSON array will exceed. generateText() itself
// has no such cap; the limit lives only in ai-generate.js's handler.
//
// BATCH SIZE = 1 order per tick, deliberately small: a single generation
// call producing ~14 structured entries can itself take several seconds,
// and this needs to stay well inside Netlify's 10s synchronous limit even
// on a scheduled function — that ceiling doesn't go away just because
// nothing HTTP is waiting on the response.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { generateText } = require('./_lib/anthropicHelper');

const BATCH_SIZE = 1;
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
const GENERATION_MAX_TOKENS = 4000; // ~14 entries * ~150-200 tokens + JSON structure overhead, with headroom
const SEND_HOUR_IST = 9; // fixed daily send time — see schema comment on scheduled_at

const TONE_GUIDANCE = {
  postpartum: `This is for a new parent. Content must be warm, practical, and NEVER read as medical or professional advice. Absolutely no medical claims (about the baby's or parent's health, feeding, sleep, medication) and no mental-health diagnostic language (do not name or imply conditions like "postpartum depression" — even sympathetically). Focus on: emotional encouragement, practical non-medical support ("order food tonight," "nap when you can," "you're allowed to feel however you feel"), and light warmth/humor. This is a friend's care, not a doctor's advice.`,
};

const RELATIONSHIP_GUIDANCE = {
  friend: 'Casual, warm, like a close friend texting — can be a little playful.',
  parent: "A parent's voice — nurturing, a bit more traditional, deeply caring.",
  'in-law': 'Warm but slightly more formal/respectful — a caring in-law, not overly casual.',
  partner: "A partner's voice — intimate, tender, personally invested.",
};

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: orders, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    .from('care_package_orders')
    .select('id, sender_name, package_type, relationship_tone, personal_note, start_date, cadence_days, total_messages, generation_attempts')
    .eq('status', 'pending_generation')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (fetchError) {
    console.error('care-package-generator: fetch error:', fetchError.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: fetchError.message };
  }
  if (!orders || orders.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Nothing to generate.' };
  }

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(orders.map((order) => processOrder(supabase, order)));
  const done = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;
  console.log(`care-package-generator: done=${done} failed=${failed}`);

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ processed: orders.length, done, failed }) };
};

async function processOrder(supabase, order) {
  try {
    const entries = await generateSequence(order);
    const rows = entries.map((entry, i) => {
      const dayNumber = i + 1;
      const scheduledAt = addDaysAtFixedTime(order.start_date, i * order.cadence_days, SEND_HOUR_IST);
      return {
        care_package_order_id: order.id,
        day_number: dayNumber,
        message_text: entry.message_text,
        tone_tag: entry.tone_tag || null,
        scheduled_at: scheduledAt,
      };
    });

    const { error: insertError } = await supabase.from('care_package_messages').insert(rows);
    if (insertError) throw new Error(`insert failed: ${insertError.message}`);

    await supabase.from('care_package_orders')
      .update({ status: 'active', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', order.id);

    console.log(`care-package-generator: generated ${rows.length} messages for order ${order.id}`);
    return { id: order.id, status: 'active' };
  } catch (err) {
    const attempts = (order.generation_attempts || 0) + 1;
    const nextStatus = attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'pending_generation' : 'failed';
    console.error(`care-package-generator: order ${order.id} failed (attempt ${attempts}):`, err.message);

    await supabase.from('care_package_orders')
      .update({
        status: nextStatus,
        generation_attempts: attempts,
        generation_error: err.message,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', order.id);

    throw err;
  }
}

async function generateSequence(order) {
  const toneGuidance = TONE_GUIDANCE[order.package_type] || TONE_GUIDANCE.postpartum;
  const relationshipGuidance = RELATIONSHIP_GUIDANCE[order.relationship_tone] || RELATIONSHIP_GUIDANCE.friend;
  const total = order.total_messages || 14;

  const system = `You write short, warm WhatsApp messages for Zivogift's Care Package feature — a paced sequence of personal notes from a real sender to someone going through a life event, spread out over time rather than sent all at once.

${toneGuidance}

Relationship voice: ${relationshipGuidance}

Every message must feel personally written by the sender, never like an automated subscription. Reference the sender by name naturally sometimes (sender's name: "${order.sender_name}"), e.g. "${order.sender_name} wanted you to know...".

${order.personal_note ? `Personal context from the sender about the recipient: "${order.personal_note}" — use this naturally where it fits, don't force it into every message.` : ''}

Respond with ONLY a JSON array, nothing else — no markdown fencing, no preamble. Exactly ${total} entries, each: {"message_text": "<2-3 lines, under 300 characters>", "tone_tag": "rest"|"food"|"encouragement"|"light-humor"}. Vary the tone_tag across entries — don't repeat the same one back-to-back.`;

  const prompt = `Generate the full ${total}-message sequence now.`;

  const raw = await generateText({ system, prompt, maxTokens: GENERATION_MAX_TOKENS });
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim();

  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`model did not return valid JSON: ${err.message}`);
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || parsed.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('model returned an empty or non-array result');
  }
  if (parsed.length < total) {
    throw new Error(`expected ${total} entries, got ${parsed.length} — likely truncated`);
  }
  return parsed.slice(0, total).map((e) => ({
    message_text: String(e.message_text || '').trim(),
    tone_tag: e.tone_tag || null,
  })).filter((e) => e.message_text);
}

// Adds N days to a date, at a fixed hour, in IST (UTC+5:30), returning an
// ISO timestamp — matches gift-scheduler.js's scheduled_at convention.
function addDaysAtFixedTime(startDateStr, daysToAdd, hourIST) {
  const [y, m, d] = startDateStr.split('-').map(Number);
  const istMs = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + daysToAdd, hourIST, 0, 0) - (5.5 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  return new Date(istMs).toISOString();
}

module.exports.addDaysAtFixedTime = addDaysAtFixedTime; // exported for testing

// netlify/functions/care-package-guardrail.js
//
// SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs every 2 minutes, same cadence as the other
// care-package crons. Deliberately SEPARATE from care-package-generator.js —
// see schema comment on guardrail_checked for why (10s limit risk from
// stacking 1 generation call + 14 sequential safety checks in one tick).
//
// Picks up a small batch of individual care_package_messages rows where
// guardrail_checked=false (not orders — batching by MESSAGE keeps each tick
// small and predictable regardless of how many messages one order has),
// checks them in PARALLEL (Promise.all, not sequential) via
// _lib/carePackageContentGuard.js, and marks each checked.
//
// care-package-scheduler.js never sends a message where guardrail_checked
// is still false — so a message simply won't go out until this has run,
// typically within a couple of ticks (a few minutes) of generation.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { checkCarePackageContent } = require('./_lib/carePackageContentGuard');

const BATCH_SIZE = 8; // small enough that 8 parallel Anthropic calls comfortably finish inside 10s

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: messages, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    .from('care_package_messages')
    .select('id, message_text')
    .eq('guardrail_checked', false)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (fetchError) {
    console.error('care-package-guardrail: fetch error:', fetchError.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: fetchError.message };
  }
  if (!messages || messages.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Nothing to check.' };
  }

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    messages.map((msg) => checkOne(supabase, msg))
  );
  const checked = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
  const errored = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;
  console.log(`care-package-guardrail: checked=${checked} errored=${errored}`);

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ processed: messages.length, checked, errored }) };
};

async function checkOne(supabase, msg) {
  const result = await checkCarePackageContent(msg.message_text);
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('care_package_messages')
    .update({ guardrail_checked: true, guardrail_flagged: !result.ok })
    .eq('id', msg.id);

  if (error) throw new Error(`update failed for message ${msg.id}: ${error.message}`);
  if (!result.ok) {
    console.warn(`care-package-guardrail: message ${msg.id} flagged: ${result.reason}`);
  }
  return { id: msg.id, flagged: !result.ok };
}

FILE: netlify\functions\care-package-scheduler.js
