// netlify/functions/care-package-scheduler.js
//
// SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs every 2 minutes, same cadence as
// gift-scheduler.js / clip-scheduler.js.
//
// Sends care_package_messages that are: due (scheduled_at <= now),
// guardrail_checked = true AND guardrail_flagged = false (never auto-sends
// unchecked or flagged content), sent_status = 'pending', and whose PARENT
// order is status = 'active' (not paused/completed/failed).
//
// A message that's due while its order is 'paused' is marked 'skipped', not
// silently left pending forever — see schema comment. It is NOT rescheduled
// to fire later on resume; the recipient paused, they don't get a pile of
// backlogged messages dumped on them when they unmute — see
// whatsapp-webhook.js's RESUME handling, which only re-arms future sends.
//
// On the last message of a sequence sending successfully, notifies the
// sender once (completion_notified guards against duplicate notification on
// retry).

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');

const BATCH_SIZE = 20; // lightweight sends (template messages), can handle more per tick than clip rendering

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  // Mark due messages whose order is paused as 'skipped' first, so they
  // stop showing up in the due query on every future tick.
  await skipDueMessagesForPausedOrders(supabase, now);

  const { data: dueMessages, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    .from('care_package_messages')
    .select('id, care_package_order_id, day_number, message_text')
    .eq('sent_status', 'pending')
    .eq('guardrail_checked', true)
    .eq('guardrail_flagged', false)
    .lte('scheduled_at', now)
    .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (fetchError) {
    console.error('care-package-scheduler: fetch error:', fetchError.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: fetchError.message };
  }
  if (!dueMessages || dueMessages.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Nothing due.' };
  }

  // Only send for orders that are actually active (not paused in the gap
  // between the skip-pass above and this fetch, and not completed/failed).
  const orderIds = [...new Set(dueMessages.map((m) => m.care_package_order_id))];
  const { data: orders } = await supabase
    .from('care_package_orders')
    .select('id, recipient_phone, sender_name, sender_phone, total_messages, status, completion_notified')
    .in('id', orderIds);
  const orderById = new Map((orders || []).map((o) => [o.id, o]));

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    dueMessages
      .filter((m) => orderById.get(m.care_package_order_id)?.status === 'active')
      .map((m) => sendOne(supabase, m, orderById.get(m.care_package_order_id)))
  );
  const sent = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;
  console.log(`care-package-scheduler: sent=${sent} failed=${failed}`);

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ processed: dueMessages.length, sent, failed }) };
};

async function skipDueMessagesForPausedOrders(supabase, now) {
  const { data: pausedOrders } = await supabase
    .from('care_package_orders')
    .select('id')
    .eq('status', 'paused');
  if (!pausedOrders || pausedOrders.length === 0) return;

  const pausedIds = pausedOrders.map((o) => o.id);
  await supabase
    .from('care_package_messages')
    .update({ sent_status: 'skipped' })
    .in('care_package_order_id', pausedIds)
    .eq('sent_status', 'pending')
    .lte('scheduled_at', now);
}

async function sendOne(supabase, message, order) {
  try {
    await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
      recipientPhone: order.recipient_phone,
      templateName: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CARE_DAILY || 'zg_care_package_daily',
      bodyVariables: [order.sender_name, message.message_text],
    });

    await supabase.from('care_package_messages')
      .update({ sent_status: 'sent', sent_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', message.id);

    if (message.day_number >= order.total_messages && !order.completion_notified) {
      await notifySenderOfCompletion(supabase, order);
    }

    return { id: message.id, status: 'sent' };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`care-package-scheduler: message ${message.id} send failed:`, err.message);
    await supabase.from('care_package_messages')
      .update({ sent_status: 'failed', send_error: err.message })
      .eq('id', message.id);
    throw err;
  }
}

async function notifySenderOfCompletion(supabase, order) {
  try {
    await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
      recipientPhone: order.sender_phone,
      templateName: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CARE_COMPLETE || 'zg_care_package_complete',
      bodyVariables: [order.sender_name],
    });
    await supabase.from('care_package_orders')
      .update({ status: 'completed', completion_notified: true, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', order.id);
  } catch (err) {
    // Non-fatal — the recipient's messages all sent successfully either
    // way; a failed completion ping to the sender shouldn't be treated as
    // the same class of failure. Log it and move on; order still gets
    // marked completed since the sequence itself genuinely finished.
    console.warn(`care-package-scheduler: completion notification failed for order ${order.id}:`, err.message);
    await supabase.from('care_package_orders')
      .update({ status: 'completed', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', order.id);
  }
}

FILE: netlify\functions\cashfree-webhook.js

// POST /.netlify/functions/cashfree-webhook
// Configure this exact URL in Cashfree Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks
// for the PAYMENT_SUCCESS / PAYMENT_FAILED events.
//
// Cashfree signs every webhook — we verify that signature before trusting
// anything in the payload, then update the order and fire off emails.
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { verifyWebhookSignature } = require('./_lib/cashfree');
const { scheduleDigitalSendsForOrder } = require('./_lib/digitalSendsHelper');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const signature = event.headers['x-webhook-signature'];
  const timestamp = event.headers['x-webhook-timestamp'];
  const rawBody = event.body || '';

  if (!signature || !timestamp || !verifyWebhookSignature({ rawBody, timestamp, signature })) {
    console.error('Cashfree webhook signature mismatch — rejecting.');
    return { statusCode: 401, body: 'Invalid signature' };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Replay protection: unconditionally process each distinct webhook
  // delivery exactly once. A duplicate signature — whether a genuine
  // Cashfree retry or a captured-and-resent request — is rejected here
  // regardless of the order's current status, which the status-based
  // idempotency check below doesn't cover (e.g. if an order was manually
  // refunded/cancelled after the first delivery).
  const { error: replayInsertErr } = await supabase
    .from('cashfree_webhook_events')
    .insert({ signature });
  if (replayInsertErr) {
    if (replayInsertErr.code === '23505') { // unique_violation
      console.warn('Cashfree webhook: duplicate/replayed delivery — skipping.');
      return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Already processed' };
    }
    console.error('cashfree-webhook: replay-log insert failed:', replayInsertErr.message);
    // Don't fail the whole webhook over a logging error — proceed, since
    // the signature+timestamp checks above already passed.
  }

  const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  const eventType = payload.type; // e.g. "PAYMENT_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK", "PAYMENT_FAILED_WEBHOOK"
  const orderNumber = payload.data?.order?.order_id;
  const cfPaymentId = payload.data?.payment?.cf_payment_id;

  if (!orderNumber) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: 'Missing order_id in webhook payload' };
  }

  const { data: order, error } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .select('*')
    .eq('order_number', orderNumber)
    .single();

  if (error || !order) {
    console.error('Webhook for unknown order:', orderNumber);
    return { statusCode: 404, body: 'Order not found' };
  }

  // Idempotency — Cashfree may retry webhooks; don't double-process.
  if (order.status === 'paid' || order.status === 'processing') {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Already processed' };
  }

  const isSuccess = eventType === 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK';
  const newStatus = isSuccess ? 'paid' : 'payment_failed';

  await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .update({ status: newStatus, cashfree_payment_id: cfPaymentId || null })
    .eq('id', order.id);

  await supabase.from('order_status_history').insert({
    order_id: order.id,
    status: newStatus,
    note: isSuccess ? 'Payment confirmed by Cashfree' : 'Payment failed',
  });

  if (isSuccess) {
    const { data: items } = await supabase.from('order_items').select('*').eq('order_id', order.id);
    const updatedOrder = { ...order, status: newStatus };

    try {
      const { sendOrderConfirmationEffects } = require('./_lib/orderConfirmationEffects');
      await sendOrderConfirmationEffects(supabase, updatedOrder, items || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Order confirmation effects failed:', e.message);
    }


    // Feature #15 — Zivo Pass: activate a 6-month subscription if this order
    // includes the pass_semester product. Rides on the generic product
    // pipeline — no separate payment flow needed.
    try {
      const passItem = (items || []).find((i) => i.product_id === 'pass_semester');
      if (passItem && order.user_id) {
        const startedAt = new Date();
        const expiresAt = new Date(startedAt);
        expiresAt.setMonth(expiresAt.getMonth() + 6);
        await supabase.from('subscriptions').insert({
          user_id: order.user_id,
          plan: 'semester',
          status: 'active',
          started_at: startedAt.toISOString(),
          expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
          order_id: order.id,
        });
      } else if (passItem && !order.user_id) {
        console.warn(`cashfree-webhook: pass_semester purchased on guest order ${order.order_number} — cannot activate without an account.`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Zivo Pass activation failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
    }

    // Feature #20 — Campus Rep Micro-Affiliate Network: credit commission on
    // this order now that payment is confirmed (not at order-creation time,
    // since unpaid/failed orders shouldn't owe anything).
    try {
      if (order.rep_ref_code) {
        const { data: rep } = await supabase
          .from('campus_reps').select('id, commission_rate, status').eq('ref_code', order.rep_ref_code).maybeSingle();
        if (rep && rep.status === 'approved') {
          const commission = Math.round((order.subtotal || order.total) * (rep.commission_rate / 100) * 100) / 100;
          await supabase.from('orders').update({
            rep_commission_amount: commission,
            rep_commission_status: 'pending',
          }).eq('id', order.id);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Rep commission crediting failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
    }

    // Schedule WhatsApp sends for any digital products in this order
    try {
      await scheduleDigitalSendsForOrder(supabase, updatedOrder, items || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Digital send scheduling failed:', e.message);
    }

    // Schedule Care Package generation for any care package products in this order
    try {
      const { scheduleCarePackagesForOrder } = require('./_lib/carePackageHelper');
      await scheduleCarePackagesForOrder(supabase, updatedOrder, items || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Care package scheduling failed:', e.message);
    }

    // If this is a reply gift (sent back through the anonymous relay), notify the
    // original anonymous sender that they got a reply — non-fatal if it fails.
    if (order.ref === 'gift_reply' && order.reply_token) {
      try {
        const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';
        await fetch(`${siteUrl}/.netlify/functions/notify-original-sender`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            reply_token: order.reply_token,
            recipient_name: order.contact_name, // the person sending the reply
          }),
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('notify-original-sender failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
      }
    }
  } else {
    // PAYMENT FAILED — previously this path updated the order status but sent
    // no notification at all, so the owner never heard about declined or
    // abandoned payments. Send an admin alert now. Non-fatal: a mail failure
    // must never make us return non-200 (Cashfree would just keep retrying).
    try {
      const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL
        || process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
        || 'orders@zivogift.com';
      if (adminEmail) {
        const { sendEmail, adminPaymentFailedEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');
        const reason = payload.data?.payment?.payment_message
          || payload.data?.error_details?.error_description
          || null;
        await sendEmail({
          to: adminEmail,
          subject: `Payment FAILED ${order.order_number} — ₹${order.total}`,
          html: adminPaymentFailedEmail(order, reason),
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Payment-failed admin alert failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
    }
  }

  return { statusCode: 200, body: 'OK' };
};

FILE: netlify\functions\clip-scheduler.js

// netlify/functions/clip-scheduler.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs every 2 minutes, same pattern as
// gift-scheduler.js. No HTTP trigger; Netlify's infrastructure calls it.
//
// HOW IT WORKS:
//   1. Looks in `share_clip_jobs` for rows where status = 'pending'
//   2. For each, loads the parent digital_sends row for recipient/sender/
//      message/vibe/photo, renders the animated clip, uploads the MP4 to R2
//   3. Marks the row 'done' (with output_url) or 'failed' (with error_message)
//
// Kept as its own job type (not folded into gift-scheduler.js) because clip
// rendering is CPU-heavier than a WhatsApp send — a smaller batch size keeps
// each tick well-behaved even if several people tap "Download & Share" at once.
//
// NETLIFY SCHEDULED FUNCTIONS SETUP: see netlify.toml
//   [functions."clip-scheduler"]
//     schedule = "*/2 * * * *"

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { uploadBufferToR2 } = require('./_lib/r2Client');
const { renderFrames, encodeToMp4 } = require('./_lib/clipFrames');

const BATCH_SIZE = 5;       // clip rendering is heavier than a WhatsApp send — keep batches small
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;     // after this many failures, stop retrying and leave status='failed'

// ── STALE JOB RECLAIM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// processJob() marks a row 'processing' before it starts rendering, so two
// overlapping ticks cannot render the same clip twice. The hole that left:
// if the Lambda is KILLED mid-render — which is the normal outcome when an
// ffmpeg encode runs past the function timeout — nothing ever writes the row
// back. It sits at 'processing' forever. The scheduler's query only looks for
// 'pending', so it is never retried, and create-share-clip-job.js reuses any
// non-'failed' job, so every subsequent tap re-attaches to the dead row.
//
// That is the "Download & Share does nothing" bug: the button was correct,
// the job was a zombie.
//
// Any row still 'processing' after this many ms is assumed dead and pulled
// back into the queue. Comfortably longer than the worst observed render, so
// a genuinely slow job is never stolen from itself.
const STALE_PROCESSING_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Reclaim abandoned rows before selecting work, so they are picked up by
  // the very same tick rather than waiting another two minutes.
  const staleCutoff = new Date(Date.now() - STALE_PROCESSING_MS).toISOString();
  const { data: reclaimed, error: reclaimError } = await supabase
    .from('share_clip_jobs')
    .update({ status: 'pending', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('status', 'processing')
    .lt('updated_at', staleCutoff)
    .select('id');

  if (reclaimError) {
    // Non-fatal: a failed reclaim must not stop the ordinary queue draining.
    console.warn('clip-scheduler: stale reclaim failed:', reclaimError.message);
  } else if (reclaimed && reclaimed.length) {
    console.warn(`clip-scheduler: reclaimed ${reclaimed.length} stale processing job(s)`);
  }

  const { data: pendingJobs, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    .from('share_clip_jobs')
    .select('id, digital_send_id, attempts')
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (fetchError) {
    console.error('clip-scheduler: fetch error:', fetchError.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: fetchError.message };
  }

  if (!pendingJobs || pendingJobs.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Nothing to render.' };
  }

  console.log(`clip-scheduler: processing ${pendingJobs.length} jobs`);

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    pendingJobs.map((job) => processJob(supabase, job))
  );

  const done = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;
  console.log(`clip-scheduler: done=${done} failed=${failed}`);

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ processed: pendingJobs.length, done, failed }) };
};

async function processJob(supabase, job) {
  // Claim it first (mark processing) so a slow tick can't double-process
  // the same job if two invocations somehow overlap.
  // attempts is incremented HERE, not only in the catch block. A job killed
  // mid-render never reaches the catch, so counting attempts there alone let a
  // reliably-timing-out job be reclaimed and retried indefinitely.
  const attemptNo = (job.attempts || 0) + 1;

  await supabase.from('share_clip_jobs')
    .update({ status: 'processing', attempts: attemptNo, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('id', job.id);

  if (attemptNo > MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    await supabase.from('share_clip_jobs')
      .update({
        status: 'failed',
        error_message: `Gave up after ${attemptNo - 1} attempts (render did not complete)`,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', job.id);
    console.error(`clip-scheduler: job ${job.id} exceeded MAX_ATTEMPTS — marking failed`);
    return { id: job.id, status: 'failed' };
  }

  try {
    const { data: send, error: sendError } = await supabase
      .from('digital_sends')
      .select('recipient_name, sender_name, personal_message, vibe_key, recipient_photo_url')
      .eq('id', job.digital_send_id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (sendError || !send) {
      throw new Error(`parent digital_send ${job.digital_send_id} not found`);
    }

    const rendered = await renderFrames({
      vibeKey: send.vibe_key,
      recipientName: send.recipient_name,
      senderName: send.sender_name,
      message: send.personal_message,
      recipientPhotoUrl: send.recipient_photo_url,
    });

    const mp4Buffer = encodeToMp4(rendered);

    const safeRecipient = (send.recipient_name || 'gift').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase().slice(0, 30);
    const filename = `share-clips/${job.digital_send_id}/${safeRecipient}-${Date.now()}.mp4`;
    const url = await uploadBufferToR2(mp4Buffer, filename, 'video/mp4');

    await supabase.from('share_clip_jobs')
      .update({ status: 'done', output_url: url, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', job.id);

    console.log(`clip-scheduler: rendered job ${job.id} -> ${url}`);
    return { id: job.id, status: 'done' };
  } catch (err) {
    const attempts = attemptNo;
    const nextStatus = attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'pending' : 'failed';

    console.error(`clip-scheduler: job ${job.id} failed (attempt ${attempts}):`, err.message);

    await supabase.from('share_clip_jobs')
      .update({
        status: nextStatus,
        attempts,
        error_message: err.message,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', job.id);

    throw err;
  }
}

FILE: netlify\functions\college-email-verify.js
=====================================================

// POST /.netlify/functions/college-email-verify?action=send|confirm
//
// FEATURE #16 — College-Exclusive Vibes.
// A student proves they own a .edu-style college email address. Once
// verified, profiles.college_domain is set and studio.js unlocks any
// exclusive_vibes row whose college_domain matches (e.g. 'vit.ac.in' →
// "VIT Tech Bro Mode"). No third-party OTP provider needed — codes are
// emailed via the Resend integration Zivogift already uses.
//
// ?action=send    body: { collegeEmail }               → emails a 6-digit code, 10 min TTL
// ?action=confirm body: { collegeEmail, code }          → verifies + sets profiles.college_domain

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const { sendEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');

const OTP_TTL_MINUTES = 10;

// A short list of consumer/free email providers we refuse as "college" email —
// keeps the feature meaningfully exclusive. Anything else is accepted as a
// college domain since South Indian colleges use hundreds of different TLDs.
const BLOCKED_DOMAINS = new Set([
  'gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'outlook.com', 'hotmail.com', 'icloud.com', 'protonmail.com', 'rediffmail.com',
]);

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  const token = (event.headers.authorization || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return json(401, { error: 'Please log in first' });

  const supabaseUser = createClient(
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL,
    process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    { global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } }
  );
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await supabaseUser.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) return json(401, { error: 'Invalid session' });

  const action = (event.queryStringParameters || {}).action || '';
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); } catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }); }

  if (action === 'send') {
    const collegeEmail = String(body.collegeEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(collegeEmail)) return json(400, { error: 'Enter a valid email address' });

    const domain = collegeEmail.split('@')[1];
    if (BLOCKED_DOMAINS.has(domain)) {
      return json(400, { error: 'Please use your official college email address, not a personal one.' });
    }

    const code = String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + OTP_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

    const { error: insErr } = await supabase.from('college_email_otps').insert({
      user_id: user.id, college_email: collegeEmail, otp_code: code, expires_at: expiresAt,
    });
    if (insErr) return json(500, { error: insErr.message });

    try {
      await sendEmail({
        to: collegeEmail,
        subject: `Your Zivogift verification code: ${code}`,
        html: otpEmailHtml(code),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('college-email-verify: send email failed:', e.message);
      return json(502, { error: 'Could not send the verification email — try again in a minute.' });
    }

    return json(200, { sent: true, expiresInMinutes: OTP_TTL_MINUTES });
  }

  if (action === 'confirm') {
    const collegeEmail = String(body.collegeEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const code = String(body.code || '').trim();
    if (!collegeEmail || !code) return json(400, { error: 'Missing email or code' });

    const { data: otpRow, error: otpErr } = await supabase
      .from('college_email_otps')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('college_email', collegeEmail)
      .eq('consumed', false)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (otpErr || !otpRow) return json(400, { error: 'No pending verification for this email — request a new code.' });
    if (new Date(otpRow.expires_at) < new Date()) return json(400, { error: 'Code expired — request a new one.' });
    if (otpRow.otp_code !== code) return json(400, { error: 'Incorrect code.' });

    await supabase.from('college_email_otps').update({ consumed: true }).eq('id', otpRow.id);

    const domain = collegeEmail.split('@')[1];
    const { error: profErr } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ college_email: collegeEmail, college_domain: domain, college_verified: true })
      .eq('id', user.id);
    if (profErr) return json(500, { error: profErr.message });

    return json(200, { verified: true, collegeDomain: domain });
  }

  return json(400, { error: `Unknown action: ${action}` });
};

function otpEmailHtml(code) {
  return `
  <div style="font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;background:#0d0a17;color:#F5F5F0;padding:32px;border-radius:16px;max-width:420px;margin:auto;">
    <h2 style="font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.5px;margin:0 0 12px;">Zivogift 🎓</h2>
    <p style="font-size:14px;color:#ccc;margin:0 0 20px;">Verify your college email to unlock exclusive vibes only your campus gets.</p>
    <div style="font-size:32px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px;">${code}</div>
    <p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">This code expires in ${OTP_TTL_MINUTES} minutes. If you didn't request this, ignore this email.</p>
  </div>`;
}

function json(status, body) {
  return { statusCode: status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) };
}

FILE: netlify\functions\compose-memory-board.js

// POST /.netlify/functions/compose-memory-board
//
// Feature #21 — Squad Memory Board with Photo Upload.
// Composites 2-6 uploaded photos into a single 1080×1080 collage — a vibe-
// matched background + polaroid-style frames + group message + caption —
// using pure Sharp compositing (no AI image generation needed, per spec).
// Uploads the result to R2 and returns the public URL, same contract as
// generate-card-image.js so gift-scheduler.js can call either one.
//
// Body: { photo_urls: string[], vibe_key, recipient_name, sender_name, message, sub_heading, order_id }
// Returns: { url }

const { uploadBufferToR2 } = require('./_lib/r2Client');

const VIBE_STYLES = {
  squad_memory_board: { bg: ['#2a1400', '#120800'], accent: '#FF9A56', text: '#FFF3E0' },
};
const DEFAULT_STYLE = { bg: ['#2a1400', '#120800'], accent: '#FF9A56', text: '#FFF3E0' };

const CANVAS = 1080;
const MAX_PHOTOS = 6;
const MIN_PHOTOS = 2;

function wrapText(text, maxCharsPerLine) {
  const words = (text || '').split(/\s+/);
  const lines = [];
  let current = '';
  for (const word of words) {
    if ((current + ' ' + word).trim().length > maxCharsPerLine) {
      if (current) lines.push(current);
      current = word;
    } else {
      current = (current + ' ' + word).trim();
    }
  }
  if (current) lines.push(current);
  return lines;
}

function esc(s) {
  return (s || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

// Computes a grid layout (cols/rows + per-tile rect) for N photos within a
// fixed content area, centering any incomplete last row.
function computeGridLayout(count, area) {
  const cols = count <= 2 ? count : (count <= 4 ? 2 : 3);
  const rows = Math.ceil(count / cols);
  const gap = 18;
  const tileW = (area.w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
  const tileH = (area.h - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows;

  const tiles = [];
  let idx = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    const itemsInRow = Math.min(cols, count - r * cols);
    const rowWidth = itemsInRow * tileW + (itemsInRow - 1) * gap;
    const rowStartX = area.x + (area.w - rowWidth) / 2; // center incomplete rows
    for (let c = 0; c < itemsInRow; c++) {
      tiles.push({
        x: Math.round(rowStartX + c * (tileW + gap)),
        y: Math.round(area.y + r * (tileH + gap)),
        w: Math.round(tileW),
        h: Math.round(tileH),
      });
      idx++;
    }
  }
  return tiles;
}

function buildBaseSvg({ vibeKey, caption, message, senderName, tiles }) {
  const style = VIBE_STYLES[vibeKey] || DEFAULT_STYLE;
  const [bg1, bg2] = style.bg;
  const accent = style.accent;
  const textCol = style.text;

  const frameRects = tiles.map((t) =>
    `<rect x="${t.x - 8}" y="${t.y - 8}" width="${t.w + 16}" height="${t.h + 16}" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.96"/>`
  ).join('');

  const msgLines = wrapText((message || 'Made with love from your squad 💛').trim(), 46);
  const footerStartY = CANVAS - 150;
  const msgSvg = msgLines.slice(0, 3).map((line, i) =>
    `<tspan x="${CANVAS / 2}" dy="${i === 0 ? 0 : 30}">${esc(line)}</tspan>`).join('');

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="${CANVAS}" height="${CANVAS}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${bg1}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${bg2}"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="${CANVAS}" height="${CANVAS}" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="${CANVAS / 2}" y="70" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="${accent}" fill-opacity="0.9"
    font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" letter-spacing="5" font-weight="700">✦ SQUAD MEMORIES ✦</text>
  <text x="${CANVAS / 2}" y="102" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" fill="${textCol}" fill-opacity="0.6"
    font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" letter-spacing="2">${esc(caption || 'A few of our favourites')}</text>

  <!-- Polaroid frames (photos get composited into these rects) -->
  ${frameRects}

  <!-- Footer message -->
  <text font-size="26" text-anchor="middle" fill="${textCol}" fill-opacity="0.95"
    font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="500" y="${footerStartY}">
    ${msgSvg}
  </text>
  <text x="${CANVAS / 2}" y="${CANVAS - 55}" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="${textCol}" fill-opacity="0.55"
    font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" letter-spacing="2">— ${esc(senderName || 'your squad')}</text>

  <text x="${CANVAS / 2}" y="${CANVAS - 25}" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle"
    fill="${textCol}" fill-opacity="0.3" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif"
    letter-spacing="6" font-weight="500">ZIVOGIFT</text>
</svg>`;
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { photo_urls, vibe_key, recipient_name, sender_name, message, sub_heading, order_id } = body;

  const photoUrls = Array.isArray(photo_urls) ? photo_urls.slice(0, MAX_PHOTOS) : [];
  if (photoUrls.length < MIN_PHOTOS) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: `At least ${MIN_PHOTOS} photo_urls are required` }) };
  }

  try {
    let sharp;
    try {
      sharp = require('sharp');
    } catch {
      return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'sharp not installed. Run: npm install sharp' }) };
    }

    // Content area for the photo grid (below header, above footer message)
    const gridArea = { x: 60, y: 150, w: CANVAS - 120, h: CANVAS - 150 - 210 };
    const tiles = computeGridLayout(photoUrls.length, gridArea);

    const baseSvg = buildBaseSvg({
      vibeKey: vibe_key || 'squad_memory_board',
      caption: sub_heading,
      message,
      senderName: sender_name,
      tiles,
    });
    const baseBuffer = await sharp(Buffer.from(baseSvg, 'utf8'), { density: 144 }).png().toBuffer();

    // Fetch + resize each photo to exactly fill its tile (cover crop), then
    // composite all of them onto the base layer in one pass.
    const compositeOps = await Promise.all(photoUrls.map(async (url, i) => {
      const tile = tiles[i];
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`fetch failed (${res.status})`);
        const arrBuf = await res.arrayBuffer();
        const resized = await sharp(Buffer.from(arrBuf))
          .resize(tile.w, tile.h, { fit: 'cover', position: 'attention' })
          .png()
          .toBuffer();
        return { input: resized, top: tile.y, left: tile.x };
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`compose-memory-board: photo ${i} failed (${url}):`, err.message);
        return null;
      }
    }));

    const validOps = compositeOps.filter(Boolean);
    if (!validOps.length) {
      return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'All photo fetches failed' }) };
    }

    const finalBuffer = await sharp(baseBuffer)
      .composite(validOps)
      .png({ compressionLevel: 7 })
      .toBuffer();

    const safeRecipient = (recipient_name || 'squad').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase().slice(0, 30);
    const filename = `collages/${order_id || 'preview'}/${safeRecipient}-${Date.now()}.png`;
    const url = await uploadBufferToR2(finalBuffer, filename, 'image/png');

    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url }),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('compose-memory-board error:', err.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }) };
  }
};

// POST /.netlify/functions/compose-scrapbook  (Run 5)
// Composites ONE scrapbook page (or the cover) into a 1080×1350 PNG and uploads
// to R2. Same output contract as generate-card-image.js / compose-memory-board.js.
// ONE page per call — up to 12 pages × 2 photo fetches would blow the 10s limit
// (same reasoning as the Care Package split). Viewing needs no compositing;
// scrapbook.html renders real photos client-side. These PNGs are for teaser/share.
// FONTS: Sharp from _lib/cardFonts.loadSharp(); {{SERIF}}/{{SANS}} → FAMILIES.
const { uploadBufferToR2 } = require('./_lib/r2Client');
const { loadSharp, FAMILIES } = require('./_lib/cardFonts');
const { resolveVibe } = require('../../js/vibe-tokens');
const { buildPageSvg, buildCoverSvg, pagePhotoLayout, CANVAS_W } = require('./_lib/scrapbook-core');

function paletteFromVibe(v) { return { bg1: v.bg1, bg2: v.bg2, accent: v.accent, text: v.text }; }
function applyFonts(svg) {
  return svg.replace(/\{\{SERIF\}\}/g, `${FAMILIES.serif}, serif`).replace(/\{\{SANS\}\}/g, `${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif`);
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  let body;
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); }
  catch { return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) }; }

  const { page, book, cover, vibe_key, order_id } = body;
  if (!book || !book.title) return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'book (with title) is required' }) };
  if (!cover && (!page || (!page.note && !(Array.isArray(page.photo_urls) && page.photo_urls.length)))) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'page with a note or photo is required (or set cover:true)' }) };
  }

  try {
    const sharp = await loadSharp();
    const vibe = resolveVibe(vibe_key, 'squad_memory_board');
    const palette = paletteFromVibe(vibe);

    let svgStr, tiles = [];
    if (cover) { svgStr = applyFonts(buildCoverSvg(book, palette)); }
    else { svgStr = applyFonts(buildPageSvg(page, book, palette)); tiles = pagePhotoLayout((page.photo_urls || []).length); }

    const baseBuffer = await sharp(Buffer.from(svgStr, 'utf8'), { density: 144 }).png({ compressionLevel: 7 }).toBuffer();
    let finalBuffer = baseBuffer;

    if (tiles.length) {
      const meta = await sharp(baseBuffer).metadata();
      const scale = (meta.width || CANVAS_W) / CANVAS_W;
      const ops = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length && i < (page.photo_urls || []).length; i++) {
        const t = tiles[i];
        try {
          const res = await fetch(page.photo_urls[i]);
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`photo fetch ${res.status}`);
          const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
          const resized = await sharp(buf).resize(Math.round(t.w * scale), Math.round(t.h * scale), { fit: 'cover', position: 'attention' }).png().toBuffer();
          ops.push({ input: resized, left: Math.round(t.x * scale), top: Math.round(t.y * scale) });
        } catch (e) { console.warn(`compose-scrapbook: photo ${i} failed:`, e.message); }
      }
      if (ops.length) finalBuffer = await sharp(baseBuffer).composite(ops).png({ compressionLevel: 7 }).toBuffer();
    }

    const safe = String(book.recipient_name || 'friend').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase().slice(0, 30);
    const tag = cover ? 'cover' : ('p' + ((page && page.index != null) ? page.index : 'x'));
    const filename = `scrapbooks/${order_id || 'preview'}/${safe}-${tag}-${Date.now()}.png`;
    const url = await uploadBufferToR2(finalBuffer, filename, 'image/png');
    return { statusCode: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ url }) };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('compose-scrapbook error:', err.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }) };
  }
};

module.exports._applyFonts = applyFonts;

FILE: netlify\functions\contact-submit.js

// POST /.netlify/functions/contact-submit
//
// Handles the Contact Us form (contact.html).
//
// WHY THIS EXISTS: the form used to be a Netlify Forms submission
// (data-netlify="true"), which POSTs to the page URL and relies on Netlify's
// build-time form detection. When that detection isn't active the POST hits a
// static HTML file and Netlify returns its 404 "Page Not Found" — exactly the
// broken-link symptom on "Send Message". This function replaces that flow: the
// page fetch()es here, we email the message to the owner via Resend, and the
// page shows an inline success state. No page navigation, so no 404.

const { sendEmail, contactMessageEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');

function json(status, body) {
  return {
    statusCode: status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  };
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); }
  catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid request' }); }

  // Honeypot — bots fill hidden fields. Pretend success, send nothing.
  if (body['bot-field']) return json(200, { ok: true });

  const name = String(body.name || '').trim();
  const email = String(body.email || '').trim();
  const phone = String(body.phone || '').trim();
  const message = String(body.message || '').trim();

  if (!name || !email || !message) {
    return json(400, { error: 'Please fill in your name, email and message.' });
  }
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
    return json(400, { error: 'Please enter a valid email address.' });
  }
  if (message.length > 5000) {
    return json(400, { error: 'That message is a little long — please shorten it.' });
  }

  const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL
    || process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
    || 'orders@zivogift.com';

  try {
    await sendEmail({
      to: adminEmail,
      replyTo: email,
      subject: `New contact message from ${name}`,
      html: contactMessageEmail({ name, email, phone, message }),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('contact-submit: email send failed:', e.message);
    return json(500, { error: 'Sorry, something went wrong sending your message. Please email hello@zivogift.com.' });
  }

  return json(200, { ok: true });
};

// POST /.netlify/functions/create-cashfree-order
//
// Body: {
//   cart: [{ productId, qty, recipientName, recipientDob, message, selectedOptions, addonIds:[] }],
//   contact: { name, phone, email },
//   delivery: { type: 'campus'|'standard', addressLine, city, pincode, notes },
//   promoCode: 'ZIVOGIFT10' | null
// }
// Optional header: Authorization: Bearer <supabase access token> — attaches the order to a logged-in user.
//
// This function is the ONLY place an order is ever created. Prices are always
// re-read from the `products`/`addons` tables here — the browser's prices are
// never trusted, so a tampered cart can't change what gets charged.
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { createCashfreeOrder } = require('./_lib/cashfree');
const { normalizePhone } = require('./_lib/phoneUtil');
const { moderateMessage } = require('./_lib/moderateMessage');
const { checkCartItemMedia } = require('./_lib/mediaSizeGuard');

// Pincode-zone delivery pricing — the SAME resolver the browser uses, so the
// fee shown on checkout is exactly the fee charged here. Netlify's bundler
// traces this relative require and ships it with the function. A tiny inline
// mirror is kept as a defensive fallback in case bundling ever drops it.
let ZGDeliveryZones;
try {
  ZGDeliveryZones = require('../../js/delivery-zones.js');
} catch (e) {
  ZGDeliveryZones = (function () {
    const ZONES = {
      local:   { key: 'local',   fee: 55 },
      south:   { key: 'south',   fee: 85 },
      rest:    { key: 'rest',    fee: 120 },
      special: { key: 'special', fee: 150 },
    };
    const CAMPUS_ZONES = { local: true, south: true };
    function resolveZone(raw) {
      const pin = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (pin.length !== 6 || /^[09]/.test(pin)) return { valid: false, zone: 'unknown', fee: null };
      const p2 = parseInt(pin.slice(0, 2), 10);
      const p3 = parseInt(pin.slice(0, 3), 10);
      if (p2 === 78 || p2 === 79) return { valid: true, zone: 'special', fee: 150 };
      if (p3 >= 180 && p3 <= 194) return { valid: true, zone: 'special', fee: 150 };
      if (p3 === 744) return { valid: true, zone: 'special', fee: 150 };
      if (p3 === 560 || p3 === 561 || p3 === 562) return { valid: true, zone: 'local', fee: 55 };
      if (p3 >= 563 && p3 <= 591) return { valid: true, zone: 'south', fee: 85 };
      if (p3 >= 500 && p3 <= 509) return { valid: true, zone: 'south', fee: 85 };
      if (p3 >= 515 && p3 <= 535) return { valid: true, zone: 'south', fee: 85 };
      if (p3 >= 600 && p3 <= 643) return { valid: true, zone: 'south', fee: 85 };
      return { valid: true, zone: 'rest', fee: 120 };
    }
    function isCampusEligible(z) { return !!CAMPUS_ZONES[z]; }
    function feeFor(type, pin) {
      const z = resolveZone(pin);
      if (!z.valid) return { ok: false, fee: null, reason: 'invalid_pincode', zone: z };
      if (type === 'campus') {
        if (!isCampusEligible(z.zone)) return { ok: false, fee: null, reason: 'campus_not_available', zone: z };
        return { ok: true, fee: 0, reason: null, zone: z };
      }
      return { ok: true, fee: z.fee, reason: null, zone: z };
    }
    return { ZONES, resolveZone, isCampusEligible, feeFor };
  })();
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let payload;
  try {
    payload = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }) };
  }

  const { cart, contact, delivery, promoCode, ref, replyToken, repCode, verificationToken } = payload;
  if (!Array.isArray(cart) || cart.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Cart is empty' }) };
  }
  if (!contact || !contact.name || !contact.phone || !contact.email) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing contact details' }) };
  }
  // Address is required for physical orders but optional for all-digital carts
  const DIGITAL_PREFIXES_CHECK = ['digital_', 'squad_', 'pass_', 'carepkg_'];
  const isAllDigital = Array.isArray(cart) && cart.length > 0 &&
    cart.every((i) => i.productId && DIGITAL_PREFIXES_CHECK.some((p) => i.productId.startsWith(p)));
  const hasAnyDigital = Array.isArray(cart) &&
    cart.some((i) => i.productId && DIGITAL_PREFIXES_CHECK.some((p) => i.productId.startsWith(p)));
  if (!delivery) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing delivery object' }) };
  }
  if (!isAllDigital && !delivery.addressLine) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing delivery address' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Resolve the logged-in user (if any) from the bearer token, without trusting
  // client-sent user IDs. Moved up because the digital-gift gate right below
  // needs it — digital carts now require login (see reasoning there).
  let userId = null;
  const authHeader = event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization;
  if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    const token = authHeader.slice(7);
    const { data: userData } = await supabase.auth.getUser(token);
    if (userData && userData.user) userId = userData.user.id;
  }

  // ── SENDER PHONE VERIFICATION (mandatory for every digital gift, text or
  // photo) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // This is the actual enforcement point — checked here, server-side, not
  // just gated in the UI. A request that skips the browser and calls this
  // function directly still can't create a digital gift order without a
  // logged-in, verified account.
  //
  // CHANGED (per the "OTP every order" fix): verification used to be a
  // 30-minute sender_verification_tokens row, re-checked fresh on every
  // order — that's why OTP kept firing for repeat orders. It's now a
  // permanent phone_verified flag on the buyer's profiles row, set once via
  // My Account -> Verify Mobile Number (verify-sender-otp.js). Because that
  // flag lives on an account, digital carts now require login -- there's no
  // durable place to attach "verified" to an anonymous guest checkout.
  if (hasAnyDigital) {
    if (!userId) {
      return { statusCode: 401, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Please log in to order digital gifts', code: 'LOGIN_REQUIRED' }) };
    }
    const claimedPhone = normalizePhone(contact.phone);
    if (!claimedPhone) {
      return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number' }) };
    }
    const { data: profileRow, error: profileErr } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('phone, phone_verified')
      .eq('id', userId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (profileErr) {
      return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: profileErr.message }) };
    }
    const verifiedPhone = profileRow && profileRow.phone_verified ? normalizePhone(profileRow.phone) : null;
    if (!verifiedPhone || verifiedPhone !== claimedPhone) {
      return { statusCode: 403, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Please verify your mobile number in My Account before placing this order', code: 'PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED' }) };
    }
  }
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // ── MESSAGE CONTENT MODERATION (every digital gift's personalization_message) ──
  // Checked here — same enforcement point as phone verification above — so it
  // can't be skipped by calling this function directly. See
  // _lib/moderateMessage.js for what this allows vs blocks, and why it fails
  // open (allows through) rather than closed if the check itself errors out.
  if (hasAnyDigital) {
    const messagesToCheck = cart
      .filter((i) => i.message && String(i.message).trim())
      .map((i) => ({ recipientName: i.recipientName || 'the recipient', text: i.message }));

    for (const { recipientName, text } of messagesToCheck) {
      const result = await moderateMessage(text);
      if (!result.allowed) {
        console.warn(`create-cashfree-order: message blocked for recipient "${recipientName}": ${result.reason}`);
        return {
          statusCode: 403,
          body: JSON.stringify({
            error: `Your message for ${recipientName} couldn't be sent — please revise it and try again.`,
            code: 'MESSAGE_BLOCKED',
          }),
        };
      }
    }
  }
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // ── MEDIA UPLOAD SIZE ENFORCEMENT (every digital gift's photo/video/audio) ──
  // Same enforcement point as the two checks above — can't be skipped by
  // calling this function directly. Checks the REAL size R2 reports for the
  // uploaded object, not anything the client claims (the 8MB check in
  // studio.js is convenience-only, easily bypassed by calling
  // get-media-upload-url.js's presigned PUT URL directly). See
  // _lib/mediaSizeGuard.js for the limits and why oversized uploads get
  // deleted, not just rejected.
  if (hasAnyDigital) {
    for (const item of cart) {
      const result = await checkCartItemMedia(item);
      if (!result.ok) {
        console.warn(`create-cashfree-order: media rejected for recipient "${item.recipientName || 'unknown'}": ${result.error}`);
        return {
          statusCode: 413,
          body: JSON.stringify({
            error: result.error || 'One of your uploaded files is too large — please try a smaller one.',
            code: 'MEDIA_TOO_LARGE',
          }),
        };
      }
    }
  }
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // Feature #15 — Zivo Pass perks: 10% off notes/bundles, and waived
  // "scheduling premium" on digital_midnight / digital_examkit (they drop to
  // the same price as a standard digital gift). Resolved server-side from the
  // logged-in user's subscription row — never trust a client-sent flag.
  let hasActivePass = false;
  if (userId) {
    const { data: sub } = await supabase
      .from('subscriptions')
      .select('id')
      .eq('user_id', userId).eq('status', 'active')
      .gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
      .maybeSingle();
    hasActivePass = !!sub;
  }
  const PASS_NOTE_DISCOUNT_PCT = 10;
  const PASS_WAIVED_SCHEDULING_PRICE = { digital_midnight: 49, digital_examkit: 49 };

  // Feature #20 — Campus Rep Micro-Affiliate Network: validate the referral
  // code against a real, approved rep before trusting it.
  let validRepCode = null;
  if (repCode) {
    const { data: rep } = await supabase
      .from('campus_reps').select('ref_code, status').eq('ref_code', repCode).eq('status', 'approved').maybeSingle();
    if (rep) validRepCode = rep.ref_code;
  }

  // Pull every product/addon referenced by the cart in one go.
  const productIds = [...new Set(cart.map((i) => i.productId))];
  const addonIds = [...new Set(cart.flatMap((i) => i.addonIds || []))];

  const { data: products, error: prodErr } = await supabase
    .from('products')
    .select('*')
    .in('id', productIds)
    .eq('active', true);
  if (prodErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: prodErr.message }) };

  const { data: addons, error: addonErr } = addonIds.length
    ? await supabase.from('addons').select('*').in('id', addonIds).eq('active', true)
    : { data: [], error: null };
  if (addonErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: addonErr.message }) };

  const productMap = Object.fromEntries(products.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const addonMap = Object.fromEntries(addons.map((a) => [a.id, a]));

  const lineItems = [];
  let subtotal = 0;
  let physicalKeepsakeUnits = 0;

  // ── STOCK PRE-CHECK (audit finding #10) ──────────────────────────────────
  // Nothing previously stopped the site selling a serial-number note that had
  // run out. A ₹500 note carrying a specific birth date either exists in the
  // drawer or it does not -- and the customer had already PAID before anyone
  // found out, which means a refund, an apology, and a lost customer.
  //
  // Two layers, deliberately:
  //   1. This read-only check, which rejects the order BEFORE the customer is
  //      sent to a payment page -- so they see "sold out", not a refund later.
  //   2. The atomic decrement_stock() RPC after the order row is written,
  //      which is what actually settles a race between two simultaneous
  //      buyers of the last unit.
  //
  // stock_qty NULL = unlimited, which is every product's default. Sites that
  // have not run 70_pipeline_fixes.sql have no such column at all, so the
  // whole check degrades to a no-op rather than blocking checkout.
  const qtyByProduct = {};
  for (const item of cart) {
    const id = item.productId;
    qtyByProduct[id] = (qtyByProduct[id] || 0) + Math.max(1, parseInt(item.qty, 10) || 1);
  }
  for (const [pid, wanted] of Object.entries(qtyByProduct)) {
    const p = productMap[pid];
    if (!p) continue;
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(p, 'stock_qty')) break; // migration not applied
    if (p.stock_qty === null || p.stock_qty === undefined) continue;  // unlimited
    if (p.stock_qty < wanted) {
      return {
        statusCode: 409,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          error: p.stock_qty === 0
            ? `${p.name} has just sold out. Please remove it from your cart to continue.`
            : `Only ${p.stock_qty} left of ${p.name}. Please reduce the quantity to continue.`,
          code: 'out_of_stock',
          productId: pid,
          available: p.stock_qty,
        }),
      };
    }
  }

  for (const item of cart) {
    const product = productMap[item.productId];
    if (!product) {
      return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: `Unknown or inactive product: ${item.productId}` }) };
    }
    const qty = Math.max(1, parseInt(item.qty, 10) || 1);
    const chosenAddons = (item.addonIds || [])
      .map((id) => addonMap[id])
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((a) => ({ id: a.id, name: a.name, price: Number(a.price) }));
    const addonTotal = chosenAddons.reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0);

    // Feature #15 — Zivo Pass perks (server-resolved, price never trusted from client)
    let effectiveUnitPrice = product.price;
    if (hasActivePass && (product.type === 'note' || product.type === 'bundle')) {
      effectiveUnitPrice = Math.round(product.price * (100 - PASS_NOTE_DISCOUNT_PCT) / 100);
    } else if (hasActivePass && PASS_WAIVED_SCHEDULING_PRICE[product.id]) {
      effectiveUnitPrice = PASS_WAIVED_SCHEDULING_PRICE[product.id];
    }

    // Scented Card is only sellable alongside the Premium Keepsake Box. The
    // browser disables it, but the price/eligibility authority lives here.
    const chosenAddonIds = chosenAddons.map((a) => a.id);
    if (chosenAddonIds.includes('addon_scent') && !chosenAddonIds.includes('addon_box')) {
      return {
        statusCode: 400,
        body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'The Scented Card add-on is available only with the Premium Keepsake Box.' }),
      };
    }

    const lineTotal = effectiveUnitPrice * qty + addonTotal;
    if (product.type === 'note') physicalKeepsakeUnits += qty;
    subtotal += lineTotal;

    lineItems.push({
      product_id: product.id,
      name_snapshot: product.name,
      unit_price: effectiveUnitPrice,
      qty,
      recipient_name: item.recipientName || null,
      recipient_dob: item.recipientDob || null,
      // normalizePhone was already imported here for the buyer's own contact
      // number but was never applied to the RECIPIENT's. Different studio
      // entry points send different shapes ('9876543210' vs '919876543210'),
      // and a number without a country code is accepted by Meta and then
      // never delivered -- a silent failure that looks like a successful send.
      recipient_phone: normalizePhone(item.recipientPhone) || item.recipientPhone || null,
      recipient_email: item.recipientEmail || null,
      delivery_mode: item.deliveryMode || 'whatsapp',
      scheduled_send_at: item.scheduledSendAt || null,
      personalization_message: item.message || null,
      selected_options: item.selectedOptions || {},
      addons: chosenAddons,
      addon_total: addonTotal,
      line_total: lineTotal,
      // Group 2 fields
      gift_type: item.giftType || 'standard',
      media_url: item.mediaUrl || null,
      media_type: item.mediaType || null,
      persona_key: item.personaKey || null,
      contributor_phones: Array.isArray(item.contributorPhones) ? item.contributorPhones : [],
      contributor_names: Array.isArray(item.contributorNames) ? item.contributorNames : [],
      // Group 3 fields
      is_time_capsule: !!item.isTimeCapsule,
      condition_type: item.conditionType || 'none',
      condition_label: item.conditionLabel || null,
    });
  }

  // Promo code
  let discount = 0;
  let appliedPromo = null;
  // A 'fixed_total' promo overrides the final payable amount to a flat value
  // (e.g. ZIVOSURI01 -> ₹1) regardless of cart contents. It exists purely to
  // run a real, low-value smoke test through the LIVE Cashfree gateway. It is
  // resolved AFTER the delivery fee below because it must win over everything.
  let forcedTotal = null;
  if (promoCode) {
    const { data: promo } = await supabase
      .from('promo_codes')
      .select('*')
      .eq('code', promoCode.toUpperCase())
      .eq('active', true)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (promo && (!promo.expires_at || new Date(promo.expires_at) > new Date())) {
      if (promo.type === 'fixed_total') {
        // Cashfree's minimum order amount is ₹1, so never let this fall below 1.
        forcedTotal = Math.max(1, Math.round(promo.value));
        appliedPromo = promo.code;
      } else {
        discount = promo.type === 'percent' ? Math.round((subtotal * promo.value) / 100) : promo.value;
        if (promo.max_discount) discount = Math.min(discount, promo.max_discount);
        appliedPromo = promo.code;
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Delivery fee: pincode-zone pricing (server = source of truth) ─────────
  // Digital-only carts ship nothing, so it's free. For physical carts the fee
  // is resolved from the destination pincode via the SAME module the browser
  // used — an unknown pincode or an ineligible campus request is rejected here
  // rather than silently charging a guessed amount.
  let deliveryFee = 0;
  // A Premium Keepsake Box anywhere in the cart forces a flat Rs.150 delivery
  // fee, overriding zone pricing, campus delivery and the 4+ keepsake waiver.
  const GIFT_BOX_DELIVERY_FEE = 150;
  const hasGiftBoxAddon = cart.some((i) => Array.isArray(i.addonIds) && i.addonIds.includes('addon_box'));
  if (!isAllDigital) {
    const feeRes = ZGDeliveryZones.feeFor(delivery.type === 'campus' ? 'campus' : 'standard', delivery.pincode);
    if (!feeRes.ok) {
      const errMsg = feeRes.reason === 'campus_not_available'
        ? 'Free campus delivery is only available for Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu. Please choose Standard delivery for this pincode.'
        : 'Could not determine a delivery fee for this pincode. Please enter a valid serviceable pincode.';
      return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: errMsg }) };
    }
    deliveryFee = feeRes.fee;
    // Only four or more physical note-type units qualify. Digital gifts, bundles, kits and add-ons do not count.
    if (physicalKeepsakeUnits >= 4) deliveryFee = 0;
    // Gift-box surcharge wins over every other delivery rule above.
    if (hasGiftBoxAddon) deliveryFee = GIFT_BOX_DELIVERY_FEE;
  }
  let total = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount) + deliveryFee;
  if (forcedTotal !== null) {
    // Charge exactly the forced amount. Record the difference as a discount so
    // the stored subtotal/discount/total still reconciles arithmetically.
    total = forcedTotal;
    discount = Math.max(0, subtotal + deliveryFee - forcedTotal);
  }

  // Create the order (pending_payment) + items
  const { data: order, error: orderErr } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .insert({
      user_id: userId,
      guest_email: userId ? null : contact.email,
      guest_phone: userId ? null : contact.phone,
      status: 'pending_payment',
      contact_name: contact.name,
      contact_phone: contact.phone,
      contact_email: contact.email,
      delivery_type: delivery.type || 'standard',
      address_line: delivery.addressLine,
      city: delivery.city || 'Bengaluru',
      pincode: delivery.pincode || null,
      delivery_notes: delivery.notes || null,
      subtotal,
      discount,
      delivery_fee: deliveryFee,
      total,
      promo_code: appliedPromo,
      ref: ref || null,
      reply_token: replyToken || null,
      rep_ref_code: validRepCode,
      rep_commission_status: validRepCode ? 'pending' : 'none',
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (orderErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: orderErr.message }) };

  const { data: insertedItems, error: itemsErr } = await supabase
    .from('order_items')
    .insert(lineItems.map((li) => ({ ...li, order_id: order.id })))
    .select('*');
  if (itemsErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: itemsErr.message }) };

  await supabase.from('order_status_history').insert({
    order_id: order.id,
    status: 'pending_payment',
    note: 'Order created, awaiting payment',
  });

  // ── ATOMIC STOCK RESERVATION (audit finding #10) ─────────────────────────
  // The pre-check above is read-only, so two customers buying the last unit
  // at the same instant would both pass it. decrement_stock() is a single
  // conditional UPDATE (see 70_pipeline_fixes.sql) so exactly one of them can
  // win; the loser is told before being charged.
  //
  // Reserved at ORDER-CREATION time, not on payment success, because the
  // whole point is to stop a second customer buying a unit that is already
  // spoken for while the first is on the payment page. The trade-off is that
  // an abandoned checkout holds stock -- acceptable at this volume, and the
  // admin can correct any number by hand from the Catalog tab.
  for (const [pid, wanted] of Object.entries(qtyByProduct)) {
    try {
      const { data: okStock, error: stockErr } = await supabase
        .rpc('decrement_stock', { p_product_id: pid, p_qty: wanted });
      if (stockErr) {
        // Function absent = 70_pipeline_fixes.sql not applied. Stock control
        // is opt-in, so this must never block a sale.
        console.warn(`create-cashfree-order: decrement_stock unavailable (${stockErr.message}) — skipping stock control`);
        break;
      }
      if (okStock === false) {
        // Lost the race. Void the order we just wrote and tell them plainly,
        // rather than taking money for something that no longer exists.
        await supabase.from('orders')
          .update({ status: 'cancelled' })
          .eq('id', order.id);
        await supabase.from('order_status_history').insert({
          order_id: order.id, status: 'cancelled',
          note: `Auto-cancelled: ${pid} sold out during checkout`,
        });
        const soldOut = productMap[pid];
        return {
          statusCode: 409,
          body: JSON.stringify({
            error: `${(soldOut && soldOut.name) || pid} sold out while you were checking out. You have not been charged.`,
            code: 'out_of_stock',
            productId: pid,
          }),
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('create-cashfree-order: stock reservation error (non-fatal):', (e && e.message) || e);
      break;
    }
  }

  // Free orders (e.g. 100% promo) skip Cashfree entirely.
  if (total <= 0) {
    await supabase.from('orders').update({ status: 'paid' }).eq('id', order.id);
    await supabase.from('order_status_history').insert({ order_id: order.id, status: 'paid', note: 'Zero-value order auto-confirmed' });
    // Schedule digital sends for free orders immediately — use the inserted rows
    // (which carry real order_items.id values) not the in-memory lineItems array.
    await scheduleDigitalSends(supabase, order, insertedItems || lineItems, contact);
    const { scheduleCarePackagesForOrder } = require('./_lib/carePackageHelper');
    await scheduleCarePackagesForOrder(supabase, order, insertedItems || lineItems);
    // Same confirmation email / admin alert / numerology PDF a normally-paid
    // order gets from the Cashfree webhook — a ₹0 order never fires that
    // webhook (there's nothing for Cashfree to confirm), so this has to be
    // triggered here explicitly or it silently never happens.
    try {
      const { sendOrderConfirmationEffects } = require('./_lib/orderConfirmationEffects');
      const paidOrder = { ...order, status: 'paid', contact_email: contact.email, contact_name: contact.name };
      await sendOrderConfirmationEffects(supabase, paidOrder, insertedItems || lineItems);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Free-order confirmation effects failed:', e.message);
    }
    return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ orderNumber: order.order_number, free: true }) };
  }

  const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || `https://${event.headers.host}`;
  try {
    const cf = await createCashfreeOrder({
      orderId: order.id,
      orderNumber: order.order_number,
      amount: total,
      customer: { id: userId || order.id, name: contact.name, email: contact.email, phone: contact.phone },
      returnUrl: `${siteUrl}/order-status.html?phone=${encodeURIComponent(contact.phone)}`,
      notifyUrl: `${siteUrl}/.netlify/functions/cashfree-webhook`,
    });

    await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .update({ cashfree_order_id: cf.cfOrderId, cashfree_payment_session_id: cf.paymentSessionId })
      .eq('id', order.id);

    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        orderNumber: order.order_number,
        paymentSessionId: cf.paymentSessionId,
        cashfreeEnv: process.env.CASHFREE_ENV === 'production' ? 'production' : 'sandbox',
      }),
    };
  } catch (e) {
    await supabase.from('orders').update({ status: 'payment_failed' }).eq('id', order.id);
    return { statusCode: 502, body: JSON.stringify({ error: e.message }) };
  }
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------
// scheduleDigitalSends — called after a paid/free order is confirmed.
// For any digital product in the cart, inserts a digital_sends row so the
// gift-scheduler function picks it up at the right time and sends the
// WhatsApp message to the recipient.
//
// The buyer provides:
//   item.recipientPhone — recipient's WhatsApp number
//   item.scheduledSendAt — ISO string (midnight IST = 18:30:00Z today or
//                           next day, computed by the frontend)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------
async function scheduleDigitalSends(supabase, order, lineItems, contact) {
  // Delegate entirely to the shared helper which handles all Group 2 gift types.
  const { scheduleDigitalSendsForOrder } = require('./_lib/digitalSendsHelper');
  const fullOrder = { ...order, contact_name: contact.name, contact_phone: contact.phone };
  // lineItems here are the in-memory cart rows (have recipient_phone etc already set)
  await scheduleDigitalSendsForOrder(supabase, fullOrder, lineItems);
}

// Returns the next midnight in IST (UTC+5:30) as an ISO string.
// Used when the buyer doesn't specify a custom send time.
function nextMidnightIST() {
  const now = new Date();
  // IST offset = 330 minutes ahead of UTC
  const istOffsetMs = 330 * 60 * 1000;
  const nowIST = new Date(now.getTime() + istOffsetMs);
  // Set to midnight IST (00:00:00.000)
  nowIST.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  // If midnight IST has already passed today, advance to tomorrow
  if (nowIST.getTime() <= now.getTime() + istOffsetMs) {
    nowIST.setUTCDate(nowIST.getUTCDate() + 1);
  }
  // Convert back to UTC for storage
  return new Date(nowIST.getTime() - istOffsetMs).toISOString();
}

// POST /.netlify/functions/create-reply-token
//
// Called from digitalSendsHelper.js when gift_type = 'character_drop'.
// Stores an anonymous relay token so the recipient can reply without
// ever seeing the real sender's phone number.
//
// Body: { gift_id, real_sender_phone }
// Returns: { token }   — a UUID string
//
// The token is stored in the reply_tokens table. The gift.html page passes
// only this token (never the phone) in the reply CTA URL.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { gift_id, real_sender_phone } = body;

  if (!gift_id) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_id is required' }) };
  }
  if (!real_sender_phone) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'real_sender_phone is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Check if a token already exists for this gift (idempotent)
  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from('reply_tokens')
    .select('token')
    .eq('gift_id', gift_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (existing) {
    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: existing.token }),
    };
  }

  // Insert new token row — Supabase generates the UUID via DEFAULT
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('reply_tokens')
    .insert({ gift_id, real_sender_phone })
    .select('token')
    .single();

  if (error) {
    console.error('create-reply-token: insert error:', error.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }) };
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ token: data.token }),
  };
};

// POST /.netlify/functions/create-scrapbook  (Run 5)
// Creates a Digital Scrapbook gift row in digital_sends. Pages (chapters + notes
// + photo_urls) are stored as JSONB on the row so scrapbook.html can render them
// client-side with the real photos. Delivery reuses the pipeline with
// gift_type='digital_scrapbook'. Returns { ok, gift_id, gift_url, page_count }.
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { normalizeScrapbook } = require('./_lib/scrapbook-core');

async function _process(input, supabase, now) {
  const norm = normalizeScrapbook(input || {});
  if (!norm.ok) return { statusCode: 400, body: { error: norm.error } };
  const book = norm.scrapbook;

  const channel = input.channel === 'email' ? 'email' : 'whatsapp';
  if (channel === 'whatsapp' && !input.recipient_phone) return { statusCode: 400, body: { error: 'recipient_phone_required' } };
  if (channel === 'email' && !input.recipient_email) return { statusCode: 400, body: { error: 'recipient_email_required' } };

  const row = {
    recipient_name:  book.recipient_name,
    recipient_phone: input.recipient_phone || null,
    recipient_email: input.recipient_email || null,
    sender_name:     book.sender_name,
    sender_phone:    input.sender_phone || null,
    occasion:        input.occasion || book.title,
    gift_type:       'digital_scrapbook',
    vibe_key:        book.vibe_key,
    channel:         channel,
    status:          'pending',
    condition_met:   true,
    scheduled_at:    input.scheduled_at || new Date(now || Date.now()).toISOString(),
    scrapbook_data:  { title: book.title, page_count: book.page_count, pages: book.pages },
    attempts:        0
  };
  if (input.order_id) row.order_id = input.order_id;

  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('digital_sends').insert(row).select('id').single();
  if (error) return { statusCode: 500, body: { error: 'insert_failed', detail: error.message } };

  const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';
  return { statusCode: 200, body: { ok: true, gift_id: data.id, gift_url: `${siteUrl}/scrapbook.html?id=${data.id}`, page_count: book.page_count } };
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  let input;
  try { input = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); }
  catch { return { statusCode: 400, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'bad_json' }) }; }
  try {
    const res = await _process(input, getSupabaseAdmin(), Date.now());
    return { statusCode: res.statusCode, headers, body: JSON.stringify(res.body) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('create-scrapbook fatal:', e && e.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'server_error' }) };
  }
};

module.exports._process = _process;

// POST /.netlify/functions/create-share-clip-job
//
// Called from gift.html when the recipient/sender taps "Download & Share".
// Creates a share_clip_jobs row (status='pending') that clip-scheduler.js
// picks up on its next tick. Generation is deliberately async/queued, not
// synchronous — see _lib/clipFrames.js header for why.
//
// Body: { gift_id }   — the digital_sends.id (same id used by gift.html's ?id=)
// Returns: { job_id, status }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }) };
  }

  const { gift_id } = body;
  if (!gift_id) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_id is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Confirm the gift exists before creating a job for it.
  const { data: gift, error: giftError } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', gift_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (giftError || !gift) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Gift not found' }) };
  }

  // Reuse an existing pending/processing/done job instead of spawning a
  // duplicate if the user taps the button more than once (double-tap, or
  // reopening the page). Only a genuinely failed job gets a fresh retry row.
  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from('share_clip_jobs')
    .select('id, status, output_url')
    .eq('digital_send_id', gift_id)
    .neq('status', 'failed')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (existing) {
    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ job_id: existing.id, status: existing.status, output_url: existing.output_url || null }),
    };
  }

  const { data: job, error: insertError } = await supabase
    .from('share_clip_jobs')
    .insert({ digital_send_id: gift_id, status: 'pending' })
    .select('id, status')
    .single();

  if (insertError) {
    console.error('create-share-clip-job: insert failed:', insertError.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: insertError.message }) };
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ job_id: job.id, status: job.status }),
  };
};
