FILE: netlify\functions\festival-scheduler.js
=====================================================

// netlify/functions/festival-scheduler.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs once daily at 03:00 UTC (08:30 IST).
//
// Reads public.festival_schedules, and for any ACTIVE festival whose
// (month, day) minus lead_days is TODAY, materialises a real campaign row and
// sets it to 'sending'. campaign-sender.js then drains it exactly as if you
// had created and launched it by hand.
//
// WHY IT CREATES A CAMPAIGN INSTEAD OF SENDING DIRECTLY
// ----------------------------------------------------
// Because then there is exactly ONE send path, one set of counters, one
// delivery report and one opt-out filter for both manual and automated
// campaigns. An automated sender with its own delivery logic would be a
// second thing to debug, from a phone, a year from now.
//
// It also means an auto-created festival campaign shows up in the Campaigns
// tab like any other and can be PAUSED or CANCELLED from the panel before
// campaign-sender gets to it — the cron runs at 03:00 UTC and the sender is
// a separate cron, so there is a real window to catch a mistake.
//
// ── THE ONCE-A-YEAR GUARD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// last_fired_year is written BEFORE the campaign is created, and is checked
// against the current year on entry. If the function is invoked twice in one
// day — Netlify does retry on non-200 — the second run sees the year already
// recorded and does nothing. Writing it first means the failure mode is
// "a festival campaign did not go out" rather than "a festival campaign went
// out twice to your entire customer list".
//
// ── LUNAR FESTIVALS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Holi, Raksha Bandhan and Diwali move every year. The seeded dates are
// placeholders and MUST be corrected annually from the admin panel. The
// health check surfaces any active lunar festival whose date has not been
// touched this year.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { guardCampaigns, getSettings } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');
const { resolveAudience } = require('./_lib/audience');

// Festivals that follow the lunar calendar and therefore have no fixed
// Gregorian date. Kept here rather than in the DB because it is a property of
// the festival, not of your configuration.
const LUNAR = ['holi', 'raksha bandhan', 'diwali'];

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const halted = await guardCampaigns(supabase, 'festival-scheduler');
  if (halted) return halted;

  const settings = await getSettings(supabase);
  if (settings.pause_festivals) {
    console.log('festival-scheduler: halted -- pause_festivals is ON');
    return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ skipped: 'pause_festivals' }) };
  }

  const { data: festivals, error } = await supabase
    .from('festival_schedules').select('*').eq('active', true);

  if (error) {
    console.error('festival-scheduler: fetch failed:', error.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: error.message };
  }
  if (!festivals || !festivals.length) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'No active festivals.' };
  }

  // Evaluate "today" in IST, not UTC. At 03:00 UTC it is already 08:30 IST
  // the same day, but a festival dated the 1st with lead_days 0 would fire on
  // the wrong calendar day if compared in UTC near month boundaries.
  const nowIst = new Date(Date.now() + (5.5 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  const year = nowIst.getUTCFullYear();
  const todayKey = `${nowIst.getUTCMonth() + 1}-${nowIst.getUTCDate()}`;

  const fired = [];
  const skipped = [];

  for (const f of festivals) {
    if (f.last_fired_year === year) { skipped.push({ name: f.name, why: 'already fired this year' }); continue; }

    // The festival date this year, minus the lead time.
    const target = new Date(Date.UTC(year, f.month - 1, f.day));
    target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() - (f.lead_days || 0));
    const targetKey = `${target.getUTCMonth() + 1}-${target.getUTCDate()}`;

    if (targetKey !== todayKey) { skipped.push({ name: f.name, why: `not due (due ${targetKey})` }); continue; }

    if (LUNAR.indexOf(String(f.name).toLowerCase()) !== -1) {
      console.warn(`festival-scheduler: "${f.name}" is a lunar festival -- confirm ${f.day}/${f.month} is correct for ${year}`);
    }

    try {
      // ── ATOMIC CLAIM ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      // Conditional UPDATE ... RETURNING. The WHERE clause matches only rows
      // that have NOT already fired this year, so if two invocations race,
      // exactly one gets a row back and the other gets an empty array and
      // bails. `.select()` is what makes this a claim rather than a blind
      // write — without it we could not tell who won.
      const { data: claimed, error: claimErr } = await supabase
        .from('festival_schedules')
        .update({ last_fired_year: year })
        .eq('id', f.id)
        .or(`last_fired_year.is.null,last_fired_year.neq.${year}`)
        .select('id');
      if (claimErr) throw new Error(`claim failed: ${claimErr.message}`);
      if (!claimed || !claimed.length) {
        skipped.push({ name: f.name, why: 'claimed by a concurrent run' });
        continue;
      }

      const { recipients, stats } = await resolveAudience(supabase, f.segment, f.channel);
      if (!recipients.length) {
        skipped.push({ name: f.name, why: 'no reachable recipients' });
        continue;
      }

      const { data: campaign, error: cErr } = await supabase.from('campaigns').insert({
        name: `${f.name} ${year}`,
        channel: f.channel,
        segment: f.segment,
        subject: f.subject,
        body: f.body,
        cta_url: f.cta_url,
        cta_label: f.cta_label,
        wa_template: f.wa_template,
        status: 'sending',
        started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        total_recipients: 0,
        is_automated: true,
      }).select().single();
      if (cErr) throw new Error(`campaign insert failed: ${cErr.message}`);

      const rows = [];
      for (const r of recipients) {
        for (const ch of r.channels) {
          rows.push({
            campaign_id: campaign.id,
            customer_key: r.customer_key,
            full_name: r.full_name,
            email: ch === 'email' ? r.email : null,
            phone10: ch === 'whatsapp' ? r.phone10 : null,
            channel: ch,
            status: 'queued',
          });
        }
      }

      const CHUNK = 500;
      for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += CHUNK) {
        const { error: insErr } = await supabase.from('campaign_recipients')
          .upsert(rows.slice(i, i + CHUNK), { onConflict: 'campaign_id,customer_key,channel', ignoreDuplicates: true });
        if (insErr) throw new Error(`recipient insert failed: ${insErr.message}`);
      }

      await supabase.from('campaigns').update({ total_recipients: rows.length }).eq('id', campaign.id);

      fired.push({ name: f.name, campaign_id: campaign.id, queued: rows.length, stats });
      console.log(`festival-scheduler: queued "${f.name} ${year}" -- ${rows.length} recipients`);

    } catch (e) {
      // Release the claim so tomorrow's run can retry, rather than the
      // festival being silently marked done after a transient failure.
      await supabase.from('festival_schedules').update({ last_fired_year: null }).eq('id', f.id);
      console.error(`festival-scheduler: "${f.name}" failed and was released for retry:`, (e && e.message) || e);
      skipped.push({ name: f.name, why: `failed: ${(e && e.message) || e}` });
    }
  }

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ today_ist: todayKey, year, fired, skipped }) };
};

// netlify/functions/friends-api.js
//
// REST-style endpoint for the friends table.
// All routes require a valid Supabase session (Authorization: Bearer <token>).
// RLS on the friends table provides the true security boundary — this function
// validates the token and passes it through so Supabase enforces row-level rules.
//
// Routes (method + query param `action`):
//   GET  ?action=list               → list all friends for the logged-in user
//   POST ?action=save               → create or upsert a friend (by id if provided)
//   POST ?action=delete             → delete a friend by id
//   POST ?action=toggle_reminder    → flip birthday_reminders_enabled or anniversary_reminders_enabled
//
// Body schema (save):
//   {
//     id?:                          uuid (present = update, absent = insert)
//     name:                         string (required)
//     phone?:                       string '9876543210'
//     relationship_type?:           string
//     college?:                     string (used by Occasion Intelligence to match college-calendar events)
//     context_notes?:               string
//     birthday_date?:               'YYYY-MM-DD' (year can be dummy e.g. 2000)
//     friendship_start_date?:       'YYYY-MM-DD'
//     last_vibe_key?:               string
//     remind_before_days?:          number (default 3)
//     birthday_reminders_enabled?:  boolean
//     anniversary_reminders_enabled?: boolean
//   }

const { getSupabaseAdmin }  = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { createClient }      = require('@supabase/supabase-js');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  // ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const token = (event.headers.authorization || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return json(401, { error: 'Unauthorised' });

  // Verify the token and get the user id via a user-scoped client
  const supabaseUser = createClient(
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL,
    process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    { global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } }
  );
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await supabaseUser.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) return json(401, { error: 'Invalid session' });

  const userId  = user.id;
  const action  = (event.queryStringParameters || {}).action || '';
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin(); // service-role for writes (RLS on, but we set user_id explicitly)

  // ── GET list ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (event.httpMethod === 'GET' && action === 'list') {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('friends')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .order('name', { ascending: true });

    if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });

    // Attach each friend's special dates (a friend has many). One query for
    // the whole set, then grouped in memory — cheaper than N queries.
    const friends = data || [];
    let specialByFriend = {};
    if (friends.length) {
      const { data: dates } = await supabase
        .from('friend_special_dates')
        .select('*')
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('event_date', { ascending: true });
      (dates || []).forEach((d) => {
        (specialByFriend[d.friend_id] = specialByFriend[d.friend_id] || []).push(d);
      });
    }
    friends.forEach((f) => { f.special_dates = specialByFriend[f.id] || []; });

    return json(200, { friends });
  }

  // ── POST routes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); } catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }); }

  // ── save (insert or update) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'save') {
    const { id, name, phone, relationship_type, context_notes, college,
            birthday_date, friendship_start_date, last_vibe_key,
            remind_before_days, birthday_reminders_enabled,
            anniversary_reminders_enabled } = body;

    if (!name || !name.trim()) return json(400, { error: 'name is required' });

    const payload = {
      user_id: userId,
      name: name.trim(),
      phone: phone ? String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : null,
      relationship_type: relationship_type || null,
      college: college || null,
      context_notes: context_notes || null,
      birthday_date: birthday_date || null,
      friendship_start_date: friendship_start_date || null,
      last_vibe_key: last_vibe_key || null,
      remind_before_days: Number.isFinite(remind_before_days) ? remind_before_days : 3,
      birthday_reminders_enabled: birthday_reminders_enabled !== false, // default true
      anniversary_reminders_enabled: anniversary_reminders_enabled !== false,
    };

    let result;
    if (id) {
      // Update — verify ownership first
      const { data: existing } = await supabase
        .from('friends').select('id, user_id').eq('id', id).maybeSingle();
      if (!existing || existing.user_id !== userId) return json(403, { error: 'Not found or forbidden' });

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('friends').update(payload).eq('id', id).select().single();
      if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });
      result = data;
    } else {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('friends').insert(payload).select().single();
      if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });
      result = data;
    }

    // ── Special dates (replace-all) ─────────────────────────────────────────
    // The client sends the FULL desired set of special days for this friend.
    // Simplest correct model: wipe this friend's rows and re-insert. Sizes are
    // tiny (a handful per friend), so the churn is negligible and it removes
    // any need to diff on the client. Only runs when the client includes the
    // key, so an old client that never sends it leaves existing dates alone.
    if (Array.isArray(body.special_dates)) {
      await supabase.from('friend_special_dates').delete().eq('friend_id', result.id);

      const rows = body.special_dates
        .filter((d) => d && d.event_date)               // a date is the only hard requirement
        .map((d) => ({
          friend_id: result.id,
          user_id: userId,
          occasion_type: (d.occasion_type || 'custom').slice(0, 40),
          label: d.label ? String(d.label).slice(0, 80) : null,
          event_date: d.event_date,
          reminders_enabled: d.reminders_enabled !== false,
          remind_before_days: Number.isFinite(d.remind_before_days) ? d.remind_before_days : 3,
        }));

      if (rows.length) {
        const { data: inserted, error: sdErr } = await supabase
          .from('friend_special_dates').insert(rows).select();
        if (sdErr) return json(500, { error: 'Friend saved but special dates failed: ' + sdErr.message });
        result.special_dates = inserted || [];
      } else {
        result.special_dates = [];
      }
    }

    return json(200, { friend: result });
  }

  // ── delete ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'delete') {
    const { id } = body;
    if (!id) return json(400, { error: 'id is required' });

    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('friends').select('id, user_id').eq('id', id).maybeSingle();
    if (!existing || existing.user_id !== userId) return json(403, { error: 'Not found or forbidden' });

    const { error } = await supabase.from('friends').delete().eq('id', id);
    if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });
    return json(200, { deleted: id });
  }

  // ── toggle_reminder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (action === 'toggle_reminder') {
    const { id, type, enabled } = body; // type: 'birthday' | 'anniversary'
    if (!id || !type) return json(400, { error: 'id and type are required' });

    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('friends').select('id, user_id').eq('id', id).maybeSingle();
    if (!existing || existing.user_id !== userId) return json(403, { error: 'Not found or forbidden' });

    const col = type === 'birthday'
      ? 'birthday_reminders_enabled'
      : 'anniversary_reminders_enabled';

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('friends').update({ [col]: !!enabled }).eq('id', id).select().single();
    if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });
    return json(200, { friend: data });
  }

  return json(400, { error: `Unknown action: ${action}` });
};

function json(status, body) {
  return {
    statusCode: status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  };
}

// POST /.netlify/functions/generate-card-image
//
// Renders a personalised PNG card for a digital gift (SVG -> Sharp/librsvg),
// uploads it to Cloudflare R2 and returns the public URL.
//
// ── WHAT CHANGED AND WHY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// 1. FONTS. Sharp rasterizes SVG through librsvg, which resolves font-family
//    through fontconfig. The Netlify Lambda image ships no fonts, so every
//    <text>/<tspan> rendered to NOTHING while gradients and rects drew fine —
//    the "card renders without text" bug. Sharp now comes from
//    _lib/cardFonts.js, which wires FONTCONFIG_PATH to our bundled TTFs before
//    the native binding initialises. This file never requires('sharp').
//
// 2. NO EMOJI IN THE SVG. style.icon used to be an emoji character; there is
//    no emoji font on Lambda, so it rasterized as a tofu box. Emoji are now
//    vector motifs (MOTIFS below). Emoji still appear in the email HTML and
//    gift.html, where the client has real emoji fonts.
//
// 3. TWO VARIANTS. variant:'sealed' renders WITHOUT the personal message —
//    that is the image the delivery email and WhatsApp embed, so the message
//    cannot leak into an inbox preview thumbnail. variant:'full' includes it
//    and is only ever generated by get-full-card.js, after the gift is opened.
//
// 4. THE ART. The first pass was flat: a single gradient, thin line-art motif,
//    dead space top and bottom, and mismatched type. This version adds a
//    layered bloom, a vignette, a deterministic confetti field, an embossed
//    wax seal with ribbon tails, a foil-gradient name with a soft halo, and
//    ornamental rules — all pure SVG geometry plus feGaussianBlur, which is
//    the subset of filters librsvg renders reliably.
//
// 5. LAYOUT IS ADAPTIVE. Name size steps down by length, message type scales
//    with character count, and the sign-off is anchored to fixed positions
//    with the message block centred in the band above it — so a two-word note
//    and a 300-character note produce the same card silhouette, and neither
//    runs off the canvas.
//
// Body: { vibe_key, recipient_name, sender_name, message, order_id, gift_type,
//         sub_heading, photo_url, variant }
// Returns: { url, variant }

const { uploadBufferToR2 } = require('./_lib/r2Client');
const { loadSharp, familyFor, FAMILIES } = require('./_lib/cardFonts');
const { resolveVibe } = require('../../js/vibe-tokens');

const CARD_W = 1080, CARD_H = 1080;
const PHOTO_SIZE = 300;
const PHOTO_CX = 540, PHOTO_CY = 262;

// ── XML ESCAPE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Sender-controlled strings go straight into an XML document. Anything
// unescaped either breaks the parse (blank card, HTTP 500) or injects markup.
function esc(s) {
  return String(s === null || s === undefined ? '' : s)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&apos;')
    // Control characters are illegal in XML 1.0 and make libxml bail.
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F]/g, '');
}

// ── COLOUR HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function hexLighten(hex, amt) {
  const n = parseInt(String(hex).slice(1), 16);
  let r = (n >> 16) & 255, g = (n >> 8) & 255, b = n & 255;
  r = Math.min(255, Math.round(r + (255 - r) * amt));
  g = Math.min(255, Math.round(g + (255 - g) * amt));
  b = Math.min(255, Math.round(b + (255 - b) * amt));
  return '#' + ((1 << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b).toString(16).slice(1);
}
function hexDarken(hex, amt) {
  const n = parseInt(String(hex).slice(1), 16);
  let r = (n >> 16) & 255, g = (n >> 8) & 255, b = n & 255;
  r = Math.round(r * (1 - amt)); g = Math.round(g * (1 - amt)); b = Math.round(b * (1 - amt));
  return '#' + ((1 << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b).toString(16).slice(1);
}

// Deterministic PRNG — a regenerated card is byte-identical to the first one,
// so a retry never produces a visibly different image.
function lcg(seed) { let s = seed >>> 0; return function () { s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s / 4294967296; }; }

// ── CONFETTI FIELD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Adds depth and motion-feel to what was a dead flat gradient. Deterministic.
function confetti(accent, textCol, seed, opts){
  const o = Object.assign({count:78, avoidY:[0,0]}, opts||{});
  const rnd = lcg(seed);
  let out = '';
  for(let i=0;i<o.count;i++){
    const x = rnd()*CARD_W;
    const y = rnd()*CARD_H;
    const kind = rnd();
    const op = (0.05 + rnd()*0.34).toFixed(3);
    const col = rnd() > 0.45 ? accent : textCol;
    // Keep the centre column clear so confetti never fights the text.
    const nearCentre = Math.abs(x-540) < 300 && y > o.avoidY[0] && y < o.avoidY[1];
    if (nearCentre) continue;
    if (kind < 0.42){
      const r=(1.6+rnd()*4.2).toFixed(1);
      out += `<circle cx="${x.toFixed(0)}" cy="${y.toFixed(0)}" r="${r}" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="${op}"/>`;
    } else if (kind < 0.74){
      const w=(4+rnd()*11).toFixed(0), h=(3+rnd()*6).toFixed(0), rot=(rnd()*360).toFixed(0);
      out += `<rect x="${x.toFixed(0)}" y="${y.toFixed(0)}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="1.5" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="${op}" transform="rotate(${rot} ${x.toFixed(0)} ${y.toFixed(0)})"/>`;
    } else {
      const k=3+rnd()*7;
      out += `<path d="M ${x.toFixed(0)} ${(y-k).toFixed(0)} L ${(x+k*0.3).toFixed(0)} ${(y-k*0.3).toFixed(0)} L ${(x+k).toFixed(0)} ${y.toFixed(0)} L ${(x+k*0.3).toFixed(0)} ${(y+k*0.3).toFixed(0)} L ${x.toFixed(0)} ${(y+k).toFixed(0)} L ${(x-k*0.3).toFixed(0)} ${(y+k*0.3).toFixed(0)} L ${(x-k).toFixed(0)} ${y.toFixed(0)} L ${(x-k*0.3).toFixed(0)} ${(y-k*0.3).toFixed(0)} Z" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="${op}"/>`;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

  orb(cx,cy,r,a){return `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*0.72}" fill="none" stroke="${a}" stroke-width="${(r*0.1).toFixed(1)}"/><ellipse cx="${cx-r*0.2}" cy="${cy-r*0.26}" rx="${r*0.22}" ry="${r*0.14}" fill="${a}" transform="rotate(-28 ${cx-r*0.2} ${cy-r*0.26})"/><path d="M ${cx-r*0.95} ${cy+r*0.86} q ${r*0.95} ${r*0.26} ${r*1.9} 0" fill="none" stroke="${a}" stroke-width="${(r*0.1).toFixed(1)}"/>`;},
  bloom(cx,cy,r,a){let s='';for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const g=(i*60*Math.PI)/180,x=cx+Math.cos(g)*r*0.46,y=cy+Math.sin(g)*r*0.46;
    s+=`<ellipse cx="${x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${y.toFixed(1)}" rx="${(r*0.42).toFixed(1)}" ry="${(r*0.23).toFixed(1)}" fill="${a}" fill-opacity="0.8" transform="rotate(${i*60} ${x.toFixed(1)} ${y.toFixed(1)})"/>`;}
    return s+`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*0.22}" fill="${a}"/>`;},
  frame(cx,cy,r,a){return `<rect x="${cx-r*0.92}" y="${cy-r*0.72}" width="${r*1.84}" height="${r*1.44}" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="${a}" stroke-width="${(r*0.11).toFixed(1)}"/><circle cx="${cx-r*0.42}" cy="${cy-r*0.26}" r="${r*0.15}" fill="${a}"/><path d="M ${cx-r*0.82} ${cy+r*0.56} L ${cx-r*0.16} ${cy-r*0.1} L ${cx+r*0.26} ${cy+r*0.3} L ${cx+r*0.55} ${cy+r*0.04} L ${cx+r*0.82} ${cy+r*0.56} Z" fill="${a}"/>`;},
  gem(cx,cy,r,a){return `<path d="M ${cx-r*0.9} ${cy-r*0.3} L ${cx-r*0.45} ${cy-r*0.8} L ${cx+r*0.45} ${cy-r*0.8} L ${cx+r*0.9} ${cy-r*0.3} L ${cx} ${cy+r*0.88} Z" fill="${a}"/>`;},
  dot(cx,cy,r,a){return `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*0.46}" fill="${a}"/><circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*0.85}" fill="none" stroke="${a}" stroke-width="${(r*0.08).toFixed(1)}"/>`;},
};
function motifSvg(key,cx,cy,r,col){return (MOTIFS[key]||MOTIFS.burst)(cx,cy,r,col);}

// ── SHARED DEFS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function defs(v, seedName){
  const accentLight = hexLighten(v.accent, 0.45);
  const accentDark  = hexDarken(v.accent, 0.35);
  return `
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="85%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${hexLighten(v.bg1,0.06)}"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="${v.bg1}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${v.bg2}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bloom" cx="50%" cy="26%" r="62%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${v.accent}" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="${v.accent}" stop-opacity="0.09"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${v.accent}" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="48%" r="76%">
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="frameStroke" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${accentLight}" stop-opacity="0.75"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="${v.accent}" stop-opacity="0.28"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${accentLight}" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Foil shimmer on the recipient name: a light band raked across the accent. -->
    <linearGradient id="foil" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="30%">
      <stop offset="0%"  stop-color="${v.accent}"/>
      <stop offset="34%" stop-color="${accentLight}"/>
      <stop offset="52%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="68%" stop-color="${accentLight}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${v.accent}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="waxGrad" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="78%">
      <stop offset="0%"  stop-color="${accentLight}"/>
      <stop offset="58%" stop-color="${v.accent}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${accentDark}"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ribbon" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${accentDark}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${hexDarken(v.accent,0.62)}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Soft halo behind the name. librsvg supports feGaussianBlur reliably;
         a blurred duplicate underneath is cheaper and safer than feDropShadow. -->
    <filter id="softGlow" x="-45%" y="-70%" width="190%" height="260%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="16"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="tightGlow" x="-40%" y="-60%" width="180%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>`;
}

// ── FRAME ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function frame(v){
  const c = [[70,70],[CARD_W-70,70],[70,CARD_H-70],[CARD_W-70,CARD_H-70]];
  let corners = '';
  c.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
    const sx = i%2===0 ? 1 : -1;
    const sy = i<2 ? 1 : -1;
    corners += `<g stroke="${v.accent}" stroke-opacity="0.55" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
      <path d="M ${x+sx*4} ${y+sy*30} L ${x+sx*4} ${y+sy*4} L ${x+sx*30} ${y+sy*4}"/>
    </g><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="3.4" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.8"/>`;
  });
  return `
  <rect x="38" y="38" width="${CARD_W-76}" height="${CARD_H-76}" rx="42" fill="none" stroke="url(#frameStroke)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="56" y="56" width="${CARD_W-112}" height="${CARD_H-112}" rx="32" fill="none" stroke="${v.accent}" stroke-opacity="0.13" stroke-width="1"/>
  ${corners}`;
}

// ── WAX SEAL ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Thematic anchor for "sealed until you open it", and it gives the card the
// physical, premium feel the flat line-art motif never had.
function waxSeal(v, cx, cy, r){
  let notches = '';
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const g=(i*Math.PI*2)/26;
    notches += `<circle cx="${(cx+Math.cos(g)*r*0.99).toFixed(1)}" cy="${(cy+Math.sin(g)*r*0.99).toFixed(1)}" r="${(r*0.115).toFixed(1)}" fill="url(#waxGrad)"/>`;
  }
  const inkCol = hexDarken(v.bg2, 0.25);
  return `
  <!-- ribbon tails -->
  <path d="M ${cx-r*0.55} ${cy+r*0.5} L ${cx-r*1.32} ${cy+r*1.9} L ${cx-r*0.66} ${cy+r*1.62} L ${cx-r*0.5} ${cy+r*2.15} Z" fill="url(#ribbon)" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M ${cx+r*0.55} ${cy+r*0.5} L ${cx+r*1.32} ${cy+r*1.9} L ${cx+r*0.66} ${cy+r*1.62} L ${cx+r*0.5} ${cy+r*2.15} Z" fill="url(#ribbon)" opacity="0.85"/>
  <!-- halo -->
  <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*2.0}" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.07"/>
  <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*1.42}" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.10"/>
  <!-- wax body -->
  ${notches}
  <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r}" fill="url(#waxGrad)"/>
  <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*0.99}" fill="none" stroke="${hexLighten(v.accent,0.55)}" stroke-opacity="0.45" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- embossed rim -->
  <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r*0.76}" fill="none" stroke="${inkCol}" stroke-opacity="0.30" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- embossed vibe motif -->
  <g opacity="0.82">${motifSvg(v.motif, cx, cy, r*0.42, inkCol)}</g>
  <!-- specular highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="${cx-r*0.34}" cy="${cy-r*0.42}" rx="${r*0.3}" ry="${r*0.17}" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.22" transform="rotate(-32 ${cx-r*0.34} ${cy-r*0.42})"/>`;
}

// ── ORNAMENTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ruledLabel(text, y, col, size, gapHalf){
  const halfW = gapHalf || 230;
  return `
  <line x1="${540-halfW-90}" y1="${y-9}" x2="${540-halfW}" y2="${y-9}" stroke="${col}" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="${540+halfW}" y1="${y-9}" x2="${540+halfW+90}" y2="${y-9}" stroke="${col}" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="540" y="${y}" font-size="${size}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${col}"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.display}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="7">${esc(text)}</text>`;
}

function diamondDivider(y, col, halfW){
  const w = halfW || 250;
  return `
  <line x1="${540-w}" y1="${y}" x2="${540-16}" y2="${y}" stroke="${col}" stroke-opacity="0.32" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="${540+16}" y1="${y}" x2="${540+w}" y2="${y}" stroke="${col}" stroke-opacity="0.32" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M 540 ${y-7} L 547 ${y} L 540 ${y+7} L 533 ${y} Z" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="0.75"/>`;
}

// Long names must not overflow. Bebas is condensed so it takes more chars.
function nameSize(name, base){
  const n = name.length;
  if (n <= 8)  return base;
  if (n <= 12) return Math.round(base*0.84);
  if (n <= 16) return Math.round(base*0.68);
  if (n <= 22) return Math.round(base*0.54);
  return Math.round(base*0.44);
}

function wrapText(text, max){
  const words=String(text||'').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const lines=[];let cur='';
  for(const w of words){
    if((cur+' '+w).trim().length>max){ if(cur)lines.push(cur);
      if(w.length>max){let rest=w;while(rest.length>max){lines.push(rest.slice(0,max-1)+'-');rest=rest.slice(max-1);}cur=rest;}
      else cur=w;
    } else cur=(cur+' '+w).trim();
  }
  if(cur)lines.push(cur);
  return lines;
}

// ══ SEALED CARD ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildSealed({vibe:v, recipientName, senderName, eyebrow, tease, hasPhoto}){
  const fam = familyFor(v.font);
  const recipient = String(recipientName||'Friend').trim();
  const sender = String(senderName||'Someone special').trim();
  const nSize = nameSize(recipient, 104);
  const seed = recipient.length*7919 + sender.length*104729 + 13;

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>${defs(v)}</defs>

  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bloom)"/>
  ${confetti(v.accent, v.text, seed, {count:86, avoidY:[440,980]})}
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
  ${frame(v)}

  ${hasPhoto ? photoWell(v, PHOTO_CX, PHOTO_CY, PHOTO_SIZE/2) : waxSeal(v, 540, 262, 84)}

  ${ruledLabel(eyebrow, 508, v.accent, 26, 250)}

  <text x="540" y="572" font-size="27" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.5"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="2">for</text>

  <!-- Name: blurred duplicate underneath for the halo, foil gradient on top. -->
  <text x="540" y="688" font-size="${nSize}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.55"
    font-family="${fam}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" font-weight="800" filter="url(#softGlow)">${esc(recipient)}</text>
  <text x="540" y="688" font-size="${nSize}" text-anchor="middle" fill="url(#foil)"
    font-family="${fam}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="-1">${esc(recipient)}</text>

  ${diamondDivider(740, v.accent, 260)}

  <text x="540" y="806" font-size="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.8"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-style="italic">${esc(tease)}</text>

  <text x="540" y="892" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.42"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="5">FROM</text>
  <text x="540" y="946" font-size="46" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.92"
    font-family="${fam}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" font-weight="700">${esc(sender)}</text>

  <line x1="420" y1="994" x2="660" y2="994" stroke="${v.accent}" stroke-opacity="0.22" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="540" y="1034" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.45"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.display}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="9">ZIVOGIFT</text>
</svg>`;
}

// ══ FULL CARD ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildFull({vibe:v, recipientName, senderName, message, eyebrow, hasPhoto}){
  const fam = familyFor(v.font);
  const recipient = String(recipientName||'Friend').trim();
  const sender = String(senderName||'Someone special').trim();
  const msg = String(message||'').trim() || 'Wishing you an amazing day.';
  const short = msg.length>300 ? msg.slice(0,299)+'\u2026' : msg;
  // Message type scales with length so a long note still fits between the
  // name block and the fixed sign-off anchors instead of running off canvas.
  let msgSize, lh, wrapAt;
  if (short.length <= 110)      { msgSize=40; lh=52; wrapAt=28; }
  else if (short.length <= 190) { msgSize=35; lh=45; wrapAt=32; }
  else                          { msgSize=30; lh=39; wrapAt=38; }
  const lines = wrapText(short, wrapAt);
  const nSize = nameSize(recipient, 88);
  const seed = recipient.length*7919 + sender.length*104729 + 29;

  // The sign-off is anchored to fixed positions near the bottom; the message
  // block is centred in the band between the name rule and that anchor. This
  // keeps every card's silhouette consistent regardless of message length.
  const BAND_CENTRE = 700;
  const msgTop = Math.max(600, Math.round(BAND_CENTRE - ((lines.length-1)*lh)/2));
  const msgSvg = lines.map((l,i)=>`<tspan x="540" dy="${i===0?0:lh}">${esc(l)}</tspan>`).join('');
  const msgBottom = msgTop + (lines.length-1)*lh;
  const signY = 906;

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>${defs(v)}</defs>

  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bloom)"/>
  ${confetti(v.accent, v.text, seed, {count:80, avoidY:[400,980]})}
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
  ${frame(v)}

  <!-- Motif medallion instead of the wax seal: the card is open now.
       A recipient photo takes the same slot when there is one. -->
  ${hasPhoto ? photoWell(v, PHOTO_CX, PHOTO_CY, PHOTO_SIZE/2) : `
  <circle cx="540" cy="222" r="112" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.07"/>
  <circle cx="540" cy="222" r="80" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="540" cy="222" r="80" fill="none" stroke="${v.accent}" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g filter="url(#tightGlow)" opacity="0.65">${motifSvg(v.motif,540,222,50,v.accent)}</g>
  ${motifSvg(v.motif,540,222,50,v.accent)}`}

  ${ruledLabel(eyebrow, 392, v.accent, 24, 240)}

  <text x="540" y="502" font-size="${nSize}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.5"
    font-family="${fam}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" font-weight="800" filter="url(#softGlow)">${esc(recipient)}</text>
  <text x="540" y="502" font-size="${nSize}" text-anchor="middle" fill="url(#foil)"
    font-family="${fam}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="-1">${esc(recipient)}</text>

  ${diamondDivider(556, v.accent, 250)}

  <!-- Quote marks frame the message the way a real card would. -->
  <text x="180" y="${msgTop+18}" font-size="120" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.16"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif">&#8220;</text>

  <text y="${msgTop}" font-size="${msgSize}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.95"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif">${msgSvg}</text>

  <text x="898" y="${msgBottom+46}" font-size="120" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.16"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif">&#8221;</text>

  ${diamondDivider(signY-58, v.accent, 200)}

  <text x="540" y="${signY-4}" font-size="19" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.42"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="5">FROM</text>
  <text x="540" y="${signY+56}" font-size="54" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.92"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.hand}, cursive">${esc(sender)}</text>

  <text x="540" y="1040" font-size="19" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.34"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.display}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="9">ZIVOGIFT</text>
</svg>`;
}

// ══ ROAST CERTIFICATE (Group 4 · #11) ══════════════════════════════════════
// message arrives as "TITLE — BODY" (see studio-group4.js addToCart).
// Sealed withholds both, since the award title IS the punchline.
function buildCertificate({vibe:v, recipientName, senderName, message, subHeading, sealed}){
  const recipient = String(recipientName||'Friend').trim();
  const sender    = String(senderName||'Someone special').trim();
  const raw       = String(message||'').trim();
  const splitIdx  = raw.indexOf('\u2014');
  const title     = (splitIdx > -1 ? raw.slice(0, splitIdx) : 'Certificate of Distinction').trim();
  const bodyText  = (splitIdx > -1 ? raw.slice(splitIdx + 1) : raw).trim();

  const shownTitle = sealed ? 'Sealed until opened' : (title || 'Certificate of Distinction');
  const shownBody  = sealed ? '' : bodyText;

  const titleLines = wrapText(shownTitle, 26);
  const bodyLines  = shownBody ? wrapText(shownBody, 40) : [];
  const titleSvg   = titleLines.map((l,i)=>`<tspan x="540" dy="${i===0?0:54}">${esc(l)}</tspan>`).join('');
  const bodyTop    = 576 + titleLines.length * 54;
  const bodySvg    = bodyLines.map((l,i)=>`<tspan x="540" dy="${i===0?0:36}">${esc(l)}</tspan>`).join('');
  const seed       = recipient.length*7919 + sender.length*104729 + 41;

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>${defs(v)}</defs>
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bloom)"/>
  ${confetti(v.accent, v.text, seed, {count:54, avoidY:[240,900]})}
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#vignette)"/>

  <!-- Ornate double rule, flatter and more formal than the standard frame. -->
  <rect x="42" y="42" width="${CARD_W-84}" height="${CARD_H-84}" fill="none" stroke="url(#frameStroke)" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="60" y="60" width="${CARD_W-120}" height="${CARD_H-120}" fill="none" stroke="${v.accent}" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="74" r="6" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="${CARD_W-74}" cy="74" r="6" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="${CARD_H-74}" r="6" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="${CARD_W-74}" cy="${CARD_H-74}" r="6" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.7"/>

  ${ruledLabel('CERTIFICATE OF ROAST', 164, v.accent, 25, 260)}

  ${subHeading ? `<text x="540" y="222" font-size="19" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.5"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" letter-spacing="2">${esc(subHeading)}</text>` : ''}

  <text x="540" y="300" font-size="21" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.55"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-style="italic">this certifies that</text>

  <text x="540" y="392" font-size="${nameSize(recipient, 78)}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.accent}" fill-opacity="0.5"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-weight="700" filter="url(#softGlow)">${esc(recipient)}</text>
  <text x="540" y="392" font-size="${nameSize(recipient, 78)}" text-anchor="middle" fill="url(#foil)"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-weight="700">${esc(recipient)}</text>

  ${diamondDivider(432, v.accent, 270)}

  <text x="540" y="486" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.55"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-style="italic">is hereby awarded the title of</text>

  <text y="546" font-size="42" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-weight="800">${titleSvg}</text>

  ${bodySvg ? `<text y="${bodyTop}" font-size="27" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.82"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif">${bodySvg}</text>` : ''}

  ${waxSeal(v, 540, CARD_H-214, 52)}

  <line x1="360" y1="${CARD_H-112}" x2="720" y2="${CARD_H-112}" stroke="${v.text}" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="540" y="${CARD_H-84}" font-size="19" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.68"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.serif}, serif" font-style="italic">Chief Roast Officer \u2014 on behalf of ${esc(sender)}</text>

  <text x="540" y="${CARD_H-34}" font-size="19" text-anchor="middle" fill="${v.text}" fill-opacity="0.42"
    font-family="${FAMILIES.display}, ${FAMILIES.sans}, sans-serif" letter-spacing="9">ZIVOGIFT</text>
</svg>`;
}

// ══ HOROSCOPE DROP (Group 4 · #17) ═════════════════════════════════════════
function buildHoroscope({vibe:v, recipientName, senderName, message, subHeading, sealed}){
  const fam       = familyFor(v.font);
  const recipient = String(recipientName||'Friend').trim();
  const sender    = String(senderName||'Someone special').trim();
  const body      = sealed
    ? 'The stars have notes on you.\nSealed until you open it.'
    : String(message||'').trim();
  const lines     = body.split('\n').reduce((a,p)=>a.concat(wrapText(p,34)),[]);
  const lh        = 42;
  const top       = Math.max(600, Math.round(690 - ((lines.length-1)*lh)/2));
  const msgSvg    = lines.map((l,i)=>`<tspan x="540" dy="${i===0?0:lh}">${esc(l)}</tspan>`).join('');
  const seed      = recipient.length*7919 + sender.length*104729 + 53;

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>${defs(v)}</defs>
  <rect width="${CARD_W}" height="${CARD_H}" fill="url(#bg)"/>

// ── PHOTO ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Fetch -> cover-crop -> circle-mask -> accent ring. Returns null if there is
// no photo or it cannot be fetched: a missing photo must never cost the
// recipient their card, so we fall back to the wax seal / motif layout.
async function prepareCircularPhoto(sharp, photoUrl, accentColor) {
  if (!photoUrl) return null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(photoUrl);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('photo fetch failed (' + res.status + ')');
    const arrBuf = await res.arrayBuffer();

    const maskSvg = Buffer.from(
      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="' + PHOTO_SIZE + '" height="' + PHOTO_SIZE + '">' +
      '<circle cx="' + PHOTO_SIZE / 2 + '" cy="' + PHOTO_SIZE / 2 + '" r="' + PHOTO_SIZE / 2 + '" fill="#fff"/></svg>'
    );
    const ringSvg = Buffer.from(
      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="' + PHOTO_SIZE + '" height="' + PHOTO_SIZE + '">' +
      '<circle cx="' + PHOTO_SIZE / 2 + '" cy="' + PHOTO_SIZE / 2 + '" r="' + (PHOTO_SIZE / 2 - 4) + '" fill="none" stroke="' +
      accentColor + '" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.95"/></svg>'
    );

    const circular = await sharp(Buffer.from(arrBuf))
      .resize(PHOTO_SIZE, PHOTO_SIZE, { fit: 'cover', position: 'attention' })
      .composite([{ input: maskSvg, blend: 'dest-in' }])
      .png()
      .toBuffer();

    return await sharp(circular).composite([{ input: ringSvg }]).png().toBuffer();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('generate-card-image: photo prepare failed, rendering without photo:', err.message);
    return null;
  }
}

// A photo replaces the wax seal, so it needs its own halo to sit in.
function photoWell(v, cx, cy, r) {
  return '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + (r * 1.55) + '" fill="' + v.accent + '" fill-opacity="0.07"/>' +
         '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + (r * 1.2) + '" fill="' + v.accent + '" fill-opacity="0.10"/>' +
         '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + (r + 4) + '" fill="' + v.bg2 + '" fill-opacity="0.92"/>';
}

// ── HANDLER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { vibe_key, recipient_name, sender_name, message, order_id, gift_type, sub_heading } = body;
  // gift-scheduler.js sends photo_url; accept the digital_sends column name too
  // so a manual call with the raw row also works.
  const photoUrl = body.photo_url || body.recipient_photo_url || null;

  // 'sealed' is the DEFAULT on purpose: anything that forgets to pass a variant
  // gets the message-free card, so a future caller cannot reintroduce the leak.
  const variant = body.variant === 'full' ? 'full' : 'sealed';
  const sealed = variant === 'sealed';

  if (!recipient_name) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'recipient_name is required' }) };
  }

  try {
    // Sharp comes from cardFonts, which has already pointed fontconfig at our
    // bundled TTFs and verified glyphs rasterize. If fonts are missing this
    // throws — a 500 is far better than a blank card that gets marked `sent`.
    const sharp = await loadSharp();

    const vibe = resolveVibe(vibe_key, gift_type);
    const giftType = gift_type || 'standard';

    // The certificate and horoscope layouts have no photo slot.
    const layoutTakesPhoto = giftType !== 'roast_certificate' && giftType !== 'horoscope_drop';
    const photoBuffer = layoutTakesPhoto
      ? await prepareCircularPhoto(sharp, photoUrl, vibe.accent)
      : null;

    const copy = sealedCopyFor(giftType);
    const args = {
      vibe,
      recipientName: recipient_name,
      senderName: sender_name,
      message,
      subHeading: sub_heading,
      hasPhoto: !!photoBuffer,
      giftType,
      eyebrow: sealed ? copy.eyebrow : openEyebrowFor(giftType),
      tease: copy.tease,
      sealed,
    };

    let svgStr;
    if (giftType === 'roast_certificate') svgStr = buildCertificate(args);
    else if (giftType === 'horoscope_drop') svgStr = buildHoroscope(args);
    else svgStr = sealed ? buildSealed(args) : buildFull(args);

    // density:144 supersamples the text, so the rendered bitmap is larger than
    // the 1080-unit SVG canvas — the photo has to be scaled and positioned in
    // that rendered space, not in card space, or it lands off-centre.
    const baseBuffer = await sharp(Buffer.from(svgStr, 'utf8'), { density: 144 })
      .png({ compressionLevel: 7 })
      .toBuffer();

    let pngBuffer = baseBuffer;
    if (photoBuffer) {
      const meta = await sharp(baseBuffer).metadata();
      const scale = (meta.width || CARD_W) / CARD_W;
      const drawn = Math.round(PHOTO_SIZE * scale);
      const scaled = await sharp(photoBuffer).resize(drawn, drawn).png().toBuffer();
      pngBuffer = await sharp(baseBuffer)
        .composite([{
          input: scaled,
          left: Math.round((PHOTO_CX - PHOTO_SIZE / 2) * scale),
          top:  Math.round((PHOTO_CY - PHOTO_SIZE / 2) * scale),
        }])
        .png({ compressionLevel: 7 })
        .toBuffer();
    }

    // Variant is in the object key so sealed and full can never collide, and an
    // R2 listing is self-describing.
    const safeRecipient = String(recipient_name).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase().slice(0, 30);
    const filename = 'cards/' + (order_id || 'preview') + '/' + variant + '-' + safeRecipient + '-' + Date.now() + '.png';

    const url = await uploadBufferToR2(pngBuffer, filename, 'image/png');

    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url, variant }),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('generate-card-image error:', err.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }) };
  }
};

// Exported for scripts/verify-cards.js and for clip-frame reuse.
module.exports.buildSealed = buildSealed;
module.exports.buildFull = buildFull;
module.exports.buildCertificate = buildCertificate;
module.exports.buildHoroscope = buildHoroscope;
module.exports.motifSvg = motifSvg;
module.exports.wrapText = wrapText;
module.exports.escXml = esc;
module.exports.sealedCopyFor = sealedCopyFor;
module.exports.openEyebrowFor = openEyebrowFor;

// ============================================================================
// ZIVOGIFT — generate-roast.js  (Run 3)
// POST { name, about?, tone?, count? } → { ok, roasts:[...], title }
// Calls Gemini via REST, then hands raw text to roast-core.parseRoastResponse()
// (forgiving JSON extraction + safety filtering). Env: GEMINI_API_KEY.
// ============================================================================
const { buildRoastPrompt, parseRoastResponse } = require('./_lib/roast-core');

const GEMINI_KEY   = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
const GEMINI_MODEL = process.env.GEMINI_MODEL || 'gemini-1.5-flash';

async function callGemini(prompt) {
  const url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/'
    + encodeURIComponent(GEMINI_MODEL) + ':generateContent?key=' + GEMINI_KEY;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
      generationConfig: { temperature: 0.9, maxOutputTokens: 800 },
      safetySettings: [
        { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT',        threshold: 'BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH' },
        { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH',       threshold: 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE' },
        { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT', threshold: 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE' },
        { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT', threshold: 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE' }
      ]
    })
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error('gemini_http_' + res.status + (t ? ': ' + t.slice(0, 200) : ''));
  }
  const data = await res.json();
  const cand = data && data.candidates && data.candidates[0];
  const text = cand && cand.content && cand.content.parts && cand.content.parts.map(p => p.text || '').join('');
  if (!text) throw new Error('gemini_empty_response');
  return text;
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  if (!GEMINI_KEY) return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'missing_gemini_key' }) };

  let input;
  try { input = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); }
  catch { return { statusCode: 400, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'bad_json' }) }; }
  if (!input.name || !String(input.name).trim()) {
    return { statusCode: 400, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'name_required' }) };
  }

  try {
    const prompt = buildRoastPrompt(input);
    let parsed = parseRoastResponse(await callGemini(prompt), { minCount: 3 });
    if (!parsed.ok) parsed = parseRoastResponse(await callGemini(prompt + '\nReturn ONLY the JSON.'), { minCount: 3 });
    if (!parsed.ok) return { statusCode: 502, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'generation_failed', detail: parsed.error }) };
    return { statusCode: 200, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true, roasts: parsed.roasts, title: parsed.title }) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('generate-roast error:', e.message);
    return { statusCode: 502, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gemini_error', detail: e.message.slice(0, 160) }) };
  }
};

FILE: netlify\functions\get-full-card.js

// POST /.netlify/functions/get-full-card
//
// Returns the FULL card image for a gift — the one with the personal message
// painted on it — generating and caching it on first request.
//
// ── WHY THIS EXISTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// gift-scheduler.js deliberately only ever generates the SEALED card, so the
// message-bearing image does not exist anywhere at delivery time and cannot
// end up in an inbox preview thumbnail or a WhatsApp notification.
//
// But the recipient still wants a saveable keepsake once they have opened the
// gift. That is this endpoint: called by gift.html from Act 3 (Keepsake) when
// the recipient taps Save card, i.e. strictly AFTER the reveal.
//
// GUARD: the gift must already be marked opened. A link that has never been
// opened cannot mint its own full card — otherwise anyone holding the URL
// could skip the reveal and pull the message straight out of an image, which
// is the leak this whole split was built to close.
//
// Body:    { gift_id }
// Returns: { url } | { error }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { gift_id } = body;
  if (!gift_id) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_id is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: send, error } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('id, order_id, recipient_name, sender_name, personal_message, occasion, vibe_key, gift_type, card_image_url, recipient_photo_url, photo_urls, opened_at, is_time_capsule, scheduled_at')
    .eq('id', gift_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error || !send) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Gift not found' }) };
  }

  // A time capsule that has not matured has nothing to hand out.
  if (send.is_time_capsule && send.scheduled_at && new Date(send.scheduled_at) > new Date()) {
    return { statusCode: 403, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'This gift is not open yet' }) };
  }

  // The reveal must have happened. gift.html calls mark-gift-opened on the
  // Open tap, so by the time the Save button is reachable opened_at is set.
  if (!send.opened_at) {
    return { statusCode: 403, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Open the gift first' }) };
  }

  // Already generated — hand back the cached one.
  if (send.card_image_url) {
    return json({ url: send.card_image_url, cached: true });
  }

  const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';
  const isMemoryBoard = send.gift_type === 'squad_memory_board';
  const endpoint = isMemoryBoard ? 'compose-memory-board' : 'generate-card-image';

  const genBody = isMemoryBoard
    ? {
        photo_urls: send.photo_urls || [],
        vibe_key: send.vibe_key || 'squad_memory_board',
        recipient_name: send.recipient_name,
        sender_name: send.sender_name,
        message: send.personal_message || '',
        sub_heading: send.occasion,
        order_id: send.order_id,
      }
    : {
        variant: 'full',
        vibe_key: send.vibe_key || 'confetti_pop',
        recipient_name: send.recipient_name,
        sender_name: send.sender_name,
        message: send.personal_message || '',
        order_id: send.order_id,
        gift_type: send.gift_type,
        sub_heading: send.occasion,
        photo_url: send.recipient_photo_url || null,
      };

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${siteUrl}/.netlify/functions/${endpoint}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(genBody),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const detail = await res.text().catch(() => '');
      console.warn(`get-full-card: generation failed for ${gift_id} (${res.status}) ${detail.slice(0, 300)}`);
      return { statusCode: 502, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Could not generate the card right now' }) };
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    await supabase.from('digital_sends').update({ card_image_url: data.url }).eq('id', gift_id);

    return json({ url: data.url, cached: false });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('get-full-card error:', err.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }) };
  }
};

function json(payload) {
  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// ZIVOGIFT — get-gift-timeline.js   (Phase 1 UX · Per-Gift Timeline)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /.netlify/functions/get-gift-timeline?id=<digital_sends.id>
//
// Returns a single gift's LIFECYCLE as an ordered list of events:
//     created → sent → opened → reveal_completed → reacted → shared → anniversary
//
// This is DELIBERATELY different from Memory Vault (memories.js / get-my-memories.js),
// which lists MANY gifts as flat rows. This endpoint is the story of ONE gift.
//
// It is READ-ONLY. It writes nothing and needs no new columns — every field it
// reads already exists (verified against ZivoGift_all_sql_FINAL_combined.sql):
//   digital_sends: created_at, sent_at, opened_at, reveal_completed_at,
//                  reacted_at, reaction, is_time_capsule, scheduled_at,
//                  gift_type, recipient_name, sender_name, occasion, status
//   gift_reactions: submitted_at, contributor_name         (Squad reactions)
//   share_clip_jobs: status, created_at, updated_at         (Download & Share)
//
// Same security posture as get-gift.js: all reads go through the service-role
// key on the server, never the browser anon key.
// ============================================================================

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

const GIFT_LABELS = {
  standard:            'Gift',
  birthday_note:       'Birthday note',
  meme_card:           'Meme card',
  midnight_drop:       'Midnight drop',
  hype_reel:           'Hype reel',
  farewell_note:       'Farewell note',
  love_note:           'Love note',
  personal_message:    'Personal message',
  character_drop:      'Anonymous drop',
  squad_drop:          'Squad gift',
  roast_certificate:   'Roast certificate',
  horoscope_drop:      'Horoscope',
  exam_survival_kit:   'Exam survival kit',
  squad_memory_board:  'Squad memory board',
  digital_scrapbook:   'Scrapbook',
  care_package:        'Care package',
};

function labelFor(t) { return GIFT_LABELS[t] || 'Gift'; }

// The next calendar anniversary of a date (same month/day, next future year).
function nextAnniversary(iso) {
  if (!iso) return null;
  const base = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(base)) return null;
  const now = new Date();
  const a = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), base.getUTCMonth(), base.getUTCDate()));
  if (a < now) a.setUTCFullYear(a.getUTCFullYear() + 1);
  return a.toISOString();
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };

  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  }

  const giftId = (event.queryStringParameters || {}).id;
  if (!giftId) {
    return { statusCode: 400, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'id_required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  try {
    const { data: g, error: gErr } = await supabase
      .from('digital_sends')
      .select('id, gift_type, recipient_name, sender_name, occasion, status, ' +
              'created_at, sent_at, opened_at, reveal_completed_at, reaction, ' +
              'reacted_at, is_time_capsule, scheduled_at')
      .eq('id', giftId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (gErr)  return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: gErr.message }) };
    if (!g)    return { statusCode: 404, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_not_found' }) };

    // Squad reactions that have actually been recorded (a video was submitted).
    const { data: reactions } = await supabase
      .from('gift_reactions')
      .select('contributor_name, submitted_at')
      .eq('gift_id', giftId)
      .not('submitted_at', 'is', null)
      .order('submitted_at', { ascending: true });

    // Was a shareable clip ever produced for this gift?
    const { data: clips } = await supabase
      .from('share_clip_jobs')
      .select('status, created_at, updated_at')
      .eq('digital_send_id', giftId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    const events = [];
    const push = (key, at, title, detail) => {
      if (!at) return;
      events.push({ key, at, title, detail: detail || null });
    };

    push('created', g.created_at, 'Gift created',
         `${labelFor(g.gift_type)} for ${g.recipient_name || 'them'}`);

    if (g.is_time_capsule && g.scheduled_at && new Date(g.scheduled_at) > new Date()) {
      push('sealed', g.created_at, 'Sealed as a Time Capsule',
           `Unlocks ${new Date(g.scheduled_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}`);
    }

    push('sent', g.sent_at, 'Delivered', `Sent to ${g.recipient_name || 'them'}`);
    push('opened', g.opened_at, 'Opened',
         `${g.recipient_name || 'They'} tapped to open it`);
    push('reveal_completed', g.reveal_completed_at, 'Fully revealed',
         'Watched the whole reveal');

    const doneClip = (clips || []).find((c) => c.status === 'done');
    if (doneClip) {
      push('shared', doneClip.updated_at || doneClip.created_at, 'Made shareable',
           'A share clip was generated');
    }

    // Squad reactions — one event per recorded reaction.
    (reactions || []).forEach((r) => {
      push('reacted', r.submitted_at, 'Reaction recorded',
           r.contributor_name ? `${r.contributor_name} sent a video` : 'A squad member reacted');
    });
    // Single-recipient emoji reaction stored on the row itself.
    if (g.reaction && g.reacted_at) {
      push('reacted', g.reacted_at, 'They reacted', `Reacted ${g.reaction}`);
    }

    // Forward-looking: the next anniversary of the send (Feature #19 hooks this).
    const anchor = g.sent_at || g.created_at;
    const anniv = nextAnniversary(anchor);
    if (anniv) {
      events.push({
        key: 'anniversary',
        at: anniv,
        title: 'Upcoming anniversary',
        detail: `One year since this ${labelFor(g.gift_type).toLowerCase()}`,
        upcoming: true,
      });
    }

    // Sort past events chronologically; keep the upcoming anniversary last.
    events.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.upcoming && !b.upcoming) return 1;
      if (b.upcoming && !a.upcoming) return -1;
      return new Date(a.at) - new Date(b.at);
    });

    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        gift: {
          id: g.id,
          gift_type: g.gift_type,
          label: labelFor(g.gift_type),
          recipient_name: g.recipient_name,
          occasion: g.occasion,
          status: g.status,
        },
        events,
      }),
    };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('get-gift-timeline fatal:', e && e.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'server_error' }) };
  }
};

FILE: netlify\functions\get-gift.js
=====================================================


// GET /.netlify/functions/get-gift?id=<uuid>
//
// Server-side fetch for gift.html — replaces the direct anon-key Supabase
// query so we can REDACT sender_phone/sender_name at the source for
// character_drop gifts. This guarantees the real sender identity never
// appears in any network response sent to the recipient's browser, satisfying
// the anonymous relay privacy requirement exactly.
//
// Returns the shape gift.html expects, minus sender_phone/sender_name when
// gift_type === 'character_drop'.
//
// ── WHAT CHANGED AND WHY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// 1. `teaser_image_url` is now returned alongside `card_image_url`. The
//    redesigned gift.html uses the sealed image as the Act 0 envelope face
//    (it is already cached in the recipient's browser from the email, so it
//    paints instantly) and only ever fetches the full card on demand.
//
// 2. TIME CAPSULE HARDENING. The old response included personal_message for
//    every gift, including a time capsule whose scheduled_at is still years
//    away. gift.html hid the content behind a locked screen, but the message
//    was sitting in the JSON the whole time — one devtools tab away. A
//    still-locked capsule now returns the lock metadata ONLY. The client-side
//    guard in gift.html stays as a second layer, but it is no longer the only
//    thing standing between the recipient and an early peek.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

const BASE_SELECT_COLUMNS = [
  'id',
  'recipient_name',
  'sender_name',
  'sender_phone',
  'personal_message',
  'occasion',
  'vibe_key',
  'card_image_url',
  'teaser_image_url',
  'gift_url',
  'gift_type',
  'media_url',
  'media_type',
  'persona_key',
  'reply_token',
  'scheduled_at',
  'is_time_capsule',
  'opened_at',
];
// Part 2: gift_title is additive (schema-voice-video-tribute.sql). If the
// migration hasn't been applied yet, selecting it would 400 the whole read,
// so we try WITH it first and fall back WITHOUT it — the title simply won't
// show until the column exists. Nothing else is affected.
const SELECT_WITH_TITLE = BASE_SELECT_COLUMNS.concat(['gift_title']).join(', ');
const SELECT_BASE = BASE_SELECT_COLUMNS.join(', ');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const giftId = event.queryStringParameters && event.queryStringParameters.id;
  if (!giftId) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'id is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  let { data: gift, error } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select(SELECT_WITH_TITLE)
    .eq('id', giftId)
    .maybeSingle();

  // Graceful fallback: if gift_title column isn't there yet, retry without it.
  if (error && /gift_title/i.test(error.message || '')) {
    ({ data: gift, error } = await supabase
      .from('digital_sends')
      .select(SELECT_BASE)
      .eq('id', giftId)
      .maybeSingle());
  }

  if (error || !gift) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Gift not found' }) };
  }

  // ── TIME CAPSULE: withhold everything until it is actually due ────────────
  const locked = !!gift.is_time_capsule
    && gift.scheduled_at
    && new Date(gift.scheduled_at) > new Date();

  if (locked) {
    return json({
      data: {
        id: gift.id,
        recipient_name: gift.recipient_name,
        is_time_capsule: true,
        locked: true,
        scheduled_at: gift.scheduled_at,
        vibe_key: gift.vibe_key,
        gift_type: gift.gift_type,
      },
    });
  }

  // ── PRIVACY: character_drop must never leak the real sender's identity ────
  // Not even momentarily, in a network response the recipient can inspect.
  if (gift.gift_type === 'character_drop') {
    gift.sender_phone = null;
    gift.sender_name = null;
  }

  gift.locked = false;
  return json({ data: gift });
};

function json(payload) {
  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  };
}

FILE: netlify\functions\get-media-upload-url.js
=====================================================



// POST /.netlify/functions/get-media-upload-url
//
// Generates a presigned PUT URL so the browser can upload a media blob
// directly to Cloudflare R2 without routing through Netlify (avoids
// the 10-second function timeout for large files).
//
// Body: { file_extension: 'webm' | 'mp4' | 'mp3', order_id: string }
// Returns: { upload_url, public_url }
//   upload_url — presigned S3/R2 PUT URL; browser does: fetch(upload_url, { method:'PUT', body: blob })
//   public_url — the permanent public URL once the upload completes
//
// Must complete in under 2 seconds (only generates a URL, no upload here).

const { S3Client, PutObjectCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-s3');
const { getSignedUrl } = require('@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner');

const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ['webm', 'mp4', 'mp3', 'ogg', 'm4a', 'wav', 'mov', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'];
const CONTENT_TYPES = {
  webm: 'video/webm',
  mp4: 'video/mp4',
  mp3: 'audio/mpeg',
  ogg: 'audio/ogg',
  // Part 2: common phone-recording formats for Voice/Video Gift uploads.
  m4a: 'audio/mp4',
  wav: 'audio/wav',
  mov: 'video/quicktime',
  jpg: 'image/jpeg',
  jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
  png: 'image/png',
  webp: 'image/webp',
};
// Presigned URL expires in 15 minutes — enough for a slow mobile upload.
const EXPIRES_IN_SECONDS = 900;

function generateUUID() {
  // Simple random UUID v4 without crypto dependency
  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
    var r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    var v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return v.toString(16);
  });
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { file_extension, order_id } = body;

  if (!file_extension || !ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.includes(file_extension.toLowerCase())) {
    return {
      statusCode: 400,
      body: JSON.stringify({ error: `file_extension must be one of: ${ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.join(', ')}` }),
    };
  }
  if (!order_id) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'order_id is required' }) };
  }
  // order_id becomes part of the R2 object key path — restrict to a safe
  // charset so it can't be used to write outside the intended prefix (e.g.
  // '../', slashes, or other path-meaningful characters).
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(order_id)) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid order_id' }) };
  }

  const accountId = process.env.R2_ACCOUNT_ID;
  const bucketName = process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME;
  const accessKey = process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID;
  const secretKey = process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY;
  const publicUrl = process.env.R2_PUBLIC_URL;

  if (!accountId || !bucketName || !accessKey || !secretKey) {
    console.error('get-media-upload-url: missing R2 env vars');
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Server storage not configured' }) };
  }

  const ext = file_extension.toLowerCase();
  const uuid = generateUUID();
  const key = `gift-media/${order_id}/${uuid}.${ext}`;
  const contentType = CONTENT_TYPES[ext] || 'application/octet-stream';
  // NOTE: do NOT pass CacheControl into the presigned command. Any header we
  // set here becomes part of SignedHeaders, so the browser must reproduce it
  // byte-for-byte on the PUT or R2 answers 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch, and it
  // also forces a CORS preflight that must allow the `cache-control` header.
  // Long-lived caching for gift-media/* is applied by a Cloudflare cache rule
  // on the public R2 domain instead.

  const client = new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: { accessKeyId: accessKey, secretAccessKey: secretKey },
  });

  try {
    const command = new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: bucketName,
      Key: key,
      ContentType: contentType,
    });

    const uploadUrl = await getSignedUrl(client, command, { expiresIn: EXPIRES_IN_SECONDS });

    const base = (publicUrl || `https://${bucketName}.${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`).replace(/\/$/, '');
    const finalPublicUrl = `${base}/${key}`;

    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ upload_url: uploadUrl, public_url: finalPublicUrl, content_type: contentType, key: key }),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('get-media-upload-url: presign error:', err.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to generate upload URL' }) };
  }
};

FILE: netlify\functions\get-my-memories.js

// ============================================================================
// ZIVOGIFT — get-my-memories.js  (Run 1: Memory Vault)
// Returns the logged-in user's SENT and RECEIVED digital gifts for the
// "My Memories" tab. Verifies the caller's Supabase access token, then calls
// the get_my_memories() RPC as that user so its auth.uid()-scoped queries
// return only their data.
// ============================================================================
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const ANON_KEY     = process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };

  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET' && event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  }

  try {
    const authHeader = event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization || '';
    const token = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
    if (!token) return { statusCode: 401, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'missing_token' }) };

    const authClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, ANON_KEY);
    const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await authClient.auth.getUser(token);
    if (userErr || !userData || !userData.user) {
      return { statusCode: 401, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'invalid_token' }) };
    }

    const userScoped = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, ANON_KEY, {
      global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
    });

    const { data, error } = await userScoped.rpc('get_my_memories');
    if (error) {
      console.error('get_my_memories RPC error for', userData.user.id, error.message);
      return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'query_failed' }) };
    }

    return { statusCode: 200, headers, body: JSON.stringify(data || { sent: [], received: [] }) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('get-my-memories fatal:', e);
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'server_error' }) };
  }
};
