FILE: netlify\functions\get-order-squad-status.js
=====================================================

// GET /.netlify/functions/get-order-squad-status?order_id=<uuid>
// Authorization: Bearer <user access token>
//
// Bridges the account page (which knows ORDER ids) to the Squad Wall (which is
// keyed by digital_sends.id / gift_id). Because direct client reads of
// digital_sends are RLS-scoped (that's why Memory Vault used a SECURITY DEFINER
// RPC), we can't look this up from the browser. This function:
//   1. verifies the caller's Supabase token → userId
//   2. confirms the order belongs to that user (orders.user_id === userId)
//   3. finds squad_drop gifts for the order and summarises their progress
// Returns { squad_gifts: [{ gift_id, recipient_name, invited, submitted, ... }] }.
// Never returns phones/tokens/video URLs of pending contributors.
//
// NOTE: it matches on digital_sends.gift_type === 'squad_drop' (the value your
// studio uses via data-type), NOT on an order_items product_id string, so there
// is no product-id-format guessing.
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { summarizeSquad } = require('./_lib/squad-core');

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const ANON_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

async function verifyUser(authHeader) {
  const token = String(authHeader || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return null;
  const c = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, ANON_KEY);
  const { data, error } = await c.auth.getUser(token);
  if (error || !data || !data.user) return null;
  return data.user.id;
}

// Testable core: userId is already resolved; supabase is injected.
async function _process(orderId, userId, supabase) {
  if (!orderId) return { statusCode: 400, body: { error: 'order_id required' } };
  if (!userId) return { statusCode: 401, body: { error: 'unauthenticated' } };

  // 1) Ownership check — the caller must own this order.
  const { data: order, error: oErr } = await supabase
    .from('orders').select('id, user_id').eq('id', orderId).maybeSingle();
  if (oErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: { error: 'order_lookup_failed' } };
  if (!order || order.user_id !== userId) return { statusCode: 403, body: { error: 'forbidden' } };

  // 2) Squad gifts on this order.
  const { data: sends, error: sErr } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends').select('id, recipient_name')
    .eq('order_id', orderId).eq('gift_type', 'squad_drop');
  if (sErr) return { statusCode: 500, body: { error: 'sends_lookup_failed' } };
  if (!sends || !sends.length) return { statusCode: 200, body: { squad_gifts: [] } };

  // 3) Summarise each gift's reaction wall.
  const out = [];
  for (const s of sends) {
    const { data: rx } = await supabase
      .from('gift_reactions').select('contributor_name, video_url, submitted_at').eq('gift_id', s.id);
    out.push(Object.assign({ gift_id: s.id, recipient_name: s.recipient_name || null }, summarizeSquad(rx || [])));
  }
  return { statusCode: 200, body: { squad_gifts: out } };
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  const orderId = event.queryStringParameters && event.queryStringParameters.order_id;
  try {
    const userId = await verifyUser(event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization);
    const res = await _process(orderId, userId, getSupabaseAdmin());
    return { statusCode: res.statusCode, headers, body: JSON.stringify(res.body) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('get-order-squad-status fatal:', e && e.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'server_error' }) };
  }
};

module.exports._process = _process;

// GET /.netlify/functions/get-reaction-context?token=<uuid>
//
// Called by react.html on page load to get context for the reaction recording UI.
// Returns safe gift context — no phone numbers, no private data.
//
// Returns: { gift_id, recipient_name, sender_name, contributor_name, already_submitted }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const token = event.queryStringParameters && event.queryStringParameters.token;
  if (!token) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'token is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Fetch the reaction row by token
  const { data: reaction, error: reactionErr } = await supabase
    .from('gift_reactions')
    .select('id, gift_id, contributor_name, video_url, submitted_at')
    .eq('token', token)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (reactionErr || !reaction) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Reaction token not found' }) };
  }

  // Fetch the parent gift for display context
  const { data: gift, error: giftErr } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('recipient_name, sender_name')
    .eq('id', reaction.gift_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (giftErr || !gift) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Gift not found' }) };
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      gift_id: reaction.gift_id,
      reaction_id: reaction.id,
      recipient_name: gift.recipient_name,
      sender_name: gift.sender_name,
      contributor_name: reaction.contributor_name,
      already_submitted: !!reaction.submitted_at,
    }),
  };
};

// GET /.netlify/functions/get-reactions?gift_id=<uuid>
//
// Called by gift.html after reveal to check if there are squad reactions to display.
// Only returns submitted (video_url != null) reactions.
//
// Returns: { reactions: [{ contributor_name, video_url }] }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const gift_id = event.queryStringParameters && event.queryStringParameters.gift_id;
  if (!gift_id) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_id is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: reactions, error } = await supabase
    .from('gift_reactions')
    .select('contributor_name, video_url, submitted_at')
    .eq('gift_id', gift_id)
    .not('video_url', 'is', null)
    .order('submitted_at', { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    console.error('get-reactions: fetch error:', error.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }) };
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      // Allow gift.html to fetch this from any origin (same domain in prod, but helps local dev)
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      reactions: (reactions || []).map((r) => ({
        contributor_name: r.contributor_name || 'Friend',
        video_url: r.video_url,
      })),
    }),
  };
};

// GET /.netlify/functions/get-scrapbook?id=<gift_id>  (Run 5)
// Returns the scrapbook JSON for scrapbook.html. Reads scrapbook_data JSONB from
// the digital_sends row. Never returns phone numbers or sender contact info.
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

async function _process(id, supabase) {
  if (!id) return { statusCode: 400, body: { error: 'missing_id' } };
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('id, gift_type, recipient_name, sender_name, scrapbook_data')
    .eq('id', id).single();
  if (error || !data) return { statusCode: 404, body: { error: 'not_found' } };
  if (data.gift_type !== 'digital_scrapbook' || !data.scrapbook_data) return { statusCode: 404, body: { error: 'not_a_scrapbook' } };
  const sd = data.scrapbook_data;
  return { statusCode: 200, body: { book: {
    title: sd.title, page_count: sd.page_count,
    recipient_name: data.recipient_name, sender_name: data.sender_name,
    pages: Array.isArray(sd.pages) ? sd.pages.map(function (p) { return { chapter: p.chapter, note: p.note, photo_urls: p.photo_urls || [] }; }) : []
  } } };
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=60' };
  const id = (event.queryStringParameters || {}).id;
  try {
    const res = await _process(id, getSupabaseAdmin());
    return { statusCode: res.statusCode, headers, body: JSON.stringify(res.body) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('get-scrapbook fatal:', e && e.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'server_error' }) };
  }
};

module.exports._process = _process;

// GET /.netlify/functions/get-share-clip-status?job_id=<uuid>
//
// Polled by gift.html after create-share-clip-job.js while the clip is
// generating. Returns status + the R2 URL once clip-scheduler.js finishes it.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const jobId = event.queryStringParameters && event.queryStringParameters.job_id;
  if (!jobId) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'job_id is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const { data: job, error } = await supabase
    .from('share_clip_jobs')
    .select('id, status, output_url, error_message')
    .eq('id', jobId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error || !job) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Job not found' }) };
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      status: job.status,
      output_url: job.output_url || null,
      error: job.status === 'failed' ? (job.error_message || 'Generation failed') : null,
    }),
  };
};



=====================================================
FILE: netlify\functions\gift-scheduler.js
=====================================================

// netlify/functions/gift-scheduler.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs every 2 minutes automatically.
// No HTTP trigger, no user action needed; Netlify's infrastructure calls it.
//
// HOW IT WORKS:
//   1. Looks in `digital_sends` for rows where status='pending',
//      condition_met=true and scheduled_at <= now.
//   2. Generates the SEALED card image for the send (see below).
//   3. Fires the WhatsApp message or the delivery email.
//   4. Marks the row 'sent', or retries, or gives up and alerts admin.
//
// Netlify runs cron in UTC — midnight IST = 18:30 UTC. Buyers pick
// "midnight IST" in the UI and checkout converts to UTC before saving.
//
// This function runs with the service-role Supabase key, so it can read and
// update digital_sends regardless of RLS.
//
// ── WHAT CHANGED AND WHY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// THE CARD SENT OUT IS NOW THE SEALED VARIANT.
// resolveCardImageUrl() used to pass `message: send.personal_message` to
// generate-card-image.js, which painted the sender's message onto the PNG.
// That PNG was then embedded in the delivery email and attached to the
// WhatsApp message — so the entire surprise was legible in the inbox preview
// thumbnail and on the recipient's lock screen, before they opened anything.
// Removing the message block from the email template alone would NOT have
// fixed this; the leak was in the image.
//
// There are now two images per send:
//   teaser_image_url — sealed, no message. Email + WhatsApp. Generated here.
//   card_image_url   — full, message included. gift.html and the share clip
//                      only. Generated lazily on first reveal, NOT here, so
//                      the full card never exists at delivery time.
//
// THE WHATSAPP BODY NO LONGER CONTAINS THE MESSAGE either, for the same
// reason — a WhatsApp notification preview is as public as an inbox preview.
// The template name and its parameter COUNT are unchanged, so no Meta
// re-approval is needed; only the string content is now a teaser.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendGiftMessage, sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
const { sendEmail, adminSendFailedEmail, buyerSendFailedEmail, giftDeliveryEmail, giftLabelFor } = require('./_lib/resend');

// WhatsApp template names — approve these in Meta Business Manager →
// WhatsApp Manager → Message Templates.
const TEMPLATE_GIFT_DELIVERED_SENDER = 'gift_delivered_sender_notify';

// How many sends to process per run. Safety cap so a campus rep placing 200
// orders at once cannot burst the provider APIs.
const BATCH_SIZE = 20;

// A failed send retries this many times — transient API/network issues should
// not cost someone their gift — before giving up and alerting admin.
// See schema-scheduler-hardening.sql for the reasoning.
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;

/**
 * Generates (or reuses) the SEALED card image for a send.
 *
 * Shared by both channels. The URL is persisted so a retry does not
 * regenerate, and so whichever channel runs second for a `both`-delivery
 * order reuses the same image instead of paying for generation twice.
 *
 * A generation failure is NOT fatal: an email with no image is still a
 * working gift link, whereas failing the send would delay the gift. The
 * fallback is a static asset, never the full card.
 */
async function resolveSealedCardUrl(supabase, send, siteUrl) {
  if (send.teaser_image_url) return send.teaser_image_url;

  try {
    // Squad Memory Board (#21) composites uploaded photos via Sharp — a
    // different endpoint from the SVG card generator, since it has no
    // message-card layout to render, only photos.
    const isMemoryBoard = send.gift_type === 'squad_memory_board';
    const genEndpoint = isMemoryBoard ? 'compose-memory-board' : 'generate-card-image';

    const genBody = isMemoryBoard
      ? {
          photo_urls: send.photo_urls || [],
          vibe_key: send.vibe_key || 'squad_memory_board',
          recipient_name: send.recipient_name,
          sender_name: send.sender_name,
          // Deliberately empty: the memory board is delivered sealed too.
          message: '',
          sub_heading: send.occasion,
          order_id: send.order_id,
        }
      : {
          variant: 'sealed',          // ← the whole point. No message painted on.
          vibe_key: send.vibe_key || 'confetti_pop',
          recipient_name: send.recipient_name,
          sender_name: send.sender_name,
          order_id: send.order_id,
          gift_type: send.gift_type,
          sub_heading: send.occasion,
          // The uploaded recipient photo never used to reach the card
          // generator, which is why a gift with a photo still arrived as a
          // plain card. It is composited by Sharp in generate-card-image.js.
          photo_url: send.recipient_photo_url || null,
          // NOTE: `message` is intentionally absent. generate-card-image.js
          // defaults to variant 'sealed' and ignores message on that path,
          // but not sending it at all means it cannot leak even if that
          // default ever changes.
        };

    const cardRes = await fetch(`${siteUrl}/.netlify/functions/${genEndpoint}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(genBody),
    });

    if (!cardRes.ok) {
      const detail = await cardRes.text().catch(() => '');
      // A 500 here is usually the font guard in _lib/cardFonts.js refusing to
      // render blank text. Log it loudly — silently mailing a textless card is
      // exactly the failure mode that guard exists to prevent.
      console.warn(`gift-scheduler: sealed card generation failed for ${send.id} (${cardRes.status}) ${detail.slice(0, 300)}`);
      return `${siteUrl}/og-image.png`;
    }

    const cardData = await cardRes.json();
    const imageUrl = cardData.url;
    await supabase.from('digital_sends').update({ teaser_image_url: imageUrl }).eq('id', send.id);
    return imageUrl;
  } catch (cardErr) {
    console.warn(`gift-scheduler: sealed card generation error for ${send.id}:`, cardErr.message);
    return `${siteUrl}/og-image.png`;
  }
}

/**
 * The one-line teaser that goes in the WhatsApp template body.
 *
 * Meta rejects a template body parameter containing newlines, tabs or 4+
 * consecutive spaces. _lib/whatsapp.js sanitizes as a safety net, but
 * building it flat here keeps the bubble readable instead of silently
 * squashed. It contains the gift TYPE and the link — never the message.
 */
function whatsappTeaser(send, giftUrl) {
  const who  = send.sender_name ? send.sender_name : 'Someone';
  const name = send.recipient_name ? `${send.recipient_name}, ` : '';
  // Emotion-first, single line (Meta rejects newlines in a template body var).
  return `${name}${who} made something just for you \uD83D\uDC9B  Sound on \uD83D\uDD0A \u2014 tap to open: ${giftUrl}`;
}

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  // Group 3 guards:
  //   condition_met = true → condition-based gifts (#23) only fire once the
  //                          sender has confirmed via the WhatsApp keyword.
  //   is_time_capsule rows are ordinary scheduled rows whose scheduled_at is
  //   simply years out. No special filter needed; they fire when due.
  const { data: pendingSends, error: fetchError } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('*')
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .eq('condition_met', true)
    .lte('scheduled_at', now)
    .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(BATCH_SIZE);

  if (fetchError) {
    console.error('gift-scheduler: fetch error:', fetchError.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: fetchError.message };
  }

  if (!pendingSends || pendingSends.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Nothing to send.' };
  }

  console.log(`gift-scheduler: processing ${pendingSends.length} sends`);

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    pendingSends.map((send) => processSend(supabase, send))
  );

  const sent = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;
  console.log(`gift-scheduler: sent=${sent} failed=${failed}`);

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ processed: pendingSends.length, sent, failed }) };
};

async function processSend(supabase, send) {
  const isCapsule = !!send.is_time_capsule;
  const sendLabel = isCapsule ? `[TIME CAPSULE] send ${send.id}` : `send ${send.id}`;

  try {
    const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';
    const giftUrl = `${siteUrl}/gift.html?id=${send.id}`;
    const channel = send.channel || 'whatsapp';
    let messageId = null;

    const sealedImageUrl = await resolveSealedCardUrl(supabase, send, siteUrl);

    if (channel === 'whatsapp') {
      let result;
      try {
        result = await sendGiftMessage({
          recipientPhone: send.recipient_phone,
          senderName: send.sender_name,
          // Teaser only. This string lands on a lock screen.
          personalMessage: whatsappTeaser(send, giftUrl),
          occasion: send.occasion,
          imageUrl: sealedImageUrl,
          // Only used if the approved template has a dynamic URL button.
          giftUrl,
        });
      } catch (waErr) {
        // ── WhatsApp -> Email fallback ──────────────────────────────────────
        // _lib/whatsapp.js now marks an error `.terminal` when no amount of
        // retrying will help: a paused template, a revoked token, a number
        // that is not on WhatsApp. Retrying those three more times just delays
        // the gift by six minutes and then loses it entirely.
        //
        // A gift is emotional cargo with a deadline. If we hold an email
        // address for this recipient, deliver there NOW rather than fail --
        // arriving by the wrong channel beats not arriving.
        if (waErr.terminal && send.recipient_email) {
          console.warn(`gift-scheduler: WhatsApp permanently failed for ${sendLabel} (${waErr.message}) -- falling back to email`);
          return await deliverByEmail(supabase, send, giftUrl, sealedImageUrl, {
            fallbackReason: `whatsapp_terminal: ${waErr.message}`.slice(0, 400),
          });
        }
        throw waErr;
      }

      messageId = result.messageId;

      // Notify the sender that the gift was delivered (Feature 4).
      if (send.sender_phone) {
        try {
          await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
            recipientPhone: send.sender_phone,
            templateName: TEMPLATE_GIFT_DELIVERED_SENDER,
            bodyVariables: [
              send.recipient_name,
              send.scheduled_at
                ? new Date(send.scheduled_at).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }) + ' IST'
                : 'now',
            ],
          });
        } catch (notifyErr) {
          // Non-fatal — never fail a delivered gift because a courtesy ping failed.
          console.warn(`gift-scheduler: sender delivery notify failed for ${sendLabel}:`, notifyErr.message);
        }
      }
    } else if (channel === 'email') {
      return await deliverByEmail(supabase, send, giftUrl, sealedImageUrl, {});
    }

    await updateSend(
      supabase,
      send.id,
      {
        status: 'sent',
        sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        provider_message_id: messageId,
        // Stored for both channels. It used to be WhatsApp-only, so an
        // emailed recipient's row had no record of the link the mail pointed at.
        gift_url: giftUrl,
      },
      {
        // 'sent' here means "Meta accepted it", NOT "the phone buzzed".
        // whatsapp-webhook.js upgrades this to delivered/read, or flips it to
        // failed, when Meta sends the receipt. Without this the admin
        // delivery-health numbers were pure optimism.
        wa_status: 'sent',
        wa_status_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }
    );

    console.log(`gift-scheduler: delivered ${sendLabel} via ${channel}`);
    return { id: send.id, status: 'sent' };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`gift-scheduler: failed to deliver ${sendLabel}:`, err.message);

    const attempts = (send.attempts || 0) + 1;
    const giveUp = attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS;

    await supabase
      .from('digital_sends')
      // A retryable failure goes back to 'pending' — picked up again next
      // tick by the same query, no special-casing needed. Only the FINAL
      // attempt is terminal.
      .update({
        status: giveUp ? 'failed' : 'pending',
        attempts,
        error_message: err.message,
      })
      .eq('id', send.id);

    if (giveUp) {
      console.error(`gift-scheduler: ${sendLabel} gave up after ${attempts} attempts — alerting admin`);
      try {
        const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL;
        if (adminEmail) {
          await sendEmail({
            to: adminEmail,
            subject: `Gift delivery failed permanently — ${send.id}`,
            html: adminSendFailedEmail(send, err.message, attempts),
          });
        } else {
          console.warn('gift-scheduler: ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL not set — failure alert not sent anywhere.');
        }
      } catch (alertErr) {
        // Do not let a failed alert mask the original failure.
        console.error('gift-scheduler: failure alert email itself failed:', alertErr.message);
      }

      // ── TELL THE BUYER ────────────────────────────────────────────────
      // Until now the ONLY notification on permanent failure went to
      // ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL -- and if that env var was unset, nowhere at all.
      // The person who paid for a midnight birthday surprise was never told
      // it had not arrived; they found out from the recipient, or never.
      //
      // This is the single worst customer-experience gap in the digital
      // pipeline, because it turns a recoverable delivery problem (usually a
      // wrong number) into a silent, unrecoverable disappointment.
      //
      // Guarded by buyer_notified_at so a re-queue or a manual retry that
      // fails again cannot email the same person twice. Entirely non-fatal:
      // the original delivery error is what matters and must still surface.
      try {
        if (!send.buyer_notified_at) {
          const { data: order } = await supabase
            .from('orders')
            .select('order_number, contact_name, contact_email')
            .eq('id', send.order_id)
            .maybeSingle();

          if (order && order.contact_email) {
            await sendEmail({
              to: order.contact_email,
              subject: `We could not deliver your gift — order ${order.order_number}`,
              html: buyerSendFailedEmail(order, send, process.env.SITE_URL),
            });
            // Best-effort stamp. If the column is missing (migration not yet
            // applied) this logs and moves on rather than throwing.
            const { error: stampErr } = await supabase
              .from('digital_sends')
              .update({ buyer_notified_at: new Date().toISOString() })
              .eq('id', send.id);
            if (stampErr) {
              console.warn(`gift-scheduler: buyer_notified_at not stamped (${stampErr.message}) — run 70_pipeline_fixes.sql`);
            }
            console.log(`gift-scheduler: buyer ${order.contact_email} notified about failed ${sendLabel}`);
          } else {
            console.warn(`gift-scheduler: no buyer email on order ${send.order_id} — cannot notify them of the failure`);
          }
        }
      } catch (buyerErr) {
        console.error('gift-scheduler: buyer failure notification failed:', buyerErr.message);
      }
    }

    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Updates a digital_sends row, tolerating a database that has not had
 * 50_whatsapp_delivery.sql applied yet.
 *
 * `corePatch` uses only columns that have always existed. `optionalPatch`
 * carries the new WhatsApp receipt columns. We try both together; if Postgres
 * rejects the write because a column is missing, we retry with the core patch
 * alone. The delivery itself has already happened at this point, so failing to
 * record it would mean re-sending the same gift on the next tick -- far worse
 * than losing a status field.
 */
async function updateSend(supabase, id, corePatch, optionalPatch) {
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .update({ ...corePatch, ...(optionalPatch || {}) })
    .eq('id', id);

  if (!error) return;

  console.warn(`gift-scheduler: update with WhatsApp receipt columns failed for ${id} (${error.message}) -- retrying without them. Run supabase/consolidated/50_whatsapp_delivery.sql.`);
  const { error: coreErr } = await supabase.from('digital_sends').update(corePatch).eq('id', id);
  if (coreErr) {
    console.error(`gift-scheduler: core update failed for ${id}:`, coreErr.message);
  }
}

/**
 * Delivers a send over email and marks the row 'sent'.
 *
 * Used by BOTH the ordinary email channel and the WhatsApp terminal-failure
 * fallback, so the two paths cannot drift apart -- previously the email logic
 * lived inline in the WhatsApp-or-email branch and there was no fallback at all.
 *
 * @param {object} opts
 * @param {string} [opts.fallbackReason] - set when we arrived here because
 *        WhatsApp permanently failed. Recorded so the admin view can show
 *        "delivered, but not on the channel the buyer chose".
 */
async function deliverByEmail(supabase, send, giftUrl, sealedImageUrl, { fallbackReason } = {}) {
  // An email row with no address can only ever fail at the provider, and
  // failing there costs four retries and an admin alert before anyone finds
  // out. Catch it here with a message that says what is wrong.
  if (!send.recipient_email) {
    throw new Error('email delivery requested but send has no recipient_email');
  }

  // Subject, HTML and plain text all come from the one template, so the
  // subject line cannot drift out of sync with the gift type.
  const { subject, html, text } = giftDeliveryEmail({
    send,
    giftUrl,
    cardImageUrl: sealedImageUrl,   // sealed -- never the full card
  });

  const result = await sendEmail({ to: send.recipient_email, subject, html, text });

  // sendEmail() returns { skipped: true } instead of throwing when
  // RESEND_API_KEY is absent. Without this check the row was still marked
  // 'sent' -- so a missing or rotated API key silently swallowed every gift,
  // permanently, with the database insisting they had all been delivered.
  if (result && result.skipped) {
    throw new Error('RESEND_API_KEY not configured -- email was not sent');
  }

  await updateSend(
    supabase,
    send.id,
    {
      status: 'sent',
      sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      provider_message_id: (result && result.id) || 'email-sent',
      gift_url: giftUrl,
      // The row now genuinely went out over email, so make the channel honest.
      channel: 'email',
    },
    fallbackReason ? { fallback_reason: fallbackReason } : null
  );

  console.log(`gift-scheduler: delivered send ${send.id} via email${fallbackReason ? ' (WhatsApp fallback)' : ''}`);
  return { id: send.id, status: 'sent', channel: 'email', fellBack: !!fallbackReason };
}

module.exports.resolveSealedCardUrl = resolveSealedCardUrl;
module.exports.whatsappTeaser = whatsappTeaser;
module.exports.deliverByEmail = deliverByEmail;

// ============================================================================
// ZIVOGIFT — mark-gift-opened.js  (Run 2: analytics-aware)
// gift.html already POSTs here twice per gift:
//   { gift_id, stage: 'opened' }                    when the envelope is tapped
//   { gift_id, stage: 'completed', mode: '<mode>' } when the reveal finishes
// This delegates to the atomic record_gift_open() RPC (see supabase/02_functions.sql).
//
// ⚠️ IF your current mark-gift-opened.js ALSO does other things (notify sender,
// write an events log, flip status), copy that block into the marked section so
// it is preserved. This drop-in only handles the analytics write.
// ============================================================================
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');

const supabase = createClient(process.env.SUPABASE_URL, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }) };
  }
  let body;
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); }
  catch { return { statusCode: 400, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'bad_json' }) }; }

  const giftId = body.gift_id;
  const stage  = body.stage === 'completed' ? 'completed' : 'opened';
  const mode   = typeof body.mode === 'string' ? body.mode.slice(0, 32) : null;

  if (!giftId || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(giftId)) {
    return { statusCode: 400, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'invalid_gift_id' }) };
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('record_gift_open', {
      p_gift_id: giftId, p_stage: stage, p_mode: mode,
    });
    if (error) {
      console.error('record_gift_open error:', error.message);
      // Non-fatal: the reveal must never break because analytics failed.
      return { statusCode: 200, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: false }) };
    }

    // ── PRESERVE EXISTING SIDE-EFFECTS HERE (e.g. notify-original-sender) ────

    return { statusCode: 200, headers, body: JSON.stringify(data || { ok: true }) };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('mark-gift-opened fatal:', e);
    return { statusCode: 200, headers, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: false }) };
  }
};

FILE: netlify\functions\notify-original-sender.js
=====================================================

// POST /.netlify/functions/notify-original-sender
//
// Called from the cashfree-webhook when an order has ref='gift_reply'
// AND reply_token is present in the order metadata.
//
// This function looks up the real_sender_phone from reply_tokens (server-side only)
// and notifies them that their anonymous gift received a reply.
//
// Body: { reply_token, recipient_name }   (recipient of the REPLY gift = original sender's name)
// Returns: { ok: true }
//
// PRIVACY: The real_sender_phone is never exposed outside this function.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');

// Meta WhatsApp template to approve:
//   Name:     gift_reply_received
//   Category: UTILITY
//   Body:     "🎁 Someone replied to your anonymous Zivogift! Check your gift — a surprise is on its way. 🌟"
//   (No variables needed — the reply is itself the notification)
const TEMPLATE_REPLY_RECEIVED = process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REPLY_RECEIVED || 'gift_reply_received';

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { reply_token, recipient_name } = body;

  if (!reply_token) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'reply_token is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Look up the real sender phone via token — never exposed in client-side code
  const { data: tokenRow, error: tokenErr } = await supabase
    .from('reply_tokens')
    .select('real_sender_phone, used, gift_id')
    .eq('token', reply_token)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (tokenErr || !tokenRow) {
    console.warn('notify-original-sender: token not found:', reply_token);
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Token not found' }) };
  }

  if (tokenRow.used) {
    // Already notified — idempotent; don't double-send
    return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true, already: true }) };
  }

  const senderPhone = tokenRow.real_sender_phone;

  // Send WhatsApp notification to the original anonymous sender
  try {
    await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
      recipientPhone: senderPhone,
      templateName: TEMPLATE_REPLY_RECEIVED,
      bodyVariables: [recipient_name || 'Someone'],
    });
    console.log(`notify-original-sender: notified ${senderPhone} for token ${reply_token}`);
  } catch (whatsappErr) {
    // Non-fatal — log and continue
    console.warn('notify-original-sender: WhatsApp notify failed:', whatsappErr.message);
  }

  // Mark token as used (one notification per reply)
  await supabase
    .from('reply_tokens')
    .update({ used: true })
    .eq('token', reply_token);

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true }),
  };
};



=====================================================
FILE: netlify\functions\notify-status-update.js
=====================================================

// POST /.netlify/functions/notify-status-update
// Called by the admin panel right after it updates an order's status directly
// in Supabase (allowed by RLS for admins). This function's only job is to
// send the customer an email — it re-verifies the caller is an admin first.
//
// Body: { orderId, newStatus, note }
const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendEmail, statusUpdateEmail } = require('./_lib/resend');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const authHeader = event.headers.authorization || event.headers.Authorization;
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return { statusCode: 401, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing auth token' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const token = authHeader.slice(7);
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await supabase.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) {
    return { statusCode: 401, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid session' }) };
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('is_admin')
    .eq('id', userData.user.id)
    .single();
  if (!profile?.is_admin) {
    return { statusCode: 403, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Admin access required' }) };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }
  const { orderId, newStatus, note } = body;
  if (!orderId || !newStatus) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'orderId and newStatus are required' }) };
  }

  const { data: order, error: orderErr } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', orderId)
    .single();
  if (orderErr || !order) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Order not found' }) };
  }

  try {
    await sendEmail({
      to: order.contact_email,
      subject: `Update on order ${order.order_number} — Zivogift`,
      html: statusUpdateEmail(order, newStatus, note),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return { statusCode: 502, body: JSON.stringify({ error: e.message }) };
  }

  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ sent: true }) };
};

// netlify/functions/occasion-scheduler.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs once daily at 08:00 IST (02:30 UTC).
//
// FEATURE #13 — Occasion Intelligence — Smart Reminders.
// Zivogift knows when a college's exam window, placement season, freshers
// week, or graduation is coming up (college_calendar, fed by campus reps and
// approved by an admin — see submit-college-event.js). Every morning this
// checks for events starting within the next NUDGE_WINDOW_DAYS days and nudges
// any user who has a friend saved at that college, linking straight into the
// studio with the right gift type pre-selected.
//
// DEDUPLICATION: occasion_notify_log has a UNIQUE (event_id, user_id, friend_id)
// constraint — each sender gets nudged once per event, ever.
//
// NETLIFY SETUP (add to netlify.toml):
//   [functions."occasion-scheduler"]
//     schedule = "30 2 * * *"   # 02:30 UTC = 08:00 IST every day
//
// REQUIRED WHATSAPP TEMPLATE (approve in Meta Business Manager):
//   zg_occasion_nudge — body {{1}}=sender_name {{2}}=friend_name {{3}}=event_label {{4}}=deep_link

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
// An occasion nudge is PROMOTIONAL, so it must honour marketing_optouts --
// see _lib/suppression.js for why this is not optional.
const { loadSuppressionSet, isSuppressed } = require('./_lib/suppression');
const { guardSchedulers } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');

const NUDGE_WINDOW_DAYS = 5;
const TEMPLATE_OCCASION_NUDGE = process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_OCCASION_NUDGE || 'zg_occasion_nudge';

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const siteUrl   = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';

  // Respect the Emergency tab's "Pause EVERYTHING" switch.
  const halted = await guardSchedulers(supabase, 'occasion-scheduler');
  if (halted) return halted;

  const suppression = await loadSuppressionSet(supabase);
  let suppressed = 0;

  const today = new Date();
  const windowEnd = new Date(today.getTime() + NUDGE_WINDOW_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const todayStr     = today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const windowEndStr = windowEnd.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // 1. Find active events starting within the nudge window.
  const { data: events, error: evErr } = await supabase
    .from('college_calendar')
    .select('*')
    .eq('active', true)
    .gte('start_date', todayStr)
    .lte('start_date', windowEndStr);

  if (evErr) {
    console.error('occasion-scheduler: event fetch error:', evErr.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: evErr.message }) };
  }

  let sent = 0, failed = 0, skipped = 0;

  for (const ev of (events || [])) {
    // 2. Find friends saved at this college (case-insensitive partial match —
    //    reps and users don't always type the college name identically).
    const { data: friends, error: frErr } = await supabase
      .from('friends')
      .select('id, user_id, name, phone, college, last_vibe_key')
      .ilike('college', `%${ev.college_name}%`);

    if (frErr) { console.error('occasion-scheduler: friends fetch error:', frErr.message); continue; }

    for (const friend of (friends || [])) {
      try {
        // Skip if already nudged for this exact event
        const { data: already } = await supabase
          .from('occasion_notify_log')
          .select('id').eq('event_id', ev.id).eq('user_id', friend.user_id)
          .eq('friend_id', friend.id).maybeSingle();
        if (already) { skipped++; continue; }

        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from('profiles').select('phone, full_name').eq('id', friend.user_id).maybeSingle();
        const senderPhone = normalisePhone(profile?.phone);
        if (!senderPhone) { skipped++; continue; }
        if (isSuppressed(suppression, { phone: profile?.phone })) { suppressed++; continue; }

        const deepLink = `${siteUrl}/digital-studio.html?type=${encodeURIComponent(ev.gift_type_hint)}` +
          `&recipientName=${encodeURIComponent(friend.name)}` +
          (friend.phone ? `&recipientPhone=${encodeURIComponent(friend.phone)}` : '') +
          (friend.last_vibe_key ? `&vibeKey=${encodeURIComponent(friend.last_vibe_key)}` : '');

        const copy = ev.nudge_copy || defaultNudgeCopy(ev.event_type, ev.event_label);

        await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
          recipientPhone: senderPhone,
          templateName: TEMPLATE_OCCASION_NUDGE,
          bodyVariables: [profile?.full_name || 'Hey', friend.name, copy, deepLink],
        });

        await supabase.from('occasion_notify_log').insert({
          event_id: ev.id, user_id: friend.user_id, friend_id: friend.id,
        }).throwOnError();

        sent++;
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.code === '23505') { skipped++; continue; } // dedupe race, harmless
        console.error(`occasion-scheduler: nudge failed for friend ${friend.id}:`, err.message);
        failed++;
      }
    }
  }

  const summary = {
    events_checked: (events || []).length, sent, failed, skipped,
    suppressed,
    suppression_list_readable: suppression.ok,
  };
  console.log('occasion-scheduler complete:', JSON.stringify(summary));
  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify(summary) };
};

function defaultNudgeCopy(eventType, label) {
  const templates = {
    exams:         `${label} is coming up`,
    placements:    `Placement season is here — ${label}`,
    freshers_week: `Freshers week is starting — ${label}`,
    graduation:    `Graduation is near — ${label}`,
    fest:          `${label} is happening soon`,
    other:         label,
  };
  return templates[eventType] || label;
}

function normalisePhone(raw) {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const digits = String(raw).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 10 && /^[6-9]/.test(digits)) return '91' + digits;
  if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91'))  return digits;
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('0'))   return '91' + digits.slice(1);
  return null;
}

FILE: netlify\functions\reminder-scheduler.js

// netlify/functions/reminder-scheduler.js
//
// A Netlify SCHEDULED FUNCTION — runs once daily at 7:30 AM IST (02:00 UTC).
//
// WHAT IT DOES (Group 3, Features #10 + #19):
//   Feature #10 — Birthday Reminder + One-Click Re-order
//     Finds friends whose birthday falls within the next N days (default 3).
//     Sends the gift-giver a WhatsApp nudge with a deep-link back into the
//     studio pre-filled with the friend's name, phone, and last vibe.
//
//   Feature #19 — Friendship Anniversary Auto-Card
//     Finds friends whose friendship_start_date anniversary falls within the
//     next 7 days.
//     Sends the gift-giver a WhatsApp nudge with a pay link so they can send
//     a no-fuss anniversary card.
//
// DEDUPLICATION:
//   We write to reminder_log (friend_id, reminder_type, sent_for_year) with a
//   UNIQUE constraint. If the scheduler fires twice in a day (e.g. a retry),
//   the second insert fails silently — no double sends.
//   We also update last_birthday_reminder_sent_for / last_anniversary_reminder_sent_for
//   on the friends row as a fast in-memory guard.
//
// NETLIFY SETUP (add to netlify.toml):
//   [functions."reminder-scheduler"]
//     schedule = "0 2 * * *"   # 02:00 UTC = 07:30 IST every day
//
// REQUIRED ENV VARS (same as gift-scheduler):
//   WHATSAPP_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, SITE_URL
//
// REQUIRED WHATSAPP TEMPLATES (approve in Meta Business Manager):
//   zg_birthday_reminder   — body {{1}}=sender_name {{2}}=friend_name {{3}}=days_away {{4}}=deep_link
//   zg_anniversary_nudge   — body {{1}}=sender_name {{2}}=friend_name {{3}}=years {{4}}=pay_link

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');
// Marketing suppression + global kill switch. A birthday/anniversary nudge is
// PROMOTIONAL (unsolicited, recurring, drives a repeat purchase), so it must
// honour marketing_optouts. Before this, an unsubscribed customer kept being
// nudged from this cron even though campaigns correctly excluded them.
const { loadSuppressionSet, isSuppressed } = require('./_lib/suppression');
const { guardSchedulers } = require('./_lib/adminSettings');

const TEMPLATE_BIRTHDAY_REMINDER  = 'zg_birthday_reminder';
const TEMPLATE_ANNIVERSARY_NUDGE  = 'zg_anniversary_nudge';
// Generic reminder for user-defined Special Days (graduation, promotion, exam,
// wedding, etc). Approve in Meta Business Manager with the SAME 4-variable
// shape as zg_birthday_reminder so no code change is needed if you reword it:
//   zg_special_day_reminder — {{1}}=sender_name {{2}}=friend_name
//                              {{3}}=occasion (e.g. "Graduation") {{4}}=deep_link
const TEMPLATE_SPECIAL_DAY_REMINDER = 'zg_special_day_reminder';

// Display names for the occasion keys the account UI stores. Keep in sync with
// OCCASIONS in js/account-group3.js.
const OCCASION_LABELS = {
  birthday: 'Birthday', anniversary: 'Anniversary', work_anniversary: 'Work Anniversary',
  wedding: 'Wedding', engagement: 'Engagement', graduation: 'Graduation',
  promotion: 'Promotion', new_job: 'New Job', exam: 'Exam / Result Day',
  house_warming: 'House Warming', baby: 'New Baby', farewell: 'Farewell', custom: 'Special Day',
};

exports.handler = async () => {
  const supabase  = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const siteUrl   = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';

  // Respect the Emergency tab's "Pause EVERYTHING" switch. This cron had no
  // knowledge of the settings table, so that button did not actually stop it.
  const halted = await guardSchedulers(supabase, 'reminder-scheduler');
  if (halted) return halted;

  // Loaded ONCE per invocation and checked in memory -- the opt-out list is
  // small, and one query per candidate would be needless load.
  const suppression = await loadSuppressionSet(supabase);
  let suppressed = 0;

  // Current date in IST (UTC+5:30)
  const nowUtc    = new Date();
  const istOffset = 330 * 60 * 1000;
  const nowIST    = new Date(nowUtc.getTime() + istOffset);

  const todayM    = nowIST.getUTCMonth() + 1;  // 1-12
  const todayD    = nowIST.getUTCDate();         // 1-31
  const thisYear  = nowIST.getUTCFullYear();

  let birthdaySent = 0, birthdayFailed = 0;
  let anniversarySent = 0, anniversaryFailed = 0;

  // ── FEATURE #10: Birthday Reminders ──────────────────────────────────────

  // Pull all friends with birthday reminders enabled who haven't been reminded
  // yet this year. We fetch the full set and filter in JS — birthday_date is a
  // `date` column whose year component is arbitrary (we only care about MM-DD).
  const { data: birthdayFriends, error: bErr } = await supabase
    .from('friends')
    .select('id, user_id, name, phone, last_vibe_key, birthday_date, remind_before_days, last_birthday_reminder_sent_for')
    .eq('birthday_reminders_enabled', true)
    .not('birthday_date', 'is', null);

  if (bErr) {
    console.error('reminder-scheduler: birthday fetch error:', bErr.message);
  } else {
    const birthdayCandidates = (birthdayFriends || []).filter((f) => {
      // Skip if already reminded this year
      if (f.last_birthday_reminder_sent_for === thisYear) return false;

      const bdate   = new Date(f.birthday_date);
      const bM      = bdate.getUTCMonth() + 1;
      const bD      = bdate.getUTCDate();
      const daysAway = daysUntilNextOccurrence(bM, bD, todayM, todayD, thisYear);
      const window  = f.remind_before_days ?? 3;

      // Fire when the birthday is exactly `window` days away
      return daysAway === window;
    });

    for (const friend of birthdayCandidates) {
      try {
        // Look up the sender's profile phone
        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('phone, full_name')
          .eq('id', friend.user_id)
          .maybeSingle();

        const senderPhone = profile?.phone;
        if (!senderPhone) {
          console.warn(`reminder-scheduler: no phone for user ${friend.user_id} — skip birthday nudge`);
          continue;
        }
        if (isSuppressed(suppression, { phone: senderPhone })) {
          suppressed++;
          continue;
        }

        const bdate    = new Date(friend.birthday_date);
        const bM       = bdate.getUTCMonth() + 1;
        const bD       = bdate.getUTCDate();
        const daysAway = daysUntilNextOccurrence(bM, bD, todayM, todayD, thisYear);

        // Deep link into studio pre-filled: name, phone, last vibe
        const deepLink = buildStudioDeepLink(siteUrl, {
          recipientName: friend.name,
          recipientPhone: friend.phone,
          vibeKey: friend.last_vibe_key,
        });

        const e164Sender = normalisePhone(senderPhone);
        if (!e164Sender) {
          console.warn(`reminder-scheduler: bad sender phone for user ${friend.user_id}`);
          continue;
        }

        await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
          recipientPhone: e164Sender,
          templateName:   TEMPLATE_BIRTHDAY_REMINDER,
          bodyVariables: [
            profile?.full_name || 'Hey',
            friend.name,
            String(daysAway),
            deepLink,
          ],
        });

        // Dedupe — insert into reminder_log (UNIQUE constraint catches double sends)
        await supabase.from('reminder_log').insert({
          friend_id:        friend.id,
          reminder_type:    'birthday',
          sent_for_year:    thisYear,
        }).throwOnError();

        // Also update the fast guard on the friends row
        await supabase.from('friends')
          .update({ last_birthday_reminder_sent_for: thisYear })
          .eq('id', friend.id);

        birthdaySent++;
        console.log(`reminder-scheduler: birthday nudge sent for friend ${friend.name} (${friend.id})`);
      } catch (err) {
        // reminder_log insert will throw on duplicate — that's fine, just skip
        if (err.code === '23505') {
          console.log(`reminder-scheduler: birthday duplicate skipped for ${friend.id}`);
        } else {
          console.error(`reminder-scheduler: birthday nudge failed for ${friend.id}:`, err.message);
          birthdayFailed++;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ── FEATURE #19: Friendship Anniversary Nudges ───────────────────────────

  const { data: anniversaryFriends, error: aErr } = await supabase
    .from('friends')
    .select('id, user_id, name, friendship_start_date, last_anniversary_reminder_sent_for')
    .eq('anniversary_reminders_enabled', true)
    .not('friendship_start_date', 'is', null);

  if (aErr) {
    console.error('reminder-scheduler: anniversary fetch error:', aErr.message);
  } else {
    const ANNIVERSARY_WINDOW_DAYS = 7;

    const anniversaryCandidates = (anniversaryFriends || []).filter((f) => {
      if (f.last_anniversary_reminder_sent_for === thisYear) return false;

      const adate   = new Date(f.friendship_start_date);
      const aM      = adate.getUTCMonth() + 1;
      const aD      = adate.getUTCDate();
      const daysAway = daysUntilNextOccurrence(aM, aD, todayM, todayD, thisYear);

      // Don't remind on year-0 (the same year the friendship started)
      const friendshipYears = thisYear - adate.getUTCFullYear();
      return daysAway === ANNIVERSARY_WINDOW_DAYS && friendshipYears >= 1;
    });

    for (const friend of anniversaryCandidates) {
      try {
        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('phone, full_name')
          .eq('id', friend.user_id)
          .maybeSingle();

        const senderPhone = profile?.phone;
        if (!senderPhone) {
          console.warn(`reminder-scheduler: no phone for user ${friend.user_id} — skip anniversary nudge`);
          continue;
        }
        if (isSuppressed(suppression, { phone: senderPhone })) {
          suppressed++;
          continue;
        }

        const adate          = new Date(friend.friendship_start_date);
        const friendshipYears = thisYear - adate.getUTCFullYear();

        // Pay link — sends them straight to a pre-built cart for a birthday_note
        const payLink = `${siteUrl}/studio.html?type=birthday_note&recipientName=${encodeURIComponent(friend.name)}`;

        const e164Sender = normalisePhone(senderPhone);
        if (!e164Sender) continue;

        await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
          recipientPhone: e164Sender,
          templateName:   TEMPLATE_ANNIVERSARY_NUDGE,
          bodyVariables: [
            profile?.full_name || 'Hey',
            friend.name,
            String(friendshipYears),
            payLink,
          ],
        });

        await supabase.from('reminder_log').insert({
          friend_id:     friend.id,
          reminder_type: 'anniversary',
          sent_for_year: thisYear,
        }).throwOnError();

        await supabase.from('friends')
          .update({ last_anniversary_reminder_sent_for: thisYear })
          .eq('id', friend.id);

        anniversarySent++;
        console.log(`reminder-scheduler: anniversary nudge sent for friend ${friend.name} (${friend.id})`);
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.code === '23505') {
          console.log(`reminder-scheduler: anniversary duplicate skipped for ${friend.id}`);
        } else {
          console.error(`reminder-scheduler: anniversary nudge failed for ${friend.id}:`, err.message);
          anniversaryFailed++;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ── FEATURE: User-defined Special Days ───────────────────────────────────
  // A third pass over friend_special_dates. Each row carries its own
  // remind_before_days window and dedupes in reminder_log using the special
  // date's id inside reminder_type (friend_id stays the real friend so the
  // existing FK holds). Mirrors the birthday/anniversary passes exactly.
  let specialSent = 0, specialFailed = 0;

  const { data: specialDates, error: sErr } = await supabase
    .from('friend_special_dates')
    .select('id, user_id, friend_id, occasion_type, label, event_date, remind_before_days, last_reminder_sent_for')
    .eq('reminders_enabled', true)
    .not('event_date', 'is', null);

  if (sErr) {
    console.error('reminder-scheduler: special-dates fetch error:', sErr.message);
  } else {
    const specialCandidates = (specialDates || []).filter((d) => {
      if (d.last_reminder_sent_for === thisYear) return false;
      const dt   = new Date(d.event_date);
      const m    = dt.getUTCMonth() + 1;
      const day  = dt.getUTCDate();
      const win  = Number.isFinite(d.remind_before_days) ? d.remind_before_days : 3;
      return daysUntilNextOccurrence(m, day, todayM, todayD, thisYear) === win;
    });

    for (const sd of specialCandidates) {
      try {
        // Need the friend's name + the owner's phone.
        const { data: friend } = await supabase
          .from('friends').select('name').eq('id', sd.friend_id).maybeSingle();
        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from('profiles').select('phone, full_name').eq('id', sd.user_id).maybeSingle();

        const senderPhone = profile?.phone;
        if (!senderPhone || !friend) {
          console.warn(`reminder-scheduler: missing phone/friend for special date ${sd.id} — skip`);
          continue;
        }
        if (isSuppressed(suppression, { phone: senderPhone })) {
          suppressed++;
          continue;
        }
        const e164Sender = normalisePhone(senderPhone);
        if (!e164Sender) continue;

        const occasion = sd.occasion_type === 'custom'
          ? (sd.label || 'Special Day')
          : (OCCASION_LABELS[sd.occasion_type] || 'Special Day');

        const deepLink = `${siteUrl}/studio.html?recipientName=${encodeURIComponent(friend.name)}`;

        await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
          recipientPhone: e164Sender,
          templateName:   TEMPLATE_SPECIAL_DAY_REMINDER,
          bodyVariables: [ profile?.full_name || 'Hey', friend.name, occasion, deepLink ],
        });

        // Dedup: friend_id = real friend, reminder_type carries the date id so
        // two different special days for one friend never collide.
        await supabase.from('reminder_log').insert({
          friend_id:     sd.friend_id,
          reminder_type: 'special:' + sd.id,
          sent_for_year: thisYear,
        }).throwOnError();

        await supabase.from('friend_special_dates')
          .update({ last_reminder_sent_for: thisYear })
          .eq('id', sd.id);

        specialSent++;
        console.log(`reminder-scheduler: special-day (${occasion}) nudge sent for friend ${friend.name}`);
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.code === '23505') {
          console.log(`reminder-scheduler: special-day duplicate skipped for ${sd.id}`);
        } else {
          console.error(`reminder-scheduler: special-day nudge failed for ${sd.id}:`, err.message);
          specialFailed++;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const summary = {
    birthday:     { sent: birthdaySent,     failed: birthdayFailed },
    anniversary:  { sent: anniversarySent,  failed: anniversaryFailed },
    special:      { sent: specialSent,      failed: specialFailed },
    // Surfaced so a sudden jump in opt-outs is visible in the function log
    // rather than only as a quiet drop in sends.
    suppressed,
    suppression_list_readable: suppression.ok,
  };
  console.log('reminder-scheduler complete:', JSON.stringify(summary));
  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify(summary) };
};

// ── HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Returns how many days until the next occurrence of a MM-DD anniversary,
 * looking forward from today. Returns 0 on the day itself.
 */
function daysUntilNextOccurrence(targetM, targetD, todayM, todayD, thisYear) {
  // Build Date objects in UTC to avoid DST edge cases
  const todayDate  = Date.UTC(thisYear, todayM - 1, todayD);
  let targetYear   = thisYear;
  let target       = Date.UTC(targetYear, targetM - 1, targetD);

  // If the date already passed this year, use next year's occurrence
  if (target < todayDate) {
    targetYear++;
    target = Date.UTC(targetYear, targetM - 1, targetD);
  }

  return Math.round((target - todayDate) / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
}

/**
 * Normalise a phone to E.164 without leading '+' (Meta Cloud API format).
 * Accepts: '9876543210', '09876543210', '+919876543210', '919876543210'.
 */
function normalisePhone(raw) {
  const digits = String(raw).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 10 && /^[6-9]/.test(digits)) return '91' + digits;
  if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91'))  return digits;
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('0'))   return '91' + digits.slice(1);
  return null; // unrecognised — caller should skip
}

/**
 * Build a studio deep link with name, phone, and vibe pre-filled.
 * gift-sender clicks this → lands directly on step 2 with fields populated
 * (studio.js reads these params on DOMContentLoaded — see studio-group3.js).
 */
function buildStudioDeepLink(siteUrl, { recipientName, recipientPhone, vibeKey }) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (recipientName)  params.set('recipientName', recipientName);
  if (recipientPhone) params.set('recipientPhone', recipientPhone);
  if (vibeKey)        params.set('vibeKey', vibeKey);
  return `${siteUrl}/studio.html?${params.toString()}`;
}

FILE: netlify\functions\rep-apply.js
=====================================================

// POST /.netlify/functions/rep-apply
//
// Feature #20 — Campus Rep Micro-Affiliate Network.
// Requires a logged-in Supabase session (so the dashboard later can just be
// "show me my own campus_reps row" under RLS — no separate rep auth needed).
//
// Body: { fullName, college, phone, yearOfStudy, socialHandle, upiId }
// Generates a unique ref_code like 'rohit-vit' (name + college initials +
// random suffix if taken), inserts a `pending` campus_reps row. Admin
// approves from admin.html → status flips to 'approved' and the rep's link
// starts earning commission immediately (checkout already reads ?rep=<code>
// regardless of approval status, but the admin panel highlights pending reps
// for review — you can also gate commission crediting to approved-only by
// checking status in cashfree-webhook.js, which this build does).

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const { sendEmail, escapeHtml } = require('./_lib/resend');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  const token = (event.headers.authorization || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return json(401, { error: 'Please log in first' });

  const supabaseUser = createClient(
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL,
    process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    { global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } }
  );
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await supabaseUser.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) return json(401, { error: 'Invalid session' });

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); } catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }); }

  const { fullName, college, phone, yearOfStudy, socialHandle, upiId } = body;
  if (!fullName || !fullName.trim()) return json(400, { error: 'Full name is required' });
  if (!college || !college.trim())   return json(400, { error: 'College is required' });
  if (!phone || !String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '').length) return json(400, { error: 'Phone is required' });

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Already applied?
  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from('campus_reps').select('id, ref_code, status').eq('user_id', user.id).maybeSingle();
  if (existing) return json(200, { rep: existing, alreadyApplied: true });

  const refCode = await generateUniqueRefCode(supabase, fullName, college);

  const { data: rep, error } = await supabase
    .from('campus_reps')
    .insert({
      user_id: user.id,
      ref_code: refCode,
      full_name: fullName.trim(),
      college: college.trim(),
      phone: String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10),
      year_of_study: yearOfStudy || null,
      social_handle: socialHandle || null,
      upi_id: upiId || null,
      status: 'pending',
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });
    // The application is already stored. Email failure must not create a duplicate submission.
  try {
    const adminEmail = process.env.CAMPUS_REP_NOTIFY_EMAIL || 'hello@zivogift.com';
    const e = value => escapeHtml(String(value || 'Not provided').trim());
    await sendEmail({
      to: adminEmail,
      subject: `New Campus Rep application: ${String(fullName).trim()} - ${String(college).trim()}`,
      replyTo: user.email || undefined,
      html: `<h2>New Campus Rep application</h2><p><strong>Name:</strong> ${e(fullName)}</p><p><strong>College:</strong> ${e(college)}</p><p><strong>Phone:</strong> ${e(phone)}</p><p><strong>Login email:</strong> ${e(user.email)}</p><p><strong>Year:</strong> ${e(yearOfStudy)}</p><p><strong>Social:</strong> ${e(socialHandle)}</p><p><strong>UPI:</strong> ${e(upiId)}</p><p><strong>Reference:</strong> ${e(rep && rep.ref_code)}</p><p>Status: pending review.</p>`,
      text: `New Campus Rep application\nName: ${fullName}\nCollege: ${college}\nPhone: ${phone}\nLogin email: ${user.email || 'Not provided'}\nYear: ${yearOfStudy || 'Not provided'}\nSocial: ${socialHandle || 'Not provided'}\nUPI: ${upiId || 'Not provided'}\nReference: ${(rep && rep.ref_code) || 'Pending'}\nStatus: pending review.`
    });
  } catch (mailErr) {
    console.error('Campus Rep admin notification failed:', mailErr);
  }

return json(200, { rep });
};

async function generateUniqueRefCode(supabase, fullName, college) {
  const first = slug(fullName.split(/\s+/)[0] || 'rep');
  const collegeSlug = slug((college.match(/[A-Za-z]+/g) || ['campus']).slice(0, 2).join('-'));
  let base = `${first}-${collegeSlug}`.slice(0, 40);
  let candidate = base;
  let suffix = 0;

  while (true) {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('campus_reps').select('id').eq('ref_code', candidate).maybeSingle();
    if (!data) return candidate;
    suffix++;
    candidate = `${base}-${suffix}`;
  }
}

function slug(s) {
  return String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '') || 'zg';
}

function json(status, body) {
  return { statusCode: status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) };
}

// GET /.netlify/functions/resolve-reply-token?token=<uuid>
//
// Called by digital-studio.html when loaded with ?reply_token= in the URL.
// Returns ONLY the persona display info — NEVER the real sender phone.
// The real phone stays locked in the reply_tokens table, server-side only.
//
// Returns: { persona_display_name, persona_emoji, gift_id }
//          or { error } if token is invalid/used.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

// Must match js/personas.js
const PERSONA_INFO = {
  the_mystery:    { display_name: 'The Mystery',    emoji: '🕵️' },
  the_romantic:   { display_name: 'The Romantic',   emoji: '🌹' },
  the_chaos_agent:{ display_name: 'The Chaos Agent',emoji: '😈' },
  the_ghost:      { display_name: 'The Ghost',      emoji: '👻' },
};

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  const token = event.queryStringParameters && event.queryStringParameters.token;
  if (!token) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'token is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Look up the token
  const { data: row, error } = await supabase
    .from('reply_tokens')
    .select('gift_id, used')
    .eq('token', token)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error || !row) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Token not found' }) };
  }

  // Fetch the gift to get persona info (we never return the real phone)
  const { data: gift, error: giftErr } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .select('persona_key, recipient_name, sender_name')
    .eq('id', row.gift_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (giftErr || !gift) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Gift not found' }) };
  }

  const persona = PERSONA_INFO[gift.persona_key] || { display_name: 'Someone Special', emoji: '🎁' };

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      persona_display_name: persona.display_name,
      persona_emoji: persona.emoji,
      persona_key: gift.persona_key,
      gift_id: row.gift_id,
      // Include recipient name so studio can pre-fill "sending to [persona name]"
      // display. We do NOT return real_sender_phone.
      original_recipient_name: gift.recipient_name,
    }),
  };
};

FILE: netlify\functions\send-reaction-invites.js
=====================================================

// POST /.netlify/functions/send-reaction-invites
//
// Called from digitalSendsHelper.js when gift_type = 'squad_drop'.
// For each contributor phone:
//   1. Creates a row in gift_reactions (token generated by Supabase DEFAULT)
//   2. Sends a WhatsApp invite via Meta Cloud API
//
// Body: { gift_id, recipient_name, sender_name, contributors: [{ phone, name }] }
// Returns: { ok: true, sent: N }
//
// Uses Promise.all for parallel WhatsApp sends — must complete under 3 seconds.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { sendWhatsAppTemplate } = require('./_lib/whatsapp');

// Meta WhatsApp template to approve in Meta Business Manager:
//   Name:     squad_reaction_invite
//   Category: UTILITY
//   Header:   IMAGE (the gift card image)
//   Body:     "Hey {{1}}! 🎬 {{2}} is gifting {{3}} — record your 3-sec reaction and be part of their surprise wall! Tap: {{4}}"
//   Variables: {{1}} = contributor name, {{2}} = sender name, {{3}} = recipient name, {{4}} = react URL
const TEMPLATE_REACTION_INVITE = process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REACTION_INVITE || 'squad_reaction_invite';

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { gift_id, recipient_name, sender_name, contributors, card_image_url } = body;

  if (!gift_id) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_id is required' }) };
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(contributors) || contributors.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'contributors array is required' }) };
  }

  const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com';
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Build reaction rows to insert in one batch
  const reactionRows = contributors
    .filter((c) => c && c.phone)
    .slice(0, 8) // Hard cap at 8
    .map((c) => ({
      gift_id,
      contributor_name: c.name || 'Friend',
      contributor_phone: String(c.phone).replace(/\D/g, ''),
      // token is generated by Supabase DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
    }));

  if (reactionRows.length === 0) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'No valid contributor phones' }) };
  }

  // Insert all rows and get back the generated tokens
  const { data: insertedRows, error: insertErr } = await supabase
    .from('gift_reactions')
    .insert(reactionRows)
    .select('id, token, contributor_phone, contributor_name');

  if (insertErr) {
    console.error('send-reaction-invites: insert error:', insertErr.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: insertErr.message }) };
  }

  // Send WhatsApp invites in parallel
  const sendResults = await Promise.allSettled(
    insertedRows.map(async (row) => {
      const reactUrl = `${siteUrl}/react.html?token=${row.token}`;
      await sendWhatsAppTemplate({
        recipientPhone: row.contributor_phone,
        templateName: TEMPLATE_REACTION_INVITE,
        bodyVariables: [
          row.contributor_name || 'Friend',
          sender_name || 'Someone',
          recipient_name || 'their friend',
          reactUrl,
        ],
        imageUrl: card_image_url || null,
      });
    })
  );

  const sent = sendResults.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
  const failed = sendResults.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected').length;

  if (failed > 0) {
    sendResults.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (r.status === 'rejected') {
        console.warn(`send-reaction-invites: invite failed for row ${i}:`, r.reason?.message);
      }
    });
  }

  console.log(`send-reaction-invites: gift=${gift_id} sent=${sent} failed=${failed}`);

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true, sent, failed }),
  };
};

// POST /.netlify/functions/store-reaction
//
// Stores an emoji reaction from the gift recipient.
// Body: { gift_id, emoji }
// Returns: { ok: true }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { gift_id, emoji } = body;
  if (!gift_id || !emoji) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'gift_id and emoji are required' }) };
  }

  const ALLOWED_EMOJIS = ['❤️', '😭', '😂', '🔥', '🥹', '👑'];
  if (!ALLOWED_EMOJIS.includes(emoji)) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid emoji' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('digital_sends')
    .update({ reaction: emoji, reacted_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('id', gift_id);

  if (error) {
    console.error('store-reaction error:', error.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }) };
  }

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true }),
  };
};

// POST /.netlify/functions/submit-college-event
//
// Feature #13 — Occasion Intelligence, fed by campus reps (Feature #20).
// An approved campus rep tells us their college's exam window, placement
// season, freshers week, or graduation date. Inserted as `active:false` —
// admin.html reviews and flips it live so a rep can't spam nudges.
//
// Body: { collegeName, collegeDomain?, state?, eventType, eventLabel,
//          startDate, endDate?, giftTypeHint }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');

const VALID_EVENT_TYPES = ['exams', 'placements', 'freshers_week', 'graduation', 'fest', 'other'];
const VALID_GIFT_TYPES  = ['hype_reel', 'farewell_note', 'birthday_note', 'meme_card', 'midnight_drop', 'exam_survival_kit'];

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') return json(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' });

  const token = (event.headers.authorization || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim();
  if (!token) return json(401, { error: 'Please log in first' });

  const supabaseUser = createClient(
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL,
    process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    { global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } }
  );
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await supabaseUser.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) return json(401, { error: 'Invalid session' });

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: rep } = await supabase
    .from('campus_reps').select('id, status').eq('user_id', user.id).maybeSingle();
  if (!rep) return json(403, { error: 'You need to be a Campus Rep to submit events. Apply first.' });
  if (rep.status !== 'approved') return json(403, { error: 'Your rep application is still pending approval.' });

  let body = {};
  try { body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}'); } catch { return json(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }); }

  const { collegeName, collegeDomain, state, eventType, eventLabel, startDate, endDate, giftTypeHint } = body;
  if (!collegeName || !collegeName.trim()) return json(400, { error: 'College name is required' });
  if (!VALID_EVENT_TYPES.includes(eventType)) return json(400, { error: 'Invalid event type' });
  if (!eventLabel || !eventLabel.trim()) return json(400, { error: 'Event label is required' });
  if (!startDate) return json(400, { error: 'Start date is required' });

  const { data: row, error } = await supabase
    .from('college_calendar')
    .insert({
      college_name: collegeName.trim(),
      college_domain: collegeDomain || null,
      state: state || null,
      event_type: eventType,
      event_label: eventLabel.trim(),
      start_date: startDate,
      end_date: endDate || null,
      gift_type_hint: VALID_GIFT_TYPES.includes(giftTypeHint) ? giftTypeHint : 'hype_reel',
      submitted_by_rep: rep.id,
      active: false,
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) return json(500, { error: error.message });
  return json(200, { event: row, note: 'Submitted — an admin will review and activate it.' });
};

function json(status, body) {
  return { statusCode: status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) };
}

// POST /.netlify/functions/submit-reaction
//
// Called by react.html after the contributor has uploaded their video to R2.
// Updates the gift_reactions row with the video URL and timestamps it.
//
// Body: { token, video_url, duration_ms }
// Returns: { ok: true }

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./_lib/supabaseAdmin');

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'POST') {
    return { statusCode: 405, body: 'Method Not Allowed' };
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(event.body || '{}');
  } catch {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }) };
  }

  const { token, video_url, duration_ms } = body;

  if (!token) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'token is required' }) };
  }
  if (!video_url) {
    return { statusCode: 400, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'video_url is required' }) };
  }

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  // Verify token exists and is not already submitted
  const { data: reaction, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
    .from('gift_reactions')
    .select('id, submitted_at')
    .eq('token', token)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (fetchErr || !reaction) {
    return { statusCode: 404, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Reaction token not found' }) };
  }

  if (reaction.submitted_at) {
    // Idempotent — already submitted
    return {
      statusCode: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true, already: true }),
    };
  }

  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from('gift_reactions')
    .update({
      video_url,
      submitted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('id', reaction.id);

  if (updateErr) {
    console.error('submit-reaction: update error:', updateErr.message);
    return { statusCode: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: updateErr.message }) };
  }

  console.log(`submit-reaction: reaction ${reaction.id} submitted with video ${video_url}`);

  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ok: true }),
  };
};
