// netlify/functions/_lib/numerologyHelper.js
//
// Feature #22 — "Your Note's Numerology" Upgrade.
// Fulfils the existing `addon_numerology` addon (already live on the site
// at ₹49 — this file is what actually generates the reading; previously
// the addon existed in the UI with nothing behind it). When an order item
// is a physical note/bundle with this addon attached and a recipient DOB,
// generates a styled single-page PDF numerology reading and returns it as
// a Buffer for emailing.
//
// The Life Path number is computed deterministically in code (dobUtils.js)
// and handed to Claude as a fact — the model writes the reading around a
// real number, it doesn't invent one.

const PDFDocument = require('pdfkit');
const { generateText } = require('./anthropicHelper');
const { serialDigitsFromDob, lifePathNumber } = require('./dobUtils');

const READING_SYSTEM_PROMPT =
  'You write numerology readings in the serious, warm register of an experienced astrologer — not comedic, ' +
  'not a horoscope-app throwaway. Given a recipient\'s name, their computed Life Path number, and the digit ' +
  'sequence encoded in their gifted note\'s serial number, write a ~220-word reading covering: what their Life ' +
  'Path number traditionally signifies, one or two grounded observations about how it might show up in their ' +
  'life, and a short closing paragraph on what the serial-encoded digits add to the reading (treat them as a ' +
  'secondary, reinforcing signal, not the main event). Write in second person, addressed to the recipient. ' +
  'Respond with ONLY the reading text, in 2-3 short paragraphs separated by a blank line — no title, no preamble.';

function fallbackReading(recipientName, lifePath, serialDigits) {
  return `Your Life Path number is ${lifePath} — in numerology, this is calculated from every digit of your ` +
    `birth date, reduced until a single core number remains. It's considered one of the most stable markers in ` +
    `a reading, less about what happens to you and more about the lens you tend to see things through.\n\n` +
    `People often find that the traits linked to their Life Path number show up quietly rather than dramatically ` +
    `— in how they make decisions, what they gravitate toward under pressure, what keeps pulling them back no ` +
    `matter how far they wander from it.\n\n` +
    `The note that came with this reading carries ${serialDigits} in its serial number — the same digits as your ` +
    `birth date. In numerology this is read as a reinforcing signal, not a separate story: a small, literal ` +
    `echo of the same number sitting in your pocket.`;
}

async function getReadingText(recipientName, lifePath, serialDigits) {
  try {
    const prompt = `Recipient name: ${recipientName}. Life Path number: ${lifePath}. ` +
      `Note serial-encoded digits (from their birth date): ${serialDigits}.`;
    return await generateText({ system: READING_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt, maxTokens: 500 });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('numerologyHelper: Claude generation failed, using fallback —', err.message);
    return fallbackReading(recipientName, lifePath, serialDigits);
  }
}

// Renders the reading into a styled single-page PDF, returns a Buffer.
function renderPdf({ recipientName, lifePath, serialDigits, denominationLabel, readingText }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const doc = new PDFDocument({ size: 'A5', margin: 0 });
      const chunks = [];
      doc.on('data', (c) => chunks.push(c));
      doc.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks)));
      doc.on('error', reject);

      const W = doc.page.width, H = doc.page.height;
      const gold = '#D4A017';
      const cream = '#FFF8E7';
      const dark = '#120e00';

      // Background
      doc.rect(0, 0, W, H).fill(dark);
      // Double-rule border
      doc.rect(20, 20, W - 40, H - 40).lineWidth(1.5).stroke(gold);
      doc.rect(28, 28, W - 56, H - 56).lineWidth(0.5).strokeOpacity(0.5).stroke(gold);
      doc.strokeOpacity(1);

      // Header
      doc.fillColor(gold).font('Helvetica-Bold').fontSize(11)
        .text('✦  YOUR NOTE\'S NUMEROLOGY  ✦', 40, 55, { width: W - 80, align: 'center', characterSpacing: 2 });

      doc.fillColor(cream).font('Helvetica').fontSize(9).fillOpacity(0.7)
        .text(`A reading for ${recipientName} — carried with your ${denominationLabel}`, 40, 78, { width: W - 80, align: 'center' });
      doc.fillOpacity(1);

      // Life path number — big circular badge
      const cx = W / 2, cy = 145, r = 34;
      doc.circle(cx, cy, r).lineWidth(1.5).stroke(gold);
      doc.circle(cx, cy, r - 8).lineWidth(0.5).strokeOpacity(0.4).stroke(gold);
      doc.strokeOpacity(1);
      doc.fillColor(gold).font('Helvetica-Bold').fontSize(30)
        .text(String(lifePath), cx - r, cy - 16, { width: r * 2, align: 'center' });
      doc.fillColor(cream).font('Helvetica').fontSize(7).fillOpacity(0.6)
        .text('LIFE PATH', cx - r, cy + 20, { width: r * 2, align: 'center', characterSpacing: 1 });
      doc.fillOpacity(1);

      // Reading body
      doc.fillColor(cream).font('Helvetica').fontSize(10.5).fillOpacity(0.92)
        .text(readingText, 46, 200, { width: W - 92, align: 'left', lineGap: 4 });
      doc.fillOpacity(1);

      // Serial digits footer note
      doc.fillColor(gold).font('Helvetica-Oblique').fontSize(8.5).fillOpacity(0.75)
        .text(`Serial-encoded digits: ${serialDigits}`, 40, H - 60, { width: W - 80, align: 'center' });
      doc.fillOpacity(1);

      doc.fillColor(cream).font('Helvetica').fontSize(8).fillOpacity(0.35)
        .text('Z I V O G I F T', 40, H - 38, { width: W - 80, align: 'center', characterSpacing: 3 });

      doc.end();
    } catch (err) {
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

// Main entry — item is an order_items row (product_id, recipient_name,
// recipient_dob, name_snapshot all present on it already).
async function buildNumerologyPdf(item) {
  const serialDigits = serialDigitsFromDob(item.recipient_dob);
  const lifePath = lifePathNumber(item.recipient_dob);
  if (!serialDigits || !lifePath) return null;

  const recipientName = item.recipient_name || 'them';
  const denominationLabel = item.name_snapshot || 'your note';
  const readingText = await getReadingText(recipientName, lifePath, serialDigits);
  const pdfBuffer = await renderPdf({ recipientName, lifePath, serialDigits, denominationLabel, readingText });

  return { buffer: pdfBuffer, recipientName, filename: `numerology-${recipientName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase()}.pdf` };
}

// Finds every order item that should get a numerology PDF: a note/bundle
// product with the addon_numerology addon attached and a DOB on file.
function findNumerologyItems(items) {
  return (items || []).filter((i) =>
    i.product_id &&
    (i.product_id.startsWith('note_') || i.product_id.startsWith('bundle_')) &&
    i.recipient_dob &&
    Array.isArray(i.addons) &&
    i.addons.some((a) => a.id === 'addon_numerology')
  );
}

module.exports = { buildNumerologyPdf, findNumerologyItems };

// netlify/functions/_lib/orderConfirmationEffects.js
//
// ROOT CAUSE this file fixes:
// Order confirmation (buyer email), the admin new-order alert, and the
// numerology PDF follow-up only ever lived inline inside
// cashfree-webhook.js's PAYMENT_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK handler. That's correct
// for a normally-paid order — Cashfree calls that webhook once payment
// clears. But create-cashfree-order.js has a SEPARATE branch for
// `total <= 0` (a 100%-off promo code) that "skips Cashfree entirely" —
// by design, since there's nothing to charge. That branch marks the order
// paid and schedules the digital gift sends, but it never ran any of the
// email logic, because that logic only existed inside the webhook handler
// that a ₹0 order never triggers. Any order paid down to ₹0 by a promo
// code — which is exactly how test/QA orders tend to get placed — silently
// never got a confirmation email, with no error anywhere to point at.
//
// Both the webhook and the free-order path now call the same function
// below, so they can't diverge like this again.

const { sendEmail, orderConfirmationEmail, adminNewOrderEmail, numerologyEmail } = require('./resend');
const { buildNoteStoryEmailSection } = require('./noteStoryHelper');
const { buildNumerologyPdf, findNumerologyItems } = require('./numerologyHelper');

async function sendOrderConfirmationEffects(supabase, order, items) {
  try {
    // Feature #14 — Currency Note Story Card: rides along in the same
    // confirmation email, zero extra send, zero cost increase.
    let noteStorySection = '';
    try {
      noteStorySection = await buildNoteStoryEmailSection(items || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Note story generation failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
    }

    await sendEmail({
      to: order.contact_email,
      subject: `Order ${order.order_number} confirmed — Zivogift`,
      html: orderConfirmationEmail(order, items || [], noteStorySection),
    });
    // Admin new-order alert. This used to be gated on ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL alone,
    // so if that env var was never set in Netlify the owner silently got no
    // alert on paid orders. Fall back to the verified sender address so the
    // alert always lands somewhere the owner controls; set ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL
    // to route it to a dedicated inbox instead.
    const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL
      || process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
      || 'orders@zivogift.com';
    if (adminEmail) {
      await sendEmail({
        to: adminEmail,
        subject: `New order ${order.order_number} — ₹${order.total}`,
        html: adminNewOrderEmail(order, items || []),
      });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Order confirmation email send failed:', e.message);
  }

  // Feature #22 — Numerology Upgrade.
  try {
    const numerologyItems = findNumerologyItems(items || []);
    for (const item of numerologyItems) {
      try {
        const pdf = await buildNumerologyPdf(item);
        if (!pdf) continue;
        await sendEmail({
          to: order.contact_email,
          subject: `Your numerology reading is ready — Zivogift 🔢`,
          html: numerologyEmail(order, pdf.recipientName),
          attachments: [{ filename: pdf.filename, content: pdf.buffer.toString('base64') }],
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(`Numerology PDF failed for item ${item.id}:`, e.message);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Numerology processing failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
  }
}

module.exports = { sendOrderConfirmationEffects };

// netlify/functions/_lib/phoneUtil.js
//
// Normalizes an Indian mobile number to E.164-without-'+' (e.g. '919876543210'),
// matching the exact convention already used across the codebase
// (reminder-scheduler.js, occasion-scheduler.js, studio-group2.js's '91'+phone).

function normalizePhone(raw) {
  const digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 10 && /^[6-9]/.test(digits)) return '91' + digits;
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('0')) return '91' + digits.slice(1);
  if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('91')) return digits;
  return null; // not a recognizable Indian mobile number
}

module.exports = { normalizePhone };

// netlify/functions/_lib/r2Client.js
//
// Shared Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible) upload helper. Used by
// generate-card-image.js and compose-memory-board.js so both functions
// share one place for the R2 client setup and env var checks.

const { S3Client, PutObjectCommand, HeadObjectCommand, DeleteObjectCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-s3');

function getR2Client() {
  const accountId  = process.env.R2_ACCOUNT_ID;
  const accessKey  = process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID;
  const secretKey  = process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY;
  if (!accountId || !accessKey || !secretKey) {
    throw new Error('Missing R2 env vars: R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: { accessKeyId: accessKey, secretAccessKey: secretKey },
  });
}

// Extracts the R2 object key from a public URL built by uploadBufferToR2 /
// get-media-upload-url.js (both do `${base}/${key}` — this reverses that).
function extractKeyFromPublicUrl(url) {
  try {
    const publicUrl = (process.env.R2_PUBLIC_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (publicUrl && url.startsWith(publicUrl)) {
      return url.slice(publicUrl.length + 1);
    }
    // Fallback: strip protocol+host, keep the path
    const u = new URL(url);
    return u.pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// HEAD request — returns the object's real size in bytes as reported by R2
// itself, not whatever the client claims. Used to enforce upload size limits
// server-side, since the presigned PUT URL this codebase uses has no
// built-in size constraint (unlike S3's presigned POST + content-length-range,
// which Cloudflare R2 has had inconsistent/incomplete support for — this
// approach uses only basic HEAD/DELETE, which R2 supports reliably).
async function getObjectSize(key) {
  const client = getR2Client();
  const bucketName = process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME;
  const res = await client.send(new HeadObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucketName, Key: key }));
  return res.ContentLength;
}

async function deleteObject(key) {
  const client = getR2Client();
  const bucketName = process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME;
  await client.send(new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: bucketName, Key: key }));
}

async function uploadBufferToR2(buffer, filename, contentType) {
  const accountId  = process.env.R2_ACCOUNT_ID;
  const bucketName = process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME;
  const accessKey  = process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID;
  const secretKey  = process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY;
  const publicUrl  = process.env.R2_PUBLIC_URL; // e.g. https://pub-xxx.r2.dev

  if (!accountId || !bucketName || !accessKey || !secretKey) {
    throw new Error('Missing R2 env vars: R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_BUCKET_NAME, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }

  const client = new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: { accessKeyId: accessKey, secretAccessKey: secretKey },
  });

  await client.send(new PutObjectCommand({
    Bucket: bucketName,
    Key: filename,
    Body: buffer,
    ContentType: contentType || 'image/png',
    CacheControl: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
  }));

  const base = (publicUrl || `https://${bucketName}.${accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`).replace(/\/$/, '');
  return `${base}/${filename}`;
}

module.exports = { uploadBufferToR2, getObjectSize, deleteObject, extractKeyFromPublicUrl };

// netlify/functions/_lib/resend.js
//
// Resend transactional email helper.
// Free tier: 3,000 emails/month forever. Paid from $20/mo for 50K.
//
// SETUP (one-time, ~10 minutes):
// 1. resend.com → create free account
// 2. Domains → Add Domain → zivogift.com → add the TXT + MX records Resend
//    gives you in Hostinger's DNS Zone Editor → Verify
// 3. API Keys → Create API Key (Full Access) → Netlify env: RESEND_API_KEY
// 4. RESEND_FROM_EMAIL = orders@zivogift.com (must match the verified domain)
// 5. ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL = where new-order and failure alerts go
//
// ── WHAT CHANGED AND WHY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// 1. ONE SHELL. Every customer-facing email used to build its own full HTML
//    document, so "the Zivogift email look" was defined four separate times
//    and had already drifted. emailShell() now owns the brand bar, the panel
//    and the footer; templates supply only their inner rows.
//
// 2. ONE PALETTE. VIBE_EMAIL_STYLES was a hand-copied fork of the card
//    generator's table — squad_memory_board and personal_message existed only
//    in the email copy, campus_legend and zivo_pass_gold only in the card
//    copy. Colours now come from js/vibe-tokens.js, shared with
//    generate-card-image.js, clipFrames.js and gift.html.
//
// 3. NO MESSAGE CONTENT. giftDeliveryEmail() used to render the sender's
//    personal message in a blockquote AND repeat it in the plain-text
//    alternative — so the whole surprise was visible in the inbox preview
//    before the recipient opened anything. Both are gone. The email's only
//    job now is: who it is from, what kind of gift it is, one button.
//    The card image it embeds is the SEALED variant (no message painted on
//    it); gift-scheduler.js is responsible for passing the right one.
//
// Why table + inline CSS: Outlook 2016/2019/365 on Windows renders mail
// through Microsoft Word, which ignores flexbox, most border-radius,
// background gradients and any surviving <style> block. Anything that must be
// right in every inbox is an attribute or an inline style on a <table>, and
// the CTA has a VML fallback so the button is still a button in Word.
//
// Animation: deliberately none. No mail client runs JS and Gmail strips
// @keyframes. The moving reveal lives on gift.html, which the CTA opens.

const { resolveVibe } = require('../../../js/vibe-tokens');

const RESEND_URL = 'https://api.resend.com/emails';

// ── ESCAPING ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Every template interpolates user-controlled data (contact name, recipient
// name, delivery notes) into an HTML string. Without escaping, anyone can put
// <img onerror=...> into any checkout field and have it render in whichever
// inbox opens the mail. Escape everything that is not a value this codebase
// generated itself (order numbers, totals, our own static copy).
function escapeHtml(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
  return String(value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

// ── TRANSPORT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// `headers` was added for marketing campaigns (_lib/campaignEmail.js). Gmail
// and Yahoo require List-Unsubscribe / List-Unsubscribe-Post on bulk mail --
// without them, bulk sends get throttled or junked no matter how good the
// content is. It is an OPTIONAL parameter and every existing caller that
// omits it behaves exactly as before.
async function sendEmail({ to, subject, html, text, attachments, replyTo, headers }) {
  const apiKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
  const fromEmail = process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL || 'orders@zivogift.com';
  const fromName = process.env.RESEND_FROM_NAME || 'Zivogift';

  if (!apiKey) {
    console.warn('RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping email send.');
    return { skipped: true };
  }

  const payload = {
    from: `${fromName} <${fromEmail}>`,
    to: [to],
    subject,
    html,
  };
  // Optional Reply-To — used by the contact form so a reply lands in the
  // visitor's inbox rather than the shared sender address.
  if (replyTo) payload.reply_to = replyTo;
  // A plain-text alternative is not cosmetic: multipart/alternative scores
  // materially better with spam filters than HTML-only, and it is the version
  // watches, screen readers and text-mode clients actually render.
  if (text) payload.text = text;
  if (Array.isArray(attachments) && attachments.length) {
    payload.attachments = attachments;
  }
  // Resend passes these straight through to the outgoing message.
  if (headers && typeof headers === 'object' && Object.keys(headers).length) {
    payload.headers = headers;
  }

  const res = await fetch(RESEND_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Resend send failed (${res.status}): ${body}`);
  }
  const data = await res.json();
  return { sent: true, id: data.id };
}

// Bulletproof CTA: VML rounded rectangle for Word-rendered Outlook, a real
// anchor for everything else.
function ctaButton(url, label, accent) {
  const safeUrl = escapeHtml(url);
  const safeLabel = escapeHtml(label);
  return `
                    <!--[if mso]>
                    <v:roundrect xmlns:v="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml" xmlns:w="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word" href="${safeUrl}" style="height:52px;v-text-anchor:middle;width:300px;" arcsize="50%" stroke="f" fillcolor="${accent}">
                      <w:anchorlock/>
                      <center style="color:#12100c;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;">${safeLabel}</center>
                    </v:roundrect>
                    <![endif]-->
                    <!--[if !mso]><!-- -->
                    <a href="${safeUrl}" target="_blank" style="display:inline-block;background:${accent};background-color:${accent};color:#12100c;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;line-height:52px;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;width:300px;max-width:300px;border-radius:26px;mso-hide:all;">${safeLabel}</a>
                    <!--<![endif]-->`;
}

// Small row helpers so templates read as content, not as table plumbing.
const row = {
  eyebrow: (text, accent) => `
                      <tr><td align="center" style="padding:0 0 10px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:${accent};">${text}</td></tr>`,
  headline: (text, color) => `
                      <tr><td align="center" class="zg-head" style="padding:0 0 10px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:28px;line-height:36px;font-weight:bold;color:${color};">${escapeHtml(text)}</td></tr>`,
  body: (html, align) => `
                      <tr><td align="${align || 'center'}" style="padding:0 0 20px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:23px;color:${BRAND.muted};">${html}</td></tr>`,
  image: (src, alt) => `
                      <tr><td align="center" style="padding:0 0 22px;"><img src="${escapeHtml(src)}" width="500" alt="${escapeHtml(alt)}" style="display:block;width:100%;max-width:500px;height:auto;border:0;outline:none;text-decoration:none;border-radius:14px;" /></td></tr>`,
  pill: (text, bg, color) => `
                      <tr><td align="center" style="padding:0 0 18px;"><table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0"><tr><td bgcolor="${bg}" style="background-color:${bg};border-radius:20px;padding:9px 18px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:${color};">${text}</td></tr></table></td></tr>`,
  cta: (url, label, accent) => `
                      <tr><td align="center" style="padding:0 0 8px;">${ctaButton(url, label, accent)}</td></tr>`,
  note: (html) => `
                      <tr><td align="center" style="padding:14px 0 0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:20px;color:${BRAND.muted};">${html}</td></tr>`,
  raw: (html) => html,
};

function orderItemFulfilmentHtml(item) {
  const sections = [];
  if (item.personalization_message) sections.push(`<div style="margin-top:5px;color:#5f5a52;"><strong>Customer note:</strong> &quot;${escapeHtml(item.personalization_message)}&quot;</div>`);
  const options = item.selected_options && typeof item.selected_options === 'object' ? item.selected_options : {};
  const keys = Object.keys(options);
  if (keys.length) sections.push(`<div style="margin-top:5px;color:#5f5a52;"><strong>Selected options:</strong><br>${keys.map((key) => `${escapeHtml(key)}: ${escapeHtml(options[key])}`).join('<br>')}</div>`);
  const addons = Array.isArray(item.addons) ? item.addons : [];
  if (addons.length) sections.push(`<div style="margin-top:5px;color:#7a4b00;"><strong>Add-ons to prepare:</strong><br>${addons.map((addon) => `${escapeHtml(addon.name || addon.id || 'Add-on')}${addon.price != null ? ` (+&#8377;${escapeHtml(addon.price)})` : ''}`).join('<br>')}</div>`);
  return sections.join('');
}

// ── ORDER CONFIRMATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function orderConfirmationEmail(order, items, extraSection) {
  const itemRows = items.map((i) =>
    `<tr>
      <td style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid ${BRAND.hairline};font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#cfcbc2;">${escapeHtml(i.name_snapshot)} &times; ${escapeHtml(i.qty)}${i.recipient_name ? ' &mdash; for ' + escapeHtml(i.recipient_name) : ''}${orderItemFulfilmentHtml(i)}</td>
      <td style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid ${BRAND.hairline};text-align:right;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:${BRAND.gold};font-weight:bold;">&#8377;${escapeHtml(i.line_total)}</td>
    </tr>`
  ).join('');

  const bodyRows =
    row.eyebrow('Order confirmed', BRAND.gold) +
    row.headline('Thanks, ' + (order.contact_name || 'there') + '!', BRAND.ink) +
    row.body(`Order <strong style="color:${BRAND.gold};font-family:monospace;">${escapeHtml(order.order_number)}</strong> is in. We are putting it together with care.`) +
    `
                      <tr><td style="padding:0 0 6px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0">${itemRows}</table></td></tr>
                      <tr><td style="padding:12px 0 0;border-top:1px solid ${BRAND.hairline};font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:${BRAND.ink};font-weight:bold;">Total paid
                        <span style="float:right;color:${BRAND.gold};font-size:17px;">&#8377;${escapeHtml(order.total)}</span></td></tr>` +
    row.body(order.address_line
      ? `Delivering to: ${escapeHtml(order.address_line)}, ${escapeHtml(order.city)}`
      : 'Delivered digitally &mdash; no shipping needed.', 'left') +
    (extraSection ? row.raw(`<tr><td style="padding:0 0 12px;">${extraSection}</td></tr>`) : '') +
    row.cta(`https://zivogift.com/order-status.html?order_number=${encodeURIComponent(order.order_number || '')}`, 'Track my order', BRAND.gold);

  return emailShell({
    title: `Order ${order.order_number} confirmed`,
    preheader: `Order ${order.order_number} is confirmed. We are putting it together.`,
    bodyRows,
  });
}

// ── STATUS UPDATE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function statusUpdateEmail(order, newStatus, note) {
  const labels = {
    processing: 'We are crafting your gift',
    packed: 'Your gift is packed',
    out_for_delivery: 'Out for delivery',
    delivered: 'Delivered!',
    cancelled: 'Order cancelled',
    refunded: 'Order refunded',
  };
  const title = labels[newStatus] || `Order update: ${String(newStatus || '').replace(/_/g, ' ')}`;

  const bodyRows =
    row.eyebrow('Order update', BRAND.gold) +
    row.headline(title, BRAND.ink) +
    row.body(`Hi ${escapeHtml(order.contact_name)}, here is an update on order <strong style="color:${BRAND.gold};font-family:monospace;">${escapeHtml(order.order_number)}</strong>.`) +
    (note ? `
                      <tr><td style="padding:0 0 20px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" bgcolor="${BRAND.panelAlt}" style="background-color:${BRAND.panelAlt};border-radius:12px;"><tr>
                        <td width="4" bgcolor="${BRAND.gold}" style="background-color:${BRAND.gold};width:4px;font-size:0;line-height:0;">&nbsp;</td>
                        <td style="padding:14px 16px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:22px;color:#cfcbc2;">${escapeHtml(note)}</td>
                      </tr></table></td></tr>` : '') +
    // ── Courier tracking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Previously this email told a customer their gift was "Out for
    // delivery" and then gave them no way to actually track it. Rendered
    // only when a tracking number exists, so every existing email without
    // one is byte-identical to before.
    (order.tracking_number ? `
                      <tr><td style="padding:0 0 20px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" bgcolor="${BRAND.panelAlt}" style="background-color:${BRAND.panelAlt};border-radius:12px;"><tr>
                        <td style="padding:14px 16px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:22px;color:#cfcbc2;">
                          <strong style="color:${BRAND.ink};">Tracking details</strong><br />
                          ${order.courier_name ? `Courier: ${escapeHtml(order.courier_name)}<br />` : ''}
                          Tracking number: <span style="font-family:monospace;color:${BRAND.gold};">${escapeHtml(order.tracking_number)}</span>
                          ${order.tracking_url ? `<br /><a href="${escapeHtml(order.tracking_url)}" style="color:${BRAND.gold};">Track this shipment &rarr;</a>` : ''}
                        </td>
                      </tr></table></td></tr>` : '') +
    row.cta(`https://zivogift.com/order-status.html?order_number=${encodeURIComponent(order.order_number || '')}`, 'Track my order', BRAND.gold);

  return emailShell({ title, preheader: `${title} — order ${order.order_number}`, bodyRows });
}

// ── BUYER: GIFT DELIVERY FAILED ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// The gap this closes: gift-scheduler.js gave up after MAX_ATTEMPTS and
// emailed ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL only -- and if that env var was unset, the
// failure went nowhere but a log line. The person who PAID for a midnight
// birthday surprise was never told it had not arrived. They found out from
// the recipient, days later, if at all.
//
// TONE: this email apologises, states plainly what happened, and tells them
// exactly what happens next. It deliberately does NOT reveal the technical
// error -- "Meta error 131047" helps nobody -- and it does not ask the buyer
// to do anything they cannot do.
function buyerSendFailedEmail(order, send, siteUrl) {
  const site = (siteUrl || 'https://zivogift.com').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const recipient = send.recipient_name || 'your recipient';
  const channel = send.channel === 'email' ? 'email' : 'WhatsApp';

  const bodyRows =
    row.eyebrow('Action needed', BRAND.coral) +
    row.headline("We could not deliver your gift", BRAND.ink) +
    row.body(
      `Hi ${escapeHtml(order.contact_name || 'there')}, we are sorry &mdash; we were unable to deliver your gift to ` +
      `<strong style="color:${BRAND.ink};">${escapeHtml(recipient)}</strong> over ${escapeHtml(channel)}, ` +
      `even after several attempts.`) +
    row.body(
      `The most common cause is a number that is not on WhatsApp, or a small typo in the contact details. ` +
      `<strong style="color:${BRAND.ink};">Your gift has not been lost</strong> &mdash; we still have it, and we can re-send it as soon as we have the right details.`) +
    `
                      <tr><td style="padding:0 0 20px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" bgcolor="${BRAND.panelAlt}" style="background-color:${BRAND.panelAlt};border-radius:12px;"><tr>
                        <td width="4" bgcolor="${BRAND.coral}" style="background-color:${BRAND.coral};width:4px;font-size:0;line-height:0;">&nbsp;</td>
                        <td style="padding:14px 16px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:22px;color:#cfcbc2;">
                          <strong>Order ${escapeHtml(order.order_number || '')}</strong><br />
                          For: ${escapeHtml(recipient)}<br />
                          Tried to send via: ${escapeHtml(channel)}
                        </td>
                      </tr></table></td></tr>` +
    row.body(
      `Just reply to this email with the correct WhatsApp number or email address, ` +
      `or message us on WhatsApp, and we will send it straight away.`) +
    row.cta(`${site}/contact.html`, 'Contact us', BRAND.coral) +
    row.note(`Or email <a href="mailto:hello@zivogift.com" style="color:${BRAND.gold};">hello@zivogift.com</a> &mdash; we read every one.`);

  return emailShell({
    title: 'We could not deliver your gift',
    preheader: `Your gift to ${recipient} did not go through — we can fix this.`,
    bodyRows,
    accent: BRAND.coral,
  });
}

// ── BUYER: ABANDONED CHECKOUT RECOVERY ──────────────────────────────────────
// Fires from abandoned-cart-scheduler.js for orders stuck in
// 'pending_payment'. These are people who chose a gift, filled in a delivery
// address and reached the payment page -- the highest-intent traffic the site
// ever sees -- and nothing followed up with them at all.
//
// This is transactional-adjacent (it refers to a specific order THEY started,
// not a broadcast offer), but it is still commercial, so it carries the same
// unsubscribe affordance as a campaign. The caller passes unsubscribeUrl.
function abandonedCheckoutEmail(order, items, siteUrl, unsubscribeUrl) {
  const site = (siteUrl || 'https://zivogift.com').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const list = (items || []).slice(0, 4).map((i) =>
    `<div style="margin-bottom:6px;">&bull; ${escapeHtml(i.name_snapshot)}${i.recipient_name ? ` &mdash; for ${escapeHtml(i.recipient_name)}` : ''}</div>`
  ).join('');

  const resumeUrl = `${site}/checkout.html?resume=${encodeURIComponent(order.order_number || '')}`;

  const bodyRows =
    row.eyebrow('Still there?', BRAND.gold) +
    row.headline('Your gift is still waiting', BRAND.ink) +
    row.body(
      `Hi ${escapeHtml(order.contact_name || 'there')}, you started an order with us but the payment did not go through. ` +
      `Nothing has been charged.`) +
    (list ? `
                      <tr><td style="padding:0 0 20px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" bgcolor="${BRAND.panelAlt}" style="background-color:${BRAND.panelAlt};border-radius:12px;"><tr>
                        <td style="padding:14px 16px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:22px;color:#cfcbc2;">${list}</td>
                      </tr></table></td></tr>` : '') +
    row.body(`Your details are saved &mdash; picking up where you left off takes about a minute.`) +
    row.cta(resumeUrl, 'Complete my order', BRAND.gold) +
    row.note(`If you changed your mind, no problem at all &mdash; you can ignore this email.`);

  const footerHtml =
    `Made with care at <a href="https://zivogift.com" style="color:#8a847b;text-decoration:underline;">zivogift.com</a>` +
    (unsubscribeUrl
      ? `<br /><br /><a href="${escapeHtml(unsubscribeUrl)}" style="color:#8a847b;text-decoration:underline;">Do not send me reminders like this</a>`
      : '');

  return emailShell({
    title: 'Your Zivogift order is still waiting',
    preheader: 'Your payment did not go through — nothing was charged.',
    bodyRows,
    footerHtml,
  });
}

  character_drop:     { emoji: '\uD83C\uDFAD', eyebrow: 'A mystery sender has appeared',      headline: (n) => `Someone has a message for you, ${n}`,       blurb: 'Their identity stays hidden \u2014 you can still reply.',              cta: 'Meet your sender' },

};

function giftCopyFor(giftType) {
  return GIFT_TYPE_COPY[giftType] || GIFT_TYPE_COPY.standard;
}

function giftLabelFor(giftType) {
  return GIFT_TYPE_LABELS[giftType] || GIFT_TYPE_LABELS.standard;
}

function articleFor(word) {
  return /^[aeiou]/i.test(String(word || '').trim()) ? 'an' : 'a';
}

/**
 * Builds the gift delivery email.
 *
 * @param {object} o
 * @param {object} o.send          the digital_sends row
 * @param {string} o.giftUrl       gift.html reveal link
 * @param {string} [o.cardImageUrl] MUST be the SEALED card variant. Passing
 *                 the full card here re-creates the leak this rewrite
 *                 removed, because the message would be painted onto the
 *                 image the inbox renders as a preview thumbnail.
 *
 * Returns { subject, html, text } — the caller passes all three to sendEmail
 * so the message goes out as multipart/alternative.
 */
function giftDeliveryEmail({ send, giftUrl, cardImageUrl }) {
  const giftType = send.gift_type || 'standard';
  const copy = giftCopyFor(giftType);
  const label = giftLabelFor(giftType);
  const vibe = resolveVibe(send.vibe_key, giftType);
  const occasion = send.occasion || 'Birthday';
  const recipient = send.recipient_name || 'Friend';
  const sender = send.sender_name || 'Someone special';
  const accent = vibe.accent;

  const isVideo = giftType === 'media_video' || send.media_type === 'video';
  const isAudio = giftType === 'media_audio' || send.media_type === 'audio';

  const headlineRaw = copy.headline(recipient, occasion);
  // The sender name is user-supplied and goes into a mail HEADER. Collapse
  // any newline or tab out of it: a CR/LF in a subject is header-injection
  // shaped, and even where the provider rejects it outright that turns into a
  // hard delivery failure on a gift that was otherwise fine.
  const safeSubjectSender = String(sender).replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 80);
  const subject = `${copy.emoji} ${safeSubjectSender} sent you ${articleFor(label)} ${label}`;
  // The preheader is the second thing an inbox shows. It is generic copy on
  // purpose — it used to be fine, but it sits right next to where the message
  // used to leak, so it is worth being explicit: nothing here is personalised
  // beyond the gift type.
  const preheader = `${copy.blurb} Open it before it gets cold.`;

  const cardBlock = cardImageUrl
    ? row.image(cardImageUrl, `${label} for ${recipient}`)
    : '';

  const mediaPill = (isVideo || isAudio)
    ? row.pill(isVideo ? '&#127916; A video message is waiting for you'
                       : '&#127911; A voice message is waiting for you',
               vibe.bg2, accent)
    : '';

  // Layout order is gift-type aware. A media gift leads with the play
  // affordance; everything else leads with the sealed card.
  const lead = (isVideo || isAudio) ? mediaPill + cardBlock : cardBlock + mediaPill;

  //
  // NOTE: there is deliberately NO message block here. The sender's personal
  // message is never rendered into this email, in any form — not as HTML, not
  // in the text alternative, not in the preheader, and not painted onto the
  // card image (gift-scheduler.js passes the sealed variant). The reveal is
  // the product; the email is only the knock at the door.
  //
  const bodyRows =
    row.eyebrow(`${copy.emoji} ${escapeHtml(copy.eyebrow)}`, accent) +
    row.headline(headlineRaw, vibe.text) +
    row.body(escapeHtml(copy.blurb)) +
    lead +
    row.cta(giftUrl, copy.cta, accent) +
    row.note(`Sent by <span style="color:${vibe.text};font-weight:bold;">${escapeHtml(sender)}</span> &middot; ${escapeHtml(label)}`);

  const html = emailShell({
    title: subject,
    preheader,
    bodyRows,
    panelBg: vibe.bg1,
    panelBg2: vibe.bg2,
    accent,
    footerHtml: `The full reveal &mdash; animation, sound and all &mdash; lives on the gift page.<br />
              Made with care at <a href="https://zivogift.com" style="color:#8a847b;text-decoration:underline;">zivogift.com</a>`,
  });

  const text = [
    copy.eyebrow.toUpperCase(),
    '',
    headlineRaw,
    copy.blurb,
    '',
    isVideo ? 'A video message is waiting for you.' : (isAudio ? 'A voice message is waiting for you.' : null),
    (isVideo || isAudio) ? '' : null,
    `${copy.cta}: ${giftUrl}`,
    '',
    `Sent by ${sender} \u2014 ${label}`,
    'Zivogift \u00b7 https://zivogift.com',
  ].filter((line) => line !== null).join('\n');

  return { subject, html, text };
}

module.exports = {
  sendEmail,
  emailShell,
  ctaButton,
  orderConfirmationEmail,
  adminNewOrderEmail,
  adminSendFailedEmail,
  adminPaymentFailedEmail,
  buyerSendFailedEmail,
  abandonedCheckoutEmail,
  contactMessageEmail,
  statusUpdateEmail,
  numerologyEmail,
  giftDeliveryEmail,
  giftLabelFor,
  giftCopyFor,
  escapeHtml,
  BRAND,
  GIFT_TYPE_LABELS,
  GIFT_TYPE_COPY,
};

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · roast-core.js  (Run 3 — pure, testable core of the AI Roast gift)
   1. buildRoastPrompt()   — strict Gemini prompt with safety rails.
   2. parseRoastResponse() — robustly extract roasts from real Gemini output
      (```json fences, "Sure! here you go" preambles, smart quotes, trailing
      commas, bare arrays) and strip unsafe lines; enforce >=3 clean lines.
   ============================================================================ */
'use strict';

var BANNED = ['suicide', 'kill yourself', 'kys', 'rape', 'terrorist', 'nigger', 'faggot', 'retard'];

function buildRoastPrompt(input) {
  input = input || {};
  var name  = String(input.name || 'my friend').slice(0, 60);
  var about = String(input.about || '').slice(0, 500);
  var tone  = ['savage', 'mild', 'wholesome'].indexOf(input.tone) >= 0 ? input.tone : 'savage';
  var count = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(input.count, 10) || 6, 3), 10);
  var toneLine = {
    savage: 'Punchy and savage but still affectionate — the kind of roast a close friend delivers with a grin.',
    mild: 'Gently teasing and warm — more fond than fierce.',
    wholesome: 'Barely a roast at all — compliments disguised as insults.'
  }[tone];

  return [
    'You are writing a playful roast for a close friend as a fun digital gift.',
    'Recipient name: ' + name + '.',
    about ? ('What we know about them: ' + about) : 'No extra details were given; keep it universal and relatable.',
    '', 'STYLE: ' + toneLine,
    'AUDIENCE: Indian college students / young professionals. Modern, relatable, funny.', '',
    'HARD RULES:',
    '- It must be light-hearted and clearly affectionate. Never cruel, humiliating, or mean-spirited.',
    '- NEVER reference or attack: religion, caste, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, body weight/appearance in a hurtful way, family tragedy, or mental health.',
    '- No profanity stronger than PG-13. No slurs. No sexual content. No self-harm references.',
    '- Each line stands alone, max ~140 characters, no numbering inside the text.', '',
    'Return STRICT JSON ONLY, no prose, no markdown fences, in exactly this shape:',
    '{"roasts":["line one","line two"],"title":"a 2-4 word mock award title for them"}',
    'Give exactly ' + count + ' roast lines.'
  ].join('\n');
}

function extractJsonObject(text) {
  if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return null;
  var t = text.trim();
  var fence = t.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
  if (fence) t = fence[1].trim();
  var first = t.indexOf('{'), last = t.lastIndexOf('}');
  if (first !== -1 && last !== -1 && last > first) t = t.slice(first, last + 1);
  t = t.replace(/[\u201C\u201D]/g, '"').replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'").replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1');
  try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function sanitizeLine(line) {
  var s = String(line || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (s.length > 180) s = s.slice(0, 177).trim() + '…';
  return s;
}
function isSafe(line) {
  var low = ' ' + line.toLowerCase() + ' ';
  for (var i = 0; i < BANNED.length; i++) if (low.indexOf(BANNED[i]) !== -1) return false;
  return true;
}

function parseRoastResponse(rawText, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var minCount = opts.minCount || 3;
  var obj = extractJsonObject(rawText);
  var lines = null, title = null;
  if (obj && Array.isArray(obj.roasts)) { lines = obj.roasts; title = obj.title; }
  else if (Array.isArray(obj)) { lines = obj; }
  else if (obj && Array.isArray(obj.lines)) { lines = obj.lines; }
  if (!lines) {
    var fallback = String(rawText || '').split('\n')
      .map(function (l) { return l.replace(/^\s*[-*\d.)\]]+\s*/, '').trim(); })
      .filter(function (l) { return l.length > 8 && l.length < 200; });
    if (fallback.length >= minCount) lines = fallback;
  }
  if (!lines || !lines.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no_roasts_parsed' };
  var clean = lines.map(sanitizeLine).filter(function (l) { return l.length >= 4; }).filter(isSafe);
  var seen = {};
  clean = clean.filter(function (l) { var k = l.toLowerCase(); if (seen[k]) return false; seen[k] = true; return true; });
  if (clean.length < minCount) return { ok: false, error: 'too_few_safe_roasts', got: clean.length, roasts: clean };
  return { ok: true, roasts: clean, title: title ? sanitizeLine(title).slice(0, 40) : null };
}

module.exports = { buildRoastPrompt, extractJsonObject, parseRoastResponse, sanitizeLine, isSafe, BANNED };

/* ============================================================================
   ZIVOGIFT · scrapbook-core.js  (Run 5 — Digital Scrapbook, pure core)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Pure logic for the swipeable "memory book": normalize/validate input, compute
   photo layout, and build page/cover SVGs. No Sharp/R2/Supabase → unit-testable.
   FONTS: SVGs use {{SERIF}}/{{SANS}} placeholders that compose-scrapbook.js
   swaps for cardFonts.FAMILIES before rasterizing (Lambda has no system fonts).
   Canvas 1080×1350 (4:5) to match the card family.
   ============================================================================ */
'use strict';

var CANVAS_W = 1080, CANVAS_H = 1350;
var MIN_PAGES = 2, MAX_PAGES = 12, MAX_PHOTOS_PER_PAGE = 2;

function esc(s) {
  return String(s == null ? '' : s)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&apos;')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F]/g, '');
}
function wrapText(text, maxChars, maxLines) {
  var words = String(text || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  var lines = [], cur = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
    var w = words[i];
    if (!cur) { cur = w; continue; }
    if ((cur + ' ' + w).length <= maxChars) cur += ' ' + w;
    else { lines.push(cur); cur = w; if (maxLines && lines.length === maxLines - 1) break; }
  }
  if (cur && (!maxLines || lines.length < maxLines)) lines.push(cur);
  var consumed = lines.join(' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  if (maxLines && consumed < words.length && lines.length) {
    var last = lines[lines.length - 1];
    if (last.length > maxChars - 1) last = last.slice(0, maxChars - 1);
    lines[lines.length - 1] = last + '\u2026';
  }
  return lines;
}

var SUGGESTED_CHAPTERS = ['When We Met', 'Our First Trip', 'The Funniest Moment', 'Late Night Talks',
  'Worst Decisions', 'Best Memories', 'Things I Never Said', 'Future Goals', 'Final Message'];

function normalizeScrapbook(input) {
  input = input || {};
  var rawPages = Array.isArray(input.pages) ? input.pages : [];
  if (rawPages.length < MIN_PAGES) return { ok: false, error: 'too_few_pages' };
  var pages = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < rawPages.length && pages.length < MAX_PAGES; i++) {
    var p = rawPages[i] || {};
    var photos = Array.isArray(p.photo_urls)
      ? p.photo_urls.filter(function (u) { return typeof u === 'string' && u.trim(); }).slice(0, MAX_PHOTOS_PER_PAGE) : [];
    var note = String(p.note || '').trim();
    var chapter = String(p.chapter || '').trim();
    if (!photos.length && !note) continue;
    pages.push({ index: pages.length, chapter: chapter || ('Chapter ' + (pages.length + 1)), note: note, photo_urls: photos });
  }
  if (pages.length < MIN_PAGES) return { ok: false, error: 'too_few_valid_pages' };
  return { ok: true, scrapbook: {
    title: String(input.title || 'Our Story').trim().slice(0, 60),
    sender_name: String(input.sender_name || 'Someone').trim().slice(0, 40),
    recipient_name: String(input.recipient_name || 'Friend').trim().slice(0, 40),
    vibe_key: input.vibe_key || 'confetti_pop',
    pages: pages, page_count: pages.length
  } };
}

function pagePhotoLayout(photoCount) {
  var area = { x: 90, y: 300, w: CANVAS_W - 180, h: 620 };
  if (photoCount <= 0) return [];
  if (photoCount === 1) return [{ x: area.x, y: area.y, w: area.w, h: area.h }];
  var gap = 22, half = Math.round((area.h - gap) / 2);
  return [{ x: area.x, y: area.y, w: area.w, h: half }, { x: area.x, y: area.y + half + gap, w: area.w, h: half }];
}

function buildPageSvg(page, book, palette) {
  palette = palette || {};
  var bg1 = palette.bg1 || '#241539', bg2 = palette.bg2 || '#0e1030';
  var accent = palette.accent || '#FFD24A', text = palette.text || '#FFF6E9';
  var tiles = pagePhotoLayout((page.photo_urls || []).length);
  var frameRects = tiles.map(function (t) {
    return '<rect x="' + (t.x - 10) + '" y="' + (t.y - 10) + '" width="' + (t.w + 20) + '" height="' + (t.h + 20) + '" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.96"/>';
  }).join('');
  var noteTop = tiles.length ? 1000 : 560;
  var noteMax = tiles.length ? 3 : 8;
  var noteLines = wrapText(page.note || '', 40, noteMax);
  var noteSvg = noteLines.map(function (ln, i) { return '<tspan x="' + (CANVAS_W / 2) + '" dy="' + (i === 0 ? 0 : 46) + '">' + esc(ln) + '</tspan>'; }).join('');
  var pageNum = (page.index + 1) + ' / ' + book.page_count;
  return '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' +
'<svg width="' + CANVAS_W + '" height="' + CANVAS_H + '" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
  '<defs>' +
    '<linearGradient id="bg" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="' + bg1 + '"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="' + bg2 + '"/></linearGradient>' +
    '<radialGradient id="bloom" cx="50%" cy="22%" r="60%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="' + accent + '" stop-opacity="0.18"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="' + accent + '" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>' +
  '</defs>' +
  '<rect width="' + CANVAS_W + '" height="' + CANVAS_H + '" fill="url(#bg)"/>' +
  '<rect width="' + CANVAS_W + '" height="' + CANVAS_H + '" fill="url(#bloom)"/>' +
  '<rect x="46" y="46" width="' + (CANVAS_W - 92) + '" height="' + (CANVAS_H - 92) + '" rx="26" fill="none" stroke="' + accent + '" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="2"/>' +
  '<text x="' + (CANVAS_W / 2) + '" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" letter-spacing="6" fill="' + accent + '" fill-opacity="0.9" font-family="{{SANS}}" font-weight="700">CHAPTER ' + (page.index + 1) + '</text>' +
  '<text x="' + (CANVAS_W / 2) + '" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-size="58" fill="' + text + '" font-family="{{SERIF}}" font-weight="700">' + esc(page.chapter) + '</text>' +
  frameRects +
  (noteSvg ? '<text y="' + noteTop + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="34" fill="' + text + '" fill-opacity="0.95" font-family="{{SERIF}}" font-style="italic">' + noteSvg + '</text>' : '') +
  '<text x="' + (CANVAS_W / 2) + '" y="' + (CANVAS_H - 96) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" fill="' + text + '" fill-opacity="0.55" font-family="{{SANS}}">' + esc(book.title) + '</text>' +
  '<text x="' + (CANVAS_W / 2) + '" y="' + (CANVAS_H - 60) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="' + text + '" fill-opacity="0.4" font-family="{{SANS}}" letter-spacing="3">' + esc(pageNum) + '</text>' +
  '<text x="' + (CANVAS_W / 2) + '" y="' + (CANVAS_H - 30) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="' + text + '" fill-opacity="0.3" font-family="{{SANS}}" letter-spacing="6">ZIVOGIFT</text>' +
'</svg>';
}

/* ZIVOGIFT · squad-core.js  (shared — Squad Wall 2.0 pure summariser)
   A gift_reactions row with video_url=null is "invited, not yet recorded";
   non-null is "submitted". No Supabase/I/O so it's unit-testable. */
'use strict';

function summarizeSquad(rows) {
  rows = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
  var submitted = [], pending = [];
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    var name = (r.contributor_name && String(r.contributor_name).trim()) || 'Friend';
    if (r.video_url) submitted.push({ contributor_name: name, submitted_at: r.submitted_at || null });
    else pending.push({ contributor_name: name });
  });
  submitted.sort(function (a, b) { return String(b.submitted_at || '').localeCompare(String(a.submitted_at || '')); });
  var invited = rows.length, done = submitted.length;
  var pct = invited > 0 ? Math.round((done / invited) * 100) : 0;
  return {
    invited: invited, submitted: done, pending: pending.length, percent: pct,
    complete: invited > 0 && done === invited,
    submitted_contributors: submitted, pending_contributors: pending,
    summary_line: invited === 0 ? 'No squad members invited yet.'
      : (done + ' of ' + invited + ' ' + (invited === 1 ? 'friend has' : 'friends have') + ' recorded')
  };
}

function buildWallPlaylist(rows) {
  var subs = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [])
    .filter(function (r) { return r.video_url; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return String(a.submitted_at || '').localeCompare(String(b.submitted_at || '')); });
  return subs.map(function (r, i) {
    return { index: i, total: subs.length, contributor_name: (r.contributor_name && String(r.contributor_name).trim()) || 'Friend', video_url: r.video_url };
  });
}

module.exports = { summarizeSquad, buildWallPlaylist };

// Server-side Supabase client using the SERVICE ROLE key.
// This bypasses Row Level Security — it must NEVER be imported into
// any browser-facing file. Functions only.
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');

function getSupabaseAdmin() {
  const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !key) {
    throw new Error('Missing SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env vars');
  }
  return createClient(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false } });
}

module.exports = { getSupabaseAdmin };

// netlify/functions/_lib/suppression.js
//
// Marketing suppression for the NUDGE schedulers.
//
// WHY THIS EXISTS
// ---------------
// 60_campaigns_and_admin_ops.sql introduced public.marketing_optouts, and
// _lib/audience.js honours it for campaigns. But reminder-scheduler.js and
// occasion-scheduler.js pre-date that work and send their own promotional
// WhatsApp nudges ("Rohit's birthday is in 5 days -- create a gift") on a
// daily cron. They were never wired to the opt-out list, so a customer who
// unsubscribed kept receiving promotional pushes from a different code path.
//
// That is the exact failure the opt-out system exists to prevent, so the
// check belongs in a shared module both schedulers call -- not copy-pasted
// logic that can drift.
//
// WHAT COUNTS AS MARKETING HERE
// -----------------------------
// A birthday/anniversary/occasion nudge is promotional: it is unsolicited,
// recurring, and its purpose is to drive a repeat purchase. It is NOT a
// transactional message about something the user already bought. So it is
// correctly subject to opt-out.
//
// Gift DELIVERY (gift-scheduler.js) is transactional -- someone paid for it
// -- and is deliberately NOT suppressed by this module.
//
// FAIL-OPEN vs FAIL-CLOSED
// ------------------------
// loadSuppressionSet() returns an EMPTY set if the table cannot be read
// (migration not applied, transient error). That is fail-open, and it is the
// right call for a nudge: the alternative is that one DB blip silently stops
// every reminder your customers actually like receiving. The read failure is
// logged loudly so it shows up in the function log.
//
// The volume here is small (an opt-out list, not a customer list), so the
// whole set is loaded once per invocation and checked in memory rather than
// issuing one query per recipient.

const PAGE = 1000;
const MAX_ROWS = 50000;

/**
 * Loads every opted-out phone (last 10 digits) and email into memory.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<{phones:Set<string>, emails:Set<string>, ok:boolean, error?:string}>}
 */
async function loadSuppressionSet(supabase) {
  const phones = new Set();
  const emails = new Set();

  try {
    for (let from = 0; from < MAX_ROWS; from += PAGE) {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('marketing_optouts')
        .select('email, phone10')
        .range(from, from + PAGE - 1);

      if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
      if (!data || !data.length) break;

      for (const row of data) {
        if (row.phone10) phones.add(String(row.phone10));
        if (row.email) emails.add(String(row.email).toLowerCase());
      }
      if (data.length < PAGE) break;
    }
    return { phones, emails, ok: true };
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(
      'suppression: could not read marketing_optouts (run 60_campaigns_and_admin_ops.sql) -- ' +
      'proceeding WITHOUT suppression: ' + ((e && e.message) || e)
    );
    return { phones, emails, ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e) };
  }
}

// Normalises any phone shape in this codebase to the last 10 digits.
// orders.contact_phone is raw user input, profiles.phone varies, and
// digital_sends.recipient_phone is '91'-prefixed -- the last 10 digits is the
// only comparison that matches all of them, and it is the same convention
// marketing_optouts.phone10 stores.
function phone10(raw) {
  const d = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  return d.length >= 10 ? d.slice(-10) : '';
}

/**
 * @param {{phones:Set, emails:Set}} set  from loadSuppressionSet()
 * @param {{phone?:string, email?:string}} who
 * @returns {boolean} true if this person has opted out of marketing
 */
function isSuppressed(set, { phone, email } = {}) {
  if (!set) return false;
  const p = phone10(phone);
  if (p && set.phones.has(p)) return true;
  if (email && set.emails.has(String(email).toLowerCase())) return true;
  return false;
}

module.exports = { loadSuppressionSet, isSuppressed, phone10 };

FILE: netlify\functions\_lib\unsubToken.js
=====================================================

// netlify/functions/_lib/unsubToken.js
//
// Signed one-click unsubscribe tokens.
//
// The unsubscribe endpoint has to be PUBLIC -- the whole point is that it
// works from an email client with no login. That means the only thing
// standing between it and "anyone can unsubscribe anyone" is the signature.
//
// HMAC-SHA256 over "email|phone10|issued_at", truncated to 32 hex chars and
// base64url-packed with the payload. Node's crypto is built in, so this adds
// no dependency to package.json.
//
// SECRET: UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET env var. If it is not set we deliberately fall
// back to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as the HMAC key rather than throwing --
// a missing env var must never be the reason a legally-required unsubscribe
// link 500s. The service role key is already a high-entropy secret present on
// every deploy, and it is only ever used here as an HMAC key, never exposed.

const crypto = require('crypto');

function secret() {
  const s = process.env.UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET || process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!s) throw new Error('No UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY available to sign unsubscribe links');
  return s;
}

function b64url(buf) {
  return Buffer.from(buf).toString('base64').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}
function unb64url(str) {
  const s = String(str || '').replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  return Buffer.from(s + '==='.slice((s.length + 3) % 4), 'base64').toString('utf8');
}

function sign(payload) {
  return crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(payload).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);
}

/**
 * @param {{email?:string, phone10?:string, campaignId?:string}} who
 * @returns {string} opaque token safe for a URL query string
 */
function makeToken({ email, phone10, campaignId }) {
  const payload = [
    String(email || '').toLowerCase(),
    String(phone10 || ''),
    String(campaignId || ''),
    String(Date.now()),
  ].join('|');
  return b64url(`${payload}|${sign(payload)}`);
}

/**
 * @returns {{valid:boolean, email?:string, phone10?:string, campaignId?:string, reason?:string}}
 */
function readToken(token) {
  let raw;
  try { raw = unb64url(token); } catch (e) { return { valid: false, reason: 'malformed' }; }

  const parts = raw.split('|');
  if (parts.length !== 5) return { valid: false, reason: 'malformed' };

  const [email, phone10, campaignId, issued, sig] = parts;
  const expected = sign([email, phone10, campaignId, issued].join('|'));

  // Constant-time compare. Both sides are fixed-length hex from the same
  // function, so a length mismatch here means a tampered token.
  const a = Buffer.from(sig);
  const b = Buffer.from(expected);
  if (a.length !== b.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'bad_signature' };
  }

  // NOTE: no expiry check, on purpose. An unsubscribe link must keep working
  // forever -- people unsubscribe from year-old emails, and an expired
  // unsubscribe link is a spam complaint.
  return {
    valid: true,
    email: email || null,
    phone10: phone10 || null,
    campaignId: campaignId || null,
    issuedAt: Number(issued) || null,
  };
}

/** Full public URL for the footer of a marketing email. */
function unsubUrl(who) {
  const site = (process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://zivogift.com').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return `${site}/.netlify/functions/unsubscribe?t=${makeToken(who)}`;
}

module.exports = { makeToken, readToken, unsubUrl };

// netlify/functions/_lib/waInbox.js
//
// THE CUSTOMER MESSAGES STORE.
//
// Every read and write of the WhatsApp inbox goes through here, so the
// webhook, the admin API, the automation mirror and the personal-number relay
// can never drift apart on what a "conversation" means.
//
// Requires supabase/consolidated/80_whatsapp_inbox.sql.
//
// ── DESIGN RULE: NEVER THROW INTO A CALLER THAT IS DELIVERING A MESSAGE ─────
// recordInbound() is called from whatsapp-webhook.js, and recordOutboundMirror()
// is called from inside the WhatsApp send path used by gift-scheduler. If
// either threw, a bookkeeping failure would take down an actual customer
// delivery. So both return a structured result and log instead of throwing.
// The webhook checks that result and spools a failure row when it is not ok.

const { getSupabaseAdmin } = require('./supabaseAdmin');

// Meta's documented customer-service window. Free-text replies are permitted
// only inside it; outside, only approved templates are delivered.
const WINDOW_HOURS = 24;

/** Digits-only, last 10 — the phone convention used across this codebase. */
function toPhone10(raw) {
  const digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  return digits.length >= 10 ? digits.slice(-10) : '';
}

/** Full E.164-without-'+' for sending. Mirrors _lib/phoneUtil.js behaviour. */
function toWaPhone(raw) {
  const digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 10 && /^[6-9]/.test(digits)) return `91${digits}`;
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('0')) return `91${digits.slice(1)}`;
  if (digits.length >= 11) return digits;
  return null;
}

/**
 * One-line summary of a message for the conversation list. Media has no body
 * text, and a list showing three blank rows is useless — so every type gets a
 * human label.
 */
function previewFor({ msgType, body, caption }) {
  const text = (body || caption || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (text) return text.slice(0, 160);
  const labels = {
    image: '📷 Photo',
    audio: '🎤 Voice message',
    video: '🎬 Video',
    document: '📄 Document',
    sticker: '🌟 Sticker',
    location: '📍 Location',
    contacts: '👤 Contact card',
    reaction: '❤️ Reaction',
    button: '🔘 Button reply',
    interactive: '🔘 Menu reply',
    system: 'ℹ️ System message',
    unsupported: '❓ Unsupported message type',
  };
  return labels[msgType] || '(no text)';
}

/**
 * Flattens ANY Meta inbound message object into our row shape.
 *
 * The critical property: this function has no failure mode that returns
 * nothing. An unrecognised type yields msg_type 'unsupported' with the raw
 * object attached, because a message we cannot parse is still a message a
 * customer sent, and dropping it is the exact bug this feature exists to fix.
 */
function parseInboundMessage(msg) {
  const type = String(msg.type || 'unsupported');
  const out = {
    waMessageId: msg.id || null,
    msgType: type,
    body: null,
    caption: null,
    mediaId: null,
    mediaMime: null,
    mediaSha256: null,
    contextWaId: (msg.context && msg.context.id) || null,
  };

  const media = msg[type];

  switch (type) {
    case 'text':
      // Original casing preserved. The old code upper-cased before storing,
      // which made the log useless as a support transcript.
      out.body = (msg.text && msg.text.body) || '';
      break;

    case 'image':
    case 'audio':
    case 'video':
    case 'document':
    case 'sticker':
      if (media) {
        out.mediaId = media.id || null;
        out.mediaMime = media.mime_type || null;
        out.mediaSha256 = media.sha256 || null;
        out.caption = media.caption || null;
        // A document's filename is often the entire message ("PO_4412.pdf").
        if (media.filename) out.body = media.filename;
      }
      break;

    case 'location':
      if (msg.location) {
        const l = msg.location;
        out.body = [l.name, l.address, `${l.latitude}, ${l.longitude}`].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      }
      break;

    case 'contacts': {
      const names = (msg.contacts || [])
        .map((c) => (c.name && (c.name.formatted_name || c.name.first_name)) || '')
        .filter(Boolean);
      out.body = names.join(', ') || null;
      break;
    }

    case 'button':
      // Quick-reply button on a template we sent.
      out.body = (msg.button && (msg.button.text || msg.button.payload)) || null;
      break;

    case 'interactive': {
      const i = msg.interactive || {};
      const picked = i.button_reply || i.list_reply || {};
      out.body = picked.title || picked.id || null;
      break;
    }

    case 'reaction':
      out.body = (msg.reaction && msg.reaction.emoji) || null;
      out.contextWaId = (msg.reaction && msg.reaction.message_id) || out.contextWaId;
      break;

    case 'order':
    case 'system':
      out.body = JSON.stringify(msg[type] || {}).slice(0, 500);
      break;

    default:
      // Includes Meta's own 'unsupported' type (sent when a customer uses a
      // feature the Cloud API cannot represent) and anything added to the API
      // after this code was written.
      out.msgType = 'unsupported';
      out.body = (msg.errors && msg.errors[0] && msg.errors[0].title) || null;
      break;
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * Finds or creates the conversation header for a phone number.
 * Returns the contact row, or null if the phone is unusable.
 */
async function upsertContact(supabase, { phone, profileName }) {
  const phone10 = toPhone10(phone);
  if (!phone10) return null;

  const db = supabase || getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: existing } = await db
    .from('wa_contacts').select('*').eq('phone10', phone10).limit(1);

  if (existing && existing.length) {
    const row = existing[0];
    // Only write when something actually changed — this runs on every single
    // inbound message and a no-op UPDATE is still a write.
    if (profileName && profileName !== row.profile_name) {
      await db.from('wa_contacts')
        .update({ profile_name: profileName, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', row.id);
      row.profile_name = profileName;
    }
    return row;
  }

  const { data: created, error } = await db
    .from('wa_contacts')
    .insert({
      phone10,
      wa_phone: toWaPhone(phone) || phone10,
      profile_name: profileName || null,
      status: 'open',
    })
    .select().single();

  if (error) {
    // 23505 = another concurrent webhook invocation created it first. Meta can
    // deliver several messages in parallel, so this is expected, not an error.
    if (error.code === '23505') {
      const { data: raced } = await db
        .from('wa_contacts').select('*').eq('phone10', phone10).limit(1);
      return raced && raced.length ? raced[0] : null;
    }
    throw new Error(`wa_contacts upsert failed: ${error.message}`);
  }
  return created;
}

/**
 * Stores ONE inbound message and updates its conversation header.
 *
 * Called before any keyword/condition interpretation in the webhook, so that
 * a bug in that downstream logic cannot cost you the message.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<{ok:boolean, duplicate?:boolean, contact?:object, messageId?:string, error?:string}>}
 */
async function recordInbound(supabase, { msg, profileName, rawPayload }) {
  const db = supabase || getSupabaseAdmin();
  try {
    const parsed = parseInboundMessage(msg);
    const contact = await upsertContact(db, { phone: msg.from, profileName });
    if (!contact) return { ok: false, error: `unusable from-phone "${msg.from}"` };

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    // Meta sends a unix timestamp (seconds) per message; prefer it over now()
    // so a webhook delivered late does not reorder the transcript.
    const sentAt = msg.timestamp
      ? new Date(Number(msg.timestamp) * 1000).toISOString()
      : nowIso;

    const { error: insErr } = await db.from('wa_messages').insert({
      contact_id: contact.id,
      phone10: contact.phone10,
      direction: 'in',
      wa_message_id: parsed.waMessageId,
      msg_type: parsed.msgType,
      body: parsed.body,
      caption: parsed.caption,
      media_id: parsed.mediaId,
      media_mime: parsed.mediaMime,
      media_sha256: parsed.mediaSha256,
      context_wa_id: parsed.contextWaId,
      source: 'customer',
      raw_payload: rawPayload || msg,
      created_at: sentAt,
    });

    if (insErr) {
      // Already stored — Meta retried the webhook. Not a failure, and the
      // conversation header must NOT be bumped again or the unread count
      // would inflate on every retry.
      if (insErr.code === '23505') {
        return { ok: true, duplicate: true, contact, messageId: parsed.waMessageId };
      }
      throw new Error(insErr.message);
    }

    const windowExpires = new Date(Date.parse(sentAt) + WINDOW_HOURS * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();

    await db.from('wa_contacts').update({
      last_inbound_at: sentAt,
      last_message_at: sentAt,
      window_expires_at: windowExpires,
      last_message_preview: previewFor(parsed),
      unread_count: (contact.unread_count || 0) + 1,
      // A customer writing back re-opens a closed conversation. Anything else
      // would let a reply vanish from the default view.
      status: 'open',
      updated_at: nowIso,
    }).eq('id', contact.id);

    return { ok: true, contact, messageId: parsed.waMessageId, parsed };
  } catch (e) {
    const detail = String((e && e.message) || e);
    console.error('waInbox.recordInbound failed:', detail);
    return { ok: false, error: detail };
  }
}

/**
 * Stores ONE outbound message in the thread.
 *
 * Used by three callers with different `source` values:
 *   'reply'      — typed by an admin in the dashboard
 *   'automation' — mirrored from gift/campaign/order template sends
 *   'relay'      — sent from the personal-number relay
 *
 * Never throws: an outbound message that was genuinely delivered must not be
 * reported as failed just because we could not write the mirror row.
 */
async function recordOutbound(supabase, {
  phone, waMessageId, msgType = 'text', body, caption, templateName,
  status = 'sent', sentByAdmin, source = 'reply', errorCode, errorMessage,
  rawPayload, contextWaId, markRead = false,
}) {
  const db = supabase || getSupabaseAdmin();
  try {
    const contact = await upsertContact(db, { phone });
    if (!contact) return { ok: false, error: `unusable phone "${phone}"` };

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const { data: inserted, error: insErr } = await db.from('wa_messages').insert({
      contact_id: contact.id,
      phone10: contact.phone10,
      direction: 'out',
      wa_message_id: waMessageId || null,
      msg_type: msgType,
      body: body || null,
      caption: caption || null,
      template_name: templateName || null,
      status,
      status_at: nowIso,
      error_code: errorCode || null,
      error_message: errorMessage || null,
      sent_by_admin: sentByAdmin || null,
      source,
      context_wa_id: contextWaId || null,
      raw_payload: rawPayload || null,
      created_at: nowIso,
    }).select('id').single();

    if (insErr) {
      if (insErr.code === '23505') return { ok: true, duplicate: true, contact };
      throw new Error(insErr.message);
    }

    const patch = {
      last_outbound_at: nowIso,
      last_message_at: nowIso,
      last_message_preview: previewFor({ msgType, body, caption }),
      updated_at: nowIso,
    };
    // Replying to someone is an implicit "I have seen this". Automation
    // mirrors must NOT clear unread — a gift notification going out does not
    // mean you read the customer's question.
    if (markRead) patch.unread_count = 0;

    await db.from('wa_contacts').update(patch).eq('id', contact.id);

    return { ok: true, contact, rowId: inserted && inserted.id };
  } catch (e) {
    const detail = String((e && e.message) || e);
    console.warn('waInbox.recordOutbound failed (message itself was unaffected):', detail);
    return { ok: false, error: detail };
  }
}

/**
 * Applies a Meta delivery receipt (sent/delivered/read/failed) to the thread.
 * Silent no-op when the id belongs to something else — most receipts do.
 */
async function applyStatusToThread(supabase, st) {
  const db = supabase || getSupabaseAdmin();
  try {
    const messageId = st && st.id;
    const status = String((st && st.status) || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!messageId || !status) return;

    const patch = { status, status_at: new Date().toISOString() };
    if (status === 'failed') {
      const first = (Array.isArray(st.errors) && st.errors[0]) || {};
      patch.error_code = first.code ? String(first.code) : null;
      patch.error_message =
        (first.error_data && first.error_data.details) || first.title || 'unknown';
    }
    await db.from('wa_messages').update(patch).eq('wa_message_id', messageId);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('waInbox.applyStatusToThread failed:', (e && e.message) || e);
  }
}

/** True when a free-text (non-template) reply is still permitted. */
function windowIsOpen(contact) {
  if (!contact || !contact.window_expires_at) return false;
  return new Date(contact.window_expires_at).getTime() > Date.now();
}

/**
 * Last-resort spool. Called when anything above reports not-ok, so a message
 * we failed to process is still recoverable from the raw payload.
 */
async function spoolFailure(supabase, { stage, waMessageId, fromPhone, error, rawPayload }) {
  try {
    const db = supabase || getSupabaseAdmin();
    await db.from('wa_webhook_failures').insert({
      stage: stage || 'unknown',
      wa_message_id: waMessageId || null,
      from_phone: fromPhone || null,
      error: String(error || '').slice(0, 2000),
      raw_payload: rawPayload || null,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    // If even the spool is unavailable the log line is all that is left.
    console.error('waInbox.spoolFailure could not record a failure:', (e && e.message) || e, error);
  }
}

module.exports = {
  WINDOW_HOURS,
  toPhone10,
  toWaPhone,
  previewFor,
  parseInboundMessage,
  upsertContact,
  recordInbound,
  recordOutbound,
  applyStatusToThread,
  windowIsOpen,
  spoolFailure,
};
