await_block();
async function await_block() {}

module.exports.__run = async function run() {
  await atest('EXCLUDES opted-out customers — the single most important rule', async () => {
    const db = fakeClient({ v_customers: CUSTOMERS });
    const { recipients, stats } = await audience.resolveAudience(db, 'all', 'both');
    const keys = recipients.map((r) => r.customer_key);
    assert.ok(!keys.includes('c@d.com'), 'opted-out customer leaked into the audience!');
    assert.strictEqual(stats.opted_out, 1, 'should have counted 1 opt-out');
  });

  await atest('de-duplicates a repeated customer_key', async () => {
    const db = fakeClient({ v_customers: CUSTOMERS });
    const { recipients } = await audience.resolveAudience(db, 'all', 'both');
    const keys = recipients.map((r) => r.customer_key);
    assert.strictEqual(new Set(keys).size, keys.length, 'duplicate customer_key produced two recipients');
  });

  await atest('drops an invalid email but keeps the reachable phone', async () => {
    const db = fakeClient({ v_customers: CUSTOMERS });
    const { recipients } = await audience.resolveAudience(db, 'all', 'both');
    const broken = recipients.find((r) => r.customer_key === 'g@h.com');
    assert.ok(broken, 'customer with a valid phone should still be reachable');
    assert.strictEqual(broken.email, null, 'invalid email must be nulled');
    assert.deepStrictEqual(broken.channels, ['whatsapp']);
  });

  await atest('channel=email yields no whatsapp recipients', async () => {
    const db = fakeClient({ v_customers: CUSTOMERS });
    const { recipients, stats } = await audience.resolveAudience(db, 'all', 'email');
    assert.strictEqual(stats.whatsapp_recipients, 0);
    for (const r of recipients) assert.deepStrictEqual(r.channels, ['email']);
  });

  await atest('a customer with no reachable channel is excluded entirely', async () => {
    const db = fakeClient({ v_customers: [
      { customer_key: 'x', email: null, phone10: null, full_name: 'Ghost', opted_out: false },
    ] });
    const { recipients } = await audience.resolveAudience(db, 'all', 'both');
    assert.strictEqual(recipients.length, 0);
  });

  await atest('an unknown segment throws rather than silently sending to everyone', async () => {
    const db = fakeClient({ v_customers: CUSTOMERS });
    await assert.rejects(() => audience.resolveAudience(db, 'not_a_real_segment', 'email'), /Unknown segment/);
  });

  await atest('segment filters build the expected PostgREST chain', async () => {
    let captured = null;
    const db = { from() {
      const q = { _calls: [],
        select() { return q; }, order() { return q; },
        range(a, b) { q._range = [a, b]; return q; },
        gt(c, v) { q._calls.push(['gt', c, v]); return q; },
        gte(c, v) { q._calls.push(['gte', c, v]); return q; },
        lt(c, v) { q._calls.push(['lt', c, v]); return q; },
        eq(c, v) { q._calls.push(['eq', c, v]); return q; },
        then(r) { captured = q._calls; return Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }).then(r); } };
      return q;
    } };
    await audience.resolveAudience(db, 'dormant_90', 'email');
    assert.deepStrictEqual(captured[0], ['gt', 'paid_orders_count', 0]);
    assert.strictEqual(captured[1][0], 'lt');
    assert.strictEqual(captured[1][1], 'last_order_at');
  });

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  section('3. Campaign email rendering');
  const { renderCampaignEmail, unsubHeaders } = require('../netlify/functions/_lib/campaignEmail');

  const CAMPAIGN = {
    id: 'camp-1', name: 'Diwali 2026', subject: 'Diwali gifting, sorted',
    body: 'Line one.\n\nLine two with an & ampersand.', cta_url: 'https://zivogift.com', cta_label: 'Send a gift',
  };
  const RECIP = { full_name: 'Aisha', email: 'aisha@example.com', phone10: '9876543210', customer_key: 'aisha@example.com' };

  test('EVERY marketing email contains an unsubscribe link', () => {
    const { html, text } = renderCampaignEmail(CAMPAIGN, RECIP);
    assert.ok(/unsubscribe\?t=/.test(html), 'HTML body has no unsubscribe link');
    assert.ok(/unsubscribe\?t=/.test(text), 'plain-text body has no unsubscribe link');
  });

  test('produces a plain-text alternative (spam-filter scoring)', () => {
    const { text } = renderCampaignEmail(CAMPAIGN, RECIP);
    assert.ok(text.length > 40);
    assert.ok(!/<[a-z]/i.test(text), 'text part should not contain HTML tags');
  });

  test('escapes HTML injected through the admin message body', () => {
    const evil = { ...CAMPAIGN, body: '<script>alert(1)</script>' };
    const { html } = renderCampaignEmail(evil, RECIP);
    assert.ok(!/<script>/.test(html), 'unescaped <script> reached the email HTML');
    assert.ok(/&lt;script&gt;/.test(html), 'should appear escaped');
  });

  test('preserves paragraph breaks from the admin textarea', () => {
    const { html } = renderCampaignEmail(CAMPAIGN, RECIP);
    assert.ok(html.includes('Line one.'));
    assert.ok(html.includes('Line two'));
    assert.ok(/&amp;/.test(html), 'ampersand should be escaped');
  });

  test('emits RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe headers', () => {
    const h = unsubHeaders(CAMPAIGN, RECIP);
    assert.ok(h['List-Unsubscribe'].startsWith('<https://'), h['List-Unsubscribe']);
    assert.strictEqual(h['List-Unsubscribe-Post'], 'List-Unsubscribe=One-Click');
  });

  test('two recipients get DIFFERENT unsubscribe tokens', () => {
    const a = renderCampaignEmail(CAMPAIGN, RECIP).html;
    const b = renderCampaignEmail(CAMPAIGN, { ...RECIP, email: 'other@example.com' }).html;
    const tok = (s) => (s.match(/unsubscribe\?t=([^"&]+)/) || [])[1];
    assert.notStrictEqual(tok(a), tok(b), 'tokens must be per-recipient');
  });

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  section('4. CSV export encoding');
  const { toCsv } = require('../netlify/functions/admin-export');

  test('quotes commas, quotes and newlines correctly', () => {
    const csv = toCsv([{ name: 'Sharma, Rohit', note: 'He said "hi"', addr: 'Line1\nLine2' }]);
    const lines = csv.trim().split('\n');
    assert.strictEqual(lines[0], 'name,note,addr');
    assert.ok(csv.includes('"Sharma, Rohit"'), 'comma not quoted');
    assert.ok(csv.includes('"He said ""hi"""'), 'quotes not doubled');
  });

  test('neutralises CSV/Excel formula injection', () => {
    const csv = toCsv([{ name: '=HYPERLINK("http://evil","click")' }]);
    assert.ok(csv.includes("'="), 'formula was not neutralised — Excel would execute it');
  });

  test('uses the UNION of keys, so a null column is not dropped', () => {
    const csv = toCsv([{ a: 1 }, { a: 2, b: 'appears-only-in-row-2' }]);
    assert.strictEqual(csv.split('\n')[0], 'a,b', 'column b was dropped from the header');
    assert.ok(csv.includes('appears-only-in-row-2'));
  });

  test('handles an empty result without throwing', () => {
    assert.strictEqual(toCsv([]), 'no_data\n');
  });

  test('serialises nested JSON columns', () => {
    const csv = toCsv([{ addons: [{ id: 'box', price: 149 }] }]);
    assert.ok(csv.includes('box'), 'jsonb column lost');
  });

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  section('5. Admin settings kill switches');
  const settings = require('../netlify/functions/_lib/adminSettings');

  await atest('reads switches and coerces to booleans', async () => {

  });

    assert.ok(r, 'should have returned a short-circuit response');

  });

    const s = await settings.getSettings(db);
    assert.strictEqual(s._readable, false);

  });

    for (const [, name, m, d] of rows) {

      assert.ok(dd >= 1 && dd <= maxDay, `${name}: ${dd}/${mm} is not a real date`);

  test('campaign-sender uses the same batch size as gift-scheduler', () => {

    const grab = (s) => (s.match(/BATCH_SIZE\s*=\s*(\d+)/) || [])[1];
    assert.strictEqual(grab(cs), grab(gs), 'batch sizes drifted apart');
  });

  test('netlify.toml registers both new cron functions', () => {
    const toml = require('fs').readFileSync(__dirname + '/../netlify.toml', 'utf8');
    assert.ok(toml.includes('[functions."campaign-sender"]'), 'campaign-sender cron missing');
    assert.ok(toml.includes('[functions."festival-scheduler"]'), 'festival-scheduler cron missing');
    assert.ok(/\[functions\."festival-scheduler"\]\s*\n\s*schedule = "0 3 \* \* \*"/.test(toml), 'festival cron should be 03:00 UTC');
  });

  test('admin.html wires both new tabs, panels and scripts', () => {
    const html = require('fs').readFileSync(__dirname + '/../admin.html', 'utf8');
    for (const needle of [
      'data-tab="campaigns"', 'data-tab="emergency"',
      'id="admin-campaigns"', 'id="admin-emergency"',
      'id="admin-campaigns-body"', 'id="admin-emergency-body"',
      'js/admin-campaigns.js', 'js/admin-ops.js',

    // Script order matters: both new files CHAIN admin-group5's onTab, so

    // tags — searching for the bare filename also hits the HTML comments
    // above the panels and gives a false negative.
    const order = [...html.matchAll(/<script src="(js\/[^"]+)"><\/script>/g)].map((m) => m[1]);

    assert.ok(at('js/admin-group5.js') < at('js/admin-campaigns.js'),

    assert.ok(at('js/admin-group5.js') < at('js/admin-ops.js'),
      `admin-ops.js must load AFTER admin-group5.js (order: ${order.join(', ')})`);

  test('no admin function forgets the shared auth wrapper', () => {
    const fs = require('fs');

      const src = fs.readFileSync(__dirname + '/../netlify/functions/' + f, 'utf8');
      assert.ok(src.includes('withAdmin'), `${f} does not use withAdmin`);

  test('the public unsubscribe endpoint is the ONLY one without admin auth', () => {
    const src = require('fs').readFileSync(__dirname + '/../netlify/functions/unsubscribe.js', 'utf8');
    assert.ok(!src.includes('verifyAdmin'), 'unsubscribe must not require admin auth');
    assert.ok(src.includes('readToken'), 'unsubscribe must verify the signed token');
  });

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  console.log(`\n${'─'.repeat(58)}`);
  console.log(`  ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);

#!/usr/bin/env node
/* scripts/verify-cards.js
 *
 * Renders every card layout locally and asserts three things:
 *
 *   1. TEXT ACTUALLY RASTERIZES. Counts non-background pixels in the region
 *      where the recipient's name is drawn. This is the automated version of
 *      the bug that shipped: a card that looked fine as SVG and came out of
 *      Sharp as a correct-looking PNG with every word missing.
 *
 *   2. THE SEALED VARIANT CONTAINS NO MESSAGE. Greps the generated SVG source
 *      for a sentinel string passed in as the personal message. If it appears
 *      anywhere in the markup, the sealed card is leaking.
 *
 *   3. EVERY VIBE RESOLVES. Walks js/vibe-tokens.js and renders one card per
 *      vibe, so a newly added vibe with a typo'd motif key fails here rather
 *      than in someone's inbox.
 *
 * Run:  npm run verify:cards
 * Exit: 0 = all good, 1 = something would ship broken.
 *
 * Writes preview PNGs to .card-previews/ (gitignored) so you can eyeball them.
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const OUT_DIR = path.join(ROOT, '.card-previews');

const SENTINEL = 'ZZ_SECRET_MESSAGE_SENTINEL_ZZ';

async function main() {
  const { loadSharp } = require(path.join(ROOT, 'netlify/functions/_lib/cardFonts.js'));
  const { resolveVibe, keys } = require(path.join(ROOT, 'js/vibe-tokens.js'));

  // Requiring generate-card-image pulls in r2Client → @aws-sdk. That is fine
  // locally after npm install; we only use the exported SVG builders.
  const card = require(path.join(ROOT, 'netlify/functions/generate-card-image.js'));

  let sharp;
  try {
    sharp = await loadSharp();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('\nFAIL — fonts are not usable:\n  ' + err.message + '\n');
    console.error('Fix: node scripts/fetch-fonts.js\n');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  fs.mkdirSync(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const failures = [];
  let rendered = 0;

  // ── 1 + 2: the three layouts, both variants ──────────────────────────────
  const layouts = [
    { name: 'standard',    fn: card.buildStandardSvg,    giftType: 'birthday_note',     vibe: 'confetti_pop' },
    { name: 'certificate', fn: card.buildCertificateSvg, giftType: 'roast_certificate', vibe: 'roast_certificate' },
    { name: 'horoscope',   fn: card.buildHoroscopeSvg,   giftType: 'horoscope_drop',    vibe: 'horoscope_drop' },
  ];

  for (const layout of layouts) {
    for (const sealed of [true, false]) {
      const label = `${layout.name}-${sealed ? 'sealed' : 'full'}`;
      const svg = layout.fn({
        vibe: resolveVibe(layout.vibe, layout.giftType),
        recipientName: 'Priyadarshini',
        senderName: 'Rahul',
        message: `Roast Title \u2014 ${SENTINEL}`,
        subHeading: 'VIT Vellore',
        hasPhoto: false,
        sealed,
        giftType: layout.giftType,
      });

      if (sealed && svg.includes(SENTINEL)) {
        failures.push(`${label}: SEALED CARD LEAKS THE PERSONAL MESSAGE`);
      }
      if (!sealed && layout.name !== 'certificate' && !svg.includes(SENTINEL)) {
        failures.push(`${label}: full card is missing the message`);
      }

      const png = await sharp(Buffer.from(svg), { density: 144 }).png().toBuffer();
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT_DIR, label + '.png'), png);
      rendered++;

      const inkPct = await inkCoverage(sharp, png);
      // A card with no text still has borders and a motif, so the floor is not
      // zero — but a fully textless render sits far below this.
      if (inkPct < 1.2) {
        failures.push(`${label}: only ${inkPct.toFixed(2)}% ink — text almost certainly did not render`);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── 3: every vibe renders ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  for (const key of keys()) {
    const svg = card.buildStandardSvg({
      vibe: resolveVibe(key),
      recipientName: 'Aarav',
      senderName: 'Meera',
      message: 'Test',
      hasPhoto: false,
      sealed: true,
      giftType: 'standard',
    });
    try {
      await sharp(Buffer.from(svg), { density: 96 }).png().toBuffer();
      rendered++;
    } catch (err) {
      failures.push(`vibe "${key}": ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  console.log(`\nverify-cards: rendered ${rendered} cards → ${path.relative(ROOT, OUT_DIR)}/`);
  if (failures.length) {
    console.error('\nFAILURES:\n  ' + failures.join('\n  ') + '\n');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('verify-cards: all checks passed.\n');
}

// Share of pixels that differ meaningfully from the card's own background.
async function inkCoverage(sharp, pngBuffer) {
  const { data, info } = await sharp(pngBuffer)
    .resize(300, 300, { fit: 'fill' })
    .greyscale()
    .raw()
    .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

  // Background is the modal value; ink is anything far from it.
  const hist = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) hist[data[i]]++;
  let mode = 0;
  for (let v = 1; v < 256; v++) if (hist[v] > hist[mode]) mode = v;

  let ink = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) if (Math.abs(data[i] - mode) > 45) ink++;

  return (100 * ink) / (info.width * info.height);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error('verify-cards: ' + err.stack);
  process.exit(1);
});

const path = require('path');

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
function test(n, f) {
  try { f(); console.log('  \u2713 ' + n); pass++; }
  catch (e) { console.log('  \u2717 ' + n + '\n      ' + e.message); fail++; }
}
async function atest(n, f) {
  try { await f(); console.log('  \u2713 ' + n); pass++; }
  catch (e) { console.log('  \u2717 ' + n + '\n      ' + e.message); fail++; }
}
const section = (s) => console.log('\n' + s);

function fakeClient(tables) {
  return {
    from(t) {
      const q = {
        _range: null,
        select() { return q; }, eq() { return q; }, is() { return q; },
        not() { return q; }, order() { return q; }, limit() { return q; },
        range(a, b) { q._range = [a, b]; return q; },
        then(r) {
          const rows = tables[t] || [];
          const out = q._range ? rows.slice(q._range[0], q._range[1] + 1) : rows;
          return Promise.resolve({ data: out, error: null, count: rows.length }).then(r);
        },
      };
      return q;
    },
  };
}

section('1. Marketing suppression (audit finding #2)');
const sup = require('../netlify/functions/_lib/suppression');

test('phone10 normalises every phone shape in this codebase', () => {
  assert.strictEqual(sup.phone10('9876543210'), '9876543210', 'bare 10-digit');
  assert.strictEqual(sup.phone10('919876543210'), '9876543210', 'E.164 without +');
  assert.strictEqual(sup.phone10('+91 98765 43210'), '9876543210', 'formatted');
  assert.strictEqual(sup.phone10('09876543210'), '9876543210', 'leading zero');
  assert.strictEqual(sup.phone10(''), '');
  assert.strictEqual(sup.phone10(null), '');

  ] });
  const set = await sup.loadSuppressionSet(db);
  assert.strictEqual(set.ok, true);
  assert.ok(sup.isSuppressed(set, { phone: '919876543210' }), 'E.164 form must match');
  assert.ok(sup.isSuppressed(set, { phone: '+91 98765 43210' }), 'formatted form must match');
  assert.ok(sup.isSuppressed(set, { email: 'gone@example.com' }), 'email match is case-insensitive');

  }) }) }) };

  assert.strictEqual(set.ok, false, 'should report the read failed');

test('every send site in reminder-scheduler is guarded (all 3 passes)', () => {

FILE: scripts\verify-sender.js

/* scripts/verify-sender.js
 *
 * Exercises campaign-sender's processRecipient() state machine with STUBBED
 * providers, so the send / retry / terminal-failure logic is proven before a
 * single real message is sent.
 *
 * Uses require.cache injection so the real Resend and Meta transports are
 * never loaded. The campaignEmail renderer is deliberately NOT stubbed — we
 * want the real HTML, headers and unsubscribe link exercised here.
 *
 * Run:  node scripts/verify-sender.js
 */
process.env.UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET = 'test-secret';
process.env.SITE_URL = 'https://zivogift.com';

const path = require('path');
const assert = require('assert');

const sent = { email: [], wa: [] };
let emailBehaviour = 'ok';
let waBehaviour = 'ok';

function stubLib(rel, exports) {
  const p = require.resolve(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'netlify', 'functions', '_lib', rel));
  require.cache[p] = { id: p, filename: p, loaded: true, exports };
}

// Load the real resend first so we can keep emailShell/ctaButton/BRAND, then
// replace only the transport.
const realResend = require('../netlify/functions/_lib/resend');
stubLib('resend.js', Object.assign({}, realResend, {
  sendEmail: async (o) => {
    if (emailBehaviour === 'skip') return { skipped: true };
    if (emailBehaviour === 'throw') throw new Error('Resend 429 rate limited');
    sent.email.push(o);
    return { sent: true, id: 'em_' + sent.email.length };
  },
}));

stubLib('whatsapp.js', {
  sendWhatsAppTemplate: async (o) => {
    if (waBehaviour === 'terminal') { const e = new Error('template REJECTED'); e.terminal = true; throw e; }
    if (waBehaviour === 'throw') throw new Error('transient meta error');
    sent.wa.push(o);
    return { messageId: 'wa_' + sent.wa.length, templateName: o.templateName, language: 'en' };
  },
});

const { processRecipient } = require('../netlify/functions/campaign-sender');

// Records every patch written back to campaign_recipients.
const updates = [];
const db = {
  from() {
    return {
      update(p) {
        const q = { eq() { return q; }, then(r) { updates.push(p); return Promise.resolve({ error: null }).then(r); } };
        return q;
      },
    };
  },
};

const CAMP = {
  id: 'c1', name: 'Test', subject: 'Hi', body: 'Body text',
  channel: 'both', wa_template: 'zg_promo_broadcast',
  cta_url: 'https://zivogift.com', cta_label: 'Go',
};

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const t = async (n, f) => {
  try { await f(); console.log('  \u2713 ' + n); pass++; }
  catch (e) { console.log('  \u2717 ' + n + '\n      ' + e.message); fail++; }
};

(async () => {
  console.log('\ncampaign-sender \u00b7 processRecipient state machine');

  await t('sends an email and marks the row sent', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; emailBehaviour = 'ok';
    const r = await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r1', channel: 'email', email: 'a@b.com', full_name: 'Aisha', attempts: 0, phone10: null });
    assert.strictEqual(r, 'sent');
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].status, 'sent');
    assert.ok(String(updates[0].provider_message_id).startsWith('em_'));
    assert.ok(sent.email[0].headers['List-Unsubscribe'], 'List-Unsubscribe header never reached Resend');
    assert.ok(/unsubscribe\?t=/.test(sent.email[0].html), 'no unsubscribe link in the sent HTML');
  });

  await t('sends WhatsApp with a 91-prefixed number and 2 body variables', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; waBehaviour = 'ok';
    const r = await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r2', channel: 'whatsapp', phone10: '9876543210', full_name: 'Rohit', attempts: 0, email: null });
    assert.strictEqual(r, 'sent');
    assert.strictEqual(sent.wa[0].recipientPhone, '919876543210', 'must be E.164 without +');
    assert.strictEqual(sent.wa[0].bodyVariables.length, 2);
    assert.strictEqual(sent.wa[0].bodyVariables[0], 'Rohit');
  });

  await t('a MISSING RESEND KEY is a failure, not a silent success', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; emailBehaviour = 'skip';
    const r = await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r3', channel: 'email', email: 'a@b.com', attempts: 0 });
    assert.strictEqual(r, 'failed', 'a skipped send was wrongly counted as sent');
    assert.ok(/RESEND_API_KEY/.test(updates[0].error_message));
  });

  await t('a transient error REQUEUES rather than failing permanently', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; emailBehaviour = 'throw';
    await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r4', channel: 'email', email: 'a@b.com', attempts: 0 });
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].status, 'queued', 'should retry');
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].attempts, 1);
  });

  await t('gives up permanently on the final attempt', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; emailBehaviour = 'throw';
    await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r5', channel: 'email', email: 'a@b.com', attempts: 2 });
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].status, 'failed', 'should be terminal at MAX_ATTEMPTS');
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].attempts, 3);
  });

  await t('a TERMINAL WhatsApp error never retries (protects number quality)', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; waBehaviour = 'terminal';
    await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r6', channel: 'whatsapp', phone10: '9876543210', attempts: 0 });
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].status, 'failed', 'terminal errors must not requeue');
    assert.ok(/REJECTED/.test(updates[0].error_message));
  });

  await t('rejects a row that has no contact detail', async () => {
    updates.length = 0; emailBehaviour = 'ok';
    await processRecipient(db, CAMP, { id: 'r7', channel: 'email', email: null, attempts: 0 });
    assert.strictEqual(updates[0].status, 'failed');
  });

  console.log('\n  ' + pass + ' passed, ' + fail + ' failed\n');
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
})();

-- ============================================================================

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scrapbook_data           jsonb;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

FILE: supabase\02_functions.sql

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT · 02_functions.sql  —  ALL RPC functions for Runs 1–2 (consolidated)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Run this SECOND (after 01_columns.sql). Idempotent (CREATE OR REPLACE).
-- Contains:
--   • zg_phone_last10()  helper (tolerant phone matching)
--   • get_my_memories()  — Run 1 Memory Vault (sent + received, redacted)
--   • record_gift_open() — Run 2 atomic open/complete analytics recorder
-- ============================================================================

-- ── helper: last 10 digits of any phone string ──────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zg_phone_last10(p text)
RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT right(regexp_replace(coalesce(p,''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10);
$$;

-- ── Run 1: Memory Vault ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Returns the caller's SENT (orders.user_id = auth.uid()) and RECEIVED
-- (digital_sends.recipient_phone last-10 matches the caller's profile phone)
-- gifts. SECURITY DEFINER but every query is scoped to auth.uid(). Never
-- returns phone numbers; redacts sender_name for the anonymous character_drop.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_memories()
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_phone text;
  v_sent jsonb;
  v_received jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_authenticated');
  END IF;

  SELECT public.zg_phone_last10(phone) INTO v_phone FROM public.profiles WHERE id = v_uid;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row ORDER BY row->>'created_at' DESC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_sent
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'id', ds.id, 'direction', 'sent',
      'recipient_name', ds.recipient_name, 'occasion', ds.occasion, 'gift_type', ds.gift_type,
      'channel', ds.channel, 'card_image_url', ds.card_image_url, 'teaser_image_url', ds.teaser_image_url,
      'gift_url', ds.gift_url, 'status', ds.status, 'scheduled_at', ds.scheduled_at,
      'sent_at', ds.sent_at, 'opened_at', ds.opened_at, 'reveal_completed_at', ds.reveal_completed_at,
      'reaction', ds.reaction, 'reacted_at', ds.reacted_at, 'is_time_capsule', ds.is_time_capsule,
      'order_number', o.order_number, 'created_at', ds.created_at,
      'open_delay_seconds', CASE WHEN ds.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND ds.sent_at IS NOT NULL
                                 THEN extract(epoch FROM (ds.opened_at - ds.sent_at))::int END,
      'reaction_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gift_reactions gr WHERE gr.gift_id = ds.id AND gr.submitted_at IS NOT NULL)
    ) AS row
    FROM public.digital_sends ds
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = ds.order_id
    WHERE o.user_id = v_uid
  ) s;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row ORDER BY row->>'sort_at' DESC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_received
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'id', ds.id, 'direction', 'received',
      'sender_name', CASE WHEN ds.gift_type = 'character_drop' THEN NULL ELSE ds.sender_name END,
      'occasion', ds.occasion, 'gift_type', ds.gift_type, 'channel', ds.channel,
      'card_image_url', ds.card_image_url, 'gift_url', ds.gift_url, 'status', ds.status,
      'sent_at', ds.sent_at, 'opened_at', ds.opened_at, 'is_time_capsule', ds.is_time_capsule,
      'sort_at', coalesce(ds.sent_at, ds.scheduled_at, ds.created_at)
    ) AS row
    FROM public.digital_sends ds
    WHERE v_phone IS NOT NULL AND length(v_phone) = 10
      AND public.zg_phone_last10(ds.recipient_phone) = v_phone
      AND ds.status = 'sent'
  ) r;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'sent', v_sent, 'received', v_received,
    'sent_count', jsonb_array_length(v_sent), 'received_count', jsonb_array_length(v_received)
  );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_memories() FROM anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_memories() TO authenticated;

-- ── Run 2: atomic open/complete recorder ────────────────────────────────────
-- mark-gift-opened.js calls this instead of a read-modify-write, so two rapid
-- taps can't race or double-count. SECURITY DEFINER because the recipient is
-- anonymous; the gift_id in the URL is the capability (as get-gift.js treats it).
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_gift_open(
  p_gift_id uuid, p_stage text, p_mode text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE r public.digital_sends%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.digital_sends WHERE id = p_gift_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'not_found'); END IF;

  IF p_stage = 'opened' THEN
    UPDATE public.digital_sends
       SET view_count = view_count + 1,
           opened_at  = COALESCE(opened_at, now()),
           first_open_delay_seconds = COALESCE(first_open_delay_seconds,
             CASE WHEN sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, extract(epoch FROM (now() - sent_at))::int) END)
     WHERE id = p_gift_id;
  ELSIF p_stage = 'completed' THEN
    UPDATE public.digital_sends
       SET reveal_completed_at = COALESCE(reveal_completed_at, now()),
           reveal_mode         = COALESCE(reveal_mode, p_mode)
     WHERE id = p_gift_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.record_gift_open(uuid, text, text) FROM public;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_gift_open(uuid, text, text) TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

FILE: supabase\schema-account-phone-verification.sql
=====================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Account-level mobile verification
-- Run this once in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run
-- Safe to re-run.
-- ============================================================================
-- Fixes the "OTP asked on every digital order" complaint: verification used
-- to be a 30-minute token (sender_verification_tokens) re-checked per order.
-- Now it's a permanent flag on the user's profile, tied to profiles.phone —
-- verify once in My Account, never see the OTP box again for that number.
--
-- Digital gift checkout now REQUIRES login (see create-cashfree-order.js),
-- so guest/no-login digital orders are no longer possible — this column
-- only needs to exist for logged-in users.

do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_name='profiles' and column_name='phone_verified') then
    alter table public.profiles add column phone_verified boolean not null default false;
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_name='profiles' and column_name='phone_verified_at') then
    alter table public.profiles add column phone_verified_at timestamptz;
  end if;
end $$;

-- If a user edits their phone number in My Account, the verification no
-- longer applies to the new number — this trigger resets it automatically
-- server-side, so it can never be missed by forgetting to clear it in the
-- application code (belt-and-braces alongside the explicit reset already
-- done in account.js / account-phone-verify.js).
create or replace function public.reset_phone_verification_on_change()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  if new.phone is distinct from old.phone then
    new.phone_verified := false;
    new.phone_verified_at := null;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists trg_reset_phone_verification on public.profiles;
create trigger trg_reset_phone_verification
  before update on public.profiles
  for each row execute procedure public.reset_phone_verification_on_change();

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Admin visibility into care_package_orders
-- Run this once in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run
-- Safe to re-run.
-- ============================================================================
-- care_package_orders has RLS enabled (schema-care-package.sql) but was
-- deliberately left with NO policies at all — the comment there says
-- "backend-only table", meaning it was only ever meant to be touched by
-- Netlify functions using the service-role key (which bypasses RLS anyway).
--
-- That's fine for the cron/webhook functions, but it also means the admin
-- dashboard's browser-side query (js/admin.js, using the anon-key client,
-- which IS subject to RLS) gets zero rows back — not an error, just silent
-- empty results. Needed now for the admin "Digital Status" column to show
-- real care-package delivery status instead of always "Not scheduled yet".

drop policy if exists "care_package_orders_admin_select" on public.care_package_orders;
create policy "care_package_orders_admin_select" on public.care_package_orders for select
  using (public.is_admin());



=====================================================
FILE: supabase\schema-admin-order-delete.sql
=====================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Admin: allow deleting orders from the admin dashboard
-- Run in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run.
-- Safe to re-run (DROP POLICY IF EXISTS guard).
-- ============================================================================
--
-- WHY THIS IS NEEDED
-- ------------------
-- schema.sql enables RLS on public.orders and defines exactly two policies:
--   orders_owner_select  (SELECT)
--   orders_admin_update  (UPDATE)
-- There is deliberately NO INSERT policy (orders are created only by the
-- create-cashfree-order Netlify function via the service-role key), and there
-- was NO DELETE policy at all.
--
-- With RLS on and no DELETE policy, a browser DELETE through the anon key
-- (which is what /admin.html uses) matches zero rows and returns SUCCESS with
-- an empty result — a silent no-op. The admin "Delete selected" button would
-- therefore appear to work while deleting nothing.
--
-- This adds a DELETE policy that mirrors the existing orders_admin_update
-- policy exactly: only a logged-in admin (public.is_admin() → profiles.is_admin
-- for auth.uid()) may delete. A random anon visitor is not an admin, so this
-- does not widen public access.
--
-- CHILD ROWS ARE HANDLED BY THE DATABASE, NOT THE BROWSER
-- -------------------------------------------------------
-- Every foreign key pointing at orders(id) already specifies its own delete
-- behaviour, so one DELETE on orders cleans everything up and can never be
-- blocked by a foreign key:
--   order_items.order_id          ON DELETE CASCADE
--   order_status_history.order_id ON DELETE CASCADE
--   digital_sends.order_id        ON DELETE CASCADE
--        └─ reply_tokens.gift_id        ON DELETE CASCADE
--        └─ gift_reactions.gift_id      ON DELETE CASCADE
--        └─ share_clip_jobs.digital_send_id ON DELETE CASCADE
--   care_package_orders.order_id  ON DELETE SET NULL
--   subscriptions.order_id        ON DELETE SET NULL   (a paid Zivo Pass is
--                                                        kept alive on purpose)
-- FK cascade actions run at the system level and are NOT filtered by the child
-- tables' own RLS policies, so no extra per-child DELETE policy is required.
-- ============================================================================

drop policy if exists "orders_admin_delete" on public.orders;
create policy "orders_admin_delete" on public.orders for delete
  using (public.is_admin());

-- Optional: make PostgREST pick the change up immediately instead of waiting
-- for its periodic schema refresh.
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

FILE: supabase\schema-care-package.sql
=====================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Care Package feature (New Parent pack, v1)
-- Run in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run.
-- ============================================================================
--
-- CADENCE DECISION (confirmed): 14 messages over 6 weeks (~every 3 days),
-- not the spec's original 30-daily. cadence_days is stored per-order (not
-- hardcoded) so Exam Support / Marriage Toolkit can reuse this same schema
-- with their own spacing later, per the spec's generalization goal (#7).
--
-- PAUSE/MUTE IS REQUIRED, NOT OPTIONAL (confirmed decision): status='paused'
-- is a first-class state, set by the RECIPIENT texting a keyword — see
-- whatsapp-webhook.js. This isn't just UX polish: unsolicited daily WhatsApp
-- messages to a new parent, with no way to stop them, is a real wellbeing
-- concern given postpartum's elevated depression/anxiety risk — not just a
-- product nicety.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.care_package_orders (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id uuid REFERENCES public.orders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,

  recipient_phone text NOT NULL,          -- normalized E.164 without '+'
  sender_name text NOT NULL,
  sender_phone text NOT NULL,             -- normalized E.164 without '+' — needed for completion notification

  package_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'postpartum',   -- postpartum | exam | marriage (v1: postpartum only)
  relationship_tone text NOT NULL,                    -- friend | parent | in-law | partner — changes generation tone
  personal_note text,                                 -- optional context, e.g. "first-time mom, exhausted, loves chai"

  trigger_date date NOT NULL,             -- baby's birth date / due date
  start_date date NOT NULL,               -- first message send date (usually = trigger_date or trigger_date+1)
  cadence_days int NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,    -- gap between messages; 14 msgs * 3 days ≈ 6 weeks
  total_messages int NOT NULL DEFAULT 14,

  -- pending_generation: order paid, content not generated yet (cron picks this up)
  -- active:   content generated, sends in progress
  -- paused:   recipient muted via WhatsApp reply — no sends until resumed
  -- completed: all messages sent
  -- failed:   generation failed after retries — needs manual attention
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_generation',
  generation_attempts int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  generation_error text,

  linked_digital_send_id uuid REFERENCES public.digital_sends(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  -- Day-1 gift wrapper (Personal Message video / digital card) — reuses the
  -- EXISTING digital gift studio pipeline as-is per the spec's reuse map;
  -- this column just links a care package to that already-independently-
  -- created digital_sends row. Nullable — the wrapper gift is optional.

  completion_notified boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,  -- sender notified once, on day 14 sent

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_care_orders_status ON public.care_package_orders(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_care_orders_recipient_phone ON public.care_package_orders(recipient_phone);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.care_package_messages (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  care_package_order_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.care_package_orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  day_number int NOT NULL,                -- 1..total_messages (sequence position, not calendar day)
  message_text text NOT NULL,
  tone_tag text,                          -- rest | food | encouragement | light-humor
  scheduled_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  -- Fixed send time (not model-generated) — see care-package-generator.js.
  -- A per-entry send_time picked by the model adds complexity for no real
  -- benefit and risks inconsistent/nonsensical timestamps for something
  -- delivery-critical; Zivo sets one sensible daily time centrally instead.
  -- Matches gift-scheduler.js's own scheduled_at + lte(now) pattern exactly.

  sent_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',   -- pending | sent | failed | skipped
  -- skipped: order was paused when this day came due and never resumed in
  -- time — scheduler marks it skipped rather than silently losing track, so
  -- the sequence has an honest record instead of a message that vanishes.
  sent_at timestamptz,
  send_error text,

  guardrail_checked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  guardrail_flagged boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  -- Defense-in-depth: content is checked AFTER generation, not just
  -- prompted-against, for medical-claim / diagnostic-language drift — see
  -- _lib/carePackageContentGuard.js. A flagged row is NOT sent automatically;
  -- it needs a human look, same spirit as moderateMessage.js failing safe
  -- rather than trusting the prompt alone.
  --
  -- guardrail_checked is deliberately separate from generation: checking all
  -- 14 messages for one order in the SAME tick as generating them risks
  -- blowing Netlify's 10s limit (1 generation call + 14 sequential safety
  -- checks is the same mistake photo-compositing made in the share-clip
  -- feature before it got split into async stages). care-package-guardrail.js
  -- runs as its own cron tick, checking a small batch of unchecked MESSAGES
  -- (not orders) at a time. The scheduler never sends a message where
  -- guardrail_checked=false — see care-package-scheduler.js.

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_care_messages_due ON public.care_package_messages(scheduled_at, sent_status, guardrail_checked);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_care_messages_unchecked ON public.care_package_messages(guardrail_checked) WHERE guardrail_checked = false;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_care_messages_order ON public.care_package_messages(care_package_order_id);

-- RLS: no public policies — only Netlify functions using the service-role key
-- touch these (care-package-generator.js, care-package-scheduler.js,
-- create-cashfree-order.js, whatsapp-webhook.js), same pattern as every
-- other backend-only table in this schema.
ALTER TABLE public.care_package_orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.care_package_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- ---------- Product catalog entry ----------
-- Price: needs your call — this is a 14-message paced sequence + optional
-- Day-1 gift wrapper, materially more product than a single ₹49-59 digital
-- gift, and (per the earlier cost discussion) needs to cover ~14 WhatsApp
-- template sends per customer, not just generation cost. ₹199 below is a
-- placeholder, not a pricing recommendation — change before going live.
insert into public.products (id,type,name,description,emoji,price,options,sort_order) values
('carepkg_postpartum','digital','New Parent Care Package','14 personal messages from you, paced over 6 weeks, for a friend who just became a parent.','🍼',199,'[{"label":"Relationship","values":["friend","parent","in-law","partner"]}]',260)
on conflict (id) do update set
  name = excluded.name,
  description = excluded.description,
  emoji = excluded.emoji,
  price = excluded.price,
  options = excluded.options,
  active = true;

FILE: supabase\schema-fix-digital-sends-email.sql
=====================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Fix: digital_sends has no recipient_email column
-- Run in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run
-- Safe to re-run.
--
-- ROOT CAUSE of "digital gifts not delivering by email or WhatsApp":
-- public.digital_sends was created with `recipient_phone text not null`
-- and a comment marking email as "(future)" — that future migration never
-- happened. _lib/digitalSendsHelper.js inserts email-channel rows as
-- { recipient_email: '...', channel: 'email' }, but digital_sends has no
-- recipient_email column at all, and recipient_phone is NOT NULL and gets
-- left out of that row. Every insert containing an email-channel row is
-- rejected by Postgres outright — and because scheduleDigitalSendsForOrder
-- inserts all of an order's send rows in a single batch, a single email
-- item in an order poisons the whole insert, silently dropping the
-- WhatsApp-channel rows from the SAME order too. The function only
-- console.error()s the failure and returns, so nothing in the UI or the
-- order ever surfaces it — it just looks like delivery "didn't happen".
-- ============================================================================

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='digital_sends' AND column_name='recipient_email') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN recipient_email text;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- recipient_phone can no longer be NOT NULL — an email-channel row
-- legitimately has no phone number.
ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ALTER COLUMN recipient_phone DROP NOT NULL;

-- Guardrail: every row must have an address that actually matches its
-- channel, so a malformed insert fails loudly (a clear Postgres constraint
-- error in the logs) instead of silently sending to nobody.
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.table_constraints
    WHERE table_name = 'digital_sends' AND constraint_name = 'digital_sends_channel_address_chk'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends
      ADD CONSTRAINT digital_sends_channel_address_chk
      CHECK (
        (channel = 'whatsapp' AND recipient_phone IS NOT NULL)
        OR (channel = 'email' AND recipient_email IS NOT NULL)
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

FILE: supabase\schema-fix-track-order-leak.sql
=====================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Fix track_order() leaking sender_phone/sender_name
-- Run in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run.
-- ============================================================================
--
-- WHY: schema.sql already revoked direct anon SELECT on public.digital_sends
-- specifically because sender_phone/sender_name must never be readable via
-- the public anon key (see the "SECURITY:" comment block in schema.sql).
-- But track_order() is SECURITY DEFINER — it runs as the function owner and
-- bypasses RLS entirely — and its second version (added when digital_sends
-- was folded into the response) does `jsonb_agg(ds)`, i.e. every column,
-- including sender_phone and sender_name. That's the exact same leak the
-- direct-SELECT fix was meant to close, reopened through a different path,
-- and it's reachable by anyone with an order_number + the phone used at
-- checkout — both are guessable/knowable by someone other than the buyer
-- in some flows (e.g. a recipient who receives the order_number).
--
-- FIX: return an explicit allowlist of digital_sends columns instead of the
-- whole row. Nothing in this function's actual purpose (letting the buyer
-- see their own gift's delivery status) needs sender_phone, sender_name, or
-- the internal reply_token/provider_message_id fields.

create or replace function public.track_order(p_order_number text, p_phone text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_history jsonb;
  v_digital_sends jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_order from public.orders
    where order_number = p_order_number and contact_phone = p_phone;
  if not found then return null; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(oi), '[]'::jsonb) into v_items
    from public.order_items oi where oi.order_id = v_order.id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(h order by h.changed_at), '[]'::jsonb) into v_history
    from public.order_status_history h where h.order_id = v_order.id;

  -- Explicit allowlist — deliberately excludes sender_phone, sender_name,
  -- reply_token, and provider_message_id.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', ds.id,
    'recipient_name', ds.recipient_name,
    'occasion', ds.occasion,
    'card_image_url', ds.card_image_url,
    'channel', ds.channel,
    'scheduled_at', ds.scheduled_at,
    'sent_at', ds.sent_at,
    'status', ds.status,
    'gift_type', ds.gift_type,
    'media_type', ds.media_type,
    'opened_at', ds.opened_at
  ) order by ds.scheduled_at), '[]'::jsonb) into v_digital_sends
    from public.digital_sends ds where ds.order_id = v_order.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'order', to_jsonb(v_order),
    'items', v_items,
    'history', v_history,
    'digital_sends', v_digital_sends
  );
end;
$$;

-- Grant is idempotent — CREATE OR REPLACE keeps prior grants, but stating it
-- explicitly here means this file is a complete, standalone fix on its own.
grant execute on function public.track_order(text, text) to anon, authenticated;

FILE: supabase\schema-frames-pricing.sql
=====================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT · FRAMES PRICING — Frame-Size upcharges (+ keep Handmade deltas)
-- schema-frames-pricing.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- WHY: the storefront lets buyers pick a Frame Size (A4/A3, or A5/A4 for Leaf)
-- but the price never changed, because products.option_pricing only carried a
-- "Creation Type" delta — never a "Frame Size" delta. create-cashfree-order.js
-- already prices GENERICALLY:  final = products.price + Σ option_pricing deltas
-- across EVERY option label — so simply adding a "Frame Size" block here makes
-- the server charge the upcharge correctly. js/frames.js computes the identical
-- sum for display, using BYTE-IDENTICAL size strings (plain ASCII, no unicode ×)
-- so what's shown always equals what's charged.
--
-- Run AFTER schema-portrait-frames.sql and schema-portrait-frames-v2.sql.
-- Idempotent: it fully REPLACES each product's option_pricing with the complete
-- intended map, so re-running is safe and always converges to the same state.
--
-- Launch defaults (edit anytime in Supabase / admin):
--   Standard frames:  A4 = +0   A3 = +₹400
--   Leaf Art:         A5 = +0   A4 = +₹300
--   Handmade upcharge: Word Portrait +₹700 · Leaf +₹900 (unchanged)
-- ============================================================================

-- Defensive: ensure the column exists.
alter table public.products add column if not exists option_pricing jsonb;

-- ── Word Portrait: Creation Type + Frame Size ───────────────────────────────
update public.products
set option_pricing = '{"Creation Type":{"Handmade":700,"Digital":0},"Frame Size":{"A4 (8x12 in)":0,"A3 (12x16 in)":400}}'::jsonb,
    options        = '[{"label":"Creation Type","values":["Handmade","Digital"]},{"label":"Frame Size","values":["A4 (8x12 in)","A3 (12x16 in)"]},{"label":"Language","values":["English","Hindi","Kannada"]}]'::jsonb
where id = 'frame_wordart';

-- ── Leaf Art: Creation Type + Frame Size (A5 base, A4 larger) ────────────────
update public.products
set option_pricing = '{"Creation Type":{"Handmade":900,"Digital":0},"Frame Size":{"A5 (6x8 in)":0,"A4 (8x12 in)":300}}'::jsonb,
    options        = '[{"label":"Creation Type","values":["Handmade","Digital"]},{"label":"Frame Size","values":["A5 (6x8 in)","A4 (8x12 in)"]}]'::jsonb
where id = 'frame_leaf';

-- ── Name Across Earth: Frame Size only ──────────────────────────────────────
update public.products
set option_pricing = '{"Frame Size":{"A4 (8x12 in)":0,"A3 (12x16 in)":400}}'::jsonb,

where id = 'frame_landsat';

-- =====================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Friend Special Dates
-- =====================================================================
--
-- WHY
-- ---
-- The friends table (schema-group3.sql) modelled exactly TWO dates per
-- friend: birthday_date and friendship_start_date. Users asked to mark ANY
-- number of meaningful days per friend — work anniversary, graduation,
-- wedding, promotion, exam day, "the day we met", etc. — each with its own
-- reminder. A pair of columns can't grow to that, so special days live in
-- their own child table: one friend → many special dates.
--
-- The two original columns are LEFT IN PLACE and keep working. birthday_date
-- in particular is still what the studio auto-suggest and the birthday
-- reminder read. This table is additive.
--
-- REMINDERS
-- ---------
-- reminder-scheduler.js gains a third pass over this table, mirroring the
-- birthday/anniversary passes: it fires a WhatsApp nudge N days before each
-- enabled date's next occurrence and dedupes via reminder_log using the
-- special-date row id as the friend_id-scoped key.
--
-- Idempotent — safe to run more than once.
-- RUN THIS AFTER schema-group3.sql (it references public.friends).
-- =====================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.friend_special_dates (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  friend_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.friends(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)      ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- occasion_type is one of the known keys the UI offers (birthday,
  -- anniversary, work_anniversary, graduation, wedding, engagement,
  -- promotion, new_job, exam, house_warming, baby, farewell, custom).
  -- 'custom' is the "Other" bucket and uses `label` for the display name.
  occasion_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom',
  label         text,                 -- free text; required only for 'custom'
  event_date    date NOT NULL,        -- year may be approximate; month+day drive reminders

  reminders_enabled  boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  remind_before_days int     NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  last_reminder_sent_for int,          -- year, to avoid duplicate sends within a year

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fsd_friend  ON public.friend_special_dates(friend_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fsd_user    ON public.friend_special_dates(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fsd_date    ON public.friend_special_dates(event_date)
  WHERE reminders_enabled = true;

-- ── RLS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.friend_special_dates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "fsd_owner_all" ON public.friend_special_dates;
CREATE POLICY "fsd_owner_all" ON public.friend_special_dates FOR ALL
  USING (user_id = auth.uid())
  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());

-- ── touch updated_at ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_fsd_updated_at()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_fsd_touch ON public.friend_special_dates;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_fsd_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.friend_special_dates
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch_fsd_updated_at();

-- ── reminder_log: allow special-date reminders to dedupe here too ──────
-- reminder_log already exists (schema-group3.sql) keyed by (friend_id,
-- reminder_type, sent_for_year). Special dates reuse it with
-- reminder_type = 'special:' || occasion_type and friend_id = the special
-- date row id, so nothing about the existing table needs to change.

FILE: supabase\schema-gift-reveal-v2.sql
=====================================================

-- =====================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Gift Reveal v2
-- Sealed/full card split + reveal telemetry
-- =====================================================================
--
-- WHY
-- ---
-- gift-scheduler.js used to generate ONE card image with the sender's
-- personal message painted onto it, and embed that image in the delivery
-- email and the WhatsApp media. The message was therefore legible in the
-- inbox preview thumbnail and on the recipient's lock screen, before they
-- opened anything. Removing the message block from the email template alone
-- did not fix that — the leak was in the image itself.
--
-- There are now two images per send:
--
--   teaser_image_url  SEALED. No message. Generated at delivery time by
--                     gift-scheduler.js. This is what email and WhatsApp
--                     embed, and what gift.html paints on the Act 0 envelope.
--
--   card_image_url    FULL. Message included. Generated LAZILY by
--                     get-full-card.js, only after opened_at is set, only
--                     when the recipient taps Save card. Existing column,
--                     new lifecycle.
--
-- BACKFILL: none, deliberately. Rows already marked 'sent' are never
-- re-processed by gift-scheduler, so historic gifts keep whatever
-- card_image_url they were delivered with and nothing in flight breaks.
-- Rows still 'pending' have card_image_url = NULL and teaser_image_url =
-- NULL, so they pick up the new path on their next scheduler tick.
--
-- Idempotent — safe to run more than once. Follows the same DO-block pattern
-- as schema-group2.sql / schema-group3.sql.
--
-- RUN THIS BEFORE DEPLOYING. gift-scheduler.js writes teaser_image_url on
-- every send; without the column the UPDATE fails, the send is retried four
-- times and then hard-fails to the admin alert.
-- =====================================================================

DO $$
BEGIN

  -- ── Sealed card image ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name = 'digital_sends' AND column_name = 'teaser_image_url'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN teaser_image_url text;
    COMMENT ON COLUMN public.digital_sends.teaser_image_url IS
      'Sealed card PNG (no personal message). Safe for email/WhatsApp previews. Generated by gift-scheduler.js.';
  END IF;

  -- ── Clarify the existing column's new meaning ────────────────────────
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name = 'digital_sends' AND column_name = 'card_image_url'
  ) THEN
    COMMENT ON COLUMN public.digital_sends.card_image_url IS
      'FULL card PNG including the personal message. Generated lazily by get-full-card.js AFTER opened_at is set. Never embedded in an email or a WhatsApp message.';
  END IF;

  -- ── Reveal telemetry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- opened_at already existed but was written by gift.html on PAGE LOAD, so
  -- it measured "the link was fetched" — including link previews and
  -- crawlers — rather than "the recipient opened the gift". The redesigned
  -- gift.html only calls mark-gift-opened on the Open tap, so from now on
  -- opened_at means what its name says. reveal_completed_at records the
  -- recipient actually reaching the keepsake card, which is the number worth
  -- watching for the redesign.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name = 'digital_sends' AND column_name = 'reveal_completed_at'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN reveal_completed_at timestamptz;
    COMMENT ON COLUMN public.digital_sends.reveal_completed_at IS
      'Set when the recipient reaches Act 3 (keepsake card) in gift.html. NULL means they opened but did not finish the reveal.';
  END IF;

  -- ── Which reveal the recipient got ───────────────────────────────────
  -- Lets us tell a reduced-motion / skipped reveal apart from a full one when
  -- reading the funnel, instead of guessing from timestamps.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name = 'digital_sends' AND column_name = 'reveal_mode'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN reveal_mode text;
    COMMENT ON COLUMN public.digital_sends.reveal_mode IS
      'full | skipped | reduced_motion — how the recipient experienced the reveal.';
  END IF;

END $$;

-- ── Index: the scheduler's hot query ───────────────────────────────────
-- gift-scheduler runs every 2 minutes and always filters on exactly this
-- predicate. A partial index keeps it cheap as digital_sends grows, and stays
-- tiny because it only covers rows still waiting to go out.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS digital_sends_due_idx
  ON public.digital_sends (scheduled_at)
  WHERE status = 'pending' AND condition_met = true;

-- ── Funnel view ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Delivered → opened → reveal finished, per gift type. Service-role only;
-- admin.html reads it through the existing admin RPC pattern.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.gift_reveal_funnel AS
SELECT
  gift_type,
  channel,
  count(*)                                                              AS delivered,
  count(opened_at)                                                      AS opened,
  count(reveal_completed_at)                                            AS completed,
  round(100.0 * count(opened_at)           / nullif(count(*), 0), 1)    AS open_rate_pct,
  round(100.0 * count(reveal_completed_at) / nullif(count(opened_at), 0), 1) AS completion_rate_pct
FROM public.digital_sends
WHERE status = 'sent'
GROUP BY gift_type, channel
ORDER BY delivered DESC;

REVOKE ALL ON public.gift_reveal_funnel FROM anon, authenticated;

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT — Group 3 Schema Additions (Retention & Repeat Purchase Engine)
-- Run in Supabase: Dashboard → SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run
-- Safe to re-run: all wrapped in IF NOT EXISTS guards.
-- ============================================================================

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Feature 9 + 10 + 19: friends table
-- One row per (user, person they gift to). Powers:
--   #9  Relationship Context Engine  — context_notes feeds AI Polish
--   #10 Birthday Reminder            — birthday_date + last_vibe_key
--   #19 Friendship Anniversary       — friendship_start_date
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.friends (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  phone text,
  relationship_type text,              -- e.g. 'study partner', 'roommate', 'sibling'
  context_notes text,                  -- free text, fed into AI Polish system prompt
  birthday_date date,                  -- month+day matters most; year optional/approximate
  friendship_start_date date,          -- for anniversary auto-card
  last_vibe_key text,                  -- pre-select on re-order
  last_gift_type text,
  remind_before_days int NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  birthday_reminders_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  anniversary_reminders_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  last_birthday_reminder_sent_for int,     -- year, to avoid duplicate sends within a year
  last_anniversary_reminder_sent_for int,  -- year, to avoid duplicate sends within a year
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_friends_user_id ON public.friends(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_friends_birthday ON public.friends(birthday_date) WHERE birthday_reminders_enabled = true;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_friends_anniversary ON public.friends(friendship_start_date) WHERE anniversary_reminders_enabled = true;

ALTER TABLE public.friends ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "friends_owner_all" ON public.friends;
CREATE POLICY "friends_owner_all" ON public.friends FOR ALL
  USING (auth.uid() = user_id OR public.is_admin())
  WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Keep updated_at fresh
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_friends_updated_at()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_friends_touch ON public.friends;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_friends_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.friends
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch_friends_updated_at();

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Feature 5: 4-Year Fresher Time Capsule
-- No new columns needed beyond what Group 2 already added — gift_type already
-- exists on digital_sends/order_items, scheduled_at already supports any future
-- date. We add one explicit marker so capsules are easy to query/report on,
-- plus an opened-protection flag (capsule should never be openable early even
-- if someone guesses the gift.html URL).
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='digital_sends' AND column_name='is_time_capsule') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN is_time_capsule boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='order_items' AND column_name='is_time_capsule') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_items ADD COLUMN is_time_capsule boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Feature 23: Condition-Based Delivery
-- A digital_sends row can wait on a sender's WhatsApp confirmation instead of
-- (or in addition to) a fixed scheduled_at. gift-scheduler.js skips rows with
-- condition_type='sender_confirm' AND condition_met=false even if scheduled_at
-- has passed. whatsapp-webhook.js flips condition_met=true when the sender
-- texts the matching keyword.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='digital_sends' AND column_name='condition_type') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN condition_type text DEFAULT 'none'; -- 'none' | 'sender_confirm'
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='digital_sends' AND column_name='condition_met') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN condition_met boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true; -- true = no condition / already satisfied
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='digital_sends' AND column_name='condition_keyword') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN condition_keyword text; -- e.g. 'SEND PRIYA' — normalized uppercase, sender texts this
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='digital_sends' AND column_name='condition_label') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.digital_sends ADD COLUMN condition_label text; -- human-readable, e.g. "after their placement result"
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='order_items' AND column_name='condition_type') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_items ADD COLUMN condition_type text DEFAULT 'none';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='order_items' AND column_name='condition_label') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_items ADD COLUMN condition_label text;
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_digital_sends_condition
  ON public.digital_sends(condition_type, condition_met)
  WHERE condition_type = 'sender_confirm' AND condition_met = false;

-- Inbound WhatsApp messages log — lets whatsapp-webhook.js dedupe Meta's
-- at-least-once delivery and gives you an audit trail of inbound keywords.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.whatsapp_inbound_log (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  wa_message_id text UNIQUE,           -- Meta's message id — used to dedupe retries
  from_phone text NOT NULL,
  body text,
  matched_keyword text,
  matched_send_id uuid REFERENCES public.digital_sends(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  processed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.whatsapp_inbound_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "whatsapp_inbound_log_admin_all" ON public.whatsapp_inbound_log;
CREATE POLICY "whatsapp_inbound_log_admin_all" ON public.whatsapp_inbound_log
  FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin());
-- No anon policy — webhook writes via service-role key only.

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Feature 10 + 19: reminders_sent log (optional but useful for admin visibility
-- and prevents double-sends across overlapping scheduler runs)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.reminder_log (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  friend_id uuid REFERENCES public.friends(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reminder_type text NOT NULL,         -- 'birthday' | 'anniversary'
  sent_for_year int NOT NULL,
  sent_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (friend_id, reminder_type, sent_for_year)
);

ALTER TABLE public.reminder_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "reminder_log_admin_all" ON public.reminder_log;
CREATE POLICY "reminder_log_admin_all" ON public.reminder_log
  FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin());

-- ============================================================================

-- ---------- New product: Squad Memory Board ----------

('digital_squadmemory','digital','Squad Memory Board','Up to 6 photos composited into one shareable memory board.','📸',89,'[]',260)

-- ---------- Numerology addon now actually generates a reading (see
-- netlify/functions/_lib/numerologyHelper.js) — update its description to

-- One row per rep. Tied to a logged-in account (user_id) so the rep can see
-- their own dashboard under RLS without any extra auth mechanism.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.campus_reps (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ref_code text UNIQUE NOT NULL,             -- e.g. 'anna-rohit' → zivogift.com/?rep=anna-rohit
  full_name text NOT NULL,
  college text NOT NULL,
  phone text NOT NULL,
  year_of_study text,
  social_handle text,
  upi_id text,                                -- for weekly UPI payouts
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',     -- 'pending' | 'approved' | 'suspended'
  commission_rate numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, -- percent, 8–12 typical
  badge text,                                  -- e.g. 'Official Zivogift Rep' once earned
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  approved_at timestamptz
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campus_reps_user ON public.campus_reps(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campus_reps_ref_code ON public.campus_reps(ref_code);

ALTER TABLE public.campus_reps ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "campus_reps_owner_read" ON public.campus_reps;
CREATE POLICY "campus_reps_owner_read" ON public.campus_reps FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = user_id OR public.is_admin());
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "campus_reps_owner_insert" ON public.campus_reps;
CREATE POLICY "campus_reps_owner_insert" ON public.campus_reps FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "campus_reps_admin_write" ON public.campus_reps;
CREATE POLICY "campus_reps_admin_write" ON public.campus_reps FOR UPDATE
  USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin());

-- Orders carry which rep referred them + the commission computed at payment time.
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='orders' AND column_name='rep_ref_code') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN rep_ref_code text;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='orders' AND column_name='rep_commission_amount') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN rep_commission_amount numeric DEFAULT 0;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='orders' AND column_name='rep_commission_status') THEN
    -- 'none' (no rep) | 'pending' (owed, unpaid) | 'paid' (payout sent)
    ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN rep_commission_status text DEFAULT 'none';
  END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_rep_ref_code ON public.orders(rep_ref_code) WHERE rep_ref_code IS NOT NULL;

-- Weekly payout batches — admin marks a rep's pending commissions as paid in bulk.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.rep_payouts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  rep_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.campus_reps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  amount numeric NOT NULL,
  order_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  method text DEFAULT 'upi',
  paid_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note text
);
ALTER TABLE public.rep_payouts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "rep_payouts_owner_read" ON public.rep_payouts;
CREATE POLICY "rep_payouts_owner_read" ON public.rep_payouts FOR SELECT
  USING (public.is_admin() OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.campus_reps r WHERE r.id = rep_id AND r.user_id = auth.uid()));
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "rep_payouts_admin_write" ON public.rep_payouts;
CREATE POLICY "rep_payouts_admin_write" ON public.rep_payouts FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (public.is_admin());

-- RPC — a rep can fetch their own aggregated stats without needing broad read
-- access to the `orders` table (which belongs to buyers, not reps). Security
-- definer bypasses RLS internally but only ever returns the caller's own data.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_rep_stats()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  rep record;
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO rep FROM public.campus_reps WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;
  IF rep.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('is_rep', false);
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'is_rep', true,
    'ref_code', rep.ref_code,
    'status', rep.status,
    'commission_rate', rep.commission_rate,
    'badge', rep.badge,
    'total_orders', COALESCE(COUNT(o.id), 0),
    'total_sales', COALESCE(SUM(o.total) FILTER (WHERE o.status NOT IN ('pending_payment','payment_failed','cancelled')), 0),
    'commission_pending', COALESCE(SUM(o.rep_commission_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.rep_commission_status = 'pending'), 0),
    'commission_paid', COALESCE(SUM(o.rep_commission_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.rep_commission_status = 'paid'), 0),
    'recent_orders', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'order_number', ro.order_number, 'total', ro.total,
               'status', ro.status, 'created_at', ro.created_at,
               'commission', ro.rep_commission_amount
             ) ORDER BY ro.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (SELECT * FROM public.orders WHERE rep_ref_code = rep.ref_code ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) ro
    )
  ) INTO result
  FROM public.orders o
  WHERE o.rep_ref_code = rep.ref_code;

  RETURN result;
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================================
-- ZIVOGIFT · PERSONALISED FRAMES (Word Portrait + Name Across Earth)
-- schema-portrait-frames.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Adds two new PHYSICAL, human-fulfilled gift products under a new product
-- type 'frame'. Both are ordered like any physical keepsake (address required,
-- delivery fee by pincode, NO OTP / digital gate) and fulfilled by hand from
-- the /admin order screen — the storefront only collects the personalisation.
--
--   1) frame_wordart  — "Memory Word Portrait"
--        A framed portrait rendered entirely from words/messages the buyer
--        chooses, from ONE uploaded photo. Single product with a "Creation
--        Type" choice: Handmade (100% hand-drawn) or Digital (computer-made).
--        Handmade costs more — enforced server-side via option_pricing below.
--
--   2) frame_landsat  — "Name Across Earth"
--        A premium frame spelling a NAME using real satellite / Landsat
--        landforms (rivers, coastlines, mountains) — one letter per formation,
--        plus a personal dedication message. Composed by hand per order.
--
-- Idempotent: safe to run multiple times. Prices/copy are editable any time
-- from Supabase Table Editor or the /admin Catalog & Pricing screen — no code
-- change or deploy needed. The numbers below are sensible launch defaults.
-- ============================================================================

-- ── 1. Option-based price deltas ────────────────────────────────────────────
-- A nullable jsonb map that lets a SINGLE product change price by the buyer's
-- option choice. Shape:
--   { "<Option Label>": { "<Option Value>": <rupees to ADD per unit>, ... } }
-- e.g. { "Creation Type": { "Handmade": 700, "Digital": 0 } }
-- Resolved server-side in create-cashfree-order.js (the browser price is never
-- trusted). Existing products keep option_pricing = NULL and are unaffected.
alter table public.products
  add column if not exists option_pricing jsonb;

comment on column public.products.option_pricing is
  'Optional per-option price deltas (rupees to add per unit), keyed by option label then value. NULL = no deltas.';

-- ── 2. Seed the two frame products ──────────────────────────────────────────
-- Word Portrait: base price = the Digital price (₹799). Handmade adds ₹700 via
-- option_pricing => Handmade lands at ₹1499. Both share the same product card.
insert into public.products
  (id, type, name, description, emoji, price, compare_at_price, options, option_pricing, sort_order)
values
(
  'frame_wordart',
