#!/usr/bin/env node
/* ============================================================================
   tools/wa-inbox-verify.js
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Structural self-check for the Customer Messages (WhatsApp Inbox) feature.

   OPTIONAL. Everything this reports is ALSO visible in
   Admin -> 🚨 Emergency -> Re-check, which needs no laptop. Use this when you
   want the answer in a terminal.

     node tools/wa-inbox-verify.js            # structure only, no network
     node tools/wa-inbox-verify.js --live     # also calls Meta + Supabase

   Structure mode needs nothing: no env vars, no DB, no network. It verifies
   the files exist, parse, and export what the rest of the code requires --
   which is what catches a bad merge or a half-applied drop-in.
   ========================================================================= */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const LIVE = process.argv.includes('--live');

let pass = 0, fail = 0, warn = 0;
const ok   = (m) => { pass++; console.log(`  \x1b[32m✓\x1b[0m ${m}`); };
const bad  = (m) => { fail++; console.log(`  \x1b[31m✗\x1b[0m ${m}`); };
const note = (m) => { warn++; console.log(`  \x1b[33m!\x1b[0m ${m}`); };
const head = (m) => console.log(`\n\x1b[1m${m}\x1b[0m`);

function readIf(rel) {
  const p = path.join(ROOT, rel);
  return fs.existsSync(p) ? fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8') : null;
}

// ── 1. FILES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
head('1. Files present');
const FILES = [
  'supabase/consolidated/80_whatsapp_inbox.sql',
  'netlify/functions/_lib/waInbox.js',
  'netlify/functions/_lib/whatsappSession.js',
  'netlify/functions/_lib/waNotify.js',
  'netlify/functions/_lib/waRelay.js',
  'netlify/functions/whatsapp-webhook.js',
  'netlify/functions/admin-inbox.js',
  'js/admin-inbox.js',
  'admin.html',
];
for (const f of FILES) {
  if (readIf(f)) ok(f); else bad(`${f} is MISSING`);
}

// ── 2. MODULES LOAD AND EXPORT WHAT CALLERS NEED ────────────────────────────
head('2. Modules load and export their contracts');
const CONTRACTS = {
  'netlify/functions/_lib/waInbox.js': ['recordInbound', 'recordOutbound', 'applyStatusToThread', 'spoolFailure', 'windowIsOpen', 'previewFor', 'parseInboundMessage', 'toPhone10'],
  'netlify/functions/_lib/whatsappSession.js': ['sendWhatsAppText', 'sendWhatsAppMedia', 'fetchInboundMedia', 'markMessageRead'],
  'netlify/functions/_lib/waNotify.js': ['notifyNewMessage'],
  'netlify/functions/_lib/waRelay.js': ['handleAdminRelayMessage', 'isFromAdmin', 'registerRelay'],
};
for (const [file, expected] of Object.entries(CONTRACTS)) {
  try {
    const m = require(path.join(ROOT, file));
    const missing = expected.filter((k) => typeof m[k] !== 'function');
    if (missing.length) bad(`${file} is missing export(s): ${missing.join(', ')}`);
    else ok(`${file} exports ${expected.length} function(s)`);
  } catch (e) {
    // A missing THIRD-PARTY dependency means `npm install` has not been run in
    // this checkout. That says nothing about whether these files are correct,
    // so it is a note rather than a failure -- otherwise the tool reports a
    // scary red ✗ for a problem that does not exist on Netlify.
    if (e.code === 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND' && /node_modules|@supabase|@aws-sdk/.test(e.message)) {
      note(`${file} could not be loaded here (run \`npm install\` first) — structure not verified`);
    } else {
      bad(`${file} failed to load: ${e.message}`);
    }
  }
}

// The mirror is the reason gift sends show up in a customer's thread.
head('3. Outbound mirror is wired');
try {
  const wa = require(path.join(ROOT, 'netlify/functions/_lib/whatsapp.js'));
  if (wa.sendWhatsAppTemplate && wa.sendWhatsAppTemplate.name === 'sendWhatsAppTemplateMirrored') {
    ok('_lib/whatsapp.js exports the MIRRORED sender');
  } else {
    bad('_lib/whatsapp.js is NOT exporting the mirrored sender — automation will not appear in threads');
  }
  if (typeof wa.sendWhatsAppTemplateRaw === 'function') ok('sendWhatsAppTemplateRaw available (used by admin template replies)');
  else bad('sendWhatsAppTemplateRaw missing — admin-inbox.js would double-record template replies');

  const src = readIf('netlify/functions/_lib/whatsapp.js') || '';
  if (/sendWhatsAppTemplate\s*=\s*sendWhatsAppTemplateMirrored/.test(src)) {
    ok('in-module rebind present — sendGiftMessage() is mirrored too');
  } else {
    bad('in-module rebind MISSING — gift deliveries would bypass the thread mirror');
  }
} catch (e) {
  bad(`_lib/whatsapp.js failed to load: ${e.message}`);
}

// ── 4. WEBHOOK IS CAPTURE-FIRST ─────────────────────────────────────────────
head('4. Webhook stores before it interprets');
// Strip comments first. The file's own header QUOTES the old buggy lines to
// explain what was fixed, and scanning raw text matches that documentation
// and reports a bug that is not there.
const stripComments = (src) => String(src)
  .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '')
  .replace(/^[ \t]*\/\/.*$/gm, '');

const wh = stripComments(readIf('netlify/functions/whatsapp-webhook.js') || '');
if (/recordInbound/.test(wh)) ok('calls recordInbound()');
else bad('does NOT call recordInbound() — messages would not be stored');

// The `if (!fromPhone || !body) return;` guard is FINE inside the
// interpretation step -- a photo genuinely has no keyword to match. It is a
// BUG only when it runs before the message has been stored. So the test is
// positional, not textual: is the guard upstream of the capture call?
const capIdx = wh.indexOf('recordInbound(supabase');
const dropIdx = wh.search(/if\s*\(!fromPhone\s*\|\|\s*!body\)\s*return/);
if (dropIdx > -1 && capIdx > -1 && dropIdx < capIdx) {
  bad('the non-text early-return runs BEFORE capture — images/voice notes are being lost');
} else if (dropIdx > -1) {
  ok('the non-text early-return only guards interpretation, after capture');
} else {
  ok('no pre-capture message drop found');
}

const intIdx = wh.indexOf('interpretInboundMessage(supabase');
if (capIdx > -1 && intIdx > -1 && capIdx < intIdx) ok('capture happens BEFORE interpretation');
else if (capIdx > -1 && intIdx > -1) bad('interpretation runs before capture — ordering guarantee broken');

if (/spoolFailure/.test(wh)) ok('failure spool wired (wa_webhook_failures)');
else bad('no failure spool — an unhandled payload would be lost');

if (/verifyMetaSignature/.test(wh)) ok('HMAC signature verification retained');
else bad('signature verification missing — endpoint would be forgeable');

// ── 5. ADMIN PANEL WIRING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
head('5. Admin panel wiring');
const adminHtml = readIf('admin.html') || '';
if (/data-tab="inbox"/.test(adminHtml)) ok('nav button data-tab="inbox" present');
else bad('nav button missing');
if (/id="admin-inbox"/.test(adminHtml)) ok('panel id="admin-inbox" present (showTab needs this exact id)');
else bad('panel id="admin-inbox" missing — the tab would open a blank screen');
if (/id="admin-inbox-body"/.test(adminHtml)) ok('render target #admin-inbox-body present');
else bad('#admin-inbox-body missing');
if (/js\/admin-inbox\.js/.test(adminHtml)) ok('js/admin-inbox.js script tag present');
else bad('script tag missing');

const inboxJs = readIf('js/admin-inbox.js') || '';
const g5 = inboxJs.indexOf('ZGAdminGroup5');
if (g5 > -1 && /if\s*\(typeof prev === 'function'\)/.test(inboxJs)) ok('onTab hook is CHAINED (does not clobber other tabs)');
else bad('onTab hook is not chained — Campaigns/Emergency tabs could break');

// ── 6. SQL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
head('6. Migration contents');
const sql = readIf('supabase/consolidated/80_whatsapp_inbox.sql') || '';
for (const t of ['wa_contacts', 'wa_messages', 'wa_webhook_failures', 'wa_relay_map']) {
  if (new RegExp(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public\\.${t}`).test(sql)) ok(`creates ${t}`);
  else bad(`does not create ${t}`);
}
if (/ALTER TABLE public\.whatsapp_inbound_log/.test(sql)) bad('migration ALTERs whatsapp_inbound_log — it must be left untouched');
else ok('leaves whatsapp_inbound_log untouched');
if (/pause_wa_relay[\s\S]{0,60}true/.test(sql)) ok('paid relay seeded OFF');
else note('could not confirm the relay is seeded OFF — check admin_settings');
if (/raw_payload\s+jsonb/.test(sql)) ok('raw_payload retained (last-resort recovery)');
else bad('raw_payload column missing');

// ── 7. LIVE CHECKS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!LIVE) {
  head('7. Live checks');
  note('skipped — re-run with --live (needs env vars) or use Admin → Emergency → Re-check');
} else {
  (async () => {
    head('7. Live checks');
    const need = ['WHATSAPP_TOKEN', 'WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID', 'WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET', 'WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN', 'SUPABASE_URL', 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY'];
    for (const n of need) {
      if (process.env[n]) ok(`${n} is set`);
      else bad(`${n} is NOT set${n === 'WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET' ? ' — the webhook will reject EVERY inbound message' : ''}`);
    }
    if (!process.env.ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL) note('ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL not set — no free new-message alerts');

    if (process.env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN && process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0/${process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID}?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating`, {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN}` },
        });
        const d = await r.json();
        if (d.error) bad(`Meta phone number check: ${d.error.message}`);
        else ok(`Meta phone: ${d.display_phone_number} (${d.verified_name}) quality=${d.quality_rating || 'n/a'}`);
      } catch (e) { bad(`Meta unreachable: ${e.message}`); }
    }

    if (process.env.SUPABASE_URL && process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
      for (const t of ['wa_contacts', 'wa_messages', 'wa_webhook_failures', 'wa_relay_map']) {
        try {
          const r = await fetch(`${process.env.SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${t}?select=count`, {
            headers: {
              apikey: process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY,
              Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
              Prefer: 'count=exact',
            },
          });
          if (r.ok) ok(`table ${t} reachable`);
          else bad(`table ${t}: HTTP ${r.status} — run 80_whatsapp_inbox.sql`);
        } catch (e) { bad(`table ${t}: ${e.message}`); }
      }
    }
    summary();
  })();
}

function summary() {
  console.log(`\n${'─'.repeat(58)}`);
  console.log(`  \x1b[32m${pass} passed\x1b[0m   \x1b[31m${fail} failed\x1b[0m   \x1b[33m${warn} notes\x1b[0m`);
  if (fail === 0) console.log('  Structure is sound. Live behaviour still depends on Meta + Supabase.\n');
  else console.log('  Fix the ✗ items above before relying on the inbox.\n');
  process.exitCode = fail ? 1 : 0;
}

if (!LIVE) summary();

#!/usr/bin/env node
/* eslint-disable no-console */
//
// ZivoGift — WhatsApp preflight check.
//
// RUN THIS ON YOUR OWN MACHINE, BEFORE YOU DEPLOY. It costs zero Netlify
// credits and zero deploys. It talks straight to Meta's Graph API with the
// same env vars Netlify uses, and tells you whether a real gift send will
// succeed — instead of you having to deploy and find out.
//
// USAGE (PowerShell, from the repo root):
//
//   $env:WHATSAPP_TOKEN           = "EAA..."
//   $env:WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID = "123456789012345"
//   $env:WHATSAPP_WABA_ID         = "987654321098765"
//   $env:R2_PUBLIC_URL            = "https://pub-xxxx.r2.dev"   # optional but checked
//
//   node tools/wa-preflight.js
//
// To also send ONE real message to your own handset (this is the only way to
// be certain end-to-end):
//
//   node tools/wa-preflight.js --send 9876543210
//
// Requires Node 18+ (uses built-in fetch). No npm install needed.

const GRAPH = process.env.WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION || 'v20.0';
const TOKEN = process.env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN;
const PHONE_ID = process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID;
const WABA_ID = process.env.WHATSAPP_WABA_ID;
const R2_PUBLIC_URL = process.env.R2_PUBLIC_URL;

// Mirror of the template contract in the code. Keep in sync when you add one.
const EXPECTED = [
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME || 'zivogift_birthday_surprise', bodyVars: 2, usedBy: 'gift-scheduler.js  (THE MAIN GIFT MESSAGE)', critical: true },
  { name: 'gift_delivered_sender_notify',                                     bodyVars: 2, usedBy: 'gift-scheduler.js  (sender notify)' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REPLY_RECEIVED  || 'gift_reply_received',    bodyVars: 1, usedBy: 'notify-original-sender.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_REACTION_INVITE || 'squad_reaction_invite',  bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'send-reaction-invites.js' },
  { name: 'zg_condition_gift_instructions',                                   bodyVars: 4, usedBy: '_lib/digitalSendsHelper.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_OCCASION_NUDGE  || 'zg_occasion_nudge', bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'occasion-scheduler.js' },
  { name: 'zg_birthday_reminder',                                             bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'reminder-scheduler.js' },
  { name: 'zg_anniversary_nudge',                                             bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'reminder-scheduler.js' },
  { name: 'zg_special_day_reminder',                                          bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'reminder-scheduler.js' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CARE_DAILY    || 'zg_care_package_daily',    bodyVars: 3, usedBy: 'care-package-scheduler.js (not launched)' },
  { name: process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CARE_COMPLETE || 'zg_care_package_complete', bodyVars: 2, usedBy: 'care-package-scheduler.js (not launched)' },
];

const RED = '\x1b[31m', GREEN = '\x1b[32m', YELLOW = '\x1b[33m', DIM = '\x1b[2m', BOLD = '\x1b[1m', OFF = '\x1b[0m';
const problems = [];
const warnings = [];

function head(s) { console.log(`\n${BOLD}${s}${OFF}\n${'-'.repeat(s.length)}`); }
function good(s) { console.log(`  ${GREEN}PASS${OFF}  ${s}`); }
function bad(s)  { console.log(`  ${RED}FAIL${OFF}  ${s}`); problems.push(s); }
function warn(s) { console.log(`  ${YELLOW}WARN${OFF}  ${s}`); warnings.push(s); }

function countParams(text) {
  const m = String(text || '').match(/\{\{\s*(\d+)\s*\}\}/g) || [];
  return m.reduce((mx, x) => Math.max(mx, parseInt(x.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 0), 0);
}

async function graph(url) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` } });
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return { ok: res.ok && !data.error, status: res.status, data };
}

(async () => {
  console.log(`${BOLD}ZivoGift WhatsApp preflight${OFF}  ${DIM}(Graph ${GRAPH})${OFF}`);

  // ── 1. Env ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  head('1. Environment variables');
  if (TOKEN) good('WHATSAPP_TOKEN is set'); else bad('WHATSAPP_TOKEN is NOT set — nothing can send.');
  if (PHONE_ID) good('WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID is set'); else bad('WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID is NOT set — nothing can send.');
  if (WABA_ID) good('WHATSAPP_WABA_ID is set'); else bad('WHATSAPP_WABA_ID is NOT set — template auditing is impossible and the code has to guess payload shapes.');
  if (process.env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET) good('WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is set (webhook can verify Meta signatures)');
  else warn('WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is NOT set — the webhook rejects every inbound call, so you get NO delivery receipts and condition-gift keywords never work.');

  if (!TOKEN || !PHONE_ID) { summarize(); return; }

  // ── 2. Token + phone number ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  head('2. Token and sending number');
  const num = await graph(`https://graph.facebook.com/${GRAPH}/${PHONE_ID}` +
    `?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,throughput`);
  if (!num.ok) {
    bad(`Could not read the phone number: ${num.data.error ? num.data.error.message : 'HTTP ' + num.status}`);
    if (num.data.error && num.data.error.code === 190) {
      bad('Token is invalid or expired. Generate a permanent System User token with whatsapp_business_messaging + whatsapp_business_management.');
    }
  } else {
    const d = num.data;
    good(`Number ${d.display_phone_number} ("${d.verified_name}") is reachable with this token`);
    if (d.code_verification_status && d.code_verification_status !== 'VERIFIED') {
      bad(`Number verification status is ${d.code_verification_status}, not VERIFIED. An unregistered number cannot send.`);
    } else {
      good('Number is VERIFIED');
    }
    if (d.quality_rating && !['GREEN', 'UNKNOWN'].includes(String(d.quality_rating).toUpperCase())) {
      warn(`Quality rating is ${d.quality_rating}. A YELLOW/RED number gets throttled and messages silently undelivered.`);
    } else {
      good(`Quality rating: ${d.quality_rating || 'UNKNOWN (normal for a new number)'}`);
    }
    if (d.platform_type) console.log(`  ${DIM}platform: ${d.platform_type}${OFF}`);
  }

  // ── 3. Templates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  head('3. Template audit (declared shape vs. what the code sends)');
  let catalogue = [];
  if (!WABA_ID) {
    warn('Skipped — WHATSAPP_WABA_ID not set.');
  } else {
    let url = `https://graph.facebook.com/${GRAPH}/${WABA_ID}/message_templates?fields=name,language,status,category,components&limit=100`;
    let pageCount = 0;
    while (url && pageCount < 10) {
      const r = await graph(url);
      if (!r.ok) {
        bad(`Template list failed: ${r.data.error ? r.data.error.message : 'HTTP ' + r.status}`);
        if (r.data.error && r.data.error.code === 200) {
          bad('Token lacks whatsapp_business_management permission, or WHATSAPP_WABA_ID is wrong.');
        }
        break;
      }
      catalogue = catalogue.concat(r.data.data || []);
      url = r.data.paging && r.data.paging.next ? r.data.paging.next : null;
      pageCount += 1;
    }

    if (catalogue.length) {
      console.log(`  ${DIM}Found ${catalogue.length} template(s) on the WABA.${OFF}\n`);
      for (const exp of EXPECTED) {
        const found = catalogue.find((t) => t.name === exp.name);
        const tag = exp.critical ? ' [CRITICAL]' : '';
        if (!found) {
          const msg = `${exp.name}${tag} — NOT FOUND on this WABA. Used by ${exp.usedBy}.`;
          if (exp.critical) bad(msg); else warn(msg);
          continue;
        }
        const body = (found.components || []).find((c) => String(c.type).toUpperCase() === 'BODY');
        const header = (found.components || []).find((c) => String(c.type).toUpperCase() === 'HEADER');
        const actual = body ? countParams(body.text) : 0;
        const issues = [];
        if (String(found.status).toUpperCase() !== 'APPROVED') issues.push(`status=${found.status}`);
        if (actual !== exp.bodyVars) issues.push(`template wants ${actual} body var(s), code sends ${exp.bodyVars}`);

        const hdr = header ? String(header.format || 'TEXT').toUpperCase() : 'none';
        if (issues.length) {
          const msg = `${exp.name}${tag} — ${issues.join('; ')}  ${DIM}(lang=${found.language}, header=${hdr})${OFF}`;
          if (exp.critical) bad(msg); else warn(msg);
        } else {
          good(`${exp.name}${tag} — OK  ${DIM}(lang=${found.language}, ${actual} body vars, header=${hdr})${OFF}`);
        }
      }

      const known = new Set(EXPECTED.map((e) => e.name));
      const extra = catalogue.map((t) => t.name).filter((n) => !known.has(n));
      if (extra.length) console.log(`\n  ${DIM}Also on the WABA (not used by code): ${[...new Set(extra)].join(', ')}${OFF}`);
    }
  }

  // ── 4. Header image reachability ─────────────────────────────────────────
  head('4. Card image URL (the silent WhatsApp killer)');
  console.log(`  ${DIM}WhatsApp REJECTS an entire template message if it cannot download the`);
  console.log(`  header image. Email delivers anyway with a broken <img>. That asymmetry`);
  console.log(`  is a classic "email works, WhatsApp doesn't".${OFF}\n`);

  if (!R2_PUBLIC_URL) {
    bad('R2_PUBLIC_URL is NOT set. _lib/r2Client.js then builds card URLs from ' +
        'https://{bucket}.{account}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com — that is the AUTHENTICATED S3 ' +
        'endpoint, which returns 401 to Meta. Set R2_PUBLIC_URL to your public r2.dev URL or custom domain.');
  } else if (!/^https:\/\//i.test(R2_PUBLIC_URL)) {
    bad(`R2_PUBLIC_URL is "${R2_PUBLIC_URL}" — Meta only fetches over HTTPS.`);
  } else if (/r2\.cloudflarestorage\.com/i.test(R2_PUBLIC_URL)) {
    bad(`R2_PUBLIC_URL points at r2.cloudflarestorage.com, the authenticated S3 endpoint. ` +
        `Meta cannot read it. Use your public r2.dev bucket URL or a custom domain.`);
  } else {
    good(`R2_PUBLIC_URL looks public: ${R2_PUBLIC_URL}`);
    try {
      const probe = await fetch(R2_PUBLIC_URL.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/preflight-probe-nonexistent.png', { method: 'GET' });
      // 404 is the CORRECT answer here: the bucket is publicly readable and
      // simply has no such object. 401/403 means anonymous reads are blocked,
      // which is precisely what breaks Meta.
      if (probe.status === 404) good('Bucket answers anonymous requests with 404 — public reads are enabled.');
      else if (probe.status === 401 || probe.status === 403) bad(`Bucket returned ${probe.status} to an anonymous request — public read access is OFF. Meta will not be able to fetch card images. Enable public access (r2.dev) or attach a custom domain.`);
      else console.log(`  ${DIM}Probe returned HTTP ${probe.status} — inconclusive, but not an auth block.${OFF}`);
    } catch (e) {
      warn(`Could not probe the bucket: ${e.message}`);
    }
  }
  console.log(`\n  ${DIM}Note: the shipped _lib/whatsapp.js now auto-retries WITHOUT the image if`);
  console.log(`  Meta cannot fetch it, so gifts still arrive — just without the card art.${OFF}`);

  // ── 5. Optional real send ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sendIdx = process.argv.indexOf('--send');
  if (sendIdx !== -1 && process.argv[sendIdx + 1]) {
    head('5. Live send test');
    let to = String(process.argv[sendIdx + 1]).replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (to.length === 10) to = '91' + to;
    const tplName = process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME || 'zivogift_birthday_surprise';
    const tpl = catalogue.find((t) => t.name === tplName);
    const bodyC = tpl ? (tpl.components || []).find((c) => String(c.type).toUpperCase() === 'BODY') : null;
    const varCount = bodyC ? countParams(bodyC.text) : 2;
    const lang = tpl ? tpl.language : 'en_US';

    const params = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < varCount; i += 1) params.push({ type: 'text', text: i === 0 ? 'ZivoGift' : 'Preflight test - if you can read this, WhatsApp works.' });

    const payload = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to,
      type: 'template',
      template: { name: tplName, language: { code: lang }, components: params.length ? [{ type: 'body', parameters: params }] : [] },
    };
    console.log(`  ${DIM}Sending "${tplName}" (lang=${lang}, ${varCount} vars, no image) to ${to}...${OFF}`);
    const res = await fetch(`https://graph.facebook.com/${GRAPH}/${PHONE_ID}/messages`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (res.ok && !data.error) {
      good(`Meta ACCEPTED the message (id ${data.messages && data.messages[0] && data.messages[0].id}).`);
      console.log(`  ${YELLOW}Now check the handset.${OFF} Acceptance is NOT delivery — if it does not arrive,`);
      console.log(`  the cause is downstream (number quality, user never opted in, or Meta policy).`);
    } else {
      const e = data.error || {};
      bad(`Send REJECTED: ${e.message} (code ${e.code})${e.error_data && e.error_data.details ? ' — ' + e.error_data.details : ''}`);
    }
  } else {
    head('5. Live send test');
    console.log(`  ${DIM}Skipped. Re-run with:  node tools/wa-preflight.js --send 9876543210${OFF}`);
  }

  summarize();
})();

function summarize() {
  head('VERDICT');
  if (!problems.length && !warnings.length) {
    console.log(`  ${GREEN}${BOLD}All checks passed.${OFF} WhatsApp is configured correctly — deploy with confidence.`);
  } else {
    if (problems.length) {
      console.log(`  ${RED}${BOLD}${problems.length} blocking problem(s) — fix these BEFORE you deploy:${OFF}`);
      problems.forEach((p, i) => console.log(`    ${i + 1}. ${p.replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m/g, '')}`));
    }
    if (warnings.length) {
      console.log(`\n  ${YELLOW}${warnings.length} warning(s) — not fatal, but read them:${OFF}`);
      warnings.forEach((w, i) => console.log(`    ${i + 1}. ${w.replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m/g, '')}`));
    }
  }
  console.log('');
  process.exit(problems.length ? 1 : 0);
}
